V_BIS_DEPT.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "HIS"."V_BIS_DEPT" ("DEPT_CODE", "DEPT_NAME", "DEPT_TYPE", "HOSPITAL_CODE", "PARENTDEPT_CODE") AS 
  SELECT a.dept_code AS dept_code --科室代码
, a.dept_name AS dept_name --科室名称
,
CASE WHEN a.OUTP_OR_INP = 1 THEN '1'
     WHEN a.outp_or_inp IN('1','2') AND a.clinic_attr NOT IN('0','1') THEN '2'
     WHEN a.clinic_attr = 1 AND a.internal_or_sergery = 9 THEN '3'
     WHEN a.clinic_attr = 0 AND a.outp_or_inp = 1 AND a.internal_or_sergery = 9
     AND a.dept_name NOT LIKE '%麻醉%' AND a.dept_name NOT LIKE '%营养科%' THEN '4' 
     ELSE '99' 
END AS dept_type -- 科室类别：01=临床科室、02=护理单元、03=医技科室、04=手术室、99=其他
, a.hospital_value AS hospital_code --所属院区代码
, SUBSTR(REPLACE(a.dept_code, 'H', ''), 1, LENGTH(REPLACE(a.dept_code, 'H', '')) - 2) AS parentdept_code --上级科室代码
FROM dept_dict a 
WHERE a.stop_flag IS NULL 
  AND a.dept_code NOT LIKE '%H%'  /* GOLDENGATE_DDL_REPLICATION */

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "HIS"."V_BIS_FEEITEM" ("ITEM_CLASS", "ITEM_NAME", "ITEM_CODE", "ITEM_PRICE", "HIS_CLASS", "DEPT_NAME", "ITEM_SPEC") AS 
  SELECT a.item_class as item_class,--类别
       a.ITEM_NAME as item_name,-- 检验项目名称
       a.ITEM_CODE as item_code,-- 检验项目代码
       a.PRICE as item_price,      --项目单价
       a.CLASS_ON_MR as his_class, --归类
         b.dept_name  as  DEPT_NAME,   --执行科室
        a.ITEM_SPEC   --单位
  from  price_list  a
  left join dept_dict b on b.dept_code =a.PERFORMED_BY
  where
a.ITEM_CLASS in ('C','H','I') AND a.STOP_DATE is null
or a.ITEM_NAME ='血液除滤费'  /* GOLDENGATE_DDL_REPLICATION */

V_BIS_PATS_IN_HOSPITAL.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "HIS"."V_BIS_PATS_IN_HOSPITAL" ("HOSPITAL_CODE", "PAT_ID", "VISIT_ID", "INP_NO", "PAT_CARDNO", "TIMES", "INP_DATE", "PAT_NAME", "PAT_SEX", "PAT_BIRTH", "PAT_AGE_DESC", "CHARGE_TYPENO", "REQ_DOCNO", "REQ_DEPTNO", "REQ_WARDNO", "REQ_BEDNO", "PAT_DIAG_NAME", "PAT_DIAG_CODE", "PAT_ADDRESS", "PAT_CONTRY", "PAT_IDCARDNO", "PAT_LOCALITY", "PAT_HEIGHT", "WEIGHT", "BLD_TRANSFUSED", "BLD_PREGNANCYED", "BLD_PREGCOUNT", "BLD_BIRTHCOUNT", "PAT_NATION", "DRGS_CODE", "DRGS_NAME") AS 
  select
b.hospital_value as hospital_code                 --所在院区
,a.patient_id as pat_id                           --患者id
,a.visit_id as visit_id                           --就诊号
,c.inp_no as inp_no                            --住院号  
,a.patient_id as pat_cardno                            --需要确认一下卡表
,a.visit_id as times                              --就诊次数
,a.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME as inp_date                -- 入院日期
,c.name as pat_name                               --患者姓名
,c.sex as pat_sex                                 --性别
,c.date_of_birth as pat_birth                     --出生日期
,TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, c.date_of_birth) / 12)  as pat_age_desc -- 年龄
,d.charge_type as charge_typeno           --收费类型，关联 v_bis_feetype 视图
,d.ATTENDING_DOCTOR as req_docno
,a.dept_code as req_deptno                        --科室代码
,a.ward_code as req_wardno                        --病区代码
,a.bed_no as req_bedno                            --床号
,a.diagnosis as pat_diag_name                     --临床诊断
,a.DIAGNOSIS_CODE as pat_diag_code                --诊断的ICD10编码
,d.PATIENT_AREA_ADDRESS as pat_address            --地址
,c.citizenship as pat_contry                      --国籍
,c.ID_NO as pat_idcardno                          --身份证号
， cast(case when c.ID_NO is not null and length(c.ID_NO) >= 4 and substr(c.ID_NO, 1, 4) = '3701' then '本埠' else '外埠' end as varchar(8)) as pat_locality   --属地
,d.ADULT_HEIGHT as pat_height                      --身高
,d.ADULT_WEIGHT as weight                          --体重
,d.BLOOD_TRAN_TIMES as bld_transfused              --既往有输血史
,'' as bld_pregnancyed                             --既往有妊娠史
,'' as bld_pregcount                               --孕育次数
,'' as bld_birthcount                              --生产次数
,c.NATION as pat_nation                                  --病人民族
,'' as drgs_code                                         --单病种编码
,'' as drgs_name                                         --单病种名称
from pats_in_hospital a
inner join dept_dict b on a.dept_code=b.dept_code
inner join pat_master_index c on a.patient_id=c.patient_id
inner join pat_visit d on a.patient_id=d.patient_id and a.visit_id=d.visit_id
where a.ward_code is not null  /* GOLDENGATE_DDL_REPLICATION */

,a.VISIT_NO as visit_id                           --门诊号

,a.doctor as req_docno                          --主管医生

V_BI_DRMZCJFY.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "HIS"."V_BI_DRMZCJFY" ("科室名称", "门诊科室次均费用", "全院次均费用") AS 
  WITH daily_clinic AS (
    -- 获取今日各科室门诊人次
    SELECT
        NVL(b.dept_name, '其他科室') AS 科室名称,
        NVL(b.dept_code, 'OTHER') AS 科室编码,
        COUNT(*) AS 门诊人次
    FROM clinic_master a
    LEFT JOIN dept_dict b ON a.VISIT_DEPT = b.dept_code
    WHERE a.registering_date >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
      AND a.registering_date < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1
      AND a.returned_date IS NULL
    GROUP BY b.dept_name, b.dept_code
),
daily_income AS (
    -- 获取今日各科室门诊收入
    SELECT
        NVL(b.dept_name, '其他科室') AS 科室名称,
        NVL(b.dept_code, 'OTHER') AS 科室编码,
        ROUND(SUM(a.COSTS), 4) AS 门诊收入
    FROM OUTP_BILL_ITEMS a
    LEFT JOIN dept_dict b ON a.ORDERED_BY_DEPT = b.dept_code
    WHERE a.visit_date >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
      AND a.visit_date < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1
    GROUP BY b.dept_name, b.dept_code
),
combined AS (
    -- 合并人次与收入（FULL JOIN 确保两边都有数据）
    SELECT
        NVL(c.科室名称, i.科室名称) AS 科室名称,
        NVL(c.科室编码, i.科室编码) AS 科室编码,
        NVL(c.门诊人次, 0) AS 门诊人次,
        NVL(i.门诊收入, 0) AS 门诊收入
    FROM daily_clinic c
    FULL JOIN daily_income i
        ON c.科室编码 = i.科室编码
),
totals AS (
    -- 计算全院总人次和总收入
    SELECT
        SUM(门诊人次) AS total_人次,
        SUM(门诊收入) AS total_收入
    FROM combined
)
-- 最终结果
SELECT
    c.科室名称,
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN c.门诊人次 = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE c.门诊收入 / c.门诊人次
        END,
        2
    ) AS 门诊科室次均费用,
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN t.total_人次 = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE t.total_收入 / t.total_人次
        END,
        2
    ) AS 全院次均费用
FROM combined c
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY 门诊科室次均费用 DESC
  /* GOLDENGATE_DDL_REPLICATION */

V_BI_INP_FEE_BASE.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "HIS"."V_BI_INP_FEE_BASE" ("PATIENT_ID", "VISIT_ID", "ITEM_CLASS", "ITEM_CODE", "ITEM_NAME", "COSTS", "BILLING_DATE_TIME", "PERFORMED_BY", "STAT_DEPT_CODE", "STAT_DEPT_NAME", "INCOME_CATEGORY_L1") AS 
  SELECT
    a.PATIENT_ID,
    a.VISIT_ID,
    a.ITEM_CLASS,
    a.ITEM_CODE,
    a.ITEM_NAME,
    NVL(a.COSTS, 0) AS COSTS,
    a.BILLING_DATE_TIME,
    a.PERFORMED_BY,
    /* 先按开单科室作为统计科室，可按你院口径再调整 */
    a.PERFORMED_BY AS STAT_DEPT_CODE,
    d.DEPT_NAME    AS STAT_DEPT_NAME,
    /* 第一版收入分类，后续你核查后再细化 */
    CASE
        WHEN a.ITEM_CLASS IN ('A','B') THEN '药品收入'
        WHEN a.ITEM_CLASS = 'I' THEN '服务设施收入'
        ELSE '诊疗收入'
    END AS INCOME_CATEGORY_L1
FROM INP_BILL_DETAIL a
LEFT JOIN DEPT_DICT d
  ON a.ORDERED_BY = d.DEPT_CODE
  /* GOLDENGATE_DDL_REPLICATION */

V_BI_ZYCJFY.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "HIS"."V_BI_ZYCJFY" ("科室名称", "住院收入_元", "在院人次", "在院次均费用_元") AS 
  WITH
-- 1. 今日各科室住院收入（万元）
daily_income AS (
    SELECT
        NVL(b.dept_name, '未知科室') AS 科室名称,
        NVL(b.dept_code, 'OTHER') AS dept_code,
        ROUND(SUM(a.COSTS) , 3) AS 住院收入_元
    FROM INP_BILL_DETAIL a
    LEFT JOIN dept_dict b ON a.ORDERED_BY = b.dept_code
    INNER JOIN pats_in_hospital c
        ON a.patient_id = c.patient_id
        AND a.visit_id = c.visit_id
    WHERE
        a.BILLING_DATE_TIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
        AND a.BILLING_DATE_TIME < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1
    GROUP BY b.dept_name, b.dept_code
),
-- 2. 各科室当前在院人次
current_patients AS (
    SELECT
        NVL(b.dept_name, '未知科室') AS 科室名称,
        NVL(b.dept_code, 'OTHER') AS dept_code,
        COUNT(*) AS 在院人次
    FROM pats_in_hospital a
    LEFT JOIN dept_dict b ON a.DEPT_CODE = b.dept_code
    WHERE a.WARD_CODE IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.dept_name, b.dept_code
)
-- 3. 合并计算次均费用
SELECT
    NVL(i.科室名称, p.科室名称) AS 科室名称,
    NVL(i.住院收入_元, 0) AS 住院收入_元,
    NVL(p.在院人次, 0) AS 在院人次,
    CASE
        WHEN NVL(p.在院人次, 0) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE ROUND(i.住院收入_元  / p.在院人次, 2)  -- 转回元，再求次均
    END AS 在院次均费用_元
FROM daily_income i
FULL JOIN current_patients p
    ON i.dept_code = p.dept_code
ORDER BY 在院次均费用_元 DESC
  /* GOLDENGATE_DDL_REPLICATION */

V_BI_ZYPJZYR.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "HIS"."V_BI_ZYPJZYR" ("科室名称", "平均住院日") AS

    ROUND(AVG(SYSDATE - a.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME), 2) AS 平均住院日
FROM pats_in_hospital a
LEFT JOIN dept_dict b ON a.DEPT_CODE = b.dept_code
WHERE
    a.WARD_CODE IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY b.dept_name
ORDER BY 平均住院日 DESC
  /* GOLDENGATE_DDL_REPLICATION */

V_CYBR.ddl:

    select
        patient_id,
        visit_id,
        diagnosis_desc
    from his.diagnosis
    where diagnosis_type   = '2'
      and diagnosis_no     = '1'
),

diag_out as (
    select
        patient_id,
        visit_id,
        diagnosis_desc
    from his.diagnosis
    where diagnosis_type = '3'
      and diagnosis_no   = '1'
)
select
    a.patient_id as 患者ID,
    a.visit_id as 次数,
    c.inp_no as 住院号,
    c.name as 患者姓名,
    c.date_of_birth as 出生日期,
    c.sex as 性别,
     round((a.admission_date_time- c.date_of_birth)/365) 年龄,
    a.admission_date_time as 入院日期,
    a.discharge_date_time as 出院日期,
    e.diagnosis_desc as 入院诊断,
    '' as 入院病情,
    a.doctor_in_charge as 管床医生编号,
    g.NAME 管床医生,
    a.consulting_doctor as 门诊医师,
    '' as 护理级别,
    '' as 所在科室编码,
    '' as 所在科室名称,
    '出院' as 是否出院,
    b.dept_code as 入院科室编码,
    b.dept_name as 入院科室名称,
    d.dept_code as 出院科室编码,
    d.dept_name as 出院科室名称,
    f.diagnosis_desc as 出院主诊断,
    (
    select
        diagnosis_desc
    from his.diagnosis o
    where
    o.patient_id = a.patient_id
          and o.visit_id   = a.visit_id  and diagnosis_type = '3'
      and diagnosis_no   = '2'and rownum=1) 出院其他诊断1，
       (
    select
        diagnosis_desc
    from his.diagnosis o
    where
    o.patient_id = a.patient_id
          and o.visit_id   = a.visit_id  and diagnosis_type = '3'
      and diagnosis_no   = '3' and rownum=1) 出院其他诊断2，
       (
    select
        diagnosis_desc
    from his.diagnosis o
    where
    o.patient_id = a.patient_id
          and o.visit_id   = a.visit_id  and diagnosis_type = '3'
      and diagnosis_no   = '4' and rownum=1) 出院其他诊断3，
       (
    select
        diagnosis_desc
    from his.diagnosis o
    where
    o.patient_id = a.patient_id
          and o.visit_id   = a.visit_id  and diagnosis_type = '3'
      and diagnosis_no   = '5' and rownum=1) 出院其他诊断4，
       (
    select
        diagnosis_desc
    from his.diagnosis o
    where
    o.patient_id = a.patient_id
          and o.visit_id   = a.visit_id  and diagnosis_type = '3'
      and diagnosis_no   = '6' and rownum=1) 出院其他诊断5，
    (
        select '手术名称:'|| OPERATION_DESC||',手术编码:'|| OPERATION_CODE||   ',切口愈合等级:'||HEAL||  ',切口等级:'||WOUND_GRADE || ',手术日期:'||OPERATING_DATE
          ||',麻醉方式:'||ANAESTHESIA_METHOD||',手术级别:'||OPERATION_SCALE
        from his.operation o
        where o.patient_id = a.patient_id
          and o.visit_id   = a.visit_id
          and o.operation_no = '1' and rownum=1
    ) as 手术,  (
        select OPERATING_DATE
        from his.operation o
        where o.patient_id = a.patient_id
          and o.visit_id   = a.visit_id
          and o.operation_no = '1' and rownum=1
    )   手术日期,
       (
        select '手术名称:'|| OPERATION_DESC||',手术编码:'|| OPERATION_CODE||   ',切口愈合等级:'||HEAL||  ',切口等级:'||WOUND_GRADE || ',手术日期:'||OPERATING_DATE
          ||',麻醉方式:'||ANAESTHESIA_METHOD||',手术级别:'||OPERATION_SCALE
        from his.operation o
        where o.patient_id = a.patient_id
          and o.visit_id   = a.visit_id
          and o.operation_no = '2' and rownum=1
    ) as 手术1, (
        select OPERATING_DATE
        from his.operation o
        where o.patient_id = a.patient_id
          and o.visit_id   = a.visit_id
          and o.operation_no = '2' and rownum=1
    )   手术日期1,
       (
        select '手术名称:'|| OPERATION_DESC||',手术编码:'|| OPERATION_CODE||   ',切口愈合等级:'||HEAL||  ',切口等级:'||WOUND_GRADE || ',手术日期:'||OPERATING_DATE
          ||',麻醉方式:'||ANAESTHESIA_METHOD||',手术级别:'||OPERATION_SCALE
        from his.operation o
        where o.patient_id = a.patient_id
          and o.visit_id   = a.visit_id
          and o.operation_no = '3' and rownum=1
    ) as 手术2,  (
        select OPERATING_DATE
        from his.operation o
        where o.patient_id = a.patient_id
          and o.visit_id   = a.visit_id
          and o.operation_no = '3' and rownum=1
    )   手术日期2,
       (
        select '手术名称:'|| OPERATION_DESC||',手术编码:'|| OPERATION_CODE||   ',切口愈合等级:'||HEAL||  ',切口等级:'||WOUND_GRADE || ',手术日期:'||OPERATING_DATE
          ||',麻醉方式:'||ANAESTHESIA_METHOD||',手术级别:'||OPERATION_SCALE
        from his.operation o
        where o.patient_id = a.patient_id
          and o.visit_id   = a.visit_id
          and o.operation_no = '4' and rownum=1
    ) as 手术3, (
        select OPERATING_DATE
        from his.operation o
        where o.patient_id = a.patient_id
          and o.visit_id   = a.visit_id
          and o.operation_no = '4' and rownum=1
    )   手术日期3,
       (
        select '手术名称:'|| OPERATION_DESC||',手术编码:'|| OPERATION_CODE||   ',切口愈合等级:'||HEAL||  ',切口等级:'||WOUND_GRADE || ',手术日期:'||OPERATING_DATE
          ||',麻醉方式:'||ANAESTHESIA_METHOD||',手术级别:'||OPERATION_SCALE
        from his.operation o
        where o.patient_id = a.patient_id
          and o.visit_id   = a.visit_id
          and o.operation_no = '5' and rownum=1
    ) as 手术4, (
        select OPERATING_DATE
        from his.operation o
        where o.patient_id = a.patient_id
          and o.visit_id   = a.visit_id
          and o.operation_no = '5' and rownum=1
    )   手术日期4,
      (
        select '手术名称:'|| OPERATION_DESC||',手术编码:'|| OPERATION_CODE||   ',切口愈合等级:'||HEAL||  ',切口等级:'||WOUND_GRADE || ',手术日期:'||OPERATING_DATE
          ||',麻醉方式:'||ANAESTHESIA_METHOD||',手术级别:'||OPERATION_SCALE
        from his.operation o
        where o.patient_id = a.patient_id
          and o.visit_id   = a.visit_id
          and o.operation_no = '6' and rownum=1
    ) as 手术5 , (
        select OPERATING_DATE
        from his.operation o
        where o.patient_id = a.patient_id
          and o.visit_id   = a.visit_id
          and o.operation_no = '6' and rownum=1
    )   手术日期5
from his.pat_visit a
left join his.dept_dict b
       on a.dept_admission_to = b.dept_code
inner join his.pat_master_index c
        on c.patient_id = a.patient_id
inner join his.dept_dict d
        on a.dept_discharge_from = d.dept_code
left join pat_diag_in e
       on e.patient_id = a.patient_id
      and e.visit_id   = a.visit_id
left join diag_out f
       on f.patient_id = a.patient_id
      and f.visit_id   = a.visit_id
      left  join
      his.staff_dict g on g.EMP_NO=a.doctor_in_charge
where a.dept_admission_to not in ('030210','030224','030603','030611','0306','040711','040712','040705')
  and a.dept_discharge_from not in ('030210','030224','030603','030611','0306','040711','040712','040705')
  and a.discharge_date_time >=sysdate-14

DIAGNOSIS_DICT.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "JHEMR"."DIAGNOSIS_DICT" ("XH", "DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "STD_INDICATOR", "APPROVED_INDICATOR", "ICD_FLAG", "BL_DIAG_FLAG", "ZD_DIAG_FLAG", "CREATE_DATE", "INPUT_CODE", "PYM", "WBM", "CONFIRMED_INDICATOR", "CONTAGIOUS", "ISSTOP", "CUSTOM_FLAG", "YB_CODE", "YB_NAME") AS 
  SELECT
       ROWNUM XH,--序号
       DIAGNOSIS_CODE DIAGNOSIS_CODE,          --诊断代码
       DIAGNOSIS_NAME DIAGNOSIS_NAME,          --诊断名称
       STD_INDICATOR STD_INDICATOR,        --正名标志
       APPROVED_INDICATOR APPROVED_INDICATOR,        --标准化标识
       case when STD_INDICATOR = '1' then 'ICD-10'
         else '院标扩展' end ICD_FLAG,--ICD-10标志
       case when DIAGNOSIS_CODE between 'M8000/0' and 'M9999/6' and DIAGNOSIS_CODE not like '%.%'
         then '1' else '0' end BL_DIAG_FLAG,--病理诊断标志..1是。0否。
        case when DIAGNOSIS_CODE like 'V%' then '1'
             when DIAGNOSIS_CODE like 'X%' then '1'
               when DIAGNOSIS_CODE like 'Y%' then '1'
                 when DIAGNOSIS_CODE like 'W%' then '1'
                   else '0' end ZD_DIAG_FLAG,--中毒及外部损伤诊断标志..1是。0否。
       CREATE_DATE CREATE_DATE,        --录入日期
       INPUT_CODE INPUT_CODE,         --输入码
       INPUT_CODE PYM,        --拼音码
       INPUT_CODE_WB WBM,          --五笔码
       '' CONFIRMED_INDICATOR,  --确诊诊断标志
       (CASE FLAG WHEN 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) CONTAGIOUS,        --传染病标志
       STOP_FLAG ISSTOP,        --可用标志
       case when STD_INDICATOR = '1' then 'ICD-10'
         else '院标扩展' end CUSTOM_FLAG,         --是否自定义
       YB_CODE YB_CODE,--医保编码
       YB_NAME YB_NAME--医保名称

 FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS_DICT dd
 where dd.stop_flag = 0

V_BCJL.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "JHEMR"."V_BCJL" ("MRID", "病历内容", "病历创建所在科室", "病历创建所在科室编码", "病历标题时间", "病历日期", "病历创建时间", "病历最后签名时间", "病历名称", "病历创建人编码", "病历创建人", "病历类别", "患者ID", "次数", "护理关联ID", "RN") AS 
  SELECT "MRID","病历内容","病历创建所在科室","病历创建所在科室编码","病历标题时间","病历日期","病历创建时间","病历最后签名时间","病历名称","病历创建人编码",病历创建人,"病历类别","患者ID","次数","护理关联ID","RN"
FROM (
    SELECT
        e.file_unique_id as mrid,
        dbms_lob.substr(f.mr_content, 2000, 1) as 病历内容,
        b.dept_name as 病历创建所在科室,
        b.dept_code as 病历创建所在科室编码,
        e.caption_date_time as 病历标题时间,
        trunc(e.caption_date_time) as 病历日期,
        e.create_date_time as 病历创建时间,
        e.last_modify_date_time as 病历最后签名时间,
        e.topic as 病历名称,
        e.creator_name as 病历创建人,
                         e.CREATOR_ID as 病历创建人编码,

        e.mr_class as 病历类别,
        e.patient_id as 患者ID,
        e.visit_id as 次数,
        e.patient_id || '_' || to_char(e.visit_id) as 护理关联ID,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY e.file_unique_id
            ORDER BY e.last_modify_date_time DESC NULLS LAST
        ) rn

    FROM jhemr.jhmr_file_index e
    LEFT JOIN jhemr.jhmr_file_content_text f
           ON f.file_unique_id = e.file_unique_id
    INNER JOIN his.dept_dict b
           ON e.dept_code = b.dept_code

    WHERE e.file_flag <> 'T'
      AND e.mr_class IN ('EMR10.00.03','EMR10.00.02','EMR10.00.01')
      AND e.topic IS NOT NULL
      AND e.topic NOT LIKE '%会诊记录%'
      AND b.dept_code NOT IN ('030210','030224','030603','030611','0306','040711','040712','040705')
)
WHERE rn = 1

V_BCJL_META.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "JHEMR"."V_BCJL_META" ("MRID", "病历标题时间", "病历创建时间", "病历最后签名时间", "病历名称", "创建人", "病历类别", "患者ID", "次数") AS 
  select
    e.file_unique_id as mrid,
    e.caption_date_time as 病历标题时间,
    e.create_date_time as 病历创建时间,
    e.last_modify_date_time as 病历最后签名时间,
    e.topic as 病历名称,
    e.creator_name as 创建人,
    e.mr_class as 病历类别,
    e.patient_id as 患者ID,
    e.visit_id as 次数
from his.pats_in_hospital a
join jhemr.jhmr_file_index e
  on e.patient_id = a.patient_id
 and e.visit_id   = a.visit_id
where a.dept_code in ('030113','020103')
  and e.file_flag <> 'T'
  and e.mr_class in ('EMR10.00.03','EMR10.00.02','EMR10.00.01')
  and e.topic not like '会诊记录%'

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "JHEMR"."V_CYBR" ("患者ID", "次数", "住院号", "患者姓名", "出生日期", "性别", "年龄", "入院日期", "出院日期", "入院诊断", "入院病情", "管床医生编号", "管床医生", "门诊医师", "护理级别", "所在科室编码", "所在科室名称", "是否出院", "入院科室编码", "入院科室名称", "出院科室编码", "出院科室名称", "出院主诊断", "出院其他诊断1", "出院其他诊断2", "出院其他诊断3", "出院其他诊断4", "出院其他诊断5", "手术", "手术日期", "手术1", "手术日期1", "手术2", "手术日期2", "手术3", "手术日期3", "手术4", "手术日期4", "手术5", "手术日期5") AS 
  with pat_diag_in as (
    select
        patient_id,
        visit_id,
        diagnosis_desc
    from his.diagnosis
    where diagnosis_type   = '2'
      and diagnosis_no     = '1'
),

diag_out as (
    select
        patient_id,
        visit_id,
        diagnosis_desc
    from his.diagnosis
    where diagnosis_type = '3'
      and diagnosis_no   = '1'
)
select
    a.patient_id as 患者ID,
    a.visit_id as 次数,
    c.inp_no as 住院号,
    c.name as 患者姓名,
    c.date_of_birth as 出生日期,
    c.sex as 性别,
     round((a.admission_date_time- c.date_of_birth)/365) 年龄,
    a.admission_date_time as 入院日期,
    a.discharge_date_time as 出院日期,
    e.diagnosis_desc as 入院诊断,
    '' as 入院病情,
    a.doctor_in_charge as 管床医生编号,
    g.NAME 管床医生,
    a.consulting_doctor as 门诊医师,
    '' as 护理级别,
    '' as 所在科室编码,
    '' as 所在科室名称,
    '出院' as 是否出院,
    b.dept_code as 入院科室编码,
    b.dept_name as 入院科室名称,
    d.dept_code as 出院科室编码,
    d.dept_name as 出院科室名称,
    f.diagnosis_desc as 出院主诊断,
    (
    select
        diagnosis_desc
    from his.diagnosis o
    where
    o.patient_id = a.patient_id
          and o.visit_id   = a.visit_id  and diagnosis_type = '3'
      and diagnosis_no   = '2'and rownum=1) 出院其他诊断1，
       (
    select
        diagnosis_desc
    from his.diagnosis o
    where
    o.patient_id = a.patient_id
          and o.visit_id   = a.visit_id  and diagnosis_type = '3'
      and diagnosis_no   = '3' and rownum=1) 出院其他诊断2，
       (
    select
        diagnosis_desc
    from his.diagnosis o
    where
    o.patient_id = a.patient_id
          and o.visit_id   = a.visit_id  and diagnosis_type = '3'
      and diagnosis_no   = '4' and rownum=1) 出院其他诊断3，
       (
    select
        diagnosis_desc
    from his.diagnosis o
    where
    o.patient_id = a.patient_id
          and o.visit_id   = a.visit_id  and diagnosis_type = '3'
      and diagnosis_no   = '5' and rownum=1) 出院其他诊断4，
       (
    select
        diagnosis_desc
    from his.diagnosis o
    where
    o.patient_id = a.patient_id
          and o.visit_id   = a.visit_id  and diagnosis_type = '3'
      and diagnosis_no   = '6' and rownum=1) 出院其他诊断5，
    (
        select '手术名称:'|| OPERATION_DESC||',手术编码:'|| OPERATION_CODE||   ',切口愈合等级:'||HEAL||  ',切口等级:'||WOUND_GRADE || ',手术日期:'||OPERATING_DATE

          ||',麻醉方式:'||ANAESTHESIA_METHOD||',手术级别:'||OPERATION_SCALE

from his.pat_visit a
left join his.dept_dict b
       on a.dept_admission_to = b.dept_code
inner join his.pat_master_index c
        on c.patient_id = a.patient_id
inner join his.dept_dict d
        on a.dept_discharge_from = d.dept_code
left join pat_diag_in e
       on e.patient_id = a.patient_id
      and e.visit_id   = a.visit_id
left join diag_out f
       on f.patient_id = a.patient_id
      and f.visit_id   = a.visit_id
      left  join

V_ZYBR.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "JHEMR"."V_ZYBR" ("患者ID", "次数", "住院号", "患者姓名", "出生日期", "性别", "年龄", "入院日期", "出院日期", "入院诊断", "入院病情", "管床医生编号", "管床医生", "门诊医师", "护理级别", "所在科室编码", "所在科室名称", "是否出院", "入院科室编码", "入院科室名称", "出院科室编码", "出院科室名称", "出院主诊断", "出院其他诊断1", "出院其他诊断2", "出院其他诊断3", "出院其他诊断4", "出院其他诊断5", "手术", "手术日期", "手术1", "手术日期1", "手术2", "手术日期2", "手术3", "手术日期3", "手术4", "手术日期4", "手术5", "手术日期5") AS 
  select
    a.patient_id as 患者ID,
    a.visit_id as 次数,
    c.inp_no as 住院号,
    c.name as 患者姓名,
    c.date_of_birth as 出生日期,
    c.sex as 性别,
         round((a.admission_date_time- c.date_of_birth)/365) 年龄,

    a.admission_date_time as 入院日期,
    d.discharge_date_time as 出院日期,
    a.diagnosis as 入院诊断,
    case a.patient_condition
        when '1' then '病危'
        when '2' then '病重'
        when '3' then '普通'
        else null
    end as 入院病情,
    nvl( f.emp_no,   a.doctor_in_charge) as 管床医生编号,

    a.doctor_in_charge as 管床医生,
    d.consulting_doctor as 门诊医师,
    case a.nursing_class
        when '0' then '特级护理'
        when '1' then '一级护理'
        when '2' then '二级护理'
        when '3' then '三级护理'
        else null
    end as 护理级别,
    b.dept_code as 所在科室编码,
    b.dept_name as 所在科室名称,
    '在院' as 是否出院,
    e.dept_code as 入院科室编码,
    e.dept_name as 入院科室名称,
    '' as 出院科室编码,
    '' as 出院科室名称,
    '' as 出院主诊断,
        NULL AS 出院其他诊断1,
    NULL AS 出院其他诊断2,
    NULL AS 出院其他诊断3,
    NULL AS 出院其他诊断4,
    NULL AS 出院其他诊断5,
        '' as 手术,
    NULL AS 手术日期,
    NULL AS 手术1,
    NULL AS 手术日期1,
    NULL AS 手术2,
    NULL AS 手术日期2,
    NULL AS 手术3,
    NULL AS 手术日期3,
    NULL AS 手术4,
    NULL AS 手术日期4,
    NULL AS 手术5,
    NULL AS 手术日期5

from his.pats_in_hospital a
inner join his.dept_dict b
        on a.dept_code = b.dept_code
inner join his.pat_master_index c
        on c.patient_id = a.patient_id
inner join his.pat_visit d
        on d.patient_id = a.patient_id
       and d.visit_id   = a.visit_id
left join his.dept_dict e
       on d.dept_admission_to = e.dept_code
       left join his.staff_dict f on f.name=a.doctor_in_charge
where b.dept_code not in ('030210','030224','030603','030611','0306','040711','040712','040705')

V_ZY_PATIENTINFO.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "JHEMR"."V_ZY_PATIENTINFO" ("PATIENTNO", "CLINICTIMES", "NAME", "SEX", "BIRTHDAY", "AGE", "DIAGNOSE", "TEL", "NURSINGLEVEL", "PAT_ID", "HISTORYEFFECT_TXT", "FAMILYEFFECT_TXT", "NATION", "WEIGHT", "DEPTCODE", "DEPT", "CLINICDATE", "DOCTORCODE", "DOCTOR", "BEDNO", "DISDATE") AS 
  select
    /* 住院号 */
    p.inp_no as patientno,

    /* 住院次数 */
    to_char(a.visit_id) as Clinictimes,

    /* 姓名 */
    p.name as name,

    /* 性别：1男 2女 9不详 */
    case
        when p.sex in ('男','1','男性') then '1'
        when p.sex in ('女','2','女性') then '2'
        else '9'
    end as sex,

    /* 出生日期 */
    to_char(p.date_of_birth, 'yyyy-mm-dd') as Birthday,

    /* 年龄 */
    case
        when p.date_of_birth is not null
         and nvl(a.admission_date_time, a.discharge_date_time) is not null
        then to_char(trunc(months_between(nvl(a.admission_date_time, a.discharge_date_time), p.date_of_birth) / 12))
        else ''
    end as age,

    /* 疾病名称：优先取出院主诊断，没有则取入院主诊断 */
    nvl(
        (
            select max(d1.diagnosis_desc)
              from his.diagnosis d1
             where d1.patient_id = a.patient_id
               and d1.visit_id = a.visit_id
               and d1.diagnosis_type = '3'
               and d1.diagnosis_no = '1'
        ),
        (
            select max(d2.diagnosis_desc)
              from his.diagnosis d2
             where d2.patient_id = a.patient_id
               and d2.visit_id = a.visit_id
               and d2.diagnosis_type = '2'
               and d2.diagnosis_no = '1'
        )
    ) as Diagnose,

    /* 联系方式 */
    p.next_of_kin_phone as Tel,

    /* 护理级别：来源暂不明确，先置空 */
    '' as nursinglevel,

    /* 患者ID */
    a.patient_id as pat_id,

    /* 既往史：先定位“既往史”，再截取附近内容，避免前2000字截不到 */
    nvl(
        nullif(
            trim(
                regexp_replace(
                    regexp_substr(
                        dbms_lob.substr(
                            ct.mr_content,
                            1500,
                            greatest(dbms_lob.instr(ct.mr_content, '既往史'), 1)
                        ),
                        '既[[:space:]]*往[[:space:]]*史[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(个人史|个人史、婚育史|婚育史|月经及婚育史|月经生育史|家族史|体[[:space:]]*格[[:space:]]*检[[:space:]]*查)',
                        1,
                        1,
                        'n',
                        1
                    ),
                    '[[:space:]]+',
                    ' '
                )
            ),
            ''
        ),
        ''
    ) as historyeffect_txt,

    /* 家族史：先定位“家族史”，再截取附近内容 */
    nvl(
        nullif(
            trim(
                regexp_replace(
                    regexp_substr(
                        dbms_lob.substr(
                            ct.mr_content,
                            1200,
                            greatest(dbms_lob.instr(ct.mr_content, '家族史'), 1)
                        ),
                        '家[[:space:]]*族[[:space:]]*史[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(体[[:space:]]*格[[:space:]]*检[[:space:]]*查|辅[[:space:]]*助[[:space:]]*检[[:space:]]*查|表格<生命体征>|初步诊断|入院诊断|医师签名|病史记录属实|上述内容记录属实)',
                        1,
                        1,
                        'n',
                        1
                    ),
                    '[[:space:]]+',
                    ' '
                )
            ),
            ''
        ),
        ''
    ) as familyeffect_txt,

    /* 民族：来源暂不明确，先置空 */
    '' as nation,

    /* 体重：兼容“体重75kg / WT 75 / weight 75 / W 75kg” */
    nvl(
        regexp_substr(
            dbms_lob.substr(
                ct.mr_content,
                800,
                case
                    when dbms_lob.instr(ct.mr_content, '表格<生命体征>') > 0
                    then dbms_lob.instr(ct.mr_content, '表格<生命体征>')
                    when dbms_lob.instr(ct.mr_content, '体  格') > 0
                    then dbms_lob.instr(ct.mr_content, '体  格')
                    when dbms_lob.instr(ct.mr_content, '体格检查') > 0
                    then dbms_lob.instr(ct.mr_content, '体格检查')
                    else 1
                end
            ),
            '(体重|WT|Wt|weight)[[:space:]]*[:：]?[[:space:]]*([0-9]{1,3}([.][0-9]+)?)',
            1,
            1,
            'in',
            2
        ),
        nvl(
            regexp_substr(
                dbms_lob.substr(
                    ct.mr_content,
                    800,
                    case
                        when dbms_lob.instr(ct.mr_content, '表格<生命体征>') > 0
                        then dbms_lob.instr(ct.mr_content, '表格<生命体征>')
                        when dbms_lob.instr(ct.mr_content, '体  格') > 0
                        then dbms_lob.instr(ct.mr_content, '体  格')
                        when dbms_lob.instr(ct.mr_content, '体格检查') > 0
                        then dbms_lob.instr(ct.mr_content, '体格检查')
                        else 1
                    end
                ),
                '(^|[[:space:]])W[[:space:]]*([0-9]{1,3}([.][0-9]+)?)',
                1,
                1,
                'in',
                2
            ),
            ''
        )
    ) as weight,

    /* 入院科室代码 */
    nvl(to_char(a.dept_admission_to), '') as deptcode,

    /* 入院科室名称 */
    nvl(
        (
            select max(d.dept_name)
              from his.dept_dict d
             where to_char(d.dept_code) = to_char(a.dept_admission_to)
        ),
        ''
    ) as Dept,

    /* 入院日期 */
    to_char(a.admission_date_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') as Clinicdate,

    /* 主治医生工号：来源字段暂不明确，先置空 */
    a.doctor_in_charge as Doctorcode,

    /* 主治医生姓名：来源字段暂不明确，先置空 */
  (select name from his.staff_dict e where e.emp_no= a.doctor_in_charge) as Doctor,

    /* 床位号：来源字段暂不明确，先置空 */
  a.discharge_bed_no   as Bedno,

    /* 出院日期 */
    to_char(a.discharge_date_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') as Disdate

from his.pat_visit a

left join his.pat_master_index p
       on p.patient_id = a.patient_id

/* 每次住院只取一份入院记录，避免多份文书导致重复 */
left join (
    select *
    from (
        select
            fi.*,
            row_number() over (
                partition by fi.patient_id, fi.visit_id
                order by fi.create_date_time desc nulls last,
                         fi.last_modify_date_time desc nulls last,
                         fi.file_unique_id desc
            ) as rn
        from jhemr.jhmr_file_index fi
        where nvl(fi.delete_flag, '0') <> '1'
          and (
                 fi.file_name like '%入院记录%'
              or fi.topic like '%入院记录%'
          )
    )
    where rn = 1
) b
       on a.patient_id = b.patient_id
      and a.visit_id = b.visit_id

/* 每个 FILE_UNIQUE_ID 只取一条正文，避免正文表一对多导致重复 */
left join (
    select file_unique_id, mr_content
    from (
        select
            c.file_unique_id,
            c.mr_content,
            row_number() over (
                partition by c.file_unique_id
                order by c.rowid
            ) as rn
        from jhemr.jhmr_file_content_text c
    )
    where rn = 1
) ct
       on b.file_unique_id = ct.file_unique_id

where (
        a.admission_date_time >= add_months(trunc(sysdate), -3)
     or a.discharge_date_time >= add_months(trunc(sysdate), -3)
)

A.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "CDA"."A" ("VISIT_TYPE_CODE", "VISIT_TYPE_NAME", "CONTENT_ID", "OUTHOS_NO", "INHOS_NO", "VISIT_ID", "INHOS_NUM", "AUTHOR_CODE", "AUTHOR_NAME", "AUTHOR_TIME", "EFFECTIVETIME", "INHOSP_INDEX_NO", "PAT_ID_NUMBER", "PAT_NAME", "PHYSI_SEX_CODE", "PHYSI_SEX_NAME", "AGE_YEAR", "SURGERY_DELIVERY_DAYS", "ADMIT_DATE", "ACTUAL_INHOSP_DAYS", "BED_NAME", "BED_CODE", "SICKROOM_NAME", "SICKROOM_CODE", "WARD_CODE", "WARD_NAME", "DEPT_CODE", "DEPT_NAME", "DIAG_CODE", "DIAG_NAME", "BREATHING_RATE", "VENTILATOR_FLAG", "PULSE_RATE", "PACEMAKER_RATE", "TEMPERATURE", "SYSTOLIC_PRESSURE", "DIASTOLIC_PRESSURE", "WEIGHT", "AC", "NURSING_OBSERVE_ITEM_NAME", "NURSING_OBSERVE_RESULT") AS 
  select
'02' VISIT_TYPE_CODE   ,--就诊类型 01 门诊  02 住院
'住院' VISIT_TYPE_NAME,--  住院 或者门诊
' '  CONTENT_ID  ,-- 文档流水号，标识一份文档的唯一值
pi.OUTHOS_NO  OUTHOS_NO ,-- 患者门诊号，同一患者多次就诊，门诊号相同
pi.INHOS_NO  INHOS_NO  ,-- 患者住院号，同一患者多次住院，住院号相同
pi.VISIT_ID  VISIT_ID  ,-- 患者就诊/住院流水号，同一患者多次就诊/住院，流水号不同
pi.INHOS_NUM  INHOS_NUM ,-- 住院次数
us.user_code  AUTHOR_CODE ,-- 作者工号
us.user_name  AUTHOR_NAME ,-- 作者姓名
pi.EFFECTIVETIME  AUTHOR_TIME ,-- 创建日期
pi.EFFECTIVETIME  EFFECTIVETIME ,-- 文档生效时间
--p.mrn||p.series  INHOSP_INDEX_NO ,-- 住院号
pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO INHOSP_INDEX_NO ,-- 住院号
pi.PAT_ID_NUMBER  PAT_ID_NUMBER ,-- 患者身份证号
pi.PAT_NAME  PAT_NAME  ,-- 患者姓名
pi.PHYSI_SEX_CODE PHYSI_SEX_CODE  ,-- 患者性别代码
pi.PHYSI_SEX_NAME PHYSI_SEX_NAME  ,-- 患者性别代码
-- (case when p.physi_sex_name='男' then '1' else '2' end)  PHYSI_SEX_CODE  ,-- 患者性别代码
-- p.physi_sex_name  PHYSI_SEX_NAME  ,-- 患者性别名称
pi.AGE_YEAR  AGE_YEAR  ,-- 患者年龄
case when ( round(WSFL.plan_time-
(select e.begin_time from ydhl.mcs_event_info e where event_type  in ('2003','2004')
and e.patient_uid=WSFL.patient_uid and rownum=1),0)+1) >0 then ( round(WSFL.plan_time-
(select e.begin_time from ydhl.mcs_event_info e where event_type  in ('2003','2004')
and e.patient_uid=WSFL.patient_uid and rownum=1),0)+1)
else 0 end  SURGERY_DELIVERY_DAYS ,-- 手术或分娩后天数
 to_char(p.admission_time,'yyyymmddhh24miss')  ADMIT_DATE  ,-- 入院日期时间，日期格式：YYYYMMDDHH24MISS，如20190101235959
ROUND(p.DISCHARGE_DATE-p.admission_time)  ACTUAL_INHOSP_DAYS  ,-- 实际住院天数
pi.BED_NAME  BED_NAME  ,-- 病床名称
pi.BED_CODE  BED_CODE  ,-- 病床代码
-- (select vi.adt_room_no from his.pat_visit vi where vi.patient_id=to_char(substr(p.patient_id,'1','8')) and to_char(vi.visit_id)=to_char(substr(p.patient_id,'10','10')))  SICKROOM_NAME ,-- 病房名称
-- (select vi.adt_room_no from his.pat_visit vi where vi.patient_id=to_char(substr(p.patient_id,'1','8')) and to_char(vi.visit_id)=to_char(substr(p.patient_id,'10','10')))  SICKROOM_CODE ,-- 病房代码
'-' SICKROOM_NAME ,-- 病房名称
'-' SICKROOM_CODE ,-- 病房代码
pi.ward_code  WARD_CODE ,-- 病区代码
pi.ward_name  WARD_NAME ,-- 病区名称
pi.dept_code  DEPT_CODE ,-- 科室代码
pi.dept_name  DEPT_NAME ,-- 科室名称
nvl(nvl(zd.ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_CODE,
(select cd.国标编码 from cda.cda_dictionary cd where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码' and cd.系统标识='HIS'and cd.院标名称=dd.diagnosis_desc and rownum = 1)),'Z00.000')  DIAG_CODE ,-- 西医诊断代码
nvl(nvl(zd.ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_NAME,
(select cd.国标名称 from cda.cda_dictionary cd where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码' and cd.系统标识='HIS'and cd.院标名称=dd.diagnosis_desc and rownum = 1)),'一般性医学检查') DIAG_NAME ,-- 西医诊断名称
nvl(TO_CHAR(r.BREATHING_RATE,'FM9999999'),'0')  BREATHING_RATE  ,-- 呼吸频率，患者单位时间内呼吸次数的测量值，计量单位为次/min
(case
when (SELECT A.VITALSIGN_SVAL2   FROM ydhl.mcs_vital_info A WHERE A.vitalsign_type='1004' AND A.PATIENT_UID=wsfl.PATIENT_UID
  and a.is_valid='1'   and a.plan_time=wsfl.plan_time and rownum=1) IS NOT  NULL THEN 'true'
    ELSE 'false'
  END)  VENTILATOR_FLAG ,-- 使用呼吸机标志
nvl(TO_CHAR(r.PULSE_RATE,'FM9999999'),'0')   PULSE_RATE  ,-- 脉率，患者每分钟脉搏次数的测量值，计量单位为次/min
'-'  PACEMAKER_RATE  ,-- 起搏器心率
nvl(TO_CHAR(r.TEMPERATURE,'FM9999999'),'0')  TEMPERATURE ,-- 体温，体温的测量值，计量单位为℃
nvl( (SELECT TO_CHAR(A.vitalsign_nval1,'FM9999999')   FROM ydhl.mcs_vital_info A WHERE A.vitalsign_type='1005' AND A.Patient_Uid=wsfl.PATIENT_UID
  and a.is_valid='1'  and a.plan_time=wsfl.plan_time  and rownum=1),'0')  SYSTOLIC_PRESSURE ,-- 收缩压测量值，计量单位为 mmHg
nvl((SELECT TO_CHAR(A.vitalsign_nval2,'FM9999999')   FROM ydhl.mcs_vital_info A WHERE A.vitalsign_type='1005'AND A.PATIENT_UID=wsfl.PATIENT_UID
   and a.plan_time=wsfl.plan_time  and rownum=1 ),'0')  DIASTOLIC_PRESSURE  ,-- 舒张压测量值，计量单位为 mmHg
nvl(TO_CHAR(r.WEIGHT,'FM9999999.00'),'0.00')  WEIGHT  ,-- 体重（kg），患者体重的测量值，计量单位为 kg
nvl(TO_CHAR(r.AC,'FM9999999'),'0')as  AC  ,-- 腹围（cm），患者腹部周长的测量值，计量单位为 cm
'-'  NURSING_OBSERVE_ITEM_NAME ,-- 护理观察项目，主要描述住院患者一般护理的护理观察结果
nvl(TO_CHAR(r.NURSING_OBSERVE_RESULT,'FM9999999'),'0') NURSING_OBSERVE_RESULT  -- 护理观察结果
from  ydhl.inpatients p inner join
(
   select min(aa.record_time) record_time,patient_uid, plan_time ,
   min(record_nurse_id) Created_By ,ward_code
   from ydhl.mcs_vital_info aa where is_valid='1' and to_char(plan_time,'yyyymmdd')>='20230101'
   --and patient_uid ='P-c0523490_203716872'
   group by patient_uid,ward_code,plan_time
)  WSFL
on  WSFL.PATIENT_UID=p.pat_index_no and p.status ='out' and to_char(p.ADMISSION_TIME,'yyyymm') ='202401'
inner join ydhl.mcs_sys_users us on wsfl.Created_By=us.user_code
inner join cda.patient_info pi on pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = substr(p.patient_id,'1','8')
and to_char(pi.INHOS_NUM) = to_char(substr(p.patient_id,'10','10'))
and EFFECTIVETIME >= '20240102000000' and EFFECTIVETIME < '20240201000000'
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_CODE,ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_NAME,PRNA_WEST_CIS_POSITION,PRNA_DIAG_DATE,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY PRNA_WEST_CIS_POSITION) as rn
    FROM cda.入院西
) ZD
on ZD.rn =1 and ZD.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and ZD.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
Left Join
(
    select a.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id,visit_id ORDER BY DIAGNOSIS_NO) as rn
    from his.diagnosis a where DIAGNOSIS_TYPE ='3'
) dd On dd.rn = 1 and pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO=dd.patient_id And pi.INHOS_NUM=dd.visit_id
left join (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT PATIENT_UID,plan_time,vitalsign_nval1,vitalsign_type
        FROM ydhl.mcs_vital_info where is_valid='1' --and to_char(PLAN_TIME,'yyyymm')>='202401'
    )
    PIVOT (
         max(vitalsign_nval1)
         FOR vitalsign_type IN ('1004' AS BREATHING_RATE,'1002' AS PULSE_RATE,'1001' AS TEMPERATURE,
                               '1005' AS SYSTOLIC_PRESSURE,'1014' AS WEIGHT,'3080' AS AC,
                               '1010' AS NURSING_OBSERVE_RESULT
                               )
          )
)r on r.PATIENT_UID=wsfl.PATIENT_UID and r.plan_time=wsfl.plan_time

EMR_ADMISSION_ASSESSMENT.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "CDA"."EMR_ADMISSION_ASSESSMENT" ("ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "WARD_CODE", "WARD_NAME", "DEPT_CODE", "DEPT_NAME", "SICKBED_NUM", "EORD_NUM", "NAME", "SEX_CODE", "SEX_NAME", "AGE", "AGE_MONTH", "ADMISSION_ID", "ADMISSION_TYPE", "ADMISSION_DIAGNOSIS_CD", "ADMISSION_DIAGNOSIS_NA", "ADMISSION_DATE", "CHIEF_COMPLAINT", "WEIGHT", "BREATHING_RATE", "PULSE_RATE", "PRESSURE_H", "PRESSURE_L", "ADMISSION_CAUSE", "ADMISSION_TYPE_CODE", "ADMISSION_TYPE_NAME", "APGAR", "DIET_CODE", "DIET_NAME", "DEVELOPMENT_CODE", "DEVELOPMENT_NAME", "SPIRIT_CODE", "SLEEP_CODE", "SPECIAL_CASE", "PHYCHOLOGICAL_CD", "PHYCHOLOGICAL_NA", "NUTRITION_CODE", "NUTRITION_NAME", "SELF_CARE_ABILITY", "SELF_CARE_ABI_NA", "ALLERGY_HISTORY_FIR", "HEALTH_STATUS_CODE", "DISEASE_HIS", "INFECTION_FLAG", "INFECTION_HISTORY", "VACCINATION_HISTORY", "SURGERY_HISTORY", "BT_HISTORY", "ALLERGY_HISTORY_SEN", "FAMILY_HISTORY", "SMOKE_STATUS", "STOP_SMOKE_DAY", "SMOKE_STATUS_CODE", "SMOKE_STATUS_NAME", "SMOKE_COUNT_DAY", "DRINK_STATUS", "DRINK_FREQUENCY", "DRINK_NAME", "DRINK_AMOUNT", "NOTICE_DOC_CODE", "NOTICE_DOC_DATE", "ASSESSMENT_DATE", "RES_NURSE_NAME", "ACCEPTS_NURS_NAME", "SIGNATURE_DATE", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME") AS 
  select
f.id ID  ,--  内码
''ORG_CODE  ,--  组织机构代码
'' ORG_NAME  ,--  组织机构名称
pi.ward_code  WARD_CODE ,-- 病区代码  必填
pi.WARD_NAME  WARD_NAME ,-- 病区名称  必填
pi.dept_code  DEPT_CODE ,-- 科室代码  必填
pi.DEPT_NAME  DEPT_NAME ,-- 科室名称  必填

pi.BED_NAME  SICKBED_NUM  ,-- 病床名称  必填
'-'  EORD_NUM ,-- 病房名称  必填


pi.PAT_NAME   NAME  ,--  患者姓名

pi.PHYSI_SEX_CODE  SEX_CODE  ,-- 患者性别代码  必填
pi.PHYSI_SEX_NAME  SEX_NAME  ,-- 患者性别名称  必填
pi.AGE_YEAR  AGE  ,--  年龄（岁）
 '' AGE_MONTH  ,--  年龄（月）


pi.VISIT_ID ADMISSION_ID  ,--  住院唯一标示号
 nvl(pn.IN_SICKROOM_METHOD,'-')  ADMISSION_TYPE  ,--  入病房方式

 nvl(zd.ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_CODE,'Z00.000')  ADMISSION_DIAGNOSIS_CD ,-- 入院诊断代码
nvl(zd.ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_NAME,'一般性医学检查')   ADMISSION_DIAGNOSIS_NA ,-- 入院诊断名称



pi.ADMIT_DATE  ADMISSION_DATE  ,--  入院日期时间
nvl(pn.IMAIN_SYMPTOM,'-')   CHIEF_COMPLAINT  ,--  主要症状
pn.WEIGHT  WEIGHT  ,--  体重（kg）
pn.BREATHING_RATE BREATHING_RATE  ,--  呼吸频率（次/min）
pn.PULSE_RATE PULSE_RATE  ,--  脉率（次/min）
pn.SYSTOLIC_PRESSURE PRESSURE_H  ,--  收缩压（mmHg）
pn.DIASTOLIC_PRESSURE PRESSURE_L  ,--  舒张压（mmHg）
pi.ADMIT_REASON  ADMISSION_CAUSE  ,--  入院原因
case when pn.ADMIT_WAY_NAME='门诊' then '1'
     when pn.ADMIT_WAY_NAME='急诊' then '2'
     when pn.ADMIT_WAY_NAME='转入' then '3' else '9' end  ADMISSION_TYPE_CODE  ,--  入院途径代码
case when pn.ADMIT_WAY_NAME='门诊' then '门诊'
     when pn.ADMIT_WAY_NAME='急诊' then '急诊'
     when pn.ADMIT_WAY_NAME='转入' then '其他医疗机构转入' else '其他' end ADMISSION_TYPE_NAME  ,--  入院途径描述
'' APGAR  ,--  Apgar评分值
nvl(substr(pn.DIET_SITUATION_NAME,1,1),'1')  DIET_CODE  ,--  饮食情况代码
nvl(substr(pn.DIET_SITUATION_NAME,3),'良好')  DIET_NAME  ,--  饮食情况描述
'' DEVELOPMENT_CODE  ,--  发育程度代码
'' DEVELOPMENT_NAME  ,--  发育程度描述
 ''SPIRIT_CODE  ,--  精神状态正常标志
''SLEEP_CODE  ,--  睡眠状况
''SPECIAL_CASE  ,--  特殊情况
''PHYCHOLOGICAL_CD  ,--  心理状态代码
''PHYCHOLOGICAL_NA  ,--  心理状态描述
''NUTRITION_CODE  ,--  营养状态代码
''NUTRITION_NAME  ,--  营养状态描述
''SELF_CARE_ABILITY  ,--  自理能力代码
''SELF_CARE_ABI_NA  ,--  自理能力描述
nvl(pn.ALLERGY_HISTORY,'无')  ALLERGY_HISTORY_FIR  ,--  过敏史
'' HEALTH_STATUS_CODE  ,--  一般健康状况标志
nvl(pn.DISEASE_HISTORY,'无')  DISEASE_HIS  ,--  疾病史（含外伤）
''INFECTION_FLAG  ,--  患者传染性标志
nvl((select t3.INFECT_DISEASE_HISTORY from cda.v_t3 t3 where t3.INHOS_NO=pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and t3.vi=pi.INHOS_NUM and rownum=1),'无') INFECTION_HISTORY  ,--  传染病史
nvl((select DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t3.VACCINE_HISTORY,2000) from cda.v_t3 t3 where t3.INHOS_NO=pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and t3.vi=pi.INHOS_NUM and rownum=1),'无')    VACCINATION_HISTORY  ,--  预防接种史
nvl(pn.SURGERY_HISTORY,'无') SURGERY_HISTORY  ,--  手术史
nvl(pn.METACHYSIS_HISTORY,'无') BT_HISTORY  ,--  输血史
nvl(pn.ALLERGY_HISTORY,'无')  ALLERGY_HISTORY_SEN  ,--  过敏史
nvl(pn.FAMILY_HISTORY,'无') FAMILY_HISTORY  ,--  家族史
case when pn.SMOKING_HISTORY ='是' then 'true' else 'false' end  SMOKE_STATUS  ,--  吸烟标志
nvl(pn.STOP_SMOKING_DAYS,'0')  STOP_SMOKE_DAY  ,--  停止吸烟天数
case when pn.SMOKING_HISTORY ='是' and pn.delete_SMOKING='是' then '2'
     when pn.SMOKING_HISTORY ='是' then '3' else '1' end   SMOKE_STATUS_CODE  ,--  吸烟状况代码
case when pn.SMOKING_HISTORY ='是' and pn.delete_SMOKING='是' then '过去吸，已戒烟'
     when pn.SMOKING_HISTORY ='是' then '吸烟' else '从不吸烟' end SMOKE_STATUS_NAME  ,--  吸烟状况描述
nvl(pn.DAY_SMOKING,'0') SMOKE_COUNT_DAY  ,--  日吸烟量（支）
case when pn.DRINKING_HISTORY ='是' then 'true' else 'false' end  DRINK_STATUS  ,--  饮酒标志
case when pn.DRINKING_RATE_NAME in ('每周不到一次','每周不到1次') then '2'
     when pn.DRINKING_RATE_NAME = '每周1-2次' then '33'
     when pn.DRINKING_RATE_NAME = '每周至少3次' then '3'  else '1' end DRINK_FREQUENCY  ,--  饮酒频率代码
case when pn.DRINKING_RATE_NAME in ('每周不到一次','每周不到1次') then '偶尔'
     when pn.DRINKING_RATE_NAME = '每周1-2次' then '1d/周～2d/周'
     when pn.DRINKING_RATE_NAME = '每周至少3次' then '经常'  else '从不' end   DRINK_NAME  ,--  饮酒频率描述
nvl(pn.DAY_DRINKING,'0') DRINK_AMOUNT  ,--  日饮酒量（mL）
'true'  NOTICE_DOC_CODE  ,--  通知医师标志
ydzd.admission_ward_time NOTICE_DOC_DATE  ,--  通知医师日期时间
f.assess_time ASSESSMENT_DATE  ,--  评估日期时间
pi.PRIMARY_NURSE_SIGN_CODE   RES_NURSE_NAME  ,--  责任护士签名
f.created_name  ACCEPTS_NURS_NAME  ,--  接诊护士签名
f.assess_time SIGNATURE_DATE  ,--  签名日期时间
''DISTRICT_CODE  ,--  行政区划
'' EXCHANGE_TYPE  ,--  交换类型
f.assess_time SYSTEM_TIME  --  数据上传时间

from ydhl.mcs_assess_form f inner join ydhl.inpatients ydzd
on
 f.PATIENT_UID=ydzd.pat_index_no
and f.generator_type='manul'
and f.is_valid='1'
and ydzd.admission_ward_time is not null
inner join cda.patient_info pi on pi.INHOS_NO = SUBSTR(YDZD.PATIENT_ID, 1, INSTR(YDZD.PATIENT_ID, '_') - 1)
and to_char(pi.INHOS_NUM) = SUBSTR(YDZD.PATIENT_ID,INSTR(YDZD.PATIENT_ID, '_') + 1)
left join cda.入院西 zd on zd.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and zd.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM

where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00050' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1) IS NULL  AND ydzd.nursing_class='3' THEN '1' END )  NURSE_TYPE_CODE  ,--  护理类型代码
(CASE WHEN (SELECT substr( A.STRING_VALUE ,instr(A.STRING_VALUE , '.' ,-1 )+1)  from   ydhl.mcs_doc_form_records a
where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00050' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1) IS NOT NULL
     THEN (SELECT substr( A.STRING_VALUE ,instr(A.STRING_VALUE , '.' ,-1 )+1)  from   ydhl.mcs_doc_form_records a
where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00050' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1)
      WHEN (SELECT substr( A.STRING_VALUE ,instr(A.STRING_VALUE , '.' ,-1 )+1)  from   ydhl.mcs_doc_form_records a
where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00050' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1) IS NULL  AND  ydzd.nursing_class='999' THEN '基础护理'
      WHEN (SELECT substr( A.STRING_VALUE ,instr(A.STRING_VALUE , '.' ,-1 )+1)  from   ydhl.mcs_doc_form_records a
where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00050' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1) IS NULL  AND ydzd.nursing_class='0' THEN '特殊护理'
      WHEN (SELECT substr( A.STRING_VALUE ,instr(A.STRING_VALUE , '.' ,-1 )+1)  from   ydhl.mcs_doc_form_records a
where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00050' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1) IS NULL  AND ydzd.nursing_class='1' THEN '基础护理'
      WHEN (SELECT substr( A.STRING_VALUE ,instr(A.STRING_VALUE , '.' ,-1 )+1)  from   ydhl.mcs_doc_form_records a
where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00050' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1) IS NULL  AND ydzd.nursing_class='2' THEN '基础护理'
      WHEN (SELECT substr( A.STRING_VALUE ,instr(A.STRING_VALUE , '.' ,-1 )+1)  from   ydhl.mcs_doc_form_records a
where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00050' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1) IS NULL  AND ydzd.nursing_class='3' THEN '基础护理' END ) NURSE_TYPE_NAME  ,--  护理类型名称
nvl((SELECT A.STRING_VALUE  from ydhl.mcs_doc_form_records a where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00051' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1),'-')  NURSE_PROBLEM  ,--  护理问题
nvl((SELECT A.STRING_VALUE  from ydhl.mcs_doc_form_records a where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00061' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1),'-')  NURSE_PROJECT_NAME  ,--  护理操作项目类目名称
 nvl((SELECT A.STRING_VALUE  from ydhl.mcs_doc_form_records a where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00069' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1),'-')  NURSE_OPERATION  ,--  护理操作名称
nvl((SELECT A.STRING_VALUE  from ydhl.mcs_doc_form_records a where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00062' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1),'-')  NURSE_OPERATION_RESULT  ,--  护理操作结果
 nvl((SELECT A.STRING_VALUE  from ydhl.mcs_doc_form_records a where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00063' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1),'-') CATHETER_NURSE_NOTE  ,--  导管护理描述
nvl((SELECT A.STRING_VALUE  from ydhl.mcs_doc_form_records a where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00064' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1),'-')  POSITION_NURSE  ,--  体位护理
nvl((SELECT A.STRING_VALUE  from ydhl.mcs_doc_form_records a where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00065' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1),'-')   SKIN_NURSE  ,--  皮肤护理
nvl((SELECT  case when substr( A.STRING_VALUE,1 ,instr(A.STRING_VALUE , '.' ,-1 )-1) ='1' then '1'
                  when substr( A.STRING_VALUE,1 ,instr(A.STRING_VALUE , '.' ,-1 )-1) ='2' then '2'
                  when substr( A.STRING_VALUE,1 ,instr(A.STRING_VALUE , '.' ,-1 )-1) ='3' then '3'

where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00066' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1),'1')   CATHETER_NURSE_CODE  ,--  气管护理代码
nvl((SELECT  CASE WHEN substr( A.STRING_VALUE ,instr(A.STRING_VALUE , '.' ,-1 )+1) = '翻身拍背' then '翻身拍背'
                  WHEN substr( A.STRING_VALUE ,instr(A.STRING_VALUE , '.' ,-1 )+1) = '雾化吸入' then '雾化吸入'
                  WHEN substr( A.STRING_VALUE ,instr(A.STRING_VALUE , '.' ,-1 )+1) = '吸痰' then '吸痰'
                  else '翻身拍背' end from ydhl.mcs_doc_form_records a
where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00066' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1),'翻身拍背')  CATHETER_NURSE_NAME  ,--  气管护理名称
nvl((SELECT  CASE WHEN substr( A.STRING_VALUE ,1,instr(A.STRING_VALUE , '.' ,-1 )-1) ='1' THEN '1'
                  WHEN substr( A.STRING_VALUE ,1,instr(A.STRING_VALUE , '.' ,-1 )-1) ='2' THEN '2'
                  WHEN substr( A.STRING_VALUE ,1,instr(A.STRING_VALUE , '.' ,-1 )-1) ='3' THEN '3'
                  else '1' end from ydhl.mcs_doc_form_records a
where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00067' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1),'1')  SECURITY_NURSE_CODE  ,--  安全护理代码
nvl((SELECT case when substr( A.STRING_VALUE ,instr(A.STRING_VALUE , '.' ,-1 )+1) ='勤巡视病房' then '勤巡视病房'
                 when substr( A.STRING_VALUE ,instr(A.STRING_VALUE , '.' ,-1 )+1) ='加床档' then '加床档'
                 when substr( A.STRING_VALUE ,instr(A.STRING_VALUE , '.' ,-1 )+1) ='约束四肢' then '约束四肢'
                 else '勤巡视病房' end from ydhl.mcs_doc_form_records a
where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00067' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1),'勤巡视病房')   SECURITY_NURSE_NAME  ,--  安全护理名称
nvl((SELECT    substr( A.STRING_VALUE,1 ,instr(A.STRING_VALUE , '.' ,-1 )-1) from ydhl.mcs_doc_form_records a
where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00068' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1),'99')   DIET_GUIDE_CODE  ,--  饮食指导代码
nvl((SELECT   substr( A.STRING_VALUE ,instr(A.STRING_VALUE , '.' ,-1 )+1)  from ydhl.mcs_doc_form_records a
where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00068' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1),'其他')   DIET_GUIDE_NAME  ,--  饮食指导名称
f.created_name NUSRSE_NAME  ,--  护士签名
f.form_time SIGNATURE_DATE  ,--  签名日期时间
''DISTRICT_CODE  ,--  所属行政区划
''EXCHANGE_TYPE	,--	交换类型

on
 f.PATIENT_UID=ydzd.pat_index_no
and f.TEMPLATE_CODE='846'
and f.is_valid='1'
and f.created_by<>'dba'
and f.form_time >= to_date('2023-01-01 00:00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
inner join cda.patient_info pi on pi.INHOS_NO = SUBSTR(YDZD.PATIENT_ID, 1, INSTR(YDZD.PATIENT_ID, '_') - 1)
and to_char(pi.INHOS_NUM) = SUBSTR(YDZD.PATIENT_ID,INSTR(YDZD.PATIENT_ID, '_') + 1)
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_CODE,ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_NAME,PRNA_WEST_CIS_POSITION,PRNA_DIAG_DATE,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY PRNA_WEST_CIS_POSITION) as rn
    FROM cda.入院西
) ZD1
on ZD1.rn = 1 and ZD1.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and ZD1.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
Left Join
(
    select patient_id,visit_id,diagnosis_desc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id,visit_id ORDER BY DIAGNOSIS_DATE desc,DIAGNOSIS_NO) as rn
    from his.diagnosis where DIAGNOSIS_DATE is not null
) d
On d.rn=1 and pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO=d.patient_id And pi.INHOS_NUM=d.visit_id

 ''AGE_MONTH  ,--  年龄（月）

 where DIAGNOSIS_TYPE ='3' and a.patient_id=pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and a.visit_id = pi.INHOS_NUM and a.DIAGNOSIS_NO='1'and rownum = 1) and rownum = 1)  DISEASE_CODE  ,--  疾病诊断编码

where DIAGNOSIS_TYPE ='3' and a.patient_id=pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and a.visit_id = pi.INHOS_NUM and a.DIAGNOSIS_NO='1'and rownum = 1) and rownum = 1) DISEASE_NAME  ,--  疾病诊断
p.admission_time ADMISSION_DATE  ,--  入院日期时间
ROUND(p.DISCHARGE_DATE-p.admission_time)  INPATIENT_DAY  ,--  实际住院天数
case when ( round(aa.plan_time-

(select e.begin_time from ydhl.mcs_event_info e where event_type  in ('2003','2004')
and e.patient_uid=aa.patient_uid and rownum=1),0)+1)
else 0 end  OPERATION_DAY  ,--  手术或分娩后天数

  and a.is_valid='1'   and a.plan_time=aa.plan_time and rownum=1) ,pn.PULSE_RATE),'')    PULSE_RATE  ,--  脉率（次/min）
nvl(nvl((SELECT TO_CHAR(A.vitalsign_nval1,'FM9999999')   FROM ydhl.mcs_vital_info A WHERE A.vitalsign_type='1003' AND A.PATIENT_UID=aa.PATIENT_UID
  and a.is_valid='1'   and a.plan_time=aa.plan_time and rownum=1) ,pn.PULSE_RATE),'')   HEART_RATE  ,--  起搏器心率（次/min）1003
nvl((SELECT TO_CHAR(A.vitalsign_nval1,'FM9999999.0')   FROM ydhl.mcs_vital_info A WHERE A.vitalsign_type='1001' AND A.PATIENT_UID=aa.PATIENT_UID
 and a.is_valid='1' and a.plan_time=aa.plan_time and rownum=1),'')   TEMPERATURE  ,--  体温（℃）
nvl( (SELECT TO_CHAR(nvl(A.vitalsign_nval1,'0') ,'FM9999999')   FROM ydhl.mcs_vital_info A WHERE A.vitalsign_type='1005' AND A.Patient_Uid=aa.PATIENT_UID
  and a.is_valid='1'  and a.plan_time=aa.plan_time  and rownum=1),'')  PRESSURE_H  ,--  收缩压（mmHg）
nvl((SELECT TO_CHAR(nvl(A.vitalsign_nval2,'0') ,'FM9999999')   FROM ydhl.mcs_vital_info A WHERE A.vitalsign_type='1005'AND A.PATIENT_UID=aa.PATIENT_UID
   and a.plan_time=aa.plan_time  and rownum=1 ),'')  PRESSURE_L  ,--  舒张压（mmHg）
 nvl((SELECT TO_CHAR(nvl(A.vitalsign_nval1,'0') ,'FM9999999.00')   FROM ydhl.mcs_vital_info A
 WHERE A.vitalsign_type='1014' and a.is_valid='1' AND A.PATIENT_UID=aa.PATIENT_UID
   and a.plan_time=aa.plan_time and rownum=1),'')  WEIGHT  ,--  体重（kg）
nvl( (SELECT TO_CHAR(nvl(A.vitalsign_nval1,'0') ,'FM9999999.00')   FROM ydhl.mcs_vital_info A
 WHERE A.vitalsign_type='3080' and a.is_valid='1' AND A.PATIENT_UID=aa.PATIENT_UID
   and a.plan_time=aa.plan_time and rownum=1) ,'') ABDOMINAL  ,--  腹围（cm）

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "CDA"."PATIENT_INFO" ("OUTHOS_NO", "INHOS_NO", "VISIT_ID", "INHOS_NUM", "EFFECTIVETIME", "HC_NO", "INHOSP_INDEX_NO", "ZIP_CODE", "PATIENT_AREA_ADDRESS", "PHONE_NO", "ADDR_COMPANY_PHONE_NO", "PAT_ID_NUMBER", "PAT_NAME", "PHYSI_SEX_CODE", "PHYSI_SEX_NAME", "MARITAL_STATUS_CODE", "MARITAL_STATUS_NAME", "AGE_YEAR", "DATE_BIRTH", "ETHNIC_CODE", "ETHNIC_NAME", "NATION_CODE", "NATION_NAME", "OCCUPATION_CATEG_CODE", "OCCUPATION_CATEG_NAME", "PRESENTER_PAT_RELATION", "PRESENTER_PAT_RELATION_NAME", "ABO_CODE", "ABO_NAME", "RH_CODE", "RH_NAME", "INHOSP_DR_SIGN_CODE", "INHOSP_DR_SIGN", "ATTEND_DR_SIGN_CODE", "ATTEND_DR_SIGN", "CHIEF_DR_SIGN_CODE", "CHIEF_DR_SIGN", "PRIMARY_NURSE_SIGN_CODE", "PRIMARY_NURSE_SIGN", "ATTEND_DR_SKILL_POST_CODE", "ATTEND_DR_SKILL_POST_NAME", "CONTACT_PHONE_NO", "CONTACT_NAME", "ADMIT_DATE", "DISCHARGE_DATE", "DEATH_DATE", "BED_NAME", "BED_CODE", "DEPT_CODE", "DEPT_NAME", "WARD_CODE", "WARD_NAME", "ADMIT_REASON", "ACTUAL_INHOSP_DAYS", "TREAT_RESULT_CODE", "TREAT_RESULT_NAME", "DRUG_USE_WAY_CODE", "DRUG_USE_WAY_NAME", "DRUG_USE_RATE", "DRUG_USE_NAME", "FAMILY_AGREE_AUTOPSY_FLAG") AS 
  select
pv.patient_id OUTHOS_NO,--患者门诊号，同一患者多次就诊，门诊号相同
pv.patient_id INHOS_NO,--患者住院号，同一患者多次住院，住院号相同
nvl(pmi.inp_no,'-') VISIT_ID,--患者就诊/住院流水号，同一患者多次就诊/住院，流水号不同
pv.visit_id INHOS_NUM,--住院次数
to_char(pv.discharge_date_time,'yyyymmddhh24miss') EFFECTIVETIME,--文档生效时间
pmi.id_no HC_NO,--健康卡号
pv.patient_id INHOSP_INDEX_NO,--住院号
nvl(pv.zip_code,'000000') ZIP_CODE,--家庭住址，邮政编码
pmi.patient_area_address patient_area_address, --家庭住址
pv.next_of_kin_phone PHONE_NO,--患者联系电话
nvl(pmi.work_tel,'-') ADDR_COMPANY_PHONE_NO ,-- 工作单位电话
nvl(pmi.id_no,pv.INSURANCE_NO) PAT_ID_NUMBER,--患者身份证号
pmi.name PAT_NAME,--患者姓名
nvl((select cd.国标编码 from cda.cda_dictionary cd where cd.字典名称 = '生理性别代码表' and cd.院标名称=pmi.sex),'9') PHYSI_SEX_CODE,--患者性别代码
nvl((select cd.国标名称 from cda.cda_dictionary cd where cd.字典名称 = '生理性别代码表' and cd.院标名称=pmi.sex),'未说明的性别') PHYSI_SEX_NAME,--患者性别名称
nvl((select cd.国标编码 from cda.cda_dictionary cd where cd.字典名称 = '婚姻状态代码' and cd.院标名称=pv.Marital_Status),'90') MARITAL_STATUS_CODE,--患者婚姻状况代码
nvl((select cd.国标名称 from cda.cda_dictionary cd where cd.字典名称 = '婚姻状态代码' and cd.院标名称=pv.Marital_Status),'未说明的婚姻状况') MARITAL_STATUS_NAME,--患者婚姻状况名称
TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(pv.discharge_date_time,pmi.date_of_birth) / 12) AGE_YEAR,--患者年龄
nvl(to_char(pmi.Date_Of_Birth,'yyyymmdd'),substr(pv.INSURANCE_NO,7,8)) DATE_BIRTH, --患者出生日期，日期格式：YYYYMMDD，如20190101
case when (pmi.Nation in ('未知','其它')) or (pmi.Nation is null) then '01'
     when pmi.Nation = '01族' then '01'
     when REGEXP_LIKE(pmi.Nation,'^[0-9]+$') then to_char((select cd.国标编码 from CDA.CDA_DICTIONARY cd where cd.院标编码 = pmi.Nation and cd.字典名称='民族类别代码'))
     when NOT REGEXP_LIKE(pmi.Nation,'^[0-9]+$') AND pmi.Nation NOT LIKE '%族' then to_char((select cd.国标编码 from CDA.CDA_DICTIONARY cd where cd.院标名称 = pmi.Nation || '族' and cd.字典名称='民族类别代码'))
     else to_char((select cd.国标编码 from CDA.CDA_DICTIONARY cd where cd.院标名称 = pmi.Nation and cd.字典名称='民族类别代码')) end ETHNIC_CODE,--民族代码

SM_HZSJ.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "CDA"."SM_HZSJ" ("患者ID", "住院号", "住院次数", "手术号", "患者姓名", "麻醉方式", "麻醉医师", "麻醉助手", "输血医生", "第一台护士", "第二台护士", "第一供应护士", "第二供应护士", "总出量", "总入量", "手术开始时间", "手术结束时间", "麻醉开始时间", "麻醉结束时间") AS 
  select 
    b.patient_id as "患者ID",
    a.INP_NO as "住院号",
    c.visit_id as "住院次数",
    b.OPER_ID as "手术号",
    a.name as "患者姓名",
    b.anesthesia_method as "麻醉方式",
    -- 只过滤姓名（含中文），保留数字、NULL和空字符串
    CASE 
        WHEN b.anesthesia_doctor IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN b.anesthesia_doctor = '' THEN ''
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(b.anesthesia_doctor, '^[0-9]+$') THEN b.anesthesia_doctor 
        ELSE NULL 
    END as "麻醉医师",
    CASE 
        WHEN b.anesthesia_assistant IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN b.anesthesia_assistant = '' THEN ''
--         WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(b.anesthesia_assistant, '^[0-9]+$') THEN b.anesthesia_assistant 
        ELSE b.anesthesia_assistant 
    END as "麻醉助手",
    CASE 
        WHEN b.blood_tran_doctor IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN b.blood_tran_doctor = '' THEN ''
--         WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(b.blood_tran_doctor, '^[0-9]+$') THEN b.blood_tran_doctor 
        ELSE b.blood_tran_doctor 
    END as "输血医生",
    CASE 
        WHEN b.first_operation_nurse IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN b.first_operation_nurse = '' THEN ''
--         WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(b.first_operation_nurse, '^[0-9]+$') THEN b.first_operation_nurse 
        ELSE b.first_operation_nurse 
    END as "第一台护士",
    CASE 
        WHEN b.second_operation_nurse IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN b.second_operation_nurse = '' THEN ''
--         WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(b.second_operation_nurse, '^[0-9]+$') THEN b.second_operation_nurse 
        ELSE b.second_operation_nurse 
    END as "第二台护士",
    CASE 
        WHEN b.first_supply_nurse IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN b.first_supply_nurse = '' THEN ''
--         WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(b.first_supply_nurse, '^[0-9]+$') THEN b.first_supply_nurse 
        ELSE b.first_supply_nurse 
    END as "第一供应护士",
    CASE 
        WHEN b.second_supply_nurse IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN b.second_supply_nurse = '' THEN ''
--         WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(b.second_supply_nurse, '^[0-9]+$') THEN b.second_supply_nurse 
        ELSE b.second_supply_nurse 
    END as "第二供应护士",
    b.red_blood as "总出量",
    b.blood_amount as "总入量",
    b.START_DATE_TIME as "手术开始时间",
    b.END_DATE_TIME as "手术结束时间",
    b.ANES_START_TIME as "麻醉开始时间",
    b.ANES_END_TIME as "麻醉结束时间"
from SM.MED_OPERATION_MASTER b 
left join HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX a 
    on a.patient_id = b.patient_id
    left join HIS.PAT_VISIT c
    on TO_CHAR(b.patient_id) = c.patient_id and to_char(b.visit_id) = c.visit_id

nvl(pi.AGE_YEAR,BHO.AGE1)  AGE_YEAR  ,-- 患者年龄
nvl(to_char(a.report_date_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'19700101000000')  EXAM_REPORT_DATE  ,-- 检查报告日期，日期格式：YYYYMMDDHH24MISS，如20190101235959
nvl((select d.emp_no from HIS.STAFF_DICT d where BHO.REPORTDR=d.name and rownum =1),'-')  REPORT_DR_SIGN_CODE ,-- 报告医师工号
nvl(BHO.REPORTDR,'-') REPORT_DR_SIGN  ,-- 报告医师姓名
nvl((select d.emp_no from HIS.STAFF_DICT d where BHO.REPORTDR=d.name and rownum =1),'-')  PROOF_DR_SIGN_CODE  ,-- 审核医师工号
nvl(BHO.REPORTDR,'-')  PROOF_DR_SIGN ,-- 审核医师姓名
nvl(case when REGEXP_LIKE(BHO.APPLYDR,'^[0-9]+$') then BHO.APPLYDR else
(select d.emp_no from HIS.STAFF_DICT d where BHO.APPLYDR=d.name and rownum =1) end
,'-')  EXAM_TECHNICIAN_SIGN_CODE ,-- 检查技师工号
nvl(case when REGEXP_LIKE(BHO.APPLYDR,'^[0-9]+$') then
(select d.name from HIS.STAFF_DICT d where BHO.APPLYDR=d.emp_no and rownum =1) else BHO.APPLYDR end
,'-')  EXAM_TECHNICIAN_SIGN  ,-- 检查技师姓名
nvl(case when REGEXP_LIKE(BHO.APPLYDR,'^[0-9]+$') then BHO.APPLYDR else
(select d.emp_no from HIS.STAFF_DICT d where BHO.APPLYDR=d.name and rownum =1) end
,'-')  EXAM_DR_SIGN_CODE ,-- 检查医师工号
nvl(case when REGEXP_LIKE(BHO.APPLYDR,'^[0-9]+$') then
(select d.name from HIS.STAFF_DICT d where BHO.APPLYDR=d.emp_no and rownum =1) else BHO.APPLYDR end
,'-')  EXAM_DR_SIGN  ,-- 检查医师姓名
nvl((select q.dept_name from HIS.DEPT_DICT q where a.req_dept=q.dept_code and rownum =1),'-')  EXAM_APPLY_DEPT_NAME  ,-- 检查申请科室名称
nvl(pi.ADMIT_DATE,to_char(a.EXAM_DATE_TIME,'yyyymmddhh24miss')) ADMIT_DATE  ,-- 入院日期时间，日期格式：YYYYMMDDHH24MISS，如20190101235959
nvl(pi.BED_NAME,'-')  BED_NAME  ,-- 病床名称
nvl(pi.BED_CODE,'-')  BED_CODE  ,-- 病床代码
'-'  SICKROOM_NAME ,-- 病房名称
'-'  SICKROOM_CODE ,-- 病房代码
nvl(nvl(pi.DEPT_CODE,a.req_dept),'-')  DEPT_CODE ,-- 科室代码
nvl(nvl(pi.DEPT_NAME,(select q.dept_name from HIS.DEPT_DICT q where a.req_dept=q.dept_code and rownum =1)),'-')  DEPT_NAME ,-- 科室名称
nvl(pi.WARD_CODE,'-')  WARD_CODE ,-- 病区代码
nvl(pi.WARD_NAME,'-')  WARD_NAME ,-- 病区名称
nvl(to_char(h.diagnosis_date,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'19700101000000')  DIAG_DATE ,-- 诊断日期，日期格式：YYYYMMDDHH24MISS，如20190101235959
nvl((select cd.国标编码 from cda.cda_dictionary cd where cd.字典名称 ='ICD-10诊断编码' and cd.系统标识='HIS' and cd.院标名称=h.diagnosis_desc and rownum='1'),'Z00.000') DIAG_CODE ,-- 西医诊断代码
nvl((select cd.国标名称 from cda.cda_dictionary cd where cd.字典名称 ='ICD-10诊断编码' and cd.系统标识='HIS' and cd.院标名称=h.diagnosis_desc and rownum='1'),'一般性医学检查') DIAG_NAME ,-- 西医诊断名称
'山东省第二人民医院（山东省耳鼻喉医院、山东省耳鼻喉研究所）'  DIAG_MI_NAME  ,-- 诊断医疗机构名称
nvl(a.phys_sign,'-')  CHIEF_DESCR ,-- 主诉，记录患者本次疾病相关的主要症状及其持续时间
''  SYMPTOM_BEGIN_DATE  ,-- 症状开始时间，日期格式：YYYYMMDDHH24MISS，如20190101235959
''  SYMPTOM_STOP_DATE ,-- 症状停止时间，日期格式：YYYYMMDDHH24MISS，如20190101235959
a.clin_symp  SYMPTOM_DESCR ,-- 症状描述，对患者出现症状的详细描述
''  OPER_CODE ,-- 手术（操作）编码
''  OPER_NAME ,-- 手术（操作）名称
''  OPER_DATE ,-- 操作日期时间，日期格式：YYYYMMDDHH24MISS，如20190101235959
(SELECT ESD.INPUT_CODE FROM HIS.EXAM_SUBCLASS_DICT ESD WHERE ESD.EXAM_SUBCLASS_NAME = A.EXAM_SUB_CLASS and rownum =1) OPER_PART_CODE  ,-- 操作部位代码
a.exam_sub_class  OPER_PART_NAME  ,-- 操作部位名称
'-'  INTERVENTION_OBJ_NAME ,-- 介入物名称
a.exam_class  OPER_METHOD_DESCR ,-- 操作方法描述
'1'  OPER_NUM  ,-- 操作次数
''  ANES_METHOD_CODE  ,-- 麻醉方式代码
''  ANES_METHOD_NAME  ,-- 麻醉方式名称
''  ANES_DR_SIGN  ,-- 麻醉医师姓名
'-'  ANES_OBSERVE_RESULT ,-- 麻醉观察结果
''  ANES_CWM_IND_CODE ,-- 麻醉中西医标识代码
''  ANES_CWM_IND_NAME ,-- 麻醉中西医标识名称
'false'  SPECIAL_EXAM_FLAG ,-- 特殊检查标志，标识患者有无特殊检查操作经历的标志
nvl(a.exam_sub_class,'-')  EXAM_METHOD_NAME  ,-- 检查方法名称，患者接受医学检查项目所采用的检查方法名称
nvl(a.exam_class,'-')  EXAM_CATEG_NAME ,-- 检查类别
nvl(to_char(a.exam_date_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'19700101000000') EXAM_DATE ,-- 检查日期
'-'  EXAM_ITEM_CODE  ,-- 患者检查项目在特定编码体系中的代码
''  SPECIMEN_SAMPLING_DATE_TIME ,-- 标本采样日期时间，日期格式：YYYYMMDDHH24MISS，如20190101235959
''  RECEIVE_DATE  ,-- 接收标本日期时间 ，日期格式：YYYYMMDDHH24MISS，如20190101235959
'-'  SAMPLE_TYPE_NAME  ,-- 标本类别名称
'-'  SPECIMEN_STATUS ,-- 标本状态名称
'-'  SPECIMEN_FIXATIVE_NAME  ,-- 标本固定液名称
'3'  EXAM_RESULT_CODE  ,-- 检查结果代码
'不确定'  EXAM_RESULT_NAME  ,-- 检查结果名称
'0'  EXAM_RESULT ,-- 检查定量结果
'-'  EXAM_RESULT_VALUE_UNIT  ,-- 检查定量结果计量单位
nvl(a.phys_sign,'-')  TREAT_PROC_DESCR  ,-- 诊断过程，对患者诊疗过程的详细描述
nvl(BHO.OPSDESC,'-')  EXAM_REPORT_RESULT  ,-- 检查报告结果-客观所见
nvl(BHO.OPSDIAGNOSE,'-')  EXAM_RESULT_PROMPT  ,-- 检查报告结果-主观提示
'050601' EXAM_REPORT_DEPT,--检查报告科室编码
'超声诊疗室'  EXAM_REPORT_DEPT_NAME ,-- 检查报告科室名称
'山东省第二人民医院（山东省耳鼻喉医院、山东省耳鼻喉研究所）'  EXAM_REPORT_MI_NAME ,-- 检查报告机构名称
'-'  EXAM_REPORT_NOTE  -- 检查报告备注
FROM his.EXAM_MASTER a
left join (
     select a.*
     ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id,VISIT_ID ORDER BY DIAGNOSIS_NO) as rn
     from his.diagnosis a where DIAGNOSIS_DESC is not null
) h on a.patient_id=h.patient_id and a.visit_id=h.visit_id and h.rn=1
left join his.OPERATION o on a.patient_id=o.patient_id and a.visit_id=o.visit_id
inner join NJ.BHOSCHECKUS BHO on a.exam_no = BHO.HISID1
left join cda.patient_info pi on pi.INHOS_NO = a.patient_id and pi.INHOS_NUM = a.visit_id
left join his.pat_master_index pmi on a.patient_id=pmi.patient_id
WHERE A.EXAM_CLASS IN ('B超','妇产超声') AND TO_CHAR(A.REQ_DATE_TIME, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') >= '20230101000000'

T_ESBHL_CHECK_ROD_US.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "CDA"."T_ESBHL_CHECK_ROD_US" ("CONTENT_ID", "OUTHOS_NO", "INHOS_NO", "VISIT_ID", "INHOS_NUM", "AUTHOR_CODE", "AUTHOR_NAME", "AUTHOR_TIME", "EFFECTIVETIME", "OUTHOSP_INDEX_NO", "INHOSP_INDEX_NO", "EXAM_REPORT_NO", "ELECTR_REQUISITION_NO", "SAMPLE_NO", "PAT_TYPE_CODE", "PAT_TYPE_NAME", "PHONE_NO", "PAT_ID_NUMBER", "PAT_NAME", "PHYSI_SEX_CODE", "PHYSI_SEX_NAME", "AGE_YEAR", "EXAM_REPORT_DATE", "REPORT_DR_SIGN_CODE", "REPORT_DR_SIGN", "PROOF_DR_SIGN_CODE", "PROOF_DR_SIGN", "EXAM_TECHNICIAN_SIGN_CODE", "EXAM_TECHNICIAN_SIGN", "EXAM_DR_SIGN_CODE", "EXAM_DR_SIGN", "EXAM_APPLY_DEPT_NAME", "ADMIT_DATE", "BED_NAME", "BED_CODE", "SICKROOM_NAME", "SICKROOM_CODE", "DEPT_CODE", "DEPT_NAME", "WARD_CODE", "WARD_NAME", "DIAG_DATE", "DIAG_CODE", "DIAG_NAME", "DIAG_MI_NAME", "CHIEF_DESCR", "SYMPTOM_BEGIN_DATE", "SYMPTOM_STOP_DATE", "SYMPTOM_DESCR", "OPER_CODE", "OPER_NAME", "OPER_DATE", "OPER_PART_CODE", "OPER_PART_NAME", "INTERVENTION_OBJ_NAME", "OPER_METHOD_DESCR", "OPER_NUM", "ANES_METHOD_CODE", "ANES_METHOD_NAME", "ANES_DR_SIGN", "ANES_OBSERVE_RESULT", "ANES_CWM_IND_CODE", "ANES_CWM_IND_NAME", "SPECIAL_EXAM_FLAG", "EXAM_METHOD_NAME", "EXAM_CATEG_NAME", "EXAM_DATE", "EXAM_ITEM_CODE", "SPECIMEN_SAMPLING_DATE_TIME", "RECEIVE_DATE", "SAMPLE_TYPE_NAME", "SPECIMEN_STATUS", "SPECIMEN_FIXATIVE_NAME", "EXAM_RESULT_CODE", "EXAM_RESULT_NAME", "EXAM_RESULT", "EXAM_RESULT_VALUE_UNIT", "TREAT_PROC_DESCR", "EXAM_REPORT_RESULT", "EXAM_RESULT_PROMPT", "EXAM_REPORT_DEPT_NAME", "EXAM_REPORT_MI_NAME", "EXAM_REPORT_NOTE") AS 
  SELECT
          -- 已合并到CDA.T_ESBHL_CHECK_ROD_ES中
          ''  CONTENT_ID  ,-- 文档流水号，标识一份文档的唯一值
          a.patient_id  OUTHOS_NO ,-- 患者门诊号，同一患者多次就诊，门诊号相同
          a.patient_id  INHOS_NO  ,-- 患者住院号，同一患者多次住院，住院号相同
          a.visit_id  VISIT_ID  ,-- 患者就诊/住院流水号，同一患者多次就诊/住院，流水号不同
          a.visit_id  INHOS_NUM ,-- 住院次数
          a.req_physician  AUTHOR_CODE ,-- 作者工号
          (SELECT SD.NAME FROM HIS.STAFF_DICT SD WHERE SD.EMP_NO = a.req_physician)  AUTHOR_NAME ,-- 作者姓名
          to_char(a.REQ_DATE_TIME,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')  AUTHOR_TIME ,-- 创建日期
          to_char(A.REPORT_DATE_TIME,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')  EFFECTIVETIME ,-- 文档生效时间
          a.patient_id  OUTHOSP_INDEX_NO  ,-- 门（急）诊号
          BHO.INPATNO  INHOSP_INDEX_NO ,-- 住院号
          a.patient_local_id  EXAM_REPORT_NO  ,-- 检查报告单编号
          a.exam_no  ELECTR_REQUISITION_NO ,-- 电子申请单号
          '-' SAMPLE_NO ,-- 标本编号
          a.patient_source PAT_TYPE_CODE ,-- 患者类型代码
          (case a.patient_source when '1' then '门诊' when '2' then '住院' else '' end )  PAT_TYPE_NAME ,-- 患者类型名称
          BHO.PHONE1 PHONE_NO  ,-- 患者联系电话
          BHO.IDCARD  PAT_ID_NUMBER ,-- 患者身份证号
          a.name  PAT_NAME  ,-- 患者姓名
          (select decode(r.sex,'男','1','女','2') from  his.pat_master_index  r
                        where a.patient_id=r.patient_id) as PHYSI_SEX_CODE  ,-- 患者性别代码
          (select r.sex from  his.pat_master_index  r
                        where a.patient_id=r.patient_id)  PHYSI_SEX_NAME  ,-- 患者性别名称
          BHO.AGE1  AGE_YEAR  ,-- 患者年龄
          to_char(a.report_date_time,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')  EXAM_REPORT_DATE  ,-- 检查报告日期，日期格式：YYYYMMDDHH24MISS，如20190101235959
          (SELECT T.INP_NO FROM HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX T WHERE T.PATIENT_ID = A.PATIENT_ID)  REPORT_DR_SIGN_CODE ,-- 报告医师工号
          a.reporter  REPORT_DR_SIGN  ,-- 报告医师姓名
          a.technician  PROOF_DR_SIGN_CODE  ,-- 审核医师工号
          (select y.name from his.STAFF_DICT y where y.emp_no=a.technician)  PROOF_DR_SIGN ,-- 审核医师姓名
          (select y.name from his.STAFF_DICT y where y.emp_no=a.technician)  EXAM_TECHNICIAN_SIGN_CODE ,-- 检查技师工号
          (select d.name from HIS.STAFF_DICT d where a.technician=d.emp_no)  EXAM_TECHNICIAN_SIGN  ,-- 检查技师姓名
          a.technician  EXAM_DR_SIGN_CODE ,-- 检查医师工号
          (select d.name from HIS.STAFF_DICT d where a.technician=d.emp_no)  EXAM_DR_SIGN  ,-- 检查医师姓名
          (select q.dept_name from HIS.DEPT_DICT q where a.req_dept=q.dept_code)  EXAM_APPLY_DEPT_NAME  ,-- 检查申请科室名称
          (select t.admission_date_time from  his.pat_visit  t where a.patient_id=t.patient_id and a.visit_id=t.visit_id)  ADMIT_DATE  ,-- 入院日期时间，日期格式：YYYYMMDDHH24MISS，如20190101235959
          (select t.discharge_bed_no from  his.pat_visit  t where a.patient_id=t.patient_id and a.visit_id=t.visit_id)  BED_NAME  ,-- 病床名称
          (select t.discharge_bed_no from  his.pat_visit  t where a.patient_id=t.patient_id and a.visit_id=t.visit_id)  BED_CODE  ,-- 病床代码
          '-'  SICKROOM_NAME ,-- 病房名称
          '-'  SICKROOM_CODE ,-- 病房代码
          (select t.dept_admission_to from  his.pat_visit  t
          where a.patient_id=t.patient_id
          and a.visit_id=t.visit_id)  DEPT_CODE ,-- 科室代码
          (select q.dept_name from  his.pat_visit  t,his.dept_dict q
          where a.patient_id=t.patient_id
          and a.visit_id=t.visit_id
          and t.dept_admission_to=q.dept_code)  DEPT_NAME ,-- 科室名称
          (select t.adt_room_no from  his.pat_visit  t
          where a.patient_id=t.patient_id
          and a.visit_id=t.visit_id)  WARD_CODE ,-- 病区代码
          (select q.dept_name
          from  his.pat_visit  t,his.dept_dict q
          where a.patient_id=t.patient_id
          and a.visit_id=t.visit_id
          and t.adt_room_no=q.dept_code)  WARD_NAME ,-- 病区名称
          to_char(h.diagnosis_date,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')  DIAG_DATE ,-- 诊断日期，日期格式：YYYYMMDDHH24MISS，如20190101235959
          h.diagnosis_code  DIAG_CODE ,-- 西医诊断代码
          h.diagnosis_desc  DIAG_NAME ,-- 西医诊断名称
          '山东省第二人民医院（山东省耳鼻喉医院、山东省耳鼻喉研究所）'  DIAG_MI_NAME  ,-- 诊断医疗机构名称
          a.phys_sign  CHIEF_DESCR ,-- 主诉，记录患者本次疾病相关的主要症状及其持续时间
          '10101000000'  SYMPTOM_BEGIN_DATE  ,-- 症状开始时间，日期格式：YYYYMMDDHH24MISS，如20190101235959
          to_date('10101000000','YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')  SYMPTOM_STOP_DATE ,-- 症状停止时间，日期格式：YYYYMMDDHH24MISS，如20190101235959
          a.clin_symp  SYMPTOM_DESCR ,-- 症状描述，对患者出现症状的详细描述
          '-'  OPER_CODE ,-- 手术（操作）编码
          '-'  OPER_NAME ,-- 手术（操作）名称
           '10101000000'  OPER_DATE ,-- 操作日期时间，日期格式：YYYYMMDDHH24MISS，如20190101235959
          '-'  OPER_PART_CODE  ,-- 操作部位代码
          a.exam_sub_class  OPER_PART_NAME  ,-- 操作部位名称
          ''  INTERVENTION_OBJ_NAME ,-- 介入物名称
          a.exam_class  OPER_METHOD_DESCR ,-- 操作方法描述
          '1'  OPER_NUM  ,-- 操作次数
          '-'  ANES_METHOD_CODE  ,-- 麻醉方式代码
          '-'  ANES_METHOD_NAME  ,-- 麻醉方式名称
          '-'  ANES_DR_SIGN  ,-- 麻醉医师姓名
          '-'  ANES_OBSERVE_RESULT ,-- 麻醉观察结果
          '-'  ANES_CWM_IND_CODE ,-- 麻醉中西医标识代码
          '-'  ANES_CWM_IND_NAME ,-- 麻醉中西医标识名称
          '-'  SPECIAL_EXAM_FLAG ,-- 特殊检查标志，标识患者有无特殊检查操作经历的标志
          BHO.EXAMITEMS  EXAM_METHOD_NAME  ,-- 检查方法名称，患者接受医学检查项目所采用的检查方法名称
          a.exam_class  EXAM_CATEG_NAME ,-- 检查类别
          a.exam_date_time  EXAM_DATE ,-- 检查日期
          ''  EXAM_ITEM_CODE  ,-- 患者检查项目在特定编码体系中的代码
          '10101000000'  SPECIMEN_SAMPLING_DATE_TIME ,-- 标本采样日期时间，日期格式：YYYYMMDDHH24MISS，如20190101235959
          '10101000000'  RECEIVE_DATE  ,-- 接收标本日期时间 ，日期格式：YYYYMMDDHH24MISS，如20190101235959
          '-'  SAMPLE_TYPE_NAME  ,-- 标本类别名称
          '-'  SPECIMEN_STATUS ,-- 标本状态名称
          '-'  SPECIMEN_FIXATIVE_NAME  ,-- 标本固定液名称
          ''  EXAM_RESULT_CODE  ,-- 检查结果代码
          ''  EXAM_RESULT_NAME  ,-- 检查结果名称
          '-'  EXAM_RESULT ,-- 检查定量结果
          '-'  EXAM_RESULT_VALUE_UNIT  ,-- 检查定量结果计量单位
          a.phys_sign  TREAT_PROC_DESCR  ,-- 诊断过程，对患者诊疗过程的详细描述
          BHO.OPSDESC  EXAM_REPORT_RESULT  ,-- 检查报告结果-客观所见
          BHO.OPSDIAGNOSE  EXAM_RESULT_PROMPT  ,-- 检查报告结果-主观提示
          '超声诊疗室'  EXAM_REPORT_DEPT_NAME ,-- 检查报告科室名称
          '山东省第二人民医院（山东省耳鼻喉医院、山东省耳鼻喉研究所）'  EXAM_REPORT_MI_NAME ,-- 检查报告机构名称
          ''  EXAM_REPORT_NOTE  -- 检查报告备注
      FROM his.EXAM_MASTER a
          left join his.diagnosis h on a.patient_id=h.patient_id and a.visit_id=h.visit_id
          left join his.OPERATION o on a.patient_id=o.patient_id and a.visit_id=o.visit_id
          left join NJ.BHOSCHECKUS BHO on a.exam_no = BHO.HISID1

from mtl.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX t
inner JOIN mtl.EPR_INPATIENT t1
on t.UHID=t1.UHID /*and t1.DOC_STATS = '1'*/ and t1.doc_type_name ='首次病程记录'
inner join mtl.EMRSD37 T3 ON T3.段落编号=T1.ID
inner join cda.patient_info pi on pi.INHOS_NO = t.p_clinic_id and pi.INHOS_NUM = t.p_inpatient_times
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_CODE,ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_NAME,PRNA_WEST_CIS_POSITION,PRNA_DIAG_DATE,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY PRNA_WEST_CIS_POSITION) as rn
    FROM cda.入院西
) ZD
on ZD.rn = 1 and ZD.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and ZD.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_NONAG_CODE,ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_NONAG_NAME,ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_CIS_POSITION,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_CIS_POSITION) as rn
    FROM cda.入院中病
) ZD4
on ZD4.rn = 1 and ZD4.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and ZD4.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_SYMPTOM_CODE,ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_SYMPTOM_NAME,ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_CIS_POSITION,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_CIS_POSITION) as rn
    FROM cda.入院中证
) ZD5
on ZD5.rn = 1 and ZD5.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and ZD5.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,REVISED_DIAG_WEST_CODE,REVISED_DIAG_WEST_NAME,REVISED_WEST_CIS_POSITION,REVISED_DIAG_DATE,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY REVISED_WEST_CIS_POSITION) as rn
    FROM cda.修正西
) ZD6
on ZD6.rn = 1 and ZD6.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and ZD6.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,REVISED_DIAG_TCM_NONAG_CODE,REVISED_DIAG_TCM_NONAG_NAME,REVISED_TCM_CIS_POSITION,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY REVISED_TCM_CIS_POSITION) as rn
    FROM cda.修正中病
) ZD7
on ZD7.rn = 1 and ZD7.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and ZD7.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,REVISED_DIAG_TCM_SYNDROME_CODE,REVISED_DIAG_TCM_SYMPTOM_NAME,REVISED_DIAG_TCM_CIS_POSITION,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY REVISED_DIAG_TCM_CIS_POSITION) as rn
    FROM cda.修正中证
) ZD8
on ZD8.rn = 1 and ZD8.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and ZD8.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
Left Join
(
    select patient_id,visit_id,diagnosis_desc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id,visit_id ORDER BY DIAGNOSIS_DATE desc,DIAGNOSIS_NO) as rn
    from his.diagnosis where DIAGNOSIS_DATE is not null
) dd
On dd.rn=1 and pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO=dd.patient_id And pi.INHOS_NUM=dd.visit_id

from  HIS.PAT_VISIT a inner join his.pat_master_index t
on a.patient_id=t.patient_id and a.discharge_date_time is not null
inner join (
    select patient_id,visit_id,sum(costs) total
    from his.mr_bill_costs
    group by patient_id,visit_id
) r1  on a.patient_id=r1.patient_id and a.visit_id=r1.visit_id
inner join (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT PATIENT_ID,VISIT_ID,MR_BILL_CLASS,COSTS
        FROM his.mr_bill_costs
    )
    PIVOT (
         SUM(costs)
         FOR mr_bill_class IN ('01' AS MEDICAL_SERVICES_FEE,'02' AS TREAT_OPER_FEE,'03' AS NURSING_FEE,
                               '04' AS OTHER_MEDICAL_SERVICE_FEE,'05' AS PATHOLOGY_DIAG_FEE,'06' AS LAB_DIAG_FEE,
                               '07' AS IMAGE_DIAG_FEE,'08' AS CLINIC_DIAG_ITEM_FEE,'09' AS NONSURGERY_TREAT_FEE,
                               '0904' AS CLINIC_PHYSIC_FEE,'10' AS SURGERY_TREAT_FEE,'1001' AS ANAES_FEE,
                               '1002' AS SURGERY_FEE,'11' AS RECOVERY_FEE,'12' AS TCM_TREAT_FEE,
                               '13' AS WEST_DRUG_FEE,'1301' AS ANTIBAC_DRUG_FEE,'14' AS PATENT_DRUG_FEE,
                               '15' AS HERBAL_DRUG_FEE,'16' AS BLOOD_FEE,'17' AS AP_FEE,'18' AS GP_FEE,
                               '19' AS CFP_FEE,'20' AS BLOOD_CP_FEE,'21' AS EXAM_MATERIALS_FEE,
                               '22' AS SUPPLIES_TREAT_MATERIALS_FEE,'23' AS SURGERY_MATERIALS_FEE,'24' AS OTHER_FEE
                               )
          )
)r on a.patient_id=r.patient_id and a.visit_id=r.visit_id
and a.discharge_date_time>to_date('2023-01-01 00:00:00','yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss')

ydhl.inpatients YDZD inner join
ydhl.mcs_order_schedule WSFL
on  WSFL.PATIENT_UID=YDZD.pat_index_no and wsfl.ORDER_CLASS='A'
and wsfl.execute_time is not null and  Executer_Name is not null
and YDZD.Admission_Ward_Time>= to_date('2023-01-01 00:00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
inner join cda.patient_info pi on pi.INHOS_NO = SUBSTR(YDZD.PATIENT_ID, 1, INSTR(YDZD.PATIENT_ID, '_') - 1)
and to_char(pi.INHOS_NUM) = SUBSTR(YDZD.PATIENT_ID,INSTR(YDZD.PATIENT_ID, '_') + 1)
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_CODE,ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_NAME,PRNA_WEST_CIS_POSITION,PRNA_DIAG_DATE,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY PRNA_WEST_CIS_POSITION) as rn
    FROM cda.入院西
) ZD
on ZD.rn =1 and ZD.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and ZD.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
Left Join
(
    select a.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id,visit_id ORDER BY DIAGNOSIS_NO) as rn
    from his.diagnosis a where DIAGNOSIS_TYPE ='3'
) dd On dd.rn = 1 and pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO=dd.patient_id And pi.INHOS_NUM=dd.visit_id
