from mtl.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX t--患者信息
inner JOIN mtl.EPR_INPATIENT t1 on t.UHID=t1.UHID and t1.doc_type_name like '入院记录'
left join mtl.EMRSD34 T3 ON T3.段落编号=T1.ID
Left Join MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT t4 On t4.UHID=t.UHID and t4.段落编号=T1.ID
inner join cda.patient_info pi on pi.INHOS_NO = t.p_clinic_id and pi.INHOS_NUM = t.p_inpatient_times
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_CODE,ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_NAME,PRNA_WEST_CIS_POSITION,PRNA_DIAG_DATE,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY PRNA_WEST_CIS_POSITION) as rn
    FROM cda.入院西
) ZD
on ZD.rn = 1 and ZD.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and ZD.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_NONAG_CODE,ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_NONAG_NAME,ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_CIS_POSITION,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_CIS_POSITION) as rn
    FROM cda.入院中病
) ZD4
on ZD4.rn = 1 and ZD4.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and ZD4.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_SYMPTOM_CODE,ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_SYMPTOM_NAME,ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_CIS_POSITION,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_CIS_POSITION) as rn
    FROM cda.入院中证
) ZD5
on ZD5.rn = 1 and ZD5.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and ZD5.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
left join cda.出院西 zd1 on zd1.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and zd1.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
left join cda.出院中病 zd2 on zd2.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and zd2.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
left join cda.出院中证 zd3 on zd3.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and zd3.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,REVISED_DIAG_WEST_CODE,REVISED_DIAG_WEST_NAME,REVISED_WEST_CIS_POSITION,REVISED_DIAG_DATE,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY REVISED_WEST_CIS_POSITION) as rn
    FROM cda.修正西
) ZD6
on ZD6.rn = 1 and ZD6.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and ZD6.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,REVISED_DIAG_TCM_NONAG_CODE,REVISED_DIAG_TCM_NONAG_NAME,REVISED_TCM_CIS_POSITION,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY REVISED_TCM_CIS_POSITION) as rn
    FROM cda.修正中病
) ZD7
on ZD7.rn = 1 and ZD7.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and ZD7.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,REVISED_DIAG_TCM_SYNDROME_CODE,REVISED_DIAG_TCM_SYMPTOM_NAME,REVISED_DIAG_TCM_CIS_POSITION,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY REVISED_DIAG_TCM_CIS_POSITION) as rn
    FROM cda.修正中证
) ZD8
on ZD8.rn = 1 and ZD8.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and ZD8.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
Left Join
(
    select a.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PATIENT_ID,VISIT_ID ORDER BY DIAGNOSIS_DATE desc,DIAGNOSIS_NO) as rn
    from his.diagnosis a where DIAGNOSIS_TYPE='3'
)d On d.rn=1 and pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO=d.patient_id And pi.INHOS_NUM=d.visit_id
left join cda.tt_patient_nurse_info pni
on pni.patient_id = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO||'_'||pi.INHOS_NUM

from ydhl.mcs_doc_form f inner join ydhl.inpatients ydzd
on
 f.PATIENT_UID=ydzd.pat_index_no
and f.TEMPLATE_CODE='846'
and f.is_valid='1'
and f.created_by<>'dba'
and f.form_time >= to_date('2023-01-01 00:00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
inner join cda.patient_info pi on pi.INHOS_NO = SUBSTR(YDZD.PATIENT_ID, 1, INSTR(YDZD.PATIENT_ID, '_') - 1)
and to_char(pi.INHOS_NUM) = SUBSTR(YDZD.PATIENT_ID,INSTR(YDZD.PATIENT_ID, '_') + 1)
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_CODE,ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_NAME,PRNA_WEST_CIS_POSITION,PRNA_DIAG_DATE,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY PRNA_WEST_CIS_POSITION) as rn
    FROM cda.入院西
) ZD1
on ZD1.rn = 1 and ZD1.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and ZD1.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
Left Join
(
    select patient_id,visit_id,diagnosis_desc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id,visit_id ORDER BY DIAGNOSIS_DATE desc,DIAGNOSIS_NO) as rn
    from his.diagnosis where DIAGNOSIS_DATE is not null
) d

from cda.patient_info pi
inner join mtl.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX t
on pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = t.p_clinic_id and pi.INHOS_NUM = t.p_inpatient_times
inner JOIN mtl.EPR_INPATIENT t1
on t.UHID=t1.UHID and /*t1.DOC_STATS = '1'*/ (t1.doc_type_name = '术前小结' or t1.doc_type_name = '术前讨论') and t1.doc_title <> '首次病程记录'
left join mtl.EMRSD47 T3 ON T3.段落编号=T1.ID
left join mtl.EPR_INPATIENT t2
on t.UHID=t2.UHID and t2.doc_type_name = '术前小结' and t2.doc_title <> '首次病程记录'
left join mtl.EMRSD46 T4 ON T4.段落编号=T2.ID
left join mtl.emrsd_content t5 on t5.段落编号=T2.ID or t5.段落编号=T1.ID
left join
(
   select a.*,
   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id,visit_id ORDER BY OPERATION_NO,OPERATING_DATE desc) as rn
   from  his.operation a
) o on o.rn=1 and o.patient_id = t.p_clinic_id and o.visit_id = t.p_inpatient_times
/*left join mtl.his_met_com_diagnose zd on zd.inpatient_no = t.p_hisid and zd.card_no = t.p_clinic_id and zd.DIAG_FLAG = '1' and zd.DIAG_KINDNAME = '术前诊断'*/
left join cda.术前诊断 zd on zd.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and zd.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
left join cda.入院西 zd2 on zd2.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and zd2.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
left join
(
   select a.*,
   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id,visit_id ORDER BY OPER_ID) as rn
   from sm.med_operation_master a
) mom on mom.rn=1 and t.p_clinic_id = mom.patient_id and t.p_inpatient_times = mom.visit_id

from cda.patient_info pi
left join mtl.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX t on t.p_clinic_id = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and t.p_inpatient_times = pi.INHOS_NUM
inner JOIN mtl.EPR_INPATIENT t1
on t.UHID=t1.UHID and t1.doc_type_name ='阶段小结'
left join mtl.EMRSD43 T3 ON T3.段落编号=T1.ID
Left Join MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT t4 On t4.UHID=t.UHID and t4.段落编号=t1.id
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_CODE,ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_NAME,PRNA_WEST_CIS_POSITION,PRNA_DIAG_DATE,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY PRNA_DIAG_DATE desc) as rn
    FROM cda.入院西 where PRNA_WEST_CIS_POSITION = '0'
) ZD
on ZD.rn = 1 and ZD.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and ZD.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_NONAG_CODE,ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_NONAG_NAME,ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_CIS_POSITION,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_CIS_POSITION) as rn
    FROM cda.入院中病
) ZD4
on ZD4.rn = 1 and ZD4.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and ZD4.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_SYMPTOM_CODE,ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_SYMPTOM_NAME,ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_CIS_POSITION,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_CIS_POSITION) as rn
    FROM cda.入院中证
) ZD5
on ZD5.rn = 1 and ZD5.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and ZD5.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,REVISED_DIAG_WEST_CODE,REVISED_DIAG_WEST_NAME,REVISED_WEST_CIS_POSITION,REVISED_DIAG_DATE,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY REVISED_DIAG_DATE desc) as rn
    FROM cda.修正西 where REVISED_WEST_CIS_POSITION = '0'
) ZD1
on ZD1.rn = 1 and ZD1.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and ZD1.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,REVISED_DIAG_TCM_NONAG_CODE,REVISED_DIAG_TCM_NONAG_NAME,REVISED_TCM_CIS_POSITION,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY REVISED_TCM_CIS_POSITION) as rn
    FROM cda.修正中病
) ZD2
on ZD2.rn = 1 and ZD2.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and ZD2.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,REVISED_DIAG_TCM_SYNDROME_CODE,REVISED_DIAG_TCM_SYMPTOM_NAME,REVISED_DIAG_TCM_CIS_POSITION,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY REVISED_DIAG_TCM_CIS_POSITION) as rn
    FROM cda.修正中证
) ZD3
on ZD3.rn = 1 and ZD3.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and ZD3.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
Left Join
(
    select a.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PATIENT_ID,VISIT_ID ORDER BY DIAGNOSIS_DATE desc,DIAGNOSIS_NO) as rn
    from his.diagnosis a where DIAGNOSIS_DATE is not null
)dd On dd.rn=1 and pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO=dd.patient_id And pi.INHOS_NUM=dd.visit_id

from mtl.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX t
inner JOIN mtl.EPR_INPATIENT t1
on t.UHID=t1.UHID /*and t1.DOC_STATS = '1' */and t1.doc_type_name ='24小时内入院死亡记录'
left join mtl.EMRSD36 T3 ON T3.段落编号=T1.ID
inner join cda.patient_info pi on pi.INHOS_NO = t.p_clinic_id and pi.INHOS_NUM = t.p_inpatient_times
left join cda.入院西 zd on zd.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and zd.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
left join cda.入院中病 zd4 on zd4.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and zd4.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
left join cda.入院中证 zd5 on zd5.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and zd5.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
Left Join his.diagnosis dd On dd.DIAGNOSIS_DATE is not null and pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO=dd.patient_id And pi.INHOS_NUM=dd.visit_id
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_CODE,ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_NAME,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY PRNA_WEST_CIS_POSITION) as rn
    FROM cda.入院西
) a
on a.rn = 1 and a.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and a.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
Left Join
(
    select patient_id,visit_id,diagnosis_desc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id,visit_id ORDER BY DIAGNOSIS_DATE desc,DIAGNOSIS_NO) as rn
    from his.diagnosis where DIAGNOSIS_DATE is not null
) d
On d.rn=1 and pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO=d.patient_id And pi.INHOS_NUM=d.visit_id

          ,case when pi.patient_area_address LIKE '%镇%' then substr(pi.patient_area_address,instr(pi.patient_area_address,'镇',-1)+1 ) end
          ,case when pi.patient_area_address LIKE '%槐荫区%' then substr(pi.patient_area_address,instr(pi.patient_area_address,'槐荫区',-1)+3 ) end
          ,case when pi.patient_area_address LIKE '%济南市%' then substr(pi.patient_area_address,instr(pi.patient_area_address,'济南市',-1)+3 ) end
          ,case when pi.patient_area_address LIKE '%山东省%' then substr(pi.patient_area_address,instr(pi.patient_area_address,'山东省',-1)+3 ) end
          ,pi.patient_area_address,'-' )  ADDR_HOUSE_NO,--家庭住址，地址-门牌号码
coalesce(
         ( case WHEN pi.patient_area_address LIKE '%街道%街%' then  substr(pi.patient_area_address,instr(pi.patient_area_address,'街',-1)-2,3)
                WHEN pi.patient_area_address LIKE '%村%' then  substr(pi.patient_area_address,instr(pi.patient_area_address,'村')-2,3)
                WHEN pi.patient_area_address LIKE '%路%' then  substr(pi.patient_area_address,instr(pi.patient_area_address,'路')-2,3) else '' end)
         ,case  WHEN pi.patient_area_address LIKE '%槐荫区%' AND INSTR(pi.patient_area_address,'小区',-1)>0 then substr(pi.patient_area_address,instr(pi.patient_area_address,'槐荫区',-1)+3,INSTR(pi.patient_area_address,'小区',-1)-instr(pi.patient_area_address,'槐荫区',-1)-1) end
         ,case  WHEN pi.patient_area_address LIKE '%槐荫区%' AND INSTR(pi.patient_area_address,'生活区',-1)>0 then substr(pi.patient_area_address,instr(pi.patient_area_address,'槐荫区',-1)+3,INSTR(pi.patient_area_address,'生活区',-1)-instr(pi.patient_area_address,'槐荫区',-1)) end
         ,case when pi.patient_area_address LIKE '%槐荫区%' then substr(pi.patient_area_address,instr(pi.patient_area_address,'槐荫区',-1)+3 ) end
         ,case when pi.patient_area_address LIKE '%济南市%' then substr(pi.patient_area_address,instr(pi.patient_area_address,'济南市',-1)+3 ) end
         ,case when pi.patient_area_address LIKE '%山东省%' then substr(pi.patient_area_address,instr(pi.patient_area_address,'山东省',-1)+3 ) end
         ,pi.patient_area_address,'-')  ADDR_VILLAGE,--家庭住址，地址-村（街、路、弄等）
 CASE WHEN pi.patient_area_address LIKE '%镇%' then (case when pi.patient_area_address LIKE '%市%镇%'then substr(pi.patient_area_address,instr(pi.patient_area_address,'市',-1)+1,instr(pi.patient_area_address,'镇')-instr(pi.patient_area_address,'市',-1))
                                                        WHEN pi.patient_area_address LIKE '%区%镇%'then substr(pi.patient_area_address,instr(pi.patient_area_address,'区')+1,instr(pi.patient_area_address,'镇')-instr(pi.patient_area_address,'区'))
                                                        WHEN pi.patient_area_address LIKE '%县%镇%'then substr(pi.patient_area_address,instr(pi.patient_area_address,'县')+1,instr(pi.patient_area_address,'镇')-instr(pi.patient_area_address,'县'))
                                                        else substr(pi.patient_area_address,instr(pi.patient_area_address,'镇')-2,3) end)
                   WHEN pi.patient_area_address LIKE '%街道%' then  substr(pi.patient_area_address,instr(pi.patient_area_address,'街道')-2,4)
                   WHEN pi.patient_area_address LIKE '%乡%' then  substr(pi.patient_area_address,instr(pi.patient_area_address,'乡')-2,3)
                   when pi.patient_area_address LIKE '%生活区%' then  substr(pi.patient_area_address,instr(pi.patient_area_address,'生活区')-2,5)
                   when pi.patient_area_address LIKE '%生活小区%' then  substr(pi.patient_area_address,instr(pi.patient_area_address,'生活小区')-2,6)
                   else '-' end  ADDR_TOWNSHIP,--家庭住址，地址-乡（镇、街道办事处）
coalesce(
              case when pi.patient_area_address like '%槐荫%' then '槐荫区'
                   when pi.patient_area_address like '%县%' then substr(pi.patient_area_address,instr(pi.patient_area_address,'县')-2,3)
                   when pi.patient_area_address like '%区%' then substr(pi.patient_area_address,instr(pi.patient_area_address,'区')-2,3) end
              ,'-') ADDR_COUNTY,--家庭住址，地址-县（区）
coalesce(

                   when pi.patient_area_address like '%济南%' then '济南市'
                   else substr(pi.patient_area_address ,instr(pi.patient_area_address,'省')+1,instr(pi.patient_area_address,'市')-instr(pi.patient_area_address,'省')-1) end

from cda.patient_info pi
inner join mtl.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX t on t.p_clinic_id = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and t.p_inpatient_times = pi.INHOS_NUM
inner JOIN mtl.EPR_INPATIENT t1
on t.UHID=t1.UHID and t1.doc_type_name = '转科记录'
left join mtl.EMRSD42 T3 ON T3.段落编号=T1.ID
left JOIN mtl.EPR_INPATIENT t2
on t.UHID=t2.UHID and t2.doc_type_name = '转入记录'
Left Join MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT t4 On t4.段落编号=T1.ID
Left Join MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT t5 On t5.段落编号=T2.ID
left join his.adt_log al on al.patient_id = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and al.visit_id = pi.INHOS_NUM and al.action = 'E'
left join his.adt_log al1 on al1.patient_id = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and al.visit_id = pi.INHOS_NUM and al1.action = 'D'
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_CODE,ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_NAME,PRNA_WEST_CIS_POSITION,PRNA_DIAG_DATE,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY PRNA_DIAG_DATE desc) as rn
    FROM cda.入院西 where PRNA_WEST_CIS_POSITION = '0'
) ZD
on ZD.rn = 1 and ZD.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and ZD.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_NONAG_CODE,ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_NONAG_NAME,ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_CIS_POSITION,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_CIS_POSITION) as rn
    FROM cda.入院中病
) ZD4
on ZD4.rn = 1 and ZD4.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and ZD4.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_SYMPTOM_CODE,ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_SYMPTOM_NAME,ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_CIS_POSITION,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_CIS_POSITION) as rn
    FROM cda.入院中证
) ZD5
on ZD5.rn = 1 and ZD5.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and ZD5.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,REVISED_DIAG_WEST_CODE,REVISED_DIAG_WEST_NAME,REVISED_WEST_CIS_POSITION,REVISED_DIAG_DATE,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY REVISED_DIAG_DATE desc) as rn
    FROM cda.修正西 where REVISED_WEST_CIS_POSITION = '0'
) ZD1
on ZD1.rn = 1 and ZD1.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and ZD1.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,REVISED_DIAG_TCM_NONAG_CODE,REVISED_DIAG_TCM_NONAG_NAME,REVISED_TCM_CIS_POSITION,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY REVISED_TCM_CIS_POSITION) as rn
    FROM cda.修正中病
) ZD2
on ZD2.rn = 1 and ZD2.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and ZD2.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,REVISED_DIAG_TCM_SYNDROME_CODE,REVISED_DIAG_TCM_SYMPTOM_NAME,REVISED_DIAG_TCM_CIS_POSITION,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY REVISED_DIAG_TCM_CIS_POSITION) as rn
    FROM cda.修正中证
) ZD3
on ZD3.rn = 1 and ZD3.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO and ZD3.INHOS_NUM = pi.INHOS_NUM
Left Join
(
    select a.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PATIENT_ID,VISIT_ID ORDER BY DIAGNOSIS_DATE desc,DIAGNOSIS_NO) as rn
    from his.diagnosis a where DIAGNOSIS_DATE is not null
)dd On dd.rn=1 and pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO=dd.patient_id And pi.INHOS_NUM=dd.visit_id

nvl(( Select dd.国标编码 from cda.cda_dictionary dd Where dd.字典名称 Like '%频次%' And dd.院标名称=t.frequency),'99')  DRUG_USE_RATE ,-- 药物使用频率代码

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "CDA"."T_PATIENT_NURSE_INFO" ("PATIENT_UID", "PATIENT_ID", "RN", "TEMPERATURE", "PULSE_RATE", "BREATHING_RATE", "SYSTOLIC_PRESSURE", "DIASTOLIC_PRESSURE", "WEIGHT", "HEIGHT", "DISEASE_HISTORY", "SURGERY_HISTORY", "METACHYSIS_HISTORY", "ALLERGY_HISTORY", "FAMILY_HISTORY", "DRINKING_HISTORY", "DRINKING_RATE_NAME", "DAY_DRINKING", "SMOKING_HISTORY", "DELETE_SMOKING", "DAY_SMOKING", "STOP_SMOKING_DAYS", "DIET_SITUATION_NAME", "NURSING_OBSERVE_RESULT", "ADMIT_WAY_NAME", "IN_SICKROOM_METHOD", "IMAIN_SYMPTOM") AS 
  select "PATIENT_UID","PATIENT_ID","RN","TEMPERATURE","PULSE_RATE","BREATHING_RATE","SYSTOLIC_PRESSURE","DIASTOLIC_PRESSURE","WEIGHT","HEIGHT","DISEASE_HISTORY","SURGERY_HISTORY","METACHYSIS_HISTORY","ALLERGY_HISTORY","FAMILY_HISTORY","DRINKING_HISTORY","DRINKING_RATE_NAME","DAY_DRINKING","SMOKING_HISTORY","DELETE_SMOKING","DAY_SMOKING","STOP_SMOKING_DAYS","DIET_SITUATION_NAME","NURSING_OBSERVE_RESULT","ADMIT_WAY_NAME","IN_SICKROOM_METHOD","IMAIN_SYMPTOM" from
(
select * from
(
select a.ASSESS_VALUE,a.ASSESS_CODE,f.PATIENT_UID,ydzd.PATIENT_ID
,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.PATIENT_UID,ydzd.PATIENT_ID,a.ASSESS_CODE ORDER BY f.generator_type desc,a.ASSESS_TIME) as rn
from ydhl.mcs_assess_form f
inner join ydhl.inpatients ydzd
on f.PATIENT_UID=ydzd.pat_index_no
inner join ydhl.mcs_assess_form_record a
on A.FORM_ID=f.ID
and f.is_valid='1'
where a.ASSESS_VALUE is not null
) a
where a.rn=1
) aa
PIVOT (
     max(ASSESS_VALUE)
     FOR ASSESS_CODE IN ('K01003' AS TEMPERATURE  --体温
                        ,'K01009' AS PULSE_RATE  --脉搏
                        ,'K01010' AS BREATHING_RATE  --呼吸频率
                        ,'K01011' AS SYSTOLIC_PRESSURE  -- 收缩压测量值
                        ,'K01012' AS DIASTOLIC_PRESSURE -- 舒张压测量值
                        ,'K02006' AS WEIGHT  --体重（kg）
                        ,'K02007' AS height  --身高
                        ,'Z04002' AS DISEASE_HISTORY  -- 疾病史（含外伤）
                        ,'Z04015' AS SURGERY_HISTORY  -- 手术史
                        ,'Z04021' AS METACHYSIS_HISTORY  -- 输血史
                        ,'Z04031' AS ALLERGY_HISTORY  -- 过敏史
                        ,'Z06005' AS FAMILY_HISTORY   -- 家族史
                        ,'Z05021' AS DRINKING_HISTORY  -- 饮酒史
                        ,'Z05023' AS DRINKING_RATE_NAME   -- 饮酒频率名称
                        ,'Z05024' AS DAY_DRINKING  -- 日饮酒量（mL）
                        ,'Z05014' AS SMOKING_HISTORY  -- 吸烟史
                        ,'Z05018' AS delete_SMOKING  -- 是否戒烟
                        ,'Z05017' AS DAY_SMOKING  -- 日吸烟量(支)
                        ,'Z05019' AS STOP_SMOKING_DAYS -- 停止吸烟天数
                        ,'J01018' AS DIET_SITUATION_NAME  -- 饮食情况名称
                        ,'D02001' AS NURSING_OBSERVE_RESULT -- 护理观察结果
                        ,'Z01026' AS ADMIT_WAY_NAME   -- 入院途径名称
                        ,'Z01028' AS IN_SICKROOM_METHOD  -- 入病房方式 必填
                        ,'Z01031' AS IMAIN_SYMPTOM  -- 主要症状名称  必填
                         )
)

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "CDA"."T_SS" ("INHOS_NO", "VISIT_ID", "SURGERY_OPER_CODE", "SURGERY_OPER_NAME") AS 
  select
pv.patient_id INHOS_NO,--患者住院号，同一患者多次住院，住院号相同
pv.visit_id VISIT_ID,--患者就诊/住院流水号，同一患者多次就诊/住院，流水号不同
nvl(t3.ssjczbm,o.operation_code)  SURGERY_OPER_CODE ,-- 手术及操作代码
nvl(t3.ssmc,o.operation_desc)  SURGERY_OPER_NAME -- 手术及操作名称
from mtl.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX t--患者信息
inner JOIN mtl.EPR_INPATIENT t1
on t.UHID=t1.UHID and t1.DOC_STATS = '1' and t1.doc_type_name  like '手术记录'
left join mtl.EMRSD9 T3 ON T3.段落编号=T1.ID
left join his.pat_master_index pmi on pmi.patient_id = t.p_clinic_id
left join his.pat_visit pv on pv.patient_id = t.p_clinic_id and pv.visit_id = t.p_inpatient_times
left join his.operation o on pv.patient_id = o.patient_id and pv.visit_id = o.visit_id
left join sm.med_operation_master mom on mom.patient_id = pv.patient_id and mom.visit_id = pv.visit_id
left join mtl.his_met_com_diagnose zd on zd.inpatient_no = t.p_hisid and zd.card_no = t.p_clinic_id and zd.DIAG_FLAG = '1' and zd.DIAG_KINDNAME = '术前诊断'
left join mtl.his_met_com_diagnose zd1 on zd1.inpatient_no = t.p_hisid and zd1.card_no = t.p_clinic_id and zd1.DIAG_FLAG = '1' and zd1.DIAG_KINDNAME = '术后诊断'
where t.p_indate >= to_date('2023-01-01 00:00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "CDA"."T_YLDJ" ("移动护理关联", "住院号", "住院次", "护理等级代码", "护理等级名称", "护理类型代码", "护理类型名称", "XH") AS 
  SELECT
ydzd.pat_index_no 移动护理关联，
pv.patient_id 住院号,
pv.visit_id 住院次,
(case when ydzd.nursing_class='999' then '3' else  nvl(ydzd.nursing_class ,'3')  end)  护理等级代码  ,-- 护理等级代码
decode((case when ydzd.nursing_class='999' then '3' else  nvl(ydzd.nursing_class ,'3')  end),'1','特级护理','2','一级护理','3','二级护理','4','三级护理')  护理等级名称  ,-- 护理等级名称
(case when ydzd.nursing_class='999' then '3' else  nvl(ydzd.nursing_class ,'3')  end)  护理类型代码 ,-- 护理类型代码
decode((case when ydzd.nursing_class='999' then '3' else  nvl(ydzd.nursing_class ,'3')  end),'1','基础护理','2','特殊护理','3','辨证施护','9','其他')  护理类型名称, -- 护理类型名称
row_number() over (partition by ydzd.patient_id order by ydzd.admission_time) xh
FROM
ydhl.inpatients YDZD,

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "CDA"."V_ESBHL_INSPECTION_ROD" ("CONTENT_ID", "OUTHOS_NO", "INHOS_NO", "VISIT_ID", "INHOS_NUM", "AUTHOR_CODE", "AUTHOR_NAME", "AUTHOR_TIME", "EFFECTIVETIME", "OUTHOSP_INDEX_NO", "INHOSP_INDEX_NO", "PAT_INDEX_NO", "TEST_REPORT_NO", "ELECTR_REQUISITION_NO", "TEST_SPECIMEN_NO", "PAT_TYPE_CODE", "PAT_TYPE_NAME", "PHONE_NO", "PAT_ID_NUMBER", "PAT_NAME", "PHYSI_SEX_CODE", "PHYSI_SEX_NAME", "AGE_YEAR", "TEST_REPORT_DATE", "REPORT_DR_SIGN_CODE", "REPORT_DR_SIGN", "PROOF_DR_SIGN_CODE", "PROOF_DR_SIGN", "TEST_TECHNICIAN_SIGN_CODE", "TEST_TECHNICIAN_SIGN", "EXAM_DR_SIGN_CODE", "EXAM_DR_SIGN", "TEST_APPLY_DEPT_CODE", "TEST_APPLY_DEPT", "TEST_APPLY_ORGANIZATION_NAME", "ADMIT_DATE", "BED_NAME", "BED_CODE", "SICKROOM_NAME", "SICKROOM_CODE", "DEPT_CODE", "DEPT_NAME", "WARD_CODE", "WARD_NAME", "DIAG_DETAIL_FORXML", "DIAG_MI_NAME", "TEST_METHOD_NAME", "TEST_CATEG_NAME", "TEST_RESULT_FORXML", "TEST_REPORT_RESULT", "TEST_REPORT_DEPT", "TEST_REPORT_INSTITUTION_NAME", "TEST_REPORT_NOTE") AS 
  select
    CONTENT_ID,
    OUTHOS_NO,
    INHOS_NO,
    VISIT_ID,
    INHOS_NUM,
    AUTHOR_CODE,
    nvl(AUTHOR_NAME,'-') AUTHOR_NAME,
    AUTHOR_TIME,
    EFFECTIVETIME,
    OUTHOSP_INDEX_NO,
    INHOSP_INDEX_NO,
    OUTHOSP_INDEX_NO AS PAT_INDEX_NO,
    nvl(TEST_REPORT_NO,'-') as TEST_REPORT_NO,
    ELECTR_REQUISITION_NO,
    TEST_SPECIMEN_NO,
    PAT_TYPE_CODE,
    PAT_TYPE_NAME,
    PHONE_NO,
    PAT_ID_NUMBER,
    PAT_NAME,
    PHYSI_SEX_CODE,
    PHYSI_SEX_NAME,
    AGE_YEAR,
    TEST_REPORT_DATE,
    nvl(REPORT_DR_SIGN_CODE,'000285') REPORT_DR_SIGN_CODE,
    nvl(REPORT_DR_SIGN,'蔡德建') REPORT_DR_SIGN,
    nvl(nvl(PROOF_DR_SIGN_CODE,REPORT_DR_SIGN_CODE),'000285') PROOF_DR_SIGN_CODE,
    nvl(nvl(PROOF_DR_SIGN,REPORT_DR_SIGN),'蔡德建') PROOF_DR_SIGN,
    nvl(TEST_TECHNICIAN_SIGN_CODE,'002360') TEST_TECHNICIAN_SIGN_CODE,
    nvl(TEST_TECHNICIAN_SIGN,'张慧敏') TEST_TECHNICIAN_SIGN,
    EXAM_DR_SIGN_CODE,
    EXAM_DR_SIGN,
    TEST_APPLY_DEPT_CODE,
    TEST_APPLY_DEPT,
    TEST_APPLY_ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    ADMIT_DATE,
    BED_NAME,
    BED_CODE,
    SICKROOM_NAME,
    SICKROOM_CODE,
    DEPT_CODE,
    DEPT_NAME,
    WARD_CODE,
    WARD_NAME,
    XMLType.getClobVal((select xmlagg(XMLELEMENT("DIAG_DETAIL_ForXML",
                           xmlforest(DIAG_DATE,
                                     DIAG_CODE,
                                     DIAG_NAME)
                             )
                   )
    from (select distinct INHOS_NO,
                          VISIT_ID,
                          ELECTR_REQUISITION_NO,
                          nvl(to_char(DIAG_DATE), ' ') DIAG_DATE,
                          DIAG_CODE,
                          DIAG_NAME
            from cda.Tt_ESBHL_INSPECTION_ROD) b
            where T.INHOS_NO = b.INHOS_NO
            AND T.VISIT_ID = b.VISIT_ID
            and T.ELECTR_REQUISITION_NO=b.ELECTR_REQUISITION_NO
    )) AS DIAG_DETAIL_ForXML,
    DIAG_MI_NAME,
    nvl(TEST_METHOD_NAME,'-') as TEST_METHOD_NAME,
    nvl(TEST_CATEG_NAME,'-') as TEST_CATEG_NAME,
    XMLType.getClobVal((select xmlagg(XMLELEMENT("TEST_RESULT_ForXML",
                           xmlforest(TEST_DATE,
                                     TEST_ITEM_CODE,
                                     SPECIMEN_SAMPLING_DATE_TIME,
                                     RECEIVE_DATE,
                                     SAMPLE_TYPE_NAME,
                                     SPECIMEN_STATUS,
                                     EXAM_RESULT_CODE,
                                     EXAM_RESULT_NAME,
                                     TEST_RESULT_VALUE,
                                     TEST_RESULT_VALUE_UNIT)
                             )
                   )
    from (select distinct INHOS_NO,
                          VISIT_ID,
                          ELECTR_REQUISITION_NO,
                          nvl(to_char(TEST_DATE), '-') TEST_DATE,
                          nvl(TEST_ITEM_CODE,'-') TEST_ITEM_CODE,
                          SPECIMEN_SAMPLING_DATE_TIME,

V_F1.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "CDA"."V_F1" ("ID", "VI", "PATIENT_ID", "PATIENT_UID", "FORM_TIME", "TEMPERATURE", "PULSE_RATE", "BREATHING_RATE", "SYSTOLIC_PRESSURE", "DIASTOLIC_PRESSURE", "WEIGHT", "ADMIT_REASON") AS 
  SELECT
h.patient_id id,
h.visit_id vi,
        I.PATIENT_ID,
        F1.PATIENT_UID,
        F1.FORM_TIME,
        (SELECT TO_CHAR(WM_CONCAT(DECODE(R.NODE_CODE,00172,r.NUMBER_VALUE,decode(R.NODE_CODE,00112,r.NUMBER_VALUE)))) FROM YDHL.MCS_DOC_FORM_RECORDS R
            WHERE F1.ID=R.FORM_ID
             AND (R.NODE_CODE='00172'or r.NODE_CODE='00112') )  AS TEMPERATURE ,----体温(℃）
         (SELECT TO_CHAR(WM_CONCAT(DECODE(R.NODE_CODE,00121,R.NUMBER_VALUE,''))) FROM YDHL.MCS_DOC_FORM_RECORDS R
            WHERE F1.ID=R.FORM_ID
             AND R.NODE_CODE='00121' ) AS PULSE_RATE, ----脉率(次/MIN）
             (SELECT TO_CHAR(WM_CONCAT(DECODE(R.NODE_CODE,00122,R.NUMBER_VALUE,''))) FROM YDHL.MCS_DOC_FORM_RECORDS R
            WHERE F1.ID=R.FORM_ID
             AND R.NODE_CODE='00122' ) AS BREATHING_RATE, ----呼吸频率(次/MIN）
             (SELECT TO_CHAR(WM_CONCAT(DECODE(R.NODE_CODE,00117,R.NUMBER_VALUE,''))) FROM YDHL.MCS_DOC_FORM_RECORDS R
            WHERE F1.ID=R.FORM_ID
             AND R.NODE_CODE='00117' ) AS SYSTOLIC_PRESSURE, ----收缩压(MMHG）
                (SELECT TO_CHAR(WM_CONCAT(DECODE(R.NODE_CODE,00119,R.NUMBER_VALUE,''))) FROM YDHL.MCS_DOC_FORM_RECORDS R
            WHERE F1.ID=R.FORM_ID
             AND R.NODE_CODE='00119' ) AS DIASTOLIC_PRESSURE, ----舒张压(MMHG）
              '' AS WEIGHT, ----体重(KG）
         '' AS ADMIT_REASON ----入院原因
      FROM YDHL.MCS_DOC_FORM F1,
           YDHL.INPATIENTS I,
           HIS.Pat_Visit H
      WHERE F1.TEMPLATE_CODE='572'
        AND F1.IS_VALID ='1'
        AND F1.PATIENT_UID=I.PAT_INDEX_NO
      and to_char(substr(i.patient_id,'1','8'))=to_char(h.patient_id)
and to_char(substr(i.patient_id,'10','10'))=to_char(h.visit_id)

  select
       to_char(tr.hzbs) as INHOSP_INDEX_NO,-- 住院患者标识
       to_char(tr.zycs) as VISIT_NUM,-- 就诊次数
       to_char(tr.hzbs) as PATIENT_ID,--  患者id
       to_char(tr.hzbs) as OUTHOSP_INDEX_NO,--  门诊患者标识
       to_char(tr.bah) as VISIT_ID,--  就诊流水号
       to_char(decode(tr.lx,'门诊','1','3')) as VISIT_TYPE_CODE,-- 就诊类型编码
       to_char(tr.lx) as VISIT_TYPE_NAME,-- 就诊类型名称
       to_char(tr.sfzh) as PAT_ID_NUMBER,-- 身份证号
       to_char('-') as INSURANCE_ID,--  医保卡号
       to_char(tr.hzxm) as PAT_NAME,--  患者姓名
       to_char(nvl(pmt.PHONE_NUMBER_HOME,'-')) as PHONE_NO,--  联系电话
       to_char(decode(tr.xb,'男','1','女','2')) as PHYSI_SEX_CODE,--  性别代码
       to_char(decode(tr.xb,'男','男性','女','女性')) as PHYSI_SEX_NAME,--  性别
       nvl(to_char(pmt.date_of_birth,'yyyymmdd'),substr(tr.sfzh,6,8)) as DATE_BIRTH,--  出生日期
       to_char(tr.nl) as AGE,-- 年龄
       to_char(pmt.mailing_address) as ADDR_DETIL,--  住址
       to_char(tr.szksdm) as DEPT_CODE,-- 所在科室编码
       to_char(tr.szks) as DEPT_NAME,-- 所在科室名称
       to_char(tr.szbfdm) as WARD_CODE,-- 所在病区编码
       to_char(tr.szbf) as WARD_NAME,-- 所在病区名称
       to_char('-') as SICKROOM_CODE,-- 所在病房编码
       to_char('-') as SICKROOM_NAME,-- 所在病房名称
       to_char(tr.ch) as BED_NAME,--  所在病床名称
       to_char(tr.ch) as BED_CODE,--  所在病床编码
       to_char(to_date(tr.sqsj,'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss'),'yyyymmddhh24miss') as APPLY_END_TIME,--  申请单有效结束时间
       to_char(to_date(tr.sqsj,'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss'),'yyyymmddhh24miss') as APPLY_START_TIME,--  申请单有效开始时间
       to_char(tr.sqlsh) as APPLY_NO,--  申请号
       to_char(SUBSTR (tr.SQYS,INSTR(tr.SQYS, '|', 1, 1) + 1,4)) as APPLY_OPER_DOCTOR_NAME,--  申请单开立者签名
       to_char(to_date(tr.sqsj,'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss'),'yyyymmddhh24miss') as APPLY_OPER_DATE,-- 开单时间
       to_char(SUBSTR (tr.SQYS, 1, INSTR (tr.SQYS, '|', 1, 1) - 1)) as APPLY_OPERATOR_CODE,-- 申请医师工号
       to_char(SUBSTR (tr.SQYS,INSTR(tr.SQYS, '|', 1, 1) + 1,4)) as APPLY_OPERATOR_NAME,-- 申请医师姓名
       to_char(tr.szksdm) as APPLY_DEPT_CODE,-- 申请科室编码
       to_char(tr.szks) as APPLY_DEPT_NAME,-- 申请科室名称
       to_char(to_date(tr.sqsj,'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss'),'yyyymmddhh24miss') as APPLY_DATE,--  申请时间
       to_char(tr.xqzt) as APPLY_DETIL,-- 申请单内容
       to_char(tr.sxmd) as APPLY_MATTERS,-- 申请注意事项
       to_char(SUBSTR (tr.SQYS, 1, INSTR (tr.SQYS, '|', 1, 1) - 1)) as AUDIT_DOCTOR_CODE,-- 审核医师id
       to_char(SUBSTR (tr.SQYS,INSTR(tr.SQYS, '|', 1, 1) + 1,4)) as AUDIT_DOCTOR_NAME,-- 审核医师姓名
       to_char(to_date(tr.yjsxsj,'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss'),'yyyymmddhh24miss') AUDIT_DOCTOR_TIME,-- 审核时间
       to_char(DECODE(tr.CJABO,'A','1','B','2','O','3','AB','4','5')) as ABO_CODE,--  ABO编码
       to_char(DECODE(tr.CJABO,'A','A型','B','B型','O','O型','AB','AB型','不详')) as ABO_NAME,--  ABO名称
       to_char(DECODE(tr.CJRH,'+','2','-','1','4')) as RH_CODE,-- RH编码
       to_char(DECODE(tr.CJRH,'+','阳性','-','阴性','未查')) as RH_NAME,-- RH名称
       to_char(to_date(tr.yjsxsj,'yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss'),'yyyymmddhh24miss') as PERFORM_TIME,--  执行时间
       to_char(NVL(DECODE(tr.XQZT,'常规备血','1','常规输血','2','紧急输血','3'),'-')) PERFORM_DOCTOR_CODE,-- 执行编码
       to_char(tr.XQZT) as PERFORM_DOCTOR_NAME,-- 执行名称
       to_char('') as sender_id,-- 注册方标识
       to_char('') as receiver_id,-- 接收方标识
       to_char(tr.fx) as PRIORITY_CODE,-- 优先级别编码
       to_char(tr.fx) as PRIORITY_NAME,-- 优先级别名称
       to_char(DECODE(tr.CJABO,'A','1','B','2','O','3','AB','4','5')) as ABO_BLOOD_CODE,--  ABO血型代码表
       to_char(DECODE(tr.CJABO,'A','A型','B','B型','O','O型','AB','AB型','不详')) as ABO_BLOOD_NAME,--  ABO血型代码表
       to_char(DECODE(tr.CJRH,'+','2','-','1','4')) AS RH_BLOOD_CODE,-- Rh(D)血型代码表
       to_char(DECODE(tr.CJRH,'+','阳性','-','阴性','未查')) as RH_BLOOD_NAME,-- Rh(D)血型代码表
       to_char(nvl(pmt.Height,'173')) as HEIGHT,--  身高
       to_char('cm') as HEIGHT_UNIT,-- 身高单位
       to_char(nvl(pmt.Weight,'72.00'),'FM9999999990.00') as WEIGHT,--  体重
       to_char('kg') as WEIGHT_UNIT,-- 体重单位
       to_char(nvl( (SELECT TO_CHAR(nvl(AA.vitalsign_nval1,'0') ,'FM9999999')   FROM ydhl.mcs_vital_info AA WHERE AA.vitalsign_type='1005' AND AA.Patient_Uid=HL1.PATIENT_UID
  and aa.is_valid='1'  /*and aa.plan_time=hl1.plan_time */ and rownum=1),'10')) as SYSTOLIC_PRESSURE,-- 收缩压
       to_char('mmHg') as SYSTOLIC_PRESSURE_UNIT,--  收缩压单位
       to_char(nvl((SELECT TO_CHAR(nvl(AA.vitalsign_nval2,'0') ,'FM9999999')   FROM ydhl.mcs_vital_info AA WHERE AA.vitalsign_type='1005'AND AA.PATIENT_UID=HL1.PATIENT_UID
   /*and aa.plan_time=hl1.plan_time*/  and rownum=1 ),'10')) as DIASTOLIC_PRESSURE,--  舒张压
       to_char('mmHg') as DIASTOLIC_PRESSURE_UNIT,-- 舒张压单位
       to_char('36.8') as TEMPETURE,-- 体温
       to_char('℃') as TEMPETURE_UNIT,--  体温单位
       to_char(nvl((SELECT TO_CHAR(nvl(AA.vitalsign_nval1,'0') ,'FM9999999')   FROM ydhl.mcs_vital_info AA WHERE AA.vitalsign_type='1002' AND AA.PATIENT_UID=hl1.PATIENT_UID
  and aa.is_valid='1'   /*and aa.plan_time=hl1.plan_time*/ and rownum=1) ,'10')) as PLUS,--  脉搏次数
       to_char('次/分') as PLUS_UNIT,--  脉搏单位
       to_char(DECODE(tr.CJABO,'A','1','B','2','O','3','AB','4','5')) as APPLY_ABO_CODE,--  申请ABO血型编码
       to_char(DECODE(tr.CJABO,'A','A型','B','B型','O','O型','AB','AB型','不详')) as APPLY_ABO_NAME,--  申请ABO血型名称
       to_char(DECODE(tr.CJRH,'+','2','-','1','4')) as APPLY_RH_CODE,-- 申请RH血型编码
       to_char(DECODE(tr.CJRH,'+','阳性','-','阴性','未查')) as APPLY_RH_NAME,-- 申请RH血型名称
       to_char(decode(tr.lczt,'申请完成','false','true')) as BLOOD_TRANSFER_FLAG,-- 采血标记
       to_char('手术室') as BLOOD_TRANSFER_PLACE,--  输血地点
       to_char(tr.sxmd) as BLOOD_TRANSFER_AIM,--  输血目的
       to_char(NVL(DECODE(tr.XQZT,'常规备血','1','常规输血','2','紧急输血','3'),'-')) as BLOOD_TRANSFER_NATURE,-- 输血性质
       to_char(decode(tr.xqzt,'紧急输血','true','false')) as BLOOD_TRANSFER_URGENT,-- 输血紧急标志
       to_char(tr.SXS) as DISEASE_HISTORY,-- 病史信息
       to_char(DECODE(tr.SXS,'有',2,'无',1,9)) as METACHYSIS_HISTORY,--  输血史
       to_char((case NVL(R.SQLSH,'') WHEN '' THEN '无' ELSE '有' END)) as TRANSFER_REACTION_HISTORY,-- 输血反应史
       to_char('-') as ALLERGY_HISTORY,-- 药物过敏史
       to_char('1') as PREGNANCIES_NUM,-- 孕次
       to_char('次') as PREGNANCIES_UNIT,--  孕次单位
       to_char('1') as DELIVERIES_NUM,--  产次
       to_char('次') as DELIVERIES_UNIT,-- 产次单位
       to_char('-') as OTHER_HISTORY,-- 其他重要病史
       to_char('-') as NOTE,--  备注
       to_char(trunc(S2.XYGG,0)) as BLOOD_TRANSFER_AMOUNT,-- 血量值
       to_char(S2.XYJLDW) as BLOOD_TRANSFER_AMOUNT_UNIT  --血量单位*/

from  sx.b_t_reqd tr
inner JOIN SX.B_T_XYXXB S2 ON tr.SQLSH=S2.XYHZSQDH and s2.xyzt = '3'

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "LIS"."VIEW_PTBH1" ("姓名", "病人号", "患者id", "年龄", "条码号", "申请单号", "生成条码时间", "科室", "生成人", "采样时间", "采样人", "送出时间", "送出人", "接收时间", "接收人", "录入时间", "录入人", "审核时间", "审核人", "报告打印人", "报告打印时间") AS 
  select 
   base.pat_name  "姓名",
   base.pat_no "病人号",
   base.pat_id  "患者id",
   base.pat_agestr "年龄",  
   base.barcode "条码号",
   base.his_refcol2 "申请单号",
   base.create_dt "生成条码时间",
   (select deptname from dc_dept f where f.deptno=base.req_deptno and ROWNUM = 1) "科室",
   (select f.username  from secsysuser f where f.userno=base.create_user and ROWNUM = 1) "生成人",
   base.sampled_dt "采样时间",
   (select f.username  from secsysuser f where f.userno=base.sampled_user and ROWNUM = 1) "采样人",
   base.send_dt "送出时间",
   (select f.username  from secsysuser f where f.userno=base.send_user and ROWNUM = 1) "送出人",
   base.recieve_dt "接收时间",
	 (select f.username  from secsysuser f where f.userno=base.recieve_user and ROWNUM = 1) "接收人",
	 base.input_dt "录入时间",
	 (select f.username  from secsysuser f where f.userno=base.input_user and ROWNUM = 1) "录入人",
	 base.report_dt  "审核时间",
	 (select f.username  from secsysuser f where f.userno=base.rechk_user and ROWNUM = 1) "审核人",
	 (select f.username  from secsysuser f where f.userno=(SELECT LOG_User from lab_reportlog plog where plog.RptLogType ='03' and plog.reportid=base.reportid and ROWNUM = 1))  "报告打印人",
	 (SELECT TO_CHAR(max(plog.LOG_DATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') from lab_reportlog plog where plog.RptLogType='03' and plog.reportid=base.reportid) "报告打印时间"
from 
(SELECT DISTINCT
  b.pat_name,
  b.pat_no,
  b.pat_id,
  b.pat_agestr,
  a.barcode,
  d.his_refcol2,
  create_dt,
  b.req_deptno,
  a.create_user,
  a.sampled_user,
  a.sampled_dt,
  a.send_dt,
  a.send_user,
  a.recieve_dt,
  a.recieve_user,
  c.input_dt,
  c.input_user,
  c.report_dt,
  c.rechk_user,
  c.reportid 
FROM
  req_master a
  INNER JOIN req_master_pat b ON a.barcode = b.barcode
  INNER JOIN req_detail d ON b.barcode = d.barcode
  LEFT JOIN lab_report c ON a.barcode = c.barcode 
WHERE
  LENGTH(NVL( a.barcode, '' ))>1 
  AND b.pat_typecode IN ( '1', '2', '3' )) base

EMR_DISCHARGE_RECORD_DIAGNOSIS.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."EMR_DISCHARGE_RECORD_DIAGNOSIS" ("ID", "DR_ID", "SN", "DIAGNOSIS_TYPE", "DIAGNOSIS_TYPENAME", "DISEASE_CODE", "DISEASE", "DIAGNOSIS_BASIS", "CONFIRMED_DATE", "CREATED_AT", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "ADMISSION_ID", "NAME", "SEX_CODE", "ID_NUM", "LOCAL_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "LOCAL_DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "DIAG_DOC_CERTIFICATE_NO") AS 
  select substr(
           '49557032X'||'|'||
           nvl(to_char(t.patient_id), '-')||'|'||
           nvl(to_char(t.visit_id), '-')||'|'||
           nvl(to_char(t.diagnosis_type), '-')||'|'||
           nvl(to_char(t.diagnosis_no), '-'),
           1,
           100
       ) as ID,--  内码  是 主键

       substr(
           '49557032X'||'|'||
           nvl(to_char(t.patient_id), '-')||'|'||
           nvl(to_char(t.visit_id), '-'),
           1,
           100
       ) as DR_ID,--  出院记录内码 是 校验是否存在从表数据关联不到主表的数据

       nvl(t.diagnosis_no, 1) as SN,--  序号  是 多个诊断多条记录，主诊断传1其它依次排序上传

       '2' as DIAGNOSIS_TYPE,--  疾病诊断类型  是 1中医，2西医

       '西医' as DIAGNOSIS_TYPENAME,--  疾病诊断类型名称  是

       substr(
           nvl(
               nullif(trim(diag_dict.std_code), ''),
               nvl(nullif(trim(to_char(t.diagnosis_code)), ''), '-')
           ),
           1,
           12
       ) as DISEASE_CODE,--  疾病诊断代码 西医ICD10/中医2021版诊断编码

       substr(
           nvl(
               nullif(trim(diag_dict.std_name), ''),
               nvl(nullif(trim(to_char(t.diagnosis_desc)), ''), '-')
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as DISEASE,-- 疾病诊断名称  是 疾病诊断名称

       cast(null as varchar2(100)) as DIAGNOSIS_BASIS,-- 诊断依据

       cast(
           nvl(t.diagnosis_date, t1.discharge_date_time)
           as date
       ) as CONFIRMED_DATE,--  确诊日期  是 业务日期，字符型改为时间类型

       cast(null as timestamp) as CREATED_AT,--  创建时间 平台自动生成，不需要填写

       '370104' as DISTRICT_CODE,-- 所属行政区划  是 按机构所在的行政区划（区县）

       'INSERT' as EXCHANGE_TYPE,-- 交换类型  是 INSERT：向平台传新数据时 UPDATE：向平台更新某条数据时 DELETE：从平台删除某条数据时

       cast(systimestamp as timestamp) as SYSTEM_TIME,-- 数据上传时间戳

       '49557032X' as ORG_CODE,--  医院组织机构代码  是 必填项，医院代码

       '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,--  医院名称  是 必填项，医院名称

       substr(
           nvl(to_char(t.patient_id), '-')||'|'||nvl(to_char(t.visit_id), '-'),
           1,
           20
       ) as ADMISSION_ID,--  本次住院标识号 是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项，住院号不能为空,如果脚本存在数据

       substr(
           nvl(nullif(trim(cast(t2.name as varchar2(50))), ''), '-'),
           1,
           50
       ) as NAME,--  患者姓名  是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项

       substr(
           case
               when cast(t2.sex as varchar2(10)) = '男' then '1'
               when cast(t2.sex as varchar2(10)) = '女' then '2'
               when cast(t2.sex as varchar2(10)) = '未知' then '0'
               else '9'
           end,
           1,
           1
       ) as SEX_CODE,--  患者性别代码  是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项

       substr(
           nvl(nullif(trim(cast(t2.id_no as varchar2(18))), ''), '000000000000000000'),
           1,
           18
       ) as ID_NUM,--  患者身份证件号码  是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项，全部身份证件号码填写到该字段

       substr(
           cast(t.diagnosis_code as varchar2(100)),
           1,
           100
       ) as LOCAL_DIAGNOSIS_CODE,--  机构内部诊断编码 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项

       substr(
           nvl(nullif(trim(cast(t.diagnosis_desc as varchar2(100))), ''), '-'),
           1,
           100
       ) as LOCAL_DIAGNOSIS_NAME,--  机构内部诊断名称 s 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项

       substr(
           nvl(
               nullif(
                   trim(
                       cast(
                           (select yg.practice_cert_code
                              from doc_register_emp_match yg
                             where yg.emp_no = nvl(
                                               t.doctor_code,
                                               nvl(t1.attending_doctor, t1.doctor_in_charge)
                                           )
                               and rownum = 1)
                           as varchar2(100)
                       )
                   ),
                   ''
               ),
               '-'
           ),
           1,
           100
       ) as DIAG_DOC_CERTIFICATE_NO --诊断医生执业证书编号  是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项

from his.diagnosis t

left join his.pat_visit t1
       on t.patient_id = t1.patient_id
      and t.visit_id = t1.visit_id

left join his.pat_master_index t2
       on t.patient_id = t2.patient_id

left join (
        select trim(to_char(院标编码)) as local_code,
               max(nullif(trim(to_char(国标编码)), '')) as std_code,
               max(nullif(trim(to_char(国标名称)), '')) as std_name
          from cda.cda_dictionary
         where 字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
           and 系统标识 = 'HIS'
           and trim(to_char(院标编码)) is not null
         group by trim(to_char(院标编码))
       ) diag_dict
       on diag_dict.local_code = trim(to_char(t.diagnosis_code))

where t.diagnosis_type = '3'
  and t1.discharge_date_time >= to_date('2021-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
  and t1.discharge_date_time <  to_date('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
  and t.diagnosis_code is not null

EMR_HOS_CHANGE_MAJOR_RECORD.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."EMR_HOS_CHANGE_MAJOR_RECORD" ("ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "ADMISSION_ID", "DEP_NAME", "DEP_CODE", "AREA_NAME", "WARD_NUM", "SICKBED_NUM", "TREAT_NOTE", "PRESENT_SITUATION", "CURR_DIAG_WE_DIAG_NAME", "CURR_DIAG_WE_DIAG_CODE", "CURR_DIAG_CD_NAME", "CURR_DIAG_CD_CODE", "CURR_DIAG_CSYN_NAME", "CURR_DIAG_CSYN_CODE", "CHANGE_MAJOR_PURPOSE", "IN_DIAG_TREAT_PLAN", "CH_MED_PRES_DAC", "TCM_DECOCTION_METHOD", "MEDICATION_METHOD", "MATTERS_ATTENTION", "TRANSFER_RECORD_TYPE", "ROLL_OUT_DATE", "ROLL_OUT_DEP_NAME", "ROLL_OUT_DOC_NAME", "INTO_DATE", "INTO_DEP_NAME", "INTO_DOC_NAME", "ROLL_OUT_DEP_CODE", "NAME", "SEX_CODE", "ID_NUM") AS 
  select substr(
           '49557032X'||'|'||nvl(x.patient_id, x.p_clinic_id)||'|'||x.p_inpatient_times||'|'||x.uhid||'|'||x.doc_id,
           1,
           100
       ) as ID,--  内码  是 主键

       '49557032X' as ORG_CODE,--  医院组织机构代码  是 必填

       '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,--  医院名称  是 必填

       '370104' as DISTRICT_CODE,-- 所属行政区划  是 按机构所在的行政区划（区县）

       'ADDHIS' as EXCHANGE_TYPE,-- 交换类型  是 INSERT：向平台传新数据时 UPDATE：向平台更新某条数据时 DELETE：从平台删除某条数据时 ADDHIS :向平台补充历史数据

       cast(systimestamp as timestamp) as SYSTEM_TIME,-- 数据上传时间戳 是

       substr(
           nvl(x.patient_id||'|'||x.p_inpatient_times, x.p_inpatient_no||'|'||x.p_inpatient_times),
           1,
           50
       ) as ADMISSION_ID,--  住院唯一标示号 是

       nvl(
           (select dd.qmpt_name
              from his.dept_dict dd
             where dd.dept_code = x.p_dept_code
               and rownum = 1),
           x.p_dept_name
       ) as DEP_NAME,--  科室名称  是

       nvl(
           (select dd.qmpt_code
              from his.dept_dict dd
             where dd.dept_code = x.p_dept_code
               and rownum = 1),
           x.p_dept_code
       ) as DEP_CODE,--  科室代码    按平台值域填写

       x.p_are_name as AREA_NAME,-- 病区名称

       cast(null as varchar2(10)) as WARD_NUM,--  病房号

       substr(x.p_bedno, 1, 10) as SICKBED_NUM,-- 病床号

       substr(
           case
             when x.Zlgcms is not null then x.Zlgcms
             else regexp_substr(
                    x.content_text,
                    '诊[[:space:]]*疗[[:space:]]*经[[:space:]]*过[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(目[[:space:]]*前[[:space:]]*情[[:space:]]*况[[:space:]]*[:：]|目[[:space:]]*前[[:space:]]*诊[[:space:]]*断|转[[:space:]]*科[[:space:]]*目[[:space:]]*的|$)',
                    1, 1, 'n', 1
                  )
           end,
           1,
           2000
       ) as TREAT_NOTE,--  诊疗过程描述  是 诊疗过程描述

       substr(
           case
             when x.Mqqk is not null then x.Mqqk
             else regexp_substr(
                    x.content_text,
                    '目[[:space:]]*前[[:space:]]*情[[:space:]]*况[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(目[[:space:]]*前[[:space:]]*诊[[:space:]]*断|转[[:space:]]*科[[:space:]]*目[[:space:]]*的|转[[:space:]]*入[[:space:]]*诊[[:space:]]*疗[[:space:]]*计[[:space:]]*划|$)',
                    1, 1, 'n', 1
                  )
           end,
           1,
           2000
       ) as PRESENT_SITUATION,-- 目前情况  是


               x.diagnosis_desc       as CURR_DIAG_WE_DIAG_NAME,--  目前诊断-西医诊断名称

       substr(x.diagnosis_code, 1, 12) as CURR_DIAG_WE_DIAG_CODE,--  目前诊断-西医诊断编码   　按照省统一疾病编码

       cast(null as varchar2(50)) as CURR_DIAG_CD_NAME,-- 目前诊断-中医病名名称

       cast(null as varchar2(12)) as CURR_DIAG_CD_CODE,-- 目前诊断-中医病名代码

       cast(null as varchar2(50)) as CURR_DIAG_CSYN_NAME,-- 目前诊断-中医证候名称

       cast(null as varchar2(9)) as CURR_DIAG_CSYN_CODE,-- 目前诊断-中医证候代码

       substr(
           regexp_replace(
             case
               when x.Zkmd is not null then x.Zkmd
               else regexp_substr(
                      x.content_text,
                      '转[[:space:]]*科[[:space:]]*目[[:space:]]*的[及和]*注[[:space:]]*意[[:space:]]*事[[:space:]]*项[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(转[[:space:]]*入[[:space:]]*诊[[:space:]]*疗[[:space:]]*计[[:space:]]*划|医师签名|$)',
                      1, 1, 'n', 1
                    )
             end,
             '[；;。[:space:]]+$',
             ''
           ),
           1,
           200
       ) as CHANGE_MAJOR_PURPOSE,--  转科目的  是

       substr(
           regexp_replace(
             case
               when x.Zrzljh is not null then x.Zrzljh
               else regexp_substr(
                      x.content_text,
                      '转[[:space:]]*入[[:space:]]*诊[[:space:]]*疗[[:space:]]*计[[:space:]]*划[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(注意事项|医师签名|$)',
                      1, 1, 'n', 1
                    )
             end,
             '[[:space:]]+[一-龥]{2,4}[[:space:]]*$',
             ''
           ),
           1,
           2000
       ) as IN_DIAG_TREAT_PLAN,--  转入诊疗计划

       cast(null as varchar2(1000)) as CH_MED_PRES_DAC,-- 中药处方医嘱内容

       cast(null as varchar2(100)) as TCM_DECOCTION_METHOD,--  中药煎煮方法    中药煎煮方法

       cast(null as varchar2(100)) as MEDICATION_METHOD,-- 中药用药方法

       substr(
           nvl(
               regexp_substr(
                   x.content_text,
                   '注[[:space:]]*意[[:space:]]*事[[:space:]]*项[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(医师签名|$)',
                   1, 1, 'n', 1
               ),
               regexp_substr(
                   x.content_text,
                   '转[[:space:]]*科[[:space:]]*目[[:space:]]*的[及和]*注[[:space:]]*意[[:space:]]*事[[:space:]]*项[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(转[[:space:]]*入[[:space:]]*诊[[:space:]]*疗[[:space:]]*计[[:space:]]*划|医师签名|$)',
                   1, 1, 'n', 1
               )
           ),
           1,
           1000
       ) as MATTERS_ATTENTION,-- 注意事项

       case
         when x.doc_title like '%转出%' or regexp_like(x.content_text, '转出记录') then 1
         when x.doc_title like '%转入%' or regexp_like(x.content_text, '转入记录') then 2
         else 1
       end as TRANSFER_RECORD_TYPE,--  转科记录类型    　1:转出 2：转入

       cast(
           nvl(
             (
               select max(a.log_date_time) keep (
                        dense_rank first order by
                        abs(cast(a.log_date_time as date) - cast(x.createon as date)),
                        a.log_date_time
                    )
                 from his.adt_log a
                where a.patient_id = x.patient_id
                  and a.visit_id = x.p_inpatient_times
                  and a.action = 'E'
             ),
             x.createon
           ) as date
       ) as ROLL_OUT_DATE,-- 转出日期时间  是 　YYYYMMDD HHMISS

       substr(
           nvl(
             (
               select dd.dept_name
                 from his.dept_dict dd
                where dd.dept_code = (
                        select max(a.dept_code) keep (
                                   dense_rank first order by
                                   abs(cast(a.log_date_time as date) - cast(x.createon as date)),
                                   a.log_date_time
                               )
                          from his.adt_log a
                         where a.patient_id = x.patient_id
                           and a.visit_id = x.p_inpatient_times
                           and a.action = 'E'
                     )
                  and rownum = 1
             ),
             x.p_dept_name
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as ROLL_OUT_DEP_NAME,-- 转出科室  是

       substr(
           (
             select sd.name
               from his.staff_dict sd
              where sd.emp_no = (
                      select max(a.operator_no) keep (
                                 dense_rank first order by
                                 abs(cast(a.log_date_time as date) - cast(x.createon as date)),
                                 a.log_date_time
                             )
                        from his.adt_log a
                       where a.patient_id = x.patient_id
                         and a.visit_id = x.p_inpatient_times
                         and a.action = 'E'
                   )
                and rownum = 1
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as ROLL_OUT_DOC_NAME,-- 转出医师签名

       cast(
           nvl(
             (
               select max(a.log_date_time) keep (
                        dense_rank first order by
                        abs(cast(a.log_date_time as date) - cast(x.createon as date)),
                        a.log_date_time
                    )
                 from his.adt_log a
                where a.patient_id = x.patient_id
                  and a.visit_id = x.p_inpatient_times
                  and a.action = 'D'
             ),
             x.createon
           ) as date
       ) as INTO_DATE,-- 转入日期时间  是 　YYYYMMDD HHMISS

       substr(
           nvl(
             (
               select dd.dept_name
                 from his.dept_dict dd
                where dd.dept_code = (
                        select max(a.dept_code) keep (
                                   dense_rank first order by
                                   abs(cast(a.log_date_time as date) - cast(x.createon as date)),
                                   a.log_date_time
                               )
                          from his.adt_log a
                         where a.patient_id = x.patient_id
                           and a.visit_id = x.p_inpatient_times
                           and a.action = 'D'
                     )
                  and rownum = 1
             ),
             x.p_dept_name
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as INTO_DEP_NAME,-- 转入科室  是

       substr(
           (
             select sd.name
               from his.staff_dict sd
              where sd.emp_no = (
                      select max(a.operator_no) keep (
                                 dense_rank first order by
                                 abs(cast(a.log_date_time as date) - cast(x.createon as date)),
                                 a.log_date_time
                             )
                        from his.adt_log a
                       where a.patient_id = x.patient_id
                         and a.visit_id = x.p_inpatient_times
                         and a.action = 'D'
                   )
                and rownum = 1
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as INTO_DOC_NAME,-- 转入医师签名

       nvl(
           (
             select dd.qmpt_code
               from his.dept_dict dd
              where dd.dept_code = (
                      select max(a.dept_code) keep (
                                 dense_rank first order by
                                 abs(cast(a.log_date_time as date) - cast(x.createon as date)),
                                 a.log_date_time
                             )
                        from his.adt_log a
                       where a.patient_id = x.patient_id
                         and a.visit_id = x.p_inpatient_times
                         and a.action = 'E'
                   )
                and rownum = 1
           ),
           x.p_dept_code
       ) as ROLL_OUT_DEP_CODE,-- 转出科室代码  是 新增

       nvl(x.p_name, x.name) as NAME,--  患者姓名  是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项

       decode(nvl(x.p_sex, x.sex), '男', '1', '女', '2', '未知', '0', '9') as SEX_CODE,--  患者性别代码  是 值域：0未知，1男，2女，9不明，通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项

       nvl(x.id_no, '000000000000000000') as ID_NUM --  患者身份证件号码  是 全部身份证件号码填写到该字段

from (
       select t.uhid,
              t.p_inpatient_no,
              t.p_inpatient_times,
              t.p_dept_code,
              t.p_dept_name,
              t.p_are_name,
              t.p_bedno,
              t.p_name,
              t.p_sex,
              t.p_clinic_id,
              tt.patient_id,
              tt.name,
              tt.sex,
              tt.id_no,
              t1.id as doc_id,
              t1.doc_title,
              t1.doc_type_name,
              t1.createon,
              t3.Zlgcms,
              t3.Mqqk,
              t3.Zkmd,
              t3.Zrzljh,
              dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1) as content_text,
              d.diagnosis_desc,
              d.diagnosis_code
         from mtl.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX t

         left join his.pat_master_index tt
                on t.p_inpatient_no = tt.inp_no

         inner join his.pat_visit pv
                 on pv.patient_id = tt.patient_id
                and pv.visit_id = t.p_inpatient_times
                and pv.discharge_date_time >= to_date('2021-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
                and pv.discharge_date_time <  to_date('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')

         inner join mtl.EPR_INPATIENT t1
                 on t.UHID = t1.UHID
                and t1.doc_type_name = '转科记录'

         left join mtl.EMRSD42 T3
                on T3.段落编号 = T1.ID

         left join MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT t4
                on t4.UHID = t.UHID
               and t4.段落编号 = T1.ID

         left join his.diagnosis d
                on d.patient_id = tt.patient_id
               and d.visit_id = t.p_inpatient_times
               and d.diagnosis_type = '3'
               and d.diagnosis_no = '1'
     ) x

EXAM_REPORT.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."EXAM_REPORT" ("PATIENTID", "JZLSH", "JCLSH", "ITEMCODE", "ITEMNAME", "RESULT", "RESULT_TYPE", "UNIT", "APPLYTIME", "JCTIME", "REPORTTIME", "JCBW", "JCBWMC", "JCSJ", "JCZDHTS", "APPLYDEPTCODE", "APPLYDEPTNAME", "SFZY") AS 
  SELECT
       PPI.PATIENTID as patientid,
       '' as jzlsh,
       PEI.ExamStudyUID as jclsh,
       PEI.PROCEDURESTEPID as itemcode,
       PPS.PROCEDURESTEPNAME  as itemname,
       PR.REPORTRESULT as result,
       '' as result_type,
       '' as unit,
       CONCAT( PEI.APPLYDATE, PEI.APPLYTIME) as applytime,
       CONCAT( PEI.PreExamExamDate, PEI.PreExamExamTime) as jctime,
       CONCAT( PEI.PostExamReportDate, PEI.PostExamReportTime) as reporttime,
       PP.PROCEDUREID as jcbw,
       PP.PROCEDURENAME as jcbwmc,
       PR.REPORTDIAGNOSE as jcsj,
       PR.REPORTRESULT as jczdhts,
       PEI.PREEXAMDEPARTMENTCODE as applydeptcode,
       PEI.PROVIDEDBY as applydeptname,
       (CASE PEI.PREEXAMFROM WHEN '住院' THEN '1'WHEN '病房' THEN '1' ELSE '2' END) as sfzy
FROM PACS.EXAMINFO PEI left join PACS.PATIENTINFO PPI ON PEI.PATIENTVARCHARRAID = PPI.PATIENTINTRAID
                       LEFT JOIN PACS.PROCEDURESTEPINFO PPS ON PEI.PROCEDURESTEPID = PPS.PROCEDURESTEPID
                       LEFT JOIN PACS.PROCEDUREINFO PP ON PPS.PROCEDUREID = PP.PROCEDUREID
                       LEFT JOIN PACS.REPORT PR ON PEI.REPORTID = PR.REPORTID

INP_INFO114.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."INP_INFO114" ("WARD_CODE", "PATIENT_ID", "VISIT_ID", "INP_NO", "DEPT_CODE", "BED_NO", "NAME", "SEX", "DATE_OF_BIRTH", "NURSING_CLASS", "ADMISSION_DATE_TIME", "ZKZT", "CKZT", "BQ", "FB", "PREPAYMENTS", "YJ", "YZ", "责任医生", "ZRHS", "DIAGNOSIS", "YWGM", "YSLX", "SSSJ", "防跌倒", "防压疮", "防血栓", "防脱落", "陪护") AS 
  select a.ward_code, --护理单元代码
       a.patient_id, --患者 ID
       a.visit_id, --住院次
       b.inp_no, --住院号
       a.dept_code, --科室 ID
       a.bed_no, --床位号
       b.name, --姓名
       b.sex, --性别
       b.date_of_birth, -- 生日
       (select LISTAGG(hl.order_text, ', ') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY hl.order_text)
          from his.orders hl
         where a.patient_id = hl.patient_id
           and a.visit_id = hl.visit_id
           and hl.order_text in ('特级护理',
                                 '一级护理',
                                 'Ⅰ级护理',
                                 '二级护理',
                                 'Ⅱ级护理',
                                 '三级护理',
                                 'Ⅲ级护理',
                                 '病重护理',
                                 '病危护理',
                                 '整体护理')
           and hl.order_class = 'H'
           and hl.order_status = '2') as NURSING_CLASS, -- 护理级别
       a.admission_date_time, -- 入院时间
       '1' ZKZT, -- 在科状态
       '0' CKZT, -- 出科状态
       decode(a.patient_condition,
              '1',
              '病危',
              '2',
              '病重',
              '3',
              '一般' ，a.patient_condition) BQ, -- 病情
       '' FB, -- 费别
       a.prepayments, -- 余额
       '' YJ, -- 预交
       '' YZ, -- 已支
       (case
         when REGEXP_LIKE(a.Doctor_In_Charge, '^[0-9]+$') then
          (select sd.name
             from his.staff_dict sd
            where sd.EMP_NO = a.Doctor_In_Charge
              and rownum = 1)
         else
          a.Doctor_In_Charge
       end) 责任医生, -- 责任医生
       (select yg.name from his.staff_dict yg where yg.emp_no=c.Duty_Nurse) as ZRHS, -- 责任护士
       a.diagnosis, -- 入院诊断
       e.DRUG_NAME YWGM, -- 药物过敏
       (select LISTAGG(hl.order_text, ', ') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY hl.order_text)
          from his.orders hl
         where a.patient_id = hl.patient_id
           and a.visit_id = hl.visit_id
           and hl.order_text like '%饮食%'
           and hl.order_class in( 'I','Z')
           and hl.REPEAT_INDICATOR='1'
           and hl.order_status = '2') YSLX, -- 饮食类型
       '' SSSJ, -- 手术时间
       case when d.防跌倒>45 then '防跌倒' else '' end  防跌倒, -- 防跌倒坠床
       case when d.防压疮<=12 then '防压疮' else '' end 防压疮, --防压疮
       case when d.防血栓1>4 or d.防血栓2>=4 then '防血栓' else '' end 防血栓, --防VTE  --2025.12.17修改逻辑高危显示
       case when d.防脱落>=7 then '防脱落' else '' end 防脱落, --防管道滑脱 --2026.1.19修改防脱落显示
       '' 陪护 --陪护
  from his.pats_in_hospital a
  left join his.pat_master_index b
    on a.patient_id = b.patient_id
  join his.pat_visit c on a.patient_id=c.patient_id and a.visit_id=c.visit_id
  left join
  (
   select * from
   (
      select * from
      (
          select a.total_score,template_code,b.PATIENT_ID,b.SERIES,a.patient_uid
                ,row_number() over(partition by b.PATIENT_ID,template_code order by form_time desc) r
          from ydhl.mcs_doc_form a,ydhl.inpatients b
          where a.patient_uid=b.pat_index_no
          and TEMPLATE_CODE in ('581','567','570','566','713')
          and status in ('in')
          --and  b.PATIENT_ID ='c1023761_1'
          --where a.template_code='581' and a.patient_uid like '%c0939656%'
      ) a
      where a.r=1 --and a.patient_uid like '%c0939656%'
   ) d
   PIVOT (
     MAX(TOTAL_SCORE)
     FOR TEMPLATE_CODE IN ('581' AS 防跌倒,'567' AS 防血栓1,'570' as 防血栓2,'566' as 防压疮,'713' as 防脱落)
   )
  ) d
  on a.patient_id=substr(d.PATIENT_ID,1,8) and a.visit_id=d.SERIES
  /*left join (
    select patient_uid,LISTAGG(ASSESS_VALUE, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ASSESS_TIME desc) AS ASSESS_VALUE
    from ydhl.mcs_assess_form_record a
    where a.assess_code_type='Z04036.t'
    group by patient_uid
  ) e on d.patient_uid=e.PATIENT_UID*/
  left join (select  patient_uid,LISTAGG(DRUG_NAME, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY DRUG_NAME desc) AS DRUG_NAME
  from ydhl.mcs_patient_allery_history a
  where a.SKINTESTREFERENCERANGES='2'
  group by patient_uid) e on d.patient_uid=e.PATIENT_UID

LAB_REPORT.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."LAB_REPORT" ("PATIENTID", "JZLSH", "JYLSH", "ITEMCODE", "ITEMNAME", "JCJG", "SUBITEMCODE", "SUBITEMNAME", "RESULTTYPE", "UNIT", "APPLYTIME", "REPORTTIME", "APPLYDEPTCODE", "APPLYDEPTNAME") AS 
  SELECT
       lab.pat_id as patientId,
       '' as jzlsh,
       lab.barcode as jylsh,
       '' as itemCode,
       lab.specimen_code as itemName,
       lar.result_str as jcjg,
       lar.rpt_itemcode as SubItemCode,
       lar.rpt_itemname as SubItemName,
       (case lar.result_flag when 'L' then '偏低'
       when 'LL' then '偏低'
         when 'M' then '正常'
         when 'N' then '阴性'
         when 'P' then '阳性'
         when 'Q' then '弱阳性'
         when 'H' then '偏高'
           when 'HH' then '偏高'
           else '正常' end) as ResultType,
             lar.result_unit as Unit,
             lab.req_dt as ApplyTime,
             lab.report_dt as reportTime,
             lab.req_deptno as ApplyDeptCode,
             his.dept_name as ApplyDeptname
FROM LIS.LAB_REPORT lab left join LIS.LAB_RESULT lar on lab.reportid = lar.reportid
left join HIS.DEPT_DICT his on lab.req_deptno = his.dept_code

PAT_VIEW.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."PAT_VIEW" ("PUUID", "PAT_ID", "PAT_NAME", "BIRTHDAY", "VISIT_ID", "SEX", "INP_NO", "DEPT_ID", "DEPT_NAME", "DISTRICT_ADMISSION_TO_ID", "DISTRICT_ADMISSION_TO_NAME", "BED_NUM", "VISIT_TIME", "INP_TIME", "OUT_INP_TIME", "PAT_STATE", "EID") AS 
  select
t.patient_id||t.visit_id as puuid,
t.patient_id as pat_id,
ss.name as pat_name,
ss.date_of_birth as birthday,
t.patient_id as visit_id,
ss.sex as sex,
ss.inp_no as inp_no,
t.dept_admission_to as dept_id,
(select ks.dept_name from his.dept_dict ks where t.dept_admission_to=ks.dept_code) as dept_name,
t.discharge_ward_code as district_admission_to_id,
(select ks.dept_name from his.dept_dict ks where t.discharge_ward_code=ks.dept_code) as district_admission_to_name,
 CASE
         WHEN t.discharge_date_time IS NULL THEN
          (SELECT to_char(p.bed_no)
             FROM his.pats_in_hospital p
            WHERE p.patient_id = t.patient_id
              AND p.visit_id = t.visit_id
              and rownum='1')
         when t.discharge_date_time IS not NULL THEN
           (SELECT to_char(cw.bed_no)
             FROM his.bedpats_in_hospital cw
            WHERE cw.patient_id = t.patient_id
              AND cw.visit_id = t.visit_id
              and rownum='1')
         ELSE
          null
       END as bed_num,
t.admission_date_time as visit_time,
t.admission_date_time as inp_time,
t.discharge_date_time as out_inp_time,
case when t.discharge_date_time IS NULL THEN
  '2'
  else '3' end as pat_state,
to_char(t.visit_id) as eid
from his.pat_visit t

left join his.pat_master_index ss on t.patient_id=ss.patient_id
left join his.pats_in_hospital p on p.patient_id=t.patient_id and t.visit_id=p.visit_id
--where t.admission_date_time>sysdate-2

union all

select
a.clinic_no||nvl(substr(a.zylsh,instr(a.zylsh,'*',1)+1,3),a.visit_no) as puuid,
a.patient_id as pat_id,
b.name as pat_name,
b.date_of_birth as birthday,
a.patient_id as visit_id,
b.sex as sex,
to_char('') as inp_no,
a.visit_dept as dept_id,
(select ks.dept_name from his.dept_dict ks where a.visit_dept=ks.dept_code) as dept_name,
to_char('') as district_admission_to_id,
to_char('') as district_admission_to_name,
to_char('') as bed_num,
a.registering_date as visit_time,
to_date('','yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss') as inp_time,
to_date('','yyyy-MM-dd hh24:mi:ss') as out_inp_time,
'1' as pat_state,
a.clinic_no as eid
from his.clinic_master a

left join his.pat_master_index b on a.patient_id=b.patient_id
--where a.registering_date>sysdate-2

PL_SFXMMX.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."PL_SFXMMX" ("STAT_TIME", "KDKSBM", "KDKSMC", "KDYGBM", "KDYGMC", "ZXKSBM", "ZXKSMC", "ZXYGBM", "ZXYGMC", "KDYLZBM", "KDYLZMC", "ZXYLZBM", "ZXYLZMC", "ZXHSZBM", "ZXHSZMC", "ZXBQZBM", "ZXBQZMC", "XMBM", "XMMC", "FYLBBM", "FYLBMC", "PRICE", "AMOUNT", "FEE", "GG", "DW", "BRSZKSBM", "BRSZKSMC", "BRSZYLZBM", "BRSZYLZMC", "BRID", "LSH", "MZBZ", "BED_NO", "RCPT_NO", "NAME", "NJZXKSBM", "NJZXKSMC", "NJZXYGBM", "NJZXYGMC") AS 
  SELECT a.billing_date_time stat_time, ----时间  Datetime  时间，如 2013/3/5 13:30:22  标准绩效
       a.ordered_by kdksbm, ----  开单科室编码  nvarchar  his开单科室编码  标准绩效
       (SELECT dept_name FROM his.dept_dict WHERE dept_code = a.ordered_by) kdksmc, ----  开单科室名称  nvarchar  his开单科室名称  标准绩效
       a.doctor_user kdygbm, ----  开单员工编码  nvarchar  his开单员工的编码  标准绩效
       (select name from his.staff_dict sd where a.doctor_user = sd.emp_no) kdygmc, ----  开单员工名称  nvarchar  his开单员工的姓名  标准绩效
       a.performed_by zxksbm, ----  执行科室编码  nvarchar  his执行科室编码  标准绩效
       (SELECT dept_name FROM his.dept_dict WHERE dept_code = a.performed_by) zxksmc, ----  执行科室名称  nvarchar  his执行科室名称  标准绩效
       (SELECT t.emp_no
          FROM his.staff_dict t
         WHERE t.name = a.perform_doctor
           AND ROWNUM = 1)  zxygbm, ----  执行员工编码  nvarchar  his执行员工的编码  标准绩效
       a.perform_doctor zxygmc, ----  执行员工名称  nvarchar  his执行员工的名称  标准绩效
       NVL(CASE
             WHEN LENGTH(NVL(A.order_group, '0')) > 1 THEN
              A.ORDER_GROUP
             WHEN LENGTH(NVL(A.order_group, '0')) <= 1 THEN
              (SELECT DDD.ORDER_GROUP
                 FROM his.DOCTOR_GROUP DDD
                WHERE DDD.DOCTOR = a.order_doctor)
           END,
           b.dept_admission_to) kdylzbm, ----  开单医疗组编码  nvarchar  his开单医疗组编码  标准绩效
       NVL(CASE
             WHEN LENGTH(NVL(A.order_group, '0')) > 1 THEN
              (SELECT eee.group_name
                 FROM his.STAFF_GROUP_DICT eee
                WHERE eee.GROUP_CODE = a.order_group)
             WHEN LENGTH(NVL(A.order_group, '0')) <= 1 THEN
              (SELECT eee.group_name
                 FROM his.DOCTOR_GROUP DDD, his.STAFF_GROUP_DICT eee
                WHERE DDD.DOCTOR = a.order_doctor
                  AND ddd.order_group = eee.group_code)
           END,
           (SELECT eee.group_name
              FROM his.STAFF_GROUP_DICT eee
             WHERE eee.GROUP_CODE = b.dept_admission_to)) kdylzmc, ----  开单医疗组名称  nvarchar  his开单医疗组名称  标准绩效
       CASE
         WHEN LENGTH(NVL(A.perform_group, '0')) > 1 THEN
          TO_CHAR(a.perform_group)
         WHEN LENGTH(NVL(A.perform_group, '0')) <= 1 THEN
          CASE
            WHEN LENGTH(NVL(A.PERFORMED_BY, '0')) > 1 THEN
             TO_CHAR(A.PERFORMED_BY)
            WHEN LENGTH(NVL(A.PERFORMED_BY, '0')) <= 1 THEN
             TO_CHAR(A.ORDER_GROUP)
          END
       END zxylzbm,
       ----  执行医疗组编码  nvarchar  his执行医疗组编码  标准绩效
       CASE
         WHEN LENGTH(NVL(A.perform_group, '0')) > 1 THEN
          (SELECT s.group_name
             FROM his.staff_group_dict s
            WHERE s.group_code = a.perform_group)
         WHEN LENGTH(NVL(A.perform_group, '0')) <= 1 THEN
          CASE
            WHEN LENGTH(NVL(A.PERFORMED_BY, '0')) > 1 THEN
             (SELECT s.group_name
                FROM his.staff_group_dict s
               WHERE s.group_code = a.PERFORMED_BY)
            WHEN LENGTH(NVL(A.PERFORMED_BY, '0')) <= 1 THEN
             (SELECT s.group_name
                FROM his.staff_group_dict s
               WHERE s.group_code = a.ORDER_GROUP)
          END
       END zxylzmc,
       ----  执行医疗组名称  nvarchar  his执行医疗组名称  标准绩效
       case
         when a.performed_by like '%H%' then
          a.performed_by
         else
          a.wardcode
       end zxhszbm, ----  执行护士站编码  nvarchar  his执行护士站编码  标准绩效
       case
         when a.performed_by like '%H%' then
          (SELECT dept_name FROM his.dept_dict WHERE dept_code = a.performed_by)
         else
          (SELECT dept_name FROM his.dept_dict WHERE dept_code = a.wardcode)
       end zxhszmc, ----  执行护士站名称  nvarchar  his执行护士站名称  标准绩效
       case
         when a.performed_by like '%H%' then
          a.performed_by
         else
          a.wardcode
       end zxbqzbm, ----  执行病区编码  nvarchar  his执行病区编码  标准绩效
       case
         when a.performed_by like '%H%' then
          (SELECT dept_name FROM his.dept_dict WHERE dept_code = a.performed_by)
         else
          (SELECT dept_name FROM his.dept_dict WHERE dept_code = a.wardcode)
       end zxbqzmc, ----  执行病区名称  nvarchar  his执行病区名称  标准绩效
       a.item_class || '_' || a.item_code xmbm, ----  项目编码  nvarchar  项目编码(如果编码唯一，可以直接用，如果编码不唯一，需要确定唯一性后使用，比如可以用《编号##名称##规格##单位》这样的格式来避免不唯一）  标准绩效
       a.item_name xmmc, ----  项目名称  nvarchar  项目名称  标准绩效
       a.class_on_reckoning fylbbm, ---- 费用类别编码  nvarchar  对应“费用类别字典”的“费用类别编码”  标准绩效
       (SELECT r.class_name
          FROM his.RECK_ITEM_CLASS_DICT r
         WHERE r.class_code = a.class_on_reckoning) fylbmc, ---- 费用类别名称  nvarchar  对应“费用类别字典”的“费用类别名称”  标准绩效
       a.item_price price, ----  单价  numeric  项目的单价  标准绩效
       a.amount amount, ----  数量  decimal(18,2)  项目发生的数量  标准绩效
       a.charges fee, ---- 费用  numeric  费用金额  标准绩效
       a.item_spec gg, ---- 规格  nvarchar  规格  标准绩效
       a.units dw, ----单位  nvarchar  单位  标准绩效
       a.dept_code brszksbm, ----  病人所属科室编码  nvarchar  病人所属科室编码（需和医院确认，当病人进入ICU或手术室后，无法确定工作量归属的时候，请填写本字段）  标准绩效
       (SELECT dept_name FROM his.dept_dict WHERE dept_code = a.dept_code) brszksmc, ---- 病人所属科室名称  nvarchar  病人所属科室名称（需和医院确认，当病人进入ICU或手术室后，无法确定工作量归属的时候，请填写本字段）  标准绩效
       NVL(CASE
             WHEN a.order_group IS NOT NULL THEN
              a.order_group
             WHEN a.order_group IS NULL THEN
              (SELECT bb.order_group
                 FROM his.doctor_group bb
                WHERE bb.doctor_user = b.doctor_in_charge)
           END,
           b.dept_admission_to) brszylzbm,
       ----病人所在医疗组编码  nvarchar  病人所在医疗组编码  标准绩效*/

       NVL(CASE
             WHEN a.order_group IS NOT NULL THEN
              (SELECT s.group_name
                 FROM his.staff_group_dict s
                WHERE s.group_code = a.order_group)
             WHEN a.order_group IS NULL THEN
              (SELECT ccc.group_name
                 FROM his.doctor_group bb, his.staff_group_dict ccc
                WHERE bb.doctor_user = b.doctor_in_charge
                  AND bb.order_group = ccc.group_code)
           END,
           (SELECT ccc.group_name
              FROM his.staff_group_dict ccc
             WHERE b.dept_admission_to = ccc.group_code)) brszylzmc,
       ---- 病人所在医疗组名称  nvarchar  病人所在医疗组名称  标准绩效
       a.patient_id brid, ----  病人主索引(MPI)  nvarchar  关联"病人主索引"的主键  标准绩效
       TO_CHAR (a.patient_id) || '_' || TO_CHAR (a.visit_id) lsh, ---- 病人就诊流水号(门诊号/住院号)  nvarchar  对应"就诊主表"的lsh  标准绩效
       1 mzbz, ---- 门诊、住院标识  int  门诊、住院标志（0，1：0是门诊，1是住院）  标准绩效
       TO_CHAR(a.bed_no) bed_no, -----  床号  nvarchar  病人床号(如果是住院病人)  标准绩效
       a.rcpt_no, (select e.name from his.pat_master_index e where e.patient_id = a.patient_id) name,
       '' njzxksbm,
       '' njzxksmc,
       '' as njzxygbm,
       '' as njzxygmc
  FROM  his.inp_bill_detail a,  his.pat_visit b
 WHERE a.patient_id = b.patient_id(+)
   AND a.visit_id = b.visit_id(+)    and a.outp_rcpt_no is null
   AND a.billing_date_time >=
       TO_DATE('2022-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')

union all

 SELECT a.billing_date_time stat_time, ----时间  Datetime  时间，如 2013/3/5 13:30:22  标准绩效
       --a.ordered_by kdksbm, ----  开单科室编码  nvarchar  his开单科室编码(2024.10.11 zjh 根据 his报表--山东省第一人民医院(山东省耳鼻喉医院)住院收入统计报表(核算科目、开单科室)修改)
       --(SELECT dept_name FROM dept_dict WHERE dept_code = a.ordered_by) kdksmc, ----  开单科室名称  nvarchar  his开单科室名称  标准绩效
       nvl(a.ORDER_GROUP,a.ORDERED_BY) kdksbm, ----  开单科室编码  nvarchar  his开单科室编码  标准绩效
       (SELECT dept_name FROM his.dept_dict WHERE dept_code = nvl(a.ORDER_GROUP,a.ORDERED_BY)) kdksmc, ----  开单科室名称  nvarchar  his开单科室名称  标准绩效
       a.doctor_user kdygbm, ----  开单员工编码  nvarchar  his开单员工的编码  标准绩效
       (select name from his.staff_dict sd where a.doctor_user = sd.emp_no) kdygmc, ----  开单员工名称  nvarchar  his开单员工的姓名  标准绩效

       (SELECT dept_name FROM his.dept_dict WHERE dept_code = a.performed_by) zxksmc, ----  执行科室名称  nvarchar  his执行科室名称  标准绩效
       (SELECT t.emp_no
          FROM his.staff_dict t
         WHERE t.name = a.perform_doctor
           AND ROWNUM = 1)  zxygbm, ----  执行员工编码  nvarchar  his执行员工的编码  标准绩效
       a.perform_doctor zxygmc, ----  执行员工名称  nvarchar  his执行员工的名称  标准绩效
       NVL(CASE
             WHEN LENGTH(NVL(A.order_group, '0')) > 1 THEN

             WHEN LENGTH(NVL(A.order_group, '0')) <= 1 THEN
              (SELECT DDD.ORDER_GROUP
                 FROM his.DOCTOR_GROUP DDD
                WHERE DDD.DOCTOR = a.order_doctor)
           END,
           b.dept_admission_to) kdylzbm, ----  开单医疗组编码  nvarchar  his开单医疗组编码  标准绩效
       NVL(CASE

       (SELECT t.name

        (SELECT s.order_group

         WHERE s.doctor_user = cm.DOCTOR) kdylzbm, ----  开单医疗组编码  nvarchar  his开单医疗组编码  标准绩效
        (SELECT r.group_name
          FROM his.doctor_group s, his.staff_group_dict r
         WHERE s.doctor_user = cm.DOCTOR
           AND s.order_group = r.group_code) kdylzmc, ----  开单医疗组名称  nvarchar  his开单医疗组名称  标准绩效
(SELECT s.order_group
          FROM his.doctor_group s
         WHERE s.doctor_user = cm.DOCTOR) zxylzbm, ----  执行医疗组编码  nvarchar  his执行医疗组编码  标准绩效
       (SELECT r.group_name

           AND s.order_group = r.group_code) zxylzmc, ----  执行医疗组名称  nvarchar  his执行医疗组名称  标准绩效
       '' zxhszbm, ----  执行护士站编码  nvarchar  his执行护士站编码  标准绩效
       '' zxhszmc, ----  执行护士站名称  nvarchar  his执行护士站名称  标准绩效
       '' zxbqzbm, ----  执行病区编码  nvarchar  his执行病区编码  标准绩效
       '' zxbqzmc, ----  执行病区名称  nvarchar  his执行病区名称  标准绩效
       '', ----  项目编码  nvarchar  项目编码(如果编码唯一，可以直接用，如果编码不唯一，需要确定唯一性后使用，比如可以用《编号##名称##规格##单位》这样的格式来避免不唯一）  标准绩效
       '诊查费' xmmc, ----  项目名称  nvarchar  项目名称  标准绩效
       '003' fylbbm, ---- 费用类别编码  nvarchar  对应“费用类别字典”的“费用类别编码”  标准绩效
       '挂号费' fylbmc, ---- 费用类别名称  nvarchar  对应“费用类别字典”的“费用类别名称”  标准绩效
       cm.clinic_fee price, ----  单价  numeric  项目的单价  标准绩效
       -1 amount, ----  数量  decimal(18,2)  项目发生的数量  标准绩效
       -cm.clinic_charge fee, ---- 费用  numeric  费用金额  标准绩效
      '' gg, ---- 规格  nvarchar  规格  标准绩效
       '' dw, ----单位  nvarchar  单位  标准绩效
       cm.visit_dept brszksbm, ----  病人所属科室编码  nvarchar  病人所属科室编码（需和医院确认，当病人进入ICU或手术室后，无法确定工作量归属的时候，请填写本字段）  标准绩效
       (SELECT dept_name FROM his.dept_dict WHERE dept_code = cm.visit_dept) brszksmc, ---- 病人所属科室名称  nvarchar  病人所属科室名称（需和医院确认，当病人进入ICU或手术室后，无法确定工作量归属的时候，请填写本字段）  标准绩效
       cm.visit_dept brszylzbm, ----病人所在医疗组编码  nvarchar  病人所在医疗组编码  标准绩效
        (SELECT dept_name FROM his.dept_dict WHERE dept_code = cm.visit_dept) brszylzmc, ---- 病人所在医疗组名称  nvarchar  病人所在医疗组名称  标准绩效
       cm.patient_id brid, ----  病人主索引(MPI)  nvarchar  关联"病人主索引"的主键  标准绩效
      TO_CHAR (cm.patient_id) || '_' || TO_CHAR (cm.clinic_no)  lsh, ---- 病人就诊流水号(门诊号/住院号)  nvarchar  对应"就诊主表"的lsh  标准绩效
       0 mzbz, ---- 门诊、住院标识  int  门诊、住院标志（0，1：0是门诊，1是住院）  标准绩效
       '' bed_no, -----  床号  nvarchar  病人床号(如果是住院病人)  标准绩效
       '' rcpt_no,cm.name,
       '' njzxksbm,
