SM_HZSJ.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."SM_HZSJ" ("患者ID", "住院次数", "患者姓名", "手术开始时间", "手术结束时间", "麻醉开始时间", "麻醉结束时间") AS 
  select 
    b.patient_id as 患者ID,
    b.visit_id as 住院次数,
    a.name as 患者姓名,
    b.START_DATE_TIME as 手术开始时间,
    b.END_DATE_TIME as 手术结束时间,
    b.ANES_START_DATE_TIME as 麻醉开始时间,
    b.RETURN_DATE_TIME as 麻醉结束时间
from SM.MED_OPERATION_MASTER b
left join HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX a 
    on a.patient_id = b.patient_id

TJZRBL.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."TJZRBL" ("序号", "患者ID", "住院次数", "性别", "年龄", "入院科室", "文书类型", "文书标题", "创建时间", "书写科室", "文书内容", "检查所见", "检查印象") AS 
  select
a.序号,
a.患者id,
a.住院次数,
a.性别,
a.年龄,
a.入院科室,
a.文书类型,
a.文书标题,
a.创建时间,
a.书写科室,
a.文书内容,
b.检查所见,
b.检查印象
from
(select
row_number() over(partition by 患者ID order by x.id ASC) as 序号,
x.*
from
(select
row_number() over(order by eid.p_clinic_id) as id,
eid.p_clinic_id as 患者ID,
eid.p_inpatient_times as 住院次数,
eid.p_sex as 性别,
eid.p_age as 年龄,
eid.p_dept_name as 入院科室,
ei.doc_type_name as 文书类型,
ei.doc_title as 文书标题,
ei.doc_create_date as 创建时间,
ei.doc_dept_name as 书写科室,
ec.段落内容 as 文书内容
from mtl.epr_inpatient_docindex eid
left join mtl.epr_inpatient ei on ei.uhid = eid.uhid
left join mtl.emrsd_content ec on ec.段落编号 = ei.id
where eid.p_indate >= to_date('2022-01-01 00:00:00','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
and eid.p_indate < to_date('2024-08-01 00:00:00','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
and eid.p_dept_code in ('020101','020102','020105','020103','020202','020203','020302','020502','020402','020602','020604','020605','020702','022701','022801','021802','040115','040117','021729','021735','020106','020304','020305','020306','020307')
order by eid.p_clinic_id,eid.p_inpatient_times ) x ) a

left join
(select
row_number() over(partition by patient_id order by z.id ASC) as 序号,
z.*
 from
(select
row_number() over(order by em.patient_id) as id,
em.patient_id ,
em.visit_id,
er.Description as 检查所见,
er.impression as 检查印象
from his.exam_master em
left join his.exam_report er on er.exam_no = em.exam_no
where em.req_date_time >= to_date('2022-01-01 00:00:00','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
/*and em.req_date_time < to_date('2023-01-01 00:00:00','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')*/
and em.visit_id <> '0' and er.Description is not null
order by em.patient_id,em.visit_id) z ) b

on a.患者id = b.patient_id and a.住院次数 = b.visit_id and a.序号=b.序号

order by a.患者id,a.住院次数,a.序号

T_ESBHL_VAGINAL_DEL_ROD.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."T_ESBHL_VAGINAL_DEL_ROD" ("INHOSP_INDEX_NO", "VISIT_TIMES", "PUERPERA_ID_NUMBER", "PUERPERA_NAME", "AGE_YEAR", "SIGN_DATE", "BIRTH_DR_SIGN", "MIDWIFE_SIGN", "ASSISTANT_SIGN", "PROTECT_BABY_SIGN", "MENTOR_SIGN", "RECORD_SIGN", "CONTACT_PHONE_NO", "DEPT_NAME", "WARD_NAME", "SICKROOM_CODE", "BED_CODE", "GRAVIDITY_NUM", "PRODUCTION_NUM", "EDC_DATE", "LABOR_DATE_TIME", "PROM_RUPTURE_DATE_TIME", "BEFORE_AMNIOTIC_FLUID_TRAITS", "BEFORE_AMNIOTIC_FLUID_AMOUNT", "CONTRACTIONS_BEGIN_DATE", "FIRST_TPP_TIME", "CERVIX_OPEN_FULLY_DATE", "SECOND_TPP_TIME", "FETAL_DISENGAGEMENT_DATE_TIME", "THIRD_TPP_TIME", "DOTP_DATE_TIME", "TOTAL_LABOR_DURATION", "TIRE_BEARING_CODE", "FDMFLAG", "MIDWIFERY_METHOD", "DOTP_SITUATION", "INTACT_CAUL_FLAG", "AMNIOTIC_FLUID_TRAITS", "AMNIOTIC_FLUID_AMOUNT", "CORD_LENGTH", "CORD_AROUND_NECK", "UCASF", "BIRTH_DOSE", "PREMUNITION", "EPISIOTOMY_FLAG", "PERINEUM_INCISION_PLACE", "MATERNAL_PERINEUM_SUTURE_NUM", "MATERNAL_PERINEUM_DEGREE_CODE", "PERINEAL_HEMATOMA_FLAG", "PERINEAL_HEMATOMA_SIZE", "PERINEAL_HEMATOMA_HANDLE", "ANES_METHOD_CODE", "ANES_DRUG_NAME", "VAGINAL_LA_FLAG", "VAGINA_HEMATOMA_FLAG", "CERVICAL_LA_FLAG", "CERVIX_SUTURE_SITUATION", "POSTPARTUM_DOSE", "BIRTH_PROC_ABSTRACT", "CONTRACTIONS_SITUATION", "UTERINE_SITUATION", "LOCHIA_STATUS", "PERINEUM_SITUATION", "REPAIR_SURGERY_PROC", "CORD_BLOOD_MARKER", "POSTPARTUM_DIAG", "POSTPARTUM_OBSERVE_DATE", "POSTPARTUM_CHECK_TIME_LONG", "POSTPARTUM_SYSTOLIC_PRESSURE", "POSTPARTUM_DIASTOLIC_PRESSURE", "POSTPARTUM_PULSE_RATE", "POSTPARTUM_HEART_RATE", "TAOPH", "POSTPARTUM_UC", "POSTPARTUM_FUNDUS_HIGHT", "ANUS_CHECK", "BABY_SEX_CODE", "BABY_BIRTH_WEIGHT", "BABY_BIRTH_HEIGHT", "PFT_SIZE", "PFT_PART", "APGAR_SCORE_INTERVAL_TIME_CODE", "APGAR_SCORE_VALUE", "DELIVERY_ENDING_CODE", "BABY_ABMAL_CODE") AS 
  SELECT YDZD.PATIENT_ID AS INHOSP_INDEX_NO, --住院号（病人基本信息）
       YDZD.SERIES AS VISIT_TIMES, --住院次数
       YDZD.COMPANY_CERTIFICATE_NO AS PUERPERA_ID_NUMBER, --产妇身份证件号码（病人基本信息）
       YDZD.NAME AS PUERPERA_NAME, --产妇姓名（病人基本信息）
       SUBSTR(YDZD.AGE, 1, INSTR(YDZD.AGE, '岁', -1) - 1) AS AGE_YEAR, --年龄（岁）（病人基本信息）
       TO_CHAR(WSFL.FORM_TIME, 'yyyymmddhh24miss') AS SIGN_DATE, --签名日期时间（分娩记录单的记录日期FORM_TIME）
       T2.BIRTH_DR_SIGN, --接生者签名（分娩记录单中接生者签名）
       /*助产者签名（没有*/
       '-' AS MIDWIFE_SIGN, --助产者签名（没有）
       /*助手者签名（没有*/
       '-' AS ASSISTANT_SIGN, --助手签名（没有）
       '-' PROTECT_BABY_SIGN, --护婴者签名（没有）
       T2.MENTOR_SIGN, --指导者签名(分娩记录单中的督导者签名)
       T2.RECORD_SIGN, --记录人签名(取分娩记录单中的创建人)
       YDZD.CONTACT_PHONE_NO AS CONTACT_PHONE_NO, --联系人电话号码
      /* (SELECT PV.NEXT_OF_KIN
          FROM JHEMR.PAT_VISIT PV
         WHERE PV.INPATIENT_NO = YDZD.PATIENT_ID) AS CONTACT_NAME, --联系人姓名(取HIS系统)*/
       YDZD.DEPT_NAME, --科室名称（病人基本信息）
       YDZD.WARD_NAME, --病区名称（病人基本信息）
       '-' AS SICKROOM_CODE, --病房号(取HIS系统)
       YDZD.BED_NO AS BED_CODE, --病床号（病人基本信息）
       T3.GRAVIDITY_NUM, --孕次（分娩记录单中的孕次）
       T3.PRODUCTION_NUM, --产次（新生儿记录单中的产次）
       TO_CHAR(to_Date(T1.EDC_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD hh24:mi:ss'),
               'yyyymmdd') EDC_DATE, --预产期（没有）
       TO_CHAR(to_Date(T1.LABOR_DATE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),
               'yyyymmddhh24miss') LABOR_DATE_TIME, --临产日期时间（分娩记录单中临产时间）
       TO_CHAR(to_Date(T1.PROM_RUPTURE_DATE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),
               'yyyymmddhh24miss') PROM_RUPTURE_DATE_TIME, --胎膜破裂日期时间（分娩记录单中的胎膜破裂时间）
       substr(T1.BEFORE_AMNIOTIC_FLUID_TRAITS,1,100) BEFORE_AMNIOTIC_FLUID_TRAITS, --前羊水性状(没有)
       case when T1.BEFORE_AMNIOTIC_FLUID_AMOUNT in ('不清','不详','量不清') then '0'
         else T1.BEFORE_AMNIOTIC_FLUID_AMOUNT end BEFORE_AMNIOTIC_FLUID_AMOUNT , --前羊水量（ML）(没有)
       TO_CHAR(to_Date(T1.CONTRACTIONS_BEGIN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),
               'yyyymmdd') CONTRACTIONS_BEGIN_DATE, --宫缩开始日期时间(分娩记录单中宫缩开始时间)

      -- T1.FIRST_TPP_TIME,--第1产程时长(分娩记录单中第一产程时长)
            to_Char(  case
                when instr(T1.FIRST_TPP_TIME, '天', -1) = 0 then 0 else
                 substr(T1.FIRST_TPP_TIME,1,instr(T1.FIRST_TPP_TIME, '天', -1) - 1) * 1440 end +
                 case when instr(T1.FIRST_TPP_TIME, '时', -1) = 0 then 0 else
                 substr(T1.FIRST_TPP_TIME,instr(T1.FIRST_TPP_TIME, '天', -1) + 1,instr(T1.FIRST_TPP_TIME, '时', -1) - 1 - instr(T1.FIRST_TPP_TIME, '天', -1)) * 60 end +
                 case when instr(T1.FIRST_TPP_TIME, '分', -1) = 0 then 0 else
                 to_number(substr(T1.FIRST_TPP_TIME,instr(T1.FIRST_TPP_TIME, '时', -1) + 1,instr(T1.FIRST_TPP_TIME, '分', -1) - 1 - instr(T1.FIRST_TPP_TIME, '时', -1)))
              end) FIRST_TPP_TIME,--第1产程时长(分娩记录单中第一产程时长)

       TO_CHAR(to_Date(T1.CERVIX_OPEN_FULLY_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'yyyymmddhh24miss') CERVIX_OPEN_FULLY_DATE, --宫口开全日期时间（分娩记录单中宫口开全日期时间）

       --T1.SECOND_TPP_TIME, --第2产程时长（分娩记录单中第二产程）
       TO_CHAR( case
                when instr(T1.SECOND_TPP_TIME, '天', -1) = 0 then 0 else
                 substr(T1.SECOND_TPP_TIME,1,instr(T1.SECOND_TPP_TIME, '天', -1) - 1) * 1440 end +
                 case when instr(T1.SECOND_TPP_TIME, '时', -1) = 0 then 0 else
                 substr(T1.SECOND_TPP_TIME,instr(T1.SECOND_TPP_TIME, '天', -1) + 1,instr(T1.SECOND_TPP_TIME, '时', -1) - 1 - instr(T1.SECOND_TPP_TIME, '天', -1)) * 60 end +
                 case
                when instr(T1.SECOND_TPP_TIME, '分', -1) = 0 then 0 else
                 to_number(substr(T1.SECOND_TPP_TIME, instr(T1.SECOND_TPP_TIME, '时', -1) + 1, instr(T1.SECOND_TPP_TIME, '分', -1) - 1 - instr(T1.SECOND_TPP_TIME, '时', -1)))
              end) SECOND_TPP_TIME, --第2产程时长（分娩记录单中第二产程）

       TO_CHAR(to_Date(T1.FETAL_DISENGAGEMENT_DATE_TIME,
                       'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'yyyymmddhh24miss') FETAL_DISENGAGEMENT_DATE_TIME, --胎儿娩出日期时间（分娩记录单中胎儿娩出时间）
       --T1.THIRD_TPP_TIME, --第3产程时长（分娩记录单中第三产程）

      TO_CHAR( case
                when instr(T1.THIRD_TPP_TIME, '天', -1) = 0 then 0 else
                 substr(T1.THIRD_TPP_TIME,1,instr(T1.THIRD_TPP_TIME, '天', -1) - 1) * 1440 end +
                 case when instr(T1.THIRD_TPP_TIME, '时', -1) = 0 then 0 else
                substr(T1.THIRD_TPP_TIME,instr(T1.THIRD_TPP_TIME, '天', -1) + 1,instr(T1.THIRD_TPP_TIME, '时', -1) - 1 - instr(T1.THIRD_TPP_TIME, '天', -1)) * 60 end +
                case
                when instr(T1.THIRD_TPP_TIME, '分', -1) = 0 then 0 else
                 to_number(substr(T1.THIRD_TPP_TIME, instr(T1.THIRD_TPP_TIME, '时', -1) + 1, instr(T1.THIRD_TPP_TIME, '分', -1) - 1 - instr(T1.THIRD_TPP_TIME, '时', -1)))
              end) THIRD_TPP_TIME, --第3产程时长（分娩记录单中第三产程）

       TO_CHAR(to_Date(T1.DOTP_DATE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'),'yyyymmddhh24miss') DOTP_DATE_TIME, --胎盘娩出日期时间（分娩记录单中胎盘娩出时间）
      --T1.TOTAL_LABOR_DURATION, --总产程时长（分娩记录单中总产程）*/

       TO_CHAR( case
                when instr(T1.TOTAL_LABOR_DURATION, '天', -1) = 0 then  0 else
                 substr(T1.TOTAL_LABOR_DURATION, 1, instr(T1.TOTAL_LABOR_DURATION, '天', -1) - 1) * 1440 end +
                 case
                when instr(T1.TOTAL_LABOR_DURATION, '时', -1) = 0 then 0 else
                 substr(T1.TOTAL_LABOR_DURATION, instr(T1.TOTAL_LABOR_DURATION, '天', -1) + 1,
                 instr(T1.TOTAL_LABOR_DURATION, '时', -1) - 1 - instr(T1.TOTAL_LABOR_DURATION, '天', -1)) * 60 end +
                 case
                when instr(T1.TOTAL_LABOR_DURATION, '分', -1) = 0 then 0 else
                 to_number(substr(T1.TOTAL_LABOR_DURATION,instr(T1.TOTAL_LABOR_DURATION, '时', -1) + 1,
                           instr(T1.TOTAL_LABOR_DURATION, '分', -1) - 1 - instr(T1.TOTAL_LABOR_DURATION, '时', -1)))
              end) TOTAL_LABOR_DURATION,--总产程时长（分娩记录单中总产程）*/

       T1.TIRE_BEARING_CODE, --胎方位代码（分娩记录单中胎方位）
       '' AS FDMFLAG, --胎儿娩出助产标志 (分娩记录单中，)
       substr(T2.MIDWIFERY_METHOD,1,100) as MIDWIFERY_METHOD , --助产方式(没有)
       substr(T1.DOTP_SITUATION,1,100) as DOTP_SITUATION, --胎盘娩出情况(没有)

       case when T1.INTACT_CAUL_FLAG ='完整' then 'true'
         when T1.INTACT_CAUL_FLAG like '%不完整%' then 'false'
           end INTACT_CAUL_FLAG, --产程记录单中胎膜情况

       substr(T1.AMNIOTIC_FLUID_TRAITS,1,100) as AMNIOTIC_FLUID_TRAITS, --羊水性状（分娩记录单中羊水性状）
       case when T1.AMNIOTIC_FLUID_AMOUNT in ('不清','不详','量不清') then '0'
         else T1.AMNIOTIC_FLUID_AMOUNT end AMNIOTIC_FLUID_AMOUNT,--羊水量（分娩记录单中羊水量）
       T1.CORD_LENGTH, --脐带长度（分娩记录单中脐带长度）

       case when T1.UCASF = '无' then ''
         else T1.CORD_AROUND_NECK end CORD_AROUND_NECK, --绕颈身（分娩记录单中脐带情况）

       case when T1.UCASF = '无' then 'false'
         else 'true' end UCASF, --脐带异常情况标志（分娩记录单中脐带情况选择了无缠绕是正常，其他为异常）

       substr(T1.BIRTH_DOSE,1,50) as BIRTH_DOSE, --产时用药（分娩记录单中产时用药）
       substr('无',1,200) AS PREMUNITION, --预防措施(没有)
       case when T1.PERINEUM_INCISION_PLACE = '无' then 'false'
         else 'true' end EPISIOTOMY_FLAG , --产妇会阴切开标志（分娩记录单中的会阴破裂评估，选择侧切的话返回有，其他返回无）
       substr(T1.PERINEUM_INCISION_PLACE,1,100) as PERINEUM_INCISION_PLACE, --会阴切开位置(分娩记录单中的会阴破裂)
       case when T1.MATERNAL_PERINEUM_SUTURE_NUM is null then '0'
         else T1.MATERNAL_PERINEUM_SUTURE_NUM end as MATERNAL_PERINEUM_SUTURE_NUM, --产妇会阴缝合针数(分娩记录单中的会阴破裂后面的缝合)

       case
         when T1.MATERNAL_PERINEUM_DEGREE_CODE = 'Ⅰ°' then '2'
         when T1.MATERNAL_PERINEUM_DEGREE_CODE = 'Ⅱ°' then '3'
         when T1.MATERNAL_PERINEUM_DEGREE_CODE = 'Ⅲ°' then '4'
         when T1.MATERNAL_PERINEUM_DEGREE_CODE = '完整' then '1'
           ELSE '1'
         end MATERNAL_PERINEUM_DEGREE_CODE, --产妇会阴裂伤程度代码(分娩记录单中的会阴破裂)


--------------------------------------------------------------【省中医文书无】--------------------------------------------------------------
       'false' PERINEAL_HEMATOMA_FLAG, --会阴血肿标志(分娩记录单中会阴或阴道血肿，选择无时返回无，选择有时返回有)
       '0' AS PERINEAL_HEMATOMA_SIZE, --会阴血肿大小（分娩记录单中会阴或阴道血肿后面的处理）
       substr('无',1,200) as PERINEAL_HEMATOMA_HANDLE, --会阴血肿处理（分娩记录单中会阴或阴道血肿后面的处理）
       '9' as ANES_METHOD_CODE, --麻醉方法代码（分娩记录单中的麻醉方式）--【9其他麻醉方法】
       substr('无',1,50) as ANES_DRUG_NAME, --麻醉药物名称（分娩记录单中的麻醉用药）
       'false' VAGINAL_LA_FLAG, --阴道裂伤标志（分娩记录单中的子宫颈裂伤）[省中医文书模板中无此项]
       'false' VAGINA_HEMATOMA_FLAG, --阴道血肿标志（分娩记录单中会阴或阴道血肿）
       'false' CERVICAL_LA_FLAG, --宫颈裂伤标志（分娩记录单中的子宫颈裂伤）
       /*宫颈缝合情况需要添加*/
       '无' CERVIX_SUTURE_SITUATION, --宫颈缝合情况（分娩记录单中的子宫颈裂伤后面的处理）
--------------------------------------------------------------【省中医文书无】--------------------------------------------------------------


       substr(T1.POSTPARTUM_DOSE,1,50) as POSTPARTUM_DOSE , --产后用药（分娩记录单中产后用药）
       substr(T1.BIRTH_PROC_ABSTRACT,1,200) as BIRTH_PROC_ABSTRACT, --分娩过程摘要（分娩记录单中手术助产经过）
       substr(T1.CONTRACTIONS_SITUATION,1,200) as CONTRACTIONS_SITUATION, --宫缩情况（产程记录中最新的一条宫缩）
       substr('无',1,100) as UTERINE_SITUATION, --子宫情况
       /*恶露状况需要添加*/
       substr('-',1,100) LOCHIA_STATUS, --恶露状况【无】
       substr('会阴'||T1.PERINEUM_SITUATION||'裂伤',1,100) as PERINEUM_SITUATION, --会阴情况（分娩记录单中会阴或阴道血肿处理、子宫颈裂伤处理做合并处理）
       /*修补手术过程需要添加*/
       substr(T1.BIRTH_PROC_ABSTRACT,1,100) REPAIR_SURGERY_PROC, --修补手术过程（无）【取分娩过程摘要】
       /*存脐带血情况需要添加*/

--------------------------------------------------------------【省中医文书无】--------------------------------------------------------------
       'false' CORD_BLOOD_MARKER, --存脐带血情况标志（新生儿出生记录中的存脐带血）
       T1.POSTPARTUM_DIAG as POSTPARTUM_DIAG, --产后诊断（分娩记录单中最后诊断）--【手写】给默认【O26.900  与妊娠有关的情况】？0730
--------------------------------------------------------------【省中医文书无】--------------------------------------------------------------

       to_char(WSFL.FORM_TIME, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') POSTPARTUM_OBSERVE_DATE, --产后观察日期时间【书写分娩记录单时间】
       '120' POSTPARTUM_CHECK_TIME_LONG, --产后检查时间（MIN）【无】【给产后2小时观察】
       T1.POSTPARTUM_SYSTOLIC_PRESSURE, --产后收缩压（MMHG ）--产后2小时观察表中收缩压
       T1.POSTPARTUM_DIASTOLIC_PRESSURE, --产后舒张压（MMHG ）--产后2小时观察表中舒张压
       '' POSTPARTUM_PULSE_RATE, --产后脉搏（次/MIN ）--产后2小时观察表中心率
       T1.POSTPARTUM_HEART_RATE, --产后心率（次/MIN ）--产后2小时观察表中心率
       T1.TAOPH, --产后出血量（ML）--分娩记录单中失血量
       substr(T1.POSTPARTUM_UC,1,200) as POSTPARTUM_UC, --产后宫缩--无
       /*产后宫底高度需要添加*/
       '' POSTPARTUM_FUNDUS_HIGHT, --产后宫底高度（CM）--产妇产后2小时观察表中宫底--【平脐约多高？ 脐下一指？ 脐下两指？】
       /*肛查需要添加*/
       substr('无',1,100) ANUS_CHECK, --肛查--产妇产后2小时观察表中肛查--【无】
       T1.BABY_SEX_CODE, --新生儿性别代码--新生儿出生记录中胎儿性别
       T1.BABY_BIRTH_WEIGHT, --新生儿出生体重（G）
       T1.BABY_BIRTH_HEIGHT, --新生儿出生身长（CM）
       /*产瘤大小需要添加*/
       substr('-',1,100) PFT_SIZE, --产瘤大小--新生儿出生记录中产瘤大小
       substr('-',1,100) PFT_PART, --产瘤部位新生儿出生记录中产瘤部位
       '2' AS APGAR_SCORE_INTERVAL_TIME_CODE, --APGAR评分间隔时间代码  --无
       T1.APGAR_SCORE_VALUE, --APGAR评分值
       CASE T1.DELIVERY_ENDING_CODE WHEN '死产' THEN '3'
         WHEN '死胎' THEN '2'
           ELSE '1' END AS DELIVERY_ENDING_CODE, --分娩结局代码--分娩记录中的身长体重后面第二个下拉框
       CASE T1.BABY_ABMAL_CODE WHEN '死产' then '9'
         WHEN '死胎' THEN '9'
           WHEN '畸形' THEN '3'
             else '1' end as BABY_ABMAL_CODE --新生儿异常情况代码--新生儿出生记录中异常情况

  FROM YDHL.MCS_DOC_FORM WSFL

  LEFT JOIN YDHL.INPATIENTS YDZD
    ON WSFL.PATIENT_UID = YDZD.PAT_INDEX_NO

  LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT F.PATIENT_UID, F.FORM_TIME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY F.PATIENT_UID ORDER BY F.FORM_TIME ASC) RN,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00007 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS EDC_DATE,--预产期
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00006 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS LABOR_DATE_TIME,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00008 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS PROM_RUPTURE_DATE_TIME,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00250 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS BEFORE_AMNIOTIC_FLUID_AMOUNT,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00012 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS BEFORE_AMNIOTIC_FLUID_TRAITS,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00006 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS CONTRACTIONS_BEGIN_DATE,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00029 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS FIRST_TPP_TIME,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00007 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS CERVIX_OPEN_FULLY_DATE,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00032 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS SECOND_TPP_TIME,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00017 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS FETAL_DISENGAGEMENT_DATE_TIME,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00035 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS THIRD_TPP_TIME,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00023 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS DOTP_DATE_TIME,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00038 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS TOTAL_LABOR_DURATION,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00022 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS TIRE_BEARING_CODE,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00064 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS DOTP_SITUATION,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00064 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS INTACT_CAUL_FLAG,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00012 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS AMNIOTIC_FLUID_TRAITS,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00250 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS AMNIOTIC_FLUID_AMOUNT,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00268 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS CORD_LENGTH,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00270 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS CORD_AROUND_NECK,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00269 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS UCASF,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00060 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS BIRTH_DOSE,--产时用药
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00046 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS EPISIOTOMY_FLAG,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00050 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS PERINEUM_INCISION_PLACE,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00056 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS MATERNAL_PERINEUM_SUTURE_NUM,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00046 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS MATERNAL_PERINEUM_DEGREE_CODE,
                            /*MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00030 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS PERINEAL_HEMATOMA_HANDLE,*/
                            /*MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00041 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS ANES_METHOD_CODE,*/
                            /*MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00042 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS ANES_DRUG_NAME,*/
                            /*MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00034 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS VAGINAL_LA_FLAG,*/
                            /*MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00030 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS VAGINA_HEMATOMA_FLAG,*/
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00096 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS CERVIX_SUTURE_SITUATION,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00060 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS POSTPARTUM_DOSE,--产后用药
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00108 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS BIRTH_PROC_ABSTRACT,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00258 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS CONTRACTIONS_SITUATION,
                            /*MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00048 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS UTERINE_SITUATION,*/
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00072 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS LOCHIA_STATUS,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00046 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS PERINEUM_SITUATION,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00111 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS POSTPARTUM_DIAG,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00084 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS POSTPARTUM_SYSTOLIC_PRESSURE,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00262 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS POSTPARTUM_DIASTOLIC_PRESSURE,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00088 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS POSTPARTUM_HEART_RATE,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00137 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS TAOPH,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00136 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS POSTPARTUM_UC,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00071 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS BABY_SEX_CODE,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00074 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS BABY_BIRTH_WEIGHT,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00076 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS BABY_BIRTH_HEIGHT,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00083 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS APGAR_SCORE_VALUE,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00080 OR R.NODE_CODE = 00081 OR R.NODE_CODE = 00082 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS DELIVERY_ENDING_CODE,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00080 OR R.NODE_CODE = 00081 OR R.NODE_CODE = 00082 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS BABY_ABMAL_CODE
                      FROM YDHL.MCS_DOC_FORM_RECORDS R, YDHL.MCS_DOC_FORM F
                      WHERE R.NODE_CODE IN ('00007','00015', '00008', '00250', '00006', '00029', '00007', '00032', '00017', '00035', '00023', '00038', '00022', '00012',
                                            '00064', '00012', '00250', '00268', '00270', '00269', '00060', '00046', '00050', '00056', '00046','00262',
                                            '00030', '00032', '00096', '00060', '00108', '00258', '00084', '00072',
                                            '00046', '00111', '00255', '00261', '00088', '00137', '00136', '00071', '00074', '00076', '00083', '00080')
                        AND F.TEMPLATE_CODE = '445'
                        AND F.ID = R.FORM_ID
                        AND F.IS_VALID = 1
                      GROUP BY F.PATIENT_UID, F.FORM_TIME)
              WHERE RN = 1) T1
    ON WSFL.PATIENT_UID = T1.PATIENT_UID


  LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT F.PATIENT_UID, F.FORM_TIME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY F.PATIENT_UID ORDER BY F.FORM_TIME ASC) RN,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00146 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS BIRTH_DR_SIGN,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00147 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS MENTOR_SIGN,
                            f.CREATED_NAME AS RECORD_SIGN,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00019 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS CERVIX_OPEN_FULLY_DATE,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00106 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS MIDWIFERY_METHOD
                       FROM YDHL.MCS_DOC_FORM_RECORDS R, YDHL.MCS_DOC_FORM F
                      WHERE R.NODE_CODE IN ('00146', '00147', '00019', '00106')
                        AND F.TEMPLATE_CODE = '445'
                        AND F.ID = R.FORM_ID
                        AND F.IS_VALID = 1
                      GROUP BY F.PATIENT_UID, F.FORM_TIME, f.CREATED_NAME)
              WHERE RN = 1) T2
    ON WSFL.PATIENT_UID = T2.PATIENT_UID

  LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT F.PATIENT_UID, F.FORM_TIME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY F.PATIENT_UID ORDER BY F.FORM_TIME ASC) RN,
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00004 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS GRAVIDITY_NUM,--孕次
                            MAX(CASE WHEN R.NODE_CODE = 00005 THEN R.STRING_VALUE ELSE NULL END) AS PRODUCTION_NUM--产次
                       FROM YDHL.MCS_DOC_FORM_RECORDS R, YDHL.MCS_DOC_FORM F
                      WHERE R.NODE_CODE IN ('00004', '00005')
                        AND F.TEMPLATE_CODE = '444'
                        AND F.ID = R.FORM_ID
                        AND F.IS_VALID = 1
                      GROUP BY F.PATIENT_UID, F.FORM_TIME, f.CREATED_NAME)
              WHERE RN = 1) T3
    ON WSFL.PATIENT_UID = T3.PATIENT_UID

 WHERE WSFL.TEMPLATE_CODE = '445'
 AND WSFL.IS_VALID = '1'

V_AI_ZKUSER.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_AI_ZKUSER" ("USERID", "USER_NAME", "REMARK", "科室编码", "护理单元编码", "所在科室", "护理单元") AS 
  select t.USERID, t.USER_NAME ,t.REMARK ,nvl(b.DEPT_CODE,c.DEPT_CODE)  科室编码, nvl( b.WARD_CODE, c.WARD_CODE) 护理单元编码,nvl( b.科室，c.科室 ) 所在科室, nvl(b.护理单元,b.护理单元
  ) 护理单元   from  ai_zk_MED_USER_DICT t inner join his.staff_dict a on t.USERID=a.EMP_NO
   left join v_deptward b on a.DEPT_CODE=b.WARD_CODE    left join v_deptward c on a.DEPT_CODE=c.DEPT_CODE   --  where REMARK<>'普通'

V_BI_MZGH.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_BI_MZGH" ("CARD_NAME", "CARD_COUNT", "CARD_ON_YEAR_RESULE", "CARD_ON_YEAR", "CARD_QOQ_RESULT", "CARD_QOQ", "BED_NUMBER_LIST", "CARD_RANK", "STAFF_CODE", "STAFF_NAME", "DEPT_CODE", "DEPT_NAME", "SHOW_STATE", "STATSDATE") AS 
  select '门诊挂号量' as CARD_NAME,-- 指标名称
       count(1) as CARD_COUNT,--  总数
       '' as CARD_ON_YEAR_RESULE,-- 同比上升/下降
       '' as CARD_ON_YEAR,--  同比
       '' as CARD_QOQ_RESULT,-- 环比上升/下降
       '' as CARD_QOQ,--  环比
       '' as BED_NUMBER_LIST,-- 床号列表
       '' as CARD_RANK,-- 排名
       a.DOCTOR as STAFF_CODE,--  医生工号
       (select yg.name from his.staff_dict yg where yg.emp_no=a.DOCTOR and rownum='1') as STAFF_NAME,--  医生名称
       a.VISIT_DEPT as DEPT_CODE,-- 科室编号
       (select ks.dept_name from his.dept_dict ks where ks.dept_code=a.VISIT_DEPT) as DEPT_NAME,-- 科室名称
       '1' as SHOW_STATE, -- 状态
       to_char(a.REGISTERING_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') as statsdate --时间
from his.clinic_master a
where a.REGISTERING_DATE>to_date('2023-01-01 00:00:00','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
group by a.DOCTOR,a.VISIT_DEPT,to_char(a.REGISTERING_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd')

V_BI_ZYJCSQ.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_BI_ZYJCSQ" ("CARD_NAME", "CARD_COUNT", "CARD_ON_YEAR_RESULE", "CARD_ON_YEAR", "CARD_QOQ_RESULT", "CARD_QOQ", "BED_NUMBER_LIST", "CARD_RANK", "STAFF_CODE", "STAFF_NAME", "DEPT_CODE", "DEPT_NAME", "SHOW_STATE", "STATSDATE") AS 
  select '住院检查申请单开立数量' as CARD_NAME,-- 指标名称
       count(1) as CARD_COUNT,--  总数
       '' as CARD_ON_YEAR_RESULE,-- 同比上升/下降
       '' as CARD_ON_YEAR,--  同比
       '' as CARD_QOQ_RESULT,-- 环比上升/下降
       '' as CARD_QOQ,--  环比
       '' as BED_NUMBER_LIST,-- 床号列表
       '' as CARD_RANK,-- 排名
       (select yg.emp_no from his.staff_dict yg where yg.name=a.REQ_PHYSICIAN and rownum='1') as STAFF_CODE,--  医生工号
       a.Req_Physician as STAFF_NAME,--  医生名称
       a.Req_Dept as DEPT_CODE,-- 科室编号
       (select ks.dept_name from his.dept_dict ks where ks.dept_code=a.Req_Dept) as DEPT_NAME,-- 科室名称
       '1' as SHOW_STATE, -- 状态
       to_char(a.req_date_time,'yyyy-mm-dd') as statsdate --时间
from his.exam_master a
where a.charge_indicator='1'
and a.req_date_time>to_date('2023-01-01 00:00:00','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
and a.visit_id>'0'
group by a.REQ_PHYSICIAN,a.Req_Dept,to_char(a.req_date_time,'yyyy-mm-dd')

V_BI_ZYJYSQ.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_BI_ZYJYSQ" ("CARD_NAME", "CARD_COUNT", "CARD_ON_YEAR_RESULE", "CARD_ON_YEAR", "CARD_QOQ_RESULT", "CARD_QOQ", "BED_NUMBER_LIST", "CARD_RANK", "STAFF_CODE", "STAFF_NAME", "DEPT_CODE", "DEPT_NAME", "SHOW_STATE", "STATSDATE") AS 
  select '住院检验申请单开立数量' as CARD_NAME,-- 指标名称
       count(1) as CARD_COUNT,--  总数
       '' as CARD_ON_YEAR_RESULE,-- 同比上升/下降
       '' as CARD_ON_YEAR,--  同比
       '' as CARD_QOQ_RESULT,-- 环比上升/下降
       '' as CARD_QOQ,--  环比
       '' as BED_NUMBER_LIST,-- 床号列表
       '' as CARD_RANK,-- 排名
       a.ORDERING_PROVIDER as STAFF_CODE,--  医生工号
       (select yg.name from his.staff_dict yg where yg.emp_no=a.ORDERING_PROVIDER and rownum='1') as STAFF_NAME,--  医生名称
       a.ORDERING_DEPT as DEPT_CODE,-- 科室编号
       (select ks.dept_name from his.dept_dict ks where ks.dept_code=a.ORDERING_DEPT) as DEPT_NAME,-- 科室名称
       '1' as SHOW_STATE, -- 状态
       to_char(a.requested_date_time,'yyyy-mm-dd') as statsdate --时间
from his.lab_test_master a
where a.billing_indicator='1'
and a.requested_date_time>to_date('2023-01-01 00:00:00','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
and a.visit_id>'0'
group by a.ORDERING_PROVIDER,a.ORDERING_DEPT,to_char(a.requested_date_time,'yyyy-mm-dd')

V_BI_ZYSS.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_BI_ZYSS" ("CARD_NAME", "CARD_COUNT", "CARD_ON_YEAR_RESULE", "CARD_ON_YEAR", "CARD_QOQ_RESULT", "CARD_QOQ", "BED_NUMBER_LIST", "CARD_RANK", "STAFF_CODE", "STAFF_NAME", "DEPT_CODE", "DEPT_NAME", "SHOW_STATE", "STATSDATE") AS 
  select '住院手术' as CARD_NAME,-- 指标名称
       count(1) as CARD_COUNT,--  总数
       '' as CARD_ON_YEAR_RESULE,-- 同比上升/下降
       '' as CARD_ON_YEAR,--  同比
       '' as CARD_QOQ_RESULT,-- 环比上升/下降
       '' as CARD_QOQ,--  环比
       '' as BED_NUMBER_LIST,-- 床号列表
       '' as CARD_RANK,-- 排名
       a.OPERATOR as STAFF_CODE,--  医生工号
       (select yg.name from his.staff_dict yg where yg.emp_no=a.OPERATOR and rownum='1') as STAFF_NAME,--  医生名称
       b.dept_discharge_from as DEPT_CODE,-- 科室编号
       (select ks.dept_name from his.dept_dict ks where ks.dept_code=b.dept_discharge_from) as DEPT_NAME,-- 科室名称
       '1' as SHOW_STATE, -- 状态
       to_char(a.OPERATING_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') as statsdate --时间
from his.operation a
left join his.pat_visit b on a.patient_id=b.patient_id and a.visit_id=b.visit_id
where a.OPERATING_DATE>to_date('2025-06-17 00:00:00','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
group by a.OPERATOR,b.dept_discharge_from,to_char(a.OPERATING_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd')

V_BI_ZYYZ.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_BI_ZYYZ" ("CARD_NAME", "CARD_COUNT", "CARD_ON_YEAR_RESULE", "CARD_ON_YEAR", "CARD_QOQ_RESULT", "CARD_QOQ", "BED_NUMBER_LIST", "CARD_RANK", "STAFF_CODE", "STAFF_NAME", "DEPT_CODE", "DEPT_NAME", "SHOW_STATE", "STATSDATE") AS

       '' as CARD_ON_YEAR,--  同比
       '' as CARD_QOQ_RESULT,-- 环比上升/下降
       '' as CARD_QOQ,--  环比

       (select yg.emp_no from his.staff_dict yg where yg.name=a.DOCTOR and rownum='1') as STAFF_CODE,--  医生工号

V_BI_ZYYZJE.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_BI_ZYYZJE" ("CARD_NAME", "CARD_COUNT", "CARD_ON_YEAR_RESULE", "CARD_ON_YEAR", "CARD_QOQ_RESULT", "CARD_QOQ", "BED_NUMBER_LIST", "CARD_RANK", "STAFF_CODE", "STAFF_NAME", "DEPT_CODE", "DEPT_NAME", "SHOW_STATE", "STATSDATE") AS

V_EMR_ADMISSION_DEAD_RECORD_TF.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_ADMISSION_DEAD_RECORD_TF" ("ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "ADMISSION_UN_NUM", "PATIENT_NAME", "ID_NUM", "SEX_CODE", "SEX_NAME", "AGE", "AGE_MONTH", "NATION_CODE", "NATION_NAME", "MARITAL_STATUS_CODE", "MARITAL_STATUS", "ADDRESS_PROV", "ADDRESS_CITY", "ADDRESS_COUNTRY", "ADDRESS_VILLAGE", "ADDRESS_HAMLET", "ADDRESS_HNUM", "JOB_CODE", "JOB_NAME", "REPRESENTOR_NAME", "DAP_CONTACT_CODE", "DAP_CONTACT_NAME", "IS_RELIABLE", "ADMISSION_DATE", "DEATH_TIME", "ADMISSION_SITUATION", "FOUR_DIAGNOSIS", "TREATMENT_METHOD", "IN_HOS_WE_DIAG_NAME", "IN_HOS_WE_DIAG_CODE", "IN_HOS_CH_DIAG_CD_NAME", "IN_HOS_CH_DIAG_CD_CODE", "IN_HOS_CH_DIAG_CSYN_NAME", "IN_HOS_CH_DIAG_CSYN_CODE", "TREAT_NOTE", "DEATH_CAUSE", "OUT_HOS_WE_DIAG_NAME", "OUT_HOS_WE_DIAG_CODE", "OUT_HOS_CH_DIAG_CD_NAME", "OUT_HOS_CH_DIAG_CD_CODE", "OUT_HOS_CH_DIAG_CSYN_NAME", "OUT_HOS_CH_DIAG_CSYN_CODE", "DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "RESIDENT_NAME", "ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN_NAME", "CHIEF_DOCTOR_NAME", "SIG_DATE") AS 
  select ID,
       ORG_CODE,
       ORG_NAME,
       DISTRICT_CODE,
       EXCHANGE_TYPE,
       SYSTEM_TIME,
       ADMISSION_UN_NUM,
       PATIENT_NAME,
       ID_NUM,
       SEX_CODE,
       SEX_NAME,
       AGE,
       AGE_MONTH,
       NATION_CODE,
       NATION_NAME,
       MARITAL_STATUS_CODE,
       MARITAL_STATUS,
       ADDRESS_PROV,
       ADDRESS_CITY,
       ADDRESS_COUNTRY,
       ADDRESS_VILLAGE,
       ADDRESS_HAMLET,
       ADDRESS_HNUM,
       JOB_CODE,
       JOB_NAME,
       REPRESENTOR_NAME,
       DAP_CONTACT_CODE,
       DAP_CONTACT_NAME,
       IS_RELIABLE,
       ADMISSION_DATE,
       DEATH_TIME,
       ADMISSION_SITUATION,
       FOUR_DIAGNOSIS,
       TREATMENT_METHOD,
       IN_HOS_WE_DIAG_NAME,
       IN_HOS_WE_DIAG_CODE,
       IN_HOS_CH_DIAG_CD_NAME,
       IN_HOS_CH_DIAG_CD_CODE,
       IN_HOS_CH_DIAG_CSYN_NAME,
       IN_HOS_CH_DIAG_CSYN_CODE,
       TREAT_NOTE,
       DEATH_CAUSE,
       OUT_HOS_WE_DIAG_NAME,
       OUT_HOS_WE_DIAG_CODE,
       OUT_HOS_CH_DIAG_CD_NAME,
       OUT_HOS_CH_DIAG_CD_CODE,
       OUT_HOS_CH_DIAG_CSYN_NAME,
       OUT_HOS_CH_DIAG_CSYN_CODE,
       DIAGNOSIS_NAME,
       RESIDENT_NAME,
       ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN_NAME,
       CHIEF_DOCTOR_NAME,
       SIG_DATE
from (
    select q.*,
           row_number() over (
               partition by q.ID
               order by q.SIG_DATE desc nulls last,
                        q.DEATH_TIME desc nulls last
           ) as rn
    from (
        select substr(
                   '49557032X'||'|'||
                   nvl(to_char(tt.patient_id), '-')||'|'||
                   nvl(to_char(t.p_inpatient_times), '-'),
                   1,
                   100
               ) as ID,--  内码  是 主键

               '49557032X' as ORG_CODE,--  医院组织机构代码  是 必填、机构验证，

               '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,--  医院名称  是 必填，填写标准医院名称

               '370104' as DISTRICT_CODE,-- 所属行政区划  是 按机构所在的行政区划（区县）

               'ADDHIS' as EXCHANGE_TYPE,-- 交换类型 INSERT：向平台传新数据时；UPDATE：向平台更新某条数据时；DELETE：从平台删除某条数据时；ADDHIS :向平台补充历史数据

               cast(systimestamp as timestamp) as SYSTEM_TIME,-- 数据上传时间戳 是

               substr(
                   nvl(to_char(tt.patient_id), '-')||'|'||nvl(to_char(t.p_inpatient_times), '-'),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as ADMISSION_UN_NUM,--  住院唯一标识号 是

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       nullif(trim(cast(ar.name as varchar2(50))), ''),
                       nvl(nullif(trim(cast(tt.name as varchar2(50))), ''), '-')
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as PATIENT_NAME,--  患者姓名  是

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       nullif(trim(cast(ar.id_num as varchar2(18))), ''),
                       nvl(nullif(trim(cast(tt.id_no as varchar2(18))), ''), '000000000000000000')
                   ),
                   1,
                   18
               ) as ID_NUM,--  患者身份证号码 是

               case
                   when to_char(ar.sex_code) in ('0', '1', '2', '9') then to_number(ar.sex_code)
                   when cast(tt.sex as varchar2(10)) = '男' then 1
                   when cast(tt.sex as varchar2(10)) = '女' then 2
                   when cast(tt.sex as varchar2(10)) = '未知' then 0
                   else 9
               end as SEX_CODE,--  性别代码  是

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       nullif(trim(cast(ar.sex_name as varchar2(11))), ''),
                       case
                           when cast(tt.sex as varchar2(10)) = '男' then '男'
                           when cast(tt.sex as varchar2(10)) = '女' then '女'
                           when cast(tt.sex as varchar2(10)) = '未知' then '未知'
                           else '不明'
                       end
                   ),
                   1,
                   11
               ) as SEX_NAME,--  性别名称  是

               case
                   when ar.age between 0 and 200 then ar.age
                   when tt.date_of_birth is not null
                    and ttt.admission_date_time is not null
                   then least(
                            greatest(
                                trunc(months_between(ttt.admission_date_time, tt.date_of_birth) / 12),
                                0
                            ),
                            200
                        )
                   else 0
               end as AGE,-- 年龄(岁) 是 0-200

               substr(
                   case
                       when ar.age_month is not null and to_char(ar.age_month) <> '0'
                       then to_char(ar.age_month)
                       when tt.date_of_birth is not null
                        and ttt.admission_date_time is not null
                        and months_between(ttt.admission_date_time, tt.date_of_birth) < 12
                       then to_char(greatest(trunc(months_between(ttt.admission_date_time, tt.date_of_birth)), 0))
                       else null
                   end,
                   1,
                   8
               ) as AGE_MONTH,-- 年龄(月)

               substr(
    nvl(
        nullif(trim(cast(ar.nation_code as varchar2(2))), ''),
        case regexp_replace(trim(nvl(cast(tt.nation as varchar2(50)), '')), '[[:space:]]+', '')
            when '01' then '01'
            when '1' then '01'
            when '汉' then '01'
            when '汉族' then '01'
            else cast(null as varchar2(2))
        end
    ),
    1,
    2
)  as NATION_CODE,-- 民族代码 按照平台值域填写

               substr(
    nvl(
        nullif(trim(cast(ar.nation_name as varchar2(50))), ''),
        case regexp_replace(trim(nvl(cast(tt.nation as varchar2(50)), '')), '[[:space:]]+', '')
            when '01' then '汉族'
            when '1' then '汉族'
            when '汉' then '汉族'
            when '汉族' then '汉族'
            else cast(null as varchar2(50))
        end
    ),
    1,
    50
)  as NATION_NAME,-- 民族名称

              substr(
    case
        when cast(ar.marital_status_code as varchar2(10)) in ('10','20','30','40','90')
        then cast(ar.marital_status_code as varchar2(10))

        when cast(ar.marital_status_code as varchar2(10)) = '1' then '10'
        when cast(ar.marital_status_code as varchar2(10)) = '2' then '20'
        when cast(ar.marital_status_code as varchar2(10)) = '3' then '30'
        when cast(ar.marital_status_code as varchar2(10)) = '4' then '40'

        when cast(tt.marital_status as varchar2(50)) in ('1','未婚') then '10'
        when cast(tt.marital_status as varchar2(50)) in ('2','已婚','再婚') then '20'
        when cast(tt.marital_status as varchar2(50)) in ('3','丧偶') then '30'
        when cast(tt.marital_status as varchar2(50)) in ('4','离婚','离异') then '40'
        else '90'
    end,
    1,
    2
)       as MARITAL_STATUS_CODE,-- 婚姻状况代码 按照平台值域填写

        substr(
    case
        when cast(ar.marital_status_code as varchar2(10)) in ('10','1') then '未婚'
        when cast(ar.marital_status_code as varchar2(10)) in ('20','2') then '已婚'
        when cast(ar.marital_status_code as varchar2(10)) in ('30','3') then '丧偶'
        when cast(ar.marital_status_code as varchar2(10)) in ('40','4') then '离婚'

        when cast(tt.marital_status as varchar2(50)) in ('1','未婚') then '未婚'
        when cast(tt.marital_status as varchar2(50)) in ('2','已婚','再婚') then '已婚'
        when cast(tt.marital_status as varchar2(50)) in ('3','丧偶') then '丧偶'
        when cast(tt.marital_status as varchar2(50)) in ('4','离婚','离异') then '离婚'
        else '未说明的婚姻状况'
    end,
    1,
    50
)   as MARITAL_STATUS,--  婚姻状况

               substr(ar.province, 1, 70) as ADDRESS_PROV,--  地址-省（自治区、直辖市）

               substr(ar.city, 1, 70) as ADDRESS_CITY,--  地址-市（地区、州）

               substr(ar.county, 1, 70) as ADDRESS_COUNTRY,-- 地址-县（区）

               substr(ar.town, 1, 70) as ADDRESS_VILLAGE,-- 地址-乡（镇、街道办事处）

               substr(ar.village, 1, 70) as ADDRESS_HAMLET,--  地址-村（街、路、弄）

               substr(ar.house_num, 1, 70) as ADDRESS_HNUM,--  地址-门牌号码

               substr(ar.occupation_code, 1, 20) as JOB_CODE,--  职业类别代码

               substr(ar.occupation_name, 1, 50) as JOB_NAME,--  职业类别名称

       substr(
    nvl(
        nullif(
            trim(
                case
                    when ar.representor_name is not null
                     and not regexp_like(
                             trim(cast(ar.representor_name as varchar2(200))),
                             '^(主诉|现病史|辅助检查|查体)[[:space:]]*[:：]'
                         )
                    then cast(ar.representor_name as varchar2(50))
                    else null
                end
            ),
            ''
        ),
        nvl(
            nullif(
                trim(
                    regexp_substr(
                        cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 1000, 1) as varchar2(1000)),
                        '病史陈述者[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([^。；;\r\n]{1,50})',
                        1, 1, 'n', 1
                    )
                ),
                ''
            ),
            '-'
        )
    ),
    1,
    50
)     as REPRESENTOR_NAME,--  病史陈述者姓名

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       ar.linkman_relation_code,
                       case
                           when regexp_like(
                                    regexp_substr(
                                        cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 1000, 1) as varchar2(1000)),
                                        '病史陈述者[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([^[:cntrl:]]+)',
                                        1, 1, 'n', 1
                                    ),
                                    '本人|患者本人'
                                ) then '0'
                           when regexp_like(
                                    regexp_substr(
                                        cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 1000, 1) as varchar2(1000)),
                                        '病史陈述者[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([^[:cntrl:]]+)',
                                        1, 1, 'n', 1
                                    ),
                                    '配偶|丈夫|妻子|妻|夫|老伴|爱人'
                                ) then '1'
                           when regexp_like(
                                    regexp_substr(
                                        cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 1000, 1) as varchar2(1000)),
                                        '病史陈述者[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([^[:cntrl:]]+)',
                                        1, 1, 'n', 1
                                    ),
                                    '儿子|之子|其子|患儿父亲|父亲陪同'
                                ) then '2'
                           when regexp_like(
                                    regexp_substr(
                                        cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 1000, 1) as varchar2(1000)),
                                        '病史陈述者[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([^[:cntrl:]]+)',
                                        1, 1, 'n', 1
                                    ),
                                    '女儿|之女|其女'
                                ) then '3'
                           when regexp_like(
                                    regexp_substr(
                                        cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 1000, 1) as varchar2(1000)),
                                        '病史陈述者[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([^[:cntrl:]]+)',
                                        1, 1, 'n', 1
                                    ),
                                    '孙子|孙女|外孙|外孙子|外孙女'
                                ) then '4'
                           when regexp_like(
                                    regexp_substr(
                                        cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 1000, 1) as varchar2(1000)),
                                        '病史陈述者[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([^[:cntrl:]]+)',
                                        1, 1, 'n', 1
                                    ),
                                    '父亲|母亲|父母|患儿母亲|患儿父亲'
                                ) then '5'
                           when regexp_like(
                                    regexp_substr(
                                        cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 1000, 1) as varchar2(1000)),
                                        '病史陈述者[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([^[:cntrl:]]+)',
                                        1, 1, 'n', 1
                                    ),
                                    '祖父|祖母|爷爷|奶奶|外祖父|外祖母|外公|外婆'
                                ) then '6'
                           when regexp_like(
                                    regexp_substr(
                                        cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 1000, 1) as varchar2(1000)),
                                        '病史陈述者[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([^[:cntrl:]]+)',
                                        1, 1, 'n', 1
                                    ),
                                    '哥哥|弟弟|姐姐|妹妹|兄|弟|姐|妹|兄弟|姐妹'
                                ) then '7'
                           else '8'
                       end
                   ),
                   1,
                   2
               ) as DAP_CONTACT_CODE,--  陈述者与患者的关系代码

             substr(
    case
        when ar.linkman_relation_name is not null
         and not regexp_like(
                 trim(cast(ar.linkman_relation_name as varchar2(200))),
                 '^(主诉|现病史|辅助检查|查体)[[:space:]]*[:：]'
             )
        then cast(ar.linkman_relation_name as varchar2(50))

        when regexp_like(
                 regexp_substr(
                     cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 1000, 1) as varchar2(1000)),
                     '病史陈述者[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([^。；;\r\n]{1,50})',
                     1, 1, 'n', 1
                 ),
                 '本人|患者本人'
             )
        then '本人'

        when regexp_like(
                 regexp_substr(
                     cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 1000, 1) as varchar2(1000)),
                     '病史陈述者[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([^。；;\r\n]{1,50})',
                     1, 1, 'n', 1
                 ),
                 '配偶|丈夫|妻子|妻|夫|老伴|爱人'
             )
        then '配偶'

        when regexp_like(
                 regexp_substr(
                     cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 1000, 1) as varchar2(1000)),
                     '病史陈述者[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([^。；;\r\n]{1,50})',
                     1, 1, 'n', 1
                 ),
                 '儿子|之子|其子|患儿父亲|父亲陪同'
             )
        then '儿子'

        when regexp_like(
                 regexp_substr(
                     cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 1000, 1) as varchar2(1000)),
                     '病史陈述者[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([^。；;\r\n]{1,50})',
                     1, 1, 'n', 1
                 ),
                 '女儿|之女|其女'
             )
        then '女儿'

        when regexp_like(
                 regexp_substr(
                     cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 1000, 1) as varchar2(1000)),
                     '病史陈述者[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([^。；;\r\n]{1,50})',
                     1, 1, 'n', 1
                 ),
                 '家属'
             )
        then '家属'

        else '-'
    end,
    1,
    50
) as DAP_CONTACT_NAME,--  陈述者人与患者的关系名称

               case
                   when ar.is_reliable in ('0', '1') then ar.is_reliable
                   when dbms_lob.instr(t4.段落内容, '病史记录属实', 1, 1) > 0 then '1'
                   else '0'
               end as IS_RELIABLE,-- 陈述内容可靠标志 1：是 0:否

               cast(
                   nvl(ar.admission_date, ttt.admission_date_time)
                   as date
               ) as ADMISSION_DATE,--  入院日期时间  是 YYYYMMDD HHMISS

               cast(
                   nvl(sw.swsj, ttt.discharge_date_time)
                   as date
               ) as DEATH_TIME,--  死亡日期时间  是 死亡日期时间 YYYYMMDD HHMISS

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       nullif(trim(cast(t3.ryqk as varchar2(2000))), ''),
                       nvl(nullif(trim(cast(ar.present_illness as varchar2(2000))), ''), '-')
                   ),
                   1,
                   2000
               ) as ADMISSION_SITUATION,-- 入院情况  是 入院情况

               substr(ar.four_diagnosis, 1, 1000) as FOUR_DIAGNOSIS,--  中医“四诊”观察结果

               substr(
                   nvl(ar.therapeutic_treatment, t3.zzzf),
                   1,
                   100
               ) as TREATMENT_METHOD,--  治则治法

               substr(
                   nvl(cast(d2.diagnosis_desc as varchar2(50)), cast(d1.diagnosis_desc as varchar2(50))),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as IN_HOS_WE_DIAG_NAME,-- 入院诊断-西医诊断名称

               substr(
                   nvl(cast(d2.diagnosis_code as varchar2(50)), cast(d1.diagnosis_code as varchar2(50))),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as IN_HOS_WE_DIAG_CODE,-- 入院诊断-西医诊断编码

               cast(null as varchar2(50)) as IN_HOS_CH_DIAG_CD_NAME,--  入院诊断-中医病名名称

               cast(null as varchar2(9)) as IN_HOS_CH_DIAG_CD_CODE,--  入院诊断-中医病名代码

               cast(null as varchar2(50)) as IN_HOS_CH_DIAG_CSYN_NAME,--  入院诊断-中医证候名称

               cast(null as varchar2(9)) as IN_HOS_CH_DIAG_CSYN_CODE,--  入院诊断-中医证候代码

               substr(
                   nvl(nullif(trim(cast(t3.zlgcms as varchar2(2000))), ''), '-'),
                   1,
                   2000
               ) as TREAT_NOTE,--  诊疗过程描述

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       nullif(trim(cast(t3.swyy as varchar2(100))), ''),
                       nvl(nullif(trim(cast(dd.diagnosis_desc as varchar2(100))), ''), '-')
                   ),
                   1,
                   100
               ) as DEATH_CAUSE,-- 死亡原因  是 死亡原因,直接死亡原因

               substr(cast(dd.diagnosis_desc as varchar2(50)), 1, 50) as OUT_HOS_WE_DIAG_NAME,--  死亡诊断-西医诊断名称

               substr(cast(dd.diagnosis_code as varchar2(50)), 1, 50) as OUT_HOS_WE_DIAG_CODE,--  死亡诊断-西医诊断编码

               cast(null as varchar2(50)) as OUT_HOS_CH_DIAG_CD_NAME,-- 死亡诊断-中医病名名称

               cast(null as varchar2(9)) as OUT_HOS_CH_DIAG_CD_CODE,-- 死亡诊断-中医病名代码

               cast(null as varchar2(50)) as OUT_HOS_CH_DIAG_CSYN_NAME,-- 死亡诊断-中医证候名称

               cast(null as varchar2(9)) as OUT_HOS_CH_DIAG_CSYN_CODE,-- 死亡诊断-中医证候代码

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       ar.doctor_name,
                       nvl(
                           (select cast(sd.name as varchar2(50))
                              from his.staff_dict sd
                             where sd.emp_no = nvl(ttt.attending_doctor, ttt.doctor_in_charge)
                               and rownum = 1),
                           '-'
                       )
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as DIAGNOSIS_NAME,--  接诊医师签名

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       ar.doctor_name,
                       nvl(
                           (select cast(sd.name as varchar2(50))
                              from his.staff_dict sd
                             where sd.emp_no = nvl(ttt.attending_doctor, ttt.doctor_in_charge)
                               and rownum = 1),
                           '-'
                       )
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as RESIDENT_NAME,-- 住院医师签名

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       ar.attending_doctor_name,
                       nvl(
                           ar.doctor_name,
                           nvl(
                               (select cast(sd.name as varchar2(50))
                                  from his.staff_dict sd
                                 where sd.emp_no = nvl(ttt.attending_doctor, ttt.doctor_in_charge)
                                   and rownum = 1),
                               '-'
                           )
                       )
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN_NAME,--  主治医师签名  是 主治医师签名

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       ar.chief_doctor_name,
                       (select cast(sd.name as varchar2(50))
                          from his.staff_dict sd
                         where sd.emp_no = ttt.director
                           and rownum = 1)
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as CHIEF_DOCTOR_NAME,-- 主任医师签名

           cast(
    case
        when t1.doc_title_time is not null
         and nvl(sw.swsj, ttt.discharge_date_time) is not null
         and t1.doc_title_time - nvl(sw.swsj, ttt.discharge_date_time) <= 1
        then t1.doc_title_time
        else nvl(sw.swsj, ttt.discharge_date_time)
    end
    as date
)   as SIG_DATE -- 签名日期  是

        from mtl.epr_inpatient_docindex t

        inner join mtl.epr_inpatient t1
                on t.uhid = t1.uhid
               and cast(t1.doc_type_name as varchar2(100)) = '24小时内入院死亡记录'

        left join mtl.emrsd36 t3
               on t3.段落编号 = t1.id

        join mtl.emrsd_content t4
             on t4.uhid = t1.uhid
            and t4.段落编号 = t1.id

        left join his.pat_master_index tt
               on t.p_inpatient_no = tt.inp_no

        left join his.pat_visit ttt
               on tt.patient_id = ttt.patient_id
              and t.p_inpatient_times = ttt.visit_id

        left join v_emr_admission_record ar
               on ar.admission_id = tt.patient_id||'|'||t.p_inpatient_times

        left join his.diagnosis d2
               on ttt.patient_id = d2.patient_id
              and ttt.visit_id = d2.visit_id
              and d2.diagnosis_type = '2'
              and d2.diagnosis_no = '1'

        left join his.diagnosis d1
               on ttt.patient_id = d1.patient_id
              and ttt.visit_id = d1.visit_id
              and d1.diagnosis_type = '1'
              and d1.diagnosis_no = '1'

        left join his.diagnosis dd
               on ttt.patient_id = dd.patient_id
              and ttt.visit_id = dd.visit_id
              and dd.diagnosis_type = '3'
              and dd.diagnosis_no = '1'

        left join ( select sw.patient_id,
           sw.visit_id,
           min(sw.start_date_time) as swsj
      from his.orders sw
     where sw.order_text like '%临床死亡%'
       and sw.order_class = 'Z'
       and sw.order_status in ('2', '6')
     group by sw.patient_id, sw.visit_id
        ) sw
               on ttt.patient_id = sw.patient_id
              and ttt.visit_id = sw.visit_id

        where ttt.discharge_date_time >= to_date('2021-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
          and ttt.discharge_date_time <  to_date('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
          and nvl(sw.swsj, ttt.discharge_date_time) is not null
          and ttt.admission_date_time is not null
          and nvl(sw.swsj, ttt.discharge_date_time) >= ttt.admission_date_time
          and nvl(sw.swsj, ttt.discharge_date_time) <  ttt.admission_date_time + 1
    ) q
)
where rn = 1

V_EMR_ADMISSION_DIAGNOSIS.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_ADMISSION_DIAGNOSIS" ("ID", "ADMISSION_ID", "PRI_DIA_MARK", "DIAGNOSIS_TYPE_CODE", "DIAGNOSIS_TYPE_NAME", "DISEASE_CODE", "DISEASE", "DIAGNOSIS_NO", "DIAGNOSIS_BASIS", "DIAGNOSIS_DATE", "DOCTOR_ID_NUM", "DOCTOR_NAME", "DEP_CODE", "DEP_NAME", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "NAME", "SEX_CODE", "ID_NUM", "LOCAL_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "LOCAL_DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "DIAG_DOC_CERTIFICATE_NO") AS 
  select substr(
           nvl('49557032X'||'|'||
               nvl(to_char(t.patient_id), '-')||'|'||
               nvl(to_char(t.visit_id), '-')||'|'||
               nvl(to_char(t.diagnosis_type), '-')||'|'||
               nvl(to_char(t.diagnosis_no), '-'), '-'),
           1,
           100
       ) as ID,--  内码  是 主键

       substr(
           nvl(to_char(t.patient_id), '-')||'|'||nvl(to_char(t.visit_id), '-'),
           1,
           20
       ) as ADMISSION_ID,--  本次住院标识号 是 某一次住院唯一标识号

       '2' as PRI_DIA_MARK,--  中医/西医诊断标志 是

       case
           when t.diagnosis_type = '2' and to_char(t.diagnosis_no) = '1' then '1'
           when t.diagnosis_type = '2' then '2'
           else '3'
       end as DIAGNOSIS_TYPE_CODE,--疾病诊断类型代码  是 1：主要诊断 2;初步诊断 3：其他诊断

       case
           when t.diagnosis_type = '2' and to_char(t.diagnosis_no) = '1' then '主要诊断'
           when t.diagnosis_type = '2' then '初步诊断'
           else '其他诊断'
       end as DIAGNOSIS_TYPE_NAME,-- 疾病诊断类型名称  是

       substr(
           nvl(
               nullif(trim(diag_dict.std_code), ''),
               nvl(nullif(trim(to_char(t.diagnosis_code)), ''), '-')
           ),
           1,
           12
       ) as DISEASE_CODE,--  疾病诊断代码  是

       substr(
           nvl(
               nullif(trim(diag_dict.std_name), ''),
               nvl(nullif(trim(to_char(t.diagnosis_desc)), ''), '-')
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as DISEASE,-- 疾病诊断名称  是

       substr(
           nvl(nullif(trim(to_char(t.diagnosis_no)), ''), '-'),
           1,
           1
       ) as DIAGNOSIS_NO,--  诊断序号  是 主诊断为1其它依次排序赋值

       substr(
           nvl(nullif(trim('-'), ''), '-'),
           1,
           4000
       ) as DIAGNOSIS_BASIS,-- 最高诊断依据  是

       cast(
           nvl(t.diagnosis_date, t1.admission_date_time)
           as date
       ) as DIAGNOSIS_DATE,--  诊断日期  是

       substr(
           nvl(
               nullif(
                   trim(
                       (select yg.id_no
                          from his.staff_dict yg
                         where yg.emp_no = t1.doctor_in_charge
                           and rownum = 1)
                   ),
                   ''
               ),
               '-'
           ),
           1,
           18
       ) as DOCTOR_ID_NUM,-- 诊断医师身份证号    诊断医师的身份证号

       substr(
           nvl(
               nullif(
                   trim(
                       (select yg.name
                          from his.staff_dict yg
                         where yg.emp_no = t1.doctor_in_charge
                           and rownum = 1)
                   ),
                   ''
               ),
               '-'
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as DOCTOR_NAME,-- 诊断医师姓名  是 诊断医师的姓名

       substr(
           nvl(
               nullif(
                   trim(
                       (select ks.qmpt_code
                          from his.dept_dict ks
                         where ks.dept_code = nvl(t1.dept_discharge_from, t1.dept_admission_to)
                           and rownum = 1)
                   ),
                   ''
               ),
               nvl(nullif(trim(nvl(t1.dept_discharge_from, t1.dept_admission_to)), ''), '-')
           ),
           1,
           20
       ) as DEP_CODE,--  科室代码  是 按照平台值域填写

       substr(
           nvl(
               nullif(
                   trim(
                       (select ks.qmpt_name
                          from his.dept_dict ks
                         where ks.dept_code = nvl(t1.dept_discharge_from, t1.dept_admission_to)
                           and rownum = 1)
                   ),
                   ''
               ),
               nvl(
                   nullif(
                       trim(
                           (select ks.dept_name
                              from his.dept_dict ks
                             where ks.dept_code = nvl(t1.dept_discharge_from, t1.dept_admission_to)
                               and rownum = 1)
                       ),
                       ''
                   ),
                   '-'
               )
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as DEP_NAME,--  科室名称  是

       '370104' as DISTRICT_CODE,-- 所属行政区划  是 按机构所在的行政区划（区县）

       'INSERT' as EXCHANGE_TYPE,-- 交换类型  是 INSERT：向平台传新数据时 UPDATE：向平台更新某条数据时 DELETE：从平台删除某条数据时 ADDHIS:向平台补充历史遗漏数据

       cast(systimestamp as timestamp) as SYSTEM_TIME,-- 数据上传时间戳 是 按照当前时间上传

       '49557032X' as ORG_CODE,--  医院组织机构代码  是

       '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,--  医院名称  是

       substr(
           nvl(nullif(trim(t2.name), ''), '-'),
           1,
           50
       ) as NAME,--  患者姓名  是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项

       substr(
           nvl(
               nullif(
                   trim(decode(t2.sex, '男', '1', '女', '2', '未知', '0', '9')),
                   ''
               ),
               '9'
           ),
           1,
           1
       ) as SEX_CODE,--  患者性别代码  是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项，值域：0未知，1男，2女，9不明

       substr(
           nvl(nullif(trim(t2.id_no), ''), '000000000000000000'),
           1,
           18
       ) as ID_NUM,--  患者身份证件号码  是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项，全部身份证件号码填写到该字段

       substr(
           nvl(nullif(trim(t.diagnosis_code), ''), '-'),
           1,
           100
       ) as LOCAL_DIAGNOSIS_CODE,--  机构内部诊断编码  是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项

       substr(
           nvl(nullif(trim(t.diagnosis_desc), ''), '-'),
           1,
           100
       ) as LOCAL_DIAGNOSIS_NAME,--  机构内部诊断名称  是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项

       substr(
           nvl(
               nullif(
                   trim(
                       (select yg.practice_cert_code
                          from doc_register_emp_match yg
                         where yg.emp_no = t1.doctor_in_charge
                           and rownum = 1)
                   ),
                   ''
               ),
               '-'
           ),
           1,
           100
       ) as DIAG_DOC_CERTIFICATE_NO -- 诊断医生执业证书编号  是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项

from his.diagnosis t
left join his.pat_visit t1
       on t.patient_id = t1.patient_id
      and t.visit_id = t1.visit_id
left join his.pat_master_index t2
       on t.patient_id = t2.patient_id
left join (
        select trim(to_char(院标编码)) as local_code,
               max(nullif(trim(to_char(国标编码)), '')) as std_code,
               max(nullif(trim(to_char(国标名称)), '')) as std_name
          from cda.cda_dictionary
         where 字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
           and 系统标识 = 'HIS'
           and trim(to_char(院标编码)) is not null
         group by trim(to_char(院标编码))
       ) diag_dict
       on diag_dict.local_code = trim(to_char(t.diagnosis_code))
where t1.discharge_date_time >= to_date('2021-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
  and t1.discharge_date_time <  to_date('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
  and t.diagnosis_type = '2'

V_EMR_ADMISSION_RECORD.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_ADMISSION_RECORD" ("ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "ADMISSION_NUM", "ADMISSION_COUNT", "ADMISSION_ID", "NAME", "SEX_CODE", "SEX_NAME", "BORN_DATE", "AGE", "AGE_MONTH", "AGE_DAY", "AGE_HOUR", "OTHER_ID_TYPE", "OTHER_ID_TYPE_NAME", "OTHER_ID_NUM", "ID_NUM", "NATION_CODE", "NATION_NAME", "MARITAL_STATUS_CODE", "MARITAL_STATUS_NAME", "BORN_PLACE", "PROVINCE", "CITY", "COUNTY", "TOWN", "VILLAGE", "HOUSE_NUM", "OCCUPATION_CODE", "OCCUPATION_NAME", "WORKING_ORG", "ADMISSION_DATE", "RECORD_TIME", "CHIEF_COMPLAINT", "PRESENT_ILLNESS", "PAST_HISTORY", "PERSONAL_HISTORY", "MARITAL_HISTORY", "FAMILY_HISTORY", "INFECTION_HISTORY", "VACCINATION_HISTORY", "SURGERY_HISTORY", "BT_HISTORY", "ALLERGY_HISTORY", "MENSTRUATION_HISTORY", "THERAPEUTIC_TREATMENT", "FOUR_DIAGNOSIS", "SIGNS", "SPECIAL_EXAM", "DEP_CODE", "DEP_NAME", "HOS_DEP_NAME", "HOS_DEP_CODE", "DOCTOR_NAME", "DOCTOR_CODE", "WARD", "SICKBED_NUM", "REPRESENTOR_NAME", "LINKMAN_RELATION_CODE", "LINKMAN_RELATION_NAME", "IS_RELIABLE", "ATTENDING_DOCTOR_NAME", "ATTENDING_DOCTOR_CODE", "CHIEF_DOCTOR_NAME", "CHIEF_DOCTOR_CODE", "SIGNATURE_DATE", "IS_INFECTIOUS", "INPATIENT_TIMES", "CASE_NUM", "ADMISSION_TYPE_CODE", "ADMISSION_TYPE_NAME", "CITIZEN_ID", "EFFECTIVE_TIME", "STATUS", "CREATED_AT", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "DEI", "NODE_CODE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "CZRK_ID", "WEIGHT", "TEMPERATURE", "BREATHING_RATE", "PULSE_RATE", "PRESSURE_H", "PRESSURE_L", "PHYSICAL_CHECK", "BED_CODE", "DOC_ID_NUM", "IN_HOS_ORG_CODE", "IN_HOS_ORG_NAME", "ADMISSION_BILL_DATE", "REGISTRATION_NUMBER", "IS_BMIDO", "CAMPUS_CODE", "CAMPUS_NAME", "SOCIAL_ID", "INSU_TYPE_CODE", "INSU_TYPE_DESC", "ADM_WAY_CODE", "ADM_WAY_NAME") AS 
  select '49557032X'||'|'||t.patient_id||'|'||t.visit_id as ID,--  内码  是 机构编码+唯一主键
       '49557032X' as  ORG_CODE,--  医院组织机构代码  是 医疗机构编码
       '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,--  医院名称  是
       pmi.inp_no as ADMISSION_NUM,-- 住院号--患者 是 住院号不能为空
    t.visit_id    ADMISSION_COUNT ,--住院次
       t.patient_id||'|'||t.visit_id   as ADMISSION_ID,--  本次住院标识号--这次住院 是 某一次住院唯一标识号
       pmi.name as NAME,--  姓名  是
       decode(pmi.sex,'男','1','女','2','未知','0','9') as SEX_CODE,--  性别代码  是 值域：0未知，1男，2女，9不明
       decode(pmi.sex,'男','男','女','女','未知','未知','不明') as SEX_NAME,--  性别  是 请按照医院内部数据填写
       pmi.date_of_birth as BORN_DATE,-- 出生日期  是 字符型改为时间类型
      CASE
    WHEN pmi.date_of_birth IS NOT NULL
     AND t.admission_date_time IS NOT NULL
    THEN GREATEST(TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(t.admission_date_time, pmi.date_of_birth) / 12), 0)
    ELSE NULL
END AS AGE,

CASE
    WHEN pmi.date_of_birth IS NOT NULL
     AND t.admission_date_time IS NOT NULL
     AND MONTHS_BETWEEN(t.admission_date_time, pmi.date_of_birth) < 12
    THEN GREATEST(TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(t.admission_date_time, pmi.date_of_birth)), 0)
    ELSE 0
END AS AGE_MONTH,

CASE
    WHEN pmi.date_of_birth IS NOT NULL
     AND t.admission_date_time IS NOT NULL
     AND MONTHS_BETWEEN(t.admission_date_time, pmi.date_of_birth) < 1
    THEN GREATEST(TRUNC(t.admission_date_time - pmi.date_of_birth), 0)
    ELSE 0
END AS AGE_DAY,

CASE
    WHEN pmi.date_of_birth IS NOT NULL
     AND t.admission_date_time IS NOT NULL
     AND (t.admission_date_time - pmi.date_of_birth) < 1
    THEN GREATEST(TRUNC(24 * (t.admission_date_time - pmi.date_of_birth)), 1)
    ELSE 0
END AS AGE_HOUR,


       nvl((select zd.国标编码 from cda.cda_dictionary zd where zd.字典名称='身份证件类型代码' and zd.院标编码=pmi.ID_TYPE),'99') as OTHER_ID_TYPE,-- 身份证件类别代码  是 按照平台的值域进行填
