        ), '(病毒性肝炎|结核|新冠肺炎|传染病史[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*有)') THEN '1'
         ELSE ''
       END as IS_INFECTIOUS,-- 患者传染性标志
       t.visit_id as INPATIENT_TIMES,-- 住院次数  是 必须为正整数
       pmi.inp_no as CASE_NUM,--  病案号 是
       nvl((select zd.国标编码 from cda.cda_dictionary zd where zd.字典名称='入院途径代码' and zd.院标编码=pmi.PATIENT_CLASS),'9') as ADMISSION_TYPE_CODE,-- 入院途径代码  是
       nvl((select zd.国标名称 from cda.cda_dictionary zd where zd.字典名称='入院途径代码' and zd.院标编码=pmi.PATIENT_CLASS),'其他') as ADMISSION_TYPE_NAME,-- 入院途径  是
       pmi.id_no as CITIZEN_ID,--  个人内码
      CASE
    WHEN SUBSTR(
           REPLACE(REPLACE(
             REGEXP_SUBSTR(
               DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t4.段落内容, 1000, 1),
               '记录[[:space:]]*日期[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([0-9]{4}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[[:space:]]+[0-9]{1,2}:[0-9]{2})',
               1, 1, 'n', 1
             ),
           '/', '-'), '.', '-'),
         1, 16) IS NOT NULL
     AND REGEXP_LIKE(
           SUBSTR(
             REPLACE(REPLACE(
               REGEXP_SUBSTR(
                 DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t4.段落内容, 1000, 1),
                 '记录[[:space:]]*日期[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([0-9]{4}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[[:space:]]+[0-9]{1,2}:[0-9]{2})',
                 1, 1, 'n', 1
               ),
             '/', '-'), '.', '-'),
           1, 16),
           '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{1,2}-[0-9]{1,2}[[:space:]]+([01]?[0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$'
         )
    THEN TO_DATE(
           SUBSTR(
             REPLACE(REPLACE(
               REGEXP_SUBSTR(
                 DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t4.段落内容, 1000, 1),
                 '记录[[:space:]]*日期[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([0-9]{4}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[[:space:]]+[0-9]{1,2}:[0-9]{2})',
                 1, 1, 'n', 1
               ),
             '/', '-'), '.', '-'),
           1, 16),
           'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi'
         )
    ELSE t.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME
END     as EFFECTIVE_TIME,--  活动发生时间
       '1' as STATUS,--  卡片状态
       SYSDATE as CREATED_AT,--  创建时间
       '370104' as DISTRICT_CODE,-- 所属行政区划  是 按机构所在的行政区划（区县）
       'INSERT' as EXCHANGE_TYPE,-- 交换类型  是 INSERT：向平台传新数据时 UPDATE：向平台更新某条数据时 DELETE：从平台删除某条数据时 ADDHIS：向平台补充历史遗漏数据
       '' as DEI,-- 数据交换标识符
       '' as NODE_CODE,-- 节点标识符
       sysdate as SYSTEM_TIME,-- 数据上传时间戳 是 填写数据上传时间
       pmi.id_no as CZRK_ID,-- 常住人口ID
       TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t4.段落内容, 1000,
            CASE
                WHEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体格检查', 1, 1) > 0 THEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体格检查', 1, 1)
                WHEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体   格   检   查', 1, 1) > 0 THEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体   格   检   查', 1, 1)
                WHEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体 格 检 查', 1, 1) > 0 THEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体 格 检 查', 1, 1)
                ELSE 1
            END
        ),
         '(体重|WT|Wt|weight)[[:space:]]*[:：]?[[:space:]]*([0-9]{1,3}([.][0-9]+)?)',
         1,1,'in',2)) as WEIGHT,--  体重（kg）
       TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t4.段落内容, 1000,
            CASE
                WHEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体格检查', 1, 1) > 0 THEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体格检查', 1, 1)
                WHEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体   格   检   查', 1, 1) > 0 THEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体   格   检   查', 1, 1)
                WHEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体 格 检 查', 1, 1) > 0 THEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体 格 检 查', 1, 1)
                ELSE 1
            END
        ),
         'T[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([0-9]{1,2}([.][0-9]+)?)',
         1,1,'in',1)) as TEMPERATURE,-- 体温（℃）
       TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t4.段落内容, 1000,
            CASE
                WHEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体格检查', 1, 1) > 0 THEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体格检查', 1, 1)
                WHEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体   格   检   查', 1, 1) > 0 THEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体   格   检   查', 1, 1)
                WHEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体 格 检 查', 1, 1) > 0 THEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体 格 检 查', 1, 1)
                ELSE 1
            END
        ),
         '(^|[[:space:]])R[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*R?([0-9]{1,3})',
         1,1,'in',2)) as BREATHING_RATE,--  呼吸频率?
       TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t4.段落内容, 1000,
            CASE
                WHEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体格检查', 1, 1) > 0 THEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体格检查', 1, 1)
                WHEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体   格   检   查', 1, 1) > 0 THEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体   格   检   查', 1, 1)
                WHEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体 格 检 查', 1, 1) > 0 THEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体 格 检 查', 1, 1)
                ELSE 1
            END
        ),
         '(^|[[:space:]])P[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([0-9]{1,3})',
         1,1,'in',2)) as PULSE_RATE,--  脉率（次/分）
       TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t4.段落内容, 1000,
            CASE
                WHEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体格检查', 1, 1) > 0 THEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体格检查', 1, 1)
                WHEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体   格   检   查', 1, 1) > 0 THEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体   格   检   查', 1, 1)
                WHEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体 格 检 查', 1, 1) > 0 THEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体 格 检 查', 1, 1)
                ELSE 1
            END
        ),
         'B[pP][[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([0-9]{2,3})[[:space:]]*/[[:space:]]*[0-9]{2,3}',
         1,1,'in',1)) as PRESSURE_H,--  收缩压（mmHg）
       TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t4.段落内容, 1000,
            CASE
                WHEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体格检查', 1, 1) > 0 THEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体格检查', 1, 1)
                WHEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体   格   检   查', 1, 1) > 0 THEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体   格   检   查', 1, 1)
                WHEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体 格 检 查', 1, 1) > 0 THEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体 格 检 查', 1, 1)
                ELSE 1
            END
        ),
         'B[pP][[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*[0-9]{2,3}[[:space:]]*/[[:space:]]*([0-9]{2,3})',
         1,1,'in',1)) as PRESSURE_L,--  舒张压（mmHg）
       NVL(
         NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTR(REGEXP_SUBSTR(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t4.段落内容, 1000,
            CASE
                WHEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体格检查', 1, 1) > 0 THEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体格检查', 1, 1)
                WHEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体   格   检   查', 1, 1) > 0 THEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体   格   检   查', 1, 1)
                WHEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体 格 检 查', 1, 1) > 0 THEN DBMS_LOB.INSTR(t4.段落内容, '体 格 检 查', 1, 1)
                ELSE 1
            END
        ),
           '体[[:space:]]*格[[:space:]]*检[[:space:]]*查[[:space:]]*(.*?)(专科情况|专科检查|辅[[:space:]]*助[[:space:]]*检[[:space:]]*查|初步诊断|入院诊断)',
           1,1,'n',1),1,1000)),''),
         '-'
       ) as PHYSICAL_CHECK,--  体格检查
       nvl(t.DISCHARGE_BED_NO,(select aa.bed_no from his.pats_in_hospital aa where aa.patient_id=t.patient_id and aa.visit_id=t.visit_id)) as BED_CODE,--  床位代码  是
       (select id_no from his.staff_dict e where e.emp_no = t.ATTENDING_DOCTOR) as DOC_ID_NUM,--  医师身份证号码
       '49557032X' as IN_HOS_ORG_CODE,-- 入院医疗机构编号
       '山东省第二人民医院' as IN_HOS_ORG_NAME,-- 入院医疗机构名称
t.Admission_Date_Time as ADMISSION_BILL_DATE,-- 开具住院票时间 是 yyyymmdd hh24miss
'49557032X' as REGISTRATION_NUMBER,-- 医疗机构执业许可证登记号  是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项
'1' as IS_BMIDO,--  是否基本医保定点机构  是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项
'49557032X' as CAMPUS_CODE,-- 院区代码  是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项
'山东省第二人民医院' as CAMPUS_NAME,-- 院区名称  是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项
pmi.id_no as SOCIAL_ID,-- 社保卡号    通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项
nvl((select zd.国标编码 from cda.cda_dictionary zd where zd.字典名称='医疗付费方式代码' and zd.院标名称=t.CHARGE_TYPE),'99') as INSU_TYPE_CODE,--  医保类别编码  是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项
nvl((select zd.国标名称 from cda.cda_dictionary zd where zd.字典名称='医疗付费方式代码' and zd.院标名称=t.CHARGE_TYPE),'其他') as INSU_TYPE_DESC,--  医保类别名称  是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项
nvl((select zd.国标编码 from cda.cda_dictionary zd where zd.字典名称='入院途径代码' and zd.院标编码=pmi.PATIENT_CLASS),'9') as ADM_WAY_CODE,--  入院途径编码  是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项
nvl((select zd.国标名称 from cda.cda_dictionary zd where zd.字典名称='入院途径代码' and zd.院标编码=pmi.PATIENT_CLASS),'其他') as ADM_WAY_NAME -- 入院途径名称  是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项
from his.pat_visit t
LEFT JOIN his.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi ON t.PATIENT_ID = pmi.PATIENT_ID
left join mtl.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX tt on tt.P_INPATIENT_NO=pmi.inp_no and tt.P_INPATIENT_TIMES=t.visit_id --患者信息
LEFT JOIN mtl.EPR_INPATIENT t1 on tt.UHID=t1.UHID
left join mtl.EMRSD34 T3 ON T3.段落编号=T1.ID
Join MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT t4 On t4.UHID=tt.UHID and t4.段落编号=T1.ID

where  (t1.DOC_TYPE_NAME like '%入院记录%' or t1.doc_title  like '%入院记录%' )   and t.discharge_date_time>=to_date('2021-01-01','yyyy-mm-dd')
and t.discharge_date_time<to_date('2025-01-01','yyyy-mm-dd')

V_EMR_ADMISSION_RECORD_EXAM.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_ADMISSION_RECORD_EXAM" ("ID", "AR_ID", "SN", "EXAM_TYPE", "EXAM_TYPENAME", "EXAM_TIME", "HOS_ITEM_NAME", "HOS_ITEM_CODE", "EXAM_TIME_NAME", "EXAM_TIME_CODE", "EXAM_RESULT", "CREATED_AT", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME") AS 
  select substr(
           '49557032X' || '|' ||
           x.patient_id || '|' ||
           x.visit_id || '|' ||
           x.exam_no || '|' ||
           x.sn,
           1,
           100
       ) as ID,-- 内码 是 主键

       substr(
           '49557032X' || '|' || x.patient_id || '|' || x.visit_id,
           1,
           100
       ) as AR_ID,-- 入院记录内码 是，必须与 EMR_ADMISSION_RECORD.ID 保持一致

       cast(x.sn as number(3)) as SN,-- 序号 是，必须是整数

       '2' as EXAM_TYPE,-- 检查类型 是 体格检查

       '辅助检查' as EXAM_TYPENAME,-- 检查类型名称 是

       cast(x.exam_date_time as date) as EXAM_TIME,-- 检查时间 是

       substr(nvl(nullif(trim(x.exam_item), ''), '-'), 1, 100) as HOS_ITEM_NAME,-- 院内检查项目名称 是

       substr(nvl(nullif(trim(x.exam_item_code), ''), '-'), 1, 50) as HOS_ITEM_CODE,-- 院内检查项目代码 是

       substr(
           nvl(
               (
                   select max(m.value_domain_name)
                     from CDA_EXAM_ITEM_MAP m
                    where m.category_code = 'CV04.30.009'
                      and m.hospital_code = x.exam_item_code
               ),
               nvl(nullif(trim(x.exam_item), ''), '-')
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as EXAM_TIME_NAME,-- 检查项目名称 是

       substr(
           nvl(
               (
                   select max(m.value_domain_code)
                     from CDA_EXAM_ITEM_MAP m
                    where m.category_code = 'CV04.30.009'
                      and m.hospital_code = x.exam_item_code
               ),
               nvl(nullif(trim(x.exam_item_code), ''), '-')
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as EXAM_TIME_CODE,-- 检查项目编码 是

       substr(
           nvl(
               nullif(
                   trim(
                       regexp_replace(
                           replace(x.jcbg, '$nbsp$', ' '),
                           '[[:space:]]+',
                           ' '
                       )
                   ),
                   ''
               ),
               '-'
           ),
           1,
           4000
       ) as EXAM_RESULT,-- 检查结果 是

       cast(null as timestamp) as CREATED_AT,-- 创建时间，平台自动生成，不需要填写

       '370104' as DISTRICT_CODE,-- 所属行政区划 是

       'INSERT' as EXCHANGE_TYPE,-- 交换类型 是

       cast(systimestamp as timestamp) as SYSTEM_TIME,-- 数据上传时间戳 是

       '49557032X' as ORG_CODE,-- 医院组织机构代码 是

       '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME-- 医院名称 是

from (
        select y.patient_id,
               y.visit_id,
               y.exam_no,
               y.exam_date_time,
               y.exam_item,
               y.exam_item_code,
               y.jcbg,
               y.sn
          from (
                select t.patient_id,
                       t.visit_id,
                       t.exam_no,
                       t.exam_date_time,
                       t1.exam_item,
                       t1.exam_item_code,

                       substr(
                           trim(
                               nvl(nullif(trim(r.impression), ''), '') ||

                               case
                                   when nullif(trim(r.description), '') is not null
                                    and nvl(trim(r.description), '-') <> nvl(trim(r.impression), '-')
                                   then ' ' || trim(r.description)
                                   else ''
                               end ||

                               case
                                   when nullif(trim(r.recommendation), '') is not null
                                    and nvl(trim(r.recommendation), '-') <> nvl(trim(r.impression), '-')
                                    and nvl(trim(r.recommendation), '-') <> nvl(trim(r.description), '-')
                                   then ' ' || trim(r.recommendation)
                                   else ''
                               end
                           ),
                           1,
                           4000
                       ) as jcbg,

                       row_number() over (
                           partition by t.patient_id, t.visit_id
                           order by t.exam_date_time,
                                    t.exam_no,
                                    nvl(t1.exam_item_code, '-'),
                                    nvl(t1.exam_item, '-')
                       ) as sn

                  from his.exam_master t

                  inner join his.exam_items t1
                          on t.exam_no = t1.exam_no

                  inner join his.pat_visit pv
                          on pv.patient_id = t.patient_id
                         and to_char(pv.visit_id) = to_char(t.visit_id)

                  inner join his.exam_report r
                          on r.exam_no = t.exam_no

                 where t.patient_id is not null
                   and t.visit_id is not null
                   and t.exam_no is not null
                   and t.exam_date_time is not null
                   and pv.discharge_date_time >= to_date('2021-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
                   and pv.discharge_date_time <  to_date('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
                   and (
                           nullif(trim(r.description), '') is not null
                        or nullif(trim(r.impression), '') is not null
                        or nullif(trim(r.recommendation), '') is not null
                       )
               ) y
         where y.sn <= 999
           and nullif(trim(y.jcbg), '') is not null
     ) x

V_EMR_ANESTHESIA_RECORD.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_ANESTHESIA_RECORD" ("ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "PATIENT_TYPE", "VISTING_NUM", "APPLY_NUM", "DEPT_CODE", "DEPT_NAME", "WARD_NAME", "EORD_NUM", "SICKBED_NUM", "OPERA_ROOM_NUM", "NAME", "SEX_CODE", "SEX_NAME", "AGE", "WEIGHT", "OPERA_CODE", "OPERA_NAME", "OPERA_POSITION_CODE", "OPERA_POSITION_NAME", "ANES_METHOD_CODE", "ANES_METHOD_NAME", "OPERA_WINDPIPE", "BREATH_TYPE", "BREATH_TYPE_NAME", "ANES_NOTE", "ANES_MERGE_CODE", "DIAGNOSIS_NOTE", "PIER_NOTE", "SHRINK_PRESSURE", "DIASTOLE_PRESSURE", "TEMPERATURE", "HEART_RATE", "PULSE_RATE", "RESPIRATORY_RATE", "SIGNATURE_EFFECT", "BEFORE_SIGNATURE_DRUG", "OPERA_START_DATE", "ANES_START_DATE", "ANES_END_DATE", "OPERA_END_DATE", "OUT_DEPT_DATE", "OPERAER_NAME", "PACU_FLAG", "PACU_IN_DATE", "PACU_OUT_DATE", "OPERA_TRANSFUSION", "OUT_BLOOD_ML", "PATIENT_TO", "ANES_DOC_NAME", "SIGNATURE_DATE", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME") AS 
  select substr('49557032X'||'|'||b.patient_id||'|'||b.visit_id||'|'||b.oper_id,1,100) as ID,--  内码  是 唯一主键

       '49557032X' as ORG_CODE,--  组织机构代码  是 医疗机构组织机构代码

       '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,--  组织机构名称  是 医疗机构组织机构名称

       '2' as PATIENT_TYPE,--  病人类型  是 1:门急诊 2：住院

       b.patient_id||'|'||b.visit_id as VISTING_NUM,-- 就诊唯一标识号 是 门诊或者住院唯一标识号


                   b.PATIENT_ID||b.VISIT_ID||b.OPER_ID                 as APPLY_NUM,-- 电子申请单编号 是 手术申请单编号

       substr(
         nvl(
           (select hd.qmpt_code
              from his.dept_dict hd
             where hd.dept_code = v.dept_admission_to
               and rownum = 1),
           v.dept_admission_to
         ),
         1,
         20
       ) as DEPT_CODE,-- 科室代码    按照平台值域填写

       substr(
         nvl(
           (select hd.qmpt_name
              from his.dept_dict hd
             where hd.dept_code = v.dept_admission_to
               and rownum = 1),
           (select hd.dept_name
              from his.dept_dict hd
             where hd.dept_code = v.dept_admission_to
               and rownum = 1)
         ),
         1,
         50
       ) as DEPT_NAME,-- 科室名称  是 患者在医疗机构就诊的科室名称

       substr(
         nvl(
           (select hd.dept_name
              from his.dept_dict hd
             where hd.dept_code = v.discharge_ward_code
               and rownum = 1),
           v.discharge_ward_code
         ),
         1,
         50
       ) as WARD_NAME,-- 病区名称    患者当前所在病区的名称

       cast(null as varchar2(10)) as EORD_NUM,--  病房号   患者住院期间，所住病房对应的编号

    when trim(

from sm.med_operation_master a

left join sm.med_operation_schedule a1
  on a.patient_id = a1.patient_id
 and a.visit_id   = a1.visit_id
 and a.oper_id    = a1.oper_id

left join sm.med_pat_master_index b
  on a.patient_id = b.patient_id

left join sm.med_anesthesia_plan e3
  on a.patient_id = e3.patient_id
 and a.visit_id   = e3.visit_id
 and a.oper_id    = e3.oper_id

  left join (select * from (
select o.*,
       row_number() over (
           partition by
               o.patient_id,
               o.visit_id,
               trunc(o.operating_date)
           order by
               o.operation_scale desc nulls last,
               case
                   when to_char(o.op_primary) = '1' then 1
                   else 0
               end desc,
               o.operation_no asc nulls last
       ) as rn
from his.operation o  )  where rn=1)  o
               on a.patient_id = o.patient_id
              and a.visit_id = o.visit_id
            and to_char(o.operating_date,'yyyy-mm-dd')=to_char( nvl(a.start_date_time,a.SCHEDULED_DATE_TIME),'yyyy-mm-dd')

left join his.pat_visit p
  on a.patient_id = p.patient_id
 and a.visit_id   = p.visit_id

left join his.pat_master_index pmi
  on a.patient_id = pmi.patient_id

left join (
    select d.patient_id,
           d.visit_id,
           d.diagnosis_code,
           d.diagnosis_desc,
           row_number() over(
             partition by d.patient_id, d.visit_id
             order by d.diagnosis_no
           ) as rn
      from his.diagnosis d
     where d.diagnosis_type = '3'
) dd
  on dd.rn = 1
 and a.patient_id = dd.patient_id
 and a.visit_id   = dd.visit_id
left join (

           max(case when sh.item_name = '麻醉术后访视.穿刺点头疼1' then sh.item_value end) as puncture_headache1,
           max(case when sh.item_name = '麻醉术后访视.穿刺点头疼2' then sh.item_value end) as puncture_headache2,

           max(case when sh.item_name = '麻醉术后访视.腰麻后头疼1' then sh.item_value end) as spinal_headache1,
           max(case when sh.item_name = '麻醉术后访视.腰麻后头疼2' then sh.item_value end) as spinal_headache2,

           max(case when sh.item_name = '麻醉术后访视.镇痛不良反应1' then sh.item_value end) as analgesia_bad1,
           max(case when sh.item_name = '麻醉术后访视.镇痛不良反应2' then sh.item_value end) as analgesia_bad2,

           max(case when sh.item_name = '麻醉术后访视.疼痛评分分数' then sh.item_value end) as pain_score_num,

           max(case when sh.item_name = '麻醉术后访视.镇痛方式1' then sh.item_value end) as analgesia_mode1,
           max(case when sh.item_name = '麻醉术后访视.镇痛方式2' then sh.item_value end) as analgesia_mode2,
           max(case when sh.item_name = '麻醉术后访视.使用镇痛泵' then sh.item_value end) as analgesic_pump,

           max(case when sh.item_name = '麻醉术后访视.麻醉效果' then sh.item_value end) as anes_effect,
           max(case when sh.item_name = '麻醉术后访视.麻醉效果原因' then sh.item_value end) as anes_effect_reason,

           max(case when sh.item_name = '麻醉术后访视.处理记录1' then sh.item_value end) as deal1,
           max(case when sh.item_name = '麻醉术后访视.处理记录2' then sh.item_value end) as deal2,
           max(case when sh.item_name = '麻醉术后访视.处理记录3' then sh.item_value end) as deal3,

           max(case when sh.item_name = '麻醉术后访视.签署时间' then sh.item_value end) as sign_time

      from sm.med_custom_data sh
     where sh.item_name like '麻醉术后访视.%'
     group by sh.patient_id, sh.visit_id, sh.oper_id
) postv
  on postv.patient_id = a.patient_id
 and postv.visit_id   = a.visit_id
 and postv.oper_id    = a.oper_id
where nvl(to_char(a.oper_status),'0') <> '0'
  and a1.patient_id is not null and p.discharge_date_time >= to_date('2021-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
  and p.discharge_date_time <  to_date('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') and  nvl(a.done_date_time, nvl(a.end_date_time, nvl(a.anes_end_time, a.start_date_time))) is not null
and      nvl( nvl(   (select max(cd.国标名称)

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_ANES_RECORD_BLOOD" ("ID", "APPLY_NUM", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "START_DATE", "END_DATE", "IS_AUTOLOGOUS_BLOOD", "TRANSFUSION_TYPE_CODE", "TRANSFUSION_ML", "TRANSFUSION_UNIT", "BT_REACTION_MARK", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME") AS 
  select substr(
         '49557032X'
         || '|' || b.patient_id
         || '|' || b.visit_id
         || '|' || b.oper_id
         || '|' || b.blood_item,
         1,
         100
       ) as ID,-- 内码 是 唯一主键

       b.patient_id || b.visit_id || b.oper_id as APPLY_NUM,-- 电子申请单编号 是 手术申请单编号

       '49557032X' as ORG_CODE,-- 组织机构代码 是 医疗机构组织机构代码

       '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,-- 组织机构名称 是 医疗机构组织机构名称

       cast(
         nvl(
           b.start_date_time,
           nvl(b.anes_start_time, nvl(b.in_date_time, b.scheduled_date_time))
         ) as date
       ) as START_DATE,-- 输血开始日期时间 是 YYYYMMDD HHMISS

       cast(
         nvl(
           b.end_date_time,
           nvl(b.anes_end_time, nvl(b.out_date_time, nvl(b.done_date_time, b.start_date_time)))
         ) as date
       ) as END_DATE,-- 输血结束日期时间 是 YYYYMMDD HHMISS

       case
         when b.blood_item in ('BLOOD_WHOLE_SELF','SELF_BLOOD','BLOOD_REUSE') then '1'
         else '0'
       end as IS_AUTOLOGOUS_BLOOD,-- 是否为自体输血 是 0否 1是

       case
         when b.blood_item = 'BLOOD_RBC'        then '13' -- 红细胞悬液
         when b.blood_item = 'BLOOD_PLASM'      then '4'  -- 血浆
         when b.blood_item = 'BLOOD_OTHER'      then '5'  -- 冷沉淀
         when b.blood_item = 'COOL_THING'       then '5'  -- 冷沉淀
         when b.blood_item = 'BLOOD_WHOLE'      then '3'  -- 血小板，按主表说明
         when b.blood_item = 'BLOOD_XB'         then '3'  -- 血小板
         when b.blood_item = 'BLOOD_WHOLE_SELF' then '9'  -- 自体血
         when b.blood_item = 'SELF_BLOOD'       then '9'  -- 自体血
         when b.blood_item = 'BLOOD_REUSE'      then '9'  -- 回收血/自体回输
         else '9'
       end as TRANSFUSION_TYPE_CODE,-- 输血品种代码 是

       case
         when b.blood_item = 'BLOOD_RBC'        then round(b.blood_qty * 200)
         when b.blood_item = 'BLOOD_WHOLE'      then round(b.blood_qty * 200)
         when b.blood_item = 'BLOOD_XB'         then round(b.blood_qty * 200)
         when b.blood_item = 'BLOOD_OTHER'      then round(b.blood_qty * 200)
         when b.blood_item = 'COOL_THING'       then round(b.blood_qty * 200)
         when b.blood_item = 'BLOOD_PLASM'      then round(b.blood_qty)
         when b.blood_item = 'BLOOD_WHOLE_SELF' then round(b.blood_qty)
         when b.blood_item = 'SELF_BLOOD'       then round(b.blood_qty)
         when b.blood_item = 'BLOOD_REUSE'      then round(b.blood_qty)
         else round(b.blood_qty)
       end as TRANSFUSION_ML,-- 输血量 是

       'mL' as TRANSFUSION_UNIT,-- 输血量计量单位 是

       '0' as BT_REACTION_MARK,-- 输血反应标志 是

       '370104' as DISTRICT_CODE,-- 行政区划 是

       'ADDHIS' as EXCHANGE_TYPE,-- 交换类型 是

       cast(systimestamp as timestamp) as SYSTEM_TIME-- 数据上传时间 是

from sm.med_operation_master
unpivot (
  blood_qty
  for blood_item in (
     blood_rbc        as 'BLOOD_RBC',
     blood_plasm      as 'BLOOD_PLASM',
     blood_other      as 'BLOOD_OTHER',
     blood_whole      as 'BLOOD_WHOLE',
     blood_xb         as 'BLOOD_XB',
     cool_thing       as 'COOL_THING',
     blood_whole_self as 'BLOOD_WHOLE_SELF',
     self_blood       as 'SELF_BLOOD',
     blood_reuse      as 'BLOOD_REUSE'
  )
) b

left join his.pat_visit v
  on v.patient_id = b.patient_id
 and v.visit_id   = b.visit_id

where nvl(to_char(b.oper_status),'0') <> '0'
  and b.blood_qty is not null
  and b.blood_qty > 0
  and nvl(b.start_date_time, nvl(b.anes_start_time, nvl(b.in_date_time, b.scheduled_date_time))) is not null
  and nvl(b.end_date_time, nvl(b.anes_end_time, nvl(b.out_date_time, nvl(b.done_date_time, b.start_date_time)))) is not null
  and v.discharge_date_time >= to_date('2021-01-01 00:00:00','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
  and v.discharge_date_time <  to_date('2025-01-01 00:00:00','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')

V_EMR_ANES_RECORD_MED.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_ANES_RECORD_MED" ("ID", "APPLY_NUM", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DRUG_TYPE", "ANES_FLAG", "DRUG_CONT", "DRUG_STARTIME", "DRUG_ENDTIME", "DRUG_NAME", "DRUG_CODE", "DRUG_ROUTE", "DRUG_FREQUENCY_CODE", "DOSAGE_UNIT", "DRUG_UNIT_DOSE", "DRUG_ALL", "DRUG_WAY_CODE", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME") AS 
  select substr(
         '49557032X'
         || '|' || b.patient_id
         || '|' || b.visit_id
         || '|' || b.oper_id
         || '|' || mae.item_no,
         1,
         100
       ) as ID,-- 内码 是 唯一主键

       b.patient_id || b.visit_id || b.oper_id as APPLY_NUM,-- 电子申请单编号 是 手术申请单编号

       '49557032X' as ORG_CODE,-- 组织机构代码 是 医疗机构组织机构代码

       '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,-- 组织机构名称 是 医疗机构组织机构名称

       '9' as DRUG_TYPE,-- 药物使用目的代码，暂按其他处理

       case
         when mae.item_class = '2' then '1'
         when regexp_like(
                nvl(mae.item_name,''),
                '丙泊酚|依托咪酯|氯胺酮|七氟烷|异氟烷|地氟烷|芬太尼|舒芬太尼|瑞芬太尼|咪达唑仑|罗库溴铵|阿曲库铵|阿屈库铵|维库溴铵|右美托咪定|利多卡因|罗哌卡因|布比卡因|丁卡因'
              )
         then '1'
         else '0'
       end as ANES_FLAG,-- 是否麻醉药物标识 是

       case
         when mae.end_date is not null
          and (
                nvl(to_char(mae.durative_indicator),'0') = '1'
             or mae.administrator like '%泵%'
             or mae.dosage_units like '%/h%'
             or mae.dosage_units like '%/min%'
          )
         then '1'
         else '0'
       end as DRUG_CONT,-- 是否术中持续用药标识 是

       cast(
         nvl(
           mae.start_time,
           nvl(b.anes_start_time, b.start_date_time)
         ) as date
       ) as DRUG_STARTIME,-- 用药开始时间 是

       case
         when mae.end_date is not null
          and (
                nvl(to_char(mae.durative_indicator),'0') = '1'
             or mae.administrator like '%泵%'
             or mae.dosage_units like '%/h%'
             or mae.dosage_units like '%/min%'
          )
         then cast(mae.end_date as date)
         else cast(null as date)
       end as DRUG_ENDTIME,-- 用药结束时间，持续用药标识为1时必填

       substr(
         regexp_replace(
           trim(nvl(mae.item_name,'-')),
           '[[:space:]]*(mg|ug|μg|g|ml|mL|%|vi)$',
           '',
           1,
           0,
           'i'
         ),
         1,
         100
       ) as DRUG_NAME,-- 药物名称 是

       substr(nvl(mae.item_code,'-'),1,50) as DRUG_CODE,-- 药品代码

       substr(
         case
           when mae.administrator = 'i.v.' then '静脉注射'
           when lower(mae.administrator) in ('ivgtt','ivggt') then '静脉滴注'
           when mae.administrator = '泵注' then '泵入'
           when mae.administrator = '吸入' then '吸入'
           when mae.administrator = '臂丛' then '神经阻滞'
           else mae.administrator
         end,
         1,
         100
       ) as DRUG_ROUTE,-- 药物用法

       'st' as DRUG_FREQUENCY_CODE,-- 药物使用频次代码

       substr(
         nvl(
           mae.dosage_units,
           regexp_substr(mae.item_spec, '(mg|ug|μg|g|ml|mL|%)[[:space:]]*$', 1, 1, 'i')
         ),
         1,
         10
       ) as DOSAGE_UNIT,-- 药物使用计量单位

       round(mae.dosage,2) as DRUG_UNIT_DOSE,-- 药物使用次剂量

       case
         when mae.end_date is not null
          and mae.start_time is not null
          and mae.end_date > mae.start_time
          and mae.dosage_units like '%/h%'
         then round(mae.dosage * ((mae.end_date - mae.start_time) * 24), 2)
         else round(mae.dosage,2)
       end as DRUG_ALL,-- 药物使用总剂量

   case
  when mae.administrator is null
    or trim(mae.administrator) in ('', '0', '30', '备用', '备注', '台上', '台上用', 'ADMINISTRATOR')
  then 9

  -- 口服、直肠、舌下
  when lower(replace(trim(mae.administrator), ' ', '')) in ('po', 'p.o.', 'o.p.', '口服')
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%口服%'
  then 1

  when trim(mae.administrator) like '%直肠%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%灌肠%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%肛管%'
  then 2

  when trim(mae.administrator) like '%舌下%' then 3

  -- 静脉注射或静脉滴注
  when lower(replace(trim(mae.administrator), ' ', '')) in
       ('i.v.', 'i.v', 'iv', 'ivgtt', 'ivggt', 'ivtt', 'ivgtt.', 'ivggt.')
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%静脉%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%滴注%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%冲管%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%冲管测压%'
  then 404

  -- 输液泵泵入
  when trim(mae.administrator) like '%泵%'
    or upper(trim(mae.administrator)) in ('TCI', 'PCA', 'PCIA', 'PCEA')
  then 700

  -- 吸入、雾化、气道相关
  when trim(mae.administrator) = '吸入'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%吸入%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%雾化%'
  then 5

  when trim(mae.administrator) like '%气管内%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) = '气管'
  then 606

  when trim(mae.administrator) like '%喷喉%' then 609

  when trim(mae.administrator) like '%滴鼻%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%喷鼻%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%鼻腔%'
  then 608

  when trim(mae.administrator) like '%滴眼%' then 607

  -- 注射细分
  when lower(replace(trim(mae.administrator), ' ', '')) in ('i.m.', 'i.m', 'im', '肌注')
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%肌注%'
  then 403

  when trim(mae.administrator) like '%皮下%' then 401

  when trim(mae.administrator) like '%皮内%' then 402

  when trim(mae.administrator) like '%鞘内%' then 405

  -- 椎管内、硬膜外、神经阻滞、区域阻滞
  when trim(mae.administrator) like '%硬膜外%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%硬外%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%腰麻%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%骶管%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%椎管%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%臂丛%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%颈丛%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%股神经%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%坐骨神经%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%隐神经%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%肋间神经%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%肋间阻滞%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%神经阻滞%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%区域阻滞%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%肌间沟%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%腋路%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%收肌管%'
    or upper(trim(mae.administrator)) = 'TAP'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%腹横肌%'
  then 601

  -- 局部用药
  when trim(mae.administrator) like '%局麻%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%局部麻醉%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%局部注射%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%局部浸润%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%浸润%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%表面%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%表麻%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%外用%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%润滑%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%喷洒%'
  then 6

  -- 腔内给药
  when trim(mae.administrator) like '%关节腔%'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%踝关节%'
  then 602

  when trim(mae.administrator) like '%胸膜%' then 603

  when trim(mae.administrator) like '%腹腔%' then 604

  when upper(trim(mae.administrator)) = 'VD'
    or trim(mae.administrator) like '%阴道%'
  then 605

  -- 不能明确归类
  else 9
end as DRUG_WAY_CODE,-- 用药途径代码     as DRUG_WAY_CODE,-- 用药途径代码

       '370104' as DISTRICT_CODE,-- 行政区划 是

       'ADDHIS' as EXCHANGE_TYPE,-- 交换类型 是

       cast(systimestamp as timestamp) as SYSTEM_TIME-- 数据上传时间 是

from sm.med_operation_master b

join sm.med_anesthesia_event mae
  on mae.patient_id = b.patient_id
 and mae.visit_id   = b.visit_id
 and mae.oper_id    = b.oper_id
 and mae.item_class in ('2','3','C')

join his.pat_visit v
  on v.patient_id = b.patient_id
 and v.visit_id   = b.visit_id

where nvl(to_char(b.oper_status),'0') <> '0'
  and mae.item_name is not null
  and mae.start_time is not null
  and mae.dosage is not null
  and mae.dosage > 0
  and v.discharge_date_time >= to_date('2021-01-01 00:00:00','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
  and v.discharge_date_time <  to_date('2025-01-01 00:00:00','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') and   substr(
         regexp_replace(
           trim(nvl(mae.item_name,'-')),
           '[[:space:]]*(mg|ug|μg|g|ml|mL|%|vi)$',
           '',
           1,
           0,
           'i'
         ),
         1,
         100
       ) is not null

V_EMR_BOFORE_OPERA_RECORD.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_BOFORE_OPERA_RECORD" ("ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "PATIENT_TYPE", "VISTING_NUM", "APPLY_NUM", "DEPT_NAME", "DEPT_CODE", "WARD_NAME", "EORD_NUM", "SICKBED_NUM", "OPERA_ROOM_NUM", "NAME", "ID_NUM", "SEX_NAME", "SEX_CODE", "AGE", "WEIGHT", "ABO_CODE", "ABO_NAME", "RH_CODE", "RH_NAME", "BEFORE_OPERA_DIAGNOSIS", "BEFORE_OPERA_DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "OPERA_CODE", "OPERA_NAME", "ANES_METHOD_CODE", "ANES_METHOD_NAME", "OPERA_DISEASE", "ATTENTION_MATTER", "MEDICAL_HISTORY", "ALLERGIES_HISTROY", "ECR_RESULT", "X_RESULT", "CT_RESULT", "B_RESULT", "MRI_RESULT", "LUNGS_RESULT", "CBC_RESULT", "URINE_RESULT", "COAGULATION_RESULT", "LIVER_RESULT", "FLESH_RESULT", "GENERAL_EXAM_RESULT", "MENTAL_STATE_CODE", "HEART_AUSCULTATE_RESULT", "BELLOWS_AUSCULTATE_RESULT", "FOUR_LIMB_RESULT", "SPINE_RESULT", "ABDOMEN_RESULT", "TRACHEA_RESULT", "TOOTH_RESULT", "SIGNATURE_ASA", "OPERA_ADVICE", "ANANSTHESIA", "ANES_DOC_NAME", "SIGNATURE_DATE", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME") AS 
  select substr('49557032X'||'|'||a.patient_id||'|'||a.visit_id||'|'||a.oper_id,1,100) as ID,--  内码  是 唯一主键

       '49557032X' as ORG_CODE,--  组织机构代码  是 医疗机构组织机构代码

       '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,--  组织机构名称  是 医疗机构组织机构名称

       '2' as PATIENT_TYPE,--  病人类型  是 1:门急诊 2：住院

       a.patient_id||'|'||a.visit_id as VISTING_NUM,-- 就诊唯一标识号 是 门诊或者住院唯一标识号

       substr(a.patient_id||a.visit_id||a.oper_id,1,20) as APPLY_NUM,-- 电子申请单编号 是 手术申请单编号

       substr(
         nvl(
           (select hd.dept_name
              from his.dept_dict hd
             where hd.dept_code = p.dept_admission_to
               and rownum = 1),
           (select hd.qmpt_name
              from his.dept_dict hd
             where hd.dept_code = p.dept_admission_to
               and rownum = 1)
         ),
         1,
         50
       ) as DEPT_NAME,-- 科室名称  是 按照医院内部名称填写

       substr(
         nvl(
           (select hd.qmpt_code
              from his.dept_dict hd
             where hd.dept_code = p.dept_admission_to
               and rownum = 1),
           p.dept_admission_to
         ),
         1,
         20
       ) as DEPT_CODE,-- 科室代码    按照平台值域填写

       substr(
         nvl(
           (select hd.dept_name
              from his.dept_dict hd
             where hd.dept_code = p.discharge_ward_code
               and rownum = 1),
           p.discharge_ward_code
         ),
         1,
         50
       ) as WARD_NAME,-- 病区名称    患者当前所在病区的名称

       cast(null as varchar2(10)) as EORD_NUM,--  病房号

       substr(p.discharge_bed_no,1,10) as SICKBED_NUM,-- 病床号

       substr(a.operating_room,1,20) as OPERA_ROOM_NUM,--  手术间编号

       substr(nvl(pmi.name,b.name),1,50) as NAME,--  患者姓名  是

       substr(nvl(pmi.id_no,b.id_no),1,18) as ID_NUM,--  身份证件号码

       decode(nvl(pmi.sex,b.sex),'男','男','女','女','未知','未知','其他') as SEX_NAME,--  性别  是 男，女，未知，其他

       decode(nvl(pmi.sex,b.sex),'男','1','女','2','未知','0','9') as SEX_CODE,--  性别代码  是 按照平台值域填写

       to_char(
         case
           when nvl(pmi.date_of_birth,b.date_of_birth) is not null
            and p.admission_date_time is not null
           then greatest(
                  trunc(months_between(p.admission_date_time, nvl(pmi.date_of_birth,b.date_of_birth)) / 12),
                  0
                )
           else null
         end
       ) as AGE,-- 年龄  是

       nvl(
         case
           when e3.weight is not null
            and regexp_like(trim(to_char(e3.weight)), '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$')
           then round(to_number(e3.weight),2)
           when p.body_weight is not null
           then round(p.body_weight,2)
           else cast(null as number(6,2))
         end,
         cast(0 as number(6,2))
       ) as WEIGHT,--  体重（kg）  是 计量单位为kg

       nvl(
         (select to_number(cd.国标编码)
            from cda.cda_dictionary cd
           where cd.字典名称 = 'ABO血型代码'
             and cd.院标名称 = p.blood_type
             and regexp_like(cd.国标编码, '^[0-9]+$')
             and rownum = 1),
         5
       ) as ABO_CODE,--  ABO血型代码

       substr(
         nvl(
           (select cd.国标名称
              from cda.cda_dictionary cd
             where cd.字典名称 = 'ABO血型代码'
               and cd.院标名称 = p.blood_type
               and rownum = 1),
           '不详'
         ),
         1,
         50
       ) as ABO_NAME,--  ABO血型名称

       nvl(
         (select to_number(cd.国标编码)
            from cda.cda_dictionary cd
           where cd.字典名称 = 'RH血型代码'
             and cd.院标名称 = p.blood_type_rh
             and regexp_like(cd.国标编码, '^[0-9]+$')
             and rownum = 1),
         4
       ) as RH_CODE,-- Rh血型代码

       substr(
         nvl(
           (select cd.国标名称
              from cda.cda_dictionary cd
             where cd.字典名称 = 'RH血型代码'
               and cd.院标名称 = p.blood_type_rh
               and rownum = 1),
           '未查'
         ),
         1,
         50
       ) as RH_NAME,-- Rh血型名称

           nvl( nvl(   (select max(cd.国标编码)
            from cda.cda_dictionary cd
           where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
             and cd.系统标识 = 'SM'
             and cd.院标名称 = a.DIAG_before_OPERATION)    ,
              (select max(cd.国标编码)
            from cda.cda_dictionary cd
           where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
             and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
             and cd.院标名称 = dd.diagnosis_desc)
       ),         dd.diagnosis_code)      as BEFORE_OPERA_DIAGNOSIS,--  术前诊断编码    请按照省统一标准填写


                   nvl( nvl(   (select max(cd.国标名称)
            from cda.cda_dictionary cd
           where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
             and cd.系统标识 = 'SM'
             and cd.院标名称 = a.DIAG_before_OPERATION)    ,
              (select max(cd.国标名称)
            from cda.cda_dictionary cd
           where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
             and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
             and cd.院标名称 = dd.diagnosis_desc)
       ),         dd.diagnosis_desc)     as BEFORE_OPERA_DIAGNOSIS_NAME,-- 术前诊断名称  是 请按照医院内部名称填写

       substr(
         nvl(
           nvl(
             (select cd.国标编码
                from cda.cda_dictionary cd
               where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-9手术编码'
