                   and sq.item_name  = '术前访视.体格检查其它'
                   and sq.item_value is not null), '') ||
           nvl((select '其它:'||max(cast(sq.item_value as varchar2(4000 char)))||';'
                  from sm.med_custom_data sq
                 where sq.patient_id = a.patient_id
                   and sq.visit_id   = a.visit_id
                   and sq.oper_id    = a.oper_id
                   and sq.item_name  = '术前访视.其它'
                   and sq.item_value is not null), ''),
           ''
         ),
         1,
         1000
       ) as ABDOMEN_RESULT,-- 腹部检查结果

       substr(
         nvl(
           nullif(
             nvl((select '气道检查:'||max(cast(sq.item_value as varchar2(4000 char)))||';'
                    from sm.med_custom_data sq
                   where sq.patient_id = a.patient_id
                     and sq.visit_id   = a.visit_id
                     and sq.oper_id    = a.oper_id
                     and sq.item_name  = '术前访视.体格检查气道'
                     and sq.item_value is not null), '') ||
             nvl((select '气道评估:'||max(cast(sq.item_value as varchar2(4000 char)))||';'
                    from sm.med_custom_data sq
                   where sq.patient_id = a.patient_id
                     and sq.visit_id   = a.visit_id
                     and sq.oper_id    = a.oper_id
                     and sq.item_name  = '术前访视.气道评估'
                     and sq.item_value is not null), '') ||
             nvl((select 'Mallampati:'||max(cast(sq.item_value as varchar2(4000 char)))||';'
                    from sm.med_custom_data sq
                   where sq.patient_id = a.patient_id
                     and sq.visit_id   = a.visit_id
                     and sq.oper_id    = a.oper_id
                     and sq.item_name  = '术前访视.mallampati'
                     and sq.item_value is not null), '') ||
             nvl((select '张口度:'||max(cast(sq.item_value as varchar2(4000 char)))||';'
                    from sm.med_custom_data sq
                   where sq.patient_id = a.patient_id
                     and sq.visit_id   = a.visit_id
                     and sq.oper_id    = a.oper_id
                     and sq.item_name  = '术前访视.张口度'
                     and sq.item_value is not null), '') ||
             nvl((select '既往插管:'||max(cast(sq.item_value as varchar2(4000 char)))||';'
                    from sm.med_custom_data sq
                   where sq.patient_id = a.patient_id
                     and sq.visit_id   = a.visit_id
                     and sq.oper_id    = a.oper_id
                     and sq.item_name  = '术前访视.既往插管'
                     and sq.item_value is not null), ''),
             ''
           ),
           e3.cervix
         ),
         1,
         100
       ) as TRACHEA_RESULT,-- 气管检查结果

       substr(
         nvl(
           e3.tooth_exam,
           (select max(cast(sq.item_value as varchar2(4000 char)))
              from sm.med_custom_data sq
             where sq.patient_id = a.patient_id
               and sq.visit_id   = a.visit_id
               and sq.oper_id    = a.oper_id
               and sq.item_name  = '术前访视.体格检查牙齿'
               and sq.item_value is not null)
         ),
         1,
         100
       ) as TOOTH_RESULT,-- 牙齿检查结果

       nvl(
         (select to_number(zd.国标编码)
            from cda.cda_dictionary zd
           where zd.字典名称 = '美国麻醉医师协会（ASA）分级标准代码表'
             and zd.院标名称 = e3.asa_grade
             and regexp_like(zd.国标编码, '^[0-9]+$')
             and rownum = 1),
         1
       ) as SIGNATURE_ASA,-- ASA分级标准代码 是

      nvl( substr(
         nvl(
           (select max(cast(sq.item_value as varchar2(4000 char)))
              from sm.med_custom_data sq
             where sq.patient_id = a.patient_id
               and sq.visit_id   = a.visit_id
               and sq.oper_id    = a.oper_id
               and sq.item_name in ('术前访视.术前麻醉医嘱','术前访视.麻醉医嘱')
               and sq.item_value is not null),
           nvl(e3.pre_anes_pham,'-')
         ),
         1,
         1000
       ),'-') as OPERA_ADVICE,-- 术前麻醉医嘱

       substr(
         nullif(
           nvl((select '备选麻醉:'||max(cast(sq.item_value as varchar2(4000 char)))||';'
                  from sm.med_custom_data sq
                 where sq.patient_id = a.patient_id
                   and sq.visit_id   = a.visit_id
                   and sq.oper_id    = a.oper_id
                   and sq.item_name  = '术前访视.备选麻醉'
                   and sq.item_value is not null), '') ||
           nvl((select '备选麻醉方式:'||max(cast(sq.item_value as varchar2(4000 char)))||';'
                  from sm.med_custom_data sq
                 where sq.patient_id = a.patient_id
                   and sq.visit_id   = a.visit_id
                   and sq.oper_id    = a.oper_id
                   and sq.item_name  = '术前访视.备选麻醉方式'
                   and sq.item_value is not null), '') ||
           nvl((select '麻醉中需注意问题:'||max(cast(sq.item_value as varchar2(4000 char)))||';'
                  from sm.med_custom_data sq
                 where sq.patient_id = a.patient_id
                   and sq.visit_id   = a.visit_id
                   and sq.oper_id    = a.oper_id
                   and sq.item_name  = '术前访视.麻醉中需注意问题'
                   and sq.item_value is not null), ''),
           ''
         ),
         1,
         100
       ) as ANANSTHESIA,-- 麻醉适应症

      nvl( substr(
         nvl(
           nvl(
             case
               when regexp_like(a.anesthesia_doctor,'^[0-9]+$') then
                 (select sd.name
                    from his.staff_dict sd
                   where sd.emp_no = a.anesthesia_doctor
                     and rownum = 1)
               else a.anesthesia_doctor
             end,
             o.anesthesia_doctor
           ),
           (select max(cast(sq.item_value as varchar2(4000 char)))
              from sm.med_custom_data sq
             where sq.patient_id = a.patient_id
               and sq.visit_id   = a.visit_id
               and sq.oper_id    = a.oper_id
               and sq.item_name in ('术前访视.麻醉医师签名','术前访视.麻醉医生')
               and sq.item_value is not null)
         ),
         1,
         50
       ),'-') as ANES_DOC_NAME,-- 麻醉医师签名

       cast(nvl(f2.archive_date_time,nvl(e3.enter_date_time,a.start_date_time)) as date) as SIGNATURE_DATE,--  签名日期时间  是 yymmdd hh24miss

       '370104' as DISTRICT_CODE,-- 行政区划  是

       'ADDHIS' as EXCHANGE_TYPE,-- 交换类型  是 INSERT：向平台传新数据时 UPDATE：向平台更新某条数据时 DELETE：从平台删除某条数据时 ADDHIS :向平台补充历史数据

       cast(systimestamp as timestamp) as SYSTEM_TIME --数据上传时间  是 数据上传时间

from sm.med_operation_master a

 left join sm.med_operation_schedule a1
        on a.patient_id = a1.patient_id
       and a.visit_id   = a1.visit_id
       and a.oper_id    = a1.oper_id

 left join sm.med_pat_master_index b
        on a.patient_id = b.patient_id

 left join sm.med_anesthesia_plan e3
        on a.patient_id = e3.patient_id
       and a.visit_id   = e3.visit_id
       and a.oper_id    = e3.oper_id

 left join (
       select patient_id,
              visit_id,
              archive_key,
              max(archive_date_time) as archive_date_time
         from sm.med_emr_archive_detial
        where archive_type = '正常'
        group by patient_id, visit_id, archive_key
 ) f2
        on a.patient_id = f2.patient_id
       and a.visit_id   = f2.visit_id
       and to_char(a.oper_id) = to_char(f2.archive_key)
  left join (select * from (
select o.*,
       row_number() over (
           partition by
               o.patient_id,
               o.visit_id,
               trunc(o.operating_date)
           order by
               o.operation_scale desc nulls last,
               case
                   when to_char(o.op_primary) = '1' then 1
                   else 0
               end desc,
               o.operation_no asc nulls last
       ) as rn
from his.operation o  )  where rn=1)  o
               on a.patient_id = o.patient_id
              and a.visit_id = o.visit_id
            and to_char(o.operating_date,'yyyy-mm-dd')=to_char( nvl(a.start_date_time,a.SCHEDULED_DATE_TIME),'yyyy-mm-dd')

 left join his.pat_visit p
        on p.patient_id = a.patient_id
       and p.visit_id   = a.visit_id

 left join his.pat_master_index pmi
        on p.patient_id = pmi.patient_id

 left join (
       select *
         from (
               select d.*,
                      row_number() over(
                        partition by d.patient_id, d.visit_id
                        order by d.diagnosis_no
                      ) as rn
                 from his.diagnosis d
                where d.diagnosis_type = '3'
              )
        where rn = 1
 ) dd
        on p.patient_id = dd.patient_id
       and p.visit_id   = dd.visit_id

where a.oper_status > 34
  and a1.patient_id is not null
  and nvl(f2.archive_date_time,nvl(e3.enter_date_time,a.start_date_time)) < p.discharge_date_time
  and p.discharge_date_time >= to_date('2021-01-01 00:00:00','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
  and p.discharge_date_time <  to_date('2025-01-01 00:00:00','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')

V_EMR_CONSUMABLES.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_CONSUMABLES" ("ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "ADMISSION_ID", "DEPT_CODE", "DEPT_NAME", "WARD_NAME", "EORD_NUM", "SICKBED_NUM", "NAME", "SEX_CODE", "SEX_NAME", "AGE", "AGE_MONTH", "DISEASE_CODE", "RECORD_SIGN_DATE", "IMPLANT_CODE", "MATERIAL_NAME", "MATERIAL_CODE", "PRODU_CODE", "MATERIAL_PRODUCTION", "MATERIAL_SUPPLY", "MATERIAL_WORK", "AMOUNT", "USE_WAY", "NURSE_NAME", "RECORD_DATE", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME") AS 
  SELECT
    -- ID：机构代码+患者ID+就诊次号+费用序号拼接
    '49557032X' || b.PATIENT_ID || b.VISIT_ID || b.ITEM_NO AS ID,
    -- 机构信息
    '49557032X'                AS ORG_CODE,
    '济南市第二人民医院'         AS ORG_NAME,
    -- 住院标识
    b.PATIENT_ID || b.VISIT_ID  AS ADMISSION_ID,
    -- 科室
    d.DRG_DEPT_CODE             AS DEPT_CODE,
    d.DEPT_NAME                 AS DEPT_NAME,
    -- 病区/病房/床号
    b.WARDCODE                  AS WARD_NAME,
    NULL                        AS EORD_NUM,
    TO_CHAR(b.BED_NO)           AS SICKBED_NUM,
    -- 患者信息（来自 PAT_MASTER_INDEX）
    p.NAME                      AS NAME,
    p.SEX                       AS SEX_CODE,
    CASE p.SEX
        WHEN '男' THEN '1'
        WHEN '女' THEN '2'
        ELSE '0'
    END                         AS SEX_NAME,
    -- 年龄（来自 PAT_VISIT 入院日期 - 出生年月）
    CASE
        WHEN p.DATE_OF_BIRTH IS NOT NULL AND v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME IS NOT NULL
        THEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(v.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME, p.DATE_OF_BIRTH) / 12)
    END                         AS AGE,
    NULL                        AS AGE_MONTH,
    -- 诊断编码（来自 PAT_VISIT 入院诊断）
    v.RYZD                      AS DISEASE_CODE,
    -- 记录日期
    b.BILLING_DATE_TIME         AS RECORD_SIGN_DATE,
    -- 植入性耗材标志（根据名称判断）
    CASE
        WHEN b.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%植入%'
          OR b.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%支架%'
          OR b.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%钢板%'
          OR b.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%螺钉%'
          OR b.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%人工关节%'
          OR b.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%骨水泥%'
          OR b.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%人工骨%'
          OR b.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%人工晶体%'
          OR b.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%人工耳蜗%'
        THEN '1'
        ELSE '0'
    END                         AS IMPLANT_CODE,
    -- 耗材信息
    b.ITEM_NAME                 AS MATERIAL_NAME,
    b.ITEM_CODE                 AS MATERIAL_CODE,
    -- 产品编码（HIS 无 BARCODE 数据，暂置空）
    NULL                        AS PRODU_CODE,
    -- 生产厂家/供应商（费用明细表无此数据，暂置空）
    NULL                        AS MATERIAL_PRODUCTION,
    NULL                        AS MATERIAL_SUPPLY,
    b.UNITS                     AS MATERIAL_WORK,
    b.AMOUNT                    AS AMOUNT,
    NULL                        AS USE_WAY,
    -- 护士签名（无 STAFF_USER 表，暂置空）
    NULL                        AS NURSE_NAME,
    -- 签名日期
    b.BILLING_DATE_TIME         AS RECORD_DATE,
    -- 行政区划
    '370104'                    AS DISTRICT_CODE,
    -- 交换类型
    'INSERT'                    AS EXCHANGE_TYPE,
    -- 数据上传时间
    SYSTIMESTAMP                AS SYSTEM_TIME
FROM HIS.INP_BILL_DETAIL b
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX p ON b.PATIENT_ID = p.PATIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_VISIT v       ON b.PATIENT_ID = v.PATIENT_ID AND b.VISIT_ID = v.VISIT_ID
LEFT JOIN HIS.DEPT_DICT d       ON b.DEPT_CODE = d.DEPT_CODE
WHERE b.CLASS_ON_MR = '材料'
  AND b.BILLING_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2021-01-01'
  AND b.BILLING_DATE_TIME < DATE '2025-01-01'

V_EMR_DEATH_RECORD.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_DEATH_RECORD" ("ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DEP_CODE", "DEP_NAME", "SEX_CODE", "SEX_NAME", "ID_TYPE", "ID_NO", "BIRTH_DATE", "AGE", "VISITING_NUM", "PATIENT_TYPE_CODE", "PATIENT_TYPE_NAME", "AUDIT_DATE", "DISEASE_CODE", "DISEASE_NAME", "OBODE_DETAIL", "DEATH_DATE", "BASIC_CAUSE_CODE", "BASIC_CAUSE", "INPATIENT_DAY", "DOCTOR_NAME", "DOC_ID_NUM", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME") AS 
  select
       cast(
           substrb(
               '49557032X' || '|' || pv.patient_id || '|' || pv.visit_id,
               1,
               100
           ) as varchar2(100)
       ) as ID,--主键 是；机构码|患者ID|住院次数

       cast('49557032X' as varchar2(32)) as ORG_CODE,--医院组织机构代码 是

       cast('山东省第二人民医院' as varchar2(70)) as ORG_NAME,--医院名称 是

       cast(
           substrb(
               nvl(
                   to_char(pv.dept_discharge_from),
                   nvl(to_char(pv.dept_admission_to), to_char(doc.p_dept_code))
               ),
               1,
               20
           ) as varchar2(20)
       ) as DEP_CODE,--科室代码 是；优先出院科室，其次入院科室，再取文书科室

       cast(
           substrb(
               nvl(
                   (
                       select max(dd.dept_name)
                         from his.dept_dict dd
                        where to_char(dd.dept_code) =
                              nvl(
                                  to_char(pv.dept_discharge_from),
                                  nvl(to_char(pv.dept_admission_to), to_char(doc.p_dept_code))
                              )
                   ),
                   nvl(to_char(doc.p_dept_name), '-')
               ),
               1,
               50
           ) as varchar2(50)
       ) as DEP_NAME,--科室名称 是

       cast(
           decode(pmi.sex, '男', '1', '女', '2', '未知', '0', '9')
           as varchar2(1)
       ) as SEX_CODE,--性别代码 是

       cast(
           decode(pmi.sex, '男', '男', '女', '女', '未知', '未知', '不明')
           as varchar2(10)
       ) as SEX_NAME,--性别名称 是

       cast('01' as varchar2(5)) as ID_TYPE,--身份证件类型 是；01居民身份证

       cast(
           substrb(
               case
                   when regexp_like(trim(to_char(pmi.id_no)), '^[0-9]{17}[0-9Xx]$|^[0-9]{15}$')
                   then upper(trim(to_char(pmi.id_no)))
                   else '000000000000000000'
               end,
               1,
               100
           ) as varchar2(100)
       ) as ID_NO,--身份证号 是

       to_char(pmi.date_of_birth, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') as BIRTH_DATE,--出生日期 是；统一时间格式

       cast(
           substrb(
               case
                   when pmi.date_of_birth is not null
                    and nvl(pv.discharge_date_time, nvl(doc.doc_create_date, pv.admission_date_time)) is not null
                   then to_char(
                            trunc(
                                months_between(
                                    nvl(pv.discharge_date_time, nvl(doc.doc_create_date, pv.admission_date_time)),
                                    pmi.date_of_birth
                                ) / 12
                            )
                        )
                   else '-'
               end,
               1,
               3
           ) as varchar2(3)
       ) as AGE,--年龄 是

       cast(
           substrb(
               pv.patient_id || '|' || pv.visit_id,
               1,
               100
           ) as varchar2(100)
       ) as VISITING_NUM,--就诊号 是；本次入院标识

       cast('2' as char(1)) as PATIENT_TYPE_CODE,--病人类型代码 是；2住院，需按平台CC99.00005确认

       cast('住院' as varchar2(50)) as PATIENT_TYPE_NAME,--病人类型 是

       to_char(pv.admission_date_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') as AUDIT_DATE,--就诊/入院日期 是

       cast(
           substrb(
               nvl(
                   (
                       select max(to_char(cd.国标编码))
                         from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                        where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                          and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                          and cd.院标编码 = dmain.diagnosis_code
                   ),
                   nvl(
                       (
                           select max(to_char(cd.国标编码))
                             from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                            where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                              and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                              and cd.院标名称 = dmain.diagnosis_desc
                       ),
                       nvl(to_char(dmain.diagnosis_code), '-')
                   )
               ),
               1,
               12
           ) as varchar2(12)
       ) as DISEASE_CODE,--疾病诊断代码 是；优先出院主诊断标准编码

       cast(
           substrb(
               nvl(
                   (
                       select max(to_char(cd.国标名称))
                         from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                        where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                          and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                          and cd.院标编码 = dmain.diagnosis_code
                   ),
                   nvl(
                       (
                           select max(to_char(cd.国标名称))
                             from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                            where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                              and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                              and cd.院标名称 = dmain.diagnosis_desc
                       ),
                       nvl(to_char(dmain.diagnosis_desc), '-')
                   )
               ),
               1,
               100
           ) as varchar2(100)
       ) as DISEASE_NAME,--疾病诊断名称 是；优先出院主诊断标准名称

       cast(substrb(coalesce(to_char(pv.patient_area_address), to_char(pmi.patient_area_address), to_char(pv.mailing_address), to_char(pmi.mailing_address)), 1, 200) as varchar2(200)) as OBODE_DETAIL,--家庭住址 是；来源暂不明确，先置-

       to_char(
           nvl(pv.discharge_date_time, doc.doc_create_date),
           'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss'
       ) as DEATH_DATE,--死亡时间 是；优先出院时间，空时取死亡文书创建时间

       cast(
           substrb(
               nvl(
                   (
                       select max(to_char(cd.国标编码))
                         from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                        where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                          and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                          and cd.院标编码 = dmain.diagnosis_code
                   ),
                   nvl(
                       (
                           select max(to_char(cd.国标编码))
                             from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                            where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                              and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                              and cd.院标名称 = dmain.diagnosis_desc
                       ),
                       nvl(to_char(dmain.diagnosis_code), '-')
                   )
               ),
               1,
               200
           ) as varchar2(200)
       ) as BASIC_CAUSE_CODE,--根本死亡原因代码 是；暂取出院主诊断

       cast(
           substrb(
               nvl(
                   (
                       select max(to_char(cd.国标名称))
                         from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                        where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                          and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                          and cd.院标编码 = dmain.diagnosis_code
                   ),
                   nvl(
                       (
                           select max(to_char(cd.国标名称))
                             from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                            where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                              and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                              and cd.院标名称 = dmain.diagnosis_desc
                       ),
                       nvl(to_char(dmain.diagnosis_desc), '-')
                   )
               ),
               1,
               2000
           ) as varchar2(2000)
       ) as BASIC_CAUSE,--根本死亡原因 是；暂取出院主诊断

       cast(
           substrb(
               case
                   when pv.admission_date_time is not null
                    and nvl(pv.discharge_date_time, doc.doc_create_date) is not null
                   then to_char(
                            greatest(
                                1,
                                trunc(nvl(pv.discharge_date_time, doc.doc_create_date))
                                - trunc(pv.admission_date_time)
                                + 1
                            )
                        )
                   else '-'
               end,
               1,
               5
           ) as varchar2(5)
       ) as INPATIENT_DAY,--住院天数 是

       cast(
           substrb(
               nvl(
                   (
                       select max(sd.name)
                         from his.staff_dict sd
                        where to_char(sd.emp_no) = to_char(pv.attending_doctor)
                           or to_char(sd.name) = to_char(pv.attending_doctor)
                   ),
                   nvl(to_char(pv.attending_doctor), nvl(to_char(doc.createby), '-'))
               ),
               1,
               50
           ) as varchar2(50)
       ) as DOCTOR_NAME,--医师姓名 是；优先主治医师

       cast(
           substrb(
               nvl(
                   (
                       select max(sd.id_no)
                         from his.staff_dict sd
                        where to_char(sd.emp_no) = to_char(pv.attending_doctor)
                           or to_char(sd.name) = to_char(pv.attending_doctor)
                   ),
                   '-'
               ),
               1,
               18
           ) as varchar2(18)
       ) as DOC_ID_NUM,--医生身份证号

       cast('370104' as varchar2(6)) as DISTRICT_CODE,--所属行政区划 是

       cast('ADDHIS' as varchar2(10)) as EXCHANGE_TYPE,--交换类型 是

       to_char(sysdate, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') as SYSTEM_TIME--数据上传时间戳 是；统一时间格式

  from (
        select *
          from (
                select t.uhid,
                       t.p_inpatient_no,
                       t.p_inpatient_times,
                       t.p_dept_code,
                       t.p_dept_name,
                       t1.doc_create_date,
                       t1.modifiedon,
                       t1.createby,
                       row_number() over (
                           partition by t.p_inpatient_no, t.p_inpatient_times
                           order by t1.doc_create_date desc nulls last,
                                    t1.modifiedon desc nulls last,
                                    t.uhid desc
                       ) as rn
                  from mtl.epr_inpatient_docindex t
                  join mtl.epr_inpatient t1
                    on t.uhid = t1.uhid
                 where (
                           t1.doc_type_name like '%死亡记录%'
                        or t1.doc_type_name like '%死亡病例讨论记录%'
                       )
               )
         where rn = 1
       ) doc

  join his.pat_master_index pmi
    on pmi.inp_no = doc.p_inpatient_no
  join his.pat_visit pv
    on pv.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
   and to_char(pv.visit_id) = to_char(doc.p_inpatient_times)

  left join (
        select d.patient_id,
               d.visit_id,
               max(to_char(d.diagnosis_code)) keep (
                   dense_rank first
                   order by case when nvl(d.diagnosis_no, 0) = 1 then 1 else 2 end,
                            nvl(d.diagnosis_no, 99)
               ) as diagnosis_code,
               max(to_char(d.diagnosis_desc)) keep (
                   dense_rank first
                   order by case when nvl(d.diagnosis_no, 0) = 1 then 1 else 2 end,
                            nvl(d.diagnosis_no, 99)
               ) as diagnosis_desc
          from his.diagnosis d
         where to_char(d.diagnosis_type) = '3'
         group by d.patient_id,
                  d.visit_id
       ) dmain
    on dmain.patient_id = pv.patient_id
   and dmain.visit_id = pv.visit_id

V_EMR_DISCHARGE_RECORD.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_DISCHARGE_RECORD" ("ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DEP_CODE", "DEP_NAME", "HOS_DEP_CODE", "HOS_DEP_NAME", "ADMISSION_NUM", "ADMISSION_ID", "OTHER_ID_TYPE", "OTHER_ID_TYPENAME", "OTHER_ID_NUM", "ID_NUM", "NAME", "SEX_CODE", "SEX_NAME", "AGE", "AGE_MONTH", "AGE_DAY", "AGE_HOUR", "ADMISSION_DATE", "DISCHARGE_DATE", "INPATIENT_DAY", "ADMISSION_SITUATION", "DIAG_TREAT_PLAN", "TREAT_PROCESS", "DISCHARGE_SITUATION", "DISCHARGE_ORDER", "DISCHARGE_DIAGNOSIS", "DISCHARGE_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "CHARACT_CASES", "DOCTOR_CODE", "DOCTOR_NAME", "SUPERIOR_DOC_NAME", "WARD", "SICKBED_NUM", "FOUR_DIAGNOSIS", "TREATMENT_METHOD", "TCM_DECOCTION_METHOD", "MEDICATION_METHOD", "DISCHARGE_SIGNS", "CITIZEN_ID", "EFFECTIVE_TIME", "STATUS", "CREATED_AT", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "DEI", "NODE_CODE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "AR_ID", "DOC_ID_NUM", "DISCHARGE_TIME", "AUTO_LEAVE_HOS", "IS24HRADM_DISCH", "DESTINATION_CODE", "DESTINATION_DESC", "DISCHARGE_STATUS", "DISCHARGE_STATUS_NAME", "ATTEND_DOC_CERTIFICATE_NO", "DISCHARGE_CONDITION", "DISCHARGE_HP_TEXT") AS 
  select ID,
       ORG_CODE,
       ORG_NAME,
       DEP_CODE,
       DEP_NAME,
       HOS_DEP_CODE,
       HOS_DEP_NAME,
       ADMISSION_NUM,
       ADMISSION_ID,
       OTHER_ID_TYPE,
       OTHER_ID_TYPENAME,
       OTHER_ID_NUM,
       ID_NUM,
       NAME,
       SEX_CODE,
       SEX_NAME,
       AGE,
       AGE_MONTH,
       AGE_DAY,
       AGE_HOUR,
       ADMISSION_DATE,
       DISCHARGE_DATE,
       INPATIENT_DAY,
       ADMISSION_SITUATION,
       DIAG_TREAT_PLAN,
       TREAT_PROCESS,
       DISCHARGE_SITUATION,
       DISCHARGE_ORDER,
       DISCHARGE_DIAGNOSIS,
       DISCHARGE_DIAGNOSIS_CODE,
       CHARACT_CASES,
       DOCTOR_CODE,
       DOCTOR_NAME,
       SUPERIOR_DOC_NAME,
       WARD,
       SICKBED_NUM,
       FOUR_DIAGNOSIS,
       TREATMENT_METHOD,
       TCM_DECOCTION_METHOD,
       MEDICATION_METHOD,
       DISCHARGE_SIGNS,
       CITIZEN_ID,
       EFFECTIVE_TIME,
       STATUS,
       CREATED_AT,
       DISTRICT_CODE,
       EXCHANGE_TYPE,
       DEI,
       NODE_CODE,
       SYSTEM_TIME,
       AR_ID,
       DOC_ID_NUM,
       DISCHARGE_TIME,
       AUTO_LEAVE_HOS,
       IS24HRADM_DISCH,
       DESTINATION_CODE,
       DESTINATION_DESC,
       DISCHARGE_STATUS,
       DISCHARGE_STATUS_NAME,
       ATTEND_DOC_CERTIFICATE_NO,
       DISCHARGE_CONDITION,
       DISCHARGE_HP_TEXT
from (
    select q.*,
           row_number() over (
               partition by q.ID
               order by
                   case
                       when q.DISCHARGE_HP_TEXT is not null
                        and q.DISCHARGE_HP_TEXT <> '-'
                       then 0
                       else 1
                   end,
                   q.DISCHARGE_TIME desc nulls last,
                   q.AR_ID desc nulls last
           ) as rn
    from (
select substr(
           '49557032X'||'|'||
           nvl(to_char(t.patient_id), '-')||'|'||
           nvl(to_char(t.visit_id), '-'),
           1,
           100
       ) as ID,--  内码  是 主键

       '49557032X' as ORG_CODE,--  医院组织机构代码  是 是直报中的组织机构代码，必须为9位数字或字母

       '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,--  医院名称  是 填写标准医院名称，每次上传的医院名称必须一致

       substr(
           nvl(
               nullif(
                   trim(
                       cast(
                           (select ks.qmpt_code
                              from his.dept_dict ks
                             where ks.dept_code = t.dept_discharge_from
                               and rownum = 1)
                           as varchar2(20)
                       )
                   ),
                   ''
               ),
               '-'
           ),
           1,
           20
       ) as DEP_CODE,--  科室代码  是 出院科室

       substr(
           nvl(
               nullif(
                   trim(
                       cast(
                           (select ks.qmpt_name
                              from his.dept_dict ks
                             where ks.dept_code = t.dept_discharge_from
                               and rownum = 1)
                           as varchar2(50)
                       )
                   ),
                   ''
               ),
               '-'
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as DEP_NAME,--  科室名称  是 出院科室

       substr(
           nvl(nullif(trim(cast(t.dept_discharge_from as varchar2(20))), ''), '-'),
           1,
           20
       ) as HOS_DEP_CODE,--  院内科室代码  是

       substr(
           nvl(
               nullif(
                   trim(
                       cast(
                           (select ks.dept_name
                              from his.dept_dict ks
                             where ks.dept_code = t.dept_discharge_from
                               and rownum = 1)
                           as varchar2(50)
                       )
                   ),
                   ''
               ),
               '-'
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as HOS_DEP_NAME,--  院内科室名称  是

       substr(
           nvl(nullif(trim(cast(t1.inp_no as varchar2(20))), ''), '-'),
           1,
           20
       ) as ADMISSION_NUM,-- 住院号 是

       substr(
           nvl(to_char(t.patient_id), '-')||'|'||nvl(to_char(t.visit_id), '-'),
           1,
           20
       ) as ADMISSION_ID,--  本次住院标识号 是

       case
           when t1.id_no is null then cast(null as varchar2(5))
           else substr(
                    nvl(
                        (select cast(zd.国标编码 as varchar2(5))
                           from cda.cda_dictionary zd
                          where cast(zd.字典名称 as varchar2(100)) = '身份证件类型代码'
                            and cast(zd.院标编码 as varchar2(100)) = cast(t1.id_type as varchar2(100))
                            and rownum = 1),
                        '99'
                    ),
                    1,
                    5
                )
       end as OTHER_ID_TYPE,-- 身份证件类型 按照平台的值域进行填写，如果身份证件号码为空，则此字段不需要填写

       case
           when t1.id_no is null then cast(null as varchar2(32))
           else substr(
                    nvl(
                        (select cast(zd.国标名称 as varchar2(32))
                           from cda.cda_dictionary zd
                          where cast(zd.字典名称 as varchar2(100)) = '身份证件类型代码'
                            and cast(zd.院标编码 as varchar2(100)) = cast(t1.id_type as varchar2(100))
                            and rownum = 1),
                        '其他法定有效证件'
                    ),
                    1,
                    32
                )
       end as OTHER_ID_TYPENAME,-- 身份证件名称

       substr(cast(t1.id_no as varchar2(18)), 1, 18) as OTHER_ID_NUM,--  其他身份证件号码

       substr(
           nvl(nullif(trim(cast(t1.id_no as varchar2(18))), ''), '000000000000000000'),
           1,18 ) as ID_NUM,--  身份证件号码 所有身份证件号码填写到该字段

       substr(
           nvl(nullif(trim(cast(t1.name as varchar2(50))), ''), '-'),
           1,
           50
       ) as NAME,--  姓名  是 姓名

       substr(
           case
               when cast(t1.sex as varchar2(10)) = '男' then '1'
               when cast(t1.sex as varchar2(10)) = '女' then '2'
               when cast(t1.sex as varchar2(10)) = '未知' then '0'
               else '9'
           end,
           1,
           1
       ) as SEX_CODE,--  性别代码 值域：0未知，1男，2女，9不明

       substr(
           case
               when cast(t1.sex as varchar2(10)) = '男' then '男'
               when cast(t1.sex as varchar2(10)) = '女' then '女'
               when cast(t1.sex as varchar2(10)) = '未知' then '未知'
               else '不明'
           end,
           1,
           50
       ) as SEX_NAME,--  性别

       case
           when t1.date_of_birth is not null
            and t.admission_date_time is not null
            and trunc(months_between(t.admission_date_time, t1.date_of_birth) / 12) between 1 and 200
           then trunc(months_between(t.admission_date_time, t1.date_of_birth) / 12)
       end as AGE,-- 年龄 必须为整数，范围在1-200之间，如果不足一岁，请空置

       case
           when t1.date_of_birth is not null
            and t.admission_date_time is not null
            and months_between(t.admission_date_time, t1.date_of_birth) >= 1
            and months_between(t.admission_date_time, t1.date_of_birth) < 12
           then greatest(trunc(months_between(t.admission_date_time, t1.date_of_birth)), 1)
           else 0
       end as AGE_MONTH,-- 年龄（月） 不足一岁时填写，在1-12范围内的整数

       case
           when t1.date_of_birth is not null
            and t.admission_date_time is not null
            and months_between(t.admission_date_time, t1.date_of_birth) < 1
           then greatest(trunc(t.admission_date_time - t1.date_of_birth), 1)
           else 0
       end as AGE_DAY,-- 年龄（天） 不足一月时填写，在1-31范围内的整数

       case
           when t1.date_of_birth is not null
            and t.admission_date_time is not null
            and (t.admission_date_time - t1.date_of_birth) < 1
           then greatest(trunc(24 * (t.admission_date_time - t1.date_of_birth)), 1)
           else 0
       end as AGE_HOUR,--  年龄（小时） 不足一天时填写，在1-24范围内的整数

       cast(t.admission_date_time as date) as ADMISSION_DATE,--  入院日期  是 字符型改为时间类型

       cast(t.discharge_date_time as date) as DISCHARGE_DATE,--  出院日期  是 业务日期

       case
           when t.discharge_date_time is not null
            and t.admission_date_time is not null
           then greatest(trunc(t.discharge_date_time) - trunc(t.admission_date_time), 1)
           else 1
       end as INPATIENT_DAY,-- 住院天数  是 正整数

       substr(
           nvl(
               nullif(
                   trim(
                       regexp_substr(
                           cast(dbms_lob.substr(t5.段落内容, 2000, 1) as varchar2(2000)),
                           '入[[:space:]]*院[[:space:]]*情[[:space:]]*况[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)[[:space:]]*入[[:space:]]*院[[:space:]]*诊[[:space:]]*断[[:space:]]*[:：]',
                           1, 1, 'n', 1
                       )
                   ),
                   ''
               ),
               cast(t.pat_adm_condition as varchar2(2000))
           ),
           1,
           2000
       ) as ADMISSION_SITUATION,-- 入院情况

       cast(null as varchar2(2000)) as DIAG_TREAT_PLAN,-- 诊疗计划

       substr(
           nvl(
               nullif(
                   trim(
                       regexp_substr(
                           cast(dbms_lob.substr(t5.段落内容, 2000, 1) as varchar2(2000)),
                           '诊[[:space:]]*疗[[:space:]]*经[[:space:]]*过[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)[[:space:]]*出[[:space:]]*院[[:space:]]*诊[[:space:]]*断[[:space:]]*[:：]',
                           1, 1, 'n', 1
                       )
                   ),
                   ''
               ),
               cast(null as varchar2(2000))
           ),
           1,
           2000
       ) as TREAT_PROCESS,-- 诊疗经过

       substr(
           nvl(
               nullif(
                   trim(
                       regexp_substr(
                           cast(dbms_lob.substr(t5.段落内容, 2000, 1) as varchar2(2000)),
                           '出[[:space:]]*院[[:space:]]*情[[:space:]]*况[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)[[:space:]]*出[[:space:]]*院[[:space:]]*医[[:space:]]*嘱[[:space:]]*[:：]',
                           1, 1, 'n', 1
                       )
                   ),
                   ''
               ),
               cast(null as varchar2(2000))
           ),
           1,
           2000
       ) as DISCHARGE_SITUATION,-- 出院情况

       substr(
           nvl(
               nullif(
                   trim(
                       regexp_substr(
                           cast(dbms_lob.substr(t5.段落内容, 2000, 1) as varchar2(2000)),
                           '出[[:space:]]*院[[:space:]]*医[[:space:]]*嘱[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)[[:space:]]*医[[:space:]]*师[[:space:]]*签[[:space:]]*名[[:space:]]*[:：]',
                           1, 1, 'n', 1
                       )
                   ),
                   ''
               ),
               cast(null as varchar2(2000))
           ),
           1,
           2000
       ) as DISCHARGE_ORDER,-- 出院医嘱

       substr(
           nvl(
               nullif(trim(diag_dict.std_name), ''),
               nvl(
                   nullif(
                       trim(
                           regexp_replace(
                               regexp_substr(
                                   cast(dbms_lob.substr(t5.段落内容, 2000, 1) as varchar2(2000)),
                                   '出[[:space:]]*院[[:space:]]*诊[[:space:]]*断[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)[[:space:]]*出[[:space:]]*院[[:space:]]*情[[:space:]]*况[[:space:]]*[:：]',
                                   1, 1, 'n', 1
                               ),
                               '出[[:space:]]*院[[:space:]]*诊[[:space:]]*断[[:space:]]*[:：]',
                               ''
                           )
                       ),
                       ''
                   ),
                   nvl(nullif(trim(cast(t2.diagnosis_desc as varchar2(100))), ''), '-')
               )
           ),
           1,
           100
       ) as DISCHARGE_DIAGNOSIS,-- 出院诊断名称

       substr(
           nvl(
               nullif(trim(diag_dict.std_code), ''),
               nvl(nullif(trim(cast(t2.diagnosis_code as varchar2(20))), ''), '-')
           ),
           1,
           20
       ) as DISCHARGE_DIAGNOSIS_CODE,--  出院诊断编码 ICD10

       cast(null as varchar2(2000)) as CHARACT_CASES,-- 病例特点

       substr(
           cast(
               (select sd.id_no
                  from his.staff_dict sd
                 where sd.emp_no = t.attending_doctor
                   and rownum = 1)
               as varchar2(32)
           ),
           1,
           32
       ) as DOCTOR_CODE,-- 医生代码 主治医生身份证

       substr(
           nvl(
               nullif(
                   trim(
                       cast(
                           (select yg.name
                              from his.staff_dict yg
                             where yg.emp_no = t.attending_doctor
                               and rownum = 1)
                           as varchar2(50)
                       )
                   ),
                   ''
               ),
               '-'
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as DOCTOR_NAME,-- 医师姓名  是 住院医师（主治医师）

       substr(
           trim(
               regexp_substr(
                   cast(dbms_lob.substr(t5.段落内容, 2000, 1) as varchar2(2000)),
                   '医[[:space:]]*师[[:space:]]*签[[:space:]]*名[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([^[:cntrl:][:space:]]+)',
                   1, 1, 'n', 1
               )
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as SUPERIOR_DOC_NAME,-- 上级医师签名

       substr(
           nvl(
               nullif(trim(cast(t.discharge_ward_code as varchar2(50))), ''),
               cast(
                   (select aa.ward_code
                      from his.pats_in_hospital aa
                     where aa.patient_id = t.patient_id
                       and aa.visit_id = t.visit_id
                       and rownum = 1)
                   as varchar2(50)
               )
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as WARD,--  病区名称

       substr(
           nvl(
               nullif(trim(cast(t.discharge_bed_no as varchar2(20))), ''),
               cast(
                   (select aa.bed_no
                      from his.pats_in_hospital aa
                     where aa.patient_id = t.patient_id
                       and aa.visit_id = t.visit_id
                       and rownum = 1)
                   as varchar2(20)
               )
           ),
           1,
           20
       ) as SICKBED_NUM,-- 病床号 重点

       cast(null as varchar2(1000)) as FOUR_DIAGNOSIS,--  中医“四诊”观察结果

       cast(null as varchar2(100)) as TREATMENT_METHOD,--  治则治法

       cast(null as varchar2(100)) as TCM_DECOCTION_METHOD,--  中药煎煮方法

       cast(null as varchar2(100)) as MEDICATION_METHOD,-- 用药方法

       substr(
           trim(
               regexp_substr(
                   cast(dbms_lob.substr(t5.段落内容, 2000, 1) as varchar2(2000)),
                   '出[[:space:]]*院[[:space:]]*情[[:space:]]*况[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)[[:space:]]*出[[:space:]]*院[[:space:]]*医[[:space:]]*嘱[[:space:]]*[:：]',
                   1, 1, 'n', 1
               )
           ),
           1,
           1000
       ) as DISCHARGE_SIGNS,-- 出院时症状与体征

       substr(cast(t1.id_no as varchar2(32)), 1, 32) as CITIZEN_ID,-- 个人内码

       cast(t4.DOC_CREATE_DATE as date) as EFFECTIVE_TIME,-- 活动发生时间

       cast(null as varchar2(32)) as STATUS,-- 卡片状态 平台自动生成值，不需要填写

       cast(null as timestamp) as CREATED_AT,-- 创建时间 平台自动生成，不需要填写

       '370104' as DISTRICT_CODE,-- 所属行政区划  是 按机构所在的行政区划（区县）

       'INSERT' as EXCHANGE_TYPE,-- 交换类型  是 INSERT：向平台传新数据时

       cast(null as varchar2(50)) as DEI,-- 数据交换标识符

       cast(null as varchar2(50)) as NODE_CODE,-- 节点标识符

       cast(systimestamp as timestamp) as SYSTEM_TIME,-- 数据上传时间戳 是 数据上传时间戳

       substr(cast(t3.uhid as varchar2(36)), 1, 36) as AR_ID,-- 病案ID

       substr(
           cast(
               (select sd.id_no
                  from his.staff_dict sd
                 where sd.emp_no = t.attending_doctor
                   and rownum = 1)
               as varchar2(18)
           ),
           1,
           18
       ) as DOC_ID_NUM,-- 医生身份证号

       cast(t4.MODIFIEDON as date) as DISCHARGE_TIME,-- 记录时间 字符型改为时间类型

       case
           when regexp_like(
                    cast(dbms_lob.substr(t5.段落内容, 2000, 1) as varchar2(2000)),
                    '自动出院|自行出院|要求出院|拒绝.*治疗|拒绝.*检查'
                )
           then '1'
           else '0'
       end as AUTO_LEAVE_HOS,-- 自动出院标志 是 患者自动出院为1，医嘱出院为0

       case
           when t.discharge_date_time is not null
            and t.admission_date_time is not null
            and t.discharge_date_time >= t.admission_date_time
            and t.discharge_date_time - t.admission_date_time < 1
           then '1'
           else '0'
       end as IS24HRADM_DISCH,-- 是否24小时入出院 是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select cast(zd.国标编码 as varchar2(100))
                  from cda.cda_dictionary zd
                 where cast(zd.字典名称 as varchar2(100)) = '离院方式代码'
                   and cast(zd.院标编码 as varchar2(100)) = cast(t.discharge_disposition as varchar2(100))
                   and rownum = 1),
               '9'
           ),
           1,
           100
       ) as DESTINATION_CODE,-- 离院方式代码 是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select cast(zd.国标名称 as varchar2(100))
                  from cda.cda_dictionary zd
                 where cast(zd.字典名称 as varchar2(100)) = '离院方式代码'

                   and rownum = 1),
               '其他'

           100

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select cast(zd.国标编码 as varchar2(100))
                  from cda.cda_dictionary zd
                 where cast(zd.字典名称 as varchar2(100)) = '病情转归代码表'
                   and cast(zd.院标编码 as varchar2(100)) = cast(t.discharge_disposition as varchar2(100))
                   and rownum = 1),
               '9'

           1,
           100

       substr(

               (select cast(zd.国标名称 as varchar2(100))
                  from cda.cda_dictionary zd
                 where cast(zd.字典名称 as varchar2(100)) = '病情转归代码表'
                   and cast(zd.院标编码 as varchar2(100)) = cast(t.discharge_disposition as varchar2(100))
                   and rownum = 1),
               '其他'

           100

       substr(

               ),

           1,
           100
       ) as ATTEND_DOC_CERTIFICATE_NO,-- 主治医生执业证书编号 是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项

       substr(
           nvl(
               nullif(
                   trim(
                       regexp_substr(
                           cast(dbms_lob.substr(t5.段落内容, 2000, 1) as varchar2(2000)),
                           '出[[:space:]]*院[[:space:]]*情[[:space:]]*况[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)[[:space:]]*出[[:space:]]*院[[:space:]]*医[[:space:]]*嘱[[:space:]]*[:：]',
                           1, 1, 'n', 1
                       )
                   ),
                   ''
               ),
               '-'
           ),
           1,
           2000
       ) as DISCHARGE_CONDITION,-- 出院时症状与体征 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项

       substr(
           nvl(
               nullif(
                   trim(cast(dbms_lob.substr(t5.段落内容, 2000, 1) as varchar2(2000))),
                   ''
               ),
               '-'
           ),
           1,
           2000
       ) as DISCHARGE_HP_TEXT -- 出院/死亡记录文本 是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项

from his.pat_visit t

left join his.pat_master_index t1
       on t.patient_id = t1.patient_id

left join his.diagnosis t2
       on t.patient_id = t2.patient_id
      and t.visit_id = t2.visit_id
      and t2.diagnosis_type = '3'
      and t2.diagnosis_no = '1'

left join (
        select trim(to_char(院标编码)) as local_code,
               max(nullif(trim(to_char(国标编码)), '')) as std_code,

          from cda.cda_dictionary
         where 字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
           and 系统标识 = 'HIS'

       ) diag_dict
       on diag_dict.local_code = trim(to_char(t2.diagnosis_code))

left join mtl.epr_inpatient_docindex t3
       on t3.p_inpatient_no = t1.inp_no
      and t3.p_inpatient_times = t.visit_id

where cast(t4.doc_type_name as varchar2(100)) like '%出院记录%'

  and t.discharge_date_time <  to_date('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
    ) q
)
where rn = 1

V_EMR_DOC_ORDER_CHECK.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_DOC_ORDER_CHECK" ("ID", "PATIENT_ID", "ODR_GN", "ORD_SN", "ODR_TYPE", "ORD_TIME", "ORD_FRE", "STATUS_CODE", "STATUS_NAME", "ODR_CODE", "ODR_NAME", "ODR_NOTE", "DPT_CODE", "DPT_NAME", "HOS_DPT_CODE", "HOS_DPT_NAME", "DOC_IDCARD", "DOC_NAME", "ODRISU_DT", "BEGIN_TIME", "EXE_DEPT_CODE", "EXE_DEPT_NAME", "NURSE_NAME", "NUR_E_DT", "STOP_DT", "STPDOC_IDCARD", "STPDOC_NAME", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "NAME", "SEX_CODE", "ID_NUM", "ORDER_ID", "ORDER_CATEGORY_CODE", "ORDER_CATEGORY_NAME", "ORDER_DOC_CERTIFICATE_NO", "ORDER_START_TIME", "ORDER_END_TIME", "ORDER_STATUS") AS 
  select substr('49557032X' || '|' || t.patient_id || '|' || t.visit_id || '|' || t.order_no || '|' || t.order_sub_no, 1, 100) as ID,--  内码  是 主键，必填

       t.patient_id || '|' || t.visit_id as PATIENT_ID,--  住院唯一标识号 是 必填项，病人某一次住院的唯一标识

       substr(to_char(t.order_no), 1, 24) as ODR_GN,--  医嘱组号    同一组相同治疗目的得医嘱

       substr(to_char(t.order_sub_no), 1, 12) as ORD_SN,--  组内顺序号

       case
           when t.repeat_indicator = 1 then 1
           when t.repeat_indicator = 0 then 2
           else 9
       end as ODR_TYPE,--  医嘱类型代码  是 必填 1、长期，2、临时，3，出院带药9、其他

       case
           when t.repeat_indicator = 1
            and t.start_date_time is not null
           then cast(
                    least(
                        greatest(
                            round(nvl(t.stop_date_time, pv.discharge_date_time) - t.start_date_time, 2),
                            0
                        ),
                        99.99
                    ) as number(4,2)
                )
           else cast(null as number(4,2))
       end as ORD_TIME,--  执行天数    长期医嘱填，超过99.99按99.99处理

       case
           when t.repeat_indicator = 1
            and t.freq_counter is not null
            and t.freq_interval is not null
            and t.freq_interval > 0
           then cast(
                    least(
                        greatest(
                            case
                                -- 每 N 天执行 X 次：每天次数 = X / N
                                when upper(trim(t.freq_interval_unit)) in ('日', '天', 'D', 'DAY', 'DAYS')
                                then round(t.freq_counter / t.freq_interval, 2)

                                -- 每 N 小时执行 X 次：每天次数 = X * 24 / N
                                when upper(trim(t.freq_interval_unit)) in ('小时', '时', 'H', 'HOUR', 'HOURS')
                                then round(t.freq_counter * 24 / t.freq_interval, 2)

                                -- 每 N 分钟执行 X 次：每天次数 = X * 1440 / N
                                when upper(trim(t.freq_interval_unit)) in ('分钟', '分', 'MI', 'MIN', 'MINUTE', 'MINUTES')
                                then round(t.freq_counter * 1440 / t.freq_interval, 2)

                                -- 每 N 周执行 X 次：每天次数 = X / (N * 7)
                                when upper(trim(t.freq_interval_unit)) in ('周', '星期', 'W', 'WEEK', 'WEEKS')
                                then round(t.freq_counter / (t.freq_interval * 7), 2)

                                -- 每 N 月执行 X 次：每天次数 = X / (N * 30)
                                when upper(trim(t.freq_interval_unit)) in ('月', 'M', 'MONTH', 'MONTHS')
                                then round(t.freq_counter / (t.freq_interval * 30), 2)

                                else null
                            end,
                            0
                        ),
                        99.99
                    ) as number(4,2)
                )
           else cast(null as number(4,2))
       end as ORD_FRE,-- 每天执行次数    长期医嘱填，超过99.99按99.99处理

       case to_char(t.order_status)
           when '1' then '1' -- 新开：医生签名
           when '2' then '3' -- 执行：已执行
           when '3' then '3' -- 停止：按已执行历史医嘱处理
           when '4' then '4' -- 作废：医生取消
           else '3'
       end as STATUS_CODE,-- 状态代码    DMD-40

       case to_char(t.order_status)
           when '1' then '医生签名'
           when '2' then '已执行'
           when '3' then '已执行'
           when '4' then '医生取消'
           else '已执行'
       end as STATUS_NAME,-- 状态

       substr(nvl(t.order_code, to_char(t.order_no)), 1, 32) as ODR_CODE,--  医嘱编码  是 按照院内标准填写，医嘱编码为空时暂用医嘱号兜底

       substr(nvl(t.order_text, '-'), 1, 100) as ODR_NAME,--  医嘱名称  是 按照院内标准填写

       cast(null as varchar2(800)) as ODR_NOTE,--  医嘱备注说明

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select ks.qmpt_code
                  from his.dept_dict ks
                 where ks.dept_code = t.ordering_dept
                   and rownum = 1),
               t.ordering_dept
           ),
           1,
           15
       ) as DPT_CODE,--  开嘱科室编码  是 省级标准科室值域

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select ks.qmpt_name
                  from his.dept_dict ks
                 where ks.dept_code = t.ordering_dept
                   and rownum = 1),
               nvl(
                   (select ks.dept_name
                      from his.dept_dict ks
                     where ks.dept_code = t.ordering_dept
                       and rownum = 1),
                   t.ordering_dept
               )
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as DPT_NAME,--  开嘱科室名称  是 　必填

       substr(t.ordering_dept, 1, 20) as HOS_DPT_CODE,--  院内科室编码  是

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select ks.dept_name
                  from his.dept_dict ks
                 where ks.dept_code = t.ordering_dept
                   and rownum = 1),
               t.ordering_dept
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as HOS_DPT_NAME,--  院内科室名称  是

       nvl(
           substr(
               (select sd.id_no
                  from his.staff_dict sd
                 where sd.emp_no = t.doctor_user
                   and rownum = 1),
               1,
               18
           ),
           '000000000000000000'
       ) as DOC_IDCARD,--  开嘱医生身份证号  是

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select sd.name
                  from his.staff_dict sd
                 where sd.emp_no = t.doctor_user
                   and rownum = 1),
               t.doctor
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as DOC_NAME,--  开嘱医生姓名  是 　必填

       cast(t.start_date_time as date) as ODRISU_DT,-- 医嘱下达时间  是 开立日期

       cast(nvl(t.verify_data_time, t.start_date_time) as date) as BEGIN_TIME,--  医嘱开始执行时间  是 字符型改为时间类型

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select ks.qmpt_code
                  from his.dept_dict ks
                 where ks.dept_code = t.exec_dept_code
                   and rownum = 1),
               t.exec_dept_code
           ),
           1,
           15
       ) as EXE_DEPT_CODE,-- 执行科室编码

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select ks.qmpt_name
                  from his.dept_dict ks
                 where ks.dept_code = t.exec_dept_code
                   and rownum = 1),
               nvl(
                   (select ks.dept_name
                      from his.dept_dict ks
                     where ks.dept_code = t.exec_dept_code
                       and rownum = 1),
                   t.exec_dept_name
               )
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as EXE_DEPT_NAME,-- 执行科室名称

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select sd.name
                  from his.staff_dict sd
                 where sd.emp_no = t.nurse_user
                   and rownum = 1),
               t.nurse
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as NURSE_NAME,--  执行护士(医生)姓名

       cast(t.verify_data_time as date) as NUR_E_DT,--  护士（医生）执行时间    字符型改为时间类型

       cast(t.stop_date_time as date) as STOP_DT,-- 医嘱停止执行时间    字符型改为时间类型

       substr(
           (select sd.id_no
              from his.staff_dict sd
             where sd.emp_no = t.stop_doctor_user
               and rownum = 1),
           1,
           18
       ) as STPDOC_IDCARD,-- 停止执行医生身份证号

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select sd.name
                  from his.staff_dict sd
                 where sd.emp_no = t.stop_doctor_user
                   and rownum = 1),
               t.stop_doctor
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as STPDOC_NAME,-- 停止执行医生姓名

       '49557032X' as ORG_CODE,--  医院组织机构代码  是 必填

       '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,--  医院名称  是 必填

       '370104' as DISTRICT_CODE,-- 所属行政区划  是 必填

       'INSERT' as EXCHANGE_TYPE,-- 交换类型  是

       cast(systimestamp as timestamp) as SYSTEM_TIME,-- 数据上传时间戳 是 必填

       substr(nvl(t2.name, '-'), 1, 50) as NAME,--  患者姓名  是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项

       decode(t2.sex, '男', '1', '女', '2', '未知', '0', '9') as SEX_CODE,--  患者性别代码  是 值域：0未知，1男，2女，9不明，通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项

       substr(nvl(t2.id_no, '000000000000000000'), 1, 18) as ID_NUM,--  患者身份证件号码  是 全部身份证件号码填写到该字段，通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项

       substr(to_char(t.order_no) || '|' || to_char(t.order_sub_no), 1, 100) as ORDER_ID,--  医嘱流水号 是 与检查/检验表/收费相关业务表保证关联性

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select cd.国标编码
                  from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                 where cd.字典名称 = '医嘱项目类型代码'
                   and cd.院标编码 = t.order_class
                   and rownum = 1),
               '99'
           ),
           1,
           100
       ) as ORDER_CATEGORY_CODE,-- 医嘱项目大类别编码 是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select cd.国标名称
                  from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                 where cd.字典名称 = '医嘱项目类型代码'
                   and cd.院标编码 = t.order_class
                   and rownum = 1),
               '其他'
           ),
           1,
           100
       ) as ORDER_CATEGORY_NAME,-- 医嘱项目大类别名称 是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select yg.practice_cert_code
                  from doc_register_emp_match yg
                 where yg.emp_no = t.doctor_user
                   and rownum = 1),
               '-'
           ),
           1,
           100
       ) as ORDER_DOC_CERTIFICATE_NO,--  医嘱开立医生执业证书编号  是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项

       cast(t.start_date_time as date) as ORDER_START_TIME,--  医嘱开始时间  是 所有医嘱都必须填写

       case
           when t.repeat_indicator = 1
           then cast(nvl(nvl(t.stop_date_time, pv.discharge_date_time), date '1970-01-01') as date)
           else cast(date '1970-01-01' as date)
       end as ORDER_END_TIME,--  医嘱停止时间  是 长期医嘱必填，临时医嘱填写默认值1970-01-01

       case to_char(t.order_status)
           when '4' then '2' -- 作废：无效
           else '1'          -- 新开、执行、停止：有效
       end as ORDER_STATUS -- 医嘱有效标识  1.有效；2.无效

from his.orders t
left join his.pat_master_index t2
       on t.patient_id = t2.patient_id
left join his.pat_visit pv
       on t.patient_id = pv.patient_id
      and t.visit_id = pv.visit_id
where t.order_class not in ('A', 'B')
  and pv.discharge_date_time >= to_date('2021-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
  and pv.discharge_date_time <  to_date('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') and t.ordering_dept is not null

V_EMR_DOC_ORDER_DRUG.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_DOC_ORDER_DRUG" ("ID", "PATIENT_ID", "ODR_GN", "ODR_SN", "ODR_TYPE", "ODER_ITEM_CODE", "ODER_ITEM_NAME", "ODR_TYPENAME", "ORD_TIME", "STATUS_CODE", "STATUS_NAME", "ODR_CODE", "DRUG_COMMON_NAME", "ODR_NAME", "DRUG_CLASS_CODE", "DRUG_CLASS_NAME", "CATEGORY", "DRUG_FORM_CODE", "DRUG_FORM_NAME", "SPEC", "UNIT", "DRUG_DOSE", "SINGLE_DOSE", "UNIT_CODE", "JL_UNIT", "HERB_NUM", "UNIT_DOSE", "ORDER_DOSAGE", "DRUG_FREQUENCY_CODE", "DRUG_FREQUENCY_NAME", "IS_ANTI", "ANTI_USE_GRADE_CODE", "ANTI_USE_GRADE_NAME", "DRUG_WAY_CD", "DRUG_WAY_NAME", "IF_YF", "ODR_NOTE", "DPT_CODE", "DPT_NAME", "HOS_DPT_CODE", "HOS_DPT_NAME", "DOC_IDCARD", "DOC_NAME", "ODRISU_DT", "BEGIN_TIME", "NURSE_NAME", "NUR_E_DT", "STOP_DT", "STPDOC_IDCARD", "STPDOC_NAME", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "RECIPE_NUM", "NAME", "SEX_CODE", "ID_NUM", "ORDER_ID", "DTCODE", "NHSA_STANDARD_CODE", "ORDER_DOC_CERTIFICATE_NO", "PRES_DECRIPTION", "TCM_DECOCTION_METHOD", "TCM_USE_METHOD", "ORDER_STATUS", "PRES_ID", "PHYSICIAN_CERTIFICATE_NO") AS 
  select substr(
    t.patient_id || '|' || t.visit_id || '|' || to_char(t.order_no) || '|' || to_char(t.order_sub_no),
    1,
    100
)  as ID,--  内码  是 主键，必填

       t.patient_id || '|' || t.visit_id as PATIENT_ID,--  住院唯一标识号 是 必填项，病人某一次住院的唯一标识

       substr(to_char(t.order_no), 1, 24) as ODR_GN,--  医嘱组号    同一组相同治疗目的得医嘱

       substr(to_char(t.order_sub_no), 1, 12) as ODR_SN,--  组内顺序号

       case
           when t.repeat_indicator = 1 then '1'
           when t.repeat_indicator = 0 then '2'
           else '9'
       end as ODR_TYPE,--  医嘱类型代码  是 必填 1、长期，2、临时，3，出院带药9、其他

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select cd.国标编码
                  from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                 where cd.字典名称 = '医嘱项目类型代码'
                   and cd.院标编码 = t.order_class
                   and rownum = 1),
               '01'
           ),
           1,
           20
       ) as ODER_ITEM_CODE,--  医嘱项目类型代码  是

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select cd.国标名称
                  from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                 where cd.字典名称 = '医嘱项目类型代码'
                   and cd.院标编码 = t.order_class
                   and rownum = 1),
               '药品类医嘱'
           ),
           1,
           20
       ) as ODER_ITEM_NAME,--  医嘱项目类型名称  是

       substr(nvl(t.order_text, '-'), 1, 24) as ODR_TYPENAME,--  医嘱名称  是 按照医院开立医嘱名称上传

   case
    when t.repeat_indicator = 1
     and t.start_date_time is not null
    then cast(
             least(
                 greatest(
                     ceil(nvl(t.stop_date_time, pv.discharge_date_time) - t.start_date_time),
                     0
                 ),
                 9999
             ) as number(4)
         )
    else cast(null as number(4))
end as ORD_TIME,--  执行天数    长期医嘱

 case to_char(t.order_status)
           when '1' then '1' -- 新开：医生签名
           when '2' then '3' -- 执行：已执行
           when '3' then '3' -- 停止：按已执行历史医嘱处理
           when '4' then '4' -- 作废：医生取消
           else '3'
       end as STATUS_CODE,-- 状态代码    DMD-40

       case to_char(t.order_status)
           when '1' then '医生签名'
           when '2' then '已执行'
           when '3' then '已执行'
           when '4' then '医生取消'
           else '已执行'
       end as STATUS_NAME,-- 状态
--select * from DRUG_STANDARD_DICT
