             case
               when x.Zkmd is not null then x.Zkmd
               else regexp_substr(
                      x.content_text,
                      '转[[:space:]]*科[[:space:]]*目[[:space:]]*的[及和]*注[[:space:]]*意[[:space:]]*事[[:space:]]*项[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(转[[:space:]]*入[[:space:]]*诊[[:space:]]*疗[[:space:]]*计[[:space:]]*划|医师签名|$)',
                      1, 1, 'n', 1
                    )
             end,
             '[；;。[:space:]]+$',
             ''
           ),
           1,
           200
       ) as CHANGE_MAJOR_PURPOSE,--  转科目的  是

       substr(
           regexp_replace(
             case
               when x.Zrzljh is not null then x.Zrzljh
               else regexp_substr(
                      x.content_text,
                      '转[[:space:]]*入[[:space:]]*诊[[:space:]]*疗[[:space:]]*计[[:space:]]*划[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(注意事项|医师签名|$)',
                      1, 1, 'n', 1
                    )
             end,
             '[[:space:]]+[一-龥]{2,4}[[:space:]]*$',
             ''
           ),
           1,
           2000
       ) as IN_DIAG_TREAT_PLAN,--  转入诊疗计划

       cast(null as varchar2(1000)) as CH_MED_PRES_DAC,-- 中药处方医嘱内容

       cast(null as varchar2(100)) as TCM_DECOCTION_METHOD,--  中药煎煮方法    中药煎煮方法

       cast(null as varchar2(100)) as MEDICATION_METHOD,-- 中药用药方法

       substr(
           nvl(
               regexp_substr(
                   x.content_text,
                   '注[[:space:]]*意[[:space:]]*事[[:space:]]*项[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(医师签名|$)',
                   1, 1, 'n', 1
               ),
               regexp_substr(
                   x.content_text,
                   '转[[:space:]]*科[[:space:]]*目[[:space:]]*的[及和]*注[[:space:]]*意[[:space:]]*事[[:space:]]*项[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(转[[:space:]]*入[[:space:]]*诊[[:space:]]*疗[[:space:]]*计[[:space:]]*划|医师签名|$)',
                   1, 1, 'n', 1
               )
           ),
           1,
           1000
       ) as MATTERS_ATTENTION,-- 注意事项

       case
         when x.doc_title like '%转出%' or regexp_like(x.content_text, '转出记录') then 1
         when x.doc_title like '%转入%' or regexp_like(x.content_text, '转入记录') then 2
         else 1
       end as TRANSFER_RECORD_TYPE,--  转科记录类型    　1:转出 2：转入

       cast(
           nvl(
             (
               select max(a.log_date_time) keep (
                        dense_rank first order by
                        abs(cast(a.log_date_time as date) - cast(x.createon as date)),
                        a.log_date_time
                    )
                 from his.adt_log a
                where a.patient_id = x.patient_id
                  and a.visit_id = x.p_inpatient_times
                  and a.action = 'E'
             ),
             x.createon
           ) as date
       ) as ROLL_OUT_DATE,-- 转出日期时间  是 　YYYYMMDD HHMISS

       substr(
           nvl(
             (
               select dd.dept_name
                 from his.dept_dict dd
                where dd.dept_code = (
                        select max(a.dept_code) keep (
                                   dense_rank first order by
                                   abs(cast(a.log_date_time as date) - cast(x.createon as date)),
                                   a.log_date_time
                               )
                          from his.adt_log a
                         where a.patient_id = x.patient_id
                           and a.visit_id = x.p_inpatient_times
                           and a.action = 'E'
                     )
                  and rownum = 1
             ),
             x.p_dept_name
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as ROLL_OUT_DEP_NAME,-- 转出科室  是

       substr(
           (
             select sd.name
               from his.staff_dict sd
              where sd.emp_no = (
                      select max(a.operator_no) keep (
                                 dense_rank first order by
                                 abs(cast(a.log_date_time as date) - cast(x.createon as date)),
                                 a.log_date_time
                             )
                        from his.adt_log a
                       where a.patient_id = x.patient_id
                         and a.visit_id = x.p_inpatient_times
                         and a.action = 'E'
                   )
                and rownum = 1
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as ROLL_OUT_DOC_NAME,-- 转出医师签名

       cast(
           nvl(
             (
               select max(a.log_date_time) keep (
                        dense_rank first order by
                        abs(cast(a.log_date_time as date) - cast(x.createon as date)),
                        a.log_date_time
                    )
                 from his.adt_log a
                where a.patient_id = x.patient_id
                  and a.visit_id = x.p_inpatient_times
                  and a.action = 'D'
             ),
             x.createon
           ) as date
       ) as INTO_DATE,-- 转入日期时间  是 　YYYYMMDD HHMISS

       substr(
           nvl(
             (
               select dd.dept_name
                 from his.dept_dict dd
                where dd.dept_code = (
                        select max(a.dept_code) keep (
                                   dense_rank first order by
                                   abs(cast(a.log_date_time as date) - cast(x.createon as date)),
                                   a.log_date_time
                               )
                          from his.adt_log a
                         where a.patient_id = x.patient_id
                           and a.visit_id = x.p_inpatient_times
                           and a.action = 'D'
                     )
                  and rownum = 1
             ),
             x.p_dept_name
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as INTO_DEP_NAME,-- 转入科室  是

       substr(
           (
             select sd.name
               from his.staff_dict sd
              where sd.emp_no = (
                      select max(a.operator_no) keep (
                                 dense_rank first order by
                                 abs(cast(a.log_date_time as date) - cast(x.createon as date)),
                                 a.log_date_time
                             )
                        from his.adt_log a
                       where a.patient_id = x.patient_id
                         and a.visit_id = x.p_inpatient_times
                         and a.action = 'D'
                   )
                and rownum = 1
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as INTO_DOC_NAME,-- 转入医师签名

       nvl(
           (
             select dd.qmpt_code
               from his.dept_dict dd
              where dd.dept_code = (
                      select max(a.dept_code) keep (
                                 dense_rank first order by
                                 abs(cast(a.log_date_time as date) - cast(x.createon as date)),
                                 a.log_date_time
                             )
                        from his.adt_log a
                       where a.patient_id = x.patient_id
                         and a.visit_id = x.p_inpatient_times
                         and a.action = 'E'
                   )
                and rownum = 1
           ),
           x.p_dept_code
       ) as ROLL_OUT_DEP_CODE,-- 转出科室代码  是 新增

       nvl(x.p_name, x.name) as NAME,--  患者姓名  是 通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项

       decode(nvl(x.p_sex, x.sex), '男', '1', '女', '2', '未知', '0', '9') as SEX_CODE,--  患者性别代码  是 值域：0未知，1男，2女，9不明，通过比对国家数据集增加的数据项

       nvl(x.id_no, '000000000000000000') as ID_NUM --  患者身份证件号码  是 全部身份证件号码填写到该字段

from (
       select t.uhid,
              t.p_inpatient_no,
              t.p_inpatient_times,
              t.p_dept_code,
              t.p_dept_name,
              t.p_are_name,
              t.p_bedno,
              t.p_name,
              t.p_sex,
              t.p_clinic_id,
              tt.patient_id,
              tt.name,
              tt.sex,
              tt.id_no,
              t1.id as doc_id,
              t1.doc_title,
              t1.doc_type_name,
              t1.createon,
              t3.Zlgcms,
              t3.Mqqk,
              t3.Zkmd,
              t3.Zrzljh,
              dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1) as content_text,
              d.diagnosis_desc,
              d.diagnosis_code
         from mtl.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX t

         left join his.pat_master_index tt
                on t.p_inpatient_no = tt.inp_no

         inner join his.pat_visit pv
                 on pv.patient_id = tt.patient_id
                and pv.visit_id = t.p_inpatient_times
                and pv.discharge_date_time >= to_date('2021-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
                and pv.discharge_date_time <  to_date('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')

         inner join mtl.EPR_INPATIENT t1
                 on t.UHID = t1.UHID
                and t1.doc_type_name = '转科记录'

         left join mtl.EMRSD42 T3
                on T3.段落编号 = T1.ID

         left join MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT t4
                on t4.UHID = t.UHID
               and t4.段落编号 = T1.ID

         left join his.diagnosis d
                on d.patient_id = tt.patient_id
               and d.visit_id = t.p_inpatient_times
               and d.diagnosis_type = '3'
               and d.diagnosis_no = '1'
     ) x

V_EMR_HOS_CONSUL_RECORD.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_HOS_CONSUL_RECORD" ("ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "ADMISSION_ID", "DEPT_CODE", "DEP_NAME", "AREA_NAME", "WARD_NUM", "SICKBED_NUM", "MEDICAL_RECORDS_SUNNARY", "DIA_TREAT_NAME", "TREAT_NOTE", "CONSULTATION_TYPE", "CONSULTATION_REASON", "CONSULTATION_APP_DOC_NAME", "CONSULTATION_APP_DEP", "CONSULTATION_APP_ORG_NAME", "CONSULTATION_APPLAY_DATE", "CONSULTATION_OPINION", "CONSULTATION_DOC_NAME", "CONSULTATION_DEP_NAME", "CONSULTATION_DOC_ORG_NAME", "CONSULTATION_ORG_NAME", "CONSULTATION_DATE") AS 
  select substr(
           '49557032X'||'|'||t.patient_id||'|'||t.visit_id||'|'||
           t.consultation_id||'|'||
           nvl(t1.consultation_dept, '0')||'|'||
           nvl(t1.SUB_ID, '0'),
           1,
           100
       ) as ID,--  内码  是 主键

       '49557032X' as ORG_CODE,--  医院组织机构代码  是 必填、机构验证，有组织机构代码的传代码；无组织机构代码的上传编码

       '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,--  医院名称  是 必填，填写标准医院名称，每次上传的医院名称必须一致

       '370104' as DISTRICT_CODE,-- 所属行政区划  是 按机构所在的行政区划（区县）

       'INSERT' as EXCHANGE_TYPE,-- 交换类型  是 INSERT：向平台传新数据时；UPDATE：向平台更新某条数据时；DELETE：从平台删除某条数据时；ADDHIS :向平台补充历史数据

       cast(systimestamp as timestamp) as SYSTEM_TIME,-- 数据上传时间戳 是

       t.patient_id||'|'||t.visit_id as ADMISSION_ID,--  住院唯一标示号 是

       nvl(
           (select ks.qmpt_code
              from his.dept_dict ks
             where ks.dept_code = nvl(t.consultation_dept, nvl(t2.dept_discharge_from, t2.dept_admission_to))
               and rownum = 1),
           nvl(t.consultation_dept, nvl(t2.dept_discharge_from, t2.dept_admission_to))
       ) as DEPT_CODE,-- 科室代码  是 省级科室值域标准

       nvl(
           (select ks.dept_name
              from his.dept_dict ks
             where ks.dept_code = nvl(t.consultation_dept, nvl(t2.dept_discharge_from, t2.dept_admission_to))
               and rownum = 1),
           (select ks.qmpt_name
              from his.dept_dict ks
             where ks.dept_code = nvl(t.consultation_dept, nvl(t2.dept_discharge_from, t2.dept_admission_to))
               and rownum = 1)
       ) as DEP_NAME,--  科室名称  是

       t2.discharge_ward_code as AREA_NAME,-- 病区名称

       cast(null as varchar2(10)) as WARD_NUM,--  病房号

       substr(t2.discharge_bed_no, 1, 10) as SICKBED_NUM,-- 病床号

       substr(
           nvl(t.consultation_explain, '-'),
           1,
           2000
       ) as MEDICAL_RECORDS_SUNNARY,-- 病历摘要  是 病情以及治疗情况概述

       substr(
           nvl(t1.consultation_idea, '-'),
           1,
           2000
       ) as DIA_TREAT_NAME,--  诊疗过程名称  是

       substr(
           nvl(t1.consultation_idea, '-'),
           1,
           2000
       ) as TREAT_NOTE,--  诊疗过程描述  是

       case
         when trim(t.consultation_type) in ('1','2','3','4','5')
           then trim(t.consultation_type)
         when regexp_like(t.consultation_type, '急')
           then '1'
         when regexp_like(t.consultation_type, '院外')
           then '3'
         when regexp_like(t.consultation_type, '多科|多学科|MDT')
           then '4'
         when regexp_like(t.consultation_type, '指名')
           then '5'
         else '2'
       end as CONSULTATION_TYPE,-- 会诊类型  是 1：急会诊 2：普通会诊 3：院外会诊4：多科会诊 5：指名会诊

       substr(
           nvl(t.consultation_explain, '-'),
           1,
           2000
       ) as CONSULTATION_REASON,-- 会诊原因和目的 是

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select yg.name
                  from his.staff_dict yg
                 where yg.emp_no = t.consultation_apply_doctor
                   and rownum = 1),
               t.consultation_apply_doctor
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as CONSULTATION_APP_DOC_NAME,-- 会诊申请医师签名  是

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select ks.dept_name
                  from his.dept_dict ks
                 where ks.dept_code = t.consultation_dept
                   and rownum = 1),
               t.consultation_dept
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as CONSULTATION_APP_DEP,--  会诊申请科室名称

       '山东省第二人民医院' as CONSULTATION_APP_ORG_NAME,-- 会诊申请医疗机构名称

       cast(nvl(t.apply_date_time, t.consultation_date_time) as date) as CONSULTATION_APPLAY_DATE,--  发起会诊申请时间  是 YYYYMMDD HHMISS

       substr(
           nvl(t1.consultation_idea, '-'),
           1,
           2000
       ) as CONSULTATION_OPINION,--  会诊意见和建议 是

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select yg.name
                  from his.staff_dict yg
                 where yg.emp_no = t1.consultation_doctor
                   and rownum = 1),
               t1.consultation_doctor
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as CONSULTATION_DOC_NAME,-- 会诊医师签名

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select ks.dept_name
                  from his.dept_dict ks
                 where ks.dept_code = t1.consultation_dept
                   and rownum = 1),
               t1.consultation_dept
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as CONSULTATION_DEP_NAME,-- 会诊科室名称  是

       '山东省第二人民医院' as CONSULTATION_DOC_ORG_NAME,-- 会诊医师所在医疗机构名称

       '山东省第二人民医院' as CONSULTATION_ORG_NAME,-- 会诊所在医疗机构名称    会诊地点(网络会诊填写申请机构地址)

       cast(nvl(t.consultation_date_time, t.apply_date_time) as date) as CONSULTATION_DATE --会诊日期时间  是 YYYYMMDD HHMISS

from his.consultation_doctor_master t

inner join his.consultation_doctor_detail t1
        on t.consultation_id = t1.consultation_id

left join his.pat_visit t2
       on t.patient_id = t2.patient_id
      and t.visit_id = t2.visit_id

where t2.discharge_date_time >= to_date('2021-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
  and t2.discharge_date_time <  to_date('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')

V_EMR_HOS_DIFFIC_CASE_DISCUSS.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_HOS_DIFFIC_CASE_DISCUSS" ("ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "ADMISSION_UN_NUM", "DEP_NAME", "DEP_CODE", "AREA_NAME", "WARD_NUM", "SICKBED_NUM", "DISCUSS_DATE", "DISCUSS_ADDRESS", "HOET_NAME", "DISCUSS_PEOPLE_LIST", "DISCUSS_OPINION", "FOUR_DIAGNOSIS", "SYN_DIFFER_DES", "CH_MED_PRES_DA_CONTENT", "MEDICATION_METHOD", "HOST_OPINION", "DOC_NAME", "ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN_NAME", "CHIEF_DOCTOR_NAME") AS 
  select substr('49557032X'||'|'||t.uhid||'|'||t1.id, 1, 100) as ID,--  内码  是 主键

       '49557032X' as ORG_CODE,--  医院组织机构代码  是 必填

       '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,--  医院名称  是 必填

       '370104' as DISTRICT_CODE,-- 所属行政区划  是 按机构所在的行政区划（区县）

       'ADDHIS' as EXCHANGE_TYPE,-- 交换类型  是 INSERT：向平台传新数据时 UPDATE：向平台更新某条数据时 DELETE：从平台删除某条数据时 ADDHIS :向平台补充历史数据

       cast(systimestamp as timestamp) as SYSTEM_TIME,-- 数据上传时间戳 是

       substr(
           nvl(ttt.patient_id||'|'||ttt.visit_id, t.p_inpatient_no||'|'||t.p_inpatient_times),
           1,
           50
       ) as ADMISSION_UN_NUM,--  住院唯一标示号 是

       nvl(
           (select ks.qmpt_name
              from his.dept_dict ks
             where ks.dept_code = t.p_dept_code
               and rownum = 1),
           t.p_dept_name
       ) as DEP_NAME,--  科室名称  是

       nvl(
           (select ks.qmpt_code
              from his.dept_dict ks
             where ks.dept_code = t.p_dept_code
               and rownum = 1),
           t.p_dept_code
       ) as DEP_CODE,--  科室代码    按平台值域填写

       t.p_Are_Name as AREA_NAME,-- 病区名称

       cast(null as varchar2(10)) as WARD_NUM,--  病房号

       substr(t.P_BEDNO, 1, 10) as SICKBED_NUM,-- 病床号

       nvl(
           case
             /* 格式1：讨论日期：2020-12-28 16：00 / 2021-03-18 18:00 */
             when regexp_substr(
                    dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
                    '(讨论日期|讨论时间)[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([0-9]{4}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[[:space:]]+[0-9]{1,2}[：:][0-9]{2})',
                    1, 1, 'n', 2
                  ) is not null
             then to_date(
                    replace(
                      replace(
                        replace(
                          regexp_substr(
                            dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
                            '(讨论日期|讨论时间)[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([0-9]{4}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[[:space:]]+[0-9]{1,2}[：:][0-9]{2})',
                            1, 1, 'n', 2
                          ),
                          '/', '-'
                        ),
                        '.', '-'
                      ),
                      '：', ':'
                    ),
                    'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi'
                  )

             /* 格式2：讨论日期：2020年12月30日 14时00分 */
             when regexp_substr(
                    dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
                    '(讨论日期|讨论时间)[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([0-9]{4}年[0-9]{1,2}月[0-9]{1,2}日[[:space:]]*[0-9]{1,2}时[0-9]{1,2}分)',
                    1, 1, 'n', 2
                  ) is not null
             then to_date(
                    replace(
                      replace(
                        replace(
                          replace(
                            replace(
                              regexp_substr(
                                dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
                                '(讨论日期|讨论时间)[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([0-9]{4}年[0-9]{1,2}月[0-9]{1,2}日[[:space:]]*[0-9]{1,2}时[0-9]{1,2}分)',
                                1, 1, 'n', 2
                              ),
                              '年', '-'
                            ),
                            '月', '-'
                          ),
                          '日', ' '
                        ),
                        '时', ':'
                      ),
                      '分', ''
                    ),
                    'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi'
                  )

             /* 格式3：2021-03-17 10:00 在……主持下 */
             when regexp_substr(
                    dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
                    '([0-9]{4}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[[:space:]]+[0-9]{1,2}[：:][0-9]{2})[[:space:]]*在',
                    1, 1, 'n', 1
                  ) is not null
             then to_date(
                    replace(
                      replace(
                        replace(
                          regexp_substr(
                            dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
                            '([0-9]{4}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[[:space:]]+[0-9]{1,2}[：:][0-9]{2})[[:space:]]*在',
                            1, 1, 'n', 1
                          ),
                          '/', '-'
                        ),
                        '.', '-'
                      ),
                      '：', ':'
                    ),
                    'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi'
                  )

             /* 格式4：只有日期，例如 讨论日期：2021-01-06 / 2021.04.07 */
             when regexp_substr(
                    dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
                    '(讨论日期|讨论时间)[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([0-9]{4}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[-./][0-9]{1,2})',
                    1, 1, 'n', 2
                  ) is not null
             then to_date(
                    replace(
                      replace(
                        regexp_substr(
                          dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
                          '(讨论日期|讨论时间)[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([0-9]{4}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[-./][0-9]{1,2})',
                          1, 1, 'n', 2
                        ),
                        '/', '-'
                      ),
                      '.', '-'
                    ),
                    'yyyy-mm-dd'
                  )

             /* 格式5：2021年3月17日下午15时 / 2021年4月26日上午11时 */
             when regexp_substr(
                    dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
                    '([0-9]{4}年[0-9]{1,2}月[0-9]{1,2}日[[:space:]]*(上午|下午)?[0-9]{1,2}时)',
                    1, 1, 'n', 1
                  ) is not null
             then to_date(
                    replace(
                      replace(
                        replace(
                          replace(
                            replace(
                              regexp_replace(
                                regexp_substr(
                                  dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
                                  '([0-9]{4}年[0-9]{1,2}月[0-9]{1,2}日[[:space:]]*(上午|下午)?[0-9]{1,2}时)',
                                  1, 1, 'n', 1
                                ),
                                '上午|下午',
                                ''
                              ),
                              '年', '-'
                            ),
                            '月', '-'
                          ),
                          '日', ' '
                        ),
                        '时', ':00'
                      ),
                      '分', ''
                    ),
                    'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi'
                  )
           end,
           cast(t1.Createon as date)
       ) as DISCUSS_DATE,--  讨论日期时间  是

       substr(
         nvl(
           t3.tldd,
           nvl(
             regexp_substr(
               dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
               '讨论地点[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([^[:cntrl:]]+)',
               1, 1, 'n', 1
             ),
             nvl(t1.Doc_Dept_Name, t.p_dept_name) || '医生办公室'
           )
         ),
         1,
         50
       ) as DISCUSS_ADDRESS,-- 讨论地点  是

      nvl( substr(
         nvl(
           t3.Zcrxm,
           regexp_replace(
             nvl(
               regexp_substr(
                 dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
                 '主持人[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([^[:cntrl:]]{2,30})',
                 1, 1, 'n', 1
               ),
               regexp_substr(
                 dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
                 '在[^，,。；;]{0,40}主持下',
                 1, 1, 'n'
               )
             ),
             '^在|的?主持下$|科主任|主任医师|副主任医师|主任|副主任|主治医师|住院医师|医师|[[:space:]。]+',
             ''
           )
         ),
         1,
         50
       ) ,t1.MODIFIEDBY) as HOET_NAME,-- 主持人姓名 是
       substr(
         nvl(
           t3.Cjtlrymd,
           nvl(
             regexp_substr(
               dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
               '(参加人员|参与人员)[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(具体讨论意见|讨论过程|主持人小结|讨论结论|$)',
               1, 1, 'n', 2
             ),
             case
               when regexp_like(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1), '全科人员') then '全科人员'
               when regexp_like(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1), '多学科会诊|MDT') then '多学科会诊人员'
               else '-'
             end
           )
         ),
         1,
         200
       ) as DISCUSS_PEOPLE_LIST,-- 参加讨论人员名单

       nvl( substr(
         nvl(
           t3.tlyj,
           nvl(
             regexp_substr(
               dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
               '(具体讨论意见|讨论过程|讨论结论如下|讨论结果如下|讨论总结如下)[[:space:]]*[:：]?[[:space:]]*(.*?)(主持人小结意见|主持人小结|主持人签名|记录医师签名|/[[:space:]]*[^/[:cntrl:]]*$|$)',
               1, 1, 'n', 2
             ),
             dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1)
           )
         ),
         1,
         2000
       ),'-') as DISCUSS_OPINION,-- 讨论意见  是

       substr(nullif(t3.Zyszgcjg, ''), 1, 1000) as FOUR_DIAGNOSIS,--  中医“四诊”观察结果

       substr(nullif(t3.Zyszgcjg, ''), 1, 2000) as SYN_DIFFER_DES,--  辨证论治详细描述

       cast(null as varchar2(1000)) as CH_MED_PRES_DA_CONTENT,--  中药处方医嘱内容

       substr(nullif(t3.zyyyff, ''), 1, 100) as MEDICATION_METHOD,-- 中药用药方法

       substr(
         nvl(
           t3.Zcrzjyj,
           nvl(
             regexp_substr(
               dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
               '主持人[[:space:]]*小[[:space:]]*结(意见)?[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(主持人签名|记录医师签名|/[[:space:]]*[^/[:cntrl:]]*$|$)',
               1, 1, 'n', 2
             ),
             dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1)
           )
         ),
         1,
         2000
       ) as HOST_OPINION,--  主持人总结意见

       substr(
         nvl(
           regexp_substr(
             dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
             '记录医师签名[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([^[:cntrl:][:space:]/]+)',
             1, 1, 'n', 1
           ),
           nvl(
             regexp_substr(
               dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
               '/[[:space:]]*([^/[:cntrl:][:space:]]+)[[:space:]]*$',
               1, 1, 'n', 1
             ),
             nvl(
               (select sd.name
                  from his.staff_dict sd
                 where sd.emp_no = nvl(t1.Modifiedby, t1.Createby)
                   and rownum = 1),
               nvl(t1.Modifiedby, t1.Createby)
             )
           )
         ),
         1,
         50
       ) as DOC_NAME,--  医师签名

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select sd.name
                  from his.staff_dict sd
                 where sd.emp_no = ttt.ATTENDING_DOCTOR
                   and rownum = 1),
               ttt.ATTENDING_DOCTOR
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN_NAME,--  主治医师签名    主治医师签名

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select sd.name
                  from his.staff_dict sd
                 where sd.emp_no = ttt.Director
                   and rownum = 1),
               ttt.Director
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as CHIEF_DOCTOR_NAME --主任医师姓名

from  mtl.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX t

left join his.pat_master_index tt
       on tt.inp_no = t.p_inpatient_no

left join his.pat_visit ttt
       on tt.patient_id = ttt.patient_id
      and t.p_inpatient_times = ttt.visit_id

inner JOIN mtl.EPR_INPATIENT t1

       and t1.doc_title like '%疑难病例%'

left join mtl.EMRSD40 T3
