where ttt.discharge_date_time >= to_date('2021-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
  and ttt.discharge_date_time <  to_date('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')

V_EMR_HOS_DND_RECORD.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_HOS_DND_RECORD" ("ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "ADMISSION_ID", "DEP_NAME", "DEP_CODE", "AREA_NAME", "WARD_NUM", "SICKBED_NUM", "DISCUSS_DATE", "DISCUSS_ADDRESS", "HOET_NAME", "DISCUSS_PEOPLE_LIST", "PROF_TECH_CATE_CODE", "DIRECT_CAUSE_DEATH_NAME", "DIRECT_CAUSE_DEATH_CODE", "DEATH_DIAG_NAME", "DEATH_DIAG_CODE", "FAMILY_AGREE_AUTO_SIGN", "DEATH_DISCUSS_RECORD", "HOST_OPINION", "ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN_NAME", "CHIEF_DOCTOR_NAME", "SIGN_DATE") AS 
  select substr('49557032X'||'|'||t.uhid||'|'||t1.id, 1, 100) as ID,--  内码  是 主键

       '49557032X' as ORG_CODE,--  医院组织机构代码  是 必填、机构验证，有组织机构代码的传代码；无组织机构代码的上传编码

       '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,--  医院名称  是 必填，填写标准医院名称，每次上传的医院名称必须一致

       '370104' as DISTRICT_CODE,-- 所属行政区划  是 按机构所在的行政区划（区县）

       'ADDHIS' as EXCHANGE_TYPE,-- 交换类型  是 INSERT：向平台传新数据时 UPDATE：向平台更新某条数据时 DELETE：从平台删除某条数据时 ADDHIS :向平台补充历史数据

       cast(systimestamp as timestamp) as SYSTEM_TIME,-- 数据上传时间戳 是

       substr(t.p_clinic_id||'|'||t.P_INPATIENT_TIMES, 1, 50) as ADMISSION_ID,--  住院唯一标示号 是

       t.p_dept_name as DEP_NAME,--  科室名称  是 按照医院内部名称填写

       nvl(
           (select ks.qmpt_code
              from his.dept_dict ks
             where ks.dept_code = t.p_dept_code
               and rownum = 1),
           t.p_dept_code
       ) as DEP_CODE,--  科室代码    按平台值域填写

       t.P_ARE_NAME as AREA_NAME,-- 病区名称

       cast(null as varchar2(10)) as WARD_NUM,--  病房号

       substr(t.p_Bedno, 1, 10) as SICKBED_NUM,-- 病床号

       nvl(
         to_date(
           regexp_substr(
             dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
             '([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{1,2}-[0-9]{1,2}[[:space:]]+[0-9]{1,2}:[0-9]{2})[[:space:]]*[,，][[:space:]]*在',
             1, 1, 'n', 1
           ),
           'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi'
         ),
         cast(t1.doc_create_date as date)
       ) as DISCUSS_DATE,--  讨论日期时间  是 　YYYYMMDD HHMISS

       substr(
           nvl(t3.tldd, t1.Doc_Dept_Name||'医生办公室'),
           1,
           50
       ) as DISCUSS_ADDRESS,-- 讨论地点  是

     nvl(  substr(
         nvl(
           t3.Zcrxm,
           regexp_replace(
             regexp_substr(
               dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
               '在[^,，。]{2,30}主持下',
               1, 1, 'n'
             ),
             '^在|主持下$|主任医师|副主任医师|主任|副主任|主治医师|医师',
             ''
           )
         ),
         1,
         50
       ),t1.MODIFIEDBY) as HOET_NAME,-- 主持人姓名 是

       substr(
         nvl(
           t3.Cjtlrymd,
           case
             when regexp_like(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1), '全科人员') then '全科人员'
             when regexp_like(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1), '医护人员') then '医护人员'
             else '-'
           end
         ),
         1,
         200
       ) as DISCUSS_PEOPLE_LIST,-- 参加讨论人员名单  是

       case
         when regexp_like(
                (select cd.国标编码
                   from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                  where cd.字典名称 = '专业技术职务类别代码'
                    and cd.院标名称 = (
                        select sd.TITLE
                          from his.staff_dict sd
                         where sd.name = nvl(
                                           t3.zcrxm,
                                           regexp_replace(
                                             regexp_substr(
                                               dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
                                               '在[^,，。]{2,30}主持下',
                                               1, 1, 'n'
                                             ),
                                             '^在|主持下$|主任医师|副主任医师|主任|副主任|主治医师|医师',
                                             ''
                                           )
                                         )
                           and rownum = 1
                    )
                    and rownum = 1),
                '^[0-9]+$'
              )
         then to_number(
                (select cd.国标编码
                   from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                  where cd.字典名称 = '专业技术职务类别代码'
                    and cd.院标名称 = (
                        select sd.TITLE
                          from his.staff_dict sd
                         where sd.name = nvl(
                                           t3.zcrxm,
                                           regexp_replace(
                                             regexp_substr(
                                               dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
                                               '在[^,，。]{2,30}主持下',
                                               1, 1, 'n'
                                             ),
                                             '^在|主持下$|主任医师|副主任医师|主任|副主任|主治医师|医师',
                                             ''
                                           )
                                         )
                           and rownum = 1
                    )
                    and rownum = 1)
              )
       end as PROF_TECH_CATE_CODE,-- 专业技术职务类别代码    主持人的职务类别代码

       substr(
         nvl(
           regexp_substr(
             dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
             '死亡原因[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(死亡诊断[[:space:]]*[:：]|。|；|;)',
             1, 1, 'n', 1
           ),
           nvl(ddd.diagnosis_desc, dddd.diagnosis_desc)
         ),
         1,
         50
       ) as DIRECT_CAUSE_DEATH_NAME,-- 直接死亡原因名称

       case
         when regexp_like(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1), '死因不明') then '3'
         when regexp_like(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1), '非本病') then '2'
         when regexp_like(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1), '死亡原因|死亡诊断|诊断成立|抢救无效.*死亡') then '1'
         else null
       end as DIRECT_CAUSE_DEATH_CODE,-- 直接死亡原因编码    1：本病2：非本病3：死因不明

       substr(
         nvl(
           regexp_substr(
             dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
             '死亡诊断[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(住院期间|治疗过程中|家属|$)',
             1, 1, 'n', 1
           ),
           nvl(ddd.diagnosis_desc, dddd.diagnosis_desc)
         ),
         1,
         50
       ) as DEATH_DIAG_NAME,-- 死亡诊断名称

       substr(
           nvl(ddd.diagnosis_code, dddd.diagnosis_code),
           1,
           11
       ) as DEATH_DIAG_CODE,-- 死亡诊断编码    导致死亡的疾病诊断编码

       case
         when regexp_like(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1), '拒绝.*尸检|拒绝.*尸体解剖|不同意.*尸检|不同意.*尸体解剖') then '0'
         when regexp_like(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1), '同意.*尸检|同意.*尸体解剖') then '1'
         else null
       end as FAMILY_AGREE_AUTO_SIGN,--  家属是否同意尸体解剖标志

       substr(
           nvl(
               nvl(t3.swtljl, dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1)),
               '-'
           ),
           1,
           2000
       ) as DEATH_DISCUSS_RECORD,--  死亡讨论记录  是

       substr(
         nvl(
           t3.zcrzjyj,
           nvl(
             regexp_substr(
               dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
               '(整个住院期间|住院期间治疗合理|分析患者病史)(.*)$',
               1, 1, 'n', 0
             ),
             dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1)
           )
         ),
         1,
         2000
       ) as HOST_OPINION,--  主持人总结意见

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select sd.name
                  from his.staff_dict sd
                 where sd.emp_no = ttt.ATTENDING_DOCTOR
                   and rownum = 1),
               ttt.ATTENDING_DOCTOR
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN_NAME,--  主治医师签名  是 主治医师签名

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select sd.name
                  from his.staff_dict sd
                 where sd.emp_no = ttt.DIRECTOR
                   and rownum = 1),
               ttt.DIRECTOR
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as CHIEF_DOCTOR_NAME,-- 主任医师姓名

       cast(nvl(t1.Modifiedon, t1.doc_create_date) as date) as SIGN_DATE -- 签名日期时间  是 　YYYYMMDD HHMISS

from mtl.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX t

inner join mtl.EPR_INPATIENT t1
   on t.UHID = t1.UHID
  /*and t1.DOC_STATS = '1'*/
  and ( t1.doc_type_name = '死亡病例讨论记录' or t1.doc_title like '%死亡病例讨论记录%')

inner join mtl.EMRSD51 T3
   on T3.段落编号 = T1.ID

left join MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT t4
   on t4.UHID = t.UHID
  and t4.段落编号 = t3.段落编号

left join his.pat_master_index tt
   on t.p_inpatient_no = tt.inp_no

left join his.pat_visit ttt
   on tt.patient_id = ttt.patient_id
  and t.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = ttt.visit_id

left join his.diagnosis ddd
   on tt.patient_id = ddd.patient_id
  and t.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = ddd.visit_id
  and ddd.diagnosis_type = '3'
  and ddd.diagnosis_no = '1'

left join his.diagnosis dddd
   on tt.patient_id = dddd.patient_id
  and t.P_INPATIENT_TIMES = dddd.visit_id
  and dddd.diagnosis_type = '3'
  and dddd.diagnosis_no = '2'

where ttt.discharge_date_time >= to_date('2021-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
  and ttt.discharge_date_time <  to_date('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')

V_EMR_HOS_POSTOPER_RECORD.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_HOS_POSTOPER_RECORD" ("ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "ADMISSION_ID", "DEP_NAME", "DEP_CODE", "AREA_NAME", "WARD_NUM", "SICKBED_NUM", "RECORD_DATE", "NOTES", "DOC_NAME", "SIGN_DATE") AS 
  select substr('49557032X'||'|'||t.uhid||'|'||t1.id, 1, 100) as ID,--  内码  是 主键

       '49557032X' as ORG_CODE,--  医院组织机构代码  是 必填

       '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,--  医院名称  是 必填

       '370104' as DISTRICT_CODE,-- 所属行政区划  是

       'INSERT' as EXCHANGE_TYPE,-- 交换类型  是 INSERT：向平台传新数据时 UPDATE：向平台更新某条数据时 DELETE：从平台删除某条数据时 ADDHIS :向平台补充历史数据

       cast(to_date(to_char(sysdate, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss'), 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') as timestamp) as SYSTEM_TIME,-- 数据上传时间戳 是

       substr(t.p_clinic_id||'|'||t.P_INPATIENT_TIMES, 1, 50) as ADMISSION_ID,--  住院唯一标示号 是

       t.p_Dept_Name as DEP_NAME,--  科室名称  是 按医院内部名称填写

       nvl(
           (select ks.qmpt_code
              from his.dept_dict ks
             where ks.dept_code = t.p_dept_code
               and rownum = 1),
           t.p_dept_code
       ) as DEP_CODE,--  科室代码    按平台值域填写

       t.P_ARE_NAME as AREA_NAME,-- 病区名称

       cast(null as varchar2(10)) as WARD_NUM,--  病房号

       substr(t.p_Bedno, 1, 10) as SICKBED_NUM,-- 病床号

       to_date(to_char(t1.DOC_CREATE_DATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss'), 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') as RECORD_DATE,-- 记录日期时间

       DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1) as NOTES,-- 记录内容  是

       nvl(t1.MODIFIEDBY, t1.CREATEBY) as DOC_NAME,--  医师签名

       to_date(to_char(t1.DOC_TITLE_TIME, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss'), 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') as SIGN_DATE  -- 签名日期时间  是

from mtl.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX t

inner JOIN mtl.EPR_INPATIENT t1
        on t.UHID = t1.UHID
       /*and t1.DOC_STATS = '1'*/
       and (t1.doc_type_name  like '%术后首次病程记录%' or t1.DOC_TITLE like '%术后首次病程记录%')

Join MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT t4
  On t4.UHID = t.UHID
 and t4.段落编号 = T1.ID

where exists (
      select 1
        from his.pat_visit pv
        left join his.pat_master_index pmi
          on pv.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
       where pmi.inp_no = t.p_Inpatient_No
         and pv.visit_id = t.P_INPATIENT_TIMES
         and pv.discharge_date_time >= to_date('2021-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
         and pv.discharge_date_time <  to_date('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
)

V_EMR_HOS_PREOP_DISCUSS.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_HOS_PREOP_DISCUSS" ("ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "ADMISSION_ID", "DEP_NAME", "DEP_CODE", "AREA_NAME", "WARD_NUM", "SICKBED_NUM", "DISCUSS_DATE", "DISCUSS_ADDRESS", "HOET_NAME", "DISCUSS_PEOPLE_LIST", "PROF_TECH_CATE_CODE", "MEDICAL_RECORDS_SUNNARY", "BEFOPER_DCODE", "BEFOPER_DNAME", "DIAGNOSIS_BASIS", "ALLERGY_HISTORY_MARK", "ALLERGY_HISTORY", "AUX_EXAM_RESULT", "SURGICAL_INDICATION", "SURGICAL_CONTRIANDICATIONS", "PERFORM_OPERATION_NAME", "PERFORM_OPERATION_CODE", "PERFORM_OPERATION_PART_NAME", "PERFORM_OPERATION_DATE", "PERFORM_ANES_CODE", "OPERATION_MAIN_POINTS", "PREOPERATIVE_PREPARATION", "SURGICAL_INDICATIONS", "OPERATION_SCHEME", "MATTERS_ATTENTION", "DISCUSS_OPINION", "DISCUSS_CONCLUSION", "SURGERY_NAME", "ANAE_DOCTOR_NAME", "DOC_NAME", "SIGN_DATE") AS 
  select substr(
           '49557032X'||'|'||t.p_clinic_id||'|'||t.p_inpatient_times||'|'||t.uhid||'|'||t1.id,
           1,
           100
       ) as ID,--  内码  是 主键

       '49557032X' as ORG_CODE,--  医院组织机构代码  是 必填

       '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,--  医院名称  是 必填

       '370104' as DISTRICT_CODE,-- 所属行政区划  是 按机构所在的行政区划（区县）

       'INSERT' as EXCHANGE_TYPE,-- 交换类型  是 INSERT：向平台传新数据时 UPDATE：向平台更新某条数据时 DELETE：从平台删除某条数据时 ADDHIS :向平台补充历史数据

       cast(systimestamp as timestamp) as SYSTEM_TIME,-- 数据上传时间戳 是

       t.p_clinic_id||'|'||t.p_inpatient_times
        as ADMISSION_ID,--  住院唯一标示号 是

       nvl(
           (select ks.qmpt_name
              from his.dept_dict ks
             where ks.dept_code = t.p_dept_code
               and rownum = 1),
           t.p_Dept_Name
       ) as DEP_NAME,--  科室名称  是

       nvl(
           (select ks.qmpt_code
              from his.dept_dict ks
             where ks.dept_code = t.p_dept_code
               and rownum = 1),
           t.p_dept_code
       ) as DEP_CODE,--  科室代码    按平台值域填写

       t.P_ARE_NAME as AREA_NAME,-- 病区名称

       cast(null as varchar2(10)) as WARD_NUM,--  病房号

       substr(t.P_BEDNO, 1, 10) as SICKBED_NUM,-- 病床号

       cast(nvl(t1.Doc_Title_Time, t1.Createon) as date) as DISCUSS_DATE,-- 讨论日期时间

       substr(nvl(t3.Tldd, '医生办公室'), 1, 50) as DISCUSS_ADDRESS,-- 讨论地点

       substr(
           case
             when t3.Zcrxm is not null then t3.Zcrxm
             else regexp_replace(
                    regexp_substr(
                      dbms_lob.substr(t5.段落内容, 1500, 1),
                      '术[[:space:]]*前[[:space:]]*讨[[:space:]]*论[[:space:]]*由[[:space:]]*([^，,。；;[:cntrl:]]{2,30})主[[:space:]]*持',
                      1, 1, 'n', 1
                    ),
                    '主任医师|副主任医师|主任|副主任|主治医师|住院医师|医师|科主任|的|[[:space:]]',
                    ''
                  )
           end,
           1,
           50
       ) as HOET_NAME,-- 主持人姓名

       substr(
           regexp_replace(t3.Cjtlrymd, '[、,，;；[:space:]]+', '#'),
           1,
           200
       ) as DISCUSS_PEOPLE_LIST,-- 参加讨论人员名单    　人员之间，使用#分割

       nvl(
         (
           select max(to_number(cd.国标编码))
             from cda.cda_dictionary cd
            where cd.字典名称 = '专业技术职务类别代码'
              and regexp_like(cd.国标编码, '^[0-9]+$')
              and cd.院标名称 = (
                    select max(sd.title)
                      from his.staff_dict sd
                     where sd.name = t3.Zcrxm
                  )
         ),
         6
       ) as PROF_TECH_CATE_CODE,-- 专业技术职务类别代码    　主持人的职称

       substr(
           case
             when t3.Tljl is not null then t3.Tljl
             else nvl(
                    regexp_substr(
                      dbms_lob.substr(t5.段落内容, 1500, 1),
                      '简[[:space:]]*要[[:space:]]*病[[:space:]]*情[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(术[[:space:]]*前[[:space:]]*诊[[:space:]]*断[[:space:]]*[:：]|手[[:space:]]*术[[:space:]]*指[[:space:]]*征[[:space:]]*[:：]|$)',
                      1, 1, 'n', 1
                    ),
                    dbms_lob.substr(t5.段落内容, 1500, 1)
                  )
           end,
           1,
           2000
       ) as MEDICAL_RECORDS_SUNNARY,-- 病历摘要    病情以及治疗情况概述

       substr(
           (
             select max(dd.diagnosis_code) keep (
                      dense_rank first order by
                      case
                        when dd.diagnosis_type = '2' then 1
                        when dd.diagnosis_type = '1' then 2
                        when dd.diagnosis_type = '3' then 3
                        else 9
                      end
                    )
               from his.diagnosis dd
              where dd.patient_id = t.p_clinic_id
                and dd.visit_id = t.p_inpatient_times
                and dd.diagnosis_no = '1'
           ),
           1,
           20
       ) as BEFOPER_DCODE,-- 术前诊断编码

       substr(
           nvl(
               regexp_substr(
                 dbms_lob.substr(t5.段落内容, 1500, 1),
                 '术[[:space:]]*前[[:space:]]*诊[[:space:]]*断[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(手[[:space:]]*术[[:space:]]*指[[:space:]]*征[[:space:]]*[:：]|拟[[:space:]]*施[[:space:]]*手[[:space:]]*术|$)',
                 1, 1, 'n', 1
               ),
               (
                 select max(dd.diagnosis_desc) keep (
                          dense_rank first order by
                          case
                            when dd.diagnosis_type = '2' then 1
                            when dd.diagnosis_type = '1' then 2
                            when dd.diagnosis_type = '3' then 3
                            else 9
                          end
                        )
                   from his.diagnosis dd
                  where dd.patient_id = t.p_clinic_id
                    and dd.visit_id = t.p_inpatient_times
                    and dd.diagnosis_no = '1'
               )
           ),
           1,
           100
       ) as BEFOPER_DNAME,-- 术前诊断名称

       cast(null as varchar2(32)) as DIAGNOSIS_BASIS,-- 诊断依据

       case
         when t4.Gms is not null
          and not regexp_like(dbms_lob.substr(t4.Gms, 1000, 1), '无|否认|未诉|不详')
         then '1'
         else '0'
       end as ALLERGY_HISTORY_MARK,--  过敏史标志

       substr(nvl(dbms_lob.substr(t4.Gms, 1000, 1), '-'), 1, 1000) as ALLERGY_HISTORY,-- 过敏史

       substr(nvl(dbms_lob.substr(t4.Sysjqxjc, 1000, 1), '-'), 1, 1000) as AUX_EXAM_RESULT,-- 辅助检查结果

       substr(
           case
             when t4.Sssyz is not null then t4.Sssyz
             else regexp_substr(
                    dbms_lob.substr(t5.段落内容, 1500, 1),
                    '手[[:space:]]*术[[:space:]]*指[[:space:]]*征[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(拟[[:space:]]*施[[:space:]]*手[[:space:]]*术|拟[[:space:]]*施[[:space:]]*麻[[:space:]]*醉|$)',
                    1, 1, 'n', 1
                  )
           end,
           1,
           100
       ) as SURGICAL_INDICATION,-- 手术适应症

       substr(nvl(t4.Ssjjz, '-'), 1, 100) as SURGICAL_CONTRIANDICATIONS,--  手术禁忌症

       substr(
           nvl(
               regexp_substr(
                 dbms_lob.substr(t5.段落内容, 1500, 1),
                 '拟[[:space:]]*施[[:space:]]*手[[:space:]]*术[[:space:]]*名[[:space:]]*称[[:space:]]*和[[:space:]]*方[[:space:]]*式[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(拟[[:space:]]*施[[:space:]]*麻[[:space:]]*醉|术[[:space:]]*前[[:space:]]*准[[:space:]]*备|$)',
                 1, 1, 'n', 1
               ),
               nvl(o.Operation_Desc, mom.OPERATION_NAME)
           ),
           1,
           100
       ) as PERFORM_OPERATION_NAME,--  拟实施手术及操作名称

       substr(
           nvl(
               nvl(
                   (select cd.国标编码
                      from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                     where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-9手术编码'
                       and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                       and cd.院标名称 = o.Operation_Desc
                       and rownum = 1),
                   (select cd.国标编码
                      from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                     where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-9手术编码'
                       and cd.系统标识 = 'SM'
                       and cd.院标名称 = mom.OPERATION_NAME
                       and rownum = 1)
               ),
               '99.9900'
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as PERFORM_OPERATION_CODE,--  拟实施手术及操作编码

       substr(nvl(t3.Nssssmbbwmc, '-'), 1, 50) as PERFORM_OPERATION_PART_NAME,-- 拟实施手术目标部位名称

       cast(nvl(o.operating_date, mom.START_DATE_TIME) as date) as PERFORM_OPERATION_DATE,--  拟实施手术及操作日期时间    　YYYYMMDD HHMISS

       nvl(
           nvl(
               (select to_number(cd.国标编码)
                  from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                 where cd.字典名称 = '麻醉方法代码表'
                   and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                   and cd.院标名称 = o.ANAESTHESIA_METHOD
                   and regexp_like(cd.国标编码, '^[0-9]+$')
                   and rownum = 1),
               (select to_number(cd.国标编码)
                  from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                 where cd.字典名称 = '麻醉方法代码表'
                   and cd.系统标识 = '手麻'
                   and cd.院标名称 = mom.ANESTHESIA_METHOD
                   and regexp_like(cd.国标编码, '^[0-9]+$')
                   and rownum = 1)
           ),
           9
       ) as PERFORM_ANES_CODE,-- 拟实施麻醉方法代码

       substr(nvl(nvl(t3.Ssyd, t4.ssyd), '-'), 1, 200) as OPERATION_MAIN_POINTS,-- 手术要点

       substr(
           case
             when t3.Sqzb is not null then t3.Sqzb
             when t4.sqzb is not null then t4.sqzb
             else regexp_substr(
                    dbms_lob.substr(t5.段落内容, 1500, 1),
                    '术[[:space:]]*前[[:space:]]*准[[:space:]]*备[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(注[[:space:]]*意[[:space:]]*事[[:space:]]*项[[:space:]]*[:：]|手术者术前查看|$)',
                    1, 1, 'n', 1
                  )
           end,
           1,
           1000
       ) as PREOPERATIVE_PREPARATION,--  术前准备

       substr(
           case
             when t3.Sszz is not null then t3.Sszz
             when t4.sszz is not null then t4.sszz
             else regexp_substr(
                    dbms_lob.substr(t5.段落内容, 1500, 1),
                    '手[[:space:]]*术[[:space:]]*指[[:space:]]*征[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(拟[[:space:]]*施[[:space:]]*手[[:space:]]*术|拟[[:space:]]*施[[:space:]]*麻[[:space:]]*醉|$)',
                    1, 1, 'n', 1
                  )
           end,
           1,
           500
       ) as SURGICAL_INDICATIONS,--  手术指征

       substr(
           case
             when t3.Ssfa is not null then t3.Ssfa
             else regexp_substr(
                    dbms_lob.substr(t5.段落内容, 1500, 1),
                    '拟[[:space:]]*施[[:space:]]*手[[:space:]]*术[[:space:]]*名[[:space:]]*称[[:space:]]*和[[:space:]]*方[[:space:]]*式[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(拟[[:space:]]*施[[:space:]]*麻[[:space:]]*醉|术[[:space:]]*前[[:space:]]*准[[:space:]]*备|$)',
                    1, 1, 'n', 1
                  )
           end,
           1,
           1000
       ) as OPERATION_SCHEME,--  手术方案

       substr(
           case
             when t3.Zysx is not null then t3.Zysx
             when t4.zysx is not null then t4.zysx
             else regexp_substr(
                    dbms_lob.substr(t5.段落内容, 1500, 1),
                    '注[[:space:]]*意[[:space:]]*事[[:space:]]*项[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(手术者术前查看|主持人|$)',
                    1, 1, 'n', 1
                  )
           end,
           1,
           1000
       ) as MATTERS_ATTENTION,-- 注意事项

       substr(
           nvl(
               t3.Tlyj,
               '同意手术治疗，完善术前准备，注意围手术期风险。'
           ),
           1,
           200
       ) as DISCUSS_OPINION,-- 讨论意见

       substr(
           nvl(t3.Tljl, dbms_lob.substr(t5.段落内容, 1500, 1)),
           1,
           2000
       ) as DISCUSS_CONCLUSION,--  讨论结论

       substr(
           nvl(
               nvl(
                   (select sd.name
                      from his.staff_dict sd
                     where sd.user_name = o.operator
                       and rownum = 1),
                   case
                     when regexp_like(mom.SURGEON, '^[0-9]+$') then
                       (select sd.name
                          from his.staff_dict sd
                         where sd.user_name = mom.SURGEON
                           and rownum = 1)
                     else mom.SURGEON
                   end
               ),
               regexp_replace(
                 regexp_substr(
                   dbms_lob.substr(t5.段落内容, 1500, 1),
                   '手术者([^，,。；;[:cntrl:]]{2,30})术前看过患者',
                   1, 1, 'n', 1
                 ),
                 '主任医师|副主任医师|主任|副主任|主治医师|住院医师|医师|[[:space:]]',
                 ''
               )
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as SURGERY_NAME,--  手术者签名

       substr(
           nvl(
               nvl(
                   (select sd.name
                      from his.staff_dict sd
                     where sd.user_name = o.Anesthesia_Doctor
                       and rownum = 1),
                   (select sd.name
                      from his.staff_dict sd
                     where sd.user_name = mom.ANESTHESIA_DOCTOR
                       and rownum = 1)
               ),
               '-'
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as ANAE_DOCTOR_NAME,--  麻醉医师姓名    麻醉医师签名

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select sd.name
                  from his.staff_dict sd
                 where (sd.emp_no = nvl(t1.Modifiedby, t1.Createby)
                        or sd.user_name = nvl(t1.Modifiedby, t1.Createby))
                   and rownum = 1),
               nvl(t1.Modifiedby, t1.Createby)
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as DOC_NAME,--  医师签名

       cast(nvl(t1.Modifiedon, nvl(t1.Doc_Title_Time, t1.Createon)) as date) as SIGN_DATE --签名日期时间

from mtl.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX t

inner join his.pat_visit pv
        on pv.patient_id = t.p_clinic_id
       and pv.visit_id = t.p_inpatient_times
       and pv.discharge_date_time >= to_date('2021-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
       and pv.discharge_date_time <  to_date('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')

inner join mtl.EPR_INPATIENT t1
        on t.UHID = t1.UHID
       /*and t1.DOC_STATS = '1'*/
       and t1.doc_type_name in ('术前小结', '术前讨论')
       and t1.doc_title <> '首次病程记录'

left join mtl.EMRSD47 T3
       on T3.段落编号 = T1.ID

left join mtl.EMRSD46 T4
       on T4.段落编号 = T1.ID

left join mtl.emrsd_content t5
       on t5.UHID = t.UHID
      and t5.段落编号 = t1.ID

left join his.operation o
       on o.patient_id = t.p_clinic_id
      and o.visit_id = t.p_inpatient_times
      and o.operation_no = 1

left join sm.med_operation_master mom
       on mom.patient_id = t.p_clinic_id
      and mom.visit_id = t.p_inpatient_times
      and mom.oper_id = '1'

V_EMR_HOS_SAVE_RECORD.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_HOS_SAVE_RECORD" ("ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "ADMISSION_UN_NUM", "DEPT_CODE", "DEP_NAME", "AREA_NAME", "WARD_NUM", "SICKBED_NUM", "DISEASE", "DISEASE_CODE", "CHANGE_CONDITION", "RESCUE_MEASURES", "OPERATION_CODE", "OPERATION_NAME", "OPERATION_BP_NAME", "INTER_BODY", "OPER_METHODE", "OPER_TIMES", "SALVAGE_START_DATE", "SALVAGE_END_DATE", "CHECK_VERIFY_PRO_NAME", "CHECK_VERIFY_RESULT", "CHECK_VERIFY_QUANT_RESULT", "CHECK_VERIFY_RESULT_CODE", "MATTERS_ATTENTION", "RESCUERS_LIST", "PROF_TECH_CATE_CODE", "PROF_TECH_CATE_NAME", "DOC_NAME", "SIGN_DATE") AS 
  select substr(
           '49557032X'||'|'||nvl(z.patient_id, z.p_clinic_id)||'|'||z.p_inpatient_times||'|'||z.uhid||'|'||z.doc_id,
           1,
           100
       ) as ID,--  内码  是  主键

       '49557032X' as ORG_CODE,--  医院组织机构代码  是  必填、机构验证

       '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,--  医院名称  是  必填，填写标准医院名称

       '370104' as DISTRICT_CODE,-- 所属行政区划  是 按机构所在的行政区划（区县）

       'ADDHIS' as EXCHANGE_TYPE,-- 交换类型  是 INSERT：向平台传新数据时 UPDATE：向平台更新某条数据时 DELETE：从平台删除某条数据时 ADDHIS :向平台补充历史数据

       cast(systimestamp as timestamp) as SYSTEM_TIME,-- 数据上传时间戳 是

       substr(
           nvl(z.patient_id||'|'||z.p_inpatient_times, z.p_inpatient_no||'|'||z.p_inpatient_times),
           1,
           50
       ) as ADMISSION_UN_NUM,--  住院唯一标示号 是

       nvl(
           (select dd.qmpt_code
              from his.dept_dict dd
             where dd.dept_code = z.p_dept_code
               and rownum = 1),
           z.p_dept_code
       ) as DEPT_CODE,-- 科室代码

       nvl(
           (select dd.qmpt_name
              from his.dept_dict dd
             where dd.dept_code = z.p_dept_code
               and rownum = 1),
           z.p_dept_name
       ) as DEP_NAME,--  科室名称  是

       z.p_are_name as AREA_NAME,-- 病区名称

       cast(null as varchar2(10)) as WARD_NUM,--  病房号

       substr(z.p_bedno, 1, 10) as SICKBED_NUM,-- 病床号

       substr(
           nvl(z.diagnosis_desc, '未明确诊断'),
           1,
           50
       ) as DISEASE,-- 疾病诊断名称  是

       substr(
           z.diagnosis_code,
           1,
           12
       ) as DISEASE_CODE,--  疾病诊断编码  是 按照平台值域填写，不做默认兜底

       substr(
           nvl(
               z.Bqbhqk,
               nvl(
                   regexp_substr(
                       z.content_text,
                       '抢[[:space:]]*救[[:space:]]*记[[:space:]]*录[[:space:]]*(.*?)(立即|即刻|给予|予以|嘱|行|反复给予|持续|经抢救|参加抢救人员|参与抢救人员|抢救者|医师签名|$)',
                       1, 1, 'n', 1
                   ),
                   z.content_text
               )
           ),
           1,
           1000
       ) as CHANGE_CONDITION,--  病情变化情况  是

       substr(
           nvl(
               z.Qjcs,
               nvl(
                   regexp_substr(
                       z.content_text,
                       '(立即|即刻|给予|予以|嘱|行|反复给予|持续|经抢救|抢救处理)[[:space:]]*(.*?)(参加抢救人员|参与抢救人员|抢救者|医师签名|$)',
                       1, 1, 'n'
                   ),
                   z.content_text
               )
           ),
           1,
           1000
       ) as RESCUE_MEASURES,-- 抢救措施  是

       cast(null as varchar2(12)) as OPERATION_CODE,--  手术及操作编码，是否将气管插管、胸外按压等作为操作需确认

       cast(null as varchar2(80)) as OPERATION_NAME,--  手术及操作名称，是否将气管插管、胸外按压等作为操作需确认

       cast(null as varchar2(50)) as OPERATION_BP_NAME,-- 手术及操作目标部位名称

       cast(null as varchar2(100)) as INTER_BODY,--  介入物名称

       cast(null as varchar2(2000)) as OPER_METHODE,--  操作方法描述

       cast(null as number(3)) as OPER_TIMES,--  操作次数

       z.salvage_start_calc as SALVAGE_START_DATE,--  抢救开始日期时间  是 YYYYMMDD HHMISS

       cast(
           nvl(
               /* 1. 优先取结构化抢救结束时间 */
               case
                 when regexp_like(z.Qjjsrqsj_txt, '^[0-9]{14}$')
                 then to_date(z.Qjjsrqsj_txt, 'yyyymmddhh24miss')

                 when regexp_like(z.Qjjsrqsj_txt, '^[0-9]{8}$')
                 then to_date(z.Qjjsrqsj_txt, 'yyyymmdd')

                 when regexp_like(
                        z.Qjjsrqsj_txt,
                        '[0-9]{4}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[[:space:]]+[0-9]{1,2}[：:][0-9]{2}[：:][0-9]{2}'
                      )
                 then to_date(
                        replace(
                          replace(
                            replace(
                              regexp_substr(
                                z.Qjjsrqsj_txt,
                                '[0-9]{4}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[[:space:]]+[0-9]{1,2}[：:][0-9]{2}[：:][0-9]{2}',
                                1, 1, 'n'
                              ),
                              '/', '-'
                            ),
                            '.', '-'
                          ),
                          '：', ':'
                        ),
                        'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss'
                      )

                 when regexp_like(
                        z.Qjjsrqsj_txt,
                        '[0-9]{4}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[[:space:]]+[0-9]{1,2}[：:][0-9]{2}'
                      )
                 then to_date(
                        replace(
                          replace(
                            replace(
                              regexp_substr(
                                z.Qjjsrqsj_txt,
                                '[0-9]{4}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[[:space:]]+[0-9]{1,2}[：:][0-9]{2}',
                                1, 1, 'n'
                              ),
                              '/', '-'
                            ),
                            '.', '-'
                          ),
                          '：', ':'
                        ),
                        'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi'
                      )
               end,

               nvl(
                   /* 2. 从正文中提取“抢救成功/停止抢救/宣布临床死亡”附近时间 */
                   case
                     when regexp_substr(
                            z.content_text,
                            '([0-9]{1,2})[：:]([0-9]{2})[分]?[[:space:]]*[^。；;]{0,60}(抢救成功|停止抢救|宣布临床死亡|临床死亡)',
                            1, 1, 'n', 1
                          ) is not null
                     then trunc(z.salvage_start_calc)
                          +
                          (
                            to_number(
                              regexp_substr(
                                z.content_text,
                                '([0-9]{1,2})[：:]([0-9]{2})[分]?[[:space:]]*[^。；;]{0,60}(抢救成功|停止抢救|宣布临床死亡|临床死亡)',
                                1, 1, 'n', 1
                              )
                            ) * 60
                            +
                            to_number(
                              regexp_substr(
                                z.content_text,
                                '([0-9]{1,2})[：:]([0-9]{2})[分]?[[:space:]]*[^。；;]{0,60}(抢救成功|停止抢救|宣布临床死亡|临床死亡)',
                                1, 1, 'n', 2
                              )
                            )
                          ) / 1440
                   end,

                   nvl(
                       /* 3. 文书完成时间只有在开始后 6 小时内才作为结束时间 */
                       case
                         when z.doc_finish_date is not null
                          and z.doc_finish_date > date '1900-01-01'
                          and z.doc_finish_date >= z.salvage_start_calc
                          and z.doc_finish_date <= z.salvage_start_calc + 6 / 24
                         then z.doc_finish_date
                       end,

                       /* 4. 否则默认抢救开始后 20 分钟，避免跨天或相差多天 */
                       z.salvage_start_calc + 20 / 1440
                   )
               )
           ) as date
       ) as SALVAGE_END_DATE,--  抢救结束日期时间  是 YYYYMMDD HHMISS

       substr(nullif(z.jcjyxmmc, ''), 1, 80) as CHECK_VERIFY_PRO_NAME,-- 检查/检验项目名称，是否从正文血气分析等拆分需确认

       substr(nullif(z.Jcjyjg, ''), 1, 1000) as CHECK_VERIFY_RESULT,-- 检查/检验结果，是否从正文血气分析等拆分需确认

       case
         when regexp_like(z.Jcjydljg_txt, '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$')
         then to_number(z.Jcjydljg_txt)
         else cast(null as number(14,4))
       end as CHECK_VERIFY_QUANT_RESULT,-- 检查/检验定量结果

       case
         when regexp_like(z.Jcjyjgdm_txt, '^[123]$')
         then to_number(z.Jcjyjgdm_txt)
         else 3
       end as CHECK_VERIFY_RESULT_CODE,--  检查/检验结果代码   1：阳性  2：阴性  3：其他

       substr(
           nvl(
               z.Zysx,
               regexp_substr(
                   z.content_text,
                   '注[[:space:]]*意[[:space:]]*事[[:space:]]*项[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(参加抢救人员|参与抢救人员|抢救者|医师签名|$)',
                   1, 1, 'n', 1
               )
           ),
           1,
           1000
       ) as MATTERS_ATTENTION,-- 注意事项

       substr(
           regexp_replace(
             regexp_replace(
               regexp_replace(
                 nvl(
                   regexp_substr(
                     z.content_text,
                     '(参加抢救人员|参与抢救人员|抢救者|抢救人员)[[:space:]]*[:：]?[[:space:]]*(.*?)(抢救时|整个抢救过程|患者家属|医师签名|$)',
                     1, 1, 'n', 2
                   ),
                   nvl(z.Cjqjrymd, z.doc_name)
                 ),
                 '主任医师|副主任医师|主治医师|住院医师|主管护师|护师|护士长|护士|医师|医生|等多人|等',
                 ''
               ),
               '[、,，;；及和[:space:]]+',
               '#'
             ),
             '[#。；;]+$',
             ''
           ),
           1,
           200
       ) as RESCUERS_LIST,-- 参加抢救人员名单

       (
         select max(to_number(cd.国标编码))
           from cda.cda_dictionary cd
          where cd.字典名称 = '专业技术职务类别代码'
            and regexp_like(cd.国标编码, '^[0-9]+$')
            and cd.院标名称 = nvl(
                  (select sd.title
                     from his.staff_dict sd
                    where sd.name = z.doc_name
                      and rownum = 1),
                  z.attending_title
                )
       ) as PROF_TECH_CATE_CODE,-- 专业技术职务类别代码，优先按签名医生职称取

       substr(
           nvl(
             (select sd.title
                from his.staff_dict sd
               where sd.name = z.doc_name
                 and rownum = 1),
             z.attending_title
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as PROF_TECH_CATE_NAME,-- 专业技术职务类别名称，优先按签名医生职称取

       substr(
           nvl(z.doc_name, z.attending_name),
           1,
           50
       ) as DOC_NAME,--  医师签名  是 主治医生

       cast(
           nvl(
               case
                 when z.doc_finish_date is not null
                  and z.doc_finish_date > date '1900-01-01'
                 then z.doc_finish_date
               end,
               nvl(
                   case
                     when z.doc_title_time is not null
                      and z.doc_title_time > date '1900-01-01'
                     then z.doc_title_time
                   end,
                   nvl(z.createon, sysdate)
               )
           ) as date
       ) as SIGN_DATE --签名日期时间  是

from (
       select y.*,

              cast(
                nvl(
                    /* 1. 优先取结构化抢救开始时间 */
                    case
                      when regexp_like(y.Qjksrqsj_txt, '^[0-9]{14}$')
                      then to_date(y.Qjksrqsj_txt, 'yyyymmddhh24miss')

                      when regexp_like(y.Qjksrqsj_txt, '^[0-9]{8}$')
                      then to_date(y.Qjksrqsj_txt, 'yyyymmdd')

                      when regexp_like(
                             y.Qjksrqsj_txt,
                             '[0-9]{4}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[[:space:]]+[0-9]{1,2}[：:][0-9]{2}[：:][0-9]{2}'
                           )
                      then to_date(
                             replace(
                               replace(
                                 replace(
                                   regexp_substr(
                                     y.Qjksrqsj_txt,
                                     '[0-9]{4}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[[:space:]]+[0-9]{1,2}[：:][0-9]{2}[：:][0-9]{2}',
                                     1, 1, 'n'
                                   ),
                                   '/', '-'
                                 ),
                                 '.', '-'
                               ),
                               '：', ':'
                             ),
                             'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss'
                           )

                      when regexp_like(
                             y.Qjksrqsj_txt,
                             '[0-9]{4}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[[:space:]]+[0-9]{1,2}[：:][0-9]{2}'
                           )
                      then to_date(
                             replace(
                               replace(
                                 replace(
                                   regexp_substr(
                                     y.Qjksrqsj_txt,
                                     '[0-9]{4}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[[:space:]]+[0-9]{1,2}[：:][0-9]{2}',
                                     1, 1, 'n'
                                   ),
                                   '/', '-'
                                 ),
                                 '.', '-'
                               ),
                               '：', ':'
                             ),
                             'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi'
                           )
                    end,

                    nvl(
                        /* 2. 从正文里提取“昨日/今日/患者/于 03:31”等实际开始时间 */
                        case
                          when regexp_substr(
                                 y.content_text,
                                 '(昨日|今日|于|患者|今晚|凌晨|午后|晚间|今晨)[^0-9]{0,12}([0-9]{1,2})[：:点]([0-9]{2})?',
                                 1, 1, 'n', 2
                               ) is not null
                          then trunc(y.base_date)
                               +
                               case
                                 when regexp_substr(
                                        y.content_text,
                                        '(昨日|今日|于|患者|今晚|凌晨|午后|晚间|今晨)[^0-9]{0,12}([0-9]{1,2})[：:点]([0-9]{2})?',
                                        1, 1, 'n', 1
                                      ) = '昨日'
                                 then -1
                                 else 0
                               end
                               +
                               (
                                 to_number(
                                   regexp_substr(
                                     y.content_text,
                                     '(昨日|今日|于|患者|今晚|凌晨|午后|晚间|今晨)[^0-9]{0,12}([0-9]{1,2})[：:点]([0-9]{2})?',
                                     1, 1, 'n', 2
                                   )
                                 ) * 60
                                 +
                                 nvl(
                                   to_number(
                                     regexp_substr(
                                       y.content_text,
                                       '(昨日|今日|于|患者|今晚|凌晨|午后|晚间|今晨)[^0-9]{0,12}([0-9]{1,2})[：:点]([0-9]{2})?',
                                       1, 1, 'n', 3
                                     )
                                   ),
                                   0
                                 )
                               ) / 1440
                        end,

                        nvl(
                            /* 3. 从“抢救记录”正文后提取第一处 HH:MI */
                            case
                              when regexp_substr(
                                     y.content_text,
                                     '抢[[:space:]]*救[[:space:]]*记[[:space:]]*录.*?([0-9]{1,2})[：:]([0-9]{2})',
                                     1, 1, 'n', 1
                                   ) is not null
                              then trunc(y.base_date)
                                   +
                                   (
                                     to_number(
                                       regexp_substr(
                                         y.content_text,
                                         '抢[[:space:]]*救[[:space:]]*记[[:space:]]*录.*?([0-9]{1,2})[：:]([0-9]{2})',
                                         1, 1, 'n', 1
                                       )
                                     ) * 60
                                     +
                                     to_number(
                                       regexp_substr(
                                         y.content_text,
                                         '抢[[:space:]]*救[[:space:]]*记[[:space:]]*录.*?([0-9]{1,2})[：:]([0-9]{2})',
                                         1, 1, 'n', 2
                                       )
                                     )
                                   ) / 1440
                            end,

                            y.base_date
                        )
                    )
                ) as date
              ) as salvage_start_calc

         from (
                select x.*,

                       cast(
                         nvl(
                           case
                             when regexp_substr(
                                    x.content_text,
                                    '[0-9]{4}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[[:space:]]+[0-9]{1,2}[：:][0-9]{2}',
                                    1, 1, 'n'
                                  ) is not null
                             then to_date(
                                    replace(
                                      replace(
                                        replace(
                                          regexp_substr(
                                            x.content_text,
                                            '[0-9]{4}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[-./][0-9]{1,2}[[:space:]]+[0-9]{1,2}[：:][0-9]{2}',
                                            1, 1, 'n'
                                          ),
                                          '/', '-'
                                        ),
                                        '.', '-'
                                      ),
                                      '：', ':'
                                    ),
                                    'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi'
                                  )
                           end,
                           nvl(x.doc_title_time, x.createon)
                         ) as date
                       ) as base_date

                  from (
                         select t.uhid,
                                t.p_inpatient_no,
                                t.p_inpatient_times,
                                t.p_dept_code,
                                t.p_dept_name,
                                t.p_are_name,
                                t.p_bedno,
                                t.p_clinic_id,
                                pmi.patient_id,
                                t1.id as doc_id,
                                cast(t1.createon as date) as createon,
                                cast(t1.doc_title_time as date) as doc_title_time,
                                cast(t1.doc_finish_date as date) as doc_finish_date,
                                t1.modifiedby,
                                t1.createby,
                                t3.Bqbhqk,
                                t3.Qjcs,
                                trim(to_char(t3.Qjksrqsj)) as Qjksrqsj_txt,
                                trim(to_char(t3.Qjjsrqsj)) as Qjjsrqsj_txt,
                                t3.jcjyxmmc,
                                t3.Jcjyjg,
                                trim(to_char(t3.Jcjydljg)) as Jcjydljg_txt,
                                trim(to_char(t3.Jcjyjgdm)) as Jcjyjgdm_txt,
                                t3.Zysx,
                                t3.Cjqjrymd,
                                dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1) as content_text,

                                (
                                  select max(d.diagnosis_desc) keep (
                                           dense_rank first order by d.diagnosis_date desc nulls last
                                         )
                                    from his.diagnosis d
                                   where d.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
                                     and d.visit_id = t.p_inpatient_times
                                     and d.diagnosis_type = '3'
                                     and d.diagnosis_no = '1'
                                ) as diagnosis_desc,

                                (
                                  select max(d.diagnosis_code) keep (
                                           dense_rank first order by d.diagnosis_date desc nulls last
                                         )
                                    from his.diagnosis d
                                   where d.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
                                     and d.visit_id = t.p_inpatient_times
                                     and d.diagnosis_type = '3'
                                     and d.diagnosis_no = '1'
                                ) as diagnosis_code,

                                nvl(
                                  t1.doc_sign_name,
                                  nvl(
                                    (select sd.name
                                       from his.staff_dict sd
                                      where sd.emp_no = nvl(t1.modifiedby, t1.createby)
                                        and rownum = 1),
                                    (select sd.name
                                       from his.staff_dict sd
                                      where sd.user_name = nvl(t1.modifiedby, t1.createby)
                                        and rownum = 1)
                                  )
                                ) as doc_name,

                                nvl(
                                  (select sd.name
                                     from his.staff_dict sd
                                    where sd.emp_no = pv.attending_doctor
                                      and rownum = 1),
                                  pv.attending_doctor
                                ) as attending_name,

                                (
                                  select sd.title
                                    from his.staff_dict sd
                                   where sd.emp_no = pv.attending_doctor
                                     and rownum = 1
                                ) as attending_title

                           from mtl.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX t

                           left join his.pat_master_index pmi
                                  on t.p_inpatient_no = pmi.inp_no

                           inner join his.pat_visit pv
                                   on pv.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
                                  and pv.visit_id = t.p_inpatient_times
                                  and pv.discharge_date_time >= to_date('2021-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
                                  and pv.discharge_date_time <  to_date('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')

                           inner join mtl.EPR_INPATIENT t1
                                   on t.UHID = t1.UHID
                                  /*and t1.DOC_STATS = '1'*/
                                  and t1.doc_title like '%抢救记录%'

                           left join mtl.EMRSD44 T3
                                  on T3.段落编号 = T1.ID

                           left join MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT t4
                                  on t4.UHID = t.UHID
                                 and t4.段落编号 = t1.id
                       ) x
              ) y
     ) z

V_EMR_HOS_SUCCESSION_RECORD.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_HOS_SUCCESSION_RECORD" ("ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "RECORD_TYPE", "ADMISSION_UN_NUM", "DEPT_CODE", "DEP_NAME", "AREA_NAME", "WARD_NUM", "TREAT_NOTE", "PRESENT_SITUATION", "CURR_DIAG_WE_DIAG_CODE", "CURR_DIAG_WE_DIAG_NAME", "CURR_DIAG_CD_CODE", "CURR_DIAG_CD_NAME", "CURR_DIAG_CSYN_CODE", "CURR_DIAG_CSYN_NAME", "MATTERS_ATTENTION", "SUCCESSOR_DIAG_PLAN", "SUCCESSION_DATE", "SUCCESSION_NAME", "SUCCEED_NAME") AS 
  select substr(
           '49557032X'||'|'||nvl(x.patient_id, x.p_clinic_id)||'|'||x.p_inpatient_times||'|'||x.uhid||'|'||x.doc_id,
           1,
           100
       ) as ID,--  内码  是 主键

       '49557032X' as ORG_CODE,--  医院组织机构代码  是 必填

       '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,--  医院名称  是 必填，

       '370104' as DISTRICT_CODE,-- 所属行政区划  是 按机构所在的行政区划（区县）

       'INSERT' as EXCHANGE_TYPE,-- 交换类型  是 INSERT：向平台传新数据时 UPDATE：向平台更新某条数据时 DELETE：从平台删除某条数据时 ADDHIS :向平台补充历史数据

       cast(systimestamp as timestamp) as SYSTEM_TIME,-- 数据上传时间戳 是

       case
         when regexp_like(x.content_text, '新入院|新入病人|新收') then '1'
         when regexp_like(x.content_text, '病重|病危|危重') then '2'
         when regexp_like(x.content_text, '手术|术前|术后') then '3'
         else '4'
       end as RECORD_TYPE,-- 交接类型  是 1：新入院患者交班2：病重患者 3：手术患者交班4：其他交班

       substr(
           nvl(x.patient_id||'|'||x.p_inpatient_times, x.p_inpatient_no||'|'||x.p_inpatient_times),
           1,
           50
       ) as ADMISSION_UN_NUM,--  住院唯一标示号 是

       nvl(
           (select ks.qmpt_code
              from his.dept_dict ks
             where ks.dept_code = x.p_dept_code
               and rownum = 1),
           x.p_dept_code
       ) as DEPT_CODE,-- 科室代码

       nvl(
           (select ks.qmpt_name
              from his.dept_dict ks
             where ks.dept_code = x.p_dept_code
               and rownum = 1),
           x.p_dept_name
       ) as DEP_NAME,--  科室名称

       x.p_are_name as AREA_NAME,-- 病区名称

       cast(null as varchar2(10)) as WARD_NUM,--  病房号

       substr(
           nvl(
               regexp_substr(
                   x.content_text,
                   '诊[[:space:]]*疗[[:space:]]*经[[:space:]]*过[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(目[[:space:]]*前[[:space:]]*情[[:space:]]*况|现[[:space:]]*病[[:space:]]*情|注[[:space:]]*意[[:space:]]*事[[:space:]]*项|接[[:space:]]*班[[:space:]]*诊[[:space:]]*疗[[:space:]]*计[[:space:]]*划|$)',
                   1, 1, 'n', 1
               ),
               nvl(x.content_text, '-')
           ),
           1,
           2000
       ) as TREAT_NOTE,--  诊疗过程描述

       substr(
           nvl(
               x.MQQK,
               nvl(
                   regexp_substr(
                       x.content_text,
                       '(目[[:space:]]*前[[:space:]]*情[[:space:]]*况|现[[:space:]]*病[[:space:]]*情|病[[:space:]]*情[[:space:]]*变[[:space:]]*化)[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(注[[:space:]]*意[[:space:]]*事[[:space:]]*项|接[[:space:]]*班[[:space:]]*诊[[:space:]]*疗[[:space:]]*计[[:space:]]*划|诊[[:space:]]*疗[[:space:]]*计[[:space:]]*划|$)',
                       1, 1, 'n', 2
                   ),
                   '-'
               )
           ),
           1,
           2000
       ) as PRESENT_SITUATION,-- 目前情况

       substr(x.diagnosis_code, 1, 12) as CURR_DIAG_WE_DIAG_CODE,--  目前诊断-西医诊断编码

       substr(x.diagnosis_desc, 1, 50) as CURR_DIAG_WE_DIAG_NAME,--  目前诊断-西医诊断名称

       cast(null as varchar2(12)) as CURR_DIAG_CD_CODE,-- 目前诊断-中医病名代码

       cast(null as varchar2(50)) as CURR_DIAG_CD_NAME,-- 目前诊断-中医病名名称

       cast(null as varchar2(12)) as CURR_DIAG_CSYN_CODE,-- 目前诊断-中医证候代码

       cast(null as varchar2(50)) as CURR_DIAG_CSYN_NAME,-- 目前诊断-中医证候名称

       substr(
           nvl(
               x.ZYSX,
               nvl(
                   regexp_substr(
                       x.content_text,
                       '注[[:space:]]*意[[:space:]]*事[[:space:]]*项[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(接[[:space:]]*班[[:space:]]*诊[[:space:]]*疗[[:space:]]*计[[:space:]]*划|交班医师|接班医师|医师签名|$)',
                       1, 1, 'n', 1
                   ),
                   '继续观察病情变化，按交接班要求处理。'
               )
           ),
           1,
           1000
       ) as MATTERS_ATTENTION,-- 注意事项

       substr(
           nvl(
               x.HAND_OVER_TREAT_PLAN,
               regexp_substr(
                   x.content_text,
                   '(接[[:space:]]*班[[:space:]]*诊[[:space:]]*疗[[:space:]]*计[[:space:]]*划|诊[[:space:]]*疗[[:space:]]*计[[:space:]]*划|下一步治疗计划|处理意见)[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*(.*?)(交班医师|接班医师|医师签名|$)',
                   1, 1, 'n', 2
               )
           ),
           1,
           1000
       ) as SUCCESSOR_DIAG_PLAN,-- 接班诊疗计划

cast(
  nvl(
    case
      when x.doc_finish_date is not null
       and x.doc_finish_date > date '1900-01-01'
      then x.doc_finish_date
    end,
    nvl(
      case
        when x.doc_title_time is not null
         and x.doc_title_time > date '1900-01-01'
        then x.doc_title_time
      end,
      nvl(
        case
          when x.createon is not null
           and x.createon > date '1900-01-01'
          then x.createon
        end,
        sysdate
      )
    )
  ) as date
) as SUCCESSION_DATE,-- 交接班日期

       substr(
           nvl(
               x.doc_sign_name,
               nvl(
                   (select sd.name
                      from his.staff_dict sd
                     where sd.emp_no = nvl(x.modifiedby, x.createby)
                       and rownum = 1),
                   nvl(
                       (select sd.name
                          from his.staff_dict sd
                         where sd.user_name = nvl(x.modifiedby, x.createby)
                           and rownum = 1),
                       nvl(x.modifiedby, x.createby)
                   )
               )
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as SUCCESSION_NAME,-- 交班者签名

       substr(
           nvl(
               x.HAND_OVER_SIGN,
               regexp_substr(
                   x.content_text,
                   '(接班者签名|接班医师签名|接班医师)[[:space:]]*[:：][[:space:]]*([^[:cntrl:][:space:]]+)',
                   1, 1, 'n', 2
               )
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as SUCCEED_NAME -- 接班者签名

from (
       select t.uhid,
              t.p_inpatient_no,
              t.p_inpatient_times,
              t.p_dept_code,
              t.p_dept_name,
              t.p_are_name,
              t.p_clinic_id,
              pmi.patient_id,
              t1.id as doc_id,
              t1.doc_title,
              t1.doc_type_name,
              t1.createon,
              t1.modifiedby,
              t1.createby,
              t1.doc_finish_date,
              t1.doc_title_time,
              t1.doc_sign_name,
              t3.MQQK,
              t3.ZYSX,
              dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1) as content_text,

              (
                select max(j.HAND_OVER_TREAT_PLAN)
                  from cda.t_jbjl j
                 where j.OUTHOS_NO = t.p_clinic_id
                   and j.INHOS_NUM = t.p_inpatient_times
              ) as HAND_OVER_TREAT_PLAN,

              (
                select max(j.HAND_OVER_SIGN)
                  from cda.t_jbjl j
                 where j.OUTHOS_NO = t.p_clinic_id
                   and j.INHOS_NUM = t.p_inpatient_times
              ) as HAND_OVER_SIGN,

              (
                select max(d.diagnosis_code) keep (
                         dense_rank first order by d.diagnosis_date desc nulls last
                       )
                  from his.diagnosis d
                 where d.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
                   and d.visit_id = t.p_inpatient_times
                   and d.diagnosis_type = '3'
                   and d.diagnosis_no = '1'
              ) as diagnosis_code,

              (
                select max(d.diagnosis_desc) keep (
                         dense_rank first order by d.diagnosis_date desc nulls last
                       )
                  from his.diagnosis d
                 where d.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
                   and d.visit_id = t.p_inpatient_times
                   and d.diagnosis_type = '3'
                   and d.diagnosis_no = '1'
              ) as diagnosis_desc

         from mtl.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX t

         left join his.pat_master_index pmi
                on t.p_inpatient_no = pmi.inp_no

         inner join his.pat_visit pv
                 on pv.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
                and pv.visit_id = t.p_inpatient_times
                and pv.discharge_date_time >= to_date('2021-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
                and pv.discharge_date_time <  to_date('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')

         inner join mtl.EPR_INPATIENT t1
                 on t.UHID = t1.UHID
                /*and t1.DOC_STATS = '1'*/
                and t1.doc_title in ('交班记录')

         left join mtl.EMRSD41 T3
                on T3.段落编号 = T1.ID

         left join MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT t4
                on t4.UHID = t.UHID
               and t4.段落编号 = T1.ID
     ) x

       case regexp_replace(trim(nvl(to_char(coalesce(a.charge_type, b.charge_type)), '')), '[[:space:]]+', '')
           when '职工医保' then '10'
           when '省直医保' then '10'
           when '省内职工' then '11'
           when '省外职工' then '12'
           when '居民医保' then '20'
           when '省内居民' then '21'
           when '学生医保' then '21'
           when '儿童医保' then '21'
           when '新农合' then '21'
           when '省外居民' then '22'
           when '异地医保' then '22'
           when '贫困救助' then '40'
           when '商业医疗保险' then '50'
           when '全公费' then '60'
           when '自费' then '70'
           when '全自费' then '70'
           when '工伤' then '80'
           when '新生儿' then '99'
           when '离休医保' then '99'
           when '干部保健' then '99'
           else '99'
       end as CHARGE_MODE_CODE,--医疗付费方式代码；优先取本次住院a.CHARGE_TYPE

           substrb(
               case regexp_replace(trim(nvl(to_char(coalesce(a.charge_type, b.charge_type)), '')), '[[:space:]]+', '')
                   when '职工医保' then '职工基本医疗保险'
                   when '省直医保' then '职工基本医疗保险'
                   when '省内职工' then '本市职工基本医疗保险'
                   when '省外职工' then '外埠职工基本医疗保险'
                   when '居民医保' then '居民基本医疗保险'

                   when '自费' then '全自费'

                   when '工伤' then '其他社会保险'
                   when '新生儿' then '其他'

                   when '干部保健' then '其他'

               end,
               1,
               50
           ) as varchar2(50)

                 else null end as char(1)) as IS_USE_HERB,--使用医疗机构中药制剂

       cast(case when to_char(a.chinese_medicine_device) = '1' then '1'
                 when to_char(a.chinese_medicine_device) = '2' then '0'
                 else null end as char(1)) as IS_USE_EQUIP,--使用中医诊疗设备

       cast(case when to_char(a.chinese_medicine_technology) = '1' then '1'
                 when to_char(a.chinese_medicine_technology) = '2' then '0'
                 else null end as char(1)) as IS_USE_TECH,--使用中医诊疗技术

       cast(case when to_char(a.dialectical_care) = '1' then '1'
                 when to_char(a.dialectical_care) = '2' then '0'
                 else null end as char(1)) as IS_DIALECTIAL_NURSING,--辨证施护

       cast(a.zffy as number(10,2)) as TOTAL_AMOUNT_STP,--住院总费用-自付金额

       nvl(a.emer_treat_times, 0) as SAVE_TIMES,--住院患者抢救次数 是
       nvl(a.esc_emer_times, 0) as SAVE_SUCCESS_TIMES,--住院患者抢救成功次数 是

       cast(case when a.death_date_time is not null then '1' else '0' end as char(1)) as IS_DEATH,--死亡标识

       cast(case when nvl(a.infusion_react_times, 0) > 0 then '1' else '0' end as char(1)) as INFUSION_REACTION_MARK,--输液反应标志

       cast(case
                when nvl(a.blood_tran_times, 0) = 0 then '3'
                when nvl(a.blood_tran_react_times, 0) > 0 then '1'
                else '0'
            end as char(1)) as BT_REACTION_MARK,--输血反应标志；3未输

       cast(null as char(1)) as OPERATION_COMPLICATIONS,--手术并发症标识；暂无明确来源

       cast(case when to_char(a.zymosis_indicator) in ('1', '2') then '1' else '0' end as char(1)) as IS_INFECTION,--传染病标识；1已报/2未报均视为有传染病

       cast(case when to_char(a.zymosis_indicator) = '1' then '1' else '0' end as char(1)) as IS_INFECTION_REPORT,--传染病报告上报标识

       cast(case when nvl(a.critical_cond_days, 0) > 0 or to_char(a.serious_indicator) = '1' then '1' else '0' end as char(1)) as IS_CRITICAL,--危重标识

       cast(case when to_char(a.ictus_indicator) = '1' then '1' else '0' end as char(1)) as IS_EMERGENCY,--急症标识；使用住院期间急症标志

       cast(a.death_date_time as date) as DEATH_TIME,--死亡日期时间
       cast(substrb(to_char(a.death_reason), 1, 128) as varchar2(128)) as DEATH_CAUSE,--死亡原因
         cast(
    case
        when a.death_date_time is not null then     cast(substrb(nvl(main_diag_code_cd.国标编码, nvl(main_diag_name_cd.国标编码, main_diag.diagnosis_code)), 1, 100) as varchar2(100))
        else null
    end as varchar2(128)
) as ROOT_DEATH_CODE,--死亡根本原因诊断代码；暂无根本死因来源，暂不填

       cast(null as number(5)) as INFECTIOUSNESS_TIMES,--感染次数；暂无明确来源

       cast(substrb(coalesce(to_char(a.insurance_no), to_char(b.insurance_no), to_char(b.insur_card_no), to_char(b.medical_no)), 1, 128) as varchar2(128)) as INSURANCE_NUM,--医疗保险号；优先本次住院

       cast(decode(a.pat_adm_condition, '1', '1', '2', '2', '3', '3', '4') as char(1)) as IN_CONDITION_CODE,--入院情况代码

       cast(substrb(decode(a.pat_adm_condition, '1', '危重', '2', '急诊', '3', '一般', '其他'), 1, 20) as varchar2(20)) as IN_CONDITION_NAME,--入院情况名称

       cast(null as number(12,2)) as RED_BLOOD_CELL,--输红细胞量；暂无拆分来源
       cast(null as number(12,2)) as PLATELET,--输血小板量；暂无拆分来源
       cast(null as number(12,2)) as PLASMA,--输血浆量；暂无拆分来源
       cast(null as number(12,2)) as WHOLE_BLOOD,--输全血量；暂无拆分来源
       cast(null as number(12,2)) as OTHER_BLOOD,--输其他血制品量；暂无拆分来源

       cast(substrb(to_char(a.director), 1, 32) as varchar2(32)) as DIRECTOR_CODE,--科主任代码；当前保留职工号
       cast(substrb(to_char(director_sd.name), 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as DIRECTOR_NAME,--科主任签名

       cast(substrb(to_char(a.chief_doctor), 1, 32) as varchar2(32)) as CHIEF_PHYSICIAN_CODE,--主任医师代码
       cast(substrb(to_char(chief_sd.name), 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as CHIEF_PHYSICIAN_NAME,--主任医师签名

       cast(substrb(to_char(a.attending_doctor), 1, 32) as varchar2(32)) as ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN_CODE,--主治医师代码
       cast(substrb(to_char(attending_sd.name), 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as ATTENDING_PHYSICIAN_NAME,--主治医师签名

       cast(substrb(to_char(a.doctor_in_charge), 1, 32) as varchar2(32)) as RESIDENT_CODE,--住院医师代码；使用经治医师
       cast(substrb(to_char(resident_sd.name), 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as RESIDENT_NAME,--住院医师签名

       cast(substrb(to_char(a.duty_nurse), 1, 32) as varchar2(32)) as NURSE_CODE,--责任护士代码
       cast(substrb(to_char(nurse_sd.name), 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as NURSE_NAME,--责任护士签名

       cast(substrb(to_char(a.advanced_studies_doctor), 1, 32) as varchar2(32)) as REFRESHER_DOCTORS_CODE,--进修医师代码
       cast(substrb(to_char(refresher_sd.name), 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as REFRESHER_DOCTORS_NAME,--进修医师签名

       cast(substrb(to_char(a.practice_doctor), 1, 32) as varchar2(32)) as INTERN_CODE,--实习医师代码
       cast(substrb(to_char(intern_sd.name), 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as INTERN_NAME,--实习医师签名

       cast(substrb(to_char(a.cataloger), 1, 32) as varchar2(32)) as CODER_CODE,--编码员代码
       cast(substrb(to_char(coder_sd.name), 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as CODER_NAME,--编码员签名
       cast(substrb(to_char(coder_sd.id_no), 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as CODER_IDNUM,--编码员身份证号

       cast(substrb(to_char(a.doctor_of_control_quality), 1, 32) as varchar2(32)) as QCD_CODE,--质控医师代码
       cast(substrb(to_char(qcd_sd.name), 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as QCD_NAME,--质控医师签名

       cast(substrb(to_char(a.nurse_of_control_quality), 1, 32) as varchar2(32)) as QCN_CODE,--质控护士代码
       cast(substrb(to_char(qcn_sd.name), 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as QCN_NAME,--质控护士签名

       cast(substrb(nvl(adm_dept.qmpt_code, a.dept_admission_to), 1, 20) as varchar2(20)) as DEP_CODE,--入院科别代码 是
       cast(substrb(nvl(adm_dept.qmpt_name, adm_dept.dept_name), 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as DEP_NAME,--入院科别名称 是

       cast(substrb(to_char(a.adt_room_no), 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as IN_WORD,--入院病房

       cast(null as varchar2(50)) as TDEP_CODE,--转科科别代码；暂无明确来源
       cast(null as varchar2(50)) as TDEP_NAME,--转科科别；暂无明确来源

       cast(substrb(nvl(dis_dept.qmpt_code, a.dept_discharge_from), 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as ODEP_CODE,--出院科别代码 是
       cast(substrb(nvl(dis_dept.qmpt_name, dis_dept.dept_name), 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as ODEP_NAME,--出院科别 是

       cast(substrb(to_char(a.ddt_room_no), 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as OUT_WORD,--出院病房

       cast(null as varchar2(32)) as CITIZEN_ID,--个人内码；平台自动生成
       cast(null as date) as EFFECTIVE_TIME,--活动发生时间；暂无明确来源
       cast(null as varchar2(32)) as STATUS,--卡片状态；平台自动生成
       cast(a.admission_date_time as DATE) as CREATED_AT,--创建时间；暂取入院时间

       cast('370104' as varchar2(6)) as DISTRICT_CODE,--所属行政区划 是
       cast('ADDHIS' as varchar2(10)) as EXCHANGE_TYPE,--交换类型 是

       cast(null as varchar2(50)) as DEI,--数据交换标识符
       cast(null as varchar2(50)) as NODE_CODE,--节点标识符
       cast(substrb(to_char(a.inp_serial_no), 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as CASE_ID,--院内病案标识码；使用住院流水号
       cast('49557032X' as varchar2(50)) as CASE_ORG_CODE,--病案所属机构编码
       cast(sysdate as DATE) as SYSTEM_TIME,--数据上传时间戳 是
       cast(null as varchar2(36)) as CZRK_ID,--常住人口ID

       sszd_diag.diagnosis_code  as INJURY_CAUSE_CODE,--损伤中毒外部原因疾病编码；暂无明确来源

       cast(null as char(1)) as NURSING_LEVEL_CODE,--护理等级代码；不从护理天数反推
       cast(null as number) as NURSING_LEVEL_TIME,--护理等级时间
       cast(null as varchar2(50)) as NURSING_LEVEL_UNIT,--护理等级单位

       cast(substrb(to_char(resident_sd.name), 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as MAIN_DOC_NAME,--主诊医师签名；暂取经治医师

       cast(null as char(1)) as SINGLE_DISEASE_MG_CODE,--实施单病种管理标志代码；暂无明确来源

       cast(substrb(coalesce(to_char(a.clinical_pathway_finished),
                             case when to_char(a.clinical_pathway_finish) = '1' then '1'
                                  when to_char(a.clinical_pathway_finish) = '2' then '2'
                             end), 1, 1) as char(1)) as PATHWAY_COMPLETION,--临床路径完成情况代码

       cast(null as char(1)) as QUIT_REASON,--退出原因代码；a.QUIT_REASON可能为文本，暂不强转代码

       cast(decode(a.clinical_pathway_variation, '1', '2', '2', '1') as char(1)) as VARIATION_CASE,--变异情况代码；1否2是转换为1有2无

       cast(substrb(to_char(a.variation_reason), 1, 800) as varchar2(800)) as VARIATION_REASON,--变异原因

       cast(substrb(cast(b.district_provinc as varchar2(4000 char)), 1, 70) as varchar2(70)) as JG_PROVINCE,--籍贯-省
       cast(substrb(cast(b.district_city as varchar2(4000 char)), 1, 70) as varchar2(70)) as JG_CITY,--籍贯-市

       cast(null as varchar2(50)) as TDEP_CODE2,--转科科别代码2；暂无明确来源
       cast(null as varchar2(50)) as TDEP_CODE3,--转科科别代码3；暂无明确来源

       bl_diag.diagnosis_code as TUMOR_CODE,--肿瘤学编码；暂无明确来源

       cast(substrb(to_char(cdoctor_leader_sd.name), 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as MEDICAL_TEAM_NAME,--医疗组长签名

       cast(case when to_char(a.hosp_made_medicine_indicator) = '1' then '1'
                 when to_char(a.hosp_made_medicine_indicator) = '2' then '0'
                 else null end as char(1)) as MEDICAL_PREPARATION_FLAG,--使用医疗机构中药制剂标志

       cast(case when to_char(a.chinese_medicine_device) = '1' then '1'
                 when to_char(a.chinese_medicine_device) = '2' then '0'
                 else null end as char(1)) as MEDICAL_DEVICE_FLAG,--使用中医诊疗设备标志

       cast(case when to_char(a.chinese_medicine_technology) = '1' then '1'
                 when to_char(a.chinese_medicine_technology) = '2' then '0'
                 else null end as char(1)) as MEDICAL_TECHNOLOGY_FLAG,--使用中医诊疗技术标志

       cast(substrb(coalesce(to_char(a.referral_hospital), to_char(a.entrance_hospital), to_char(a.trans_hospital)), 1, 70) as varchar2(70)) as REFERRAL_ORG_NAME,--转诊医疗机构名称

       cast(substrb(nvl(outcome_dict.国标编码, '9'), 1, 1) as char(1)) as DIS_OUTCOME_CODE,--出院转归代码 是；暂用出院方式映射转归
       cast(substrb(nvl(outcome_dict.国标名称, '其他'), 1, 10) as varchar2(10)) as DIS_OUTCOME_NAME,--出院转归 是

       cast(decode(a.plan_31_admission, '1', '2', '2', '1', '2') as char(1)) as SFFJHZRY,--是否非计划再入院；1是2否，按31天计划字段转换

       cast(case when to_char(a.daysurgery_indicator) = '1' then '1' else '2' end as char(1)) as SFRJBF,--是否为日间病房；1是2否

       cast(substrb(decode(a.tumor_stage, '0', '1', '1', '2', '2', '3', '3', '4', '4', '5', '9', '6'), 1, 1) as char(1)) as TNMZLFQ,--TNM/肿瘤分期

       cast(substrb(cast(b.social_code as varchar2(4000 char)), 1, 100) as varchar2(100)) as TYSHXYDM,--统一社会信用代码

       cast(substrb(nvl(country_by_code.国标编码, '156'), 1, 100) as varchar2(100)) as GJ,--国籍代码

       cast(nvl(a.breath_mach_times,0) + nvl(a.breath_mach_time2,0) + round(nvl(a.breath_mach_time3,0) / 60, 2) as number(12,2)) as YCHXJSY,--有创呼吸机使用时长；小时

       cast(substrb(to_char(a.spec_level_nurs_days), 1, 100) as varchar2(100)) as TJHLTS,--特级护理天数
       cast(substrb(to_char(a.first_level_nurs_days), 1, 100) as varchar2(100)) as YJHLTS,--一级护理天数
       cast(substrb(to_char(a.second_level_nurs_days), 1, 100) as varchar2(100)) as EJHLTS,--二级护理天数
       cast(substrb(to_char(a.third_level_nurs_days), 1, 100) as varchar2(100)) as SJHLTS,--三级护理天数

       cast(null as varchar2(100)) as ZTXHS,--自体血回输；暂无明确来源

       cast(substrb(nvl(main_diag_code_cd.国标名称, nvl(main_diag_name_cd.国标名称, main_diag.diagnosis_desc)), 1, 100) as varchar2(100)) as ZYZD,--出院诊断-主要诊断名称

       cast(substrb(nvl(main_diag_code_cd.国标编码, nvl(main_diag_name_cd.国标编码, main_diag.diagnosis_code)), 1, 100) as varchar2(100)) as ZYZDJBBM,--出院诊断-主要诊断疾病编码

       cast(substrb(to_char(a.pat_adm_condition), 1, 100) as varchar2(100)) as ZYZDRYBQ--出院诊断-主要诊断入院病情代码；暂无诊断表对应字段，暂用PAT_VISIT入院病情

from his.pat_visit a

left join his.pat_master_index b
       on b.patient_id = a.patient_id

left join (
    select to_char(院标编码) as 院标编码,
           max(to_char(国标编码)) as 国标编码,
           max(to_char(国标名称)) as 国标名称
      from cda.cda_dictionary
     where 字典名称 = '职业代码'
     group by to_char(院标编码)
) occ_dict
       on occ_dict.院标编码 =
          case
              when regexp_replace(trim(to_char(a.occupation)), '[[:space:]]+', '') in
                   ('11','13','17','21','24','27','31','37','51','54','70','80','90')
              then regexp_replace(trim(to_char(a.occupation)), '[[:space:]]+', '')
              when regexp_replace(trim(to_char(b.occupation)), '[[:space:]]+', '') in
                   ('11','13','17','21','24','27','31','37','51','54','70','80','90')
              then regexp_replace(trim(to_char(b.occupation)), '[[:space:]]+', '')
              when regexp_replace(trim(to_char(a.occupation)), '[[:space:]]+', '') = '工人' then '24'
              when regexp_replace(trim(to_char(b.occupation)), '[[:space:]]+', '') = '工人' then '24'
              else '51'
          end

left join (
    select to_char(院标编码) as 院标编码,
           max(to_char(国标编码)) as 国标编码,
           max(to_char(国标名称)) as 国标名称
      from cda.cda_dictionary
     where 字典名称 = '国籍代码'
     group by to_char(院标编码)
) country_by_code
       on country_by_code.院标编码 = upper(trim(to_char(b.citizenship)))

left join (
    select to_char(院标编码) as 院标编码,
           max(to_char(国标编码)) as 国标编码,
           max(to_char(国标名称)) as 国标名称
      from cda.cda_dictionary
     where 字典名称 = '身份证件类型代码'
     group by to_char(院标编码)
) idtype_dict
       on idtype_dict.院标编码 =
          case
              when regexp_like(trim(to_char(b.id_type)), '^[0-9]$')
              then '0' || trim(to_char(b.id_type))
              else trim(to_char(b.id_type))
          end

left join (
    select to_char(院标名称) as 院标名称,
           max(to_char(国标编码)) as 国标编码,
           max(to_char(国标名称)) as 国标名称
      from cda.cda_dictionary
     where 字典名称 = 'ABO血型代码'
     group by to_char(院标名称)
) abo_dict
       on abo_dict.院标名称 = to_char(a.blood_type)

left join (
    select to_char(院标名称) as 院标名称,
           max(to_char(国标编码)) as 国标编码,
           max(to_char(国标名称)) as 国标名称
      from cda.cda_dictionary
     where 字典名称 = 'RH血型代码'
     group by to_char(院标名称)
) rh_dict
       on rh_dict.院标名称 = to_char(a.blood_type_rh)

left join (
    select to_char(院标编码) as 院标编码,
           max(to_char(国标编码)) as 国标编码,
           max(to_char(国标名称)) as 国标名称
      from cda.cda_dictionary
     where 字典名称 = '入院途径代码'
     group by to_char(院标编码)
) adm_type_dict
       on adm_type_dict.院标编码 = to_char(coalesce(a.patient_class, b.patient_class))

left join (
    select to_char(院标编码) as 院标编码,
           max(to_char(国标编码)) as 国标编码,
           max(to_char(国标名称)) as 国标名称
      from cda.cda_dictionary
     where 字典名称 = '家庭关系代码'
     group by to_char(院标编码)
) rel_dict
       on rel_dict.院标编码 = to_char(coalesce(a.relationship, b.relationship))

left join (
    select to_char(院标编码) as 院标编码,
           max(to_char(国标编码)) as 国标编码,
           max(to_char(国标名称)) as 国标名称
      from cda.cda_dictionary
     where 字典名称 = '离院方式代码'
     group by to_char(院标编码)
) discharge_type_dict
       on discharge_type_dict.院标编码 = to_char(a.discharge_disposition)

left join (
    select to_char(院标编码) as 院标编码,
           max(to_char(国标编码)) as 国标编码,
           max(to_char(国标名称)) as 国标名称
      from cda.cda_dictionary
     where 字典名称 = '转归方式代码'
     group by to_char(院标编码)
) outcome_dict
       on outcome_dict.院标编码 = to_char(a.discharge_disposition)

left join (
    select d.patient_id,
           d.visit_id,
           max(to_char(d.diagnosis_code)) keep (dense_rank first order by d.diagnosis_no) as diagnosis_code,
           max(to_char(d.diagnosis_desc)) keep (dense_rank first order by d.diagnosis_no) as diagnosis_desc
      from his.diagnosis d
     where d.diagnosis_type = '3'
       and d.diagnosis_no = '1'
     group by d.patient_id,
              d.visit_id
) main_diag
       on main_diag.patient_id = a.patient_id
      and main_diag.visit_id = a.visit_id

left join (
    select to_char(院标编码) as 院标编码,
           max(to_char(国标编码)) as 国标编码,
           max(to_char(国标名称)) as 国标名称
      from cda.cda_dictionary
     where 字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
       and 系统标识 = 'HIS'
     group by to_char(院标编码)
) main_diag_code_cd
       on main_diag_code_cd.院标编码 = main_diag.diagnosis_code

left join (
    select to_char(院标名称) as 院标名称,
           max(to_char(国标编码)) as 国标编码,
           max(to_char(国标名称)) as 国标名称
      from cda.cda_dictionary
     where 字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
       and 系统标识 = 'HIS'
     group by to_char(院标名称)
) main_diag_name_cd
       on main_diag_name_cd.院标名称 = main_diag.diagnosis_desc

left join (
    select emp_no, max(name) as name, max(id_no) as id_no
      from his.staff_dict
     group by emp_no
) director_sd
       on director_sd.emp_no = a.director

left join (
    select emp_no, max(name) as name, max(id_no) as id_no
      from his.staff_dict
     group by emp_no
) chief_sd
       on chief_sd.emp_no = a.chief_doctor

left join (
    select emp_no, max(name) as name, max(id_no) as id_no
      from his.staff_dict
     group by emp_no
) attending_sd
       on attending_sd.emp_no = a.attending_doctor

left join (
