V_EMR_ICH_ALLERGIES.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_ICH_ALLERGIES" ("ID", "ICH_ID", "SN", "MEDICINE", "MEDICINE_CODE", "DISTRICT_CODE", "CREATED_AT", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "ADMISSION_ID", "NAME", "SEX_CODE", "ID_NUM") AS 
  select
       cast(
           substrb(
               '49557032X' || '|' || x.patient_id || '|' || x.visit_id || '|' || x.sn,
               1,
               100
           ) as varchar2(100)
       ) as ID,--内码 是 主键；增加SN避免同一次住院多个过敏药物主键重复

       cast(
           substrb(
               '49557032X' || '|' || x.patient_id || '|' || x.visit_id,
               1,
               100
           ) as varchar2(100)
       ) as ICH_ID,--病案首页内码 是；必须与EMR_ICH.ID一致

       x.sn as SN,--序号；同一次住院内按拆分后的过敏药物重新编号

       cast(substrb(x.medicine, 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as MEDICINE,--过敏药物名称 是；由PAT_VISIT.ALERGY_DRUGS拆分清洗

       cast(null as varchar2(12)) as MEDICINE_CODE,--过敏药物代码；暂无明确药品标准编码来源，暂不编造

       cast('370104' as varchar2(6)) as DISTRICT_CODE,--所属行政区划 是

       cast(nvl(x.discharge_date_time, x.admission_date_time) as timestamp) as CREATED_AT,--创建时间；优先出院时间，空时取入院时间

       cast('ADDHIS' as varchar2(10)) as EXCHANGE_TYPE,--交换类型 是

       cast(systimestamp as timestamp) as SYSTEM_TIME,--数据上传时间戳 是

       cast('49557032X' as varchar2(32)) as ORG_CODE,--医院组织机构代码 是

       cast('山东省第二人民医院' as varchar2(70)) as ORG_NAME,--医院名称 是

       cast(
           substrb(
               x.patient_id || '|' || x.visit_id,
               1,
               20
           ) as varchar2(20)
       ) as ADMISSION_ID,--本次住院标识号 是

       cast(substrb(nvl(to_char(x.name), '-'), 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as NAME,--患者姓名 是

       cast(
           decode(x.sex, '男', '1', '女', '2', '未知', '0', '9')
           as char(1)
       ) as SEX_CODE,--患者性别代码 是；0未知，1男，2女，9不明

       cast(
           substrb(
               nvl(to_char(x.id_no), '000000000000000000'),
               1,
               18
           ) as varchar2(18)
       ) as ID_NUM--患者身份证件号码 是

from (
    select y.*,
           row_number() over (
               partition by y.patient_id, y.visit_id
               order by y.seq
           ) as sn
      from (
          select base.patient_id,
                 base.visit_id,
                 base.admission_date_time,
                 base.discharge_date_time,
                 base.name,
                 base.sex,
                 base.id_no,
                 level as seq,
                 trim(
                     regexp_substr(
                         base.allergy_text_norm,
                         '[^,]+',
                         1,
                         level
                     )
                 ) as medicine
            from (
                select a.patient_id,
                       a.visit_id,
                       a.admission_date_time,
                       a.discharge_date_time,
                       b.name,
                       b.sex,
                       b.id_no,
                       trim(
                           both ',' from
                           regexp_replace(
                               regexp_replace(
                                   regexp_replace(
                                       trim(to_char(a.alergy_drugs)),
                                       '[[:space:]]+',
                                       ''
                                   ),
                                   '[，、;；/／|｜+＋]+',
                                   ','
                               ),
                               ',+',
                               ','
                           )
                       ) as allergy_text_norm
                  from his.pat_visit a
                  left join his.pat_master_index b
                    on b.patient_id = a.patient_id
                 where a.alergy_drugs is not null
                   and trim(to_char(a.alergy_drugs)) is not null
                   and regexp_replace(trim(to_char(a.alergy_drugs)), '[[:space:]]+', '') not in
                       ('无', '否', '无过敏', '无药物过敏', '无药物过敏史',
                        '未发现', '未见', '不详', '未知', '-', '--', '—')
                   and a.discharge_date_time >= date '2021-01-01'
                   and a.discharge_date_time <  date '2025-01-01'
            ) base
          connect by prior base.patient_id = base.patient_id
                 and prior base.visit_id = base.visit_id
                 and prior sys_guid() is not null
                 and level <= regexp_count(base.allergy_text_norm, ',') + 1
      ) y
     where y.medicine is not null
       and y.medicine not in
           ('无', '否', '无过敏', '无药物过敏', '无药物过敏史',
            '未发现', '未见', '不详', '未知', '-', '--', '—')
) x

V_EMR_ICH_CHARGE.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_ICH_CHARGE" ("ID", "ICH_ID", "CHARGE_TYPE_CODE", "CHARGE_TYPE", "CHARGE_AMOUNT", "CREATED_AT", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "ADMISSION_ID", "NAME", "SEX_CODE", "ID_NUM") AS 
  select
       cast(
           substrb(
               '49557032X' || '|' || o.patient_id || '|' || o.visit_id || '|' || r.charge_type_code,
               1,
               100
           ) as varchar2(100)
       ) as ID,--内码 是 主键；机构码|患者ID|住院次数|费用分类代码，避免重复

       cast(
           substrb(
               '49557032X' || '|' || o.patient_id || '|' || o.visit_id,
               1,

           ) as varchar2(100)
       ) as ICH_ID,--病案首页内码 是；必须与EMR_ICH.ID一致

       cast(substrb(r.charge_type_name, 1, 32) as varchar2(32)) as CHARGE_TYPE,--住院费用-分类 是

       cast(round(nvl(r.costs, 0), 2) as number(9,2)) as CHARGE_AMOUNT,--住院费用-金额（元/人民币） 是

       cast(nvl(o.discharge_date_time, o.admission_date_time) as timestamp) as CREATED_AT,--创建时间

       cast('370104' as varchar2(6)) as DISTRICT_CODE,--所属行政区划 是

       cast('ADDHIS' as varchar2(10)) as EXCHANGE_TYPE,--交换类型 是

       cast(systimestamp as timestamp) as SYSTEM_TIME,--数据上传时间戳 是

       cast('49557032X' as varchar2(32)) as ORG_CODE,--医院组织机构代码 是

       cast('山东省第二人民医院' as varchar2(70)) as ORG_NAME,--医院名称 是

       cast(

               o.patient_id || '|' || o.visit_id,
               1,
               20

       ) as ADMISSION_ID,--本次住院标识号 是

       cast(substrb(nvl(to_char(pmi.name), '无名氏'), 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as NAME,--姓名 是

       cast(
           decode(pmi.sex, '男', '1', '女', '2', '未知', '0', '9')
           as char(1)
       ) as SEX_CODE,--性别代码 是；0未知，1男，2女，9不明

           substrb(
               nvl(to_char(pmi.id_no), '000000000000000000'),
               1,
               18
           ) as varchar2(18)
       ) as ID_NUM--身份证件号码 是

  from his.pat_visit o

  left join his.pat_master_index pmi
    on pmi.patient_id = o.patient_id

  join (
        select x.patient_id,
               x.visit_id,
               x.charge_type_code,
               x.charge_type_name,
               sum(nvl(x.costs, 0)) as costs
          from (
                select r.patient_id,
                       r.visit_id,

                       decode(
                           to_char(r.mr_bill_class),
                           '01',   '1',
                           '02',   '2',
                           '03',   '3',
                           '04',   '4',
                           '05',   '5',
                           '06',   '6',
                           '07',   '7',
                           '08',   '8',
                           '09',   '9',
                           '0901', '901',
                           '10',   '10',
                           '1001', '101',
                           '1002', '102',
                           '1003', '10',
                           '11',   '11',
                           '12',   '12',
                           '1202', '12',
                           '13',   '13',
                           '1301', '131',
                           '14',   '14',
                           '15',   '15',
                           '16',   '16',
                           '17',   '17',
                           '18',   '18',
                           '19',   '19',
                           '20',   '20',
                           '21',   '21',
                           '22',   '22',
                           '23',   '23',
                           '24',   '24',
                           '其他', '24',
                           '其他费', '24',
                           to_char(r.mr_bill_class)
                       ) as charge_type_code,--费用分类代码；1003归并10，1202归并12

                       decode(
                           to_char(r.mr_bill_class),
                           '01',   '一般医疗服务费',
                           '02',   '一般治疗操作费',
                           '03',   '护理费',
                           '04',   '综合医疗服务类其他费用',
                           '05',   '病理诊断费',
                           '06',   '实验室诊断费',
                           '07',   '影像学诊断费',
                           '08',   '临床诊断项目费',
                           '09',   '非手术治疗项目费',
                           '0901', '其中临床物理治疗费',
                           '10',   '手术治疗费',
                           '1001', '其中麻醉费',
                           '1002', '其中手术费',
                           '1003', '手术治疗费',
                           '11',   '康复费',
                           '12',   '中医治疗费',
                           '1202', '中医治疗费',
                           '13',   '西药费',
                           '1301', '其中抗菌药物费用',
                           '14',   '中成药费',
                           '15',   '中草药费',
                           '16',   '血费',

V_EMR_ICH_DIAGNOSIS.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_ICH_DIAGNOSIS" ("ID", "DCS_ID", "SN", "DIAGNOSIS_TYPE", "DISEASE_CODE", "DISEASE", "DIS_OUTCOME_NAME", "DIS_OUTCOME_CODE", "IS_CAWM_DIAGNOSIS", "DIAGNOSIS_DATE", "ADMISSION_CONDITION", "ADMISSION_CONNAME", "CREATED_AT", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "HIGHEST_DIAGNOSTIC_BASIS", "HIGHEST_DIAGN_NAME", "SYSTEM_TIME", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "BLZDBM", "BLZDMC", "ADMISSION_ID", "NAME", "SEX_CODE", "ID_NUM") AS 
  select
       cast(
           substrb(
               '49557032X' || '|' || a.patient_id || '|' || a.visit_id || '|' ||
               nvl(to_char(a.diagnosis_type), '-') || '|' || nvl(to_char(a.diagnosis_no), '-'),
               1,
               100
           ) as varchar2(100)
       ) as ID,--内码 是 主键；机构码|患者ID|住院次数|诊断类型|诊断序号

       cast(
           substrb(
               '49557032X' || '|' || a.patient_id || '|' || a.visit_id,
               1,
               100
           ) as varchar2(100)
       ) as DCS_ID,--病案首页内码 是；必须与EMR_ICH.ID一致

       a.diagnosis_no as SN,--序号

           cast(
           case
               when to_char(a.diagnosis_type) = '3'
                    and nvl(a.diagnosis_no, 0) = 1
               then '1'  -- 出院诊断-主要诊断

               when to_char(a.diagnosis_type) = '3'
                    and nvl(a.diagnosis_no, 0) <> 1
               then '2'  -- 出院诊断-其他诊断

               when to_char(a.diagnosis_type) = '2'
               then '3'  -- 入院初步诊断

               when to_char(a.diagnosis_type) = '8'
               then '12' -- 病理诊断；按当前结果判断，8为病理诊断

               when to_char(a.diagnosis_type) = '7'
               then '17' -- 损伤、中毒诊断；按当前结果判断，7为损伤/外因诊断

               when to_char(a.diagnosis_type) = '1'
               then '19' -- 门（急）诊诊断

               else '23' -- 其他
           end as varchar2(2)
       ) as DIAGNOSIS_TYPE,--疾病诊断类型 是；按当前数据结果修正7/8映射

    cast(
    substrb(
    nvl(
        coalesce(
            case
                when regexp_like(
                         upper(trim(to_char(diag_code_dict.国标编码))),
                         '^[A-Z][0-9][0-9A-Z](\.|X)?[0-9A-Z]*$'
                     )
                     and not regexp_like(
                         upper(trim(to_char(diag_code_dict.国标编码))),
                         '^M[0-9]{5}/'
                     )
                then upper(trim(to_char(diag_code_dict.国标编码)))
            end,
            case
                when regexp_like(
                         upper(trim(to_char(a.diagnosis_code))),
                         '^[A-Z][0-9][0-9A-Z](\.|X)?[0-9A-Z]*$'
                     )
                     and not regexp_like(
                         upper(trim(to_char(a.diagnosis_code))),
                         '^M[0-9]{5}/'
                     )
                then upper(trim(to_char(a.diagnosis_code)))
            end,
            case
                when regexp_like(
                         upper(trim(to_char(a.diagnosis_code2))),
                         '^[A-Z][0-9][0-9A-Z](\.|X)?[0-9A-Z]*$'
                     )
                     and not regexp_like(
                         upper(trim(to_char(a.diagnosis_code2))),
                         '^M[0-9]{5}/'
                     )
                then upper(trim(to_char(a.diagnosis_code2)))
            end,
            (
                select max(upper(trim(to_char(d.diagnosis_code))))
                  from his.diagnosis d
                 where d.patient_id = a.patient_id
                   and d.visit_id = a.visit_id
                   and to_char(d.diagnosis_type) = '3'
                   and nvl(d.diagnosis_no, 0) = 1
                   and regexp_like(
                           upper(trim(to_char(d.diagnosis_code))),
                           '^[A-Z][0-9][0-9A-Z](\.|X)?[0-9A-Z]*$'
                       )
                   and not regexp_like(
                           upper(trim(to_char(d.diagnosis_code))),
                           '^M[0-9]{5}/'
                       )
            )
        ),
        'Z00.000'),
        1,
        12
    ) as varchar2(12)
) as DISEASE_CODE,--疾病编码 是；禁止M码进入DISEASE_CODE，病理记录回退出院主诊断ICD

       cast(
           substrb(
           nvl(
               coalesce(
                   diag_code_dict.国标名称,
                   diag_code2_dict.国标名称,
                   diag_name_dict.国标名称,
                   to_char(a.diagnosis_desc_doc),
                   to_char(a.diagnosis_desc)
               ),
               '一般性医学检查'),
               1,
               50
           ) as varchar2(50)
       ) as DISEASE,--疾病诊断名称 是；优先标准名称，其次医生录入名称、HIS诊断名称

cast(
    substrb(
        case
            when trim(to_char(a.treat_result)) in ('1', '治愈') then '治愈'
            when trim(to_char(a.treat_result)) in ('2', '好转') then '好转'
            when trim(to_char(a.treat_result)) in ('3', '稳定') then '稳定'
            when trim(to_char(a.treat_result)) in ('4', '恶化') then '恶化'
            when trim(to_char(a.treat_result)) in ('5', '死亡') then '死亡'
            when trim(to_char(a.treat_result)) in ('6', '未愈') then '未愈'
            when trim(to_char(a.treat_result)) in ('9', '其他') then '其他'
            else '其他'
        end,
        1,
        10
    ) as varchar2(10)
) as DIS_OUTCOME_NAME,--病情转归名称
cast(
    case
        when trim(to_char(a.treat_result)) in ('1', '治愈') then '1'
        when trim(to_char(a.treat_result)) in ('2', '好转') then '2'
        when trim(to_char(a.treat_result)) in ('3', '稳定') then '3'
        when trim(to_char(a.treat_result)) in ('4', '恶化') then '4'
        when trim(to_char(a.treat_result)) in ('5', '死亡') then '5'
        when trim(to_char(a.treat_result)) in ('6', '未愈') then '6'
        when trim(to_char(a.treat_result)) in ('9', '其他') then '9'
        else '9'
    end as char(1)
) as DIS_OUTCOME_CODE,--病情转归代码；1治愈、2好转、3稳定、4恶化、5死亡、6未愈、9其他
       cast('2' as char(1)) as IS_CAWM_DIAGNOSIS,--中西医诊断标识 是；HIS诊断按西医诊断处理

       cast(nvl(a.diagnosis_date, p.admission_date_time) as date) as DIAGNOSIS_DATE,--确诊日期；优先诊断日期，空时取入院时间

       cast(
           case
               when to_char(a.admission_condition) in ('1','2','3','4')
               then to_char(a.admission_condition)
               else null
           end as char(1)
       ) as ADMISSION_CONDITION,--入院病情代码；取DIAGNOSIS.ADMISSION_CONDITION

       cast(
           substrb(
               case
                   when to_char(a.admission_condition) = '1' then '有'
                   when to_char(a.admission_condition) = '2' then '临床未确定'
                   when to_char(a.admission_condition) = '3' then '情况不明'
                   when to_char(a.admission_condition) = '4' then '无'
                   else null
               end,
               1,
               50
           ) as varchar2(50)
       ) as ADMISSION_CONNAME,--入院病情描述；1有、2临床未确定、3情况不明、4无
to_char(
    nvl(
        a.enter_date,
        nvl(a.diagnosis_date, p.admission_date_time)
    ),
    'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss'
) as CREATED_AT,--创建时间；统一时间格式

       cast('370104' as varchar2(6)) as DISTRICT_CODE,--所属行政区划 是

       cast('ADDHIS' as varchar2(10)) as EXCHANGE_TYPE,--交换类型 是

                 cast(
           case
               when regexp_substr(upper(trim(to_char(a.diagnosis_code2))), 'M[0-9]{5}/[0-9]') is not null
                    or regexp_substr(upper(trim(to_char(a.diagnosis_code))), 'M[0-9]{5}/[0-9]') is not null
                    or exists (
                        select 1
                          from his.diagnosis d
                         where d.patient_id = a.patient_id
                           and d.visit_id = a.visit_id
                           and to_char(d.diagnosis_type) = '8'
                           and (
                                regexp_substr(upper(trim(to_char(d.diagnosis_code2))), 'M[0-9]{5}/[0-9]') is not null
                                or regexp_substr(upper(trim(to_char(d.diagnosis_code))), 'M[0-9]{5}/[0-9]') is not null
                                or trim(to_char(d.diagnosis_desc_doc)) is not null
                                or trim(to_char(d.diagnosis_desc)) is not null
                           )
                    )
               then '1'
               else '19'
           end as varchar2(2)
       ) as HIGHEST_DIAGNOSTIC_BASIS,--最高诊断依据代码；同次住院存在病理诊断时填1病理，否则19其他
         cast(
           case
               when regexp_substr(upper(trim(to_char(a.diagnosis_code2))), 'M[0-9]{5}/[0-9]') is not null
                    or regexp_substr(upper(trim(to_char(a.diagnosis_code))), 'M[0-9]{5}/[0-9]') is not null
                    or exists (
                        select 1
                          from his.diagnosis d
                         where d.patient_id = a.patient_id
                           and d.visit_id = a.visit_id
                           and to_char(d.diagnosis_type) = '8'
                           and (
                                regexp_substr(upper(trim(to_char(d.diagnosis_code2))), 'M[0-9]{5}/[0-9]') is not null
                                or regexp_substr(upper(trim(to_char(d.diagnosis_code))), 'M[0-9]{5}/[0-9]') is not null
                                or trim(to_char(d.diagnosis_desc_doc)) is not null
                                or trim(to_char(d.diagnosis_desc)) is not null
                           )
                    )
               then '病理'
               else '其他'
           end as varchar2(32)
       ) as HIGHEST_DIAGN_NAME,--最高诊断依据名称
to_char(sysdate, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') as SYSTEM_TIME,--数据上传时间戳 是；统一时间格式
       cast('49557032X' as varchar2(32)) as ORG_CODE,--医院组织机构代码 是

       cast('山东省第二人民医院' as varchar2(70)) as ORG_NAME,--医院名称 是

                cast(
           substrb(
               nvl(
                   coalesce(
                       regexp_substr(upper(trim(to_char(a.diagnosis_code2))), 'M[0-9]{5}/[0-9]'),
                       regexp_substr(upper(trim(to_char(a.diagnosis_code))),  'M[0-9]{5}/[0-9]'),
                       (
                           select max(
                                      coalesce(
                                          regexp_substr(upper(trim(to_char(d.diagnosis_code2))), 'M[0-9]{5}/[0-9]'),
                                          regexp_substr(upper(trim(to_char(d.diagnosis_code))),  'M[0-9]{5}/[0-9]')
                                      )
                                  )
                             from his.diagnosis d
                            where d.patient_id = a.patient_id
                              and d.visit_id = a.visit_id
                              and to_char(d.diagnosis_type) = '8'
                       )
                   ),
                   '-'
               ),
               1,
               20
           ) as varchar2(20)
       ) as BLZDBM,--病理诊断编码；取本条或同次住院diagnosis_type=8有效M码，无则-
               cast(
           substrb(
               nvl(
                   case
                       when to_char(a.diagnosis_type) = '8'
                       then coalesce(
                                to_char(a.diagnosis_desc_doc),
                                to_char(a.diagnosis_desc)
                            )
                       else (
                            select max(
                                       coalesce(
                                           to_char(d.diagnosis_desc_doc),
                                           to_char(d.diagnosis_desc)
                                       )
                                   )
                              from his.diagnosis d
                             where d.patient_id = a.patient_id
                               and d.visit_id = a.visit_id
                               and to_char(d.diagnosis_type) = '8'
                               and (
                                    trim(to_char(d.diagnosis_desc_doc)) is not null
                                    or trim(to_char(d.diagnosis_desc)) is not null
                               )
                       )
                   end,
                   '-'
               ),
               1,
               100
           ) as varchar2(100)
       ) as BLZDMC,--病理诊断名称；取本条或同次住院diagnosis_type=8病理诊断名称，无则-

       cast(
           substrb(
               a.patient_id || '|' || a.visit_id,
               1,
               20
           ) as varchar2(20)
       ) as ADMISSION_ID,--本次住院标识号 是

       cast(substrb(nvl(to_char(pmi.name), '无名氏'), 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as NAME,--患者姓名 是

       cast(
           decode(pmi.sex, '男', '1', '女', '2', '未知', '0', '9')
           as char(1)
       ) as SEX_CODE,--患者性别代码 是

       cast(
           substrb(
               case
                   when regexp_like(trim(to_char(pmi.id_no)), '^[0-9]{17}[0-9Xx]$|^[0-9]{15}$')
                   then upper(trim(to_char(pmi.id_no)))
                   else '000000000000000000'
               end,
               1,
               18
           ) as varchar2(18)
       ) as ID_NUM--患者身份证件号码 是

  from his.diagnosis a

  left join his.pat_master_index pmi
    on pmi.patient_id = a.patient_id

  join his.pat_visit p
    on p.patient_id = a.patient_id
   and p.visit_id = a.visit_id

  left join (
        select to_char(院标编码) as 院标编码,
               max(to_char(国标编码)) as 国标编码,
               max(to_char(国标名称)) as 国标名称
          from cda.cda_dictionary
         where 字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
           and 系统标识 = 'HIS'
         group by to_char(院标编码)
       ) diag_code_dict
    on diag_code_dict.院标编码 = to_char(a.diagnosis_code)

  left join (
        select to_char(院标编码) as 院标编码,
               max(to_char(国标编码)) as 国标编码,
               max(to_char(国标名称)) as 国标名称
          from cda.cda_dictionary
         where 字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
           and 系统标识 = 'HIS'
         group by to_char(院标编码)
       ) diag_code2_dict
    on diag_code2_dict.院标编码 = to_char(a.diagnosis_code2)
   and regexp_like(
           upper(trim(to_char(a.diagnosis_code2))),
           '^[A-Z][0-9][0-9A-Z](\.|X)?[0-9A-Z]*$'
       )

  left join (
        select to_char(院标名称) as 院标名称,
               max(to_char(国标编码)) as 国标编码,
               max(to_char(国标名称)) as 国标名称
          from cda.cda_dictionary
         where 字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
           and 系统标识 = 'HIS'
         group by to_char(院标名称)
       ) diag_name_dict
    on diag_name_dict.院标名称 =
       coalesce(to_char(a.diagnosis_desc_doc), to_char(a.diagnosis_desc))



 where p.discharge_date_time >= date '2021-01-01'
   and p.discharge_date_time <  date '2025-01-01'

V_EMR_ICH_OPERATION.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_ICH_OPERATION" ("ID", "ICH_ID", "SN", "OPERATION_CODE", "OPERATION_NAME", "OPS_TYPE", "OPERATION_DATE", "ANAESTHESIA_CODE", "ANAESTHESIA_NAME", "HEALING_GRADE_CODE", "HEALING_GRADE_NAME", "OPERATION_GRADE", "OPERATION_BP_NAME", "OPERATION_BP_CODE", "INCISION_CATEGORY", "SURGEON_CODE", "SURGEON_NAME", "ASSISTANT_FIR_CODE", "ASSISTANT_FIR_NAME", "ASSISTANT_SED_CODE", "ASSISTANT_SED_NAME", "ANESTHESIA_DOC_CODE", "ANESTHESIA_DOC_NAME", "CREATED_AT", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "OPERATION_NATURE_CODE", "OPERATION_AGAIN_CODE", "ELECTIVE_EMERGENCY", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "SFWRJSS", "SFWRJCZ", "SFFJHZSS", "ADMISSION_ID", "NAME", "SEX_CODE", "ID_NUM") AS 
  select
       cast(
           substrb(
               '49557032X' || '|' || o.patient_id || '|' || o.visit_id || '|' || o.operation_no,
               1,
               100
           ) as varchar2(100)
       ) as ID,--内码 是 主键；增加手术序号，避免同一次住院多台手术ID重复

       cast(
           substrb(
               '49557032X' || '|' || o.patient_id || '|' || o.visit_id,
               1,
               100
           ) as varchar2(100)
       ) as ICH_ID,--病案首页内码 是；必须与EMR_ICH.ID保持一致

       o.operation_no as SN,--序号；取手术序号

       cast(
           substrb(
               nvl(
                   nvl(op_icd_code.国标编码, op_icd_name.国标编码),
                   to_char(o.operation_code)
               ),
               1,
               12
           ) as varchar2(12)
       ) as OPERATION_CODE,--手术/操作-代码 是；优先按手术编码映射，再按手术名称映射，最后保留原手术编码

       cast(
           substrb(
               nvl(
                   nvl(op_icd_code.国标名称, op_icd_name.国标名称),
                   nvl(to_char(o.operation_desc_doc), to_char(o.operation_desc))
               ),
               1,
               80
           ) as varchar2(80)
       ) as OPERATION_NAME,--手术/操作-名称 是；优先标准名称，其次医生自定义名/手术名称

     cast(
    case
        -- 如果字典属性里能识别内镜，优先归为5
        when instr(
                 nvl(
                     (
                         select max(to_char(d.operation_type))
                           from his.operation_dict d
                          where nvl(d.stop_flag, 0) = 0
                            and to_char(d.operation_code) = to_char(o.operation_code)
                     ),
                     ' '
                 ),
                 '内镜'
             ) > 0
        then '5'

        -- 0 手术 -> 1 手术
        when (
                select max(to_char(d.operation_indicator))
                  from his.operation_dict d
                 where nvl(d.stop_flag, 0) = 0
                   and to_char(d.operation_code) = to_char(o.operation_code)
             ) = '0'
        then '1'

        -- 3 介入治疗 -> 2 介入手术
        when (
                select max(to_char(d.operation_indicator))
                  from his.operation_dict d
                 where nvl(d.stop_flag, 0) = 0
                   and to_char(d.operation_code) = to_char(o.operation_code)
             ) = '3'
        then '2'

        -- 1 治疗性操作 -> 3 治疗性操作
        when (
                select max(to_char(d.operation_indicator))
                  from his.operation_dict d
                 where nvl(d.stop_flag, 0) = 0
                   and to_char(d.operation_code) = to_char(o.operation_code)
             ) = '1'
        then '3'

        -- 2 诊断性操作 -> 4 诊断性操作
        when (
                select max(to_char(d.operation_indicator))
                  from his.operation_dict d
                 where nvl(d.stop_flag, 0) = 0
                   and to_char(d.operation_code) = to_char(o.operation_code)
             ) = '2'
        then '4'

        else '9'
    end as varchar2(10)
) as OPS_TYPE,--手术类型；根据HIS.OPERATION_DICT.OPERATION_INDICATOR转换



       cast(o.operating_date as date) as OPERATION_DATE,--手术操作日期 是；取手术开始日期

       cast(
           substrb(
               nvl(nvl(anes_code_dict.国标编码, anes_name_dict.国标编码), '9'),
               1,
               2
           ) as varchar2(2)
       ) as ANAESTHESIA_CODE,--麻醉方法代码 是；优先按麻醉方法代码/名称映射

       cast(
           substrb(
               nvl(nvl(anes_code_dict.国标名称, anes_name_dict.国标名称), '其他麻醉方法'),
               1,
               50
           ) as varchar2(50)
       ) as ANAESTHESIA_NAME,--麻醉方法 是

      cast(
    case
        -- HEAL本身是愈合等级
        when regexp_replace(trim(to_char(o.heal)), '[[:space:]]+', '') in ('甲', '1') then '1'
        when regexp_replace(trim(to_char(o.heal)), '[[:space:]]+', '') in ('乙', '2') then '2'
        when regexp_replace(trim(to_char(o.heal)), '[[:space:]]+', '') in ('丙', '3') then '3'
        when regexp_replace(trim(to_char(o.heal)), '[[:space:]]+', '') in ('其他', '其', '4', '5', '未知', '-', '—', '0') then '4'

        -- HEAL被误填为Ⅰ/Ⅱ/Ⅲ时，不按甲乙丙处理；尝试从WOUND_GRADE里找甲乙丙
        when regexp_replace(trim(to_char(o.wound_grade)), '[[:space:]]+', '') = '甲' then '1'
        when regexp_replace(trim(to_char(o.wound_grade)), '[[:space:]]+', '') = '乙' then '2'
        when regexp_replace(trim(to_char(o.wound_grade)), '[[:space:]]+', '') = '丙' then '3'
        when regexp_replace(trim(to_char(o.wound_grade)), '[[:space:]]+', '') in ('其他', '其') then '4'

        -- 其他空值、Ⅰ/Ⅱ/Ⅲ/I/II/III等均视为愈合情况不确定
        else '4'
    end as varchar2(3)
) as HEALING_GRADE_CODE,--切口愈合等级代码 是；1甲、2乙、3丙、4其他；HEAL混入切口类别时不误转

cast(
    substrb(
        case
            when regexp_replace(trim(to_char(o.heal)), '[[:space:]]+', '') in ('甲', '1') then '甲'
            when regexp_replace(trim(to_char(o.heal)), '[[:space:]]+', '') in ('乙', '2') then '乙'
            when regexp_replace(trim(to_char(o.heal)), '[[:space:]]+', '') in ('丙', '3') then '丙'
            when regexp_replace(trim(to_char(o.heal)), '[[:space:]]+', '') in ('其他', '其', '4', '5', '未知', '-', '—', '0') then '其他'

            when regexp_replace(trim(to_char(o.wound_grade)), '[[:space:]]+', '') = '甲' then '甲'
            when regexp_replace(trim(to_char(o.wound_grade)), '[[:space:]]+', '') = '乙' then '乙'
            when regexp_replace(trim(to_char(o.wound_grade)), '[[:space:]]+', '') = '丙' then '丙'
            when regexp_replace(trim(to_char(o.wound_grade)), '[[:space:]]+', '') in ('其他', '其') then '其他'

            else '其他'
        end,
        1,
        50
    ) as varchar2(50)
) as HEALING_GRADE_NAME,--切口愈合等级；甲/乙/丙/其他

     nvl( cast(
    to_number(
        regexp_substr(
            trim(
                coalesce(
                    -- 1. 优先按手术编码匹配手术字典等级
                    (
                        select max(to_char(d.operation_scale))
                          from his.operation_dict d
                         where nvl(d.stop_flag, 0) = 0
                           and to_char(d.operation_code) = to_char(o.operation_code)
                    ),

                    -- 2. 编码匹配不到时，按手术名称匹配手术字典等级
                    (
                        select max(to_char(d.operation_scale))
                          from his.operation_dict d
                         where nvl(d.stop_flag, 0) = 0
                           and to_char(d.operation_name) =
                               coalesce(to_char(o.operation_desc_doc), to_char(o.operation_desc))
                    ),

                    -- 3. 字典仍匹配不到时，保留HIS.OPERATION原手术等级
                    to_char(o.operation_scale)
                )
            ),
            '^[0-9]+$'
        )
    ) as number
) ,'0')as OPERATION_GRADE,--手术级别代码 是；不改FROM，优先手术字典等级，其次HIS.OPERATION手术等级

       cast(null as varchar2(50)) as OPERATION_BP_NAME,--手术/操作-目标部位名称；暂无明确来源

       cast(null as varchar2(20)) as OPERATION_BP_CODE,--手术/操作-目标部位代码；暂无明确来源

       cast(
           substrb(
               nvl(incision_dict.国标编码, '1'),
               1,
               1
           ) as char(1)
       ) as INCISION_CATEGORY,--手术切口类别代码；来源o.WOUND_GRADE

       cast(
           substrb(
               coalesce(surgeon_emp.id_no, surgeon_name.id_no),
               1,
               32
           ) as varchar2(32)
       ) as SURGEON_CODE,--手术者代码；标准说明为身份证号码，优先取人员字典身份证号

       cast(
           substrb(
               coalesce(surgeon_emp.name, surgeon_name.name, to_char(o.operator), '-'),
               1,
               50
           ) as varchar2(50)
       ) as SURGEON_NAME,--手术者姓名 是

       cast(
           substrb(
               coalesce(first_emp.id_no, first_name.id_no),
               1,
               32
           ) as varchar2(32)
       ) as ASSISTANT_FIR_CODE,--Ⅰ助代码；标准说明为身份证号码

       cast(
           substrb(
               coalesce(first_emp.name, first_name.name, to_char(o.first_assistant)),
               1,
               50
           ) as varchar2(50)
       ) as ASSISTANT_FIR_NAME,--Ⅰ助姓名

       cast(
           substrb(
               coalesce(second_emp.id_no, second_name.id_no),
               1,
               32
           ) as varchar2(32)
       ) as ASSISTANT_SED_CODE,--Ⅱ助代码；标准说明为身份证号码

       cast(
           substrb(
               coalesce(second_emp.name, second_name.name, to_char(o.second_assistant)),
               1,
               50
           ) as varchar2(50)
       ) as ASSISTANT_SED_NAME,--Ⅱ助姓名

       cast(
           substrb(
               coalesce(anes_emp.id_no, anes_name.id_no),
               1,
               32
           ) as varchar2(32)
       ) as ANESTHESIA_DOC_CODE,--麻醉医师代码；标准说明为身份证号码

       cast(
           substrb(
               coalesce(anes_emp.name, anes_name.name, to_char(o.anesthesia_doctor)),
               1,
               50
           ) as varchar2(50)
       ) as ANESTHESIA_DOC_NAME,--麻醉医师姓名

       cast(nvl(o.enter_date, o.operating_date) as timestamp) as CREATED_AT,--创建时间；优先取ENTER_DATE，空时取手术日期

       cast('370104' as varchar2(6)) as DISTRICT_CODE,--所属行政区划 是

       cast('ADDHIS' as varchar2(10)) as EXCHANGE_TYPE,--交换类型 是

       cast(systimestamp as timestamp) as SYSTEM_TIME,--数据上传时间戳 是

cast(
    case
        when to_char(o.operation_emer_indicator) = '2' then '2'
        when to_char(o.operation_emer_indicator) = '1' then '1'
        else '1'
    end as char(1)
) as OPERATION_NATURE_CODE,--手术性质代码；LC003.006：1择期，2急症，来源OPERATION_EMER_INDICATOR，空值默认择期
       cast(null as char(1)) as OPERATION_AGAIN_CODE,--再次手术代码；暂无明确来源

      cast(
    case
        when to_char(o.operation_emer_indicator) = '2' then '2'
        when to_char(o.operation_emer_indicator) = '1' then '1'
        else '1'
    end as varchar2(1)
) as ELECTIVE_EMERGENCY,--择期/急症手术代码；1择期，2急症，空值默认择期

       cast('49557032X' as varchar2(32)) as ORG_CODE,--医院组织机构代码 是

       cast('山东省第二人民医院' as varchar2(70)) as ORG_NAME,--医院名称 是

       cast(
           case
               when to_char(o.primary_day) = '1' then '1'
               else '0'
           end as char(1)
       ) as SFWRJSS,--是否为日间手术 是；0否1是

       cast(
           case
               when to_char(o.oper_day) = '1' then '1'
               else '0'
           end as char(1)
       ) as SFWRJCZ,--是否为日间操作 是；0否1是

       cast(
           case
               when to_char(o.oper_plan) = '1' then '1'
               else '0'
           end as char(1)
       ) as SFFJHZSS,--是否非计划再手术 是；0否1是

       cast(
           substrb(
               o.patient_id || '|' || o.visit_id,
               1,
               20
           ) as varchar2(20)
       ) as ADMISSION_ID,--本次住院标识号 是；按标准长度20

       cast(substrb(nvl(to_char(pmi.name), '-'), 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as NAME,--患者姓名 是

       cast(
           decode(pmi.sex, '男', '1', '女', '2', '未知', '0', '9')
           as char(1)
       ) as SEX_CODE,--患者性别代码 是

       cast(
           substrb(
               nvl(to_char(pmi.id_no), '000000000000000000'),
               1,
               18
           ) as varchar2(18)
       ) as ID_NUM--患者身份证件号码 是

from his.operation o

join his.pat_visit pv
  on pv.patient_id = o.patient_id
 and pv.visit_id = o.visit_id

left join his.pat_master_index pmi
  on pmi.patient_id = o.patient_id

left join (
    select to_char(院标编码) as 院标编码,
           max(to_char(国标编码)) as 国标编码,
           max(to_char(国标名称)) as 国标名称
      from cda.cda_dictionary
     where 字典名称 = 'ICD-9手术编码'
     group by to_char(院标编码)
) op_icd_code
  on op_icd_code.院标编码 = to_char(o.operation_code)

left join (
    select to_char(院标名称) as 院标名称,
           max(to_char(国标编码)) as 国标编码,
           max(to_char(国标名称)) as 国标名称
      from cda.cda_dictionary
     where 字典名称 = 'ICD-9手术编码'
     group by to_char(院标名称)
) op_icd_name
  on op_icd_name.院标名称 = to_char(o.operation_desc)


left join (
    select to_char(院标编码) as 院标编码,
           max(to_char(国标编码)) as 国标编码,
           max(to_char(国标名称)) as 国标名称

     where 字典名称 = '麻醉方法代码表'

left join (

     where 字典名称 = '麻醉方法代码表'

left join (
    select to_char(院标编码) as 院标编码,

left join (

) surgeon_emp

left join (
    select to_char(name) as name,

      from his.staff_dict
     where name is not null
     group by to_char(name)
) surgeon_name
  on surgeon_name.name = to_char(o.operator)

left join (
    select to_char(emp_no) as emp_no,
           max(to_char(name)) as name,
           max(to_char(id_no)) as id_no
      from his.staff_dict
     group by to_char(emp_no)
) first_emp
  on first_emp.emp_no = to_char(o.first_assistant)

left join (
    select to_char(name) as name,
           max(to_char(emp_no)) as emp_no,
           max(to_char(id_no)) as id_no
      from his.staff_dict
     where name is not null
     group by to_char(name)
) first_name
  on first_name.name = to_char(o.first_assistant)

left join (
    select to_char(emp_no) as emp_no,
           max(to_char(name)) as name,
           max(to_char(id_no)) as id_no
      from his.staff_dict
     group by to_char(emp_no)
) second_emp
  on second_emp.emp_no = to_char(o.second_assistant)

left join (
    select to_char(name) as name,
           max(to_char(emp_no)) as emp_no,
           max(to_char(id_no)) as id_no

     where name is not null

) second_name
  on second_name.name = to_char(o.second_assistant)

left join (
    select to_char(emp_no) as emp_no,
           max(to_char(name)) as name,
           max(to_char(id_no)) as id_no
      from his.staff_dict
     group by to_char(emp_no)
) anes_emp
  on anes_emp.emp_no = to_char(o.anesthesia_doctor)

left join (
    select to_char(name) as name,
           max(to_char(emp_no)) as emp_no,
           max(to_char(id_no)) as id_no
      from his.staff_dict
     where name is not null
     group by to_char(name)
) anes_name
  on anes_name.name = to_char(o.anesthesia_doctor)
