V_EMR_INFOR_ANESTHESIA.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_INFOR_ANESTHESIA" ("ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "ADMISSION_ID", "INFORMED_CONSENT_CODE", "INFORMED_CONSENT_NAME", "APPLY_NUM", "DEPT_CODE", "DEP_NAME", "AREA_NAME", "WARD_NUM", "SICKBED_NUM", "PATIENT_NAME", "SEX_CODE", "SEX_NAME", "AGE", "AGE_MONTH", "PREOPERATIVE", "PREOPERATIVE_NAME", "OPERATION", "OPERATION_NAME", "OPERATION_DATE", "ANAESTHESIA_CODE", "ANAESTHESIA_NAME", "PATIENT_BASIC_CONDITION", "EFFECTS_BD_ANESTHESIA", "PERFORM_IO_DM", "AOC_ANESTHESIA", "SIGN_ANA_PUMP", "ANA_SAFETY_SIGN", "ORG_VIEW", "PATIENT_VIEW", "PATIENT_SIGN_NAME", "STATUTORY_AGENT_VIEW", "SAP_RELATIONSHIP", "SAP_RELATIONSHIP_NAME", "PATIENT_SIGN_DATE", "ANADOC", "ANADOC_DATE") AS 
  select ID,
       ORG_CODE,
       ORG_NAME,
       DISTRICT_CODE,
       EXCHANGE_TYPE,
       SYSTEM_TIME,
       ADMISSION_ID,
       INFORMED_CONSENT_CODE,
       INFORMED_CONSENT_NAME,
       APPLY_NUM,
       DEPT_CODE,
       DEP_NAME,
       AREA_NAME,
       WARD_NUM,
       SICKBED_NUM,
       PATIENT_NAME,
       SEX_CODE,
       SEX_NAME,
       AGE,
       AGE_MONTH,
       PREOPERATIVE,
       PREOPERATIVE_NAME,
       OPERATION,
       OPERATION_NAME,
       OPERATION_DATE,
       ANAESTHESIA_CODE,
       ANAESTHESIA_NAME,
       PATIENT_BASIC_CONDITION,
       EFFECTS_BD_ANESTHESIA,
       PERFORM_IO_DM,
       AOC_ANESTHESIA,
       SIGN_ANA_PUMP,
       ANA_SAFETY_SIGN,
       ORG_VIEW,
       PATIENT_VIEW,
       PATIENT_SIGN_NAME,
       STATUTORY_AGENT_VIEW,
       SAP_RELATIONSHIP,
       SAP_RELATIONSHIP_NAME,
       PATIENT_SIGN_DATE,
       ANADOC,
       ANADOC_DATE
from (
    select q.*,
           row_number() over (
               partition by q.ID
               order by q.OPERATION_DATE desc nulls last,
                        q.PATIENT_SIGN_DATE desc nulls last
           ) as rn
    from (
        select substr(
                   '49557032X'||'|'||
                   nvl(to_char(mom.patient_id), '-')||'|'||
                   nvl(to_char(mom.visit_id), '-')||'|'||
                   nvl(to_char(mom.oper_id), '0'),
                   1,
                   100
               ) as ID,-- 内码 是 主键

               '49557032X' as ORG_CODE,-- 医院组织机构代码

               '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,-- 医院名称

               '370104' as DISTRICT_CODE,-- 所属行政区划

               'ADDHIS' as EXCHANGE_TYPE,-- 交换类型

               cast(systimestamp as timestamp) as SYSTEM_TIME,-- 数据上传时间戳

               substr(
                   nvl(to_char(mom.patient_id), '-')||'|'||nvl(to_char(mom.visit_id), '-'),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as ADMISSION_ID,-- 住院唯一标识号

               substr(
                   nvl(to_char(mom.patient_id), '-')||
                   nvl(to_char(mom.visit_id), '-')||
                   nvl(to_char(mom.oper_id), '-'),
                   1,
                   20
               ) as INFORMED_CONSENT_CODE,-- 知情同意书编号

               '麻醉知情同意书' as INFORMED_CONSENT_NAME,-- 知情同意书名称

               substr(
                   nvl(to_char(mom.oper_id), '-'),
                   1,
                   20
               ) as APPLY_NUM,-- 手术申请单编号

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       (select cast(ks.qmpt_code as varchar2(50))
                          from his.dept_dict ks
                         where ks.dept_code = pv.dept_discharge_from
                           and rownum = 1),
                       nvl(cast(pv.dept_discharge_from as varchar2(50)), '-')
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as DEPT_CODE,-- 科室代码

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       (select cast(ks.qmpt_name as varchar2(50))
                          from his.dept_dict ks
                         where ks.dept_code = pv.dept_discharge_from
                           and rownum = 1),
                       nvl(
                           (select cast(ks.dept_name as varchar2(50))
                              from his.dept_dict ks
                             where ks.dept_code = pv.dept_discharge_from
                               and rownum = 1),
                           '-'
                       )
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as DEP_NAME,-- 科室名称 是

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       (select cast(ks.dept_name as varchar2(50))
                          from his.dept_dict ks
                         where ks.dept_code = pv.discharge_ward_code
                           and rownum = 1),
                       '-'
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as AREA_NAME,-- 病区名称

               cast(null as varchar2(10)) as WARD_NUM,-- 病房号

               substr(
                   cast(pv.discharge_bed_no as varchar2(10)),
                   1,
                   10
               ) as SICKBED_NUM,-- 病床号

               substr(
                   nvl(nullif(trim(cast(pmi.name as varchar2(50))), ''), '-'),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as PATIENT_NAME,-- 患者姓名 是

               case
                   when cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(10)) = '男' then 1
                   when cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(10)) = '女' then 2
                   when cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(10)) = '未知' then 0
                   else 9
               end as SEX_CODE,-- 性别代码 是

               substr(
                   case
                       when cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(10)) = '男' then '男'
                       when cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(10)) = '女' then '女'
                       when cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(10)) = '未知' then '未知'
                       else '不明'
                   end,
                   1,
                   50
               ) as SEX_NAME,-- 性别 是

               case
                   when pmi.date_of_birth is not null
                    and pv.admission_date_time is not null
                   then least(
                            greatest(
                                trunc(months_between(pv.admission_date_time, pmi.date_of_birth) / 12),
                                0
                            ),
                            200
                        )
                   else 0
               end as AGE,-- 年龄
  case
           when pmi.date_of_birth is not null
            and pv.admission_date_time is not null
            and months_between(pv.admission_date_time, pmi.date_of_birth) >= 1
            and months_between(pv.admission_date_time, pmi.date_of_birth) < 12
           then greatest(trunc(months_between(pv.admission_date_time, pmi.date_of_birth)), 1)
           else 0
       end as AGE_MONTH,-- 年龄（月） 不足一岁时填写，在1-12范围内的整数

             cast(
    coalesce(
        /* 优先取手麻系统诊断对应的国标编码 */
        (
            select max(to_char(cd.国标编码))
              from cda.cda_dictionary cd
             where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
               and cd.系统标识 = 'SM'
               and cd.院标名称 = mom.diag_before_operation
        ),

        /* 其次取HIS诊断对应的国标编码 */
        (
            select max(to_char(cd.国标编码))
              from cda.cda_dictionary cd
             where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
               and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
               and (
                       cd.院标编码 = dd.diagnosis_code
                    or cd.院标名称 = dd.diagnosis_desc
                   )
        ),

        /* 未对照时保留机构原始诊断编码，不再截断 */
        nullif(trim(to_char(dd.diagnosis_code)), '')
    )
    as varchar2(50)
) as PREOPERATIVE,  -- 术前诊断编码

              cast(
    substrb(
        coalesce(
            /* 手麻诊断对应的国标名称 */
            (
                select max(to_char(cd.国标名称))
                  from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                 where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                   and cd.系统标识 = 'SM'
                   and cd.院标名称 = mom.diag_before_operation
            ),

            /* HIS诊断对应的国标名称 */
            (
                select max(to_char(cd.国标名称))
                  from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                 where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                   and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                   and (
                           cd.院标编码 = dd.diagnosis_code
                        or cd.院标名称 = dd.diagnosis_desc
                       )
            ),

            /* 保留原始术前诊断名称 */
            nullif(trim(to_char(mom.diag_before_operation)), ''),

            /* HIS诊断名称兜底 */
            nullif(trim(to_char(dd.diagnosis_desc)), ''),

            '-'
        ),
        1,
        50
    )
    as varchar2(50)
) as PREOPERATIVE_NAME,  -- 术前诊断名称 是

            cast(
    coalesce(
        /* 手麻手术名称对应的国标编码 */
        (
            select max(to_char(cd.国标编码))
              from cda.cda_dictionary cd
             where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-9手术编码'
               and cd.系统标识 = 'SM'
               and cd.院标名称 = mom.operation_name
        ),

        /* 麻醉计划手术名称对应的国标编码 */
        (
            select max(to_char(cd.国标编码))
              from cda.cda_dictionary cd
             where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-9手术编码'
               and cd.系统标识 = 'SM'
               and cd.院标名称 = map.operation_name
        ),

        /* HIS手术名称对应的国标编码 */
        (
            select max(to_char(cd.国标编码))
              from cda.cda_dictionary cd
             where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-9手术编码'
               and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
               and cd.院标名称 = o.operation_desc
        ),

        /* HIS手术编码对应的国标编码 */
        (
            select max(to_char(cd.国标编码))
              from cda.cda_dictionary cd
             where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-9手术编码'
               and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
               and cd.院标编码 = o.operation_code
        ),

        /* 未对照时保留原始编码 */
        nullif(trim(to_char(o.operation_code)), '')
    )
    as varchar2(50)
) as OPERATION,  -- 拟实施手术及操作编码
 cast(
    substrb(
        coalesce(
            /* 优先使用手麻系统手术名称 */
            nullif(trim(to_char(mom.operation_name)), ''),

            /* 其次使用麻醉计划手术名称 */
            nullif(trim(to_char(map.operation_name)), ''),

            /* 再使用HIS手术名称 */
            nullif(trim(to_char(o.operation_desc)), ''),

            '-'
        ),
        1,
        50
    )
    as varchar2(50)
) as OPERATION_NAME, -- 拟实施手术及操作名称 是

               cast(
                   coalesce(mom.start_date_time, o.operating_date, mos.scheduled_date_time)
                   as date
               ) as OPERATION_DATE,-- 拟实施手术及操作日期

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       regexp_substr(
                           nvl(
                               (select cast(cd.国标编码 as varchar2(20))
                                  from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                                 where cd.字典名称 = '麻醉方法代码表'
                                   and cd.系统标识 = '手麻'
                                   and cd.院标名称 = mom.anesthesia_method
                                   and rownum = 1),
                               '9'
                           ),
                           '^[0-9]+'
                       ),
                       '9'
                   ),
                   1,
                   2
               ) as ANAESTHESIA_CODE,-- 拟实施麻醉方法代码 是

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       (select cast(cd.国标名称 as varchar2(50))
                          from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                         where cd.字典名称 = '麻醉方法代码表'
                           and cd.系统标识 = '手麻'
                           and cd.院标名称 = mom.anesthesia_method
                           and rownum = 1),
                       '其他麻醉方法'
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as ANAESTHESIA_NAME,-- 拟实施麻醉方法名称 是

               substr(
                   nvl(cast(dd.diagnosis_desc as varchar2(500)), '-'),
                   1,
                   500
               ) as PATIENT_BASIC_CONDITION,-- 患者基础疾病

               substr(
                   '患者基础疾病、年龄、个体差异及麻醉药物反应可能增加麻醉风险，可能出现呼吸循环抑制、心脑血管意外、过敏反应、恶性高热、误吸、气道痉挛、插管困难、神经血管损伤、出血、感染、血栓、术后认知功能障碍、恶心呕吐、尿潴留、镇痛不全等情况，严重者可危及生命。麻醉方案可能根据病情变化进行调整。',
                   1,
                   1000
               ) as EFFECTS_BD_ANESTHESIA,-- 基础疾病对麻醉可能产生的影响

               substr(
                   nvl(cast(map.operation_name as varchar2(2000)), '-'),
                   1,
                   2000
               ) as PERFORM_IO_DM,-- 执行有创操作和检测方法

               substr(
                   '麻醉中及麻醉后可能发生药物过敏、呼吸循环抑制、心脑血管意外、心跳呼吸骤停、恶性高热、误吸、气道痉挛、插管困难、牙齿或口腔黏膜损伤、喉头水肿、声音嘶哑、神经血管损伤、气胸、出血、感染、血栓、术后认知功能障碍、恶心呕吐、皮肤瘙痒、尿潴留、镇痛不全等意外及并发症，严重者可危及生命。医师将根据患者病情采取相应预防和处理措施。',
                   1,
                   1000
               ) as AOC_ANESTHESIA,-- 麻醉中、麻醉后可能发生的意外及并发症 是

               '0' as SIGN_ANA_PUMP,-- 使用麻醉镇痛泵标志

               '0' as ANA_SAFETY_SIGN,-- 参加麻醉安全保险标志

               substr(
                   '医方已向患者或法定代理人告知拟实施麻醉方式、麻醉必要性、可能风险、并发症、替代方案及相关处理措施，并对患方疑问进行解释。',
                   1,
                   2000
               ) as ORG_VIEW,-- 医疗机构意见

               substr(
                   '我已详细了解上述内容，对麻醉必要性、麻醉风险及相关并发症表示理解，同意实施麻醉。',
                   1,
                   2000
               ) as PATIENT_VIEW,-- 患者/法定代理人意见

               substr(
                   nvl(nullif(trim(cast(pmi.name as varchar2(50))), ''), '-'),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as PATIENT_SIGN_NAME,-- 患者签名 是

               substr(
                   nvl(nullif(trim(cast(pv.next_of_kin as varchar2(50))), ''), '-'),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as STATUTORY_AGENT_VIEW,-- 法定代理人签名

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       (select cast(cd.国标编码 as varchar2(2))
                          from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                         where cd.字典名称 = '家庭关系代码'
                           and cd.院标编码 = pmi.relationship
                           and rownum = 1),
                       '8'
                   ),
                   1,
                   2
               ) as SAP_RELATIONSHIP,-- 法定代理人与患者关系代码

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       (select cast(cd.国标名称 as varchar2(50))
                          from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                         where cd.字典名称 = '家庭关系代码'
                           and cd.院标编码 = pmi.relationship
                           and rownum = 1),
                       '其他'
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as SAP_RELATIONSHIP_NAME,-- 法定代理人与患者关系名称

               cast(
                   nvl(
                       (
                           select max(
                                      case
                                          when regexp_like(trim(cast(mcd.item_value as varchar2(100))), '^[0-9]{14}$')
                                          then to_date(trim(cast(mcd.item_value as varchar2(100))), 'yyyymmddhh24miss')

                                          when regexp_like(trim(cast(mcd.item_value as varchar2(100))), '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}')
                                          then to_date(substr(trim(cast(mcd.item_value as varchar2(100))), 1, 19), 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')

                                          else null
                                      end
                                  )
                             from sm.med_custom_data mcd
                            where mcd.item_name = '同意书.签名时间'
                              and mcd.patient_id = mom.patient_id
                              and mcd.visit_id = mom.visit_id
                              and mcd.oper_id = mom.oper_id
                       ),
                       nvl(mos.scheduled_date_time, nvl(mom.start_date_time, pv.admission_date_time))
                   )
                   as date
               ) as PATIENT_SIGN_DATE,-- 患者/法定代理人签名日期 是
nvl(cast(
    substrb(
        coalesce(
            nullif(
                trim(
                    case
                        when regexp_like(
                                 to_char(mom.anesthesia_doctor),
                                 '^[0-9]+$'
                             )
                        then (
                            select max(to_char(sd.name))
                              from his.staff_dict sd
                             where sd.emp_no = mom.anesthesia_doctor
                        )
                        else to_char(mom.anesthesia_doctor)
                    end
                ),
                ''
            ),

            nullif(
                trim(
                    case
                        when regexp_like(
                                 to_char(o.anesthesia_doctor),
                                 '^[0-9]+$'
                             )
                        then (
                            select max(to_char(sd.name))
                              from his.staff_dict sd
                             where sd.emp_no = o.anesthesia_doctor
                        )
                        else to_char(o.anesthesia_doctor)
                    end
                ),
                ''
            ),

            '-'
        ),
        1,
        50
    )
    as varchar2(50)
),'-') as ANADOC,  -- 麻醉医生签名 是

               cast(
                   nvl(
                       mom.anes_start_date_time,
                       nvl(mom.start_date_time, nvl(mos.scheduled_date_time, pv.admission_date_time))
                   )
                   as date
               ) as ANADOC_DATE-- 麻醉医师签名日期时间 是

          from sm.med_operation_master mom

          left join his.pat_visit pv
                 on mom.patient_id = pv.patient_id
                and mom.visit_id = pv.visit_id

          left join his.pat_master_index pmi
                 on mom.patient_id = pmi.patient_id



left join  (select * from (
select o.*,
       row_number() over (
           partition by
               o.patient_id,
               o.visit_id,
               trunc(o.operating_date)
           order by
               o.operation_scale desc nulls last,
               case
                   when to_char(o.op_primary) = '1' then 1
                   else 0
               end desc,
               o.operation_no asc nulls last
       ) as rn
from his.operation o  )  where rn=1)   o
       on o.patient_id = mom.patient_id
      and o.visit_id = mom.visit_id
      and (
              to_char(o.operation_no) = to_char(mom.oper_id)

           or (
                  o.operating_date is not null
              and nvl(mom.scheduled_date_time, mom.start_date_time) is not null
              and trunc(o.operating_date) =
                  trunc(nvl(mom.scheduled_date_time, mom.start_date_time))
              and o.operation_desc is not null
              and mom.operation_name is not null
              and (
                     instr(
                         substrb(cast(o.operation_desc as varchar2(4000)), 1, 500),
                         substrb(cast(mom.operation_name as varchar2(4000)), 1, 500)
                     ) > 0

                  or instr(
                         substrb(cast(mom.operation_name as varchar2(4000)), 1, 500),
                         substrb(cast(o.operation_desc as varchar2(4000)), 1, 500)
                     ) > 0
              )
           )
          )

          left join sm.med_anesthesia_plan map
                 on map.patient_id = mom.patient_id
                and map.visit_id = mom.visit_id
                and map.oper_id = mom.oper_id

          left join sm.med_operation_schedule mos
                 on mos.patient_id = mom.patient_id
                and mos.visit_id = mom.visit_id
                and mos.schedule_id = mom.oper_id

          left join (
                select a.patient_id,
                       a.visit_id,
                       a.diagnosis_code,
                       a.diagnosis_desc,
                       row_number() over (
                           partition by a.patient_id, a.visit_id
                           order by
                               case
                                   when a.diagnosis_type = '2' then 1
                                   when a.diagnosis_type = '1' then 2
                                   when a.diagnosis_type = '3' then 3
                                   else 4
                               end,
                               a.diagnosis_no
                       ) as rn
                  from his.diagnosis a
          ) dd
                 on dd.rn = 1
                and mom.patient_id = dd.patient_id
                and mom.visit_id = dd.visit_id

         where pv.discharge_date_time >= to_date('2021-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
           and pv.discharge_date_time <  to_date('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
    ) q
)
where rn = 1   and  OPERATION_NAME is not null

V_EMR_INFOR_CRITICALLY_ILL.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_INFOR_CRITICALLY_ILL" ("ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "ADMISSION_ID", "INFORMED_CONSENT_CODE", "INFORMED_CONSENT_NAME", "DEPT_CODE", "DEP_NAME", "AREA_NAME", "WARD_NUM", "SICKBED_NUM", "PATIENT_NAME", "SEX_CODE", "SEX_NAME", "AGE", "AGE_MONTH", "DISEASE_CODE", "DISEASE_NAME", "SUMMARY_RESCUE", "CRITICAL_NOTICE", "CRITICAL_NOTICE_DATE", "LEGAL_REPRE_NAME", "PAT_LEGAL_REPRE_CODE", "SAP_RELATIONSHIP_NAME", "LEGAL_REPRE_SIGN_DATE", "DOC_NAME", "DOC_DATE") AS 
  select ID,
       ORG_CODE,
       ORG_NAME,
       DISTRICT_CODE,
       EXCHANGE_TYPE,
       SYSTEM_TIME,
       ADMISSION_ID,
       INFORMED_CONSENT_CODE,
       INFORMED_CONSENT_NAME,
       DEPT_CODE,
       DEP_NAME,
       AREA_NAME,
       WARD_NUM,
       SICKBED_NUM,
       PATIENT_NAME,
       SEX_CODE,
       SEX_NAME,
       AGE,
       AGE_MONTH,
       DISEASE_CODE,
       DISEASE_NAME,
       SUMMARY_RESCUE,
       CRITICAL_NOTICE,
       CRITICAL_NOTICE_DATE,
       LEGAL_REPRE_NAME,
       PAT_LEGAL_REPRE_CODE,
       SAP_RELATIONSHIP_NAME,
       LEGAL_REPRE_SIGN_DATE,
       DOC_NAME,
       DOC_DATE
  from (
        select q.*,
               row_number() over (
                   partition by q.ID
                   order by q.ID
               ) as rn
          from (
                select
                       cast(
                           substrb(
                               '49557032X' || '|' ||
                               pv.patient_id || '|' ||
                               pv.visit_id || '|' ||
                               to_char(t1.id),
                               1,
                               100
                           ) as varchar2(100)
                       ) as ID,--内码 是 主键

                       cast('49557032X' as varchar2(32)) as ORG_CODE,--医院组织机构代码 是

                       cast('山东省第二人民医院' as varchar2(70)) as ORG_NAME,--医院名称 是

                       cast('370104' as varchar2(6)) as DISTRICT_CODE,--所属行政区划 是

                       cast('ADDHIS' as varchar2(10)) as EXCHANGE_TYPE,--交换类型 是

                       to_char(sysdate, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') as SYSTEM_TIME,--数据上传时间戳 是；统一时间格式

                       cast(
                           substrb(
                               pv.patient_id || '|' || pv.visit_id,
                               1,
                               50
                           ) as varchar2(50)
                       ) as ADMISSION_ID,--住院唯一标示号 是

                       cast(
                           substrb(
                               to_char(t1.id),
                               1,
                               20
                           ) as varchar2(20)
                       ) as INFORMED_CONSENT_CODE,--知情同意书编号

                       cast('病危(重)通知书' as varchar2(200)) as INFORMED_CONSENT_NAME,--知情同意书名称

                       cast(
                           substrb(
                               nvl(to_char(ks.qmpt_code), to_char(t.p_dept_code)),
                               1,
                               50
                           ) as varchar2(50)
                       ) as DEPT_CODE,--科室代码

                       cast(
                           substrb(
                               nvl(to_char(ks.qmpt_name), to_char(t.p_dept_name)),
                               1,
                               50
                           ) as varchar2(50)
                       ) as DEP_NAME,--科室名称 是

                       cast(
                           substrb(
                               to_char(t.p_are_name),
                               1,
                               50
                           ) as varchar2(50)
                       ) as AREA_NAME,--病区名称

                       cast(null as varchar2(10)) as WARD_NUM,--病房号

                       cast(
                           substrb(
                               to_char(t.p_bedno),
                               1,
                               10
                           ) as varchar2(10)
                       ) as SICKBED_NUM,--病床号

                       cast(
                           substrb(
                               nvl(to_char(t.p_name), to_char(pmi.name)),
                               1,
                               50
                           ) as varchar2(50)
                       ) as PATIENT_NAME,--患者姓名 是

                       cast(
                           case
                               when trim(pmi.sex) = '男' then 1
                               when trim(pmi.sex) = '女' then 2
                               when trim(pmi.sex) in ('未知', '未说明', '不明') then 0
                               else 9
                           end as number(1)
                       ) as SEX_CODE,--性别代码 是

                       cast(
                           case
                               when trim(pmi.sex) = '男' then '男'
                               when trim(pmi.sex) = '女' then '女'
                               when trim(pmi.sex) in ('未知', '未说明') then '未知'
                               else '不明'
                           end as varchar2(50)
                       ) as SEX_NAME,--性别 是

                       cast(
                           case
                               when pmi.date_of_birth is not null
                                and pv.admission_date_time is not null
                               then least(
                                        greatest(
                                            trunc(
                                                months_between(
                                                    pv.admission_date_time,
                                                    pmi.date_of_birth
                                                ) / 12
                                            ),
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        200
                                    )
                               else 0
                           end as number(3)
                       ) as AGE,--年龄 是

                       cast(
                           case
                               when pmi.date_of_birth is not null
                                and pv.admission_date_time is not null
                                and months_between(pv.admission_date_time, pmi.date_of_birth) >= 0
                                and months_between(pv.admission_date_time, pmi.date_of_birth) < 12
                               then to_char(
                                        trunc(
                                            months_between(
                                                pv.admission_date_time,
                                                pmi.date_of_birth
                                            )
                                        )
                                    )
                               else '0'
                           end as varchar2(8)
                       ) as AGE_MONTH,--年龄(月)

                       cast(
                           substrb(
                               coalesce(
                                   to_char(diag_code_cd.国标编码),
                                   to_char(diag_name_cd.国标编码)
                               ),
                               1,
                               12
                           ) as varchar2(12)
                       ) as DISEASE_CODE,--疾病诊断编码

                       cast(
                           substrb(
                               coalesce(
                                   cast(diag_code_cd.国标名称 as varchar2(4000 char)),
                                   cast(diag_name_cd.国标名称 as varchar2(4000 char)),
                                   cast(dd.diagnosis_desc as varchar2(4000 char))
                               ),
                               1,
                               50
                           ) as varchar2(50)
                       ) as DISEASE_NAME,--疾病诊断名称 是

                       cast(
                           substrb(
                               case
                                   when t4.ryqk is null
                                    and t5.zdyj is null
                                    and t5.zljh is null
                                   then null
                                   else dbms_lob.substr(
                                            to_clob('一、病情概况：') ||
                                            t4.ryqk ||
                                            to_clob(chr(10) || '二、诊断依据：') ||
                                            t5.zdyj ||
                                            to_clob(chr(10) || '三、诊疗计划：') ||
                                            t5.zljh,
                                            2000,
                                            1
                                        )
                               end,
                               1,
                               2000
                           ) as varchar2(2000)
                       ) as SUMMARY_RESCUE,--病情概括及主要抢救措施

                       cast(
                           substrb(
                               nvl(
                                   (
                                       select max(
                                                  dbms_lob.substr(
                                                      ec.段落内容,
                                                      4000,
                                                      1
                                                  )
                                              ) keep (
                                                  dense_rank first
                                                  order by
                                                      dbms_lob.getlength(ec.段落内容) desc nulls last,
                                                      ec.rowid
                                              )
                                         from MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT ec
                                        where ec.uhid = t.uhid
                                          and ec.段落编号 = t1.id
                                   ),
                                   '-'
                               ),
                               1,
                               4000
                           ) as varchar2(4000)
                       ) as CRITICAL_NOTICE,--病危(重)通知内容 是

                       to_char(
                           nvl(
                               t1.doc_title_time,
                               nvl(t1.doc_create_date, t1.modifiedon)
                           ),
                           'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss'
                       ) as CRITICAL_NOTICE_DATE,--病危(重)通知日期时间 是；统一时间格式

                       cast(
                           substrb(
                               nvl(to_char(pv.next_of_kin), '-'),
                               1,
                               50
                           ) as varchar2(50)
                       ) as LEGAL_REPRE_NAME,--法定代理人签名 是

                       cast(
                           substrb(
                               nvl(to_char(rel_cd.国标编码), '8'),
                               1,
                               2
                           ) as varchar2(2)
                       ) as PAT_LEGAL_REPRE_CODE,--法定代理人与患者的关系代码 是

                       cast(
                           substrb(
                               nvl(to_char(rel_cd.国标名称), '其它'),
                               1,
                               50
                           ) as varchar2(50)
                       ) as SAP_RELATIONSHIP_NAME,--法定代理人与患者的关系名称 是

                       to_char(
                           nvl(
                               t1.doc_create_date,
                               nvl(t1.doc_title_time, t1.modifiedon)
                           ),
                           'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss'
                       ) as LEGAL_REPRE_SIGN_DATE,--法定代理人签名日期 是；统一时间格式

                       cast(
                           substrb(
                               nvl(to_char(t1.modifiedby), nvl(to_char(t1.createby), '-')),
                               1,
                               50
                           ) as varchar2(50)
                       ) as DOC_NAME,--医师签名 是

                       to_char(
                           nvl(
                               t1.modifiedon,
                               nvl(t1.doc_create_date, t1.doc_title_time)
                           ),
                           'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss'
                       ) as DOC_DATE--医师签名日期时间 是；统一时间格式

                  from MTL.EPR_INPATIENT t1

                  inner join MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX t
                          on t.uhid = t1.uhid

                  left join (
                        select d.uhid,
                               max(d.id) keep (
                                   dense_rank first
                                   order by
                                       nvl(d.doc_finish_date, d.doc_sign_date) desc nulls last,
                                       d.id desc
                               ) as id
                          from MTL.EPR_INPATIENT d
                         where d.doc_type_name = '出院记录'
                         group by d.uhid
                  ) t2
                    on t2.uhid = t1.uhid

                  left join (
                        select x.段落编号,
                               x.ryqk
                          from (
                                select e.段落编号,
                                       e.ryqk,
                                       row_number() over (
                                           partition by e.段落编号
                                           order by e.段落编号
                                       ) as rn
                                  from MTL.EMRSD49 e
                               ) x
                         where x.rn = 1
                  ) t4
                    on t4.段落编号 = t2.id

                  left join (
                        select d.uhid,
                               min(d.id) keep (
                                   dense_rank first
                                   order by
                                       nvl(d.doc_finish_date, d.doc_sign_date) asc nulls last,
                                       d.id asc
                               ) as id
                          from MTL.EPR_INPATIENT d
                         where d.doc_type_name = '首次病程记录'
                         group by d.uhid
                  ) t3
                    on t3.uhid = t1.uhid

                  left join (
                        select x.段落编号,
                               x.zdyj,
                               x.zljh
                          from (
                                select e.段落编号,
                                       e.zdyj,
                                       e.zljh,
                                       row_number() over (
                                           partition by e.段落编号
                                           order by e.段落编号
                                       ) as rn
                                  from MTL.EMRSD37 e
                               ) x
                         where x.rn = 1
                  ) t5
                    on t5.段落编号 = t3.id

                  inner join HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
                          on pmi.inp_no = t.p_inpatient_no

                  inner join HIS.PAT_VISIT pv
                          on pv.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
                         and pv.visit_id = t.p_inpatient_times

                  inner join HIS.DIAGNOSIS dd
                          on dd.patient_id = pv.patient_id
                         and dd.visit_id = pv.visit_id
                         and dd.diagnosis_type = '3'
                         and dd.diagnosis_no = '1'

                  left join (
                        select cd.院标编码,
                               max(cd.国标编码) keep (
                                   dense_rank first
                                   order by
                                       case when cd.国标编码 is not null then 1 else 2 end,
                                       cd.国标编码
                               ) as 国标编码,
                               max(cd.国标名称) keep (
                                   dense_rank first
                                   order by
                                       case when cd.国标编码 is not null then 1 else 2 end,
                                       cd.国标编码
                               ) as 国标名称
                          from CDA.CDA_DICTIONARY cd
                         where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                           and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                         group by cd.院标编码
                  ) diag_code_cd
                    on diag_code_cd.院标编码 = dd.diagnosis_code

                  left join (
                        select cd.院标名称,
                               max(cd.国标编码) keep (
                                   dense_rank first
                                   order by
                                       case when cd.国标编码 is not null then 1 else 2 end,
                                       cd.国标编码
                               ) as 国标编码,
                               max(cd.国标名称) keep (
                                   dense_rank first
                                   order by
                                       case when cd.国标编码 is not null then 1 else 2 end,
                                       cd.国标编码
                               ) as 国标名称
                          from CDA.CDA_DICTIONARY cd
                         where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                           and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                         group by cd.院标名称
                  ) diag_name_cd
                    on diag_name_cd.院标名称 = dd.diagnosis_desc

                  inner join HIS.DEPT_DICT ks
                          on ks.dept_code = t.p_dept_code
                         and ks.qmpt_name is not null

                  left join (
                        select cd.院标编码,
                               max(cd.国标编码) keep (
                                   dense_rank first
                                   order by
                                       case when cd.国标编码 is not null then 1 else 2 end,
                                       cd.国标编码
                               ) as 国标编码,
                               max(cd.国标名称) keep (
                                   dense_rank first
                                   order by
                                       case when cd.国标编码 is not null then 1 else 2 end,
                                       cd.国标编码
                               ) as 国标名称
                          from CDA.CDA_DICTIONARY cd
                         where cd.字典名称 = '家庭关系代码'
                         group by cd.院标编码
                  ) rel_cd
                    on rel_cd.院标编码 = pmi.relationship

                 where t1.doc_type_name in (
                           '病重（危）通知书',
                           '病危（重）通知书',
                           '病危(重)通知书'
                       )

                   and coalesce(
                           cast(diag_code_cd.国标名称 as varchar2(4000 char)),
                           cast(diag_name_cd.国标名称 as varchar2(4000 char)),
                           cast(dd.diagnosis_desc as varchar2(4000 char))
                       ) is not null
               ) q
       )
 where rn = 1

V_EMR_INFOR_OPERATION.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_INFOR_OPERATION" ("ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "ADMISSION_ID", "INFORMED_CONSENT_CODE", "INFORMED_CONSENT_NAME", "APPLY_NUM", "DEPT_CODE", "DEP_NAME", "AREA_NAME", "WARD_NUM", "SICKBED_NUM", "PATIENT_NAME", "SEX_CODE", "SEX_NAME", "AGE", "AGE_MONTH", "PREOPERATIVE", "PREOPERATIVE_NAME", "OPERATION", "OPERATION_NAME", "OPERATION_DATE", "OPERATION_IN", "OPERATION_TABOO", "OPERATION_WAY", "ANAESTHESIA_CODE", "ANAESTHESIA_NAME", "OPERATION_READY", "OPERATIONING_RISK", "OPERATIONED_RISK", "REPLACE_PLAN", "ORG_VIEW", "PATIENT_VIEW", "PATIENT_SIGN_NAME", "STATUTORY_AGENT_VIEW", "SAP_RELATIONSHIP_CODE", "SAP_RELATIONSHIP_NAME", "PATIENT_SIGN_DATE", "DOCTOR", "OPERATOR", "DOC_DATE") AS 
  select ID,
       ORG_CODE,
       ORG_NAME,
       DISTRICT_CODE,
       EXCHANGE_TYPE,
       SYSTEM_TIME,
       ADMISSION_ID,
       INFORMED_CONSENT_CODE,
       INFORMED_CONSENT_NAME,
       APPLY_NUM,
       DEPT_CODE,
       DEP_NAME,
       AREA_NAME,
       WARD_NUM,
       SICKBED_NUM,
       PATIENT_NAME,
       SEX_CODE,
       SEX_NAME,
       AGE,
       AGE_MONTH,
       PREOPERATIVE,
       PREOPERATIVE_NAME,
       OPERATION,
       OPERATION_NAME,
       OPERATION_DATE,
       OPERATION_IN,
       OPERATION_TABOO,
       OPERATION_WAY,
       ANAESTHESIA_CODE,
       ANAESTHESIA_NAME,
       OPERATION_READY,
              nvl (OPERATIONING_RISK,'-' ) OPERATIONING_RISK,
       nvl (OPERATIONED_RISK,'-' ) OPERATIONED_RISK,
       REPLACE_PLAN,
       ORG_VIEW,
       PATIENT_VIEW,
       PATIENT_SIGN_NAME,
       STATUTORY_AGENT_VIEW,
       SAP_RELATIONSHIP_CODE,
       SAP_RELATIONSHIP_NAME,
       PATIENT_SIGN_DATE,
       DOCTOR,
       OPERATOR,
       DOC_DATE
from (
    select q.*,
           row_number() over (
               partition by q.ID
               order by q.DOC_DATE desc nulls last,
                        q.OPERATION_DATE desc nulls last
           ) as rn
    from (
        select substr(
                   '49557032X'||'|'||
                   nvl(to_char(p.patient_id), '-')||'|'||
                   nvl(to_char(p.visit_id), '-')||'|'||
                   nvl(to_char(t1.id), '-'),
                   1,
                   100
               ) as ID,--  内码 是 主键

               '49557032X' as ORG_CODE,--  医院组织机构代码 是 必填

               '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,--  医院名称 是 必填

               '370104' as DISTRICT_CODE,-- 所属行政区划 是

               'ADDHIS' as EXCHANGE_TYPE,-- 交换类型 是

               cast(systimestamp as timestamp) as SYSTEM_TIME,-- 数据上传时间戳

               substr(
                   nvl(to_char(p.patient_id), '-')||'|'||nvl(to_char(p.visit_id), '-'),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as ADMISSION_ID,-- 住院唯一标识号 是

               substr(
                   nvl(to_char(t1.doc_type_id), '-')||'-'||nvl(to_char(t1.id), '-'),
                   1,
                   20
               ) as INFORMED_CONSENT_CODE,-- 知情同意书编号

               substr(
                   nvl(nullif(trim(cast(t1.doc_type_name as varchar2(200))), ''), '手术知情同意书'),
                   1,
                   200
               ) as INFORMED_CONSENT_NAME,-- 知情同意书名称

               substr(
                   nvl(to_char(o.operation_no), nvl(to_char(mom.oper_id), to_char(t1.id))),
                   1,
                   20
               ) as APPLY_NUM,-- 手术申请单编号

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       (select cast(ks.qmpt_code as varchar2(50))
                          from his.dept_dict ks
                         where ks.dept_code = t.p_dept_code
                           and rownum = 1),
                       nvl(cast(t.p_dept_code as varchar2(50)), '-')
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as DEPT_CODE,-- 科室代码

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       (select cast(ks.qmpt_name as varchar2(50))
                          from his.dept_dict ks
                         where ks.dept_code = t.p_dept_code
                           and rownum = 1),
                       nvl(
                           (select cast(ks.dept_name as varchar2(50))
                              from his.dept_dict ks
                             where ks.dept_code = t.p_dept_code
                               and rownum = 1),
                           '-'
                       )
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as DEP_NAME,-- 科室名称 是

               substr(cast(t.p_are_name as varchar2(50)), 1, 50) as AREA_NAME,-- 病区名称

               cast(null as varchar2(10)) as WARD_NUM,-- 病房号

               substr(cast(t.p_bedno as varchar2(10)), 1, 10) as SICKBED_NUM,-- 病床号

               substr(
                   nvl(nullif(trim(cast(t.p_name as varchar2(50))), ''), nvl(cast(pmi.name as varchar2(50)), '-')),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as PATIENT_NAME,-- 患者姓名 是

               case
                   when cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(10)) = '男' then 1
                   when cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(10)) = '女' then 2
                   when cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(10)) = '未知' then 0
                   else 9
               end as SEX_CODE,-- 性别代码 是

               substr(
                   case
                       when cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(10)) = '男' then '男'
                       when cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(10)) = '女' then '女'
                       when cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(10)) = '未知' then '未知'
                       else '不明'
                   end,
                   1,
                   50
               ) as SEX_NAME,-- 性别 是

               case
                   when pmi.date_of_birth is not null
                    and p.admission_date_time is not null
                   then least(
                            greatest(
                                trunc(months_between(p.admission_date_time, pmi.date_of_birth) / 12),
                                0
                            ),
                            200
                        )
                   else 0
               end as AGE,-- 年龄 是 0-200

               substr(
                   case
                       when pmi.date_of_birth is not null
                        and p.admission_date_time is not null
                        and months_between(p.admission_date_time, pmi.date_of_birth) < 12
                       then to_char(
                                least(
                                    greatest(
                                        trunc(months_between(p.admission_date_time, pmi.date_of_birth)),
                                        0
                                    ),
                                    11
                                )
                            )
                       else null
                   end,
                   1,
                   2
               ) as AGE_MONTH,-- 年龄(月) 0-11

            nvl( nvl(   (select max(cd.国标编码)
            from cda.cda_dictionary cd
           where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
             and cd.系统标识 = 'SM'
             and cd.院标名称 = mom.DIAG_before_OPERATION)    ,
              (select max(cd.国标编码)
            from cda.cda_dictionary cd

             and cd.院标编码 = dd.diagnosis_code)
       ),         dd.diagnosis_code)         as PREOPERATIVE,-- 术前诊断编码

                  cast(
    substrb( nvl( nvl(   (select max(cd.国标名称)
            from cda.cda_dictionary cd
           where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
             and cd.系统标识 = 'SM'
             and cd.院标名称 = mom.DIAG_before_OPERATION)    ,
              (select max(cd.国标名称)
            from cda.cda_dictionary cd
           where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
             and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
             and cd.院标编码 = dd.diagnosis_code)
       ),         dd.diagnosis_desc),
        1,
        50
    )
    as varchar2(50)
)       as PREOPERATIVE_NAME,-- 术前诊断名称 是

            cast(
    coalesce(
        (
            select max(to_char(cd.国标编码))
              from cda.cda_dictionary cd
             where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-9手术编码'
               and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'

               and cd.院标编码 = o.operation_code
        ),
        (
            select max(to_char(cd.国标编码))
              from cda.cda_dictionary cd
             where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-9手术编码'
               and cd.系统标识 = 'SM'

        nullif(trim(to_char(o.operation_code)), '')
    ) as varchar2(50)
) as OPERATION,  -- 拟实施手术及操作编码

           cast(
    substrb(
        coalesce(
            (
                select max(to_char(cd.国标名称))
                  from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                 where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-9手术编码'
                   and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                   and cd.院标名称 = o.operation_desc
            ),
            (

            ),
            (
                select max(to_char(cd.国标名称))

) as OPERATION_NAME,  -- 拟实施手术及操作名称 是

               cast(
                   coalesce(o.operating_date, mom.start_date_time, mom.scheduled_date_time, t1.doc_title_time, t1.doc_finish_date)
                   as date
               ) as OPERATION_DATE,-- 拟实施手术及操作日期时间 是

               substr(

               substr(
                   nvl(nullif(trim(cast(t3.ssjjz as varchar2(1000))), ''), '-'),

                   1000

        cast(
    substrb(
        coalesce(
            nullif(

                    regexp_substr(
                        dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 1000, 1),

) as OPERATION_WAY, -- 手术方式

               substr(

               substr(
