                              from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                             where cast(cd.字典名称 as varchar2(100)) = '麻醉方法代码表'
                               and cast(cd.系统标识 as varchar2(20)) = 'HIS'
                               and cast(cd.院标名称 as varchar2(100)) = cast(o.anaesthesia_method as varchar2(100))
                               and rownum = 1),
                           (select cast(cd.国标名称 as varchar2(50))
                              from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                             where cast(cd.字典名称 as varchar2(100)) = '麻醉方法代码表'
                               and cast(cd.系统标识 as varchar2(20)) = '手麻'
                               and cast(cd.院标名称 as varchar2(100)) = cast(mom.anesthesia_method as varchar2(100))
                               and rownum = 1)
                       ),
                       '其他麻醉方法'
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as ANAESTHESIA_NAME,-- 拟实施麻醉方法名称 是

               substr(
                   nvl(nullif(trim(cast(t3.sqzb as varchar2(1000))), ''), '-'),
                   1,
                   1000
               ) as OPERATION_READY,-- 术前准备

           substr(
    nvl(
        nullif(
            trim(
                regexp_substr(
                    cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 1000, 1) as varchar2(1000)),
                    '术中或术后可能出现的并发症及手术风险[[:space:]]*[:：]?[[:space:]]*(.*?)(二[、.．][[:space:]]*替代医疗方案|三[、.．]|经治医师签名|患方明确意见)',
                    1, 1, 'n', 1
                )
            ),
            ''
        ),
        nvl(
            nullif(
                trim(
                    regexp_substr(
                        cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 1000, 1) as varchar2(1000)),
                        '主要意外、风险及并发症[[:space:]]*[:：]?[[:space:]]*(.*?)(4[.．][[:space:]]*防范措施|5[.．][[:space:]]*可替代|6[.．][[:space:]]*医师声明|医师声明)',
                        1, 1, 'n', 1
                    )
                ),
                ''
            ),
            nvl(
                nullif(
                    trim(
                        regexp_substr(
                            cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 1000, 1) as varchar2(1000)),
                            '患者住院期间的病情及风险告知[[:space:]]*[:：]?[[:space:]]*(.*?)(医师签名|医生已告知|患者签名|$)',
                            1, 1, 'n', 1
                        )
                    ),
                    ''
                ),
                '-'
            )
        )
    ),
    1,
    2000
) as OPERATIONING_RISK,-- 手术中可能出现的意外及风险

substr(
    nvl(
        nullif(
            trim(
                regexp_substr(
                    cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 1000, 1) as varchar2(1000)),
                    '术中或术后可能出现的并发症及手术风险[[:space:]]*[:：]?[[:space:]]*(.*?)(二[、.．][[:space:]]*替代医疗方案|三[、.．]|经治医师签名|患方明确意见)',
                    1, 1, 'n', 1
                )
            ),
            ''
        ),
        nvl(
            nullif(
                trim(
                    regexp_substr(
                        cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 1000, 1) as varchar2(1000)),
                        '主要意外、风险及并发症[[:space:]]*[:：]?[[:space:]]*(.*?)(4[.．][[:space:]]*防范措施|5[.．][[:space:]]*可替代|6[.．][[:space:]]*医师声明|医师声明)',
                        1, 1, 'n', 1
                    )
                ),
                ''
            ),
            nvl(
                nullif(
                    trim(
                        regexp_substr(
                            cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 1000, 1) as varchar2(1000)),
                            '患者住院期间的病情及风险告知[[:space:]]*[:：]?[[:space:]]*(.*?)(医师签名|医生已告知|患者签名|$)',
                            1, 1, 'n', 1
                        )
                    ),
                    ''
                ),
                '-'
            )
        )
    ),
    1,
    1000
) as OPERATIONED_RISK,-- 手术后可能出现的意外及并发症
           cast(
    substrb(
        coalesce(
            nullif(
                trim(
                    regexp_substr(
                        dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
                        '二[、.．][[:space:]]*替代医疗方案[[:space:]]*[:：]?[[:space:]]*(.*?)(三[、.．][[:space:]]*其他告知内容|经治医师签名|患方明确意见|$)',
                        1,
                        1,
                        'n',
                        1
                    )
                ),
                ''
            ),
            nullif(
                trim(
                    regexp_substr(
                        dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
                        '5[.．][[:space:]]*可替代的方案[[:space:]]*[:：]?[[:space:]]*(.*?)(6[.．][[:space:]]*医师声明|7[.．][[:space:]]*患方意见|$)',
                        1,
                        1,
                        'n',
                        1
                    )
                ),
                ''
            ),
            '-'
        ),
        1,
        1000
    ) as varchar2(1000)
) as REPLACE_PLAN,    -- 替代方案

               substr(
                   '医方已向患者或法定代理人告知拟实施手术、麻醉方式、术中及术后可能发生的意外、并发症、风险及替代方案，患方已知情。',
                   1,
                   2000
               ) as ORG_VIEW,-- 医疗机构意见

            substr(
    nvl(
        nullif(
            trim(
                regexp_substr(
                    cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1) as varchar2(2000)),
                    '(患方明确意见|患方意见)[[:space:]]*[:：]?[[:space:]]*(.*?)(患者签名|或患者的监护人|被授权人|因抢救|$)',
                    1, 1, 'n', 2
                )
            ),
            ''
        ),
        '-'
    ),
    1,
    2000
) as PATIENT_VIEW, -- 患者/法定代理人意见

               substr(
                   nvl(nullif(trim(cast(t.p_name as varchar2(50))), ''), nvl(cast(pmi.name as varchar2(50)), '-')),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as PATIENT_SIGN_NAME,-- 患者签名 是

               substr(
                   nvl(nullif(trim(cast(p.next_of_kin as varchar2(50))), ''), '-'),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as STATUTORY_AGENT_VIEW,-- 法定代理人签名

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       (select cast(cd.国标编码 as varchar2(2))
                          from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                         where cast(cd.字典名称 as varchar2(100)) = '家庭关系代码'
                           and cast(cd.院标编码 as varchar2(100)) = cast(pmi.relationship as varchar2(100))
                           and rownum = 1),
                       '8'
                   ),
                   1,
                   2
               ) as SAP_RELATIONSHIP_CODE,-- 法定代理人与患者的关系代码

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       (select cast(cd.国标名称 as varchar2(50))
                          from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                         where cast(cd.字典名称 as varchar2(100)) = '家庭关系代码'
                           and cast(cd.院标编码 as varchar2(100)) = cast(pmi.relationship as varchar2(100))
                           and rownum = 1),
                       '其他'
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as SAP_RELATIONSHIP_NAME,-- 法定代理人与患者的关系名称

              cast(
    case
        when t1.doc_finish_date is not null
         and t1.doc_finish_date >= date '1900-01-01'
        then t1.doc_finish_date

        when t1.doc_title_time is not null
         and t1.doc_title_time >= date '1900-01-01'
        then t1.doc_title_time

        when t1.modifiedon is not null
         and t1.modifiedon >= date '1900-01-01'
        then t1.modifiedon

        else p.admission_date_time
    end
    as date
) as PATIENT_SIGN_DATE,  -- 患者/法定代理人签名日期 是

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       (select cast(yg.name as varchar2(50))
                          from his.staff_dict yg
                         where yg.emp_no = p.doctor_in_charge
                           and rownum = 1),
                       '-'
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as DOCTOR,-- 经治医师签名

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       case
                           when regexp_like(cast(o.operator as varchar2(50)), '^[0-9]+$')
                           then (select cast(sd.name as varchar2(50))
                                   from his.staff_dict sd
                                  where sd.emp_no = o.operator
                                    and rownum = 1)
                           else nvl(
                                   (select cast(sd.name as varchar2(50))
                                      from his.staff_dict sd
                                     where sd.user_name = mom.SURGEON
                                       and rownum = 1),
                                   cast(o.operator as varchar2(50))
                                )
                       end,
                       '-'
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as OPERATOR,-- 手术者签名 是
               cast(
                   nvl(t1.modifiedon, nvl(t1.doc_finish_date, t1.doc_title_time))
                   as date
               ) as DOC_DATE -- 医师签名日期时间 是
from mtl.epr_inpatient_docindex t
inner join mtl.epr_inpatient t1
        on t.uhid = t1.uhid
       and   cast(t1.doc_type_name as varchar2(100)) = '手术同意书'

left join mtl.emrsd46 t3
       on t3.段落编号 = t1.id

left join mtl.emrsd_content t4
       on t4.uhid = t1.uhid
      and t4.段落编号 = t1.id

left join his.pat_master_index pmi
       on t.p_inpatient_no = pmi.inp_no

left join his.pat_visit p
       on pmi.patient_id = p.patient_id
      and t.p_inpatient_times = p.visit_id

left join sm.med_operation_master mom
       on mom.patient_id = p.patient_id
      and mom.visit_id = t.p_inpatient_times

left join (select * from (
select o.*,
       row_number() over (
           partition by
               o.patient_id,
               o.visit_id,
               trunc(o.operating_date)
           order by
               o.operation_scale desc nulls last,
               case
                   when to_char(o.op_primary) = '1' then 1
                   else 0
               end desc,
               o.operation_no asc nulls last
       ) as rn
from his.operation o  )  where rn=1       and not regexp_like(
              nvl(cast(operation_desc as varchar2(500)), '-'),
              '输血|红细胞|血浆|血细胞|成份血|血液透析|血液滤过|气管内插管|呼吸机|中心静脉|动脉穿刺|鼻十二指肠|营养管|肺泡灌洗|支气管镜'
          )    )  o
               on mom.patient_id = o.patient_id
              and mom.visit_id = o.visit_id
            and to_char(o.operating_date,'yyyy-mm-dd')=to_char( nvl(mom.start_date_time,mom.SCHEDULED_DATE_TIME),'yyyy-mm-dd')


left join (
    select a.patient_id,
           a.visit_id,
           a.diagnosis_code,
           a.diagnosis_desc,
           row_number() over (
               partition by a.patient_id, a.visit_id
               order by
                   case
                       when a.diagnosis_type = '2' then 1
                       when a.diagnosis_type = '1' then 2
                       when a.diagnosis_type = '3' then 3
                       else 4
                   end,
                   a.diagnosis_no
           ) as rn
      from his.diagnosis a
) dd
       on dd.rn = 1
      and p.patient_id = dd.patient_id
      and p.visit_id = dd.visit_id

where p.discharge_date_time >= to_date('2021-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
  and p.discharge_date_time <  to_date('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
and not regexp_like(
        cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 500, 1) as varchar2(500)),
        '医患沟通书|激素治疗'
    )


    ) q
)
where rn = 1

V_EMR_INFOR_OTHERS.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_INFOR_OTHERS" ("ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "ADMISSION_ID", "INFORMED_CONSENT_CODE", "INFORMED_CONSENT_NAME", "DEPT_CODE", "DEP_NAME", "AREA_NAME", "WARD_NUM", "SICKBED_NUM", "PATIENT_NAME", "SEX_CODE", "SEX_NAME", "AGE", "AGE_MONTH", "DISEASE_CODE", "DISEASE_NAME", "INFORMED_CONSENT", "ORG_VIEW", "PATIENT_VIEW", "PATIENT_SIGN_NAME", "LEGAL_REPRE_NAME", "PAT_LEGAL_REPRE_CODE", "SAP_RELATIONSHIP_NAME", "PATIENT_SIGN_DATE", "DOC_NAME", "DOC_DATE") AS 
  select d.ID,
       d.ORG_CODE,
       d.ORG_NAME,
       d.DISTRICT_CODE,
       d.EXCHANGE_TYPE,
       d.SYSTEM_TIME,
       d.ADMISSION_ID,
       d.INFORMED_CONSENT_CODE,
       d.INFORMED_CONSENT_NAME,
       d.DEPT_CODE,
       d.DEP_NAME,
       d.AREA_NAME,
       d.WARD_NUM,
       d.SICKBED_NUM,
       d.PATIENT_NAME,
       d.SEX_CODE,
       d.SEX_NAME,
       d.AGE,
       d.AGE_MONTH,
       d.DISEASE_CODE,
       d.DISEASE_NAME,
       d.INFORMED_CONSENT,
       d.ORG_VIEW,
       d.PATIENT_VIEW,
       d.PATIENT_SIGN_NAME,
       d.LEGAL_REPRE_NAME,
       d.PAT_LEGAL_REPRE_CODE,
       d.SAP_RELATIONSHIP_NAME,
       d.PATIENT_SIGN_DATE,
       d.DOC_NAME,
       d.DOC_DATE
  from (
        select q.*,
               row_number() over (
                   partition by q.ID
                   order by
                       case
                           when q.INFORMED_CONSENT is not null then 0
                           else 1
                       end,
                       case
                           when q.DISEASE_CODE is not null then 0
                           else 1
                       end,
                       q.DOC_DATE desc nulls last,
                       q.PATIENT_SIGN_DATE desc nulls last,
                       q.DISEASE_CODE nulls last,
                       q.DISEASE_NAME nulls last
               ) as id_rn
          from (
                select
                       /* 内码：机构编码+住院标识+文书ID */
                       '49557032X' ||
                       cast(pv.patient_id as varchar2(30)) || '|' ||
                       cast(pv.visit_id as varchar2(10)) || '|' ||
                       cast(t1.id as varchar2(40)) as ID,

                       '49557032X' as ORG_CODE,

                       '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,

                       '370104' as DISTRICT_CODE,

                       'ADDHIS' as EXCHANGE_TYPE,

                       sysdate as SYSTEM_TIME,

                       cast(pv.patient_id as varchar2(30)) || '|' ||
                       cast(pv.visit_id as varchar2(10)) as ADMISSION_ID,

                       nvl(
                           substrb(
                               cast(t1.id as varchar2(100)),
                               1,
                               20
                           ),
                           '-'
                       ) as INFORMED_CONSENT_CODE,

                       substrb(
                           cast(t1.doc_title as varchar2(2000)),
                           1,
                           200
                       ) as INFORMED_CONSENT_NAME,

                       substrb(
                           cast(ks.qmpt_code as varchar2(2000)),
                           1,
                           50
                       ) as DEPT_CODE,

                       substrb(
                           case
                               when trim(
                                        cast(
                                            ks.qmpt_name as varchar2(2000)
                                        )
                                    ) is not null
                               then cast(
                                        ks.qmpt_name as varchar2(2000)
                                    )
                               else cast(
                                        t.p_dept_name as varchar2(2000)
                                    )
                           end,
                           1,
                           50
                       ) as DEP_NAME,

                       substrb(
                           cast(t.p_are_name as varchar2(2000)),
                           1,
                           50
                       ) as AREA_NAME,

                       cast(null as varchar2(10)) as WARD_NUM,

                       substrb(
                           cast(t.p_bedno as varchar2(2000)),
                           1,
                           10
                       ) as SICKBED_NUM,

                       substrb(
                           cast(t.p_name as varchar2(2000)),
                           1,
                           50
                       ) as PATIENT_NAME,

                       case
                           when trim(
                                    cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(20))
                                ) = '男'
                           then 1

                           when trim(
                                    cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(20))
                                ) = '女'
                           then 2

                           when trim(
                                    cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(20))
                                ) = '未知'
                           then 0

                           else 9
                       end as SEX_CODE,

                       case
                           when trim(
                                    cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(20))
                                ) = '男'
                           then '男'

                           when trim(
                                    cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(20))
                                ) = '女'
                           then '女'

                           when trim(
                                    cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(20))
                                ) = '未知'
                           then '未知'

                           else '不明'
                       end as SEX_NAME,

                       case
                           when pmi.date_of_birth is not null
                            and pv.admission_date_time is not null
                           then least(
                                    greatest(
                                        trunc(
                                            months_between(
                                                pv.admission_date_time,
                                                pmi.date_of_birth
                                            ) / 12
                                        ),
                                        0
                                    ),
                                    200
                                )
                           else null
                       end as AGE,

                       case
                           when pmi.date_of_birth is not null
                            and pv.admission_date_time is not null
                            and months_between(
                                    pv.admission_date_time,
                                    pmi.date_of_birth
                                ) >= 0
                            and months_between(
                                    pv.admission_date_time,
                                    pmi.date_of_birth
                                ) < 12
                           then to_char(
                                    least(
                                        greatest(
                                            trunc(
                                                months_between(
                                                    pv.admission_date_time,
                                                    pmi.date_of_birth
                                                )
                                            ),
                                            0
                                        ),
                                        11
                                    )
                                )

                           when pmi.date_of_birth is not null
                            and pv.admission_date_time is not null
                           then '0'

                           else null
                       end as AGE_MONTH,

                       nvl(
                           substrb(
                               cast(
                                   diag_cd.国标编码 as varchar2(2000)
                               ),
                               1,
                               12
                           ),
                           dd.diagnosis_code
                       ) as DISEASE_CODE,

                       nvl(
                           substrb(
                               cast(
                                   diag_cd.国标名称 as varchar2(2000)
                               ),
                               1,
                               50
                           ),
                           dd.diagnosis_desc
                       ) as DISEASE_NAME,

                       substrb(
                           case
                               when trim(
                                        cast(
                                            t3.content_text as varchar2(2000)
                                        )
                                    ) is not null
                               then cast(
                                        t3.content_text as varchar2(2000)
                                    )
                               else cast(
                                        t4.content_text as varchar2(2000)
                                    )
                           end,
                           1,
                           1000
                       ) as INFORMED_CONSENT,

                       cast(null as varchar2(2000)) as ORG_VIEW,

                       cast(null as varchar2(2000)) as PATIENT_VIEW,

                       cast(null as varchar2(50)) as PATIENT_SIGN_NAME,

                       nvl(
                           substrb(
                               cast(
                                   pv.next_of_kin as varchar2(2000)
                               ),
                               1,
                               50
                           ),
                           '-'
                       ) as LEGAL_REPRE_NAME,

                       nvl(
                           substrb(
                               cast(
                                   relation_map.standard_code
                                       as varchar2(2000)
                               ),
                               1,
                               2
                           ),
                           '8'
                       ) as PAT_LEGAL_REPRE_CODE,

                       nvl(
                           substrb(
                               cast(
                                   relation_map.standard_name
                                       as varchar2(2000)
                               ),
                               1,
                               50
                           ),
                           '其它'
                       ) as SAP_RELATIONSHIP_NAME,

                       t1.doc_finish_date as PATIENT_SIGN_DATE,

                       substrb(
                           cast(t1.MODIFIEDBY as varchar2(50)),
                           1,
                           50
                       ) as DOC_NAME,

                       t1.MODIFIEDON as DOC_DATE

                  from MTL.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX t

                 inner join MTL.EPR_INPATIENT t1
                         on t1.uhid = t.uhid
                        and t1.doc_type_name = '其他知情同意书'
                        and t1.doc_title in (
                               '医患协议书-新标',
                               '拒绝检查治疗告知书-新标',
                               '激素使用知情同意书',
                               '消化内镜知情同意书-新标',
                               '化疗知情同意书-新标',
                               '自动出院或转院告知书-新标',
                               '劝阻住院患者外出告知书-新标',
                               '电子纤维支气管镜检查知情同意书-新标',
                               '临床路径知情同意书-新标',
                               '使用植入类或Ⅲ级医用耗材知情同意书-新标',
                               '留置导尿知情同意书-新标',
                               '新冰冻知情同意书',
                               '留置胃管知情同意书-新标',
                               '转科、转诊（转院）知情同意书-新标',
                               '（新版）消化内镜知情同意书'
                            )

                  left join (
                       select paragraph_id,
                              content_text
                         from (
                               select x.段落编号 as paragraph_id,

                                      cast(
                                          dbms_lob.substr(
                                              x.Zqtynr,
                                              2000,
                                              1
                                          ) as varchar2(2000)
                                      ) as content_text,

                                      row_number() over (
                                          partition by x.段落编号
                                          order by
                                              dbms_lob.getlength(
                                                  x.Zqtynr
                                              ) desc nulls last,
                                              x.rowid
                                      ) as rn
                                 from MTL.EMRSD31 x
                              )
                        where rn = 1
                  ) t3
                    on t3.paragraph_id = t1.id

                  left join (
                       select uhid,
                              paragraph_id,
                              content_text
                         from (
                               select x.uhid,
                                      x.段落编号 as paragraph_id,

                                      cast(
                                          dbms_lob.substr(
                                              x.段落内容,
                                              2000,
                                              1
                                          ) as varchar2(2000)
                                      ) as content_text,

                                      row_number() over (
                                          partition by
                                              x.uhid,
                                              x.段落编号
                                          order by
                                              dbms_lob.getlength(
                                                  x.段落内容
                                              ) desc nulls last,
                                              x.rowid
                                      ) as rn
                                 from MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT x
                              )
                        where rn = 1
                  ) t4
                    on t4.uhid = t1.uhid
                   and t4.paragraph_id = t1.id

                  left join HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
                    on pmi.inp_no = t.p_inpatient_no

                  left join HIS.PAT_VISIT pv
                    on pv.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
                   and pv.visit_id = t.p_inpatient_times

                  left join (
                       select dept_code,
                              qmpt_code,
                              qmpt_name
                         from (
                               select cast(
                                          d.dept_code as varchar2(2000)
                                      ) as dept_code,

                                      cast(
                                          d.qmpt_code as varchar2(2000)
                                      ) as qmpt_code,

                                      cast(
                                          d.qmpt_name as varchar2(2000)
                                      ) as qmpt_name,

                                      row_number() over (
                                          partition by d.dept_code
                                          order by
                                              case
                                                  when d.qmpt_code is not null
                                                  then 0
                                                  else 1
                                              end,
                                              d.qmpt_code,
                                              d.qmpt_name
                                      ) as rn
                                 from HIS.DEPT_DICT d
                              )
                        where rn = 1
                  ) ks
                    on ks.dept_code =
                       cast(t.p_dept_code as varchar2(2000))

                  left join (
                       select patient_id,
                              visit_id,
                              diagnosis_code,
                              diagnosis_desc
                         from (
                               select d.patient_id,
                                      d.visit_id,
                                      d.diagnosis_code,
                                      d.diagnosis_desc,

                                      row_number() over (
                                          partition by
                                              d.patient_id,
                                              d.visit_id
                                          order by
                                              d.rowid
                                      ) as rn
                                 from HIS.DIAGNOSIS d
                                where d.diagnosis_type = '3'
                                  and d.diagnosis_no = '1'
                              )
                        where rn = 1
                  ) dd
                    on dd.patient_id = pv.patient_id
                   and dd.visit_id = pv.visit_id

                  left join (
                       select 院标名称,
                              院标编码,
                              国标编码,
                              国标名称
                         from (
                               select cd.院标名称,
                                      cd.院标编码,
                                      cd.国标编码,
                                      cd.国标名称,

                                      row_number() over (
                                          partition by
                                              nvl(
                                                  cd.院标编码,
                                                  cd.院标名称
                                              )
                                          order by
                                              case
                                                  when cd.国标编码 is not null
                                                  then 1
                                                  else 2
                                              end,
                                              cd.国标编码,
                                              cd.国标名称
                                      ) as rn
                                 from CDA.CDA_DICTIONARY cd
                                where cd.字典名称 =
                                      'ICD-10诊断编码'
                                  and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                              )
                        where rn = 1
                  ) diag_cd
                    on (
                           diag_cd.院标编码 = dd.diagnosis_code
                        or (
                               diag_cd.院标编码 is null
                           and diag_cd.院标名称 = dd.diagnosis_desc
                           )
                       )

                  left join (
                       select local_code,
                              standard_code,
                              standard_name
                         from (
                               select cast(
                                          cd.院标编码
                                              as varchar2(2000)
                                      ) as local_code,

                                      cast(
                                          cd.国标编码
                                              as varchar2(2000)
                                      ) as standard_code,

                                      cast(
                                          cd.国标名称
                                              as varchar2(2000)
                                      ) as standard_name,

                                      row_number() over (
                                          partition by cd.院标编码
                                          order by
                                              case
                                                  when cd.国标编码 is not null
                                                  then 0
                                                  else 1
                                              end,
                                              cd.国标编码,
                                              cd.国标名称
                                      ) as rn
                                 from CDA.CDA_DICTIONARY cd
                                where cd.字典名称 = '家庭关系代码'
                              )
                        where rn = 1
                  ) relation_map
                    on relation_map.local_code =
                       cast(pmi.relationship as varchar2(2000))

                 where t1.doc_stats = '1'
               ) q
       ) d
 where d.id_rn = 1

V_EMR_INFOR_SPEC_EXAM_TREAT.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_INFOR_SPEC_EXAM_TREAT" ("ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "PATIENT_TYPE", "VISTING_NUM", "INFORMED_CONSENT_CODE", "INFORMED_CONSENT_NAME", "DEPT_CODE", "DEP_NAME", "AREA_NAME", "WARD_NUM", "SICKBED_NUM", "PATIENT_NAME", "SEX_CODE", "SEX_NAME", "AGE", "AGE_MONTH", "DISEASE_CODE", "DISEASE_NAME", "SPEC_EXAM_TREAT_NAME", "SPEC_EXAM_TREAT_PURPOSE", "SPEC_EXAM_TREAT_RISK", "REPLACE_PLAN", "STATUTORY_AGENT_VIEW", "SAP_RELATIONSHIP", "SAP_RELATIONSHIP_NAME", "PATIENT_SIGN_DATE", "OPERATOR", "DOC_DATE") AS 
  select ID,
       ORG_CODE,
       ORG_NAME,
       DISTRICT_CODE,
       EXCHANGE_TYPE,
       SYSTEM_TIME,
       PATIENT_TYPE,
       VISTING_NUM,
       INFORMED_CONSENT_CODE,
       INFORMED_CONSENT_NAME,
       DEPT_CODE,
       DEP_NAME,
       AREA_NAME,
       WARD_NUM,
       SICKBED_NUM,
       PATIENT_NAME,
       SEX_CODE,
       SEX_NAME,
       AGE,
       AGE_MONTH,
       DISEASE_CODE,
       DISEASE_NAME,
       SPEC_EXAM_TREAT_NAME,
       SPEC_EXAM_TREAT_PURPOSE,
       SPEC_EXAM_TREAT_RISK,
       REPLACE_PLAN,
       STATUTORY_AGENT_VIEW,
       SAP_RELATIONSHIP,
       SAP_RELATIONSHIP_NAME,
       PATIENT_SIGN_DATE,
       OPERATOR,
       DOC_DATE
from (
    select q.*,
           row_number() over (
               partition by q.ID
               order by q.DOC_DATE desc nulls last,
                        q.PATIENT_SIGN_DATE desc nulls last
           ) as rn
    from (
        select substr(
                   '49557032X'||'|'||
                   nvl(to_char(pv.patient_id), '-')||'|'||
                   nvl(to_char(pv.visit_id), '-')||'|'||
                   nvl(to_char(t1.id), '-'),
                   1,
                   100
               ) as ID,-- 内码 是 主键

               '49557032X' as ORG_CODE,-- 医院组织机构代码 是

               '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,-- 医院名称 是

               '370104' as DISTRICT_CODE,-- 所属行政区划 是

               'ADDHIS' as EXCHANGE_TYPE,-- 交换类型 是

               cast(systimestamp as timestamp) as SYSTEM_TIME,-- 数据上传时间戳

               '2' as PATIENT_TYPE,-- 病人类型 是 1门诊 2住院

               substr(
                   nvl(to_char(pv.patient_id), '-')||'|'||nvl(to_char(pv.visit_id), '-'),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as VISTING_NUM,-- 就诊号 是

               substr(
                   nvl(to_char(t1.doc_type_id), '-')||'-'||nvl(to_char(t1.id), '-'),
                   1,
                   20
               ) as INFORMED_CONSENT_CODE,-- 知情同意书编号

               '特殊检查及特殊治疗同意书' as INFORMED_CONSENT_NAME,-- 知情同意书名称

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       (select cast(ks.qmpt_code as varchar2(50))
                          from his.dept_dict ks
                         where ks.dept_code = t.p_dept_code
                           and rownum = 1),
                       nvl(cast(t.p_dept_code as varchar2(50)), '-')
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as DEPT_CODE,-- 科室代码

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       (select cast(ks.qmpt_name as varchar2(50))
                          from his.dept_dict ks
                         where ks.dept_code = t.p_dept_code
                           and rownum = 1),
                       nvl(
                           (select cast(ks.dept_name as varchar2(50))
                              from his.dept_dict ks
                             where ks.dept_code = t.p_dept_code
                               and rownum = 1),
                           '-'
                       )
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as DEP_NAME,-- 科室名称 是

               substr(cast(t.p_are_name as varchar2(50)), 1, 50) as AREA_NAME,-- 病区名称

               cast(null as varchar2(10)) as WARD_NUM,-- 病房号

               substr(cast(t.p_bedno as varchar2(10)), 1, 10) as SICKBED_NUM,-- 病床号

               substr(
                   nvl(nullif(trim(cast(pmi.name as varchar2(50))), ''), nvl(cast(t.p_name as varchar2(50)), '-')),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as PATIENT_NAME,-- 患者姓名 是

               case
                   when cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(10)) = '男' then 1
                   when cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(10)) = '女' then 2
                   when cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(10)) = '未知' then 0
                   else 9
               end as SEX_CODE,-- 性别代码 是

               substr(
                   case
                       when cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(10)) = '男' then '男'
                       when cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(10)) = '女' then '女'
                       when cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(10)) = '未知' then '未知'
                       else '不明'
                   end,
                   1,
                   50
               ) as SEX_NAME,-- 性别 是

               case
                   when pmi.date_of_birth is not null
                    and pv.admission_date_time is not null
                   then least(
                            greatest(
                                trunc(months_between(pv.admission_date_time, pmi.date_of_birth) / 12),
                                0
                            ),
                            200
                        )
                   else 0
               end as AGE,-- 年龄

               substr(
                   case
                       when pmi.date_of_birth is not null
                        and pv.admission_date_time is not null
                        and months_between(pv.admission_date_time, pmi.date_of_birth) < 12
                       then to_char(
                                least(
                                    greatest(
                                        trunc(months_between(pv.admission_date_time, pmi.date_of_birth)),
                                        0
                                    ),
                                    11
                                )
                            )
                       else null
                   end,
                   1,
                   2
               ) as AGE_MONTH,-- 年龄(月)

             cast(
    substrb(
        nvl(
            nullif(
                trim(
                    (select max(substrb(to_char(cd.国标编码), 1, 12))
                       from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                      where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                        and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                        and cd.院标名称 = dd.diagnosis_desc)
                ),
                ''
            ),
            nullif(substrb(to_char(dd.diagnosis_code), 1, 12), '')
        ),
        1,
        12
    ) as varchar2(12)
) as DISEASE_CODE, -- 疾病诊断编码

             cast(
    substrb(
        nvl(
            nullif(
                trim(
                    (select max(substrb(to_char(cd.国标名称), 1, 50))
                       from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                      where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                        and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                        and cd.院标名称 = dd.diagnosis_desc)
                ),
                ''
            ),
            nvl(substrb(to_char(dd.diagnosis_desc), 1, 50), '-')
        ),
        1,
        50
    ) as varchar2(50)
) as DISEASE_NAME, -- 疾病诊断名称 是

               substr(
                   case
                       when t1.doc_title = '消化内镜知情同意书-新标' then '消化内镜'
                       when t1.doc_title = '电子纤维支气管镜检查知情同意书-新标' then '电子纤维支气管镜'
                       when t1.doc_title = '术中冰冻切片检查知情同意书-新标' then '术中冰冻切片检查'
                       when t1.doc_title = '骨髓穿刺/活检术知情同意书-新标' then '骨髓穿刺/活检术'
                       when t1.doc_title = '膀胱尿道内窥镜检查治疗知情同意书-新标' then '膀胱尿道内窥镜检查'
                       else nvl(cast(t1.doc_title as varchar2(1000)), '-')
                   end,
                   1,
                   1000
               ) as SPEC_EXAM_TREAT_NAME,-- 特殊检查及特殊治疗项目名称 是

               substr(
                   case
                       when t1.doc_title = '消化内镜知情同意书-新标' then '切除食管、胃、肠黏膜病变，明确病理；切除息肉，明确病理；碎石；其他。'
                       when t1.doc_title = '电子纤维支气管镜检查知情同意书-新标' then '明确诊断、观察病变、取材活检或根据病情进行相关内镜下诊疗。'
                       when t1.doc_title = '术中冰冻切片检查知情同意书-新标' then '快速病理检查，为临床医师术中判断及手术方案提供参考意见。'
                       when t1.doc_title = '骨髓穿刺/活检术知情同意书-新标' then '了解骨髓造血及相关病变情况，协助明确诊断、疗效判断及后续治疗。'
                       when t1.doc_title = '膀胱尿道内窥镜检查治疗知情同意书-新标' then '了解膀胱、尿道及相关泌尿系统病变情况，必要时进行内镜下检查或治疗。'
                       else '详见病历'
                   end,
                   1,
                   1000
               ) as SPEC_EXAM_TREAT_PURPOSE,-- 特殊检查及特殊治疗目的 是

               cast(
    substrb(
        case
            when t1.doc_title = '消化内镜知情同意书-新标' then
                 '可能发生麻醉意外、呼吸心跳骤停、心脑血管意外、肠梗阻、消化道出血、穿孔、感染、腹膜炎、气胸、纵隔脓肿、脓胸、术后疼痛发热、病变复发、操作中止、术后狭窄、需再次治疗及其他难以预料的风险。'
            when t1.doc_title = '电子纤维支气管镜检查知情同意书-新标' then
                 '可能发生麻醉反应、药物过敏、休克、心脏呼吸骤停、术中术后出血、感染、气胸、纵隔气肿、心脑血管意外、喉头水肿、支气管痉挛、低氧血症、窒息、误吸、鼻出血、黏膜损伤、牙齿损伤、声音嘶哑、声带损伤、肺栓塞、活检后出血及其他难以预料的并发症。'
            when t1.doc_title = '术中冰冻切片检查知情同意书-新标' then
                 '冰冻切片诊断具有局限性，仅为术中参考意见；部分病变难以鉴别良恶性，可能需等待常规石蜡切片诊断；冰冻报告不能作为最终病理诊断，最终诊断以石蜡切片为准，手术方案可能因此调整。'
            when t1.doc_title = '骨髓穿刺/活检术知情同意书-新标' then
                 '可能发生局麻药过敏、药物毒性反应、穿刺部位感染、败血症、出血、血肿、心脑血管意外、心律失常、心跳呼吸骤停、穿刺失败、神经血管损伤、穿刺针折断、检查后仍不能明确诊断及其他不可预见风险。'
            when t1.doc_title = '膀胱尿道内窥镜检查治疗知情同意书-新标' then
                 '可能发生麻醉反应、药物过敏、休克、心脑血管意外、感染、尿道膀胱输尿管或肾脏损伤、血尿、疼痛、出血、菌血症、检查失败及其他并发症；高龄或合并基础疾病者风险可能增加。'
            else '详见病历'
        end,
        1,
        1000
    ) as varchar2(1000)
) as SPEC_EXAM_TREAT_RISK,  -- 特殊检查及特殊治疗风险 是

               substr(
                   case
                       when t1.doc_title = '电子纤维支气管镜检查知情同意书-新标' then '经皮肺穿刺；开胸肺活检；或根据病情选择其他替代检查治疗方案。'
                       else '详见病历'
                   end,
                   1,
                   1000
               ) as REPLACE_PLAN,-- 替代方案

               substr(
                   nvl(nullif(trim(cast(t.p_name as varchar2(50))), ''), nvl(cast(pmi.name as varchar2(50)), '-')),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as STATUTORY_AGENT_VIEW,-- 患者/法定代理人签名 是

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       (select cast(cd.国标编码 as varchar2(2))
                          from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                         where cd.字典名称 = '家庭关系代码'
                           and cd.院标编码 = pmi.relationship
                           and rownum = 1),
                       '8'
                   ),
                   1,
                   2
               ) as SAP_RELATIONSHIP,-- 法定代理人与患者关系代码

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       (select cast(cd.国标名称 as varchar2(50))
                          from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                         where cd.字典名称 = '家庭关系代码'
                           and cd.院标编码 = pmi.relationship
                           and rownum = 1),
                       '其他'
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as SAP_RELATIONSHIP_NAME,-- 法定代理人与患者关系名称

               cast(
                   case
                       when t1.doc_finish_date is not null
                        and t1.doc_finish_date >= date '1900-01-01'
                       then t1.doc_finish_date

                       when t1.doc_sign_date is not null
                        and t1.doc_sign_date >= date '1900-01-01'
                       then t1.doc_sign_date

                       when t1.modifiedon is not null
                        and t1.modifiedon >= date '1900-01-01'
                       then t1.modifiedon

                       when t1.doc_title_time is not null
                        and t1.doc_title_time >= date '1900-01-01'
                       then t1.doc_title_time

                       else pv.admission_date_time
                   end
                   as date
               ) as PATIENT_SIGN_DATE,-- 患者/法定代理人签名日期 是

               substr(
                 nvl(  nvl(nullif(trim(cast(t1.MODIFIEDBY as varchar2(50))), ''), t1.CREATEBY),'-'） ,
                   1,
                   50
               ) as OPERATOR,-- 医生签名 是

               cast(
                   case
                       when t1.doc_sign_date is not null
                        and t1.doc_sign_date >= date '1900-01-01'
                       then t1.doc_sign_date

                       when t1.doc_finish_date is not null
                        and t1.doc_finish_date >= date '1900-01-01'
                       then t1.doc_finish_date

                       when t1.modifiedon is not null
                        and t1.modifiedon >= date '1900-01-01'
                       then t1.modifiedon

                       when t1.doc_title_time is not null
                        and t1.doc_title_time >= date '1900-01-01'
                       then t1.doc_title_time

                       else pv.admission_date_time
                   end
                   as date
               ) as DOC_DATE-- 医生签名日期时间 是
           from mtl.epr_inpatient_docindex t

          inner join mtl.epr_inpatient t1
                  on t.uhid = t1.uhid
                 and t1.doc_title in (
                       '消化内镜知情同意书-新标',
                       '电子纤维支气管镜检查知情同意书-新标',
                       '术中冰冻切片检查知情同意书-新标',
                       '骨髓穿刺/活检术知情同意书-新标',
                       '膀胱尿道内窥镜检查治疗知情同意书-新标'
                 )

          left join his.pat_master_index pmi
                 on pmi.inp_no = t.p_inpatient_no

          inner join his.pat_visit pv
                  on pv.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
                 and pv.visit_id = t.p_inpatient_times

          left join (
                select a.patient_id,
                       a.visit_id,
                       a.diagnosis_code,
                       a.diagnosis_desc,
                       row_number() over (
                           partition by a.patient_id, a.visit_id
                           order by
                               case
                                   when a.diagnosis_type = '3' then 1
                                   when a.diagnosis_type = '2' then 2
                                   when a.diagnosis_type = '1' then 3
                                   else 4
                               end,
                               a.diagnosis_no
                       ) as rn
                  from his.diagnosis a
          ) dd
                 on dd.rn = 1
                and pv.patient_id = dd.patient_id
                and pv.visit_id = dd.visit_id
    ) q
)
where rn = 1

V_EMR_INFOR_TRANS_BLOOD.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_INFOR_TRANS_BLOOD" ("ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "PATIENT_TYPE", "VISTING_NUM", "INFORMED_CONSENT_CODE", "INFORMED_CONSENT_NAME", "APPLY_NUM", "DEPT_CODE", "DEP_NAME", "AREA_NAME", "WARD_NUM", "SICKBED_NUM", "PATIENT_NAME", "SEX_CODE", "SEX_NAME", "AGE", "AGE_MONTH", "DISEASE_CODE", "DISEASE_NAME", "BT_HISTORY_CODE", "BT_HISTORY_NAME", "TRANSFUSION_TRIGGER", "VOB_CODE", "VOB_NAME", "TRANSFUSION_BCPR", "TRANSFUSION_WAY", "PROTOCOL_TRANSFUSION_DATE", "ORG_VIEW", "PATIENT_VIEW", "STATUTORY_AGENT_VIEW", "SAP_RELATIONSHIP", "SAP_RELATIONSHIP_NAME", "PATIENT_SIGN_DATE", "OPERATOR", "DOC_DATE") AS 
  select cast(substrb(ID, 1, 100) as varchar2(100)) as ID,
       cast(substrb(ORG_CODE, 1, 32) as varchar2(32)) as ORG_CODE,
       cast(substrb(ORG_NAME, 1, 70) as varchar2(70)) as ORG_NAME,
       cast(substrb(DISTRICT_CODE, 1, 6) as varchar2(6)) as DISTRICT_CODE,
       cast(substrb(EXCHANGE_TYPE, 1, 10) as varchar2(10)) as EXCHANGE_TYPE,
       SYSTEM_TIME,
       cast(substrb(PATIENT_TYPE, 1, 2) as varchar2(2)) as PATIENT_TYPE,
       cast(substrb(VISTING_NUM, 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as VISTING_NUM,
       cast(substrb(INFORMED_CONSENT_CODE, 1, 20) as varchar2(20)) as INFORMED_CONSENT_CODE,
       cast(substrb(INFORMED_CONSENT_NAME, 1, 200) as varchar2(200)) as INFORMED_CONSENT_NAME,
       cast(substrb(APPLY_NUM, 1, 20) as varchar2(20)) as APPLY_NUM,
       cast(substrb(DEPT_CODE, 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as DEPT_CODE,
       cast(substrb(DEP_NAME, 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as DEP_NAME,
       cast(substrb(AREA_NAME, 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as AREA_NAME,
       cast(substrb(WARD_NUM, 1, 10) as varchar2(10)) as WARD_NUM,
       cast(substrb(SICKBED_NUM, 1, 10) as varchar2(10)) as SICKBED_NUM,
       cast(substrb(PATIENT_NAME, 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as PATIENT_NAME,
       SEX_CODE,
       cast(substrb(SEX_NAME, 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as SEX_NAME,
       AGE,
       cast(substrb(AGE_MONTH, 1, 8) as varchar2(8)) as AGE_MONTH,
       cast(substrb(DISEASE_CODE, 1, 12) as varchar2(12)) as DISEASE_CODE,
       cast(substrb(DISEASE_NAME, 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as DISEASE_NAME,
       BT_HISTORY_CODE,
       cast(substrb(BT_HISTORY_NAME, 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as BT_HISTORY_NAME,
       cast(substrb(TRANSFUSION_TRIGGER, 1, 500) as varchar2(500)) as TRANSFUSION_TRIGGER,
       VOB_CODE,
       cast(substrb(VOB_NAME, 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as VOB_NAME,
       cast(substrb(TRANSFUSION_BCPR, 1, 200) as varchar2(200)) as TRANSFUSION_BCPR,
       cast(substrb(TRANSFUSION_WAY, 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as TRANSFUSION_WAY,
       PROTOCOL_TRANSFUSION_DATE,
       cast(substrb(ORG_VIEW, 1, 2000) as varchar2(2000)) as ORG_VIEW,
       cast(substrb(PATIENT_VIEW, 1, 2000) as varchar2(2000)) as PATIENT_VIEW,
       cast(substrb(STATUTORY_AGENT_VIEW, 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as STATUTORY_AGENT_VIEW,
       cast(substrb(SAP_RELATIONSHIP, 1, 2) as varchar2(2)) as SAP_RELATIONSHIP,
       cast(substrb(SAP_RELATIONSHIP_NAME, 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as SAP_RELATIONSHIP_NAME,
       PATIENT_SIGN_DATE,
       cast(substrb(OPERATOR, 1, 50) as varchar2(50)) as OPERATOR,
       DOC_DATE
from (
    select q.*,
           row_number() over (
               partition by q.ID
               order by q.PATIENT_SIGN_DATE desc nulls last,
                        q.PROTOCOL_TRANSFUSION_DATE desc nulls last
           ) as rn
    from (
        select substr(
    '49557032X'||'|'||
    nvl(to_char(tr.hzbs), '-')||'|'||
    nvl(to_char(tr.zycs), '-')||'|'||
    nvl(to_char(tr.sqlsh), '-')||'|'||
    nvl(
        regexp_substr(
            nvl(
                (select max(cast(cd.国标编码 as varchar2(20)))
                   from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                  where cd.院标名称 = s2.xymc
                    and cd.字典名称 = '输血品种代码字典'),
                '9'
            ),
            '^[0-9]+'
        ),
        '9'
    ),
    1,
    100
) as ID, -- 内码 是 主键

               '49557032X' as ORG_CODE,-- 医院组织机构代码 是

               '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,-- 医院名称 是

               '370104' as DISTRICT_CODE,-- 所属行政区划 是

               'ADDHIS' as EXCHANGE_TYPE,-- 交换类型 是

               cast(systimestamp as timestamp) as SYSTEM_TIME,-- 数据上传时间戳 是

               '2' as PATIENT_TYPE,-- 病人类型 是；建议用代码，避免“住院”超 VARCHAR2(2)

               substr(
                   nvl(to_char(tr.hzbs), '-')||'|'||nvl(to_char(tr.zycs), '-'),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as VISTING_NUM,-- 就诊号 是

               substr(
                   nvl(to_char(tr.sqlsh), '-'),
                   1,
                   20
               ) as INFORMED_CONSENT_CODE,-- 知情同意书编号

               '输血治疗同意书' as INFORMED_CONSENT_NAME,-- 知情同意书名称

               substr(
                   nvl(to_char(tr.sqlsh), '-'),
                   1,
                   20
               ) as APPLY_NUM,-- 输血申请单编号

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       (select cast(ks.qmpt_code as varchar2(50))
                          from his.dept_dict ks
                         where ks.dept_code = p.dept_discharge_from
                           and rownum = 1),
                       nvl(cast(p.dept_discharge_from as varchar2(50)), '-')
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as DEPT_CODE,-- 科室代码

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       (select cast(ks.qmpt_name as varchar2(50))
                          from his.dept_dict ks
                         where ks.dept_code = p.dept_discharge_from
                           and rownum = 1),
                       nvl(
                           (select cast(ks.dept_name as varchar2(50))
                              from his.dept_dict ks
                             where ks.dept_code = p.dept_discharge_from
                               and rownum = 1),
                           '-'
                       )
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as DEP_NAME,-- 科室名称 是

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       (select cast(ks.dept_name as varchar2(50))
                          from his.dept_dict ks
                         where ks.dept_code = p.discharge_ward_code
                           and rownum = 1),
                       '-'
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as AREA_NAME,-- 病区名称

               cast(null as varchar2(10)) as WARD_NUM,-- 病房号

               substr(
                   cast(p.discharge_bed_no as varchar2(10)),
                   1,
                   10
               ) as SICKBED_NUM,-- 病床号

               substr(
                   nvl(nullif(trim(cast(tr.hzxm as varchar2(50))), ''), nvl(cast(pmi.name as varchar2(50)), '-')),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as PATIENT_NAME,-- 患者姓名 是

               case
                   when cast(tr.xb as varchar2(10)) = '男' then 1
                   when cast(tr.xb as varchar2(10)) = '女' then 2
                   when cast(tr.xb as varchar2(10)) = '未知' then 0
                   else 9
               end as SEX_CODE,-- 性别代码 是

               substr(
                   case
                       when cast(tr.xb as varchar2(10)) = '男' then '男'
                       when cast(tr.xb as varchar2(10)) = '女' then '女'
                       when cast(tr.xb as varchar2(10)) = '未知' then '未知'
                       else '不明'
                   end,
                   1,
                   50
               ) as SEX_NAME,-- 性别 是

               case
                   when pmi.date_of_birth is not null
                    and p.admission_date_time is not null
                   then least(
                            greatest(
                                trunc(months_between(p.admission_date_time, pmi.date_of_birth) / 12),
                                0
                            ),
                            200
                        )
                   else 0
               end as AGE,-- 年龄 是 0-200

               substr(
                   case
                       when pmi.date_of_birth is not null
                        and p.admission_date_time is not null
                        and months_between(p.admission_date_time, pmi.date_of_birth) < 12
                       then to_char(
                                least(
                                    greatest(
                                        trunc(months_between(p.admission_date_time, pmi.date_of_birth)),
                                        0
                                    ),
                                    11
                                )
                            )
                       else null
                   end,
                   1,
                   8
               ) as AGE_MONTH,-- 年龄(月) 0-11

     cast(
    substrb(
        nvl(
            nullif(
                trim(
                    (select max(substrb(to_char(cd.国标编码), 1, 12))
                       from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                      where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                        and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                        and cd.院标编码 = dd.diagnosis_code)
                ),
                ''
            ),
            nullif(substrb(to_char(dd.diagnosis_code), 1, 12), '')
        ),
        1,
        12
    ) as varchar2(12)
) as DISEASE_CODE, -- 疾病诊断编码

            cast(
    substrb(
        nvl(
            nullif(
                trim(
                    (select max(substrb(to_char(cd.国标名称), 1, 50))
                       from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                      where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                        and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                        and cd.院标编码 = dd.diagnosis_code)
                ),
                ''
            ),
            nvl(substrb(to_char(dd.diagnosis_desc), 1, 50), '-')
        ),
        1,
        50
    ) as varchar2(50)
) as DISEASE_NAME, -- 疾病诊断名称 是

               9 as BT_HISTORY_CODE,-- 输血史标识代码：1无 2有 9未说明

               '未说明' as BT_HISTORY_NAME,-- 有无输血史

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       nullif(trim(cast(tr.pgtzms as varchar2(500))), ''),
                       nvl(nullif(trim(cast(tr.sxmd as varchar2(500))), ''), '-')
                   ),
                   1,
                   500
               ) as TRANSFUSION_TRIGGER,-- 输血指征

               nvl(
                   to_number(
                       regexp_substr(
                           nvl(
                               (select max(cast(cd.国标编码 as varchar2(20)))
                                  from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                                 where cd.院标名称 = s2.xymc
                                   and cd.字典名称 = '输血品种代码字典'),
                               '9'
                           ),
                           '^[0-9]+'
                       )
                   ),
                   9
               ) as VOB_CODE,-- 输血品种代码 NUMBER(2)

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       (select max(cast(cd.国标名称 as varchar2(50)))
                          from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                         where cd.院标名称 = s2.xymc
                           and cd.字典名称 = '输血品种代码字典'),
                       nvl(cast(s2.xymc as varchar2(50)), '其他')
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as VOB_NAME,-- 输血品种名称

              substr('输血前检查#详见病历', 1, 200) as TRANSFUSION_BCPR,-- 输血前有关检查项目及结果 是

               substr('异体输血', 1, 50) as TRANSFUSION_WAY,-- 输血方式

               cast(
                   case
                       when tr.yjsxsj is not null
                        and regexp_like(trim(cast(tr.yjsxsj as varchar2(30))), '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}')
                       then to_date(substr(trim(cast(tr.yjsxsj as varchar2(30))), 1, 19), 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')

                       when tr.yjsxsj is not null
                        and regexp_like(trim(cast(tr.yjsxsj as varchar2(30))), '^[0-9]{14}$')
                       then to_date(trim(cast(tr.yjsxsj as varchar2(30))), 'yyyymmddhh24miss')

                       else null
                   end
                   as date
               ) as PROTOCOL_TRANSFUSION_DATE,-- 拟定输血日期时间 DATE

               substr(
                   '患者因病情需要拟行输血或血液制品治疗。医方已告知输血必要性、益处、可能风险及替代方案，并将严格执行临床输血相关规范，合理选择输血适应证、输血方式和输血方案。输血过程中可能发生发热、过敏、溶血、感染、输血相关循环负荷过重、输血相关急性肺损伤、病情加重甚至危及生命等风险。一旦发生风险或意外，医方将积极采取相应处理措施。',
                   1,
                   2000
               ) as ORG_VIEW,-- 医疗机构意见

               substr(
                   '医师已向我告知输血或血液制品治疗的原因、必要性、益处、可能风险及不良反应，我已理解并同意根据病情需要实施输血或血液制品治疗，并同意在紧急情况下接受必要处置。',
                   1,
                   2000
               ) as PATIENT_VIEW,-- 患者/法定代理人意见

               substr(
                   nvl(nullif(trim(cast(tr.hzxm as varchar2(50))), ''), nvl(cast(pmi.name as varchar2(50)), '-')),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as STATUTORY_AGENT_VIEW,-- 患者/法定代理人签名 是

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       (select cast(cd.国标编码 as varchar2(2))
                          from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                         where cd.字典名称 = '家庭关系代码'
                           and cd.院标编码 = pmi.relationship
                           and rownum = 1),
                       '8'
                   ),
                   1,
                   2
               ) as SAP_RELATIONSHIP,-- 法定代理人与患者关系代码

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       (select cast(cd.国标名称 as varchar2(50))
                          from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                         where cd.字典名称 = '家庭关系代码'
                           and cd.院标编码 = pmi.relationship
                           and rownum = 1),
                       '其他'
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as SAP_RELATIONSHIP_NAME,-- 法定代理人与患者关系名称

               cast(
                   case
                       when tr.sqsj is not null
                        and regexp_like(trim(cast(tr.sqsj as varchar2(30))), '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}')
                       then to_date(substr(trim(cast(tr.sqsj as varchar2(30))), 1, 19), 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')

                       when tr.sqsj is not null
                        and regexp_like(trim(cast(tr.sqsj as varchar2(30))), '^[0-9]{14}$')
                       then to_date(trim(cast(tr.sqsj as varchar2(30))), 'yyyymmddhh24miss')

                       else p.admission_date_time
                   end
                   as date
               ) as PATIENT_SIGN_DATE,-- 患者/法定代理人签名日期 是

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       nullif(trim(substr(cast(tr.sqys as varchar2(100)), instr(cast(tr.sqys as varchar2(100)), '|', 1, 1) + 1)), ''),
                       nvl(cast(tr.sqys as varchar2(50)), '-')
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as OPERATOR,-- 医生签名 是

               cast(
                   case
                       when tr.sqsj is not null
                        and regexp_like(trim(cast(tr.sqsj as varchar2(30))), '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}')
                       then to_date(substr(trim(cast(tr.sqsj as varchar2(30))), 1, 19), 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')

                       when tr.sqsj is not null
                        and regexp_like(trim(cast(tr.sqsj as varchar2(30))), '^[0-9]{14}$')
                       then to_date(trim(cast(tr.sqsj as varchar2(30))), 'yyyymmddhh24miss')

                       else p.admission_date_time
                   end
                   as date
               ) as DOC_DATE-- 医生签名日期时间 是
          from sx.b_t_reqd tr

      inner join (
    select *
    from (
        select s2.*,
               row_number() over (
                   partition by s2.xyhzsqdh, s2.xymc
                   order by s2.pk_no
               ) as rn_same_blood
          from sx.b_t_xyxxb s2
         where s2.xyzt = '3'
    )
    where rn_same_blood = 1
) s2
        on tr.sqlsh = s2.xyhzsqdh

          left join sx.b_t_reactions r
                 on tr.sqlsh = r.sqlsh
                and s2.pk_no = r.pk_no

          left join his.pat_visit p
                 on tr.hzbs = p.patient_id
                and tr.zycs = p.visit_id

          left join his.pat_master_index pmi
                 on p.patient_id = pmi.patient_id

          left join (
                select a.patient_id,
                       a.visit_id,
                       a.diagnosis_code,
                       a.diagnosis_desc,
                       row_number() over (
                           partition by a.patient_id, a.visit_id
                           order by
                               case
                                   when a.diagnosis_type = '3' then 1
                                   else 2
                               end,
                               a.diagnosis_no
                       ) as rn
                  from his.diagnosis a
                 where a.diagnosis_type = '3'
          ) dd
                 on dd.rn = 1
                and p.patient_id = dd.patient_id
                and p.visit_id = dd.visit_id

         where tr.shzt = '1'
    ) q
)
where rn = 1 and DEP_NAME is not null and DISEASE_NAME is not null

V_EMR_INSPECTION_ALLERGY_TEST.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_INSPECTION_ALLERGY_TEST" ("ID", "REPORT_ID", "APPLY_NUM", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "ITEM_ID", "DRUG_ALLERGY_CODE", "DRUG_ALLERGY_NAME", "DRUG_ALLERGY_NOTE", "PIECE_DRUG", "BACSTA_CONCEN", "BACSTA_DIAMETER", "ANTIBIOTIC_CLASS", "ANTIBIOTIC_CODE", "ANTIBIOTIC_NAME", "EFFECTIVE_TIME", "STATUS", "CREATED_AT", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME") AS 
  SELECT
    SUBSTRB(
        q.REPORT_ID || '_ALG_' || TO_CHAR(q.RN),
        1,
        100
    ) AS ID, -- 内码 VARCHAR2(100) 是 主键

    SUBSTRB(q.REPORT_ID, 1, 100) AS REPORT_ID, -- 检验报告单内码 VARCHAR2(100) 是，必须在父表存在

    SUBSTRB(NVL(q.APPLY_NUM, q.REPORT_ID), 1, 20) AS APPLY_NUM, -- 电子申请单编号 VARCHAR2(20) 是

    '49557032X' AS ORG_CODE, -- 医院组织机构代码 VARCHAR2(32) 是

    '山东省第二人民医院' AS ORG_NAME, -- 医院名称 VARCHAR2(70) 是

    SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(q.RN), 1, 32) AS ITEM_ID, -- 项目序号 VARCHAR2(32) 是

    CASE
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(q.RESULT_NORM, '剂量依赖性敏感|SDD', 'i') THEN '10'
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(q.RESULT_NORM, '非野生型|NWT', 'i') THEN '8'
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(q.RESULT_NORM, '非敏感|NS', 'i') THEN '6'
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(q.RESULT_NORM, '污染', 'i') THEN '3'
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(q.RESULT_NORM, '未做|未测|未检|未进行|无药敏', 'i') THEN '4'
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(q.RESULT_NORM, '野生型|WT', 'i') THEN '7'
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(q.RESULT_NORM, '耐药', 'i')
          OR REGEXP_LIKE(q.RESULT_NORM, '(^|[^A-Z])R([^A-Z]|$)', 'i') THEN '1'
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(q.RESULT_NORM, '敏感', 'i')
          OR REGEXP_LIKE(q.RESULT_NORM, '(^|[^A-Z])S([^A-Z]|$)', 'i') THEN '2'
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(q.RESULT_NORM, '中介|中敏', 'i')
          OR REGEXP_LIKE(q.RESULT_NORM, '(^|[^A-Z])I([^A-Z]|$)', 'i') THEN '5'
        ELSE '9'
    END AS DRUG_ALLERGY_CODE, -- 药敏结果代码 VARCHAR2(32) CC99.00093 是

    CASE
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(q.RESULT_NORM, '剂量依赖性敏感|SDD', 'i') THEN '剂量依赖性敏感'
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(q.RESULT_NORM, '非野生型|NWT', 'i') THEN '非野生型'
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(q.RESULT_NORM, '非敏感|NS', 'i') THEN '非敏感'
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(q.RESULT_NORM, '污染', 'i') THEN '污染'
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(q.RESULT_NORM, '未做|未测|未检|未进行|无药敏', 'i') THEN '未做'
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(q.RESULT_NORM, '野生型|WT', 'i') THEN '野生型'
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(q.RESULT_NORM, '耐药', 'i')
          OR REGEXP_LIKE(q.RESULT_NORM, '(^|[^A-Z])R([^A-Z]|$)', 'i') THEN '耐药'
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(q.RESULT_NORM, '敏感', 'i')
          OR REGEXP_LIKE(q.RESULT_NORM, '(^|[^A-Z])S([^A-Z]|$)', 'i') THEN '敏感'
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(q.RESULT_NORM, '中介|中敏', 'i')
          OR REGEXP_LIKE(q.RESULT_NORM, '(^|[^A-Z])I([^A-Z]|$)', 'i') THEN '中介'
        ELSE '无判定标准'
    END AS DRUG_ALLERGY_NAME, -- 药敏结果名称 VARCHAR2(100) 是

    SUBSTRB(
        '原始药敏结果=' || NVL(q.RESULT_TXT, '未知') ||
        '；原始单位=' || NVL(q.UNITS_TXT, '未知') ||
        '；原始项目=' || NVL(q.ANTIBIOTIC_NAME_SRC, '未知'),
        1,
        1000
    ) AS DRUG_ALLERGY_NOTE, -- 药敏结果描述 VARCHAR2(1000)

    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS PIECE_DRUG, -- 纸片含药量 VARCHAR2(100)

    CASE
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(q.UNITS_TXT, ''), 'μg/mL|ug/ml|μg/ml|mg/L|mg/l', 'i')
         AND REGEXP_LIKE(
                q.RESULT_NUM_TXT,
                '^(<=|>=|<|>|≤|≥)?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
             )
        THEN SUBSTRB(q.RESULT_NUM_TXT, 1, 100)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS BACSTA_CONCEN, -- 最小抑菌浓度（MIC） VARCHAR2(100)

    CASE
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(q.UNITS_TXT, ''), 'mm', 'i')
         AND REGEXP_LIKE(
                q.RESULT_NUM_TXT,
                '^(<=|>=|<|>|≤|≥)?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
             )
        THEN SUBSTRB(q.RESULT_NUM_TXT, 1, 100)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS BACSTA_DIAMETER, -- 抑菌圈直径(mm) VARCHAR2(100)

    '未分级' AS ANTIBIOTIC_CLASS, -- 抗生素等级 VARCHAR2(100) 是，源无等级时先填未分级

    SUBSTRB(
        REGEXP_REPLACE(TO_CHAR(q.ANTIBIOTIC_CODE_SRC), '[^0-9A-Za-z]', ''),
        1,
        32
    ) AS ANTIBIOTIC_CODE, -- 抗生素代码 VARCHAR2(32)，非必填，无来源不强行填0

    SUBSTRB(
        NVL(q.ANTIBIOTIC_NAME_SRC, '未知'),
        1,
        100
    ) AS ANTIBIOTIC_NAME, -- 抗生素名称 VARCHAR2(100) 是

    q.EFFECTIVE_TIME AS EFFECTIVE_TIME, -- 活动发生时间 DATE

    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(32)) AS STATUS, -- 卡片状态 VARCHAR2(32)

    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS CREATED_AT, -- 创建时间 TIMESTAMP(6)

    '370104' AS DISTRICT_CODE, -- 所属行政区划 VARCHAR2(6) 是

    'ADDHIS' AS EXCHANGE_TYPE, -- 交换类型 VARCHAR2(10) 是

    CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS SYSTEM_TIME -- 数据上传时间戳 TIMESTAMP(6) 是

FROM
(
    SELECT
        p.ID AS REPORT_ID,
        p.APPLY_NUM AS APPLY_NUM,

        NVL(
            lr.RESULT_DATE_TIME,
            NVL(
                ltm.RESULTS_RPT_DATE_TIME,
                NVL(
                    ltm.EXECUTE_DATE,
                    NVL(
                        ltm.SPCM_RECEIVED_DATE_TIME,
                        NVL(ltm.SPCM_SAMPLE_DATE_TIME, ltm.REQUESTED_DATE_TIME)
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS EFFECTIVE_TIME,

        lr.TEST_NO,
        lr.ITEM_NO,
        lr.PRINT_ORDER,
        lr.REPORT_ITEM_CODE AS ANTIBIOTIC_CODE_SRC,
        TRIM(lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME) AS ANTIBIOTIC_NAME_SRC,
        TRIM(lr.RESULT) AS RESULT_TXT,
        TRIM(lr.UNITS) AS UNITS_TXT,

        UPPER(
            REGEXP_REPLACE(
                REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(NVL(lr.RESULT, '')), '＜', '<'), '＞', '>'), '，', ','),
                '[[:space:]]+',
                ''
            )
        ) AS RESULT_NORM,

        REGEXP_REPLACE(
            REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(NVL(lr.RESULT, '')), '＜', '<'), '＞', '>'),
            '[[:space:]]+',
            ''
        ) AS RESULT_NUM_TXT,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY lr.TEST_NO
            ORDER BY
                NVL(lr.ITEM_NO, 999999),
                NVL(lr.PRINT_ORDER, 999999),
                NVL(lr.REPORT_ITEM_CODE, ' '),
                NVL(lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME, ' '),
                NVL(lr.RESULT, ' '),
                ROWIDTOCHAR(lr.ROWID)
        ) AS RN

    FROM HIS.LAB_RESULT lr

    INNER JOIN HIS.LAB_TEST_MASTER ltm
        ON ltm.TEST_NO = lr.TEST_NO
       AND ltm.RESULT_STATUS = '4'

    /* 直接关联父表，保证 REPORT_ID 一定在 EMR_INSPECTION 主表存在，并继承父表 2021-2023 口径 */
    INNER JOIN V_EMR_INSPECTION_TEST p
        ON p.ID = TO_CHAR(ltm.TEST_NO)

    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(lr.RESULT), '') IS NOT NULL

      /* 限定微生物类报告项目 */
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM HIS.LAB_TEST_ITEMS lti
          INNER JOIN HIS.CLINIC_ITEM_DICT cid
              ON cid.ITEM_CODE = lti.ITEM_CODE
             AND cid.EXPAND2 = '微生物类'
          WHERE lti.TEST_NO = lr.TEST_NO
            AND lti.ITEM_NO = lr.ITEM_NO
      )

      /* 抗菌药物、抗真菌药物类项目 */
      AND (
             lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%头孢%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%红霉素%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%阿奇霉素%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%克拉霉素%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%替考拉宁%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%达托霉素%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%链霉素%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%阿米卡星%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%哌拉西林%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%他唑巴坦%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%亚胺培南%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%美罗培南%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%厄他培南%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%莫西沙星%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%环丙沙星%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%左氧氟沙星%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%诺氟沙星%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%庆大霉素%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%妥布霉素%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%氯霉素%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%万古霉素%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%苯唑西林%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%青霉素%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%氨苄西林%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%氨曲南%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%利奈唑胺%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%克林霉素%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%利福平%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%四环素%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%米诺环素%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%替加环素%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%多黏菌素%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%多粘菌素%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%磷霉素%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%呋喃妥因%'

          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%磺胺%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%复方新诺明%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%阿莫西林%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%克拉维酸%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%舒巴坦%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%度洛巴坦%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%卡泊芬净%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%米卡芬净%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%两性霉素B%'
          OR lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME LIKE '%氟康唑%'
