      )
) q

V_EMR_INSPECTION_IMAGE_TEST.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_INSPECTION_IMAGE_TEST" ("ID", "REPORT_ID", "APPLY_NUM", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "IMAGE_NUM", "IMAGE_SAVE_PATH", "EFFECTIVE_TIME", "STATUS", "CREATED_AT", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME") AS 
  SELECT
    /* 内码：主表ID + 图片序号 */
    SUBSTRB(
        TO_CHAR(p.ID) || '_IMG_1',
        1,
        100
    ) AS ID, -- 内码 VARCHAR2(100) 是 主键

    SUBSTRB(
        TO_CHAR(p.ID),
        1,
        100
    ) AS REPORT_ID, -- 检验报告单内码 VARCHAR2(100) 是 必填、主表存在

    SUBSTRB(
        TO_CHAR(p.APPLY_NUM),
        1,
        20
    ) AS APPLY_NUM, -- 电子申请单编号 VARCHAR2(20)

    SUBSTRB(
        NVL(p.ORG_CODE, '49557032X'),
        1,
        32
    ) AS ORG_CODE, -- 医院组织机构代码 VARCHAR2(32) 是

    SUBSTRB(
        NVL(p.ORG_NAME, '山东省第二人民医院'),
        1,
        70
    ) AS ORG_NAME, -- 医院名称 VARCHAR2(70) 是

    1 AS IMAGE_NUM, -- 图片序号 NUMBER 是

    '-' AS IMAGE_SAVE_PATH, -- 图像存放路径 VARCHAR2(512) 是，暂无真实路径时按要求填横线

    p.EFFECTIVE_TIME AS EFFECTIVE_TIME, -- 活动发生时间 DATE

    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(32)) AS STATUS, -- 卡片状态 VARCHAR2(32)

    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS CREATED_AT, -- 创建时间 TIMESTAMP(6)

    SUBSTRB(
        NVL(p.DISTRICT_CODE, '370104'),
        1,
        6
    ) AS DISTRICT_CODE, -- 所属行政区划 VARCHAR2(6) 是

    SUBSTRB(
        NVL(p.EXCHANGE_TYPE, 'ADDHIS'),
        1,
        10
    ) AS EXCHANGE_TYPE, -- 交换类型 VARCHAR2(10) 是

    CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS SYSTEM_TIME -- 数据上传时间戳 TIMESTAMP(6) 是

FROM V_EMR_INSPECTION_TEST p
WHERE p.ID IS NOT NULL

V_EMR_INSPECTION_ITEM_TEST.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_INSPECTION_ITEM_TEST" ("ID", "REPORT_ID", "APPLY_NUM", "SN", "ITEM_CODE", "RECIEVE_DT", "ITEM_NAME", "RESULT_TYPE", "RESULT_TYPE_NOTE", "ITEM_RESULT", "UNIT", "REFER_VALUE_LOWER", "REFER_VALUE_UPPER", "CRITICAL_VALUE", "ALARM_STATE", "CALL_DATE", "ATTACHED_RESULT", "RESULT_EXPLAIN", "RESULT_EXPLAIN_NOTE", "EFFECTIVE_TIME", "STATUS", "CREATED_AT", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "LOCAL_ITEM_CODE", "LOCAL_ITEM_NAME", "SYSTEM_TIME", "RESULT_CODE", "RATION_RESULT", "RATION_RESULT_UOM", "TEST_SN", "TEST_RESULT_TYPE", "TEST_RESULT", "TEST_RESULT_UNIT", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "TEST_EXAM_EQUIP_CODE", "BARCODE_NO", "NAME", "SEX_CODE", "ID_NUM", "MTU_REC_MARK", "MTU_REC_LIMIT_MARK", "HOSPITEM_NAME", "HOSPITEM_CODE", "PROJECT_CODE", "PROJECT_NAME", "ITEM_SIGN", "VISITING_NUM") AS 
  SELECT
    /* ===================== 主键与父表关联 ===================== */
    SUBSTRB(
        q.REPORT_ID || '_ITEM_' || TO_CHAR(q.RN),
        1,
        100
    ) AS ID, -- 内码 VARCHAR2(100) 是 主键

    SUBSTRB(q.REPORT_ID, 1, 100) AS REPORT_ID, -- 检验报告单内码 VARCHAR2(100) 是，关联 EMR_INSPECTION.ID

    SUBSTRB(NVL(q.APPLY_NUM, q.REPORT_ID), 1, 20) AS APPLY_NUM, -- 电子申请单编号 VARCHAR2(20) 是

    q.RN AS SN, -- 序号 NUMBER

    /* ===================== 检验项目 ===================== */
    SUBSTRB(
        NVL(
            map1.PLATFORM_ITEM_CODE,
            NVL(TO_CHAR(q.REPORT_ITEM_CODE), TO_CHAR(q.ITEM_NO))
        ),
        1,
        20
    ) AS ITEM_CODE, -- 检验项目代号，优先取平台 CS_EXAMINE_ITEM 编码

    q.RECIEVE_DT AS RECIEVE_DT, -- 检验科接收时间 DATE

    SUBSTRB(
        NVL(
            map1.PLATFORM_ITEM_NAME,
            NVL(q.REPORT_ITEM_NAME, '未知项目')
        ),
        1,
        80
    ) AS ITEM_NAME, -- 检验项目名称，优先取平台 CS_EXAMINE_ITEM 名称

    CASE
        WHEN q.IS_NUMERIC_RESULT = '1' THEN '2'
        ELSE '1'
    END AS RESULT_TYPE, -- 结果类型代码 VARCHAR2(32) 是；1文本 2数值

    CASE
        WHEN q.IS_NUMERIC_RESULT = '1' THEN '数值'
        ELSE '文本'
    END AS RESULT_TYPE_NOTE, -- 结果类型描述 VARCHAR2(100) 是

    SUBSTRB(
        NVL(q.RESULT_TXT, '未记录'),
        1,
        100
    ) AS ITEM_RESULT, -- 检验项目结果 VARCHAR2(100) 是

    SUBSTRB(
        NVL(q.UNITS_TXT, '无'),
        1,
        20
    ) AS UNIT, -- 单位 VARCHAR2(20) 是

    CASE
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(
                 q.REF_RANGE_NORM,
                 '^[<>≤≥]?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?~[<>≤≥]?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
             )
        THEN TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(q.REF_RANGE_NORM, '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?', 1, 1))
        ELSE 0
    END AS REFER_VALUE_LOWER, -- 正常参考值下限 NUMBER(12,2)

    CASE
        WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(
                 q.REF_RANGE_NORM,
                 '^[<>≤≥]?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?~[<>≤≥]?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
             )
        THEN TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(q.REF_RANGE_NORM, '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?', 1, 2))
        ELSE 0
    END AS REFER_VALUE_UPPER, -- 正常参考值上限 NUMBER(12,2)

    CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(12,2)) AS CRITICAL_VALUE, -- 危急值 NUMBER(12,2)

    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(20)) AS ALARM_STATE, -- 通知状态 VARCHAR2(20)

    CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS CALL_DATE, -- 通知日期 DATE

    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS ATTACHED_RESULT, -- 附属结果 VARCHAR2(100)

    CASE
        WHEN q.ITEM_SIGN = '1' THEN '1'
        WHEN q.ITEM_SIGN = '2' THEN '2'
        ELSE '3'
    END AS RESULT_EXPLAIN, -- 结果值的解释 VARCHAR2(32) 是

    CASE
        WHEN q.ITEM_SIGN = '1' THEN '正常'
        WHEN q.ITEM_SIGN = '2' THEN '异常'
        ELSE '不确定'
    END AS RESULT_EXPLAIN_NOTE, -- 结果值的解释描述 VARCHAR2(200) 是

    NVL(q.RESULT_DATE_TIME, q.EFFECTIVE_TIME) AS EFFECTIVE_TIME, -- 活动发生时间 DATE

    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(32)) AS STATUS, -- 卡片状态 VARCHAR2(32)

    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS CREATED_AT, -- 创建时间 TIMESTAMP(6)

    '370104' AS DISTRICT_CODE, -- 所属行政区划 VARCHAR2(6) 是

    'ADDHIS' AS EXCHANGE_TYPE, -- 交换类型 VARCHAR2(10) 是

    SUBSTRB(
        NVL(TO_CHAR(q.REPORT_ITEM_CODE), TO_CHAR(q.ITEM_NO)),
        1,
        20
    ) AS LOCAL_ITEM_CODE, -- 检验报告项目本地编码，保留 LAB_RESULT 明细编码

    SUBSTRB(
        NVL(q.REPORT_ITEM_NAME, '未知项目'),
        1,
        80
    ) AS LOCAL_ITEM_NAME, -- 检验报告项目本地名称，保留 LAB_RESULT 明细名称

    CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS SYSTEM_TIME, -- 数据上传时间戳 TIMESTAMP(6) 是

    q.ITEM_SIGN AS RESULT_CODE, -- 检验结果代码 CHAR(1)

    CASE
        WHEN q.IS_NUMERIC_RESULT = '1' THEN
            TO_NUMBER(
                REGEXP_REPLACE(
                    q.RESULT_NUM_TXT,
                    '^(<=|>=|<|>|≤|≥)',
                    ''
                )
            )
        ELSE NULL
    END AS RATION_RESULT, -- 检验定量结果 NUMBER(14,4)

    CASE
        WHEN q.IS_NUMERIC_RESULT = '1' THEN SUBSTRB(NVL(q.UNITS_TXT, '无'), 1, 20)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS RATION_RESULT_UOM, -- 检验定量结果计量单位 VARCHAR2(20)

    q.RN AS TEST_SN, -- 检验项目顺序号 NUMBER(4)

    CASE
        WHEN q.IS_NUMERIC_RESULT = '1' THEN 2
        ELSE 1
    END AS TEST_RESULT_TYPE, -- 检验结果类型 NUMBER(1)

    SUBSTRB(
        NVL(q.RESULT_TXT, '未记录'),
        1,
        50
    ) AS TEST_RESULT, -- 检验结果 VARCHAR2(50)

    SUBSTRB(
        NVL(q.UNITS_TXT, '无'),
        1,
        50
    ) AS TEST_RESULT_UNIT, -- 检验结果计量单位 VARCHAR2(50)

    '49557032X' AS ORG_CODE, -- 医院组织机构代码 VARCHAR2(32) 是

    '山东省第二人民医院' AS ORG_NAME, -- 医院名称 VARCHAR2(70) 是

    SUBSTRB(q.INSTRUMENT_ID, 1, 32) AS test_exam_equip_code, -- 检查设备编码

    SUBSTRB(
        NVL(q.BARCODE_NO, q.SAMPLE_NUM),
        1,
        50
    ) AS BARCODE_NO, -- 标本条形码号 VARCHAR2(50) 是

    SUBSTRB(
        NVL(q.NAME, '未知'),
        1,
        50
    ) AS NAME, -- 患者姓名 VARCHAR2(50) 是

    CASE
        WHEN q.SEX_CODE IN ('0','1','2','9') THEN q.SEX_CODE
        ELSE '9'
    END AS SEX_CODE, -- 患者性别代码 CHAR(1) 是

    SUBSTRB(
        NVL(q.ID_NUM, '000000000000000000'),
        1,
        18
    ) AS ID_NUM, -- 患者身份证件号码 VARCHAR2(18) 是

    /* ===================== 互认字段：按 CLINIC_ITEM_MAPPING_U 判断 ===================== */
    CASE
        WHEN cim.HIS_ITEM_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN '1'
        ELSE '0'
    END AS MTU_REC_MARK, -- 是否互认标识：互认映射表存在则 1，否则 0

    SUBSTRB(
        CASE
            WHEN cim.HIS_ITEM_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN cim.SPT_ITEM_CODE
            ELSE NULL
        END,
        1,
        100
    ) AS MTU_REC_LIMIT_MARK, -- 互认范围标识：暂用平台互认项目编码 SPT_ITEM_CODE

    SUBSTRB(
        NVL(q.TEST_ITEM_NAME, NVL(q.REPORT_ITEM_NAME, '未知项目')),
        1,
        100
    ) AS HOSPITEM_NAME, -- 院内项目名称：优先取 LAB_TEST_ITEMS.ITEM_NAME

    SUBSTRB(
        NVL(q.TEST_ITEM_CODE, NVL(TO_CHAR(q.REPORT_ITEM_CODE), TO_CHAR(q.ITEM_NO))),
        1,
        100
    ) AS HOSPITEM_CODE, -- 院内项目编码：优先取 LAB_TEST_ITEMS.ITEM_CODE

    SUBSTRB(
        cim.SPT_ITEM_CODE,
        1,
        100
    ) AS PROJECT_CODE, -- 国家平台项目编码

    SUBSTRB(
        cim.SPT_ITEM_NAME,
        1,
        100
    ) AS PROJECT_NAME, -- 国家平台项目名称

    q.ITEM_SIGN AS ITEM_SIGN, -- 结果标识 VARCHAR2(100) 是；1正常 2异常 3不确定

    SUBSTRB(
        q.VISITING_NUM,
        1,
        32
    ) AS VISITING_NUM -- 就诊号 VARCHAR2(32) 是

FROM
(
    SELECT
        p.ID AS REPORT_ID,
        p.APPLY_NUM AS APPLY_NUM,
        p.SAMPLE_RECEIVE_DATE AS RECIEVE_DT,
        p.EFFECTIVE_TIME AS EFFECTIVE_TIME,
        p.SAMPLE_NUM AS SAMPLE_NUM,
        p.NAME AS NAME,
        p.SEX_CODE AS SEX_CODE,
        p.ID_NUM AS ID_NUM,
        p.VISITING_NUM AS VISITING_NUM,

        lr.TEST_NO,
        lr.ITEM_NO,
        lr.PRINT_ORDER,
        lr.REPORT_ITEM_CODE,
        TRIM(lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME) AS REPORT_ITEM_NAME,
        TRIM(lr.RESULT) AS RESULT_TXT,
        TRIM(lr.UNITS) AS UNITS_TXT,
        TRIM(lr.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR) AS ABNORMAL_INDICATOR,
        SUBSTRB(lr.INSTRUMENT_ID, 1, 32) AS INSTRUMENT_ID,
        lr.RESULT_DATE_TIME AS RESULT_DATE_TIME,

        /* LAB_TEST_ITEMS 申请/组合项目字段，用于互认映射 */
        TRIM(lti.ITEM_CODE) AS TEST_ITEM_CODE,
        TRIM(lti.ITEM_NAME) AS TEST_ITEM_NAME,

        TRIM(
            COALESCE(
                TRIM(lr.PRINT_CONTEXT),
                TRIM(lr.RESULT_RANGE)
            )
        ) AS REF_RANGE_TXT,

        REGEXP_REPLACE(
            REGEXP_REPLACE(
                TRIM(
                    COALESCE(
                        TRIM(lr.PRINT_CONTEXT),
                        TRIM(lr.RESULT_RANGE)
                    )
                ),
                '([0-9])\s*(--|－|—|–|~|～|至|-)\s*([0-9])',
                '\1~\3'
            ),
            '[[:space:]]+',
            ''
        ) AS REF_RANGE_NORM,

        p.SAMPLE_NUM AS BARCODE_NO,

        REGEXP_REPLACE(
            REPLACE(
                REPLACE(
                    REPLACE(TRIM(NVL(lr.RESULT, '')), '＜', '<'),
                    '＞',
                    '>'
                ),
                '－',
                '-'
            ),
            '[[:space:]]+',
            ''
        ) AS RESULT_NUM_TXT,

        CASE
            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(
                    REGEXP_REPLACE(
                        REPLACE(
                            REPLACE(
                                REPLACE(TRIM(NVL(lr.RESULT, '')), '＜', '<'),
                                '＞',
                                '>'
                            ),
                            '－',
                            '-'
                        ),
                        '[[:space:]]+',
                        ''
                    ),
                    '^(<=|>=|<|>|≤|≥)?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
                 )
            THEN '1'
            ELSE '0'
        END AS IS_NUMERIC_RESULT,

        CASE
            WHEN UPPER(TRIM(NVL(lr.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR, ''))) IN
                 ('H', 'L', 'HH', 'LL', 'A', 'ABN', 'HIGH', 'LOW', '↑', '↓', '+') THEN '2'

            WHEN UPPER(TRIM(NVL(lr.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR, ''))) IN
                 ('N', 'NORMAL', '0') THEN '1'

            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(
                    UPPER(TRIM(NVL(lr.RESULT, ''))),
                    '阴性|正常|未见|NEGATIVE|NORMAL'
                 )
              OR TRIM(NVL(lr.RESULT, '')) = '-' THEN '1'

            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(
                    UPPER(TRIM(NVL(lr.RESULT, ''))),
                    '阳性|POSITIVE'
                 ) THEN '3'

            WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(
                    REGEXP_REPLACE(
                        REPLACE(
                            REPLACE(
                                REPLACE(TRIM(NVL(lr.RESULT, '')), '＜', '<'),
                                '＞',
                                '>'
                            ),
                            '－',
                            '-'
                        ),
                        '[[:space:]]+',
                        ''
                    ),
                    '^(<=|>=|<|>|≤|≥)?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
                 ) THEN '1'

            ELSE '3'
        END AS ITEM_SIGN,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY lr.TEST_NO
            ORDER BY
                NVL(lr.ITEM_NO, 999999),
                NVL(lr.PRINT_ORDER, 999999),
                NVL(lr.REPORT_ITEM_CODE, ' '),
                NVL(lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME, ' '),
                ROWIDTOCHAR(lr.ROWID)
        ) AS RN

    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(m.TEST_NO), 1, 100) AS ID,
            m.TEST_NO AS TEST_NO_RAW,

            SUBSTRB(
                CASE
                    WHEN m.SRC_TYPE_FOR_JOIN IN ('O_RCPT', 'O_NORCPT') THEN
                        NVL(m.RCPT_NO_C, TO_CHAR(m.TEST_NO))
                    ELSE
                        NVL(TO_CHAR(m.ORDER_ID), TO_CHAR(m.TEST_NO))
                END,
                1,
                20
            ) AS APPLY_NUM,

            NVL(
                m.SPCM_RECEIVED_DATE_TIME,
                NVL(
                    m.EXECUTE_DATE,
                    NVL(
                        m.SPCM_SAMPLE_DATE_TIME,
                        NVL(
                            m.RESULTS_RPT_DATE_TIME,
                            NVL(
                                m.REQUESTED_DATE_TIME,
                                COALESCE(e_i.VISIT_DATE_TIME, e_or.VISIT_DATE_TIME, e_od.VISIT_DATE_TIME, m.BUSINESS_DATE)
                            )
                        )
                    )
                )
            ) AS SAMPLE_RECEIVE_DATE,

            SUBSTRB(NVL(m.SPECIMEN_NO, m.TEST_NO), 1, 20) AS SAMPLE_NUM,

            SUBSTRB(NVL(m.NAME, pmi.NAME), 1, 50) AS NAME,

            CASE TRIM(m.SEX)
                WHEN '男' THEN '1'
                WHEN '女' THEN '2'
                WHEN '未知' THEN '0'
                WHEN '不详' THEN '9'
                WHEN '未说明' THEN '9'
                ELSE '9'
            END AS SEX_CODE,

            SUBSTRB(NVL(pmi.ID_NO, '000000000000000000'), 1, 18) AS ID_NUM,

            SUBSTRB(
                CASE
                    WHEN m.SRC_TYPE_FOR_JOIN = 'I' THEN
                        m.PATIENT_ID_C || '|' || m.VISIT_ID_C
                    WHEN m.SRC_TYPE_FOR_JOIN = 'O_RCPT' THEN
                        NVL(e_or.VISIT_ID, NVL(m.RCPT_NO_C, TO_CHAR(m.TEST_NO)))
                    WHEN m.SRC_TYPE_FOR_JOIN = 'O_NORCPT' THEN
                        NVL(e_od.VISIT_ID, TO_CHAR(m.TEST_NO))
                    ELSE
                        TO_CHAR(m.TEST_NO)
                END,
                1,
                32
            ) AS VISITING_NUM,

            NVL(
                m.RESULTS_RPT_DATE_TIME,
                NVL(
                    m.EXECUTE_DATE,
                    NVL(
                        m.SPCM_RECEIVED_DATE_TIME,
                        NVL(
                            m.SPCM_SAMPLE_DATE_TIME,
                            NVL(
                                m.REQUESTED_DATE_TIME,
                                COALESCE(e_i.VISIT_DATE_TIME, e_or.VISIT_DATE_TIME, e_od.VISIT_DATE_TIME, m.BUSINESS_DATE)
                            )
                        )
                    )
                )
            ) AS EFFECTIVE_TIME

        FROM
        (
            SELECT
                m0.TEST_NO,
                m0.PATIENT_ID,
                m0.VISIT_ID,
                m0.RCPT_NO,
                m0.ORDER_ID,
                m0.REQUESTED_DATE_TIME,
                m0.SPCM_SAMPLE_DATE_TIME,
                m0.EXECUTE_DATE,
                m0.RESULTS_RPT_DATE_TIME,
                m0.SPCM_RECEIVED_DATE_TIME,
                m0.RESULT_STATUS,
                m0.SPECIMEN_NO,
                m0.NAME,
                m0.SEX,
                TO_CHAR(m0.PATIENT_ID) AS PATIENT_ID_C,
                TO_CHAR(m0.VISIT_ID) AS VISIT_ID_C,
                TO_CHAR(m0.RCPT_NO) AS RCPT_NO_C,
                NVL(
                    m0.REQUESTED_DATE_TIME,
                    NVL(
                        m0.SPCM_SAMPLE_DATE_TIME,
                        NVL(
                            m0.EXECUTE_DATE,
                            NVL(m0.RESULTS_RPT_DATE_TIME, m0.SPCM_RECEIVED_DATE_TIME)
                        )
                    )
                ) AS BUSINESS_DATE,
                CASE
                    WHEN m0.VISIT_ID > 0 THEN 'I'
                    WHEN m0.RCPT_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 'O_RCPT'
                    WHEN m0.VISIT_ID IS NULL OR m0.VISIT_ID = 0 THEN 'O_NORCPT'
                    ELSE 'X'
                END AS SRC_TYPE_FOR_JOIN
            FROM HIS.LAB_TEST_MASTER m0
        ) m

        LEFT JOIN
        (
            SELECT
                TO_CHAR(a.PATIENT_ID) AS PATIENT_ID,
                TO_CHAR(a.VISIT_ID) AS VISIT_ID,
                MIN(a.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME) AS VISIT_DATE_TIME
            FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT a
            WHERE a.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2021-01-01'
              AND a.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2024-01-01'
            GROUP BY
                TO_CHAR(a.PATIENT_ID),
                TO_CHAR(a.VISIT_ID)
        ) e_i
            ON m.SRC_TYPE_FOR_JOIN = 'I'
           AND e_i.PATIENT_ID = m.PATIENT_ID_C
           AND e_i.VISIT_ID = m.VISIT_ID_C

        LEFT JOIN
        (
            SELECT
                TO_CHAR(a.PATIENT_ID) AS PATIENT_ID,
                TO_CHAR(a.RCPT_NO) AS RCPT_NO,
                MIN(TO_CHAR(a.CLINIC_NO)) AS VISIT_ID,
                MIN(a.VISIT_DATE) AS VISIT_DATE_TIME
            FROM HIS.OUTP_ORDER_DESC a
            WHERE a.VISIT_DATE >= DATE '2021-01-01'
              AND a.VISIT_DATE <  DATE '2024-01-01'
              AND a.RCPT_NO IS NOT NULL
              AND a.CLINIC_NO IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY
                TO_CHAR(a.PATIENT_ID),
                TO_CHAR(a.RCPT_NO)
        ) e_or
            ON m.SRC_TYPE_FOR_JOIN = 'O_RCPT'
           AND e_or.PATIENT_ID = m.PATIENT_ID_C
           AND e_or.RCPT_NO = m.RCPT_NO_C

        LEFT JOIN
        (
            SELECT
                PATIENT_ID,
                VISIT_DATE,
                VISIT_ID,
                VISIT_DATE_TIME
            FROM
            (
                SELECT
                    TO_CHAR(a.PATIENT_ID) AS PATIENT_ID,
                    TRUNC(a.VISIT_DATE) AS VISIT_DATE,
                    MIN(TO_CHAR(a.CLINIC_NO)) AS VISIT_ID,
                    MIN(a.VISIT_DATE) AS VISIT_DATE_TIME,
                    COUNT(DISTINCT TO_CHAR(a.CLINIC_NO)) AS CLINIC_NO_CNT
                FROM HIS.OUTP_ORDER_DESC a
                WHERE a.VISIT_DATE >= DATE '2021-01-01'
                  AND a.VISIT_DATE <  DATE '2024-01-01'
                  AND a.CLINIC_NO IS NOT NULL
                GROUP BY
                    TO_CHAR(a.PATIENT_ID),
                    TRUNC(a.VISIT_DATE)
            )
            WHERE CLINIC_NO_CNT = 1
        ) e_od
            ON m.SRC_TYPE_FOR_JOIN = 'O_NORCPT'
           AND e_od.PATIENT_ID = m.PATIENT_ID_C
           AND e_od.VISIT_DATE = TRUNC(m.BUSINESS_DATE)

        LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX pmi
            ON pmi.PATIENT_ID = m.PATIENT_ID

        WHERE m.RESULT_STATUS <> '1'
          AND (
                (
                    m.SRC_TYPE_FOR_JOIN = 'I'
                    AND e_i.PATIENT_ID IS NOT NULL
                )
                OR
                (
                    m.SRC_TYPE_FOR_JOIN = 'O_RCPT'
                    AND m.BUSINESS_DATE >= DATE '2021-01-01'
                    AND m.BUSINESS_DATE <  DATE '2024-01-01'
                )
                OR
                (
                    m.SRC_TYPE_FOR_JOIN = 'O_NORCPT'
                    AND e_od.PATIENT_ID IS NOT NULL
                    AND m.BUSINESS_DATE >= DATE '2021-01-01'
                    AND m.BUSINESS_DATE <  DATE '2024-01-01'
                )
              )
    ) p

    INNER JOIN HIS.LAB_RESULT lr
        ON lr.TEST_NO = p.TEST_NO_RAW

    LEFT JOIN HIS.LAB_TEST_ITEMS lti
        ON lti.TEST_NO = TO_CHAR(lr.TEST_NO)
       AND lti.ITEM_NO = lr.ITEM_NO

    WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(lr.REPORT_ITEM_NAME), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(lr.RESULT), '') IS NOT NULL
) q

/* 检验结果明细项目值域：按 本地编码 + 本地名称 直接匹配 */
LEFT JOIN HIS.LIS_EXAMINE_ITEM_MAP map1
    ON TRIM(map1.LOCAL_ITEM_CODE) = TRIM(NVL(TO_CHAR(q.REPORT_ITEM_CODE), TO_CHAR(q.ITEM_NO)))
   AND TRIM(map1.LOCAL_ITEM_NAME) = TRIM(q.REPORT_ITEM_NAME)

/* 互认项目：LAB_TEST_ITEMS.ITEM_CODE -> 已去重互认映射表 */
LEFT JOIN CLINIC_ITEM_MAPPING_U cim
    ON cim.HIS_ITEM_CODE = TRIM(q.TEST_ITEM_CODE)

V_EMR_INSPECTION_TEST.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_INSPECTION_TEST" ("ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "LONIC_CLASS_CODE", "LOINC_CLASS_NAME", "LOCAL_CLASS_CODE", "LOCAL_CLASS_NAME", "INSPECTION_TYPE", "REPORT_ERROR_TYPE", "REPORT_ERROR_REASON", "NAME", "OTHER_ID_TYPE", "OTHER_ID_NUM", "ID_NUM", "PATIENT_TYPE_CODE", "PATIENT_TYPE_NAME", "SEX_CODE", "SEX_NAME", "TELEPHONE", "AGE", "AGE_MONTH", "AGE_DAY", "AGE_HOUR", "VISITING_NUM", "ORDER_ID", "SICKBED_NUM", "CHARGE_TYPE_CODE", "CHARGE_TYPE_NAME", "SAMPLE_NUM", "SAMPLE_TYPE_CODE", "SAMPLE_TYPE_NAME", "APPLY_NUM", "APPLY_HOSP_CODE", "APPLY_HOSP_NAME", "APPLY_DEPT_CODE", "APPLY_DEPT_NAME", "APPLY_DATE", "APPLY_DOCTOR_CODE", "APPLY_DOCTOR_NAME", "DISEASE_CODE", "DISEASE_NAME", "INSPECT_DATE", "SAMPLE_TAKE_DATE", "SAMPLE_RECEIVE_DATE", "EXAM_METHOD", "EXAM_CODE", "EXAM_CODE_NAME", "SPECIMEN_STATE", "SPECIMEN_PLACE_CODE", "SPECIMEN_PLACE_NAME", "SPECIMEN_RISK_CODE", "SPECIMEN_RISK_NAME", "SPECIMEN_QUANTITY_CODE", "SPECIMEN_QUANTITY_NAME", "SPECIMEN_REJECT_CODE", "SPECIMEN_REJECT_NAME", "EXAM_ENGINEER_CODE", "EXAM_ENGINEER_NAME", "EXAM_DOCTOR_CODE", "EXAM_DOCTOR_NAME", "REPORT_NUM", "EXAM_DEPT_CODE", "EXAM_DEPT_NAME", "EXAM_HOSPITAL_CODE", "EXAM_HOSPITAL_NAME", "REPORT_DATE", "REPORT_DOCTOR_CODE", "REPORT_DOCTOR_NAME", "AUDIT_DATE", "AUDIT_DOCTOR_CODE", "AUDIT_DOCTOR_NAME", "IMAGE_DEVICE", "REMARK", "DIAGNOSIS_TREAT_NO", "CARD_TYPE", "CITIZEN_ID", "STATUS", "EFFECTIVE_TIME", "CREATED_AT", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "DEI", "NODE_CODE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "SOURCE_CODE", "CZRK_ID", "DOCTOR_ID_NUM", "REVIEWERS_ID_NUM", "PRINT_TIME", "PRINT_PERSON", "LAB_PURPOSE", "COLLECT_PERSON", "ACCEPT_PERSON") AS 
  SELECT
    /* ===================== 基本信息 ===================== */
    SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(m.TEST_NO), 1, 100) AS ID, -- 内码，主键

    '49557032X' AS ORG_CODE, -- 医院组织机构代码

    '山东省第二人民医院' AS ORG_NAME, -- 医院名称

    /* ===================== 检验类别 ===================== */
    CASE
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%血液%' THEN '01'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%输血%' THEN '01'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%放免%' THEN '02'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%PCR%' OR cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%分子%' THEN '03'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%免疫%' THEN '04'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%生化%' THEN '05'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%微量元素%' THEN '05'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%细胞%' THEN '06'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%微生物%' THEN '07'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%细菌%' THEN '07'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%肿瘤%' OR cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%自身%' THEN '08'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%化学发光%' THEN '09'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%电化发光%' THEN '09'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%发光%' THEN '09'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%体液%' THEN '12'
        ELSE '99'
    END AS LONIC_CLASS_CODE, -- 检验报告的分类的LOINC编码，按CC99.00004

    CASE
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%血液%' THEN '临床血液'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%输血%' THEN '临床血液'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%放免%' THEN '核医学科(同位素)检验'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%PCR%' OR cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%分子%' THEN '分子诊断学（PCR）项目'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%免疫%' THEN '临床免疫'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%生化%' THEN '临床生化'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%微量元素%' THEN '临床生化'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%细胞%' THEN '临床细胞室开展项目'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%微生物%' THEN '细菌室项目'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%细菌%' THEN '细菌室项目'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%肿瘤%' OR cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%自身%' THEN '肿瘤标志、自身'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%化学发光%' THEN '免疫等实验'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%电化发光%' THEN '免疫等实验'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%发光%' THEN '免疫等实验'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%体液%' THEN '临床体液'
        ELSE '其它'
    END AS LOINC_CLASS_NAME, -- 检验报告的分类的LOINC名称，按CC99.00004

    CASE
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%血液%' THEN '01'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%输血%' THEN '01'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%放免%' THEN '02'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%PCR%' OR cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%分子%' THEN '03'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%免疫%' THEN '04'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%生化%' THEN '05'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%微量元素%' THEN '05'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%细胞%' THEN '06'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%微生物%' THEN '07'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%细菌%' THEN '07'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%肿瘤%' OR cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%自身%' THEN '08'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%化学发光%' THEN '09'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%电化发光%' THEN '09'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%发光%' THEN '09'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%体液%' THEN '12'
        ELSE '99'
    END AS LOCAL_CLASS_CODE, -- 本地检验类别编码，暂按平台检验类别同步

    SUBSTRB(NVL(cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME, '其它'), 1, 128) AS LOCAL_CLASS_NAME, -- 本地检验类别名称

    CASE
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%血液%' THEN '临床血液'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%输血%' THEN '临床血液'
        WHEN cls.LOCAL_CLASS_NAME LIKE '%放免%' THEN '核医学科(同位素)检验'

            m.EXECUTE_DATE,
            NVL(
                m.SPCM_RECEIVED_DATE_TIME,
                NVL(
                    m.SPCM_SAMPLE_DATE_TIME,
                    NVL(m.REQUESTED_DATE_TIME, COALESCE(e_i.VISIT_DATE_TIME, e_or.VISIT_DATE_TIME, e_od.VISIT_DATE_TIME, m.BUSINESS_DATE))
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS REPORT_DATE, -- 报告日期

    SUBSTRB(NVL(s_report.ID_NO, s_apply.ID_NO), 1, 32) AS REPORT_DOCTOR_CODE, -- 报告医生代码

    SUBSTRB(COALESCE(s_report.NAME, s_audit.NAME, s_apply.NAME, m.TRANSCRIPTIONIST, m.VERIFIED_BY, m.ORDERING_PROVIDER, '未知'), 1, 50) AS REPORT_DOCTOR_NAME, -- 报告医师签名

    NVL(
        m.RESULTS_RPT_DATE_TIME,
        NVL(
            m.EXECUTE_DATE,
            NVL(
                m.SPCM_RECEIVED_DATE_TIME,
                NVL(
                    m.SPCM_SAMPLE_DATE_TIME,
                    NVL(m.REQUESTED_DATE_TIME, COALESCE(e_i.VISIT_DATE_TIME, e_or.VISIT_DATE_TIME, e_od.VISIT_DATE_TIME, m.BUSINESS_DATE))
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS AUDIT_DATE, -- 审核日期时间

    SUBSTRB(NVL(s_audit.ID_NO, NVL(s_report.ID_NO, s_apply.ID_NO)), 1, 32) AS AUDIT_DOCTOR_CODE, -- 审核医生代码

    SUBSTRB(COALESCE(s_audit.NAME, s_report.NAME, s_apply.NAME, m.VERIFIED_BY, m.TRANSCRIPTIONIST, m.ORDERING_PROVIDER, '未知'), 1, 50) AS AUDIT_DOCTOR_NAME, -- 审核医师签名

    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(64)) AS IMAGE_DEVICE, -- 检验设备名称

    SUBSTRB(m.MEMO, 1, 200) AS REMARK, -- 备注

    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(20)) AS DIAGNOSIS_TREAT_NO, -- 诊疗编码

    CAST(NULL AS CHAR(1)) AS CARD_TYPE, -- 卡片类型

    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(32)) AS CITIZEN_ID, -- 个人内码

    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(32)) AS STATUS, -- 卡片状态

    NVL(
        m.RESULTS_RPT_DATE_TIME,
        NVL(
            m.EXECUTE_DATE,
            NVL(
                m.SPCM_RECEIVED_DATE_TIME,
                NVL(
                    m.SPCM_SAMPLE_DATE_TIME,
                    NVL(m.REQUESTED_DATE_TIME, COALESCE(e_i.VISIT_DATE_TIME, e_or.VISIT_DATE_TIME, e_od.VISIT_DATE_TIME, m.BUSINESS_DATE))
                )
            )
        )
    ) AS EFFECTIVE_TIME, -- 活动发生时间

    CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS CREATED_AT, -- 创建时间

    '370104' AS DISTRICT_CODE, -- 所属行政区划

    'ADDHIS' AS EXCHANGE_TYPE, -- 交换类型

    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS DEI, -- 数据交换标识符

    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS NODE_CODE, -- 节点标识符

    CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS SYSTEM_TIME, -- 数据上传时间戳

    CASE
        WHEN m.SRC_TYPE_FOR_JOIN IN ('O_RCPT', 'O_NORCPT') THEN '1'
        WHEN m.SRC_TYPE_FOR_JOIN = 'I' THEN '3'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS SOURCE_CODE, -- 标本来源代码：1门诊，3住院

    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(36)) AS CZRK_ID, -- 常住人口ID

    SUBSTRB(NVL(s_report.ID_NO, s_apply.ID_NO), 1, 18) AS DOCTOR_ID_NUM, -- 检验人员身份证号

    SUBSTRB(NVL(s_audit.ID_NO, NVL(s_report.ID_NO, s_apply.ID_NO)), 1, 18) AS REVIEWERS_ID_NUM, -- 审核人员身份证号

    CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS PRINT_TIME, -- 报告单打印时间

    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS PRINT_PERSON, -- 报告单打印人

    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS LAB_PURPOSE, -- 检验目的

    SUBSTRB(COALESCE(s_sampler.NAME, m.SAMPLERS), 1, 50) AS COLLECT_PERSON, -- 标本采样人

    CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS ACCEPT_PERSON -- 标本接收人
FROM
(
    SELECT /*+ NO_MERGE */
        m0.*,
        TO_CHAR(m0.PATIENT_ID) AS PATIENT_ID_C,
        TO_CHAR(m0.VISIT_ID) AS VISIT_ID_C,
        TO_CHAR(m0.RCPT_NO) AS RCPT_NO_C,

        NVL(
            m0.REQUESTED_DATE_TIME,
            NVL(
                m0.SPCM_SAMPLE_DATE_TIME,
                NVL(
                    m0.EXECUTE_DATE,
                    NVL(m0.RESULTS_RPT_DATE_TIME, m0.SPCM_RECEIVED_DATE_TIME)
                )
            )
        ) AS BUSINESS_DATE,

        CASE
            WHEN m0.VISIT_ID > 0 THEN 'I'
            WHEN m0.RCPT_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 'O_RCPT'
            WHEN m0.VISIT_ID IS NULL OR m0.VISIT_ID = 0 THEN 'O_NORCPT'
            ELSE 'X'
        END AS SRC_TYPE_FOR_JOIN
    FROM HIS.LAB_TEST_MASTER m0
    WHERE m0.RESULT_STATUS <> '1'
      AND (
            /* 住院记录按 PAT_VISIT 出院时间判断，不能在这里按检验时间过滤 */
            m0.VISIT_ID > 0

            OR

            /* 门诊/无收据门诊记录，原逻辑本身按 BUSINESS_DATE 过滤 */
            (
                NVL(
                    m0.REQUESTED_DATE_TIME,
                    NVL(
                        m0.SPCM_SAMPLE_DATE_TIME,
                        NVL(
                            m0.EXECUTE_DATE,
                            NVL(m0.RESULTS_RPT_DATE_TIME, m0.SPCM_RECEIVED_DATE_TIME)
                        )
                    )
                ) >= DATE '2021-01-01'
                AND
                NVL(
                    m0.REQUESTED_DATE_TIME,
                    NVL(
                        m0.SPCM_SAMPLE_DATE_TIME,
                        NVL(
                            m0.EXECUTE_DATE,
                            NVL(m0.RESULTS_RPT_DATE_TIME, m0.SPCM_RECEIVED_DATE_TIME)
                        )
                    )
                ) < DATE '2024-01-01'
            )
          )
) m

LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT
        TO_CHAR(a.PATIENT_ID) AS PATIENT_ID,
        TO_CHAR(a.VISIT_ID) AS VISIT_ID,
        MIN(a.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME) AS VISIT_DATE_TIME
    FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT a
    WHERE a.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= DATE '2021-01-01'
      AND a.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  DATE '2024-01-01'
    GROUP BY
        TO_CHAR(a.PATIENT_ID),
        TO_CHAR(a.VISIT_ID)
) e_i
    ON m.SRC_TYPE_FOR_JOIN = 'I'
   AND e_i.PATIENT_ID = m.PATIENT_ID_C
   AND e_i.VISIT_ID = m.VISIT_ID_C

LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT
        TO_CHAR(a.PATIENT_ID) AS PATIENT_ID,
        TO_CHAR(a.RCPT_NO) AS RCPT_NO,
        MIN(TO_CHAR(a.CLINIC_NO)) AS VISIT_ID,
        MIN(a.VISIT_DATE) AS VISIT_DATE_TIME,
        COUNT(DISTINCT TO_CHAR(a.CLINIC_NO)) AS CLINIC_NO_CNT
    FROM HIS.OUTP_ORDER_DESC a
    WHERE a.VISIT_DATE >= DATE '2021-01-01'
      AND a.VISIT_DATE <  DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND a.RCPT_NO IS NOT NULL
      AND a.CLINIC_NO IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        TO_CHAR(a.PATIENT_ID),
        TO_CHAR(a.RCPT_NO)
) e_or
    ON m.SRC_TYPE_FOR_JOIN = 'O_RCPT'
   AND e_or.PATIENT_ID = m.PATIENT_ID_C
   AND e_or.RCPT_NO = m.RCPT_NO_C

LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT
        PATIENT_ID,
        VISIT_DATE,
        VISIT_ID,
        VISIT_DATE_TIME
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            TO_CHAR(a.PATIENT_ID) AS PATIENT_ID,
            TRUNC(a.VISIT_DATE) AS VISIT_DATE,
            MIN(TO_CHAR(a.CLINIC_NO)) AS VISIT_ID,
            MIN(a.VISIT_DATE) AS VISIT_DATE_TIME,
            COUNT(DISTINCT TO_CHAR(a.CLINIC_NO)) AS CLINIC_NO_CNT
        FROM HIS.OUTP_ORDER_DESC a
        WHERE a.VISIT_DATE >= DATE '2021-01-01'
          AND a.VISIT_DATE <  DATE '2024-01-01'
          AND a.CLINIC_NO IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY
            TO_CHAR(a.PATIENT_ID),
            TRUNC(a.VISIT_DATE)
    )
    WHERE CLINIC_NO_CNT = 1
) e_od
    ON m.SRC_TYPE_FOR_JOIN = 'O_NORCPT'
   AND e_od.PATIENT_ID = m.PATIENT_ID_C
   AND e_od.VISIT_DATE = TRUNC(m.BUSINESS_DATE)

LEFT JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX p
    ON p.PATIENT_ID = m.PATIENT_ID

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT dd.DEPT_CODE,
           MAX(dd.QMPT_CODE) AS QMPT_CODE,
           MAX(dd.QMPT_NAME) AS QMPT_NAME,
           MAX(dd.DEPT_NAME) AS DEPT_NAME
      FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
     GROUP BY dd.DEPT_CODE
) d_req
    ON d_req.DEPT_CODE = m.ORDERING_DEPT

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT dd.DEPT_CODE,
           MAX(dd.QMPT_CODE) AS QMPT_CODE,
           MAX(dd.QMPT_NAME) AS QMPT_NAME,
           MAX(dd.DEPT_NAME) AS DEPT_NAME
      FROM HIS.DEPT_DICT dd
     GROUP BY dd.DEPT_CODE
) d_perf
    ON d_perf.DEPT_CODE = m.PERFORMED_BY

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT s.EMP_NO,
           MAX(s.NAME) AS NAME,
           MAX(s.ID_NO) AS ID_NO
      FROM HIS.STAFF_DICT s
     GROUP BY s.EMP_NO
) s_apply
    ON s_apply.EMP_NO = m.ORDERING_PROVIDER

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT s.EMP_NO,
           MAX(s.NAME) AS NAME,
           MAX(s.ID_NO) AS ID_NO
      FROM HIS.STAFF_DICT s
     GROUP BY s.EMP_NO
) s_report
    ON s_report.EMP_NO = m.TRANSCRIPTIONIST

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT s.EMP_NO,
           MAX(s.NAME) AS NAME,
           MAX(s.ID_NO) AS ID_NO
      FROM HIS.STAFF_DICT s
     GROUP BY s.EMP_NO
) s_audit
    ON s_audit.EMP_NO = m.VERIFIED_BY

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT s.EMP_NO,
           MAX(s.NAME) AS NAME,
           MAX(s.ID_NO) AS ID_NO
      FROM HIS.STAFF_DICT s
     GROUP BY s.EMP_NO
) s_sampler
    ON s_sampler.EMP_NO = m.SAMPLERS

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT li.TEST_NO,
           MAX(b.EXPAND2) AS LOCAL_CLASS_NAME
      FROM HIS.LAB_TEST_ITEMS li
      LEFT JOIN HIS.CLINIC_ITEM_DICT b
        ON b.ITEM_CODE = li.ITEM_CODE
     GROUP BY li.TEST_NO
) cls
    ON cls.TEST_NO = m.TEST_NO

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT x.PATIENT_ID,
           x.VISIT_ID,
           MAX(x.DIAGNOSIS_CODE) KEEP (
               DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY
               CASE x.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE
                   WHEN '3' THEN 1
                   WHEN '2' THEN 2
                   WHEN '1' THEN 3
                   ELSE 9
               END,
               NVL(x.DIAGNOSIS_NO, 999)
           ) AS DISEASE_CODE,
           MAX(x.DIAGNOSIS_DESC) KEEP (
               DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY
               CASE x.DIAGNOSIS_TYPE
                   WHEN '3' THEN 1
                   WHEN '2' THEN 2
                   WHEN '1' THEN 3
                   ELSE 9
               END,
               NVL(x.DIAGNOSIS_NO, 999)
           ) AS DISEASE_NAME
      FROM HIS.DIAGNOSIS x
     GROUP BY x.PATIENT_ID,
              x.VISIT_ID
) dg
    ON m.SRC_TYPE_FOR_JOIN = 'I'
   AND dg.PATIENT_ID = m.PATIENT_ID
   AND dg.VISIT_ID = m.VISIT_ID

WHERE m.RESULT_STATUS <>'1'
  AND (
        (
            m.SRC_TYPE_FOR_JOIN = 'I'
            AND e_i.PATIENT_ID IS NOT NULL
        )
        OR
        (
            m.SRC_TYPE_FOR_JOIN = 'O_RCPT'
            AND m.BUSINESS_DATE >= DATE '2021-01-01'
            AND m.BUSINESS_DATE <  DATE '2024-01-01'
        )
        OR
        (
            m.SRC_TYPE_FOR_JOIN = 'O_NORCPT'
            AND e_od.PATIENT_ID IS NOT NULL
            AND m.BUSINESS_DATE >= DATE '2021-01-01'
            AND m.BUSINESS_DATE <  DATE '2024-01-01'
        )
      )

V_EMR_IN_FEE_INFO_CHILD.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_IN_FEE_INFO_CHILD" ("ID", "PATIENT_ID", "PROJ_DENO", "PROJ_NAME", "HOS_PROJ_DENO", "HOS_PROJ_NAME", "FEE_CAT_CODE", "PROJ_UP", "PROJ_AMT", "PROJ_MON", "IND_PAY", "SELF_PAY", "RCD_IDCARD", "RCD_NUMBERAME", "ORD_DOC_IDCARD", "ORD_DOC_NUMBERAME", "ORD_DEP_CODE", "ORD_DEP_NAME", "HOS_DEP_CODE", "HOS_DEP_NAME", "RCD_DT", "INUMBERVOICE_NUMBERO", "IF_PRN", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "NAME", "SEX_CODE", "ID_NUM", "SETTLEMENT_ID", "INSURANCE_ID", "BASE_FEE", "ACCOUNT_FEE", "OWN_FEE", "IS_REVERSED", "REFERENCED_SETTLEMENT_ID", "CHARGE_ID", "ITEM_SUB_NO", "ITEM_SUB_NAME", "ITEM_CODE", "MEDICAL_INSURANCE_ITEM_NAME", "FEE_IN", "FEE_OUT", "RECIPE_ID", "ORDER_ID") AS 
  select substr(
           '49557032X' || '|' ||
           nvl(a.patient_id, '-') || '|' ||
           nvl(to_char(a.visit_id), '-') || '|' ||
           nvl(a.rcpt_no, '-') || '|' ||
           nvl(to_char(a.item_no), '-'),
           1,
           100
       ) as ID,-- 内码 是 主键

       substr(a.patient_id || '|' || a.visit_id, 1, 32) as PATIENT_ID,-- 住院唯一标识号 是

     nvl((select VALUE_DOMAIN_code  from   CDA_VALUE_DOMAIN_MAP e where CATEGORY_CODE='DM04-001' and e.HOSPITAL_CODE=a.item_code),a.item_code)
    PROJ_DENO,-- 收费项目明细编号 是

        nvl((select VALUE_DOMAIN_name  from   CDA_VALUE_DOMAIN_MAP e where CATEGORY_CODE='DM04-001' and e.HOSPITAL_CODE=a.item_code),a.item_name)
  as PROJ_NAME,-- 收费项目名称 是

       substr(a.item_code, 1, 100) as HOS_PROJ_DENO,-- 院内收费项目编码

       substr(a.item_name, 1, 100) as HOS_PROJ_NAME,-- 院内收费项目名称

       case trim(pl.mr_bill_class)
    when '01'   then '1'   -- 一般医疗服务费
    when '02'   then '2'   -- 一般治疗操作费
    when '03'   then '3'   -- 护理费
    when '04'   then '4'   -- 综合医疗服务类其他费用
    when '05'   then '5'   -- 病理诊断费
    when '06'   then '6'   -- 实验室诊断费
    when '07'   then '7'   -- 影像学诊断费
    when '08'   then '8'   -- 临床诊断项目费
    when '09'   then '9'   -- 非手术治疗项目费
    when '0901' then '901' -- 其中：临床物理治疗费
    when '10'   then '10'  -- 手术治疗费
    when '1001' then '101' -- 其中：麻醉费
    when '1002' then '102' -- 其中：手术费
    when '1003' then '24'  -- 治疗类：麻醉-检查，平台无细项，暂归其他费
    when '11'   then '11'  -- 康复费
    when '12'   then '12'  -- 中医治疗费
    when '1201' then '24'  -- 中医诊断费，平台无细项，暂归其他费
    when '1202' then '24'  -- 中医手术费，平台无细项，暂归其他费
    when '13'   then '13'  -- 西药费
    when '1301' then '131' -- 其中：抗菌药物费用
    when '14'   then '14'  -- 中成药费
    when '15'   then '15'  -- 中草药费
    when '16'   then '16'  -- 血费
    when '17'   then '17'  -- 白蛋白类制品费
    when '18'   then '18'  -- 球蛋白类制品费
    when '19'   then '19'  -- 凝血因子类制品费
    when '20'   then '20'  -- 细胞因子类制品费
    when '21'   then '21'  -- 检查用一次性医用材料费
    when '22'   then '22'  -- 治疗用一次性医用材料费
    when '23'   then '23'  -- 手术用一次性医用材料费
    when '24'   then '24'  -- 其他费
    else '24'
end as   FEE_CAT_CODE,-- 费用归类代码 是

       cast(round(nvl(a.item_price, 0), 2) as number(10,2)) as PROJ_UP,-- 项目单价（元） 是

       cast(round(nvl(a.amount, 0), 2) as number(10,2)) as PROJ_AMT,-- 项目数量 是，退费数量可为负数

       cast(round(nvl(a.charges, 0), 2) as number(10,2)) as PROJ_MON,-- 项目总金额（元） 是

       cast(
           case
               when a.zfbl is not null
               then round(nvl(a.charges, 0) * nvl(a.zfbl, 0) / 100, 2)
               else null
           end as number(10,2)
       ) as IND_PAY,-- 项目自付金额（元）

       cast(
           case
               when a.zfbl is not null
               then round(nvl(a.zfbl, 0) / 100, 2)
               else null
           end as number(10,2)
       ) as SELF_PAY,-- 自付比例

       substr(
           (
               select max(
                          case
                              when regexp_like(upper(s.id_no), '^[0-9]{17}([0-9]|X)$')
                              then upper(s.id_no)
                          end
                      )
                 from his.staff_dict s
                where  s.emp_no = a.operator_no
           ),
           1,
           18
       ) as RCD_IDCARD,-- 收费员身份证号

       substr(
           (
               select max(s.name)
                 from his.staff_dict s
                where  s.emp_no = a.operator_no
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as RCD_NUMBERAME,-- 收费员姓名

       substr(
           (
               select max(
                          case
                              when regexp_like(upper(s.id_no), '^[0-9]{17}([0-9]|X)$')
                              then upper(s.id_no)
                          end
                      )
                 from his.staff_dict s
                where s.name = a.order_doctor
           ),
           1,
           18
       ) as ORD_DOC_IDCARD,-- 开单医生身份证号

       substr(nvl(a.order_doctor, '-'), 1, 50) as ORD_DOC_NUMBERAME,-- 开单医生姓名 是

       substr(
           nvl(
               (
                   select max(d.qmpt_code)
                     from his.dept_dict d
                    where d.dept_code = a.ordered_by
               ),
               a.ordered_by
           ),
           1,
           20
       ) as ORD_DEP_CODE,-- 开单科室代码 是

       substr(
           nvl(
               (
                   select max(d.qmpt_name)
                     from his.dept_dict d
                    where d.dept_code = a.ordered_by
               ),
               nvl(
                   (
                       select max(d.dept_name)
                         from his.dept_dict d
                        where d.dept_code = a.ordered_by
                   ),
                   a.ordered_by
               )
           ),
           1,
           100
       ) as ORD_DEP_NAME,-- 开单科室名称 是

       substr(nvl(a.ordered_by, '-'), 1, 20) as HOS_DEP_CODE,-- 院内开立科室编码

       substr(
           nvl(
               (
                   select max(d.dept_name)
                     from his.dept_dict d
                    where d.dept_code = a.ordered_by
               ),
               a.ordered_by
           ),
           1,
           100
       ) as HOS_DEP_NAME,-- 院内开立科室名称

       cast(a.billing_date_time as date) as RCD_DT,-- 收费日期时间 是

       substr(a.rcpt_no, 1, 24) as INUMBERVOICE_NUMBERO,-- 发票号码

       case
           when a.rcpt_no is not null then '1'
           else cast(null as char(1))
       end as IF_PRN,-- 是否打印发票

       '49557032X' as ORG_CODE,-- 医院组织机构代码 是

       '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,-- 医院名称 是

       '370104' as DISTRICT_CODE,-- 所属行政区划 是

       'INSERT' as EXCHANGE_TYPE,-- 交换类型 是

       cast(systimestamp as timestamp) as SYSTEM_TIME,-- 数据上传时间戳 是

       substr(b.name, 1, 50) as NAME,-- 患者姓名 是

       case
           when b.sex = '男' then '1'
           when b.sex = '女' then '2'
           when b.sex = '未知' then '0'
           else '9'
       end as SEX_CODE,-- 患者性别代码 是

       substr(nvl(b.id_no, '000000000000000000'), 1, 18) as ID_NUM,-- 患者身份证件号码 是

       substr(nvl(a.rcpt_no, '-'), 1, 100) as SETTLEMENT_ID,-- 收费结算流水号 是

       substr(c.brjsh, 1, 100) as INSURANCE_ID,-- 医保结算流水号

       cast(round(nvl(c.tczf, 0), 2) as number) as BASE_FEE,-- 基本统筹支付金额 是

       cast(round(nvl(c.grzhzf, 0), 2) as number) as ACCOUNT_FEE,-- 医保个人账户支付金额 是

       cast(round(nvl(c.brfdje, 0), 2) as number) as OWN_FEE,-- 个人自付金额 是

       case
           when nvl(a.amount, 0) < 0 or nvl(a.charges, 0) < 0 then '1'
           else '0'
       end as IS_REVERSED,-- 是否退费

              case
           when nvl(a.amount, 0) < 0 or nvl(a.charges, 0) < 0
           then substr(a.rcpt_no, 1, 100)
           else cast(null as varchar2(100))
       end as REFERENCED_SETTLEMENT_ID,-- 退费关联结算流水号；需要确认原退费票据字段
       substr(
           nvl(
               a.rcpt_no || '|' || to_char(a.item_no),
               to_char(a.item_no)
           ),
           1,
           100
       ) as CHARGE_ID,-- 收费流水号 是

       substr(nvl(a.item_code, '-'), 1, 100) as ITEM_SUB_NO,-- 收费子项项目编码 是

       substr(nvl(a.item_name, '-'), 1, 100) as ITEM_SUB_NAME,-- 收费子项项目名称 是

       substr(a.insur_code, 1, 100) as ITEM_CODE,-- 医保项目代码

       substr(a.insur_name, 1, 100) as MEDICAL_INSURANCE_ITEM_NAME,-- 医保项目名称

       cast(0 as number(12,2)) as FEE_IN,-- 医保内总金额

       cast(0 as number(12,2)) as FEE_OUT,-- 医保外总金额

       cast(null as varchar2(100)) as RECIPE_ID,-- 处方流水号

       substr(
           nvl(
               to_char(a.oper_code),
               nvl(a.rcpt_no, '-') || '|' || nvl(to_char(a.item_no), '-')
           ),
           1,
           100
       ) as ORDER_ID-- 医嘱流水号 是；无医嘱流水号时暂用收费流水号兜底，需要确认

from his.inp_bill_detail a

inner join his.pat_master_index b
        on a.patient_id = b.patient_id

left join his.inp_settle_master_yb c
       on c.patient_id = a.patient_id
      and c.visit_id = a.visit_id
      and c.settle_type = '结算'
left join (
    select pl.item_class,
           pl.item_code,
           max(pl.mr_bill_class) as mr_bill_class
      from HIS.price_list pl
     where pl.mr_bill_class is not null
     group by pl.item_class,
              pl.item_code
) pl
  on pl.item_class = a.item_class
 and pl.item_code  = a.item_code
where a.billing_date_time >= to_date('2021-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
  and a.billing_date_time <  to_date('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')

V_EMR_IN_FEE_INFO_MAIN.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_IN_FEE_INFO_MAIN" ("ID", "PATIENT_ID", "TOTAL_FEE", "INUMBERD_PAY", "YB_PAY", "TC_PAY", "GWY_PAY", "DB_PAY", "MZJZ_PAY", "QT_PAY", "PAY_MODE", "PAY_MODE_NAME", "SO_CARD", "ID_NUM", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "DISTRICT_CODE") AS 
  select substr('49557032X' || '|' || b.patient_id || '|' || b.visit_id, 1, 100) as ID,-- 内码 是 主键

       substr(b.patient_id || '|' || b.visit_id, 1, 32) as PATIENT_ID,-- 住院唯一标识号 是

       cast(round(nvl(b.payments, 0), 2) as number(10,2)) as TOTAL_FEE,-- 总费用（元） 是

       cast(round(nvl(yb.brfdje, nvl(b.payments, 0)), 2) as number(10,2)) as INUMBERD_PAY,-- 自付金额（元） 是

       cast(round(nvl(yb.ybfdje, 0), 2) as number(10,2)) as YB_PAY,-- 医保报销费用 是

       cast(round(nvl(yb.tczf, 0), 2) as number(10,2)) as TC_PAY,-- 统筹基金支付 是

       cast(round(nvl(yb.gwybz, 0), 2) as number(10,2)) as GWY_PAY,-- 公务员基金支付 是

       cast(round(nvl(yb.dbbzje, 0), 2) as number(10,2)) as DB_PAY,-- 大病基金支付 是

       cast(round(nvl(yb.mzbzje, 0), 2) as number(10,2)) as MZJZ_PAY,-- 民政救助支付 是

       cast(round(nvl(yb.qttczf, 0), 2) as number(10,2)) as QT_PAY,-- 其他基金支付 是
       substr(
           case
               when nvl(yb.tczf, 0) > 0
                 or nvl(yb.ybfdje, 0) > 0
                 or nvl(yb.gwybz, 0) > 0
                 or nvl(yb.dbbzje, 0) > 0
                 or nvl(yb.mzbzje, 0) > 0
                 or nvl(yb.qttczf, 0) > 0
               then '07'
               else '99'
           end,
           1,
           2
       ) as PAY_MODE,-- 费用支付方式代码

       substr(
           case
               when nvl(yb.tczf, 0) > 0
                 or nvl(yb.ybfdje, 0) > 0
                 or nvl(yb.gwybz, 0) > 0
                 or nvl(yb.dbbzje, 0) > 0
                 or nvl(yb.mzbzje, 0) > 0
                 or nvl(yb.qttczf, 0) > 0
               then '统筹金'
               else '其他'
           end,
           1,
           26
       ) as PAY_MODE_NAME,-- 费用支付方式名称

       cast(null as varchar2(25)) as SO_CARD,-- 社保卡号码

       cast(null as varchar2(18)) as ID_NUM,-- 社会保障号

       '49557032X' as ORG_CODE,-- 医院组织机构编码 是

       '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,-- 医院名称 是

       'INSERT' as EXCHANGE_TYPE,-- 交换类型 是

       cast(systimestamp as timestamp) as SYSTEM_TIME,-- 数据上传时间戳 是

       '370104' as DISTRICT_CODE-- 所属行政区划 是

from (
        select s.patient_id,
               s.visit_id,
               sum(nvl(s.payments, 0)) as payments
          from his.inp_settle_master s
         where s.transact_type = '正常'
         group by s.patient_id,
                  s.visit_id
     ) b

left join (
        select y.patient_id,
               y.visit_id,
               sum(nvl(y.brfdje, 0)) as brfdje,
               sum(nvl(y.ybfdje, 0)) as ybfdje,
               sum(nvl(y.tczf, 0)) as tczf,
               sum(nvl(y.gwybz, 0)) as gwybz,
               sum(nvl(y.dbbzje, 0)) as dbbzje,
               sum(nvl(y.mzbzje, 0)) as mzbzje,
               sum(nvl(y.qttczf, 0)) as qttczf
          from his.inp_settle_master_yb y
         where y.settle_type = '结算'
         group by y.patient_id,
                  y.visit_id
     ) yb
       on b.patient_id = yb.patient_id
      and b.visit_id = yb.visit_id

left join his.pat_visit pv
       on b.patient_id = pv.patient_id
      and b.visit_id = pv.visit_id
      where pv.discharge_date_time>= date '2021-01-01'
           and  pv.discharge_date_time  <  date '2025-01-01'

V_EMR_MEDICAL_RECORD_INFO.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_MEDICAL_RECORD_INFO" ("ID", "PATIENT_TYPE", "VISTING_NUM", "MED_TYPE", "MED_NOTE", "CREATE_TIME", "CREATE_DOC_ID", "CREATE_DOC", "LAST_TIME", "LAST_DOC_ID", "LAST_DOC", "ARCHIVE_TIME", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME") AS 
  select
       cast(
           substrb(
               '49557032X' || '|' ||
               pv.patient_id || '|' ||
               pv.visit_id || '|' ||
               nvl(to_char(t1.id), '-'),
               1,
               100
           ) as varchar2(100)
       ) as ID,--内码 是 主键；机构码|患者ID|住院次数|文书ID，避免同次住院多文书重复

       cast('2' as char(1)) as PATIENT_TYPE,--门急诊/住院标志 是；1门急诊，2住院

       cast(
           substrb(
               pv.patient_id || '|' || pv.visit_id,
               1,
               32
           ) as varchar2(32)
       ) as VISTING_NUM,--就诊标识号 是

      cast(
    case
        /* 1 入院记录类：只匹配明细值域，不返回大类1 */
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%24小时内入院死亡记录%' then '103'
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%24小时内入出院记录%' then '102'
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%再次入院记录%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%多次入院记录%' then '101'
        when t1.doc_type_name = '入院记录'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%入院病历%' then '100'
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%其他入院记录%' then '104'

        /* 2 病程记录类：只匹配明细值域，不返回大类2 */
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%术后首次病程记录%' then '214'
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%首次病程记录%' then '201'
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%日常病程记录%' then '202'
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%上级医师查房记录%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%上级查房记录%' then '203'
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%疑难病例讨论%' then '204'
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%交接班记录%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%交（接）班记录%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%患者转科护理交接单%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%手术患者交接记录单%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%孕产妇出入产房交接记录单%' then '205'
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%转科记录%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%转入记录%' then '206'
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%阶段小结%' then '207'
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%抢救记录%' then '208'
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%有创诊疗操作记录%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%检查记录%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%治疗记录%' then '209'
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%会诊记录%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%护理会诊申请单%' then '210'
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%术前小结%' then '211'
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%术前讨论%' then '212'
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%手术记录%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%剖宫产记录%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%分娩记录%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%自然分娩记录%' then '213'
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%麻醉术前访视记录%' then '215'
        when t1.doc_type_name = '麻醉记录'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%麻醉记录%' then '216'
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%手术安全核查记录%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%安全核查表%' then '217'
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%手术清点记录%' then '218'
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%麻醉术后访视记录%' then '219'
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%出院记录%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%出院小结%' then '220'
        when t1.doc_type_name = '死亡记录'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%死亡记录%' then '221'
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%死亡病例讨论记录%' then '222'
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%病重（病危）患者护理记录%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%危重患者护理记录单%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%危重患者记录单%' then '223'

        /* 3 知情同意书类：只匹配明细值域，不返回大类3 */
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%手术知情同意书%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%手术同意书%' then '301'
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%PICC穿刺知情同意书%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%治疗类知情同意书%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%输血同意书%' then '302'
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%用药类知情同意书%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%特殊药品及材料使用同意书%' then '303'
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%检查类知情同意书%' then '304'
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%其他知情同意书%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%护理知情告知书%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%病重（危）通知书%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%病危（重）通知书%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%病危(重)通知书%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%医患沟通记录%' then '305'

        /* 其余护理、宣教、评估、证明、量表等暂无明确明细值域，暂归其他病程记录 */
        when t1.doc_type_name like '%护理记录%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%健康宣教%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%教育计划%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%评估%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%评分%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%筛查%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%出入量记录单%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%翻身记录单%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%生命体征记录单%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%微量血糖监测记录单%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%基础代谢率记录单%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%疼痛%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%证明%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%诊断证明%'
          or t1.doc_type_name like '%住院患者证明%' then '224'

        /* 未匹配到的住院文书，默认其他病程记录 */
        else '224'
    end as varchar2(3)
) as MED_TYPE,--病历类型 是；按平台明细值域转换，不使用大类1/2/3

       case
           when t4.段落内容 is not null then t4.段落内容
           else to_clob('-')
       end as MED_NOTE,--病历内容 是；CLOB字段，不再截取2000字

       to_char(t1.doc_create_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') as CREATE_TIME,--创建时间 是；统一时间格式

       cast(
           substrb(
               nvl(
                   (
                       select max(sd.id_no)
                         from his.staff_dict sd
                        where to_char(sd.name) = to_char(t1.createby)
                          and regexp_like(trim(to_char(sd.id_no)), '^[0-9]{17}[0-9Xx]$|^[0-9]{15}$')
                   ),
                   ''
               ),
               1,
               18
           ) as varchar2(18)
       ) as CREATE_DOC_ID,--创建医生身份证号；能匹配则取HIS.STAFF_DICT.ID_NO

       cast(
           substrb(
               nvl(to_char(t1.createby), '-'),
               1,
               50
           ) as varchar2(50)
       ) as CREATE_DOC,--创建医生姓名 是

       to_char(
           nvl(t1.modifiedon, t1.doc_create_date),
           'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss'
       ) as LAST_TIME,--最后修改时间 是；统一时间格式

       cast(
           substrb(
               nvl(
                   (
                       select max(sd.id_no)
                         from his.staff_dict sd
                        where to_char(sd.name) = to_char(t1.modifiedby)
                          and regexp_like(trim(to_char(sd.id_no)), '^[0-9]{17}[0-9Xx]$|^[0-9]{15}$')
                   ),
                   ''
               ),
               1,
               18
           ) as varchar2(18)
       ) as LAST_DOC_ID,--最后修改医生身份证号；能匹配则取HIS.STAFF_DICT.ID_NO

       cast(
           substrb(
               nvl(to_char(t1.modifiedby), nvl(to_char(t1.createby), '-')),
               1,
               50
           ) as varchar2(50)
       ) as LAST_DOC,--最后修改医生姓名 是

     to_char(
    case
        when pv.docum_date is not null
         and pv.docum_date >= date '1900-01-01'
        then pv.docum_date

        when t1.doc_finish_date is not null
         and t1.doc_finish_date >= date '1900-01-01'
        then t1.doc_finish_date

        when t1.doc_sign_date is not null
         and t1.doc_sign_date >= date '1900-01-01'
        then t1.doc_sign_date

        when t1.modifiedon is not null
         and t1.modifiedon >= date '1900-01-01'
        then t1.modifiedon

        else t1.doc_create_date
    end,
    'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss'
) as ARCHIVE_TIME,--归档日期 是；过滤0001-01-01等无效日期

       cast('49557032X' as varchar2(32)) as ORG_CODE,--医院组织机构代码 是

       cast('山东省第二人民医院' as varchar2(70)) as ORG_NAME,--医院名称 是

       cast('370104' as varchar2(6)) as DISTRICT_CODE,--所属行政区划 是

       cast('ADDHIS' as varchar2(10)) as EXCHANGE_TYPE,--交换类型 是

       to_char(sysdate, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') as SYSTEM_TIME--数据上传时间戳 是；统一时间格式

  from mtl.epr_inpatient_docindex t

  inner join  mtl.epr_inpatient t1
          on t.uhid = t1.uhid

  left join (
        select uhid,
               段落编号,
               段落内容
          from (
                select ec.uhid,
                       ec.段落编号,
                       ec.段落内容,
                       row_number() over (
                           partition by ec.uhid, ec.段落编号
                           order by dbms_lob.getlength(ec.段落内容) desc nulls last,
                                    ec.rowid
                       ) as rn
                  from mtl.emrsd_content ec
               )
         where rn = 1
       ) t4
    on t4.uhid = t.uhid
   and t4.段落编号 = t1.id

  inner join his.pat_master_index pmi
          on pmi.inp_no = t.p_inpatient_no

  inner join his.pat_visit pv
          on pv.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
         and pv.visit_id = t.p_inpatient_times

 where t1.doc_type_name is not null

V_EMR_OPERATION_NURSING.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_OPERATION_NURSING" ("ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "ADMISSION_ID", "DEPT_CODE", "DEPT_NAME", "WARD_NAME", "EORD_NUM", "SICKBED_NUM", "OPERATION_ROOM_NUM", "NAME", "SEX_CODE", "SEX_NAME", "AGE", "AGE_MONTH", "WEIGHT", "ABO_CODE", "BLOOD_ABO_NAME", "RH_CODE", "BLOOD_RH_NAME", "DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "DISEASE", "OPERATION_CODE", "OPERATION_NAME", "OPERA_DOC_NAME", "OPERATION_BP_NAME", "OPERATION_END_DATE", "OPERATION_START_DATE", "ALLERGIES_CODE", "ALLERGIES", "SKIN_CHECK_NOTE", "NURSE_LEVEL_CODE", "NURSE_LEVEL_NAME", "NURSE_OBSERVE_NAME", "NURSE_OBSERVE_RESULT", "NURSE_PROJECT", "NURSE_PROJECT_NAME", "NURSE_PROJECT_RESULT", "IN_ROOM_DATE", "OUT_ROOM_DATE", "PREPARATION", "OPERATION_DISEASE_CD", "OPERATION_ITEM", "BEFORE_OPER_CD", "BEFORE_CHECK_CODE", "AFTER_CHECK_CODE", "HANDOVER_PROJECT", "ROUND_NURSE_NAME", "INS_NURSE_NAME", "HANDOVER_NURSE", "TRANS_DOC_NAME", "HANDOVER_DATE", "RECORD_DATE", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME") AS 
  select
       substrb(
           '49557032X'
           || '|' || a.patient_id
           || '|' || a.visit_id
           || '|' || a.oper_id,
           1,
           100
       ) as ID, -- 内码 是 使用组织机构编码+业务主键或流水号

       '49557032X' as ORG_CODE, -- 组织机构代码 是

       '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME, -- 组织机构名称 是

       substrb(a.patient_id || '|' || a.visit_id, 1, 50) as ADMISSION_ID, -- 住院唯一标示号 是

       nvl(
           substrb(
               (select max(d.qmpt_code)
                  from his.dept_dict d
                 where d.dept_code = p.dept_admission_to),
               1,
               20
           ),
           '-'
       ) as DEPT_CODE, -- 科室代码

       nvl(
           substrb(
               (select max(d.qmpt_name)
                  from his.dept_dict d
                 where d.dept_code = p.dept_admission_to),
               1,
               50
           ),
           '-'
       ) as DEPT_NAME, -- 科室名称 是

       nvl(
           substrb(
               (select max(d.dept_name)
                  from his.dept_dict d
                 where d.dept_code = p.discharge_ward_code),
               1,
               50
           ),
           '-'
       ) as WARD_NAME, -- 病区名称 是

       cast(null as varchar2(10)) as EORD_NUM, -- 病房号，暂未确认来源

       substrb(p.discharge_bed_no, 1, 10) as SICKBED_NUM, -- 病床号

substrb(a.operating_room, 1, 20) as OPERATION_ROOM_NUM, -- 手术间编号
       substrb(pmi.name, 1, 50) as NAME, -- 患者姓名 是

       decode(pmi.sex, '男', '1', '女', '2', '未知', '0', '9') as SEX_CODE, -- 性别代码 是

       decode(pmi.sex, '男', '男', '女', '女', '未知', '未知', '不明') as SEX_NAME, -- 性别名称 是

       case
           when pmi.date_of_birth is not null
            and p.admission_date_time is not null
           then greatest(trunc(months_between(p.admission_date_time, pmi.date_of_birth) / 12), 0)
           else null
       end as AGE, -- 年龄 是

       case
           when pmi.date_of_birth is not null
            and p.admission_date_time is not null
            and trunc(months_between(p.admission_date_time, pmi.date_of_birth) / 12) = 0
           then substrb(to_char(mod(trunc(months_between(p.admission_date_time, pmi.date_of_birth)), 12)), 1, 2)
           else null
       end as AGE_MONTH, -- 年龄（月）

       nvl(e3.weight, 0) as WEIGHT, -- 体重 kg 是

case
    when regexp_like(upper(nurse.xuexing), 'AB') then 4
    when regexp_like(upper(nurse.xuexing), 'A')  then 1
    when regexp_like(upper(nurse.xuexing), 'B')  then 2
    when regexp_like(upper(nurse.xuexing), 'O')  then 3
    else 5

from sm.med_operation_master a

left join sm.med_operation_schedule a1
  on a.patient_id = a1.patient_id
 and a.visit_id   = a1.visit_id
 and a.oper_id    = a1.oper_id

left join sm.med_anesthesia_plan e3
  on a.patient_id = e3.patient_id
 and a.visit_id   = e3.visit_id
 and a.oper_id    = e3.oper_id

left join (
    select *
      from (
            select o.*,
                   row_number() over (
                       partition by o.patient_id,
                                    o.visit_id,
                                    trunc(o.operating_date)
                       order by o.operation_scale desc nulls last,
                                case when to_char(o.op_primary) = '1' then 1 else 0 end desc,
                                o.operation_no asc nulls last
                   ) as rn
              from his.operation o
           )
     where rn = 1
) o
  on a.patient_id = o.patient_id
 and a.visit_id   = o.visit_id
 and to_char(o.operating_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd') =
     to_char(nvl(a.start_date_time, a.scheduled_date_time), 'yyyy-mm-dd')

left join his.pat_visit p
  on a.patient_id = p.patient_id
 and a.visit_id   = p.visit_id

left join his.pat_master_index pmi
  on a.patient_id = pmi.patient_id

left join (
    select d.patient_id,
           d.visit_id,
           d.diagnosis_code,
           d.diagnosis_desc,
           row_number() over (
               partition by d.patient_id, d.visit_id
               order by decode(d.diagnosis_type, '2', 1, '3', 2, 9),
                        d.diagnosis_no
           ) as rn
      from his.diagnosis d
     where d.diagnosis_type in ('2', '3')
) dd
  on dd.rn = 1
 and a.patient_id = dd.patient_id
 and a.visit_id   = dd.visit_id

           max(case when sh.item_name in ('护理记录.止血4', '护理记录1.止血4') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as zhixue4,
           max(case when sh.item_name in ('护理记录.止血5', '护理记录1.止血5') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as zhixue5,
           max(case when sh.item_name in ('护理记录.止血9', '护理记录1.止血9') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as zhixue9,

           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.标本1', '手术护理1.标本1') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as biaoben1,
           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.标本2', '手术护理1.标本2') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as biaoben2,
           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.标本3', '手术护理1.标本3') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as biaoben3,

           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.导尿管1', '手术护理1.导尿管1') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as daoniao1,
           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.导尿管2', '手术护理1.导尿管2') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as daoniao2,
           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.导尿管3', '手术护理1.导尿管3') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as daoniao3,
           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.导尿管4', '手术护理1.导尿管4') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as daoniao4,

           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.护理jianc1', '手术护理1.护理jianc1') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as jianc1,
           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.护理jianc2', '手术护理1.护理jianc2') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as jianc2,

           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.护理name1', '手术护理1.护理name1') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as hlname1,
           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.护理name2', '手术护理1.护理name2') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as hlname2,
           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.护理name7', '手术护理1.护理name7') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as hlname7,
           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.护理name8', '手术护理1.护理name8') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as hlname8,

           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.护理time1', '手术护理1.护理time1') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as hltime1,
           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.护理time2', '手术护理1.护理time2') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as hltime2,
           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.护理time7', '手术护理1.护理time7') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as hltime7,
           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.护理time8', '手术护理1.护理time8') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as hltime8,

           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.检验', '手术护理1.检验') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as jianyan1,
           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.检验2', '手术护理1.检验2') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as jianyan2,

           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.其他仪器1', '手术护理1.其他仪器1') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as qita_yiqi1,
           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.其他仪器2', '手术护理1.其他仪器2') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as qita_yiqi2,

           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.输液1', '手术护理1.输液1') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as shuye1,
           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.输液2', '手术护理1.输液2') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as shuye2,
           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.输液人1', '手术护理1.输液人1') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as shuye_ren1,
           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.输液人2', '手术护理1.输液人2') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as shuye_ren2,

           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.术中保2', '手术护理1.术中保2') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as baowen2,
           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.术中保温1', '手术护理1.术中保温1') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as baowen1,
           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.术中保温13', '手术护理1.术中保温13') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as baowen13,
           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.术中保温144', '手术护理1.术中保温144') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as baowen144,

           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.血型种类', '手术护理1.血型种类') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as xuexing,

           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.影像', '手术护理1.影像') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as yingxiang1,
           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.影像2', '手术护理1.影像2') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as yingxiang2,

           max(case when sh.item_name in ('手术护理.转归1', '手术护理1.转归1') then nullif(trim(sh.item_value), '/') end) as zhuan_gui

      from sm.med_custom_data sh
     where sh.item_name like '手术护理.%'
        or sh.item_name like '护理记录.%'
        or sh.item_name like '手术护理1.%'
        or sh.item_name like '护理记录1.%'
        or sh.item_name like '护理单病毒加减%'
        or sh.item_name like '护理单1病毒加减%'
     group by sh.patient_id, sh.visit_id, sh.oper_id
) nurse
  on nurse.patient_id = a.patient_id
 and nurse.visit_id   = a.visit_id
 and nurse.oper_id    = a.oper_id

where nvl(to_char(a.oper_status), '0') <> '0'
  and a1.patient_id is not null
  and nurse.patient_id is not null
  and p.discharge_date_time >= to_date('2021-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
  and p.discharge_date_time <  to_date('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
  and nvl(a.start_date_time, a.scheduled_date_time) is not null
  and nvl(a.end_date_time, nvl(a.done_date_time, a.anes_end_time)) is not null

V_EMR_OPERA_RECORD.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_OPERA_RECORD" ("ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "PATIENT_TYPE", "VISTING_NUM", "APPLY_NUM", "DEPT_NAME", "WARD_NAME", "EORD_NUM", "SICKBED_NUM", "OPERA_ROOM_NUM", "NAME", "SEX_CODE", "SEX_NAME", "AGE", "BEF_OPE_DIAG", "BEF_OPE_DIAG_NAME", "AFTER_OPE_DIAG", "AFTER_OPE_DIAG_NAME", "OPERA_START_DATE", "OPERA_END_DATE", "OPERA_CODE", "OPERA_NAME", "OPERA_GRADE", "OPERA_BP_CODE", "INTER_BODY", "OPERA_POSI", "OPERA_POSI_NAME", "OPERATION_NOTE", "OPERATION_HIS", "DISINF_NOTE", "INCISION_NOTE", "DRAINAGE_CODE", "OUT_BLOOD_ML", "BEFORE_DRUG", "IN_DRUG", "DRAINAGE_TYPE", "DRAINAGE_AMOUNT", "PLACE", "BT_REACTION_MARK", "SURGEON_NAME", "ASSISTANT_FIR_NAME", "ASSISTANT_SED_NAME", "INS_NURSE_NAME", "ROUND_NURSE_NAME", "ANAESTHESIA_CODE", "ANESTHESIA_DOC_NAME", "SIGNATURE_DATE", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "SURGEON_CERTIFICATE_NO", "ANESTHESIA", "INCISION_HEALING_LEVEL_CODE", "WOUNDHEAL_LEVEL_CODE", "ANES_CERTIFICATE_NO", "LOCAL_PROCEDURE_CODE", "LOCAL_PROCEDURE_NAME", "NHS_PROCEDURE_CODE", "NHS_PROCEDURE_NAME", "IS_MAIN_PROCEDURE", "OPERATE_TYPE") AS 
  select ID,
       ORG_CODE,
       ORG_NAME,
       PATIENT_TYPE,
       VISTING_NUM,
       APPLY_NUM,
       DEPT_NAME,
       WARD_NAME,
       EORD_NUM,
       SICKBED_NUM,
       OPERA_ROOM_NUM,
       NAME,
       SEX_CODE,
       SEX_NAME,
       AGE,
       BEF_OPE_DIAG,
       BEF_OPE_DIAG_NAME,
       AFTER_OPE_DIAG,
       AFTER_OPE_DIAG_NAME,
       OPERA_START_DATE,
       OPERA_END_DATE,
       OPERA_CODE,
       OPERA_NAME,
       OPERA_GRADE,
       OPERA_BP_CODE,
       INTER_BODY,
       OPERA_POSI,
       OPERA_POSI_NAME,
       OPERATION_NOTE,
       OPERATION_HIS,
       DISINF_NOTE,
       INCISION_NOTE,
       DRAINAGE_CODE,
       OUT_BLOOD_ML,
       BEFORE_DRUG,
       IN_DRUG,
       DRAINAGE_TYPE,
       DRAINAGE_AMOUNT,
       PLACE,
       BT_REACTION_MARK,
       SURGEON_NAME,
       ASSISTANT_FIR_NAME,
       ASSISTANT_SED_NAME,
       INS_NURSE_NAME,
       ROUND_NURSE_NAME,
       ANAESTHESIA_CODE,
       ANESTHESIA_DOC_NAME,
       SIGNATURE_DATE,
       DISTRICT_CODE,
       EXCHANGE_TYPE,
       SYSTEM_TIME,
       SURGEON_CERTIFICATE_NO,
       ANESTHESIA,
       INCISION_HEALING_LEVEL_CODE,
       WOUNDHEAL_LEVEL_CODE,
       ANES_CERTIFICATE_NO,
       LOCAL_PROCEDURE_CODE,
       LOCAL_PROCEDURE_NAME,
       NHS_PROCEDURE_CODE,
       NHS_PROCEDURE_NAME,
       IS_MAIN_PROCEDURE,
      to_char( OPERATE_TYPE)  OPERATE_TYPE
from (
    select q.*,
           row_number() over (
               partition by q.ID
               order by q.OPERA_START_DATE desc nulls last,
                        q.SIGNATURE_DATE desc nulls last
           ) as rn
    from (
        select substr(
                   '49557032X'||'|'||
                   nvl(to_char(pv.patient_id), '-')||'|'||
                   nvl(to_char(pv.visit_id), '-')||'|'||
                   nvl(to_char(o.operation_no), to_char(t1.id)),
                   1,
                   100
               ) as ID,--  内码  是 使用组织机构编码+业务主键或流水号

               '49557032X' as ORG_CODE,--  组织机构代码  是 医疗机构组织机构代码

               '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,--  组织机构名称  是 医疗机构组织机构名称

               '2' as PATIENT_TYPE,--  病人类型  是 1:门急诊 2：住院

               substr(
                   nvl(to_char(pv.patient_id), '-')||'|'||nvl(to_char(pv.visit_id), '-'),
                   1,
                   32
               ) as VISTING_NUM,-- 就诊唯一标识号 是 门诊或者住院唯一标识号

               substr(
                   nvl(mom.PATIENT_ID||mom.VISIT_ID||mom.OPER_ID, to_char(t1.id)),
                   1,
                   20
               ) as APPLY_NUM,-- 电子申请单编号 是 手术申请单编号

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       (select cast(ks.qmpt_name as varchar2(50))
                          from his.dept_dict ks
                         where ks.dept_code = t.p_dept_code
                           and rownum = 1),
                       nvl(
                           (select cast(ks.dept_name as varchar2(50))
                              from his.dept_dict ks
                             where ks.dept_code = t.p_dept_code
                               and rownum = 1),
                           '-'
                       )
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as DEPT_NAME,-- 科室名称  是 患者在医疗机构就诊的科室名称

               substr(cast(t.p_are_name as varchar2(50)), 1, 50) as WARD_NAME,-- 病区名称

               cast(null as varchar2(10)) as EORD_NUM,-- 病房号

               substr(cast(t.p_bedno as varchar2(10)), 1, 10) as SICKBED_NUM,-- 病床号

               substr(
                   nvl(nullif(trim(cast(mom.operating_room_no as varchar2(20))), ''), '-'),
                   1,
                   20
               ) as OPERA_ROOM_NUM,-- 手术间编号

               substr(
                   nvl(nullif(trim(cast(t.p_name as varchar2(50))), ''), nvl(cast(pmi.name as varchar2(50)), '-')),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as NAME,-- 患者姓名

               case
                   when cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(10)) = '男' then 1
                   when cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(10)) = '女' then 2
                   when cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(10)) = '未知' then 0
                   else 9
               end as SEX_CODE,-- 性别代码

               substr(
                   case
                       when cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(10)) = '男' then '男'
                       when cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(10)) = '女' then '女'
                       when cast(pmi.sex as varchar2(10)) = '未知' then '未知'
                       else '不明'
                   end,
                   1,
                   50
               ) as SEX_NAME,-- 性别名称

               case
                   when pmi.date_of_birth is not null
                    and pv.admission_date_time is not null
                   then least(
                            greatest(trunc(months_between(pv.admission_date_time, pmi.date_of_birth) / 12), 0),
                            200
                        )
                   else 0
               end as AGE,-- 年龄


                   nvl( nvl(   (select max(cd.国标编码)
            from cda.cda_dictionary cd
           where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
             and cd.系统标识 = 'SM'
             and cd.院标名称 = mom.DIAG_before_OPERATION)    ,
              (select max(cd.国标编码)
            from cda.cda_dictionary cd
           where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
             and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
             and cd.院标编码 = dd.diagnosis_code)
       ),         dd.diagnosis_code)      AS BEF_OPE_DIAG  ,-- 术前诊断编码


                   nvl( nvl(   (select max(cd.国标名称)
            from cda.cda_dictionary cd
           where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
             and cd.系统标识 = 'SM'
             and cd.院标名称 = mom.DIAG_before_OPERATION)    ,
              (select max(cd.国标名称)
            from cda.cda_dictionary cd
           where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
             and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
             and cd.院标编码 = dd.diagnosis_code)
       ),         dd.diagnosis_desc)     as BEF_OPE_DIAG_NAME,-- 术前诊断名称

               substr(cast(df.diagnosis_code as varchar2(12)), 1, 12) as AFTER_OPE_DIAG,-- 术后诊断编码

               substr(
                   nvl(cast(df.diagnosis_desc as varchar2(50)), '-'),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as AFTER_OPE_DIAG_NAME,-- 术后诊断名称

               cast(
                   coalesce(mom.start_date_time, o.operating_date, t1.doc_title_time)
                   as date
               ) as OPERA_START_DATE,-- 手术开始日期时间

               cast(
                   coalesce(mom.end_date_time, o.operating_end_date, mom.start_date_time, o.operating_date, t1.doc_title_time)
                   as date
               ) as OPERA_END_DATE,-- 手术结束日期时间

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       nvl(
                           nvl(     (select cast(cd.国标编码 as varchar2(12))
                              from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                             where cast(cd.字典名称 as varchar2(100)) = 'ICD-9手术编码'
                               and cast(cd.系统标识 as varchar2(20)) = 'SM'
                               and cast(cd.院标名称 as varchar2(200)) = cast(mom.operation_name as varchar2(200))
                               and rownum = 1)   ,
                               (select cast(cd.国标编码 as varchar2(12))
                                  from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                                 where cast(cd.字典名称 as varchar2(100)) = 'ICD-9手术编码'
                                   and cast(cd.系统标识 as varchar2(20)) = 'HIS'
                 and (cd.院标编码 =         regexp_replace(trim(cast(o.operation_code as varchar2(100))), '[A-Z][0-9]*$', '') or cd.院标编码 = o.operation_code )
                                   and rownum = 1)
                           ),


                               (select cast(cd.国标编码 as varchar2(12))
                                  from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                                 where cast(cd.字典名称 as varchar2(100)) = 'ICD-9手术编码'
                                   and cast(cd.系统标识 as varchar2(20)) = 'HIS'
                                   and cast(cd.院标名称 as varchar2(200)) = cast(o.operation_desc as varchar2(200))
                                   and rownum = 1)



                       ),
                       cast(o.operation_code as varchar2(12))
                   ),
                   1,
                   12
               ) as OPERA_CODE,-- 手术及操作编码

              nvl( substr(
                   nvl(
                       nvl(
                           nvl((select cast(cd.国标名称 as varchar2(80))
                              from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                             where cast(cd.字典名称 as varchar2(100)) = 'ICD-9手术编码'
                               and cast(cd.系统标识 as varchar2(20)) = 'SM'
                               and cast(cd.院标名称 as varchar2(200)) = cast(mom.operation_name as varchar2(200))
                               and rownum = 1)  ,
                               (select cast(cd.国标名称 as varchar2(80))
                                  from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                                 where cast(cd.字典名称 as varchar2(100)) = 'ICD-9手术编码'
                                   and cast(cd.系统标识 as varchar2(20)) = 'HIS'
                 and (cd.院标编码 =         regexp_replace(trim(cast(o.operation_code as varchar2(100))), '[A-Z][0-9]*$', '') or cd.院标编码 = o.operation_code )
                                   and rownum = 1)
                           ),

                               (select cast(cd.国标名称 as varchar2(80))
                                  from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                                 where cast(cd.字典名称 as varchar2(100)) = 'ICD-9手术编码'
                                   and cast(cd.系统标识 as varchar2(20)) = 'HIS'
                                   and cast(cd.院标名称 as varchar2(200)) = cast(o.operation_desc as varchar2(200))
                                   and rownum = 1)
                       ),
                       nvl(cast(o.operation_desc as varchar2(80)), nvl(cast(mom.operation_name as varchar2(80)), '-'))
                   ),
                   1,
                   80
               ), mom.OPERATION_NAME  ) as OPERA_NAME,-- 手术名称

               case
                   when cast(mom.operation_scale as varchar2(20)) in ('Ⅰ','小','一','1') then 1
                   when cast(mom.operation_scale as varchar2(20)) in ('Ⅱ','中','二','2') then 2
                   when cast(mom.operation_scale as varchar2(20)) in ('Ⅲ','大','三','3') then 3
                   when cast(mom.operation_scale as varchar2(20)) in ('Ⅳ','特','四','4') then 4
                   else 1
               end as OPERA_GRADE,-- 手术级别代码

               substr(cast(t3.ssmbbwmc as varchar2(50)), 1, 50) as OPERA_BP_CODE,-- 手术目标部位名称

               substr(cast(t3.jrwmc as varchar2(100)), 1, 100) as INTER_BODY,-- 介入物名称

               case
