                   when regexp_like(
                            nvl(cast(mom.operation_position as varchar2(100)),
                                cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1) as varchar2(2000))),
                            '仰卧|平卧'
                        ) then 1
                   when regexp_like(
                            nvl(cast(mom.operation_position as varchar2(100)),
                                cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1) as varchar2(2000))),
                            '俯卧'
                        ) then 2
                   when regexp_like(
                            nvl(cast(mom.operation_position as varchar2(100)),
                                cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1) as varchar2(2000))),
                            '左侧卧'
                        ) then 3
                   when regexp_like(
                            nvl(cast(mom.operation_position as varchar2(100)),
                                cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1) as varchar2(2000))),
                            '右侧卧|侧卧'
                        ) then 4
                   when regexp_like(
                            nvl(cast(mom.operation_position as varchar2(100)),
                                cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1) as varchar2(2000))),
                            '截石'
                        ) then 5
                   when regexp_like(
                            nvl(cast(mom.operation_position as varchar2(100)),
                                cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1) as varchar2(2000))),
                            '屈氏'
                        ) then 6
                   else 9
               end as OPERA_POSI,-- 手术体位代码

               substr(
                   case
                       when regexp_like(
                                nvl(cast(mom.operation_position as varchar2(100)),
                                    cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1) as varchar2(2000))),
                                '仰卧|平卧'
                            ) then '仰卧位'
                       when regexp_like(
                                nvl(cast(mom.operation_position as varchar2(100)),
                                    cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1) as varchar2(2000))),
                                '俯卧'
                            ) then '俯卧位'
                       when regexp_like(
                                nvl(cast(mom.operation_position as varchar2(100)),
                                    cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1) as varchar2(2000))),
                                '左侧卧'
                            ) then '左侧卧位'
                       when regexp_like(
                                nvl(cast(mom.operation_position as varchar2(100)),
                                    cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1) as varchar2(2000))),
                                '右侧卧|侧卧'
                            ) then '右侧卧位'
                       when regexp_like(
                                nvl(cast(mom.operation_position as varchar2(100)),
                                    cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1) as varchar2(2000))),
                                '截石'
                            ) then '截石位'
                       when regexp_like(
                                nvl(cast(mom.operation_position as varchar2(100)),
                                    cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1) as varchar2(2000))),
                                '屈氏'
                            ) then '屈氏位'
                       else '其他'
                   end,
                   1,
                   50
               ) as OPERA_POSI_NAME,-- 手术体位名称

         NVL(
    SUBSTRB(
        NVL(
            NULLIF(
                TRIM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN t3.ssgcms IS NOT NULL THEN
                             DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(TO_CLOB(t3.ssgcms), 2000, 1)
                        ELSE NULL
                    END
                ),
                ''
            ),
            NVL(
                NULLIF(
                    TRIM(
                        REGEXP_SUBSTR(
                            DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
                            '手术经过、术中发现的情况及处理[[:space:]]*[:：]?[[:space:]]*(.*)',
                            1,
                            1,
                            'n',
                            1
                        )
                    ),
                    ''
                ),
                '-'
            )
        ),
        1,
        2000
    ),
    '-'
) AS     OPERATION_NOTE,-- 手术过程描述

               case
                   when exists (
                       select 1
                         from his.operation oo
                        where oo.patient_id = pv.patient_id
                          and oo.operation_no <> o.operation_no
                          and oo.operating_date < coalesce(o.operating_date, mom.start_date_time, t1.doc_title_time)
                          and not regexp_like(
                                  nvl(cast(oo.operation_desc as varchar2(500)), '-'),
                                  '输血|红细胞|血浆|血细胞|气管内插管|呼吸机|血液透析|血液滤过|中心静脉|鼻十二指肠|动脉穿刺|肺泡灌洗'
                              )
                          and rownum = 1
                   ) then '1'
                   else '0'
               end as OPERATION_HIS,-- 手术史标志

               substr(cast(t3.pfxdms as varchar2(200)), 1, 200) as DISINF_NOTE,-- 皮肤消毒描述

               substr(cast(t3.ssqkms as varchar2(200)), 1, 200) as INCISION_NOTE,-- 手术切口描述

               case
                   when t3.ylclmc is not null then '1'
                   when dbms_lob.instr(t4.段落内容, '置引流', 1, 1) > 0 then '1'
                   when dbms_lob.instr(t4.段落内容, '引流管', 1, 1) > 0 then '1'
                   else '0'
               end as DRAINAGE_CODE,-- 引流标志

          CASE
    WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(t3.cxlml), 1, 20)), '^[0-9]{1,5}([.][0-9]+)?$')
    THEN LEAST(
             TRUNC(TO_NUMBER(TRIM(SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(t3.cxlml), 1, 20)))),
             99999
         )

    WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(
             DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
             '出血[^0-9]{0,10}[0-9]{1,5}'
         )
    THEN LEAST(
             TO_NUMBER(
                 REGEXP_SUBSTR(
                     DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1),
                     '出血[^0-9]{0,10}([0-9]{1,5})',
                     1,
                     1,
                     'n',
                     1
                 )
             ),
             99999
         )

    ELSE 0
END   as OUT_BLOOD_ML,-- 出血量

               substr(cast(t3.sqyy as varchar2(100)), 1, 100) as BEFORE_DRUG,-- 术前用药

               substr(cast(t3.szyy as varchar2(100)), 1, 100) as IN_DRUG,-- 术中用药

               substr(cast(t3.ylclmc as varchar2(200)), 1, 200) as DRAINAGE_TYPE,-- 引流材料名称

               substr(cast(t3.ylclsm as varchar2(200)), 1, 200) as DRAINAGE_AMOUNT,-- 引流材料数目

               substr(cast(t3.fzbw as varchar2(50)), 1, 50) as PLACE,-- 放置部位

               case
                   when cast(t3.sxfybz as varchar2(20)) in ('1','是','true','TRUE') then '1'
                   when cast(t3.sxfybz as varchar2(20)) in ('0','否','false','FALSE') then '0'
                   when dbms_lob.instr(t4.段落内容, '未输血', 1, 1) > 0 then '3'
                   when dbms_lob.instr(t4.段落内容, '输血', 1, 1) > 0 then '0'
                   when dbms_lob.instr(t4.段落内容, '红细胞', 1, 1) > 0 then '0'
                   when dbms_lob.instr(t4.段落内容, '血浆', 1, 1) > 0 then '0'
                   else '3'
               end as BT_REACTION_MARK,-- 输血反应标志

               nvl( nvl(  (select cast(sd.name as varchar2(50))
                                   from his.staff_dict sd
                                  where sd.emp_no = o.OPERATOR
                                    and rownum = 1), (select cast(sd.name as varchar2(50))
                                   from his.staff_dict sd
                                  where sd.emp_no = mom.SURGEON
                                    and rownum = 1 )),              '-')     as SURGEON_NAME,-- 手术者姓名

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       cast(mom.first_assistant as varchar2(50)),
                       regexp_replace(
                           regexp_substr(
                               cast(dbms_lob.substr(t4.段落内容, 2000, 1) as varchar2(2000)),
                               '一助[[:space:]]*[:：]?[[:space:]]*([^[:cntrl:]，,；;二]+)',
                               1,
                               1,
                               'n',
                               1
                           ),
                           '[[:punct:]]',
                           ''
                       )
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as ASSISTANT_FIR_NAME,-- Ⅰ助姓名

               substr(cast(mom.second_assistant as varchar2(50)), 1, 50) as ASSISTANT_SED_NAME,-- Ⅱ助姓名

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       case
                           when regexp_like(cast(t3.qxhsxm as varchar2(50)), '^[0-9]+$')
                           then (select cast(sd.name as varchar2(50))
                                   from his.staff_dict sd
                                  where sd.emp_no = t3.qxhsxm
                                    and rownum = 1)
                           else cast(t3.qxhsxm as varchar2(50))
                       end,
                       case
                           when regexp_like(cast(mom.first_supply_nurse as varchar2(50)), '^[0-9]+$')
                           then (select cast(sd.name as varchar2(50))
                                   from his.staff_dict sd
                                  where sd.emp_no = mom.first_supply_nurse
                                    and rownum = 1)
                           else cast(mom.first_supply_nurse as varchar2(50))
                       end
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as INS_NURSE_NAME,-- 器械护士姓名

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       case
                           when regexp_like(cast(t3.xthsxm as varchar2(50)), '^[0-9]+$')
                           then (select cast(sd.name as varchar2(50))
                                   from his.staff_dict sd
                                  where sd.emp_no = t3.xthsxm
                                    and rownum = 1)
                           else cast(t3.xthsxm as varchar2(50))
                       end,
                       case
                           when regexp_like(cast(mom.first_operation_nurse as varchar2(50)), '^[0-9]+$')
                           then (select cast(sd.name as varchar2(50))
                                   from his.staff_dict sd
                                  where sd.emp_no = mom.first_operation_nurse
                                    and rownum = 1)
                           else cast(mom.first_operation_nurse as varchar2(50))
                       end
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as ROUND_NURSE_NAME,-- 巡台护士姓名

               to_number(
                   nvl(
                       regexp_substr(
                           nvl(
                               nvl(
                                   (select cast(cd.国标编码 as varchar2(20))
                                      from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                                     where cast(cd.字典名称 as varchar2(100)) = '麻醉方法代码表'
                                       and cast(cd.系统标识 as varchar2(20)) = 'HIS'
                                       and cast(cd.院标名称 as varchar2(100)) = cast(o.anaesthesia_method as varchar2(100))
                                       and rownum = 1),
                                   (select cast(cd.国标编码 as varchar2(20))
                                      from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                                     where cast(cd.字典名称 as varchar2(100)) = '麻醉方法代码表'
                                       and cast(cd.系统标识 as varchar2(20)) = '手麻'
                                       and cast(cd.院标名称 as varchar2(100)) = cast(mom.anesthesia_method as varchar2(100))
                                       and rownum = 1)
                               ),
                               '9'
                           ),
                           '^[0-9]+'
                       ),
                       '9'
                   )
               ) as ANAESTHESIA_CODE,-- 麻醉方法代码

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       case
                           when regexp_like(cast(mom.anesthesia_doctor as varchar2(50)), '^[0-9]+$')
                           then (select cast(sd.name as varchar2(50))
                                   from his.staff_dict sd
                                  where sd.emp_no = mom.anesthesia_doctor
                                    and rownum = 1)
                           else cast(mom.anesthesia_doctor as varchar2(50))
                       end,
                       '-'
                   ),
                   1,
                   50
               ) as ANESTHESIA_DOC_NAME,-- 麻醉医师姓名

               cast(
                   nvl(t1.doc_title_time, coalesce(mom.end_date_time, o.operating_end_date, mom.start_date_time, o.operating_date))
                   as date
               ) as SIGNATURE_DATE,-- 签名日期时间

               '370104' as DISTRICT_CODE,-- 行政区划

               'ADDHIS' as EXCHANGE_TYPE,-- 交换类型

               cast(systimestamp as timestamp) as SYSTEM_TIME,-- 数据上传时间

         nvl( nvl(  (select yg.PRACTICE_CERT_CODE
              from DOC_REGISTER_EMP_MATCH yg
             where yg.emp_no = o.OPERATOR
               and rownum = 1), (select yg.PRACTICE_CERT_CODE
              from DOC_REGISTER_EMP_MATCH yg
             where yg.emp_no = mom.SURGEON
               and rownum = 1)),              '-')   as SURGEON_CERTIFICATE_NO,-- 术者执业证书编号

               case
                   when o.anaesthesia_method is not null
                     or mom.anesthesia_method is not null
                     or mom.anesthesia_doctor is not null
                     or dbms_lob.instr(t4.段落内容, '麻醉方法', 1, 1) > 0
                   then '1'
                   else '0'
               end as ANESTHESIA,-- 是否进行麻醉
substr(
    case
        when regexp_replace(upper(trim(cast(o.heal as varchar2(100)))), '[[:space:]]+', '')
             in ('0','0类','0类切口','零','零类','零类切口')
        then '1'

        when regexp_replace(upper(trim(cast(o.heal as varchar2(100)))), '[[:space:]]+', '')
             in ('I','Ⅰ','1','一','一类','I类','Ⅰ类','I类切口','Ⅰ类切口','一类切口','甲')
        then '2'

        when regexp_replace(upper(trim(cast(o.heal as varchar2(100)))), '[[:space:]]+', '')
             in ('II','Ⅱ','2','二','二类','II类','Ⅱ类','II类切口','Ⅱ类切口','二类切口','乙')
        then '3'

        when regexp_replace(upper(trim(cast(o.heal as varchar2(100)))), '[[:space:]]+', '')
             in ('III','Ⅲ','3','三','三类','III类','Ⅲ类','III类切口','Ⅲ类切口','三类切口','丙','4')
        then '4'

        else cast(null as varchar2(100))
    end,
    1,
    100
)  as INCISION_HEALING_LEVEL_CODE,-- 切口类别代码，暂无确定来源

               substr(
    case
        when regexp_replace(upper(trim(cast(o.wound_grade as varchar2(100)))), '[[:space:]]+', '')
             in ('甲','1')
        then '1'

        when regexp_replace(upper(trim(cast(o.wound_grade as varchar2(100)))), '[[:space:]]+', '')
             in ('乙','2')
        then '2'

        when regexp_replace(upper(trim(cast(o.wound_grade as varchar2(100)))), '[[:space:]]+', '')
             in ('丙','3')
        then '3'

        when regexp_replace(upper(trim(cast(o.wound_grade as varchar2(100)))), '[[:space:]]+', '')
             in ('其他','其','4','未知','不详','不确定','-')
        then '4'

        else cast(null as varchar2(100))
    end,
    1,
    100
)   as WOUNDHEAL_LEVEL_CODE,-- 切口愈合等级代码，暂无确定来源

                 nvl(  (select yg.PRACTICE_CERT_CODE
              from DOC_REGISTER_EMP_MATCH yg
             where yg.emp_no = o.ANESTHESIA_DOCTOR
               and rownum = 1)  ,  (select yg.PRACTICE_CERT_CODE
              from DOC_REGISTER_EMP_MATCH yg
             where yg.emp_no = mom.ANESTHESIA_DOCTOR
               and rownum = 1)  )    as ANES_CERTIFICATE_NO,-- 麻醉医师执业证书编号


               substr(
                   nvl(
                       cast(o.operation_code as varchar2(100)),
                       nvl(
                           (select cast(cd.国标编码 as varchar2(100))
                              from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                             where cast(cd.字典名称 as varchar2(100)) = 'ICD-9手术编码'
                               and cast(cd.系统标识 as varchar2(20)) = 'SM'
                               and cast(cd.院标名称 as varchar2(200)) = cast(mom.operation_name as varchar2(200))
                               and rownum = 1),
                           '99.9900'
                       )
                   ),
                   1,
                   100
               ) as LOCAL_PROCEDURE_CODE,-- 机构内部手术及操作编码

               substr(
                   nvl(cast(o.operation_desc as varchar2(500)), nvl(cast(mom.operation_name as varchar2(500)), '其他各类操作')),
                   1,
                   500
               ) as LOCAL_PROCEDURE_NAME,-- 机构内部手术及操作名称

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       nvl(
                           nvl(
                               (select cast(cd.国标编码 as varchar2(100))
                                  from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                                 where cast(cd.字典名称 as varchar2(100)) = 'ICD-9手术编码'
                                   and cast(cd.系统标识 as varchar2(20)) = 'HIS'
                                   and cast(cd.院标名称 as varchar2(200)) = cast(o.operation_desc as varchar2(200))
                                   and rownum = 1),
                               (select cast(cd.国标编码 as varchar2(100))
                                  from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                                 where cast(cd.字典名称 as varchar2(100)) = 'ICD-9手术编码'
                                   and cast(cd.系统标识 as varchar2(20)) = 'HIS'
                                   and cast(cd.院标编码 as varchar2(100)) = cast(o.operation_code as varchar2(100))
                                   and rownum = 1)
                           ),
                           (select cast(cd.国标编码 as varchar2(100))
                              from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                             where cast(cd.字典名称 as varchar2(100)) = 'ICD-9手术编码'
                               and cast(cd.系统标识 as varchar2(20)) = 'SM'
                               and cast(cd.院标名称 as varchar2(200)) = cast(mom.operation_name as varchar2(200))
                               and rownum = 1)
                       ),
                       '99.9900'
                   ),
                   1,
                   100
               ) as NHS_PROCEDURE_CODE,-- 国家医保手术及操作编码

               substr(
                   nvl(
                       nvl(
                           nvl(
                               (select cast(cd.国标名称 as varchar2(500))
                                  from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                                 where cast(cd.字典名称 as varchar2(100)) = 'ICD-9手术编码'
                                   and cast(cd.系统标识 as varchar2(20)) = 'HIS'
                                   and cast(cd.院标名称 as varchar2(200)) = cast(o.operation_desc as varchar2(200))
                                   and rownum = 1),
                               (select cast(cd.国标名称 as varchar2(500))
                                  from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                                 where cast(cd.字典名称 as varchar2(100)) = 'ICD-9手术编码'
                                   and cast(cd.系统标识 as varchar2(20)) = 'HIS'
                                   and cast(cd.院标编码 as varchar2(100)) = cast(o.operation_code as varchar2(100))
                                   and rownum = 1)
                           ),
                           (select cast(cd.国标名称 as varchar2(500))
                              from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                             where cast(cd.字典名称 as varchar2(100)) = 'ICD-9手术编码'
                               and cast(cd.系统标识 as varchar2(20)) = 'SM'
                               and cast(cd.院标名称 as varchar2(200)) = cast(mom.operation_name as varchar2(200))
                               and rownum = 1)
                       ),
                       '其他各类操作'
                   ),
                   1,
                   500
               ) as NHS_PROCEDURE_NAME,-- 国家医保手术及操作名称

               case
                   when o.op_primary = '1' then '1'
                   when to_char(o.operation_no) = '1' then '1'
                   else '0'
               end as IS_MAIN_PROCEDURE,-- 是否主要手术或操作

         CAST(     case when  mom.EMERGENCY_INDICATOR = 0 then 1 when mom.EMERGENCY_INDICATOR =1 then 2 else 9 end   AS
  VARCHAR2(1))   as OPERATE_TYPE -- 手术类型

        from mtl.epr_inpatient_docindex t

        inner join mtl.epr_inpatient t1
                on t.uhid = t1.uhid
               and t1.doc_type_name like '%手术记录%'

        left join mtl.emrsd9 t3
               on t3.段落编号 = t1.id

        left join his.pat_master_index pmi
               on pmi.inp_no = t.p_inpatient_no

        inner join his.pat_visit pv
                on pv.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
               and pv.visit_id = t.p_inpatient_times


        left join sm.med_operation_master mom
               on mom.patient_id = pv.patient_id
              and mom.visit_id = pv.visit_id

        left join (select * from (
select o.*,
       row_number() over (
           partition by
               o.patient_id,
               o.visit_id,
               trunc(o.operating_date)
           order by
               o.operation_scale desc nulls last,
               case
                   when to_char(o.op_primary) = '1' then 1
                   else 0
               end desc,
               o.operation_no asc nulls last
       ) as rn
from his.operation o  )  where rn=1)  o
               on pv.patient_id = o.patient_id
              and pv.visit_id = o.visit_id
            and to_char(o.operating_date,'yyyy-mm-dd')=to_char( nvl(mom.start_date_time,mom.SCHEDULED_DATE_TIME),'yyyy-mm-dd')
        left join sm.med_diagnosis_dict c
               on mom.diag_before_operation = c.diagnosis_name

        left join (
            select patient_id,
                   visit_id,
                   diagnosis_code,
                   diagnosis_desc,
                   row_number() over (
                       partition by patient_id, visit_id
                       order by diagnosis_date desc nulls last,
                                diagnosis_no
                   ) as rn
              from his.diagnosis where diagnosis_type='3'
        ) dd
               on dd.rn = 1
              and dd.patient_id = pv.patient_id
              and dd.visit_id = pv.visit_id
   left join (
            select patient_id,
                   visit_id,
                   diagnosis_code,
                   diagnosis_desc,
                   row_number() over (
                       partition by patient_id, visit_id
                       order by diagnosis_date desc nulls last,
                                diagnosis_no
                   ) as rn
              from his.diagnosis
        ) df
               on df.rn = 1
              and df.patient_id = pv.patient_id
              and df.visit_id = pv.visit_id
        left join mtl.emrsd_content t4
               on t4.uhid = t.uhid
              and t4.段落编号 = t1.id

        where pv.discharge_date_time >= to_date('2021-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
          and pv.discharge_date_time <  to_date('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
    ) q
)
where rn = 1 and    BEF_OPE_DIAG_NAME is not null

V_EMR_OUTPATIENT_DIAG.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_OUTPATIENT_DIAG" ("ID", "OUTPATIENT_NUM", "TCM_WM_MARK_CODE", "TCM_WM_MARK_NAME", "IF_MAIN", "ADMIN_ILLNESS_CODE", "ADMIN_ILLNESS_NAME", "INFECTIOUS_SIGNS", "CONTAGIOUS_REPORT_SIGN", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "CHINA_MED_SYNDROME_CODE", "CHINA_MED_SYNDROME_NAME", "DOCTOR_ID_NUM", "DOCTOR_NAME", "DIAG_DATE", "DISTRICT_CODE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "NAME", "SEX_CODE", "ID_NUM", "DIAGNOSIS_NO", "LOCAL_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "LOCAL_DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "NHS_DX_CODE", "NHS_DX_NAME") AS 
  SELECT SUBSTR(
           '49557032X'
           || '|' || NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(z.clinic_no), ''), '-')
           || '|NEW|'
           || NVL(TO_CHAR(z.item_no), '0')
           || '|' || NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(z.diag_code), ''), '-'),
           1,
           100
       ) AS ID, -- 内码，主键

       SUBSTR(
           NVL(
               NULLIF(TRIM(z.clinic_no), ''),
               z.patient_id || TO_CHAR(z.visit_date, 'yyyymmdd')
           ),
           1,
           32
       ) AS OUTPATIENT_NUM, -- 本次门诊标识符

       CASE
           WHEN z.diag_type IS NULL THEN '2'
           ELSE '1'
       END AS TCM_WM_MARK_CODE, -- 中医/西医诊断类型：1中医，2西医

       CASE
           WHEN z.diag_type IS NULL THEN '西医'
           ELSE '中医'
       END AS TCM_WM_MARK_NAME, -- 中医/西医诊断类型名称

       CASE
           WHEN z.item_no = 1 THEN '1'
           ELSE '0'
       END AS IF_MAIN, -- 是否主要诊断标识

       SUBSTR(
           NVL(
               NULLIF(TRIM(z.icd_or_code), ''),
               NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(z.diag_code), ''), '-')
           ),
           1,
           12
       ) AS ADMIN_ILLNESS_CODE, -- 诊断疾病代码

       SUBSTR(
           NVL(
               NULLIF(TRIM(z.icd_or_name), ''),
               NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(z.diag_desc), ''), '-')
           ),
           1,
           100
       ) AS ADMIN_ILLNESS_NAME, -- 诊断疾病名称

       z.infect_flag AS INFECTIOUS_SIGNS, -- 传染标识

       z.infect_flag AS CONTAGIOUS_REPORT_SIGN, -- 传染上报标识

       '49557032X' AS ORG_CODE, -- 医院组织机构编码

       '山东省第二人民医院' AS ORG_NAME, -- 医院名称

       '-' AS CHINA_MED_SYNDROME_CODE, -- 中医证候代码；暂无真实来源

       '-' AS CHINA_MED_SYNDROME_NAME, -- 中医证候名称；暂无真实来源

       SUBSTR(NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(z.doctor_id_no), ''), '000000000000000000'), 1, 18) AS DOCTOR_ID_NUM, -- 诊断医师身份证号

       SUBSTR(NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(z.doctor_name), ''), NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(z.doctor), ''), '-')), 1, 50) AS DOCTOR_NAME, -- 诊断医师姓名

       CAST(z.visit_date AS DATE) AS DIAG_DATE, -- 诊断日期

       '370104' AS DISTRICT_CODE, -- 所属行政区划

       CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS SYSTEM_TIME, -- 数据上传时间戳

       'ADDHIS' AS EXCHANGE_TYPE, -- 交换类型

       SUBSTR(NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(z.patient_name), ''), '-'), 1, 50) AS NAME, -- 患者姓名

       CASE TRIM(z.sex)
           WHEN '男' THEN '1'
           WHEN '女' THEN '2'
           WHEN '未知' THEN '0'
           WHEN '不详' THEN '9'
           WHEN '未说明' THEN '9'
           ELSE '9'
       END AS SEX_CODE, -- 患者性别代码

       SUBSTR(NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(z.patient_id_no), ''), '000000000000000000'), 1, 18) AS ID_NUM, -- 患者身份证件号码

       SUBSTR(NVL(TO_CHAR(z.item_no), '1'), 1, 20) AS DIAGNOSIS_NO, -- 诊断序号

       SUBSTR(
           NVL(
               NULLIF(TRIM(z.diag_code), ''),
               NVL(
                   NULLIF(TRIM(z.insur_diag_code), ''),
                   NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(z.icd_or_code), ''), '-')
               )
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) AS LOCAL_DIAGNOSIS_CODE, -- 院内诊断编码，源为空时用医保诊断/标准诊断兜底

       SUBSTR(
           NVL(
               NULLIF(TRIM(z.diag_desc), ''),
               NVL(
                   NULLIF(TRIM(z.insur_diag_desc), ''),
                   NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(z.icd_or_name), ''), '-')
               )
           ),
           1,
           200
       ) AS LOCAL_DIAGNOSIS_NAME, -- 院内诊断名称，源为空时用医保诊断/标准诊断兜底

       SUBSTR(NULLIF(TRIM(z.insur_diag_code), ''), 1, 50) AS NHS_DX_CODE, -- 医保报销诊断编码

       SUBSTR(NULLIF(TRIM(z.insur_diag_desc), ''), 1, 200) AS NHS_DX_NAME -- 医保报销诊断名称

  FROM (
        SELECT y.*,
               CASE
                   WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(
                            UPPER(NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(y.icd_or_code), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(y.diag_code), ''))),
                            '^(A00|A01|A02|A03|A04|A05|A06|A09|A15|A16|A17|A18|A19|A20|A22|A27|A30|A33|A35|A36|A37|A38|A39|A50|A51|A52|A53|A54|A56|A64|A80|A82|A83|A90|A91|A92|A95|A98|B01|B05|B06|B15|B16|B17|B18|B19|B20|B21|B22|B23|B24|B26|B50|B51|B52|B53|B54|U07)'
                        )
                     OR REGEXP_LIKE(
                            NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(y.icd_or_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(y.diag_desc), '')),
                            '霍乱|鼠疫|炭疽|艾滋|HIV|病毒性肝炎|甲肝|乙肝|丙肝|戊肝|肺结核|结核|麻疹|风疹|水痘|流行性腮腺炎'
                        )
                     OR REGEXP_LIKE(
                            NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(y.icd_or_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(y.diag_desc), '')),
                            '流行性感冒|流感|新型冠状|新冠|COVID|手足口|猩红热|百日咳|白喉|脊髓灰质炎|流脑|乙脑'
                        )
                     OR REGEXP_LIKE(
                            NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(y.icd_or_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(y.diag_desc), '')),
                            '伤寒|副伤寒|细菌性痢疾|阿米巴痢疾|感染性腹泻|痢疾|布鲁菌|布病|钩端螺旋体|血吸虫|疟疾|登革热'
                        )
                     OR REGEXP_LIKE(
                            NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(y.icd_or_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(y.diag_desc), '')),
                            '梅毒|淋病|尖锐湿疣|生殖器疱疹|狂犬病|破伤风|人感染高致病性禽流感|禽流感'
                        )
                   THEN 1
                   ELSE 0
               END AS infect_flag
          FROM (
                SELECT q.*,

                       NVL(
                           NULLIF(TRIM(icd_code.std_diag_code), ''),
                           NVL(
                               NULLIF(TRIM(icd_local.std_diag_code), ''),
                               NULLIF(TRIM(icd_std.std_diag_code), '')
                           )
                       ) AS icd_or_code,

                       NVL(
                           NULLIF(TRIM(icd_code.std_diag_name), ''),
                           NVL(
                               NULLIF(TRIM(icd_local.std_diag_name), ''),
                               NULLIF(TRIM(icd_std.std_diag_name), '')
                           )
                       ) AS icd_or_name

                  FROM (
                        SELECT a.visit_date,
                               a.visit_no,
                               TO_CHAR(a.patient_id) AS patient_id,
                               a.item_no,
                               TO_CHAR(a.diag_code) AS diag_code,
                               TO_CHAR(a.diag_desc) AS diag_desc,
                               TO_CHAR(a.diag_type) AS diag_type,
                               TO_CHAR(a.doctor) AS doctor,
                               TO_CHAR(a.insur_diag_code) AS insur_diag_code,
                               TO_CHAR(a.insur_diag_desc) AS insur_diag_desc,
                               TO_CHAR(b.clinic_no) AS clinic_no,
                               TO_CHAR(c.id_no) AS doctor_id_no,
                               TO_CHAR(c.name) AS doctor_name,
                               TO_CHAR(pmi.name) AS patient_name,
                               TO_CHAR(pmi.sex) AS sex,
                               TO_CHAR(pmi.id_no) AS patient_id_no
                          FROM HIS.outp_mr_diag_desc a
                          JOIN HIS.clinic_master b
                            ON a.visit_date = b.visit_date
                           AND a.visit_no = b.visit_no
                           AND a.patient_id = b.patient_id
                          LEFT JOIN HIS.staff_dict c
                            ON TO_CHAR(a.doctor) = TO_CHAR(c.emp_no)
                          JOIN HIS.pat_master_index pmi
                            ON a.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
                         WHERE a.visit_date >= DATE '2021-01-01'
                           AND a.visit_date <  DATE '2025-01-01'
                       ) q

                  LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT TO_CHAR(cd.院标编码) AS match_value,
                               MAX(TO_CHAR(cd.国标编码)) AS std_diag_code,
                               MAX(TO_CHAR(cd.国标名称)) AS std_diag_name
                          FROM CDA.cda_dictionary cd
                         WHERE TO_CHAR(cd.字典名称) = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                           AND TO_CHAR(cd.系统标识) = 'HIS'
                           AND cd.院标编码 IS NOT NULL
                         GROUP BY TO_CHAR(cd.院标编码)
                       ) icd_code
                    ON icd_code.match_value = q.diag_code

                  LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT TO_CHAR(cd.院标名称) AS match_value,
                               MAX(TO_CHAR(cd.国标编码)) AS std_diag_code,
                               MAX(TO_CHAR(cd.国标名称)) AS std_diag_name
                          FROM CDA.cda_dictionary cd
                         WHERE TO_CHAR(cd.字典名称) = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                           AND TO_CHAR(cd.系统标识) = 'HIS'
                           AND cd.院标名称 IS NOT NULL
                         GROUP BY TO_CHAR(cd.院标名称)
                       ) icd_local
                    ON icd_local.match_value = q.diag_desc

                  LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT TO_CHAR(cd.国标名称) AS match_value,
                               MAX(TO_CHAR(cd.国标编码)) AS std_diag_code,
                               MAX(TO_CHAR(cd.国标名称)) AS std_diag_name
                          FROM CDA.cda_dictionary cd
                         WHERE TO_CHAR(cd.字典名称) = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                           AND TO_CHAR(cd.系统标识) = 'HIS'
                           AND cd.国标名称 IS NOT NULL
                         GROUP BY TO_CHAR(cd.国标名称)
                       ) icd_std
                    ON icd_std.match_value = q.diag_desc
               ) y
       ) z

UNION ALL

/* =========================================================
   OLD 分支：HIS.OUTP_MR
   处理原则：
   1. 所有字符字段统一 TO_CHAR，避免 ORA-12704
   2. 本地诊断编码：diag_desc_code -> admin_code_by_name -> '-'
   3. 本地诊断名称：diag_desc -> admin_name_by_name -> '-'
   ========================================================= */
SELECT SUBSTR(
           '49557032X'
           || '|' || NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(z.clinic_no), ''), '-')
           || '|OLD|'
           || NVL(TO_CHAR(z.ordinal), '1')
           || '|' || NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(z.diag_desc_code), ''), '-'),
           1,
           100
       ) AS ID, -- 内码，主键

       SUBSTR(
           NVL(
               NULLIF(TRIM(z.clinic_no), ''),
               z.patient_id || TO_CHAR(z.visit_date, 'yyyymmdd')
           ),
           1,
           32
       ) AS OUTPATIENT_NUM, -- 本次门诊标识符

       CASE
           WHEN z.diag_desc IS NOT NULL THEN '2'
           ELSE '1'
       END AS TCM_WM_MARK_CODE, -- 中医/西医诊断类型

       CASE
           WHEN z.diag_desc IS NOT NULL THEN '西医'
           ELSE '中医'
       END AS TCM_WM_MARK_NAME, -- 中医/西医诊断类型名称

       CASE
           WHEN NVL(z.ordinal, 1) = 1 THEN '1'
           ELSE '0'
       END AS IF_MAIN, -- 是否主要诊断标识

       SUBSTR(
           NVL(
               NULLIF(TRIM(z.admin_code_by_name), ''),
               NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(z.diag_desc_code), ''), '-')
           ),
           1,
           12
       ) AS ADMIN_ILLNESS_CODE, -- 诊断疾病代码

       SUBSTR(
           NVL(
               NULLIF(TRIM(z.admin_name_by_name), ''),
               NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(z.diag_desc), ''), '-')
           ),
           1,
           100
       ) AS ADMIN_ILLNESS_NAME, -- 诊断疾病名称

       z.infect_flag AS INFECTIOUS_SIGNS, -- 传染标识

       z.infect_flag AS CONTAGIOUS_REPORT_SIGN, -- 传染上报标识

       '49557032X' AS ORG_CODE, -- 医院组织机构编码

       '山东省第二人民医院' AS ORG_NAME, -- 医院名称

       '-' AS CHINA_MED_SYNDROME_CODE, -- 中医证候代码；暂无真实来源

       '-' AS CHINA_MED_SYNDROME_NAME, -- 中医证候名称；暂无真实来源

       SUBSTR(NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(z.doctor_id_no), ''), '000000000000000000'), 1, 18) AS DOCTOR_ID_NUM, -- 诊断医师身份证号

       SUBSTR(NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(z.doctor_name), ''), NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(z.doctor), ''), '-')), 1, 50) AS DOCTOR_NAME, -- 诊断医师姓名

       CAST(NVL(z.illness_date, z.visit_date) AS DATE) AS DIAG_DATE, -- 诊断日期

       '370104' AS DISTRICT_CODE, -- 所属行政区划

       CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS SYSTEM_TIME, -- 数据上传时间戳

       'ADDHIS' AS EXCHANGE_TYPE, -- 交换类型

       SUBSTR(NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(z.patient_name), ''), '-'), 1, 50) AS NAME, -- 患者姓名

       CASE TRIM(z.sex)
           WHEN '男' THEN '1'
           WHEN '女' THEN '2'
           WHEN '未知' THEN '0'
           WHEN '不详' THEN '9'
           WHEN '未说明' THEN '9'
           ELSE '9'
       END AS SEX_CODE, -- 患者性别代码

       SUBSTR(NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(z.patient_id_no), ''), '000000000000000000'), 1, 18) AS ID_NUM, -- 患者身份证件号码

       SUBSTR(NVL(TO_CHAR(z.ordinal), '1'), 1, 20) AS DIAGNOSIS_NO, -- 诊断序号

       SUBSTR(
           NVL(
               NULLIF(TRIM(z.diag_desc_code), ''),
               NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(z.admin_code_by_name), ''), '-')
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) AS LOCAL_DIAGNOSIS_CODE, -- 院内诊断编码，源为空时用诊断名称对照编码兜底

       SUBSTR(
           NVL(
               NULLIF(TRIM(z.diag_desc), ''),
               NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(z.admin_name_by_name), ''), '-')
           ),
           1,
           200
       ) AS LOCAL_DIAGNOSIS_NAME, -- 院内诊断名称，源为空时用诊断名称对照名称兜底

       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS NHS_DX_CODE, -- 医保报销诊断编码，旧表暂无来源

       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(200)) AS NHS_DX_NAME -- 医保报销诊断名称，旧表暂无来源

  FROM (
        SELECT y.*,
               CASE
                   WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(
                            UPPER(NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(y.infect_code_or), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(y.diag_desc_code), ''))),
                            '^(A00|A01|A02|A03|A04|A05|A06|A09|A15|A16|A17|A18|A19|A20|A22|A27|A30|A33|A35|A36|A37|A38|A39|A50|A51|A52|A53|A54|A56|A64|A80|A82|A83|A90|A91|A92|A95|A98|B01|B05|B06|B15|B16|B17|B18|B19|B20|B21|B22|B23|B24|B26|B50|B51|B52|B53|B54|U07)'
                        )
                     OR REGEXP_LIKE(
                            NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(y.infect_name_or), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(y.diag_desc), '')),
                            '霍乱|鼠疫|炭疽|艾滋|HIV|病毒性肝炎|甲肝|乙肝|丙肝|戊肝|肺结核|结核|麻疹|风疹|水痘|流行性腮腺炎'
                        )
                     OR REGEXP_LIKE(
                            NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(y.infect_name_or), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(y.diag_desc), '')),
                            '流行性感冒|流感|新型冠状|新冠|COVID|手足口|猩红热|百日咳|白喉|脊髓灰质炎|流脑|乙脑'
                        )
                     OR REGEXP_LIKE(
                            NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(y.infect_name_or), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(y.diag_desc), '')),
                            '伤寒|副伤寒|细菌性痢疾|阿米巴痢疾|感染性腹泻|痢疾|布鲁菌|布病|钩端螺旋体|血吸虫|疟疾|登革热'
                        )
                     OR REGEXP_LIKE(
                            NVL(NULLIF(TRIM(y.infect_name_or), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(y.diag_desc), '')),
                            '梅毒|淋病|尖锐湿疣|生殖器疱疹|狂犬病|破伤风|人感染高致病性禽流感|禽流感'
                        )
                   THEN 1
                   ELSE 0
               END AS infect_flag
          FROM (
                SELECT q.*,

                       icd_local.std_diag_code AS admin_code_by_name,
                       icd_local.std_diag_name AS admin_name_by_name,

                       NVL(
                           NULLIF(TRIM(icd_code.std_diag_code), ''),
                           NVL(
                               NULLIF(TRIM(icd_local.std_diag_code), ''),
                               NULLIF(TRIM(icd_std.std_diag_code), '')
                           )
                       ) AS infect_code_or,

                       NVL(
                           NULLIF(TRIM(icd_code.std_diag_name), ''),
                           NVL(
                               NULLIF(TRIM(icd_local.std_diag_name), ''),
                               NULLIF(TRIM(icd_std.std_diag_name), '')
                           )
                       ) AS infect_name_or

                  FROM (
                        SELECT a.visit_date,
                               a.visit_no,
                               TO_CHAR(a.patient_id) AS patient_id,
                               a.ordinal,
                               TO_CHAR(a.diag_desc_code) AS diag_desc_code,
                               TO_CHAR(a.diag_desc) AS diag_desc,
                               TO_CHAR(a.doctor) AS doctor,
                               TO_CHAR(a.doctor_no) AS doctor_no,
                               a.illness_date,
                               TO_CHAR(b.clinic_no) AS clinic_no,
                               TO_CHAR(c.id_no) AS doctor_id_no,
                               TO_CHAR(c.name) AS doctor_name,
                               TO_CHAR(pmi.name) AS patient_name,
                               TO_CHAR(pmi.sex) AS sex,
                               TO_CHAR(pmi.id_no) AS patient_id_no
                          FROM HIS.outp_mr a
                          JOIN HIS.clinic_master b
                            ON a.visit_date = b.visit_date
                           AND a.visit_no = b.visit_no
                           AND a.patient_id = b.patient_id
                          LEFT JOIN HIS.staff_dict c
                            ON TO_CHAR(a.doctor_no) = TO_CHAR(c.emp_no)
                          JOIN HIS.pat_master_index pmi
                            ON a.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
                         WHERE a.visit_date >= DATE '2021-01-01'
                           AND a.visit_date <  DATE '2025-01-01'
                       ) q

                  LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT TO_CHAR(cd.院标名称) AS match_value,
                               MAX(TO_CHAR(cd.国标编码)) AS std_diag_code,
                               MAX(TO_CHAR(cd.国标名称)) AS std_diag_name
                          FROM CDA.cda_dictionary cd
                         WHERE TO_CHAR(cd.字典名称) = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                           AND TO_CHAR(cd.系统标识) = 'HIS'
                           AND cd.院标名称 IS NOT NULL
                         GROUP BY TO_CHAR(cd.院标名称)
                       ) icd_local
                    ON icd_local.match_value = q.diag_desc

                  LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT TO_CHAR(cd.院标编码) AS match_value,
                               MAX(TO_CHAR(cd.国标编码)) AS std_diag_code,
                               MAX(TO_CHAR(cd.国标名称)) AS std_diag_name
                          FROM CDA.cda_dictionary cd
                         WHERE TO_CHAR(cd.字典名称) = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                           AND TO_CHAR(cd.系统标识) = 'HIS'
                           AND cd.院标编码 IS NOT NULL
                         GROUP BY TO_CHAR(cd.院标编码)
                       ) icd_code
                    ON icd_code.match_value = q.diag_desc_code

                  LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT TO_CHAR(cd.国标名称) AS match_value,
                               MAX(TO_CHAR(cd.国标编码)) AS std_diag_code,
                               MAX(TO_CHAR(cd.国标名称)) AS std_diag_name
                          FROM CDA.cda_dictionary cd
                         WHERE TO_CHAR(cd.字典名称) = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                           AND TO_CHAR(cd.系统标识) = 'HIS'
                           AND cd.国标名称 IS NOT NULL
                         GROUP BY TO_CHAR(cd.国标名称)
                       ) icd_std
                    ON icd_std.match_value = q.diag_desc
               ) y
         WHERE NVL(
                   NULLIF(TRIM(y.admin_code_by_name), ''),
                   NULLIF(TRIM(y.diag_desc_code), '')
               ) IS NOT NULL
            OR NVL(
                   NULLIF(TRIM(y.admin_name_by_name), ''),
                   NULLIF(TRIM(y.diag_desc), '')
               ) IS NOT NULL
       ) z

V_EMR_OUTPATIENT_DIAG_BAK.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_OUTPATIENT_DIAG_BAK" ("ID", "OUTPATIENT_NUM", "TCM_WM_MARK_CODE", "TCM_WM_MARK_NAME", "IF_MAIN", "ADMIN_ILLNESS_CODE", "ADMIN_ILLNESS_NAME", "INFECTIOUS_SIGNS", "CONTAGIOUS_REPORT_SIGN", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "CHINA_MED_SYNDROME_CODE", "CHINA_MED_SYNDROME_NAME", "DOCTOR_ID_NUM", "DOCTOR_NAME", "DIAG_DATE", "DISTRICT_CODE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "NAME", "SEX_CODE", "ID_NUM", "DIAGNOSIS_NO", "LOCAL_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "LOCAL_DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "NHS_DX_CODE", "NHS_DX_NAME") AS 
  SELECT SUBSTR(
           '49557032X'
           || '|' || z.clinic_no
           || '|NEW|'
           || NVL(TO_CHAR(z.item_no), '0')
           || '|' || NVL(z.diag_code, '-'),
           1,
           100
       ) AS ID, -- 内码，主键

       SUBSTR(
           NVL(z.clinic_no, z.patient_id || TO_CHAR(z.visit_date, 'yyyymmdd')),
           1,
           32
       ) AS OUTPATIENT_NUM, -- 本次门诊标识符

       CASE
           WHEN z.diag_type IS NULL THEN '2'
           ELSE '1'
       END AS TCM_WM_MARK_CODE, -- 中医/西医诊断类型：1中医，2西医

       CASE
           WHEN z.diag_type IS NULL THEN '西医'
           ELSE '中医'
       END AS TCM_WM_MARK_NAME, -- 中医/西医诊断类型名称

       CASE
           WHEN z.item_no = 1 THEN '1'
           ELSE '0'
       END AS IF_MAIN, -- 是否主要诊断标识

       SUBSTR(
           NVL(z.icd_or_code, z.diag_code),
           1,
           12
       ) AS ADMIN_ILLNESS_CODE, -- 诊断疾病代码

       SUBSTR(
           NVL(z.icd_or_name, z.diag_desc),
           1,
           100
       ) AS ADMIN_ILLNESS_NAME, -- 诊断疾病名称

       z.infect_flag AS INFECTIOUS_SIGNS, -- 传染标识：按ICD-10编码及诊断名称推断

       z.infect_flag AS CONTAGIOUS_REPORT_SIGN, -- 传染上报标识：当前按诊断推断，严格应取传染病报卡

       '49557032X' AS ORG_CODE, -- 医院组织机构编码

       '山东省第二人民医院' AS ORG_NAME, -- 医院名称

       CASE
           WHEN z.diag_type IS NULL THEN '-'
           ELSE '-'
       END AS CHINA_MED_SYNDROME_CODE, -- 中医证候代码；中医真实证候来源待确认

       CASE
           WHEN z.diag_type IS NULL THEN '-'
           ELSE '-'
       END AS CHINA_MED_SYNDROME_NAME, -- 中医证候名称；中医真实证候来源待确认

       SUBSTR(NVL(z.doctor_id_no, '000000000000000000'), 1, 18) AS DOCTOR_ID_NUM, -- 诊断医师身份证号

       SUBSTR(NVL(z.doctor_name, z.doctor), 1, 50) AS DOCTOR_NAME, -- 诊断医师姓名

       CAST(z.visit_date AS DATE) AS DIAG_DATE, -- 诊断日期

       '370104' AS DISTRICT_CODE, -- 所属行政区划

       CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS SYSTEM_TIME, -- 数据上传时间戳

       'ADDHIS' AS EXCHANGE_TYPE, -- 交换类型；历史补传用ADDHIS，正常增量可改INSERT

       SUBSTR(z.patient_name, 1, 50) AS NAME, -- 患者姓名

       CASE TRIM(z.sex)
           WHEN '男' THEN '1'
           WHEN '女' THEN '2'
           WHEN '未知' THEN '0'
           WHEN '不详' THEN '9'
           WHEN '未说明' THEN '9'
           ELSE '9'
       END AS SEX_CODE, -- 患者性别代码

       SUBSTR(NVL(z.patient_id_no, '000000000000000000'), 1, 18) AS ID_NUM, -- 患者身份证件号码

       SUBSTR(NVL(TO_CHAR(z.item_no), '1'), 1, 20) AS DIAGNOSIS_NO, -- 诊断序号

       SUBSTR(z.diag_code, 1, 50) AS LOCAL_DIAGNOSIS_CODE, -- 院内诊断编码

       SUBSTR(z.diag_desc, 1, 200) AS LOCAL_DIAGNOSIS_NAME, -- 院内诊断名称

       SUBSTR(z.insur_diag_code, 1, 50) AS NHS_DX_CODE, -- 医保报销诊断编码

       SUBSTR(z.insur_diag_desc, 1, 200) AS NHS_DX_NAME -- 医保报销诊断名称

  FROM (
        SELECT y.*,
               CASE
                   WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(
                            UPPER(NVL(y.icd_or_code, y.diag_code)),
                            '^(A00|A01|A02|A03|A04|A05|A06|A09|A15|A16|A17|A18|A19|A20|A22|A27|A30|A33|A35|A36|A37|A38|A39|A50|A51|A52|A53|A54|A56|A64|A80|A82|A83|A90|A91|A92|A95|A98|B01|B05|B06|B15|B16|B17|B18|B19|B20|B21|B22|B23|B24|B26|B50|B51|B52|B53|B54|U07)'
                        )
                     OR REGEXP_LIKE(
                            NVL(y.icd_or_name, y.diag_desc),
                            '霍乱|鼠疫|炭疽|艾滋|HIV|病毒性肝炎|甲肝|乙肝|丙肝|戊肝|肺结核|结核|麻疹|风疹|水痘|流行性腮腺炎'
                        )
                     OR REGEXP_LIKE(
                            NVL(y.icd_or_name, y.diag_desc),
                            '流行性感冒|流感|新型冠状|新冠|COVID|手足口|猩红热|百日咳|白喉|脊髓灰质炎|流脑|乙脑'
                        )
                     OR REGEXP_LIKE(
                            NVL(y.icd_or_name, y.diag_desc),
                            '伤寒|副伤寒|细菌性痢疾|阿米巴痢疾|感染性腹泻|痢疾|布鲁菌|布病|钩端螺旋体|血吸虫|疟疾|登革热'
                        )
                     OR REGEXP_LIKE(
                            NVL(y.icd_or_name, y.diag_desc),
                            '梅毒|淋病|尖锐湿疣|生殖器疱疹|狂犬病|破伤风|人感染高致病性禽流感|禽流感'
                        )
                   THEN 1
                   ELSE 0
               END AS infect_flag
          FROM (
                SELECT q.*,

                       NULLIF(
                           GREATEST(
                               NVL(icd_code.std_diag_code,  UNISTR('\0001')),
                               NVL(icd_local.std_diag_code, UNISTR('\0001')),
                               NVL(icd_std.std_diag_code,   UNISTR('\0001'))
                           ),
                           UNISTR('\0001')
                       ) AS icd_or_code,

                       NULLIF(
                           GREATEST(
                               NVL(icd_code.std_diag_name,  UNISTR('\0001')),
                               NVL(icd_local.std_diag_name, UNISTR('\0001')),
                               NVL(icd_std.std_diag_name,   UNISTR('\0001'))
                           ),
                           UNISTR('\0001')
                       ) AS icd_or_name

                  FROM (
                        SELECT a.visit_date,
                               a.visit_no,
                               a.patient_id,
                               a.item_no,
                               a.diag_code,
                               a.diag_desc,
                               a.diag_type,
                               a.doctor,
                               a.insur_diag_code,
                               a.insur_diag_desc,
                               b.clinic_no,
                               c.id_no AS doctor_id_no,
                               c.name AS doctor_name,
                               pmi.name AS patient_name,
                               pmi.sex,
                               pmi.id_no AS patient_id_no
                          FROM HIS.outp_mr_diag_desc a
                          JOIN HIS.clinic_master b
                            ON a.visit_date = b.visit_date
                           AND a.visit_no = b.visit_no
                           AND a.patient_id = b.patient_id
                          LEFT JOIN HIS.staff_dict c
                            ON a.doctor = c.emp_no
                          JOIN HIS.pat_master_index pmi
                            ON a.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
                         WHERE a.visit_date >= DATE '2021-01-01'
                           AND a.visit_date <  DATE '2025-01-01'
                       ) q

                  LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT cd.院标编码 AS match_value,
                               MAX(cd.国标编码) AS std_diag_code,
                               MAX(cd.国标名称) AS std_diag_name
                          FROM CDA.cda_dictionary cd
                         WHERE cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                           AND cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                           AND cd.院标编码 IS NOT NULL
                         GROUP BY cd.院标编码
                       ) icd_code
                    ON icd_code.match_value = q.diag_code

                  LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT cd.院标名称 AS match_value,
                               MAX(cd.国标编码) AS std_diag_code,
                               MAX(cd.国标名称) AS std_diag_name
                          FROM CDA.cda_dictionary cd
                         WHERE cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                           AND cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                           AND cd.院标名称 IS NOT NULL
                         GROUP BY cd.院标名称
                       ) icd_local
                    ON icd_local.match_value = q.diag_desc

                  LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT cd.国标名称 AS match_value,
                               MAX(cd.国标编码) AS std_diag_code,
                               MAX(cd.国标名称) AS std_diag_name
                          FROM CDA.cda_dictionary cd
                         WHERE cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                           AND cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                           AND cd.国标名称 IS NOT NULL
                         GROUP BY cd.国标名称
                       ) icd_std
                    ON icd_std.match_value = q.diag_desc
               ) y
       ) z

UNION ALL

/* =========================================================
   OLD 分支：HIS.OUTP_MR
   原口径：
   ADMIN_ILLNESS_CODE / ADMIN_ILLNESS_NAME：
   只按 cd.院标名称 = a.diag_desc
   传染病判断：
   cd.院标编码 = a.diag_desc_code
   OR cd.院标名称 = a.diag_desc
   OR cd.国标名称 = a.diag_desc
   ========================================================= */
SELECT SUBSTR(
           '49557032X'
           || '|' || z.clinic_no
           || '|OLD|'
           || NVL(TO_CHAR(z.ordinal), '1')
           || '|' || NVL(z.diag_desc_code, '-'),
           1,
           100
       ) AS ID, -- 内码，主键

       SUBSTR(
           NVL(z.clinic_no, z.patient_id || TO_CHAR(z.visit_date, 'yyyymmdd')),
           1,
           32
       ) AS OUTPATIENT_NUM, -- 本次门诊标识符

       CASE
           WHEN z.diag_desc IS NOT NULL THEN '2'
           ELSE '1'
       END AS TCM_WM_MARK_CODE, -- 中医/西医诊断类型：1中医，2西医

       CASE
           WHEN z.diag_desc IS NOT NULL THEN '西医'
           ELSE '中医'
       END AS TCM_WM_MARK_NAME, -- 中医/西医诊断类型名称

       CASE
           WHEN NVL(z.ordinal, 1) = 1 THEN '1'
           ELSE '0'
       END AS IF_MAIN, -- 是否主要诊断标识

       NVL(z.admin_code_by_name, z.diag_desc_code) AS ADMIN_ILLNESS_CODE, -- 诊断疾病代码

       NVL(z.admin_name_by_name, z.diag_desc) AS ADMIN_ILLNESS_NAME, -- 诊断疾病名称

       z.infect_flag AS INFECTIOUS_SIGNS, -- 传染标识：按ICD-10编码及诊断名称推断

       z.infect_flag AS CONTAGIOUS_REPORT_SIGN, -- 传染上报标识：当前按诊断推断，严格应取传染病报卡

       '49557032X' AS ORG_CODE, -- 医院组织机构编码

       '山东省第二人民医院' AS ORG_NAME, -- 医院名称

       CASE
           WHEN z.diag_desc IS NOT NULL THEN '-'
           ELSE '-'
       END AS CHINA_MED_SYNDROME_CODE, -- 中医证候代码；中医真实证候来源待确认

       CASE
           WHEN z.diag_desc IS NOT NULL THEN '-'
           ELSE '-'
       END AS CHINA_MED_SYNDROME_NAME, -- 中医证候名称；中医真实证候来源待确认

       SUBSTR(NVL(z.doctor_id_no, '000000000000000000'), 1, 18) AS DOCTOR_ID_NUM, -- 诊断医师身份证号

       SUBSTR(NVL(z.doctor_name, z.doctor), 1, 50) AS DOCTOR_NAME, -- 诊断医师姓名

       CAST(z.illness_date AS DATE) AS DIAG_DATE, -- 诊断日期

       '370104' AS DISTRICT_CODE, -- 所属行政区划

       CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP) AS SYSTEM_TIME, -- 数据上传时间戳

       'ADDHIS' AS EXCHANGE_TYPE, -- 交换类型；历史补传用ADDHIS，正常增量可改INSERT

       SUBSTR(z.patient_name, 1, 50) AS NAME, -- 患者姓名

       CASE TRIM(z.sex)
           WHEN '男' THEN '1'
           WHEN '女' THEN '2'
           WHEN '未知' THEN '0'
           WHEN '不详' THEN '9'
           WHEN '未说明' THEN '9'
           ELSE '9'
       END AS SEX_CODE, -- 患者性别代码

       SUBSTR(NVL(z.patient_id_no, '000000000000000000'), 1, 18) AS ID_NUM, -- 患者身份证件号码

       SUBSTR(NVL(TO_CHAR(z.ordinal), '1'), 1, 20) AS DIAGNOSIS_NO, -- 诊断序号

       SUBSTR(z.diag_desc_code, 1, 50) AS LOCAL_DIAGNOSIS_CODE, -- 院内诊断编码

       SUBSTR(z.diag_desc, 1, 200) AS LOCAL_DIAGNOSIS_NAME, -- 院内诊断名称

       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS NHS_DX_CODE, -- 医保报销诊断编码，旧表暂无来源

       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(200)) AS NHS_DX_NAME -- 医保报销诊断名称，旧表暂无来源

  FROM (
        SELECT y.*,
               CASE
                   WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(
                            UPPER(NVL(y.infect_code_or, y.diag_desc_code)),
                            '^(A00|A01|A02|A03|A04|A05|A06|A09|A15|A16|A17|A18|A19|A20|A22|A27|A30|A33|A35|A36|A37|A38|A39|A50|A51|A52|A53|A54|A56|A64|A80|A82|A83|A90|A91|A92|A95|A98|B01|B05|B06|B15|B16|B17|B18|B19|B20|B21|B22|B23|B24|B26|B50|B51|B52|B53|B54|U07)'
                        )
                     OR REGEXP_LIKE(
                            NVL(y.infect_name_or, y.diag_desc),
                            '霍乱|鼠疫|炭疽|艾滋|HIV|病毒性肝炎|甲肝|乙肝|丙肝|戊肝|肺结核|结核|麻疹|风疹|水痘|流行性腮腺炎'
                        )
                     OR REGEXP_LIKE(
                            NVL(y.infect_name_or, y.diag_desc),
                            '流行性感冒|流感|新型冠状|新冠|COVID|手足口|猩红热|百日咳|白喉|脊髓灰质炎|流脑|乙脑'
                        )
                     OR REGEXP_LIKE(
                            NVL(y.infect_name_or, y.diag_desc),
                            '伤寒|副伤寒|细菌性痢疾|阿米巴痢疾|感染性腹泻|痢疾|布鲁菌|布病|钩端螺旋体|血吸虫|疟疾|登革热'
                        )
                     OR REGEXP_LIKE(
                            NVL(y.infect_name_or, y.diag_desc),
                            '梅毒|淋病|尖锐湿疣|生殖器疱疹|狂犬病|破伤风|人感染高致病性禽流感|禽流感'
                        )
                   THEN 1
                   ELSE 0
               END AS infect_flag
          FROM (
                SELECT q.*,

                       icd_local.std_diag_code AS admin_code_by_name,
                       icd_local.std_diag_name AS admin_name_by_name,

                       NULLIF(
                           GREATEST(
                               NVL(icd_code.std_diag_code,  UNISTR('\0001')),
                               NVL(icd_local.std_diag_code, UNISTR('\0001')),
                               NVL(icd_std.std_diag_code,   UNISTR('\0001'))
                           ),
                           UNISTR('\0001')
                       ) AS infect_code_or,

                       NULLIF(
                           GREATEST(
                               NVL(icd_code.std_diag_name,  UNISTR('\0001')),
                               NVL(icd_local.std_diag_name, UNISTR('\0001')),
                               NVL(icd_std.std_diag_name,   UNISTR('\0001'))
                           ),
                           UNISTR('\0001')
                       ) AS infect_name_or

                  FROM (
                        SELECT a.visit_date,
                               a.visit_no,
                               a.patient_id,
                               a.ordinal,
                               a.diag_desc_code,
                               a.diag_desc,
                               a.doctor,
                               a.doctor_no,
                               a.illness_date,
                               b.clinic_no,
                               c.id_no AS doctor_id_no,
                               c.name AS doctor_name,
                               pmi.name AS patient_name,
                               pmi.sex,
                               pmi.id_no AS patient_id_no
                          FROM HIS.outp_mr a
                          JOIN HIS.clinic_master b
                            ON a.visit_date = b.visit_date
                           AND a.visit_no = b.visit_no
                           AND a.patient_id = b.patient_id
                          LEFT JOIN HIS.staff_dict c
                            ON a.doctor_no = c.emp_no
                          JOIN HIS.pat_master_index pmi
                            ON a.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
                         WHERE a.visit_date >  DATE '2021-01-01'
                           AND a.visit_date <  DATE '2025-01-01'
                       ) q

                  /* OLD 分支 ADMIN_ILLNESS_CODE / NAME 原逻辑：只按院标名称匹配 */
                  LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT cd.院标名称 AS match_value,
                               MAX(cd.国标编码) AS std_diag_code,
                               MAX(cd.国标名称) AS std_diag_name
                          FROM CDA.cda_dictionary cd
                         WHERE cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                           AND cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                           AND cd.院标名称 IS NOT NULL
                         GROUP BY cd.院标名称
                       ) icd_local
                    ON icd_local.match_value = q.diag_desc

                  /* OLD 分支传染病判断原逻辑：院标编码匹配 */
                  LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT cd.院标编码 AS match_value,
                               MAX(cd.国标编码) AS std_diag_code,
                               MAX(cd.国标名称) AS std_diag_name
                          FROM CDA.cda_dictionary cd
                         WHERE cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                           AND cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                           AND cd.院标编码 IS NOT NULL
                         GROUP BY cd.院标编码
                       ) icd_code
                    ON icd_code.match_value = q.diag_desc_code

                  /* OLD 分支传染病判断原逻辑：国标名称匹配 */
                  LEFT JOIN (
                        SELECT cd.国标名称 AS match_value,
                               MAX(cd.国标编码) AS std_diag_code,
                               MAX(cd.国标名称) AS std_diag_name
                          FROM CDA.cda_dictionary cd
                         WHERE cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                           AND cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                           AND cd.国标名称 IS NOT NULL
                         GROUP BY cd.国标名称
                       ) icd_std
                    ON icd_std.match_value = q.diag_desc
               ) y
         WHERE NVL(y.admin_code_by_name, y.diag_desc_code) IS NOT NULL
       ) z

V_EMR_OUTPATIENT_RECIPE.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_OUTPATIENT_RECIPE" ("ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "OUTPATIENT_NUM", "CASE_NUM", "RECIPE_NUM", "RECIPE_TYPE_CODE", "RECIPE_TYPE_NAME", "RECIPE_CLINIC_CODE", "RECIPE_CLINIC_NAME", "RECIPE_CLASS_CODE", "RECIPE_CLASS_NAME", "CH_METHOD", "NAME", "OTHER_ID_TYPE", "OTHER_ID_TYPE_NAME", "OTHER_ID_NUM", "ID_NUM", "SEX_CODE", "SEX_NAME", "AGE", "AGE_MONTH", "AGE_DAY", "AGE_HOUR", "PRESCRIBE_DATE", "DEP_CODE", "DEP_NAME", "HOS_DEP_CODE", "HOS_DEP_NAME", "DOCTOR_CODE", "DOCTOR_NAME", "EFFECTIVE_DAYS", "CHECKER_CODE", "CHECKER_NAME", "CHECK_DATE", "TP_DOCTOR", "HD_DOCTOR", "FY_DOCTOR", "CF_NOTES", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "DEI", "NODE_CODE", "SYSTEM_TIME") AS 
  select substr(
           '49557032X' || '|' ||
           to_char(a.presc_date, 'yyyymmddhh24miss') || '|' ||
           a.patient_id || '|' ||
           a.presc_no,
           1,
           100
       ) as ID,-- 内码 是 主键

       '49557032X' as ORG_CODE,-- 医院组织机构编码 是 必填

       '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,-- 医院名称 是 必填

       substr(nvl(a.clinic_no, a.patient_id||to_char(a.PRESC_DATE,'yyyymmdd')), 1, 18) as OUTPATIENT_NUM,-- 本次门诊标识号 是 必填

       substr(a.patient_id, 1, 20) as CASE_NUM,-- 病历号

       substr(to_char(a.presc_no), 1, 20) as RECIPE_NUM,-- 处方编号 是 与药品医嘱表保证关联性

       case
           when td.has_herb = 1 then '3'       -- 中草药
           when td.has_tcm = 1 then '1'        -- 中成药按中药处理
           when td.has_western = 1 then '2'    -- 西药
           when td.has_other = 1 then '5'      -- 辅料、试剂按非药品处理
           else '5'
       end as RECIPE_TYPE_CODE,-- 处方类别代码 是 1中药、2西药、3中草药、4中药饮片、5非药品

       case
           when td.has_herb = 1 then '中草药'
           when td.has_tcm = 1 then '中药'
           when td.has_western = 1 then '西药'
           when td.has_other = 1 then '非药品'
           else '非药品'
       end as RECIPE_TYPE_NAME,-- 处方类别名称 是

       case
           when td.has_narcotic = 1 then '2'     -- 麻醉药品
           when td.has_psych_one = 1 then '3'    -- 精神一类
           when td.has_psych_two = 1 then '4'    -- 精神二类
           when td.has_toxic = 1 then '5'        -- 毒性药品
           when td.has_precursor = 1 then '6'    -- 易制毒药品
           else '1'                              -- 普通药品
       end as RECIPE_CLINIC_CODE,-- 处方临床分类代码

       case
           when td.has_narcotic = 1 then '麻醉药品'
           when td.has_psych_one = 1 then '精神一类'
           when td.has_psych_two = 1 then '精神二类'
           when td.has_toxic = 1 then '毒性药品'
           when td.has_precursor = 1 then '易制毒药品'
           else '普通药品'
       end as RECIPE_CLINIC_NAME,-- 处方临床分类名称

       case
           when a.ordered_by in ('030603', '030601', '030504') then '02' -- 急诊
           when to_char(a.presc_source) = '0' then '01'                 -- 门诊
           when to_char(a.presc_source) = '1' then '03'                 -- 住院
           else '99'
       end as RECIPE_CLASS_CODE,-- 处方分类代码 DMD-02

       case
           when a.ordered_by in ('030603', '030601', '030504') then '急诊'
           when to_char(a.presc_source) = '0' then '门诊'
           when to_char(a.presc_source) = '1' then '住院'
           else '其他'
       end as RECIPE_CLASS_NAME,-- 处方分类名称

       cast(null as varchar2(100)) as CH_METHOD,-- 治则治法 中医处方填写

       substr(nvl(a.name, pmi.name), 1, 50) as NAME,-- 姓名 患者姓名

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select zd.国标编码
                  from cda.cda_dictionary zd
                 where zd.字典名称 = '身份证件类型代码'
                   and zd.院标编码 = pmi.id_type
                   and rownum = 1),
               case when pmi.id_no is not null then '01' else '99' end
           ),
           1,
           11
       ) as OTHER_ID_TYPE,-- 身份证件标识代码

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select zd.国标名称
                  from cda.cda_dictionary zd
                 where zd.字典名称 = '身份证件类型代码'
                   and zd.院标编码 = pmi.id_type
                   and rownum = 1),
               case when pmi.id_no is not null then '居民身份证' else '其他法定有效证件' end
           ),
           1,
           30
       ) as OTHER_ID_TYPE_NAME,-- 身份标识名称

       cast(null as varchar2(18)) as OTHER_ID_NUM,-- 其他身份证件号码

       substr(pmi.id_no, 1, 18) as ID_NUM,-- 身份证件号码

       decode(pmi.sex, '男', '1', '女', '2', '未知', '0', '9') as SEX_CODE,-- 性别代码

       decode(pmi.sex, '男', '男', '女', '女', '未知', '未知', '不明') as SEX_NAME,-- 性别

       case
           when pmi.date_of_birth is not null
            and a.presc_date is not null
            and a.presc_date >= pmi.date_of_birth
           then least(
                    greatest(trunc(months_between(a.presc_date, pmi.date_of_birth) / 12), 0),
                    200
                )
           else cast(null as number)
       end as AGE,-- 年龄 范围在0-200之间

       case
           when pmi.date_of_birth is not null
            and a.presc_date is not null
            and a.presc_date >= pmi.date_of_birth
           then least(
                    greatest(mod(trunc(months_between(a.presc_date, pmi.date_of_birth)), 12), 0),
                    11
                )
           else cast(null as number)
       end as AGE_MONTH,-- 年龄（月） 范围在0-11之间

       case
           when pmi.date_of_birth is not null
            and a.presc_date is not null
            and a.presc_date >= pmi.date_of_birth
           then least(
                    greatest(
                        trunc(
                            a.presc_date -
                            add_months(
                                pmi.date_of_birth,
                                trunc(months_between(a.presc_date, pmi.date_of_birth))
                            )
                        ),
                        0
                    ),
                    30
                )
           else cast(null as number)
       end as AGE_DAY,-- 年龄（天） 范围在0-30之间

       case
           when pmi.date_of_birth is not null
            and a.presc_date is not null
            and a.presc_date >= pmi.date_of_birth
           then least(
                    greatest(
                        trunc(
                            24 * (
                                (
                                    a.presc_date -
                                    add_months(
                                        pmi.date_of_birth,
                                        trunc(months_between(a.presc_date, pmi.date_of_birth))
                                    )
                                )
                                -
                                trunc(
                                    a.presc_date -
                                    add_months(
                                        pmi.date_of_birth,
                                        trunc(months_between(a.presc_date, pmi.date_of_birth))
                                    )
                                )
                            )
                        ),
                        0
                    ),
                    23
                )
           else cast(null as number)
       end as AGE_HOUR,-- 年龄（小时） 范围在0-23之间

       cast(a.presc_date as date) as PRESCRIBE_DATE,-- 处方开立时间 是 业务日期

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select ks.qmpt_code
                  from his.dept_dict ks
                 where ks.dept_code = nvl( d.visit_dept,a.ORDERED_BY)
                   and rownum = 1),
               d.visit_dept
           ),
           1,
           20
       ) as DEP_CODE,-- 就诊科室编号 是

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select ks.qmpt_name
                  from his.dept_dict ks
                 where ks.dept_code = nvl( d.visit_dept,a.ORDERED_BY)
                   and rownum = 1),
               nvl(
                   (select ks.dept_name
                      from his.dept_dict ks
                     where ks.dept_code = d.visit_dept
                       and rownum = 1),
                   d.visit_dept
               )
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as DEP_NAME,-- 就诊科室名称 是

       substr(d.visit_dept, 1, 20) as HOS_DEP_CODE,-- 院内科室编码 是

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select ks.dept_name
                  from his.dept_dict ks
                 where ks.dept_code = d.visit_dept
                   and rownum = 1),
               d.visit_dept
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as HOS_DEP_NAME,-- 院内科室名称 是

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select sd.emp_no
                  from his.staff_dict sd
                 where (sd.emp_no = a.prescribed_by or sd.name = a.prescribed_by)
                   and rownum = 1),
               a.prescribed_by
           ),
           1,
           32
       ) as DOCTOR_CODE,-- 医生代码(职工编号)

      nvl( substr(
           nvl(
               (select sd.name
                  from his.staff_dict sd
                 where (sd.emp_no = a.prescribed_by or sd.name = a.prescribed_by)
                   and rownum = 1),
               a.prescribed_by
           ),
           1,
           50
       ),'-') as DOCTOR_NAME,-- 医生姓名 是 开方医生姓名

       cast(nvl(td.abidance, 0) as number) as EFFECTIVE_DAYS,-- 处方有效天数

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select sd.emp_no
                  from his.staff_dict sd
                 where (sd.emp_no = a.entered_by or sd.name = a.entered_by)
                   and rownum = 1),
               '-'
           ),
           1,
           32
       ) as CHECKER_CODE,-- 审方人代码

       substr(
           nvl(
               (select sd.name
                  from his.staff_dict sd
                 where (sd.emp_no = a.entered_by or sd.name = a.entered_by)
                   and rownum = 1),
               nvl(a.entered_by, '-')
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) as CHECKER_NAME,-- 审方人姓名

       cast(a.dispensing_datetime as date) as CHECK_DATE,-- 审方时间

       substr(a.dispensing_provider, 1, 50) as TP_DOCTOR,-- 调配药剂师

       substr(a.entered_by, 1, 50) as HD_DOCTOR,-- 核对药剂师

       substr(a.dispensing_provider, 1, 50) as FY_DOCTOR,-- 发药药剂师

       substr(a.memo, 1, 100) as CF_NOTES,-- 处方备注信息

       '370104' as DISTRICT_CODE,-- 所属行政区划 是

       'INSERT' as EXCHANGE_TYPE,-- 交换类型 是

       cast(null as varchar2(50)) as DEI,-- 数据交换标识符

       cast(null as varchar2(50)) as NODE_CODE,-- 节点标识符

       cast(systimestamp as timestamp) as SYSTEM_TIME-- 数据上传时间戳 是

from his.drug_presc_master a
left join (
    select dp.presc_date,
           dp.presc_no,
           max(dp.abidance) as abidance,

           -- 处方类别：his.drug_dict.drug_indicator
           max(case when to_char(b.drug_indicator) = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as has_western,-- 西药
           max(case when to_char(b.drug_indicator) = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as has_herb,-- 中草药
           max(case when to_char(b.drug_indicator) = '3' then 1 else 0 end) as has_tcm,-- 中成药
           max(case when to_char(b.drug_indicator) in ('5', '6') then 1 else 0 end) as has_other,-- 辅料、试剂

           -- 处方临床分类：his.drug_dict.toxi_property
           max(case when replace(trim(b.toxi_property), ' ', '') = '麻醉药品' then 1 else 0 end) as has_narcotic,
           max(case when replace(trim(b.toxi_property), ' ', '') in ('精神一类', '一类精神药品') then 1 else 0 end) as has_psych_one,
           max(case when replace(trim(b.toxi_property), ' ', '') in ('精神二类', '二类精神药品') then 1 else 0 end) as has_psych_two,
           max(case when replace(trim(b.toxi_property), ' ', '') = '毒性药品' then 1 else 0 end) as has_toxic,
           max(case when replace(trim(b.toxi_property), ' ', '') = '易制毒药品' then 1 else 0 end) as has_precursor

      from his.drug_presc_detail dp
      left join his.drug_dict b
             on dp.drug_code = b.drug_code
     group by dp.presc_date, dp.presc_no
) td
       on td.presc_no = a.presc_no
      and td.presc_date = a.presc_date
left join his.clinic_master d
       on a.clinic_no = d.clinic_no
left join his.pat_master_index pmi
       on a.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
where a.presc_source = '0'
  and a.flag = '1'
  and a.costs > 0
  and a.presc_date >= to_date('2021-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
  and a.presc_date <  to_date('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') and   substr(
           nvl(
               (select ks.qmpt_code
                  from his.dept_dict ks
                 where ks.dept_code = nvl( d.visit_dept,a.ORDERED_BY)
                   and rownum = 1),
               d.visit_dept
           ),
           1,
           20
       ) is not null and substr(
           '49557032X' || '|' ||
           to_char(a.presc_date, 'yyyymmddhh24miss') || '|' ||
           a.patient_id || '|' ||
           a.presc_no,
           1,
           100
       )  <>'49557032X|20230220170748|00661308|24886'  and substr(d.visit_dept, 1, 20) is not null

    when dd.drug_indicator = 2

    when dd.drug_indicator in (5, 6, 9) then '5'
