                   ),
                   case
                       when nvl(t.quantity, 0) <> 0
                           then abs(t.costs / t.quantity)
                       else null
                   end
               ),
               2
           ) as number(9, 2)
       ) as DRUG_PRICE, -- 药物单价

       case
           when a.presc_type = '1'
               then substr(a.memo, 1, 2000)
           else cast(null as varchar2(2000))
       end as CH_DRUG_NOTES, -- 中药饮片处方描述

       substr(a.clinic_no, 1, 18)
           as OUTPATIENT_NUM, -- 本次门诊标识号

       substr(a.name, 1, 50)         as NAME, -- 患者姓名

       case trim(pmi.sex)
           when '男' then '1'
           when '女' then '2'
           when '未知' then '0'
           when '不详' then '9'
           when '未说明' then '9'
           else '9'
       end as SEX_CODE, -- 患者性别代码

      nvl( substr(pmi.id_no, 1, 18),'000000000000000000')
           as ID_NUM, -- 患者身份证件号码


   case
    when lower(trim(t.frequency)) in ('st', 'prn')
      or trim(t.frequency) in ('立即', '必要时', '术前', '术晨', '术前30’', '皮试')
    then '2'
    when t.frequency is null then '9'
    else '2'
end as ODR_TYPE, -- 处方类别编码：门诊处方默认临时

       substr(
           a.clinic_no
           || '|' || nvl(cast(t.order_no as varchar2(50)), '0')
           || '|' || nvl(cast(t.order_sub_no as varchar2(50)), '0'),
           1,
           100
       ) as ORDER_ITEM_CODE, -- 院内医嘱编号

       substr(t.drug_name, 1, 100)
           as ORDER_ITEM_NAME, -- 院内医嘱项名称

       '1' as ORDER_CATEGORY_CODE, -- 医嘱项目大类别编码：药品类

       '药品类医嘱' as ORDER_CATEGORY_NAME, -- 医嘱项目大类别名称

    case
    when lower(trim(t.dosage_units)) in ('g', '克') then 'g'
    when lower(trim(t.dosage_units)) in ('mg', '毫克') then 'mg'
    when lower(trim(t.dosage_units)) in ('μg', 'ug', 'mcg', '微克') then 'μg'
    when lower(trim(t.dosage_units)) in ('l', '升') then 'L'
    when lower(trim(t.dosage_units)) in ('ml', '毫升') then 'ml'
    when upper(trim(t.dosage_units)) in ('IU', '万IU', 'AXAIU') then 'IU'
    when upper(trim(t.dosage_units)) in ('U', '万U')
      or trim(t.dosage_units) in ('单位', '万u', 'u') then 'U'
    else substr(t.dosage_units, 1, 100)
end as ORDER_NUM_NAME, -- 医嘱用量单位

       case
           when nvl(t.flag, a.flag) = 2 then '2'
           else '1'
       end as ORDER_STATUS, -- 医嘱有效标识，1有效、2无效

       cast(null as varchar2(100))           as DTCODE, -- 药品追溯码，暂无可靠来源

       substr(
           (
               select max(m.ylxmbm)
                 from HIS.insur_vsh_center_item_new m
                where m.item_code = t.drug_code
           ),
           1,
           100
       ) as NHSA_STANDARD_CODE, -- 医保贯标码

       substr(
           cast(dd.dose_per_unit as varchar2(100)),
           1,
           100
       ) as DOSAGE, -- 最小剂量

       dd.dose_units     as DOSAGE_UNIT_NAME, -- 最小剂量单位名称

       substr(
           nvl(t.package_units, dd.units),
           1,
           100
       ) as DRUG_ALL_UNIT, -- 药品包装单位

       (
           select max(pl.amount_per_package)
                      keep (
                          dense_rank last
                          order by pl.start_date
                      )
             from HIS.drug_price_list pl
            where pl.drug_code = t.drug_code
              and pl.drug_spec =
                  nvl(t.package_spec, t.drug_spec)
              and pl.firm_id = t.firm_id
              and pl.start_date <= a.presc_date
              and (
                  pl.stop_date is null
                  or pl.stop_date >= a.presc_date
              )
       ) as DRUG_ALL_NUM, -- 药品包装量

       cast(
           greatest(
               nvl(
                   t.abidance,
                   case
                       when a.presc_type = '1'
                           then nvl(a.repetition, 1)
                       else 1
                   end
               ),
               1
           ) as number
       ) as ADMINISTRATION_DAYS, -- 执行天数


     case
    when regexp_like(trim(t.administration), '输液泵|静脉泵入|微量泵入|泵入') then '输液泵泵入'
    when regexp_like(trim(t.administration), '皮下注射') then '皮下注射'
    when regexp_like(trim(t.administration), '皮内注射|皮试') then '皮内注射'
    when regexp_like(trim(t.administration), '肌肉注射') then '肌肉注射'
    when regexp_like(trim(t.administration), '静脉滴注|静脉输液|续静滴|静脉注射|静脉推注|静脉壶内给药|静脉化疗|脐静脉给药|静脉封管|封管') then '静脉注射或静脉滴注'
    when regexp_like(trim(t.administration), '鞘内注射') then '鞘内注射'
    when regexp_like(trim(t.administration), '椎管内') then '椎管内用药'
    when regexp_like(trim(t.administration), '关节腔注射|关节腔冲洗|关节腔') then '关节腔内用药'
    when regexp_like(trim(t.administration), '胸腔注射|胸腔冲洗|胸膜腔') then '胸膜腔用药'
    when regexp_like(trim(t.administration), '腹腔注射|腹腔冲洗|腹腔灌注|腹腔用药|腹膜透析') then '腹腔用药'
    when regexp_like(trim(t.administration), '阴道内置药|阴道冲洗|阴道用药|阴道') then '阴道用药'
    when regexp_like(trim(t.administration), '气管滴药|气管内') then '气管内用药'
    when regexp_like(trim(t.administration), '滴左眼|滴右眼|滴双眼|滴眼|涂左眼|涂右眼|涂双眼|涂眼膏') then '滴眼'
    when regexp_like(trim(t.administration), '滴左耳|滴右耳|滴双耳|滴耳') then '滴耳'
    when regexp_like(trim(t.administration), '滴鼻|喷鼻|鼻腔冲洗') then '滴鼻'
    when regexp_like(trim(t.administration), '喷喉|口腔喷雾') then '喷喉'
    when regexp_like(trim(t.administration), '舌下含化|舌下|口含|含化|含漱') then '含化'
    when regexp_like(trim(t.administration), '敷伤口|湿敷') then '敷伤口'
    when regexp_like(trim(t.administration), '擦皮肤|外用|涂擦|涂剂') then '擦皮肤'
    when regexp_like(trim(t.administration), '口服|冲服|煎服|嚼服|泡服|胃管内注入|鼻空肠管注入|空肠造瘘管内注入|空肠造瘘注入') then '口服'
    when regexp_like(trim(t.administration), '直肠|肛门注入|肛塞|肛用|保留灌肠|清洁灌肠|灌肠') then '直肠用药'
    when regexp_like(trim(t.administration), '雾化吸入|雾化吸入Ⅰ号|压力雾化|吸入') then '吸入用药'
    when regexp_like(trim(t.administration), '局部麻醉|局醉|浸润麻醉|局部注射|局部用药') then '局部用药'
    else '其他用药途径'
end as DRUG_ADMINISTRATION_ROUTE, -- 给药途径

       '0' as IS_EXTERNAL_PRES -- 是否外配处方，院内处方填0

   from HIS.drug_presc_master a

join HIS.drug_presc_detail t
  on t.presc_date = a.presc_date
 and t.presc_no   = a.presc_no

join HIS.clinic_master d
  on d.clinic_no  = a.clinic_no
 and d.patient_id = a.patient_id

join HIS.pat_master_index pmi
  on pmi.patient_id = a.patient_id

left join HIS.med_dict_baseinfo m
  on m.drug_id = t.drug_code

left join (
        select x.drug_code,
               x.drug_spec,
               x.drug_name,
               x.units,
               x.drug_form,
               x.dose_per_unit,
               x.dose_units,
               x.drug_indicator
          from (
                select dd.drug_code,
                       dd.drug_spec,
                       dd.drug_name,
                       dd.units,
                       dd.drug_form,
                       dd.dose_per_unit,
                       dd.dose_units,
                       dd.drug_indicator,
                       row_number() over (
                           partition by dd.drug_code,
                                        dd.drug_spec
                           order by dd.rowid
                       ) as rn
                  from HIS.drug_dict dd
               ) x
         where x.rn = 1
       ) dd
  on dd.drug_code = t.drug_code
 and dd.drug_spec = t.drug_spec

left join (
        select g.F008_HIS_YAO_PIN_BIAN_MA as his_drug_code,
               max(g.F004_YPID11_3) as ypid_code,
               max(g.F007_CHAN_PIN_MING_CHENG) as product_name
          from DRUG_STANDARD_DICT g
         group by g.F008_HIS_YAO_PIN_BIAN_MA
       ) std
  on std.his_drug_code = t.drug_code

left join (
        select zd.院标编码 as local_code,
               max(zd.国标编码) as standard_code,
               max(zd.国标名称) as standard_name
          from CDA.cda_dictionary zd
         where zd.字典名称 in (
                   '用药途径代码',
                   '给药途径代码',
                   '药物使用途径代码'
               )
         group by zd.院标编码
       ) route_map
  on route_map.local_code = t.administration

left join (
        select v.hospital_code,
               max(v.value_domain_code) as value_domain_code,
               max(v.value_domain_name) as value_domain_name
          from CDA_VALUE_DOMAIN_MAP v
         where v.category_code = 'CV08.50.002'
         group by v.hospital_code
       ) form_map
  on form_map.hospital_code = m.dose_model_code

left join (
        select p.dict_code,
               max(v.value_domain_code) as value_domain_code,
               max(v.value_domain_name) as value_domain_name
          from PORTAL_USER.portal_sys_dict p
          join CDA_VALUE_DOMAIN_MAP v
            on v.hospital_code = p.dict_code
           and v.category_code = 'CC99.00203'
         where p.type_code = 'pharmacology_type'
         group by p.dict_code
       ) pharm_map
  on pharm_map.dict_code = m.phy_class

left join (
        select dict_code,
               max(dict_name) as dict_name
          from PORTAL_USER.portal_sys_dict
         where type_code = 'jy'
         group by dict_code
       ) jy_dict
  on jy_dict.dict_code = m.basicdrug

left join (
        select dict_code,
               max(dict_name) as dict_name
          from PORTAL_USER.portal_sys_dict
         where type_code = 'kss'
         group by dict_code
       ) kss_dict
  on kss_dict.dict_code = m.anti_flag

left join (
        select item_code,
               max(ylxmbm) as ylxmbm
          from HIS.insur_vsh_center_item_new
         group by item_code
       ) insur_map
  on insur_map.item_code = t.drug_code

where a.presc_source = '0'
  and (a.flag = 1 or a.flag is null)
  and a.costs > 0
  and d.visit_date >= date '2021-01-01'
  and d.visit_date <  date '2025-01-01'

V_EMR_OUTPATIENT_RECIPE_ITEM.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_OUTPATIENT_RECIPE_ITEM" ("ID", "OR_ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "SN", "ITEM_NUM", "ITEM_TYPE_CODE", "ITEM_TYPE_NAME", "DRUG_CLASS_CODE", "DRUG_CLASS_NAME", "DRUG_CODE", "DRUG_COMMON_NAME", "DRUG_NAME", "SPEC", "UNIT", "DRUG_DOSE", "ONCE_AMOUNT", "DOSAGE_UNIT", "JL_UNIT", "QUANTITY", "HERB_NUM", "UNIT_DOSE", "ORDER_DOSAGE", "ALL_AMOUNT", "DRUG_ROUTE_CODE", "DRUG_ROUTE_NAME", "DRUG_FREQUENCY_CODE", "DRUG_FREQUENCY_NAME", "STATUS_CODE", "STATUS_NAME", "CANCEL_REASON", "CANCEL_TIME", "DOCTOR_CODE", "DOCTOR_NAME", "DRUG_FORM_CODE", "DRUG_FORM_NAME", "GROUP_NO", "SKIN_TEST_RESULT", "IS_ESSENTIAL", "ESSENTIL_GRADE", "IS_ANTI", "ANTI_USE_GRADE_CODE", "ANTI_USE_GRADE_NAME", "IF_YF", "DISTRICT_CODE", "CREATED_AT", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "DRUG_WAY_CD", "DRUG_WAY_NAME", "DURATION_TIME", "DRUG_AMOUNT", "TCM_DECOCTION_METHOD", "MEDICATION_METHOD", "DRUG_PRICE", "CH_DRUG_NOTES", "OUTPATIENT_NUM", "NAME", "SEX_CODE", "ID_NUM", "ODR_TYPE", "ORDER_ITEM_CODE", "ORDER_ITEM_NAME", "ORDER_CATEGORY_CODE", "ORDER_CATEGORY_NAME", "ORDER_NUM_NAME", "ORDER_STATUS", "DTCODE", "NHSA_STANDARD_CODE", "DOSAGE", "DOSAGE_UNIT_NAME", "DRUG_ALL_UNIT", "DRUG_ALL_NUM", "ADMINISTRATION_DAYS", "DRUG_ADMINISTRATION_ROUTE", "IS_EXTERNAL_PRES") AS 
  SELECT SUBSTR(
           TO_CHAR(a.presc_date, 'yyyymmddhh24miss')
           || '|' || CAST(a.presc_no AS VARCHAR2(50))
           || '|' || CAST(t.item_no AS VARCHAR2(50)),
           1,
           100
       ) AS ID, -- 内码：处方日期+处方号+处方项目序号

      /* SUBSTR(
           TO_CHAR(a.presc_date, 'yyyymmddhh24miss')
           || '|' || CAST(a.presc_no AS VARCHAR2(50)),
           1,
           100
       ) AS*/
       substr(
           '49557032X' || '|' ||
           to_char(a.presc_date, 'yyyymmddhh24miss') || '|' ||
           a.patient_id || '|' ||
           a.presc_no,
           1,
           100
       )   OR_ID, -- 门诊处方内码，必须与处方主表ID保持一致

       '49557032X' AS ORG_CODE, -- 医院编码

       '山东省第二人民医院' AS ORG_NAME, -- 医院名称

       t.item_no AS SN, -- 序号

       SUBSTR(CAST(t.item_no AS VARCHAR2(20)), 1, 20) AS ITEM_NUM, -- 处方项编号

       CASE
           /* 中药饮片必须优先判断 */
           WHEN dd.drug_indicator = 2
            AND (
                   REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(t.drug_name, dd.drug_name), '饮片')
                OR REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(dd.drug_form, '-'), '饮片')
                )
           THEN '4'

           /* 西药 */
           WHEN dd.drug_indicator = 1 THEN '2'

           /* 中草药，但不属于饮片 */
           WHEN dd.drug_indicator = 2 THEN '3'

           /* 中成药归入平台“中药” */
           WHEN dd.drug_indicator = 3 THEN '1'

           /* 辅料、试剂、其他暂归为非药品 */
           WHEN dd.drug_indicator IN (5, 6, 9) THEN '5'

           /* 药品字典关联不到时，使用处方类别兜底：保持原逻辑 */
           WHEN a.presc_type = '0' THEN '2'
           WHEN a.presc_type = '1' THEN '1'

           ELSE '5'
       END AS ITEM_TYPE_CODE, -- 处方项类别代码

       CASE
           WHEN dd.drug_indicator = 2
            AND (
                   REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(t.drug_name, dd.drug_name), '饮片')
                OR REGEXP_LIKE(NVL(dd.drug_form, '-'), '饮片')
                )
           THEN '中药饮片'

           WHEN dd.drug_indicator = 1 THEN '西药'
           WHEN dd.drug_indicator = 2 THEN '中草药'
           WHEN dd.drug_indicator = 3 THEN '中药'
           WHEN dd.drug_indicator IN (5, 6, 9) THEN '非药品'

           WHEN a.presc_type = '0' THEN '西药'
           WHEN a.presc_type = '1' THEN '中药'

           ELSE '非药品'
       END AS ITEM_TYPE_NAME, -- 处方项类别名称

       NVL(pharm_map.value_domain_code, '99') AS DRUG_CLASS_CODE, -- 药品分类代码

       NVL(pharm_map.value_domain_name, '其它化学药物') AS DRUG_CLASS_NAME, -- 药品分类名称

       NVL(std.ypid_code, t.drug_code) AS DRUG_CODE, -- 药物编码

       NVL(std.product_name, t.drug_name) AS DRUG_COMMON_NAME, -- 药物通用名

       SUBSTR(t.drug_name, 1, 100) AS DRUG_NAME, -- 药物名称

       SUBSTR(
           NVL(t.package_spec, t.drug_spec),
           1,
           100
       ) AS SPEC, -- 规格

       SUBSTR(
           NVL(t.package_units, dd.units),
           1,
           6
       ) AS UNIT, -- 单位

       CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(12, 2)) AS DRUG_DOSE, -- 药物日剂量，暂无可靠来源

       CAST(
           ROUND(t.dosage_each, 2)
           AS NUMBER(12, 2)
       ) AS ONCE_AMOUNT, -- 药物使用单次量

       CASE
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.dosage_units)) IN ('g', '克') THEN '1'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.dosage_units)) IN ('mg', '毫克') THEN '2'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.dosage_units)) IN ('μg', 'ug', 'mcg', '微克') THEN '3'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.dosage_units)) IN ('l', '升') THEN '5'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.dosage_units)) IN ('ml', '毫升') THEN '6'
           WHEN UPPER(TRIM(t.dosage_units)) IN ('IU', '万IU', 'AXAIU') THEN '7'
           WHEN UPPER(TRIM(t.dosage_units)) IN ('U', '万U')
             OR TRIM(t.dosage_units) IN ('单位', '万u', 'u') THEN '8'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(t.dosage_units)), '^g(口服|po|qd|bid|tid|qid).*') THEN '1'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(t.dosage_units)), '^mg(口服|po|qd|bid|tid|qid).*') THEN '2'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(t.dosage_units)), '^ml(口服|po|qd|bid|tid|qid).*') THEN '6'
           ELSE CAST('-' AS VARCHAR2(6))
       END AS DOSAGE_UNIT, -- 剂量单位代码

       CASE
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.dosage_units)) IN ('g', '克') THEN 'g'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.dosage_units)) IN ('mg', '毫克') THEN 'mg'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.dosage_units)) IN ('μg', 'ug', 'mcg', '微克') THEN 'μg'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.dosage_units)) IN ('l', '升') THEN 'L'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.dosage_units)) IN ('ml', '毫升') THEN 'ml'
           WHEN UPPER(TRIM(t.dosage_units)) IN ('IU', '万IU', 'AXAIU') THEN 'IU'
           WHEN UPPER(TRIM(t.dosage_units)) IN ('U', '万U')
             OR TRIM(t.dosage_units) IN ('单位', '万u', 'u') THEN 'U'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(t.dosage_units)), '^g(口服|po|qd|bid|tid|qid).*') THEN 'g'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(t.dosage_units)), '^mg(口服|po|qd|bid|tid|qid).*') THEN 'mg'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(LOWER(TRIM(t.dosage_units)), '^ml(口服|po|qd|bid|tid|qid).*') THEN 'ml'
           ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(8))
       END AS JL_UNIT, -- 剂量单位名称

       CAST(
           ROUND(
               CASE
                   WHEN NVL(t.flag, a.flag) = 2 THEN -ABS(t.quantity)
                   ELSE t.quantity
               END,
               2
           ) AS NUMBER(8, 2)
       ) AS QUANTITY, -- 数量，退药时为负数

       CASE
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(t.drug_name, '饮片')
             OR dd.drug_indicator = 2
           THEN NVL(a.repetition, 1)
           ELSE CAST(NULL AS NUMBER)
       END AS HERB_NUM, -- 草药付数

       CAST(
           ROUND(dd.dose_per_unit, 2)
           AS NUMBER(9, 2)
       ) AS UNIT_DOSE, -- 单位剂量

       CAST(
           ROUND(t.dosage_each, 2)
           AS NUMBER(8, 2)
       ) AS ORDER_DOSAGE, -- 医嘱用量

       CAST(
           ROUND(
               CASE
                   WHEN NVL(t.flag, a.flag) = 2 THEN -ABS(t.quantity)
                   ELSE t.quantity
               END,
               2
           ) AS NUMBER(12, 2)
       ) AS ALL_AMOUNT, -- 药物使用总量

       SUBSTR(route_map.standard_code, 1, 4) AS DRUG_ROUTE_CODE, -- 用药方式代码

       SUBSTR(NVL(route_map.standard_name, t.administration), 1, 50) AS DRUG_ROUTE_NAME, -- 用药方式

       CASE
           /* 标准频次代码本身 */
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.frequency)) = 'bid' THEN 'bid'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.frequency)) = 'bidac' THEN 'bidac'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.frequency)) = 'tidac' THEN 'tidac'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.frequency)) = 'biw' THEN 'biw'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.frequency)) = 'hs' THEN 'hs'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.frequency)) = 'prn' THEN 'prn'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.frequency)) = 'q12h' THEN 'q12h'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.frequency)) = 'q12h1' THEN 'q12h1'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.frequency)) = 'q12h2' THEN 'q12h2'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.frequency)) = 'q1h' THEN 'q1h'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.frequency)) = 'q2h' THEN 'q2h'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.frequency)) = 'q3h' THEN 'q3h'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.frequency)) = 'q4h' THEN 'q4h'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.frequency)) = 'q6h' THEN 'q6h'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.frequency)) = 'q6h1' THEN 'q6h1'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.frequency)) = 'q6h2' THEN 'q6h2'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.frequency)) = 'q8h' THEN 'q8h'

           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(t.administration), '雾化吸入|雾化吸入Ⅰ号|压力雾化|吸入') THEN '吸入用药'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(t.administration), '局部麻醉|局醉|浸润麻醉|局部注射|局部用药') THEN '局部用药'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(t.administration), '会阴冲洗|膀胱灌注|膀胱冲洗|宫腔注射|宫颈上药|宫颈注射|直肠粘膜注射|瘤体内注射|介入治疗|肿瘤灌注|穴位封闭|穴位注射|鼻穴位注射|耳穴位注射|耳后局部注射|前房注射|玻璃体腔内注射|眼内注射|球后注射|球旁注射|半球后注射|结膜下注射|咽后壁注射|口腔粘膜注射|粘膜下注射|管道冲洗|创腔冲洗|器械冲洗|盆腔冲洗|腔内给药|引流管内注入|鼓窦内给药') THEN '其他局部用药途径'
           WHEN TRIM(t.administration) IN (
                'FREQ_DETAIL',
                '血液滤过',
                '血液透析滤过',
                '血液透析',
                '血管造影',
                '葡萄糖试验',
                '葡萄糖耐量',
                '市门统',
                '（久煎）',
                '（冲服）',
                '（后下）',
                '||07--07',
                '||04--04'
           ) THEN '其他用药途径'
           ELSE '其他用药途径'
       END AS DRUG_WAY_NAME, -- 药物使用途径名称

       CAST(
           GREATEST(
               NVL(
                   t.abidance,
                   CASE
                       WHEN a.presc_type = '1' THEN NVL(a.repetition, 1)
                       ELSE 1
                   END
               ),
               1
           ) AS NUMBER(5)
       ) AS DURATION_TIME, -- 持续用药天数

       CAST(
           ROUND(
               CASE
                   WHEN NVL(t.flag, a.flag) = 2 THEN -ABS(t.costs)
                   ELSE t.costs
               END,
               2
           ) AS NUMBER(9, 2)
       ) AS DRUG_AMOUNT, -- 药物金额

       CASE
           WHEN dd.drug_indicator = 2 THEN '9'
           ELSE NULL
       END AS TCM_DECOCTION_METHOD, -- 中药饮片煎煮法

       CASE
           WHEN a.presc_type = '1' THEN SUBSTR(a.memo, 1, 100)
           ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100))
       END AS MEDICATION_METHOD, -- 中药用药方法

       CAST(
           ROUND(
               NVL(
                   (
                       SELECT MAX(pl.retail_price)
                              KEEP (
                                  DENSE_RANK LAST
                                  ORDER BY pl.start_date
                              )
                         FROM HIS.drug_price_list pl
                        WHERE pl.drug_code = t.drug_code
                          AND pl.drug_spec = NVL(t.package_spec, t.drug_spec)
                          AND pl.firm_id = t.firm_id
                          AND pl.start_date <= a.presc_date
                          AND (
                              pl.stop_date IS NULL
                              OR pl.stop_date >= a.presc_date
                          )
                   ),
                   CASE
                       WHEN NVL(t.quantity, 0) <> 0 THEN ABS(t.costs / t.quantity)
                       ELSE NULL
                   END
               ),
               2
           ) AS NUMBER(9, 2)
       ) AS DRUG_PRICE, -- 药物单价

       CASE
           WHEN a.presc_type = '1' THEN SUBSTR(a.memo, 1, 2000)
           ELSE CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(2000))
       END AS CH_DRUG_NOTES, -- 中药饮片处方描述

       SUBSTR(a.clinic_no, 1, 18) AS OUTPATIENT_NUM, -- 本次门诊标识号

       SUBSTR(a.name, 1, 50) AS NAME, -- 患者姓名

       CASE TRIM(pmi.sex)
           WHEN '男' THEN '1'
           WHEN '女' THEN '2'
           WHEN '未知' THEN '0'
           WHEN '不详' THEN '9'
           WHEN '未说明' THEN '9'
           ELSE '9'
       END AS SEX_CODE, -- 患者性别代码

       NVL(SUBSTR(pmi.id_no, 1, 18), '000000000000000000') AS ID_NUM, -- 患者身份证件号码，保留原逻辑

       CASE
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.frequency)) IN ('st', 'prn')
             OR TRIM(t.frequency) IN ('立即', '必要时', '术前', '术晨', '术前30’', '皮试')
           THEN '2'
           WHEN t.frequency IS NULL THEN '9'
           ELSE '2'
       END AS ODR_TYPE, -- 处方类别编码：门诊处方默认临时，保留原逻辑

       SUBSTR(
           a.clinic_no
           || '|' || NVL(CAST(t.order_no AS VARCHAR2(50)), '0')
           || '|' || NVL(CAST(t.order_sub_no AS VARCHAR2(50)), '0'),
           1,
           100
       ) AS ORDER_ITEM_CODE, -- 院内医嘱编号

       SUBSTR(t.drug_name, 1, 100) AS ORDER_ITEM_NAME, -- 院内医嘱项名称

       '1' AS ORDER_CATEGORY_CODE, -- 医嘱项目大类别编码：药品类

       '药品类医嘱' AS ORDER_CATEGORY_NAME, -- 医嘱项目大类别名称

       CASE
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.dosage_units)) IN ('g', '克') THEN 'g'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.dosage_units)) IN ('mg', '毫克') THEN 'mg'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.dosage_units)) IN ('μg', 'ug', 'mcg', '微克') THEN 'μg'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.dosage_units)) IN ('l', '升') THEN 'L'
           WHEN LOWER(TRIM(t.dosage_units)) IN ('ml', '毫升') THEN 'ml'
           WHEN UPPER(TRIM(t.dosage_units)) IN ('IU', '万IU', 'AXAIU') THEN 'IU'
           WHEN UPPER(TRIM(t.dosage_units)) IN ('U', '万U')
             OR TRIM(t.dosage_units) IN ('单位', '万u', 'u') THEN 'U'
           ELSE SUBSTR(t.dosage_units, 1, 100)
       END AS ORDER_NUM_NAME, -- 医嘱用量单位

       CASE
           WHEN NVL(t.flag, a.flag) = 2 THEN '2'
           ELSE '1'
       END AS ORDER_STATUS, -- 医嘱有效标识，1有效、2无效

       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS DTCODE, -- 药品追溯码，暂无可靠来源

       SUBSTR(insur_map.ylxmbm, 1, 100) AS NHSA_STANDARD_CODE, -- 医保贯标码

       SUBSTR(
           CAST(dd.dose_per_unit AS VARCHAR2(100)),
           1,
           100
       ) AS DOSAGE, -- 最小剂量

       dd.dose_units AS DOSAGE_UNIT_NAME, -- 最小剂量单位名称

       SUBSTR(
           NVL(t.package_units, dd.units),
           1,
           100
       ) AS DRUG_ALL_UNIT, -- 药品包装单位

       (
           SELECT MAX(pl.amount_per_package)
                  KEEP (
                      DENSE_RANK LAST
                      ORDER BY pl.start_date
                  )
             FROM HIS.drug_price_list pl
            WHERE pl.drug_code = t.drug_code
              AND pl.drug_spec = NVL(t.package_spec, t.drug_spec)
              AND pl.firm_id = t.firm_id
              AND pl.start_date <= a.presc_date
              AND (
                  pl.stop_date IS NULL
                  OR pl.stop_date >= a.presc_date
              )
       ) AS DRUG_ALL_NUM, -- 药品包装量，保留原取值逻辑

       CAST(
           GREATEST(
               NVL(
                   t.abidance,
                   CASE
                       WHEN a.presc_type = '1' THEN NVL(a.repetition, 1)
                       ELSE 1
                   END
               ),
               1
           ) AS NUMBER
       ) AS ADMINISTRATION_DAYS, -- 执行天数

       CASE
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(t.administration), '输液泵|静脉泵入|微量泵入|泵入') THEN '输液泵泵入'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(t.administration), '皮下注射') THEN '皮下注射'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(t.administration), '皮内注射|皮试') THEN '皮内注射'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(t.administration), '肌肉注射') THEN '肌肉注射'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(t.administration), '静脉滴注|静脉输液|续静滴|静脉注射|静脉推注|静脉壶内给药|静脉化疗|脐静脉给药|静脉封管|封管') THEN '静脉注射或静脉滴注'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(t.administration), '鞘内注射') THEN '鞘内注射'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(t.administration), '椎管内') THEN '椎管内用药'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(t.administration), '关节腔注射|关节腔冲洗|关节腔') THEN '关节腔内用药'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(t.administration), '胸腔注射|胸腔冲洗|胸膜腔') THEN '胸膜腔用药'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(t.administration), '腹腔注射|腹腔冲洗|腹腔灌注|腹腔用药|腹膜透析') THEN '腹腔用药'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(t.administration), '阴道内置药|阴道冲洗|阴道用药|阴道') THEN '阴道用药'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(t.administration), '气管滴药|气管内') THEN '气管内用药'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(t.administration), '滴左眼|滴右眼|滴双眼|滴眼|涂左眼|涂右眼|涂双眼|涂眼膏') THEN '滴眼'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(t.administration), '滴左耳|滴右耳|滴双耳|滴耳') THEN '滴耳'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(t.administration), '滴鼻|喷鼻|鼻腔冲洗') THEN '滴鼻'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(t.administration), '喷喉|口腔喷雾') THEN '喷喉'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(t.administration), '舌下含化|舌下|口含|含化|含漱') THEN '含化'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(t.administration), '敷伤口|湿敷') THEN '敷伤口'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(t.administration), '擦皮肤|外用|涂擦|涂剂') THEN '擦皮肤'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(t.administration), '口服|冲服|煎服|嚼服|泡服|胃管内注入|鼻空肠管注入|空肠造瘘管内注入|空肠造瘘注入') THEN '口服'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(t.administration), '直肠|肛门注入|肛塞|肛用|保留灌肠|清洁灌肠|灌肠') THEN '直肠用药'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(t.administration), '雾化吸入|雾化吸入Ⅰ号|压力雾化|吸入') THEN '吸入用药'
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(t.administration), '局部麻醉|局醉|浸润麻醉|局部注射|局部用药') THEN '局部用药'
           ELSE '其他用药途径'
       END AS DRUG_ADMINISTRATION_ROUTE, -- 给药途径

       '0' AS IS_EXTERNAL_PRES -- 是否外配处方，院内处方填0

  FROM HIS.drug_presc_master a

  JOIN HIS.drug_presc_detail t
    ON t.presc_date = a.presc_date
   AND t.presc_no   = a.presc_no

  JOIN HIS.clinic_master d
    ON d.clinic_no  = a.clinic_no
   AND d.patient_id = a.patient_id

  JOIN HIS.pat_master_index pmi
    ON pmi.patient_id = a.patient_id

  LEFT JOIN HIS.med_dict_baseinfo m
    ON m.drug_id = t.drug_code

  LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT x.drug_code,
               x.drug_spec,
               x.drug_name,
               x.units,
               x.drug_form,
               x.dose_per_unit,
               x.dose_units,
               x.drug_indicator
          FROM (
                SELECT dd.drug_code,
                       dd.drug_spec,
                       dd.drug_name,
                       dd.units,
                       dd.drug_form,
                       dd.dose_per_unit,
                       dd.dose_units,
                       dd.drug_indicator,
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                           PARTITION BY dd.drug_code,
                                        dd.drug_spec
                           ORDER BY dd.rowid
                       ) AS rn
                  FROM HIS.drug_dict dd
               ) x
         WHERE x.rn = 1
       ) dd
    ON dd.drug_code = t.drug_code
   AND dd.drug_spec = t.drug_spec

  LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT g.F008_HIS_YAO_PIN_BIAN_MA AS his_drug_code,
               MAX(g.F004_YPID11_3) AS ypid_code,
               MAX(g.F007_CHAN_PIN_MING_CHENG) AS product_name
          FROM DRUG_STANDARD_DICT g
         GROUP BY g.F008_HIS_YAO_PIN_BIAN_MA
       ) std
    ON std.his_drug_code = t.drug_code

  LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT zd.院标编码 AS local_code,
               MAX(zd.国标编码) AS standard_code,
               MAX(zd.国标名称) AS standard_name
          FROM CDA.cda_dictionary zd
         WHERE zd.字典名称 IN (
                   '用药途径代码',
                   '给药途径代码',
                   '药物使用途径代码'
               )
         GROUP BY zd.院标编码
       ) route_map
    ON route_map.local_code = t.administration

  LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT v.hospital_code,
               MAX(v.value_domain_code) AS value_domain_code,
               MAX(v.value_domain_name) AS value_domain_name
          FROM CDA_VALUE_DOMAIN_MAP v
         WHERE v.category_code = 'CV08.50.002'
         GROUP BY v.hospital_code
       ) form_map
    ON form_map.hospital_code = m.dose_model_code

  LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT p.dict_code,
               MAX(v.value_domain_code) AS value_domain_code,
               MAX(v.value_domain_name) AS value_domain_name
          FROM PORTAL_USER.portal_sys_dict p
          JOIN CDA_VALUE_DOMAIN_MAP v
            ON v.hospital_code = p.dict_code
           AND v.category_code = 'CC99.00203'
         WHERE p.type_code = 'pharmacology_type'
         GROUP BY p.dict_code
       ) pharm_map
    ON pharm_map.dict_code = m.phy_class

  LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT dict_code,
               MAX(dict_name) AS dict_name
          FROM PORTAL_USER.portal_sys_dict
         WHERE type_code = 'jy'
         GROUP BY dict_code
       ) jy_dict
    ON jy_dict.dict_code = CAST(m.basicdrug AS VARCHAR2(100))

  LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT dict_code,
               MAX(dict_name) AS dict_name
          FROM PORTAL_USER.portal_sys_dict
         WHERE type_code = 'kss'
         GROUP BY dict_code
       ) kss_dict
    ON kss_dict.dict_code = CAST(m.anti_flag AS VARCHAR2(100))

  LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT item_code,
               MAX(ylxmbm) AS ylxmbm
          FROM HIS.insur_vsh_center_item_new
         GROUP BY item_code
       ) insur_map
    ON insur_map.item_code = t.drug_code

 WHERE a.presc_source = '0'
   AND (a.flag = 1 OR a.flag IS NULL)
   AND a.costs > 0
   AND d.visit_date >= DATE '2021-01-01'
   AND d.visit_date <  DATE '2025-01-01'

V_EMR_OUTPATIENT_RECORD.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_OUTPATIENT_RECORD" ("ID", "OUTPATIENT_NUM", "NAME", "CZRK_ID", "ID_NUM", "OTHER_CARD_CODE", "OTHER_CARD_NO", "CLINIC_EMERGENCY_MARK_CODE", "FALG_FIRST_VISIT", "FALG_FIRST_VISIT_NAME", "CHIEF_COMPLAINT", "MEDICAL_HISTORY", "EXAMINATION_RECORD", "TCM_WM_MARK_CODE", "TCM_WM_MARK_NAME", "ADMIN_ILLNESS_CODE", "ADMIN_ILLNESS_NAME", "OTHER_ILLNESS_CODE", "OTHER_ILLNESS_NAME", "DIAGNOSIS_SUGGESTION", "DIAGNOSIS_ALL_COST", "SELF_ALL_COST", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "TREATMENT_SECTION_CODE", "TREATMENT_SECTION_NAME", "TREATMENT_DOC_ID_NUM", "TREATMENT_DOC_ID_NAME", "TREATMENT_DATE", "DISTRICT_CODE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "TREATMENT", "REGISTRATION_NUMBER", "IS_BMIDO", "CAMPUS_CODE", "CAMPUS_NAME", "MARRIAGE", "NATIONALITY", "PROFESSION", "EDU_BACKGROUND", "NATION_CODE", "EMERGENCY_LEVEL", "INSU_TYPE_CODE", "INSU_TYPE_NAME", "PHYSICIAN_CERTIFICATE_NO", "PHYSICIAN_TITLE", "PERMANENT_PROVINCE", "PERMANENT_CITY", "PERMANENT_COUNTY", "PERMANENT_TOWN") AS 
  select substr(
           '49557032X' || '|' ||
           nvl(t.clinic_no, '-') || '|' ||
           nvl(a.patient_id, '-') || '|' ||
           to_char(a.visit_date, 'yyyymmdd') || '|' ||
           nvl(to_char(a.visit_no), '-') || '|' ||
           nvl(to_char(a.ordinal), '-'),
           1,
           100
       ) as ID,-- 内码 是 主键

       substr(nvl(t.clinic_no, t.patient_id||to_char(t.visit_date,'yyyymmdd')), 1, 18)
           as OUTPATIENT_NUM,-- 本次门诊标识符

       substr(nvl(pmi.name, a.patient_id), 1, 50)
           as NAME,-- 姓名

       cast(null as varchar2(36))
           as CZRK_ID,-- 常住人口ID

       substr(pmi.id_no, 1, 18)
           as ID_NUM,-- 身份证号码

       cast(null as char(11))
           as OTHER_CARD_CODE,-- 其他证件类别代码

       cast(null as varchar2(18))
           as OTHER_CARD_NO,-- 其他证件号码

       case
           when t.clinic_type = '留观' then '3'
           when t.clinic_type like '%急诊%' then '1'
           else '2'
       end as CLINIC_EMERGENCY_MARK_CODE,-- 门诊/急诊标志代码

       /*
        * 保留原初复诊判断逻辑。
        * 建议通过CLINIC_MASTER复合索引优化。
        */
       case
           when t.clinic_type = '留观' then '3'
           when exists (
                    select 1
                      from his.clinic_master x
                     where x.patient_id = t.patient_id
                       and x.returned_date is null
                       and x.registering_date < t.registering_date
                       and rownum = 1
                )
           then '2'
           else '1'
       end as FALG_FIRST_VISIT,-- 初复诊标志代码

       case
           when t.clinic_type = '留观' then '留观'
           when exists (
                    select 1
                      from his.clinic_master x
                     where x.patient_id = t.patient_id
                       and x.returned_date is null
                       and x.registering_date < t.registering_date
                       and rownum = 1
                )
           then '复诊'
           else '初诊'
       end as FALG_FIRST_VISIT_NAME,-- 初复诊标志名称

       substr(nvl(a.illness_desc, '未记录'), 1, 2000)
           as CHIEF_COMPLAINT,-- 主诉记录

       substr(nvl(a.anamnesis, '未记录'), 1, 2000)
           as MEDICAL_HISTORY,-- 病史

       substr(a.body_exam, 1, 2000)
           as EXAMINATION_RECORD,-- 体格检查记录

       case
           when a.cdiag is not null then '1'
           else '2'
       end as TCM_WM_MARK_CODE,-- 中医/西医诊断类型

       case
           when a.cdiag is not null then '中医'
           else '西医'
       end as TCM_WM_MARK_NAME,-- 中医/西医诊断类型名称

       /*
        * 原SQL中四次查询OUTP_MR_DIAG_DESC和CDA_DICTIONARY，
        * 现改为下方DG内联视图一次汇总。
        */
       substr(dg.admin_illness_code, 1, 50)         as ADMIN_ILLNESS_CODE,-- 主要诊断疾病代码

       cast(
           substrb(
               coalesce(
                   dg.admin_illness_name,
                   nullif(trim(to_char(a.diag_desc)), ''),
                   '-'
               ),
               1,
               100
           ) as varchar2(100)
       ) as ADMIN_ILLNESS_NAME,-- 主要诊断疾病名称

       substr(dg.other_illness_code, 1, 50)
           as OTHER_ILLNESS_CODE,-- 其他诊断疾病代码1

       cast(
           substrb(
               dg.other_illness_name,
               1,
               100
           ) as varchar2(100)
       ) as OTHER_ILLNESS_NAME,-- 其他诊断疾病名称1

       substr(a.advice, 1, 1000)
           as DIAGNOSIS_SUGGESTION,-- 治疗处理意见

       cast(nvl(e.total_costs, 0) as number(10, 2))
           as DIAGNOSIS_ALL_COST,-- 诊疗总费用

       cast(null as number(10, 2))
           as SELF_ALL_COST,-- 个人支付诊疗费用

       '49557032X'
           as ORG_CODE,-- 就诊医疗机构编码

       '山东省第二人民医院'
           as ORG_NAME,-- 就诊医疗机构名称

       substr(
           nvl(
               (
                   select d.qmpt_code
                     from his.dept_dict d
                    where d.dept_code = t.visit_dept
                      and rownum = 1
               ),
               t.visit_dept
           ),
           1,
           20
       ) as TREATMENT_SECTION_CODE,-- 就诊科室编码

       cast(
           substrb(
               coalesce(
                   (
                       select max(to_char(d.qmpt_name))
                         from his.dept_dict d
                        where d.dept_code = t.visit_dept
                   ),
                   (
                       select max(to_char(d.dept_name))
                         from his.dept_dict d
                        where d.dept_code = t.visit_dept
                   ),
                   to_char(t.visit_dept),
                   '-'
               ),
               1,
               50
           ) as varchar2(50)
       ) as TREATMENT_SECTION_NAME,-- 就诊科室名称

       substr(
           (
               select max(
                          case
                              when regexp_like(
                                       upper(c.id_no),
                                       '^[0-9]{17}([0-9]|X)$'
                                   )
                              then upper(c.id_no)
                          end
                      )
                 from his.staff_dict c
                where c.emp_no = a.doctor_no
           ),
           1,
           18
       ) as TREATMENT_DOC_ID_NUM,-- 就诊医师身份证号

       substr(
           nvl(

  /*
   * 先过滤CLINIC_MASTER的日期和退号状态，
   * 减少后续参与连接的数据量。
   */
  from (
        select cm.*
          from his.clinic_master cm
         where cm.returned_date is null
           and cm.registering_date >= date '2021-01-01'
           and cm.registering_date <  date '2025-01-01'
       ) t

  /*
   * ORDINAL='1'提前过滤。
   * 日期关联改为范围判断，等价于：
   * TRUNC(A.VISIT_DATE)=TRUNC(T.VISIT_DATE)
   */
  inner join (
        select mr.*
          from his.outp_mr mr
         where mr.ordinal = '1'
       ) a
          on a.patient_id = t.patient_id
         and a.visit_no   = t.visit_no
         and a.visit_date >= trunc(t.visit_date)
         and a.visit_date <  trunc(t.visit_date) + 1

  inner join his.pat_master_index pmi
          on pmi.patient_id = a.patient_id

  /*
   * 费用汇总保留原口径：
   * 患者+收费日期汇总未退费记录。
   *
   * 增加2021-2025日期条件，不改变结果，
   * 因为主查询只关联该范围内的就诊日期。
   */
  left join (
        select r.patient_id,
               trunc(r.visit_date) as rcpt_date,
               sum(nvl(r.total_costs, 0)) as total_costs
          from his.outp_rcpt_master r
         where r.refunded_rcpt_no is null
           and r.visit_date >= date '2021-01-01'
           and r.visit_date <  date '2025-01-01'
         group by r.patient_id,
                  trunc(r.visit_date)
       ) e
         on e.patient_id = t.patient_id
        and e.rcpt_date  = trunc(t.registering_date)

  /*
   * 一次性取得主诊断、其他诊断的编码和名称，
   * 替代原SQL中的四个相关子查询。
   */
  left join (
        select d.patient_id,
               d.visit_no,
               d.visit_date,

               nvl(
                   max(
                       case
                           when to_char(d.item_no) = '1'
                           then dict.gb_code_any
                       end
                   ),
                   max(
                       case
                           when to_char(d.item_no) = '1'
                           then to_char(d.diag_code)
                       end
                   )
               ) as admin_illness_code,

               nvl(
                   max(
                       case
                           when to_char(d.item_no) = '1'
                           then dict.gb_name_prefix
                       end
                   ),
                   max(
                       case
                           when to_char(d.item_no) = '1'
                           then to_char(d.diag_desc)
                       end
                   )
               ) as admin_illness_name,

               nvl(
                   max(
                       case
                           when to_char(d.item_no) = '2'
                           then dict.gb_code_any
                       end
                   ),
                   max(
                       case
                           when to_char(d.item_no) = '2'
                           then to_char(d.diag_code)
                       end
                   )
               ) as other_illness_code,

               nvl(
                   max(
                       case
                           when to_char(d.item_no) = '2'
                           then dict.gb_name_any
                       end
                   ),
                   max(
                       case
                           when to_char(d.item_no) = '2'
                           then to_char(d.diag_desc)
                       end
                   )
               ) as other_illness_name

          from his.outp_mr_diag_desc d
          left join (
                select cd.院标编码,

                       max(
                           case
                               when cd.字典名称 like '%ICD-10%'
                               then to_char(cd.国标编码)
                           end
                       ) as gb_code_any,

                       max(
                           case
                               when cd.字典名称 like 'ICD-10%'
                               then to_char(cd.国标名称)
                           end
                       ) as gb_name_prefix,

                       max(
                           case
                               when cd.字典名称 like '%ICD-10%'
                               then to_char(cd.国标名称)
                           end
                       ) as gb_name_any

                  from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                 where cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                   and cd.字典名称 like '%ICD-10%'
                 group by cd.院标编码
               ) dict
            on dict.院标编码 = d.diag_code

         where to_char(d.item_no) in ('1', '2')

         group by d.patient_id,
                  d.visit_no,
                  d.visit_date
       ) dg
         on dg.patient_id = t.patient_id
        and dg.visit_no   = t.visit_no
        and dg.visit_date = a.visit_date

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."V_EMR_OUTPATIENT_REGISTER" ("ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "OUTPATIENT_NUM", "CASE_NUM", "NAME", "SEX_CODE", "SEX_NAME", "BORN_DATE", "FLAG_LOCAL", "AGE", "AGE_MONTH", "AGE_DAY", "AGE_HOUR", "HEALTH_CARD_NUM", "HEALTH_RECORD_NUM", "INSURANCE_NUM", "ID_NUM", "OTHER_ID_TYPE", "OTHER_ID_TYPE_NAME", "OTHER_ID_NUM", "PATIENT_ADDR", "PROVINCE", "CITY", "COUNTY", "TOWN", "VILLAGE", "HOUSE_NUM", "WORKING_ORG", "LINKMAN_RELATION", "LINKMAN", "TEL", "LINKMAN_TEL", "CHARGE_TYPE_CODE", "CHARGE_TYPE_NAME", "REG_TYPE_CODE", "REG_TYPE_NAME", "STD_DEPT_CODE", "DEP_CODE", "DEP_NAME", "HOS_DEP_CODE", "HOS_DEP_NAME", "DOCTOR_CODE", "DOCTOR_NAME", "REG_DATE", "FLAG_REFUND", "FLAG_VISIT", "FALG_FIRST_VISIT", "FLAG_REF", "CASHIER_ID", "CASHIER_NAME", "CITIZEN_ID", "EFFECTIVE_TIME", "STATUS", "DISTRICT_CODE", "EXCHANGE_TYPE", "DEI", "NODE_CODE", "ID_TYPE", "SYSTEM_TIME", "CZRK_ID", "DOC_ID_NUM", "OUTPATIENT_CODE", "REGISTER_TYPE", "REGISTER_TYPE_NAME", "REGISTER_FEE", "REGISTER_DATE", "APP_DATE", "REG_FEE") AS 
  select substr(
           '49557032X' || '|' ||
           nvl(a.clinic_no, a.patient_id || '|' || to_char(a.registering_date, 'yyyymmddhh24miss')),
           1,
           100
       ) as ID,-- 内码 是 主键

       '49557032X' as ORG_CODE,-- 医院组织机构代码 是 必填

       '山东省第二人民医院' as ORG_NAME,-- 医院名称 是 必填，填写标准医院名称

       substr(nvl(a.clinic_no, a.patient_id||to_char(a.visit_date,'yyyymmdd')), 1, 18) as OUTPATIENT_NUM,-- 本次门诊标识号 是 必填，唯一

       substr(a.patient_id, 1, 20) as CASE_NUM,-- 病历号

       substr(nvl(a.name, b.name), 1, 50) as NAME,-- 姓名 是 必填，病人的姓名

       decode(
           b.sex,
           '男', '1',
           '女', '2',
           '未知', '0',
           decode(a.sex, '1', '1', '男', '1', '2', '2', '女', '2', '未知', '0', '9')
       ) as SEX_CODE,-- 性别代码 是 值域：0未知，1男，2女，9不明

       decode(
           b.sex,
           '男', '男',
           '女', '女',
           '未知', '未知',
           decode(a.sex, '1', '男', '2', '女', '男', '男', '女', '女', '未知', '未知', '不明')
       ) as SEX_NAME,-- 性别 是

      nvl(cast(b.date_of_birth as date), date '1900-01-01') as BORN_DATE,-- 出生日期  as BORN_DATE,-- 出生日期 是 字符型改为时间类型

       cast(null as char(1)) as FLAG_LOCAL,-- 本地户籍标识 1:是 0否

       case
           when b.date_of_birth is not null
            and a.registering_date is not null
            and a.registering_date >= b.date_of_birth
           then least(greatest(trunc(months_between(a.registering_date, b.date_of_birth) / 12), 0), 200)
           when a.age is not null
           then least(greatest(a.age, 0), 200)
           else cast(null as number)
       end as AGE,-- 年龄 是 范围在0-200之间，不足1周岁填0

       case
           when b.date_of_birth is not null
            and a.registering_date is not null
            and a.registering_date >= b.date_of_birth
           then least(greatest(mod(trunc(months_between(a.registering_date, b.date_of_birth)), 12), 0), 11)
           else cast(null as number)
       end as AGE_MONTH,-- 年龄（月）

       case
           when b.date_of_birth is not null
            and a.registering_date is not null
            and a.registering_date >= b.date_of_birth
           then least(
                    greatest(
                        trunc(
                            a.registering_date -
                            add_months(
                                b.date_of_birth,
                                trunc(months_between(a.registering_date, b.date_of_birth))
                            )
                        ),
                        0
                    ),
                    30
                )
           else cast(null as number)
       end as AGE_DAY,-- 年龄（天）

       case
           when b.date_of_birth is not null
            and a.registering_date is not null
            and a.registering_date >= b.date_of_birth
           then least(
                    greatest(
                        trunc(
                            24 * (
                                (
                                    a.registering_date -
                                    add_months(
                                        b.date_of_birth,
                                        trunc(months_between(a.registering_date, b.date_of_birth))
                                    )
                                )
                                -
                                trunc(
                                    a.registering_date -
                                    add_months(
                                        b.date_of_birth,
                                        trunc(months_between(a.registering_date, b.date_of_birth))
                                    )
                                )
                            )
                        ),
                        0
                    ),
                    23
                )
           else cast(null as number)
       end as AGE_HOUR,-- 年龄（小时）

       cast(null as varchar2(32)) as HEALTH_CARD_NUM,-- 健康卡号

       end as REG_TYPE_CODE,-- 挂号类别代码 是 值域：1便民门诊，2普通门诊，3专家门诊，4急诊，5留观，9其他

       case
