CDR_OUTPATIENT_DIAG.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."CDR_OUTPATIENT_DIAG" ("ID", "PATIENT_ID", "OUT_PATIENT_ID", "HEALTH_CARD_NO", "OUTP_NO", "VISIT_ID", "VISIT_TYPE_CODE", "VISIT_TYPE_NAME", "EMERGENCY_VISIT_IND", "DIAGNOSIS_DEPT_CODE", "DIAGNOSIS_DEPT_NAME", "DIAGNOSIS_DOCTOR_CODE", "DIAGNOSIS_DOCTOR_NAME", "DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "ICD_CODE", "ICD_NAME", "DIAGNOSIS_NUM", "DIAGNOSIS_TIME", "DIAGNOSIS_TYPE_CODE", "DIAGNOSIS_TYPE_NAME", "DIAGNOSIS_DESC") AS 
  select
       a.patient_id||'|'||a.visit_no||'|'||a.ordinal as id ,
       a.patient_id as patient_id,
       a.patient_id as OUT_PATIENT_ID,--门诊患者标识
       '' as HEALTH_CARD_NO,--健康卡号
       '' as OUTP_NO,--门诊号
       b.clinic_no as VISIT_ID,--就诊流水号
       '01' as VISIT_TYPE_CODE,--就诊类型编码
       '门诊' as VISIT_TYPE_NAME,--就诊类型名称
       case when b.clinic_type like'%急诊%' then 'true'
          else 'false' end as EMERGENCY_VISIT_IND,--急诊就诊标识
       b.visit_dept as  DIAGNOSIS_DEPT_CODE,--诊断科室编码
       (select t.dept_name from his.dept_dict t where b.visit_dept=t.dept_code) as DIAGNOSIS_DEPT_NAME,--诊断科室名称
       a.doctor_no as DIAGNOSIS_DOCTOR_CODE,--诊断医生编码
       a.doctor as DIAGNOSIS_DOCTOR_NAME,--诊断医生名称
       a.diag_desc_code as DIAGNOSIS_CODE,--诊断编码
       a.diag_desc as DIAGNOSIS_NAME,--诊断名称
       a.diag_desc_code as ICD_CODE，--ICD编码
       a.diag_desc AS ICD_NAME,--ICD名称
       a.ordinal as DIAGNOSIS_NUM,--诊断序号
       a.illness_date as DIAGNOSIS_TIME,--诊断时间
       '1' as DIAGNOSIS_TYPE_CODE,--诊断类型编码
       '门诊诊断' as DIAGNOSIS_TYPE_NAME, --诊断类型名称
       '' as DIAGNOSIS_DESC--诊断描述
from his.outp_mr a,his.clinic_master b
where a.visit_date = b.visit_date
and a.visit_no = b.visit_no

CDR_OUTPATIENT_VISIT.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."CDR_OUTPATIENT_VISIT" ("ID", "PATIENT_ID", "OUT_PATIENT_ID", "HEALTH_CARD_NO", "OUTP_NO", "VISIT_ID", "VISIT_TYPE_CODE", "VISIT_TYPE_NAME", "EMERGENCY_VISIT_IND", "PERSON_NAME", "CHARGE_TYPE_CODE", "CHARGE_TYPE_NAME", "DATE_OF_BIRTH", "ID_CARD_NO", "SEX_CODE", "SEX_NAME", "MARITAL_STATUS_CODE", "MARITAL_STATUS_NAME", "OCCUPATION_CODE", "OCCUPATION_NAME", "PHONE_NUMBER", "MAILING_ADDRESS", "VISIT_DEPT_CODE", "VISIT_DEPT_NAME", "VISIT_DOCTOR_CODE", "VISIT_DOCTOR_NAME", "REG_CATEGORY_CODE", "REG_CATEGORY_NAME", "REG_TYPE_CODE", "REG_TYPE_NAME", "REG_VISIT_SECTION_CODE", "REG_VISIT_SECTION_NAME", "REGISTER_BY_CODE", "REGISTER_BY_NAME", "REGISTING_TIME", "REGISTER_CANCEL_BY_CODE", "REGISTER_CANCEL_BYNAME", "REGISTER_CANCEL_TIME", "SEPARATE_TIME", "SEPARATE_OPER_CODE", "SEPARATE_OPER_NAME", "SEPARATE_NO", "FIRSTV_INDICATOR", "VISIT_TIME", "VISIT_CONSALT_ROOM") AS 
  select distinct
       a.patient_id||'|'||a.clinic_no||'|'||a.VISIT_NO as id ,
       a.patient_id as patient_id,
       a.patient_id as OUT_PATIENT_ID,--门诊患者标识
       '' as HEALTH_CARD_NO,--健康卡号
       '' as OUTP_NO,--门诊号
       a.clinic_no as  visit_id,--就诊流水号
       '01' as VISIT_TYPE_CODE,--就诊类型编码
       '门诊' as VISIT_TYPE_NAME,--就诊类型名称
       case when a.CLINIC_TYPE like'%急诊%' then 'true'
         else 'false' end as EMERGENCY_VISIT_IND,--急诊就诊标识
       a.name as PERSON_NAME,--姓名
       a.Charge_Type as CHARGE_TYPE_CODE,--费别编码
       a.Charge_Type as CHARGE_TYPE_NAME,--费别名称
       to_char(b.date_of_birth,'YYYY-MM-DD') as DATE_OF_BIRTH,--出生日期
       b.id_no as ID_CARD_NO,--证件号
       decode(b.sex,'男','1','女','2') as SEX_CODE,--性别编码
       b.sex as SEX_NAME,--性别名称
       case when b.MARITAL_STATUS='未婚' then '1'
  when b.MARITAL_STATUS='已婚' then '2'
    when b.MARITAL_STATUS='丧偶' then '3'
      when b.MARITAL_STATUS='离婚' then '4'
        when b.MARITAL_STATUS='其他' then '5'
          else b.MARITAL_STATUS end as MARITAL_STATUS_CODE,--婚姻状态编码
       b.MARITAL_STATUS as MARITAL_STATUS_NAME,--婚姻状态名称
       b.Occupation as  OCCUPATION_CODE,--职业编码
       (select od.occupation_name from his.occupation_dict od where od.occupation_code = replace(b.Occupation,' ','')) as OCCUPATION_NAME,--职业名称
       b.Next_Of_Kin_Phone as PHONE_NUMBER,--电话
       b.Patient_Area_Address as MAILING_ADDRESS,--联系详细地址
       a.Visit_Dept as VISIT_DEPT_CODE，--就诊科室编码
       (select t.dept_name from his.dept_dict t where a.Visit_Dept=t.dept_code) as VISIT_DEPT_NAME，--就诊科室名称
       a.Doctor as VISIT_DOCTOR_CODE,--就诊医生工号
       (select t1.name from his.staff_dict t1 where a.doctor=t1.user_name) as VISIT_DOCTOR_NAME,--就诊医生名称
       a.Clinic_Label as REG_CATEGORY_CODE,--号别编码
       a.Clinic_Label as REG_CATEGORY_NAME,--号别名称
       a.Clinic_Type as REG_TYPE_CODE,--号类编码
       a.Clinic_Type as REG_TYPE_NAME,--号类名称
       a.Visit_Time_Desc as REG_VISIT_SECTION_CODE,--出诊时段编码
       a.Visit_Time_Desc as REG_VISIT_SECTION_NAME,--出诊时段名称
       a.operator as REGISTER_BY_CODE,--挂号员工号
       (select t1.name from his.staff_dict t1 where a.operator=t1.id) as REGISTER_BY_NAME,--挂号员名称
       a.registering_date as REGISTING_TIME,--挂号时间
       a.returned_operator  REGISTER_CANCEL_BY_CODE,  --退号操作职工工号
       (select name from his.staff_dict where id = a.returned_operator) as REGISTER_CANCEL_BYNAME,  --退号操作职工姓名
       a.returned_date as REGISTER_CANCEL_TIME,--退号时间
       '' AS SEPARATE_TIME,--分诊时间
       '' as SEPARATE_OPER_CODE,--分诊操作员工号
       '' as SEPARATE_OPER_NAME,--分诊操作员名称
       '' as SEPARATE_NO,--分诊序号
       case when a.First_Visit_Indicator='1' then 'true'
         else 'false' end as firstv_indicator,--初诊标志
       nvl(a.REGISTERING_DATE,a.visit_date) as VISIT_TIME,--就诊时间
      (select t.dept_name from his.dept_dict t where a.visit_dept=t.dept_code) as VISIT_CONSALT_ROOM --就诊诊室
from his.clinic_master a,his.pat_master_index b
where a.patient_id=b.patient_id

CDR_OUT_PRESCRIPTION.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."CDR_OUT_PRESCRIPTION" ("ID", "PATIENT_ID", "OUT_PATIENT_ID", "HEALTH_CARD_NO", "OUTP_NO", "VISIT_ID", "VISIT_TYPE_CODE", "VISIT_TYPE_NAME", "CHARCE_NO", "ORDER_NO", "PARENT_ORDER_NO", "ORDER_CLASS_CODE", "ORDER_CLASS_NAME", "ORDER_ITEM_CODE", "ORDER_ITEM_NAME", "ORDER_DEPT_CODE", "ORDER_DEPT_NAME", "ORDER_DOCTOR_CODE", "ORDER_DOCTOR_NAME", "ORDER_TIME", "ORDER_TEXT", "ORDER_NOTE", "CANCEL_DOCTOR_CODE", "CANCEL_DOCTOR_NAME", "CANCEL_TIME", "CANCEL_REASON", "PRES_STATUS_CODE", "PRES_STATUS_NAME", "FREQUENCY_CODE", "FREQUENCY_NAME", "FREQUENCY_DESC", "DURATION_UNIT", "DURATION_VALUE", "DRUG_ID", "PACKAGE_NO", "SPECIFICATION", "DRUG_AMOUNT_UNIT", "DRUG_AMOUNT_VALUE", "HERB_AMOUNT_UNIT", "HERB_AMOUNT_VALUE", "DOSAGE_UNIT", "DOSAGE_VALUE", "TOTAL_DOSAGE_UNIT", "TOTAL_DOSAGE_VALUE", "PHARMACY_WAY_CODE", "PHARMACY_WAY_NAME", "PRESC_TIME", "PRESC_DEPT_CODE", "PRESC_DEPT_NAME") AS 
  select
        a.patient_id||'|'||to_char(a.presc_date,'yyyy-mm-ddhh24:mi:ss')||'|'||a.presc_no||'|'||b.item_no as id ,
        a.patient_id as patient_id,
        a.patient_id as OUT_PATIENT_ID,--门诊患者标识
        '' as HEALTH_CARD_NO,--健康卡号
        '' as OUTP_NO,--门诊号
        a.clinic_no as VISIT_ID,--就诊流水号
        decode(a.presc_source,'0','01','1','02') as VISIT_TYPE_CODE,--就诊类型编码
        decode(a.presc_source,'0','门诊','1','住院') as VISIT_TYPE_NAME,--就诊类型编码
        '' as CHARCE_NO,--收费码
        b.ORDER_NO as ORDER_NO,--医嘱序号
        a.presc_no as PARENT_ORDER_NO,--父医嘱序号
        a.Presc_Type as ORDER_CLASS_CODE,--医嘱类别编码
        case when a.Presc_Type='1' then '中药'
          when a.Presc_Type='0' then '西药' end as ORDER_CLASS_NAME,--医嘱类别名称
        b.drug_code as ORDER_ITEM_CODE,--医嘱项编码
        b.drug_name as ORDER_ITEM_NAME,--医嘱项名称
        a.Ordered_By as ORDER_DEPT_CODE,--开医嘱科室编码
        (select t.dept_name from his.dept_dict t where a.Ordered_By=t.dept_code) as ORDER_DEPT_NAME,--开医嘱科室名称
        '' as ORDER_DOCTOR_CODE,--开医嘱医生工号
        a.PRESCRIBED_BY as ORDER_DOCTOR_NAME,--开医嘱医生名称
        a.Presc_Date as ORDER_TIME,--开医嘱日期及时间
        b.drug_name as ORDER_TEXT,--医嘱正文
        a.memo as ORDER_NOTE,--医嘱备注
        '' as CANCEL_DOCTOR_CODE,--撤销医生编码
        '' as CANCEL_DOCTOR_NAME,--撤销医生名称
        a.return_visit_date as CANCEL_TIME,--撤销时间
        '' as CANCEL_REASON,--撤销原因
        '' as PRES_STATUS_CODE,--处方状态编码
        '' as PRES_STATUS_NAME,--处方状态名称
        nvl((select mtl_code from his.perform_freq_dict where freq_desc =substr(b.administration,instr(b.administration,';',1,3) +1,length(b.administration)-instr(b.administration,';',1,3) -1)and rownum = 1),'99') AS FREQUENCY_CODE,--执行频次编码
        substr(b.administration,instr(b.administration,';',1,3) +1,length(b.administration)-instr(b.administration,';',1,3) -1) AS FREQUENCY_NAME,  --执行频次名称
        '' as FREQUENCY_DESC,--执行频次描述
        '' as DURATION_UNIT,--持续时间单位
        '' as DURATION_VALUE,--持续时间值
        b.drug_code as DRUG_ID,--药品编码
        '' as PACKAGE_NO,--包装序号
        b.Package_Spec as SPECIFICATION,--包装规格说明
        b.Package_Units as DRUG_AMOUNT_UNIT,--药品数量单位
        b.Quantity as DRUG_AMOUNT_VALUE,--药品数量值
        case when a.presc_type='1' then b.package_units
          else null end as HERB_AMOUNT_UNIT,--草药数量单位
        case when a.presc_type='1' then b.quantity
          else null end as HERB_AMOUNT_VALUE,--草药数量值
        b.dosage_units as DOSAGE_UNIT,--剂量单位
        to_char(b.dosage_each,'fm9999999990.0000') as DOSAGE_VALUE,--剂量值
        '' as TOTAL_DOSAGE_UNIT,--总剂量单位
        '' as TOTAL_DOSAGE_VALUE,--总剂量值
        nvl((select hlht_code from his.administration_dict where administration_name =substr(b.administration,instr(b.administration,';',1,2) +1, instr(b.administration,';',1,3) -instr(b.administration,';',1,2)-1 )and rownum = 1),'9')  PHARMACY_WAY_CODE,--给药途径和方法编码
        substr(b.administration,instr(b.administration,';',1,2) +1, instr(b.administration,';',1,3) -instr(b.administration,';',1,2)-1 ) as PHARMACY_WAY_NAME,--给药途径和方法名称
        a.dispensing_datetime as PRESC_TIME,--执行时间
        a.dispensary as PRESC_DEPT_CODE,--执行科室编码
        (select t.dept_name from his.dept_dict t where a.dispensary=t.dept_code) as PRESC_DEPT_NAME --执行科室名称
from his.drug_presc_master a,his.drug_presc_detail b
where a.presc_no=b.presc_no
and a.presc_date=b.presc_date
and a.presc_source='0'

  select
       a.patient_id||'|' as id ,

       ''  as EID,--EMPI全局标识
       a.patient_id as OUT_PATIENT_ID,--门诊患者标识
       a.patient_id as IN_PATIENT_ID,--住院患者标识
       a.inp_no as INP_NO,--住院号

       '' AS CASE_NO,--病案号

       a.patient_id AS OUTP_NO,--门诊号
       '' as CARD_NO,--就诊卡号
       A.NAME AS PERSON_NAME,--姓名

       to_char(a.date_of_birth,'YYYY-MM-DD') as DATE_OF_BIRTH,--出生日期

       '' as DEGREE_LEVEL_NAME,--最高学位名称

       a.degree as EDUCATION_LEVEL_NAME,--最高学历名称

       a.id_no as ID_CARD_NO,--证件号码

       a.ZIP_CODE as POSTCODE,--邮编

       '' as MAILING_ADDR_PROVINCE_NAME,--联系地址省份名称

       '' as MAILING_ADDR_COUNTY_NAME,--联系地址县区名称

       '' as MAILING_ADDR_STREET_NAME,--联系地址街道名称

       '' as FAMILY_ADDR_CITY_NAME,--户籍所在地地市名称

       '' as FAMILY_ADDR_COUNTY_NAME,--户籍所在地区名称

CDR_SURGICAL_RECORD.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ODS"."CDR_SURGICAL_RECORD" ("ID", "PATIENT_ID", "OUT_PATIENT_ID", "IN_PATIENT_ID", "INP_NO", "HEALTH_CARD_NO", "CASE_NO", "PLS_NO", "OPER_GRADE_CODE", "OPER_GRADE_NAME", "OUTP_NO", "OPER_NO", "VISIT_ID", "VISIT_TYPE_CODE", "VISIT_TYPE_NAME", "OPERATION_CODE", "OPERATION_NAME", "OPERATION_NOTIFIER_CODE", "OPERATION_NOTIFIER_NAME", "OPERATION_NOTICE_TIME", "IN_OPER_DEPT_TIME", "OPER_ROOM_CODE", "OPER_ROOM_NAME", "OPER_ROOM_NO_CODE", "SURGEN_CODE", "SURGEN_NAME", "FIRST_ASSISTANT_CODE", "FIRST_ASSISTANT_NAME", "SECOND_ASSISTANT_CODE", "SECOND_ASSISTANT_NAME", "INSTRUMENT_NURSE_CODE", "INSTRUMENT_NURSE_NAME", "CIRCUIT_NURSE_CODE", "CIRCUIT_NURSE_NAME", "ANESTHESIA_DOCTOR_CODE", "ANESTHESIA_DOCTOR_NAME", "ANES_ASSISTANT_CODE", "ANES_ASSISTANT_NAME", "ANESTHESIA_START_TIME", "ANESTHESIA_METHOD_CODE", "ANESTHESIA_METHOD_NAME", "NARCOTIC_DRUG_CODE", "NARCOTIC_DRUG_NAME", "ASA_GRADE_CODE", "ASA_GRADE_NAME", "ANESTHESIA_END_TIME", "OPER_START_TIME", "SURGICAL_POSITION_CODE", "SURGICAL_POSITION_NAME", "SURGERY_SITE_CODE", "SURGERY_SITE_NAME", "WOUND_LEVEL_CODE", "WOUND_LEVEL_NAME", "DRAINAGE_SIGN_CODE", "DRAINAGE_MATERIALS_CODE", "DRAINAGE_MATERIALS_NAME", "DRAINAGE_SITE_CODE", "DRAINAGE_SITE_NAME", "OPER_END_TIME", "OPER_STATUS_CODE", "OPER_STATUS_NAME", "BLEEDING_AMOUNT_UNIT", "BLEEDING_AMOUNT_VALUE", "BLOOD_TRANSFUSION_AMOUNT_UNIT", "BLOOD_TRANSFUSION_AMOUNT_VALUE", "BLOOD_TRANSFUSION_TYPE_CODE", "BLOOD_TRANSFUSION_TYPE_NAME", "TRANSFUSION_REACTION_SIGNS", "OUT_OPER_DEPT_TIME", "ANES_IMG_1") AS 
  SELECT
mom.patient_id||'|'||mom.visit_id||'|'||mom.oper_id as id ,
mom.patient_id as patient_id,
( CASE WHEN mom.visit_id = 0 THEN mom.patient_id ELSE '' END ) OUT_PATIENT_ID,--门诊患者标识
( CASE WHEN mom.visit_id != 0 THEN mom.patient_id ELSE '' END ) IN_PATIENT_ID,--住院患者标识
( SELECT INP_NO FROM sm.MED_PAT_MASTER_INDEX WHERE patient_id = mom.patient_id ) INP_NO,--住院号 上面三个号至少有一个不为空
'' HEALTH_CARD_NO,--健康卡号
'' CASE_NO,--病案号
'' PLS_NO,--病理号
case when mom.OPERATION_SCALE='Ⅲ' then '2'
  when mom.OPERATION_SCALE='Ⅱ' then '3'
    when mom.OPERATION_SCALE='中' then '3'
      when mom.OPERATION_SCALE='特' then '1'
        when mom.OPERATION_SCALE='四' then '1'
          when mom.OPERATION_SCALE='三' then '2'
            when mom.OPERATION_SCALE='二' then '2'
              when mom.OPERATION_SCALE='一' then '1'
                when mom.OPERATION_SCALE='大' then '2'
                  when mom.OPERATION_SCALE='小' then '4'
                    when mom.OPERATION_SCALE='Ⅰ' then '4' end OPER_GRADE_CODE,--手术级别编码

case when mom.OPERATION_SCALE='Ⅲ' then '中'
  when mom.OPERATION_SCALE='Ⅱ' then '大'
    when mom.OPERATION_SCALE='中' then '中'
      when mom.OPERATION_SCALE='特' then '特'
        when mom.OPERATION_SCALE='四' then '小'
          when mom.OPERATION_SCALE='三' then '中'
            when mom.OPERATION_SCALE='二' then '大'
              when mom.OPERATION_SCALE='一' then '特'
                when mom.OPERATION_SCALE='大' then '大'
                  when mom.OPERATION_SCALE='小' then '小'
                    when mom.OPERATION_SCALE = 'Ⅰ' then '特' end OPER_GRADE_NAME,--手术级别名称
'' OUTP_NO,--门诊号
mom.oper_id OPER_NO,--手术序号
mom.patient_id||mom.visit_id VISIT_ID,--就诊流水号
decode( mom.visit_id, '0', '01', '02' ) VISIT_TYPE_CODE,--就诊类型编码 例：01或02  01：门诊，02：住院
decode( mom.visit_id, '0', '门诊', '住院' ) VISIT_TYPE_NAME,--就诊类型名称 例：01或02  01：门诊，02：住院
mom.operation_id OPERATION_CODE,--手术操作编码  手术编码和名称
mom.operation_name OPERATION_NAME,--手术操作名称  手术编码和名称
'' OPERATION_NOTIFIER_CODE,--手术通知人工号
'' OPERATION_NOTIFIER_NAME,--手术通知人姓名
'' OPERATION_NOTICE_TIME,--手术通知时间
mom.in_date_time IN_OPER_DEPT_TIME,--入手术室时间
mom.operating_room OPER_ROOM_CODE,--手术室编码
( SELECT DISTINCT location FROM sm.MED_OPERATING_ROOM WHERE dept_code = mom.operating_room) OPER_ROOM_NAME,--手术室
mom.Operating_Room_No OPER_ROOM_NO_CODE,--手术间
'' SURGEN_CODE,--手术医师工号
mom.surgeon SURGEN_NAME,--手术医师姓名
'' FIRST_ASSISTANT_CODE,--第一手术助手工号
mom.First_Assistant FIRST_ASSISTANT_NAME,--第一手术助手姓名
'' SECOND_ASSISTANT_CODE,--第二手术助手工号
mom.Second_Assistant SECOND_ASSISTANT_NAME,--第二手术助手姓名
'' INSTRUMENT_NURSE_CODE,--器械护士工号
'' INSTRUMENT_NURSE_NAME,--器械护士姓名
'' CIRCUIT_NURSE_CODE,--巡回护士工号
'' CIRCUIT_NURSE_NAME,--巡回护士姓名
'' ANESTHESIA_DOCTOR_CODE,--麻醉医师工号
mom.ANESTHESIA_DOCTOR ANESTHESIA_DOCTOR_NAME,--麻醉医师姓名
'' ANES_ASSISTANT_CODE,--麻醉助手工号
mom.Anesthesia_Assistant ANES_ASSISTANT_NAME,--麻醉助手姓名
mom.Anes_Start_Time ANESTHESIA_START_TIME,--麻醉开始间
'' ANESTHESIA_METHOD_CODE,--麻醉方式编码
mom.Anesthesia_Method ANESTHESIA_METHOD_NAME,--麻醉方式名称
'' NARCOTIC_DRUG_CODE,--麻醉剂编码
'' NARCOTIC_DRUG_NAME,--麻醉剂名称
map.asa_grade ASA_GRADE_CODE,--ASA分级编码
map.asa_grade ASA_GRADE_NAME,--ASA分级名称
mom.Anes_End_Time ANESTHESIA_END_TIME,--麻醉结束时间
mom.START_DATE_TIME OPER_START_TIME,--手术开始时间
'' SURGICAL_POSITION_CODE,--手术体位编码
mom.Operation_Position SURGICAL_POSITION_NAME,--手术体位名称
'' SURGERY_SITE_CODE,--手术部位编码
'' SURGERY_SITE_NAME,--手术部位名称
'' WOUND_LEVEL_CODE,--手术切口等级编码
'' WOUND_LEVEL_NAME,--手术切口等级
'' DRAINAGE_SIGN_CODE,--引流标志  true或false
'' DRAINAGE_MATERIALS_CODE,--引流材料编码
'' DRAINAGE_MATERIALS_NAME,--引流材料名称
'' DRAINAGE_SITE_CODE,--引流部位编码
'' DRAINAGE_SITE_NAME,--引流部位名称
mom.end_date_time OPER_END_TIME,--手术结束时间
'' OPER_STATUS_CODE,--手术状态编码
'' OPER_STATUS_NAME,--手术状态名称
'ml' BLEEDING_AMOUNT_UNIT,--术中出血量单位,--总量
mom.Blood_Lossed BLEEDING_AMOUNT_VALUE,--术中出血量值 总量
'' BLOOD_TRANSFUSION_AMOUNT_UNIT,--术中输血量单位  总量
'' BLOOD_TRANSFUSION_AMOUNT_VALUE,--术中输血量值  总量
'' BLOOD_TRANSFUSION_TYPE_CODE,--输血类型编码
'' BLOOD_TRANSFUSION_TYPE_NAME,--输血类型名称
'' TRANSFUSION_REACTION_SIGNS,--输血反应标志  true或false
mom.out_date_time OUT_OPER_DEPT_TIME,--出手术室时间
'' ANES_IMG_1--麻醉单图片  如果有多张麻醉单，则分成多列进行存储，后面添加_1、_2、_3来区分列

FROM sm.MED_OPERATION_MASTER mom -- 病人手术主记录
left join sm.med_anesthesia_plan map
on mom.patient_id = map.patient_id
and mom.visit_id = map.visit_id
and mom.oper_id = map.oper_id

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "DBZ"."EMRSHOUYETEST" ("ID", "PATIENTID", "VISITNO", "VISITCOUNT", "MEDICALRECORDNO", "INPATIENTNO", "OPERATIONCODE", "OPERATIONNAME", "OPERATIONLEVELCODE", "OPERATIONLEVELNAME", "OPERATIONCLASSCODE", "OPERATIONCLASSNAME", "OPERATIONTYPECODE", "OPERATIONTYPENAME", "CUTLEVELCODE", "CUTLEVELNAME", "HEALINGCODE", "HEALINGNAME", "SSQKYHDJDM", "ANESTHESIACODE", "ANESTHESIANAME", "STARTTIME", "ENDTIME", "NOTE", "ORDERNO") AS 
  select
t.patient_id||'-'||t.visit_id||'-'||t.OPERATION_NO as Id,
t.patient_id as PatientId,
  nvl(substr( b.ZYLSH,0,instr(b.zylsh,'-')-1 ),A.INP_NO) as VisitNo,
t.visit_id as VisitCount,
 nvl(substr( c.ZYLSH,0,instr(c.zylsh,'-')-1 ),A.INP_NO) as MedicalRecordNo,
 nvl(substr( c.ZYLSH,0,instr(c.zylsh,'-')-1 ),A.INP_NO) as InPatientNo,

t.OPERATION_CODE as OperationCode,
t.OPERATION_DESC as OperationName,
'' as OperationLevelCode,'' as OperationLevelName,
'' as OperationClassCode,'' as OperationClassName,
'' as OperationTypeCode,'' as OperationTypeName,
t.WOUND_GRADE as CutLevelCode,
t.WOUND_GRADE as CutLevelName,
t.heal as HealingCode,
t.heal as HealingName,
t.heal as SSQKYHDJDM,
t.ANAESTHESIA_METHOD as AnesthesiaCode,
t.ANAESTHESIA_METHOD as AnesthesiaName,
t1.start_date_time as StartTime,
t1.end_date_time as EndTime,
'旧病案首页数据' as Note,
t.OPERATION_NO as OrderNo
from his.operation t
left join his.operation_master t1 on t.patient_id=t1.patient_id and t.visit_id=t1.visit_id -- and
inner join HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX A on t.PATIENT_ID=A.PATIENT_ID
inner join HIS.PAT_VISIT B on  t.VISIT_ID=B.Visit_Id and t.PATIENT_ID=B.PATIENT_ID
left join HIS.SETTLE_ZY_REC C on C.PATIENT_ID = b.PATIENT_ID AND C.VISIT_ID = b.VISIT_ID
--, HIS.SETTLE_ZY_REC C
left join his.dept_dict dept on dept.dept_code=t1.OPERATING_DEPT
   where b.discharge_date_time >= TO_DATE('20200101', 'yyyymmdd') and b.discharge_date_time<=TO_DATE('20250430', 'yyyymmdd')

                                     length('000' || to_char(B.visit_id)) - 2,
                                     3)  JZLSH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  就诊流水号：医院his的唯一编号

            where x.charge_name = b.charge_type),

       a.sex as HZXB,

       a.date_of_birth CSRQ, ---  DateTime    Y  出生日期
cast(null as NUmber)as HZTZ,
cast(null as Number) as HZSG,
       (CASE

          floor(months_between(B.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME, A.DATE_OF_BIRTH) / 12)

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "DBZ"."EMR_BA_SHOUYE_TEST" ("JZLSH1", "JZLSH", "RYSJ", "RYLX", "YLFFFS", "ZYCS", "MZH", "ZYH", "BAH", "PATIENTID", "XM", "XB", "CSRQ", "NL", "GJ", "XSECSTZ", "XSERYTZ", "HYZK", "SFZ", "LXDH", "CYSJ", "CYKSBM", "CYKSMC", "SJZYTS", "RYQWYZZ", "QZRQ", "MZCYZD", "YWGM", "QJCS", "CGCS", "SFCXWJN", "SFCXYC", "XX", "XSEJBSC", "CHCYL", "XSE_XB", "ZRYSGH", "ZZYSGH", "ZYYSGH", "ZRHSGH", "ZKYSGH", "ZKHSGH", "ZKRQ", "SWGBYY", "SWSJ", "LYFS", "ZZYJH_31", "SSLCLJ", "ZYZDCODE", "ZYZDNAME", "CYZDCODE1", "CYZDNAME1", "CYZDCODE2", "CYZDNAME2", "CYZDCODE3", "CYZDNAME3", "CYZDCODE4", "CYZDNAME4", "CYZDCODE5", "CYZDNAME5", "CYZDCODE6", "CYZDNAME6", "CYZDCODE7", "CYZDNAME7", "CYZDCODE8", "CYZDNAME8", "CYZDCODE9", "CYZDNAME9", "CYZDCODE10", "CYZDNAME10", "ZYSSCODE", "ZYSSNAME", "CYSSCODE1", "CYSSNAME1", "CYSSCODE2", "CYSSNAME2", "CYSSCODE3", "CYSSNAME3", "CYSSCODE4", "CYSSNAME4", "CYSSCODE5", "CYSSNAME5", "CYSSCODE6", "CYSSNAME6", "CYSSCODE7", "CYSSNAME7", "CYSSCODE8", "CYSSNAME8", "CFRY31TN", "XTJB31TZCRY") AS 
  select
to_char( A.INP_NO)||''||to_char( B.visit_id) as jzlsh1,
           A.INP_NO || '-' || substr('000' || to_char(B.visit_id),
                                     length('000' || to_char(B.visit_id)) - 2,
                                     3)--)
                                     JZLSH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  就诊流水号：医院his的唯一编号
       b.admission_date_time RYSJ, ---  DATETIME    Y  入院时间（yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss）
       decode(b.patient_class, 2, '1', 1, '2', 3, '3', 9, '9', '9') RYLX, ---  VARCHAR  2  Y  入院类型（途径）：编码（1：门诊入院；2：急诊入院；3：其他医疗机构转入；9：其他）
       nvl((SELECT '0' || x.stat_code
             FROM HIS.STAT_VS_CHARGE_TYPE x
            where x.charge_name = b.charge_type),
           '07') YLFFFS, ---  VARCHAR  4  Y  医疗付费方式：（01：城镇职工基本医疗保险；02：城乡居民基本医疗保险；03：新型农村合作医疗；04：贫困救助；05：商业医疗保险；06：全公费；07：全自费；08：其他社会保险（指生育保险、工伤保险、农民工保险等）；99：其他）
       b.visit_id ZYCS, ---  INT  4  Y  住院次数：对应病案首页上的第_次住院
       a.patient_id MZH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  门诊号
       a.inp_no ZYH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  住院号
       a.inp_no BAH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  病案号：指本医疗机构为患者住院病案设置的唯一性编码。原则上，统一患者在同一医疗机构多次住院应当使用同一病案号。
       a.patient_id PatientId, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  患者id
       a.name XM, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  姓名：新生儿姓名填写为XX之女或XX之子
       decode(a.sex, '男', '1', '女', '2', '9') XB, ---  VARCHAR  6  Y  性别：（1：男；2：女；9：未说明的性别；）
       a.date_of_birth CSRQ, ---  DateTime    Y  出生日期
       (CASE
         WHEN floor(months_between(B.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME, A.DATE_OF_BIRTH) / 12) >= 1 THEN
          floor(months_between(B.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME, A.DATE_OF_BIRTH) / 12)
         ELSE
          0
       END) NL, ---  NUMERIC    Y  年龄
       a.citizenship GJ, ---  VARCHAR2  50  Y  国籍：国家名称
       nvl(B.WEIGHT_BIRTH, 0) XSECSTZ, ---  INT  6  N  新生儿出生体重：单位（克），精确到10克，新生儿必填
       B.BODY_WEIGHT XSERYTZ, ---  INT  6  N  新生儿入院体重：单位（克），精确到10克，新生儿必填
       decode(a.marital_status,
              '未婚',
              '1',
              '已婚',
              '2',
              '丧偶',
              '3',
              '离婚',
              '4',
              '其他',
              '9',
              a.marital_status) HYZK, ---  VARCHAR  2  Y  婚姻状况：（1：未婚；2：已婚；3：丧偶；4：离婚；9：其他）

       a.id_no SFZ, ---  VARCHAR  18  Y  身份证号
       a.next_of_kin_phone LXDH, ---  VARCHAR  20  Y  联系电话
       b.discharge_date_time CYSJ, ---  DATETIME    Y  出院时间
       b.dept_discharge_from CYKSBM, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  出院科室编码
       d.dept_name as CYKSMC,--出院
       CASE
         WHEN round(TO_NUMBER(B.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME - B.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME),
                    0) = 0 THEN
          1
         ELSE
          round(TO_NUMBER(B.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME - B.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME), 0)
       END SJZYTS, ---  NUMERIC  4  Y  实际住院天数

       case
         when b.entrance_hospital is null then
          '2'
         else
          '1'
       end RYQWYZZ, ---  VARCHAR  1  N  入院前经外院诊治：（1：有；2：无）
       cast(null as date) QZRQ, ---  DATETIME    N  确诊日期
       cast( null as varchar(50)) MZCYZD, ---
       b.ALERGY_DRUGS YWGM, ---  VARCHAR  500  Y  药物过敏：填写具体药物的名称，多种以”;“间隔，没有必填”无“
       b.EMER_TREAT_TIMES QJCS, ---  INT    N  抢救次数
       b.ESC_EMER_TIMES CGCS, ---  INT    N  成功次数
       b.SERIOUS_INDICATOR SFCXWJN, ---  VARCHAR  3  Y  住院是否出现危重、急症、疑难：0：否；1：是；
       cast( null as varchar(50)) SFCXYC, ---  VARCHAR  3  Y  住院是否出现压疮：0：否；1：是；
       b.BLOOD_TYPE XX, ---  VARCHAR  2  N  血型：（1：A；2：B；3：O；4：AB；5：不详；6：未查；）
       cast( null as varchar(50)) XSEJBSC, ---  VARCHAR  3  Y  新生儿疾病筛查：1：是；2：否；
       cast( null as number) CHCYL, ---  NUMERIC  8,1  Y  产后出血量：单位为ml
       cast( null as varchar(50)) XSE_XB, ---  VARCHAR      新生儿性别
       b.DIRECTOR ZRYSGH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  主任医师工号
       --(select name from HIS.staff_dict st where st.emp_no = b.director) ZRYSXM, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  主任医师姓名
       b.attending_doctor ZZYSGH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  主治医师工号
       --(select name from HIS.staff_dict st where st.emp_no = b.attending_doctor) ZZYSXM, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  主治医师姓名
       b.doctor_in_charge ZYYSGH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  住院医师工号
       --(select name from HIS.staff_dict st where st.emp_no = b.doctor_in_charge) ZYYSXM, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  住院医师姓名
       b.duty_nurse ZRHSGH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  责任护士工号
       --(select name from HIS.staff_dict st where st.emp_no = b.duty_nurse) ZRHSXM, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  责任护士姓名
       b.doctor_of_control_quality ZKYSGH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  质控医师工号
       --(select name from HIS.staff_dict st where st.emp_no = b.doctor_of_control_quality) ZKYSXM, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  质控医师姓名
       b.nurse_of_control_quality ZKHSGH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  质控护士工号
       --(select name from HIS.staff_dict st where st.emp_no = b.nurse_of_control_quality) ZKHSXM, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  质控护士姓名
       b.date_of_control_quality ZKRQ, ---  DATETIME    Y  质控控日期
       cast( null as varchar(50)) SWGBYY, ---  VARCHAR  500  N  死亡根本原因：离远方式为死亡时必填
       cast( null as date) SWSJ, ---  DATETIME    N  死亡时间：离远方式为死亡时必填
       (select mr_code
          FROM HIS.MR_COMM_VS_HIS_COMM t
         WHERE t.CLASS_CODE = 'DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_DICT'
           and t.HIS_CODE = b.discharge_disposition) LYFS, ---  VARCHAR  1  Y  离院方式：1：医嘱离院；2：医嘱转院，拟接收医疗机构名称；3：医嘱转社区卫生服务机构/乡镇卫生院，拟接收医疗机构名称；4：非医嘱离院；5：死亡；9：其他

       case
         when nvl(b.PLAN_31_ADMISSION, 0) = 2 then
          b.REASON_31_ADMISSION
         else
          '无'
       end ZZYJH_31, ---  VARCHAR  200  Y  是否有出院31天内再住院计划：如有，请填写再入院目的，否则填写”无“。
       case
         when b.CLINICAL_PATHWAY = 1 then
          2
         else
          3
       end SSLCLJ, ---  VARCHAR  1  Y  实施临床路径：（1：中医；2：西医；3：否；）
       d1.diagnosis_code as ZyzdCode,
       d1.diagnosis_desc as ZyzdName,
       --(select listagg(dd.diagnosis_code,',')within group(order by dd.diagnosis_no) from his.diagnosis dd where a.patient_id=dd.patient_id and dd.visit_id=b.visit_id and dd.diagnosis_type='3' and d2.diagnosis_no>1) CyzdCode,
       d2.diagnosis_code as CyzdCode1,
       d2.diagnosis_desc as CyzdName1,
       d3.diagnosis_code as CyzdCode2,
       d3.diagnosis_desc as CyzdName2,
       d4.diagnosis_code as CyzdCode3,
       d4.diagnosis_desc as CyzdName3,
       d5.diagnosis_code as CyzdCode4,
       d5.diagnosis_desc as CyzdName4,
       d6.diagnosis_code as CyzdCode5,
       d6.diagnosis_desc as CyzdName5,
       d7.diagnosis_code as CyzdCode6,
       d7.diagnosis_desc as CyzdName6,
       d8.diagnosis_code as CyzdCode7,
       d8.diagnosis_desc as CyzdName7,
       d9.diagnosis_code as CyzdCode8,
       d9.diagnosis_desc as CyzdName8,
       d10.diagnosis_code as CyzdCode9,
       d10.diagnosis_desc as CyzdName9,
       d11.diagnosis_code as CyzdCode10,
       d11.diagnosis_desc as CyzdName10,
       o1.OPERATION_CODE as ZyssCode,
       o1.OPERATION_DESC as ZyssName,
       o2.OPERATION_CODE as CyssCode1,
       o2.OPERATION_DESC as CyssName1,
       o3.OPERATION_CODE as CyssCode2,
       o3.OPERATION_DESC as CyssName2,
       o4.OPERATION_CODE as CyssCode3,
       o4.OPERATION_DESC as CyssName3,
       o5.OPERATION_CODE as CyssCode4,
       o5.OPERATION_DESC as CyssName4,
       o6.OPERATION_CODE as CyssCode5,
       o6.OPERATION_DESC as CyssName5,
       o7.OPERATION_CODE as CyssCode6,
       o7.OPERATION_DESC as CyssName6,
       o8.OPERATION_CODE as CyssCode7,
       o8.OPERATION_DESC as CyssName7,
       o9.OPERATION_CODE as CyssCode8,
       o9.OPERATION_DESC as CyssName8,
       case when
       b1.visit_id is not null and
       b1.discharge_date_time> (b.admission_date_time-31)
       then 1 else 0 end cfry31tn,
       case when
       b1.visit_id is not null and
       d1_.diagnosis_code=d1.diagnosis_code and
       d1_.diagnosis_code is not null and
       b1.discharge_date_time> (b.admission_date_time-31)
       then 1 else 0 end xtjb31tzcry
       from HIS.PAT_VISIT B
  inner join HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX A on A.PATIENT_ID = B.PATIENT_ID
  left join his.diagnosis d1 on a.patient_id=d1.patient_id and d1.visit_id=b.visit_id and d1.diagnosis_type='3' and d1.diagnosis_no=1 --and d1.mr_status=1
  left join his.diagnosis d2 on a.patient_id=d2.patient_id and d2.visit_id=b.visit_id and d2.diagnosis_type='3' and d2.diagnosis_no=2  --and d2.mr_status=1
    left join his.diagnosis d3 on a.patient_id=d3.patient_id and d3.visit_id=b.visit_id and d3.diagnosis_type='3' and d3.diagnosis_no=3 --and d3.mr_status=1
    left join his.diagnosis d4 on a.patient_id=d4.patient_id and d4.visit_id=b.visit_id and d4.diagnosis_type='3' and d4.diagnosis_no=4 --and d4.mr_status=1
    left join his.diagnosis d5 on a.patient_id=d5.patient_id and d5.visit_id=b.visit_id and d5.diagnosis_type='3' and d5.diagnosis_no=5 --and d5.mr_status=1
    left join his.diagnosis d6 on a.patient_id=d6.patient_id and d6.visit_id=b.visit_id and d6.diagnosis_type='3' and d6.diagnosis_no=6 --and d6.mr_status=1
    left join his.diagnosis d7 on a.patient_id=d7.patient_id and d7.visit_id=b.visit_id and d7.diagnosis_type='3' and d7.diagnosis_no=7 --and d7.mr_status=1
    left join his.diagnosis d8 on a.patient_id=d8.patient_id and d8.visit_id=b.visit_id and d8.diagnosis_type='3' and d8.diagnosis_no=8 --and d8.mr_status=1
    left join his.diagnosis d9 on a.patient_id=d9.patient_id and d9.visit_id=b.visit_id and d9.diagnosis_type='3' and d9.diagnosis_no=9 --and d9.mr_status=1
    left join his.diagnosis d10 on a.patient_id=d10.patient_id and d10.visit_id=b.visit_id and d10.diagnosis_type='3' and d10.diagnosis_no=10 --and d9.mr_status=1
    left join his.diagnosis d11 on a.patient_id=d11.patient_id and d11.visit_id=b.visit_id and d11.diagnosis_type='3' and d11.diagnosis_no=11 --and d9.mr_status=1
    left join his.operation o1 on o1.patient_id=a.patient_id and o1.visit_id=b.visit_id and o1.operation_no=1
    left join his.operation o2 on o2.patient_id=a.patient_id and o2.visit_id=b.visit_id and o2.operation_no=2
    left join his.operation o3 on o3.patient_id=a.patient_id and o3.visit_id=b.visit_id and o3.operation_no=3
    left join his.operation o4 on o4.patient_id=a.patient_id and o4.visit_id=b.visit_id and o4.operation_no=4
    left join his.operation o5 on o5.patient_id=a.patient_id and o5.visit_id=b.visit_id and o5.operation_no=5
    left join his.operation o6 on o6.patient_id=a.patient_id and o6.visit_id=b.visit_id and o6.operation_no=6
    left join his.operation o7 on o7.patient_id=a.patient_id and o7.visit_id=b.visit_id and o7.operation_no=7
    left join his.operation o8 on o8.patient_id=a.patient_id and o8.visit_id=b.visit_id and o8.operation_no=8
    left join his.operation o9 on o9.patient_id=a.patient_id and o9.visit_id=b.visit_id and o9.operation_no=9
    left join HIS.PAT_VISIT B1 on A.PATIENT_ID = B1.PATIENT_ID and b1.visit_id=b.visit_id-1 and b.visit_id!=1
    left join his.diagnosis d1_ on a.patient_id=d1_.patient_id and d1_.visit_id=b1.visit_id and d1_.diagnosis_type='3' and d1_.diagnosis_no=1 --and d1_.mr_status=1
    and b.visit_id!=1
    --left join (select d.patient_id,d.visit_id,listagg(d.diagnosis_code,',')within group(order by d.diagnosis_no) icdCode,listagg(d.diagnosis_desc,',')within group(order by d.diagnosis_no) icdName from his.diagnosis d where d.diagnosis_type='3' and d.diagnosis_no>1 group by d.patient_id,d.visit_id) cyzd on cyzd.patient_id=a.patient_id and cyzd.visit_id=b.visit_id
  --left join HIS.SETTLE_ZY_REC C on C.PATIENT_ID= b.PATIENT_ID and C.VISIT_ID=b.VISIT_ID
  left join HIS.DEPT_DICT d on  d.dept_code=b.dept_discharge_from

 where  length(a.inp_no)!=0-- is not null

   and b.discharge_date_time >= to_date('20200101','yyyymmdd')

EMR_DIAGNOSE.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "DBZ"."EMR_DIAGNOSE" ("PATIENTID", "ZYH", "ZYCS", "JZLSH", "ZDLX", "ICDCODE", "ICDNAME", "ISMAIN", "ORDERNUM", "ZDRQSJ") AS 
  select
t.patient_id as patientId,
  nvl(substr( b.ZYLSH,0,instr(b.zylsh,'-')-1 ),A.INP_NO) as ZYH,
t.visit_id as ZYCS,
           nvl(substr( b.ZYLSH,0,instr(b.zylsh,'-')-1 ),A.INP_NO) ||'-' ||substr('000' || to_char(t.visit_id),
                                     length('000' || to_char(t.visit_id)) - 2,
                                     3) as JZLSH,
                               decode( t.diagnosis_type,'1'，'门诊诊断','3','出院诊断','7','损伤和中毒的外部原因','2','入院诊断',t.diagnosis_type) as ZDLX,
                               t.diagnosis_code ICDCode,
                               t.diagnosis_desc as ICDName,
                               case when t.diagnosis_no=1 then 1 else 0 end as IsMain,
                               to_number( t.diagnosis_no) as OrderNum,
                               t.diagnosis_date as ZDRQSJ--,

    from
    his.diagnosis t
    left join HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX A on t.patient_id=a.patient_id
    left join HIS.PAT_VISIT B on b.patient_id=t.patient_id and b.visit_id=t.visit_id

EMR_DOC.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "DBZ"."EMR_DOC" ("ID", "PATIENTID", "ZYH", "JZLSH", "NAME", "DOCTITLE", "DOCTYPE", "MR_CLASS", "JLRQSJ", "KSBM", "KSMC", "DOCNO", "ZYYSQM", "ALLTEXT", "LASTMODIFYDATE") AS 
  select
t.file_unique_id as Id,
t.Patient_Id as PatientId,
A.Inp_No as ZYH,
A.Inp_No || '-' || substr('000' || to_char(t2.visit_id),length('000' || to_char(t2.visit_id)) - 2,3) as JZLSH,
A.Name,
t.topic as DocTitle,
decode(substr( t.mr_class,1,5),
'EMR09','入院记录',
'EMR12','出院记录',
'EMR10','病程记录',
'EMR05','手术记录',
'EMR07',t.topic,
t.mr_class
) as DocType,
t.mr_class,
t.create_date_time as JLRQSJ,
t.dept_code as KSBM,(select dept.dept_name from his.dept_dict dept where dept.dept_code=t.dept_code and rownum=1) as KSMC,
t.file_no as DocNo,
t.creator_name as Zyysqm,
t1.mr_content as AllText,

--t.*,t1.mr_content
from HIS.PAT_VISIT t2
inner join HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX A on a.patient_id=t2.patient_id

EMR_SHOUYE.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "DBZ"."EMR_SHOUYE" ("ID", "PATIENTID", "VISITCOUNT", "ADMISSIONDATE", "DISCHARGEDATE", "ZYZFY", "ZYZFYQZZFJE", "YBYLFWF", "YBZLCZF", "HLF", "ZHYLFWLQTFY", "BLZDF", "SYSZDF", "YXXZDF", "LCZDXMF", "FSSZLXMF", "QZLCWLZLF", "SSZLF", "QZMZF", "QZSSF", "KFF", "ZYZLF", "XYF", "QZKJYWF", "ZCYF", "ZCAOYF", "XF", "BDBLZPF", "QDBLZPF", "NXYZLZPF", "XBYZLZPF", "JCYYCXYYCLF", "ZLYYCXYYCLF", "SSYYCXYYCLF", "QTF") AS 
  select
b.patient_id || b.visit_id as Id,
b.patient_id as PatientId,b.visit_id as VisitCount,b.Admission_Date_Time as  AdmissionDate, b.discharge_date_time as DischargeDate,
(SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id) ZYZFY, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  住院总费用
       c.brfdje ZYZFYQZZFJE, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  住院总费用其中自付金额
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%一般医疗服务费%') YBYLFWF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  一般医疗服务费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%一般治疗操作费%') YBZLCZF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  一般治疗操作费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%护理费%') HLF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  护理费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%其他费用%') ZHYLFWLQTFY, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  综合医疗服务类其他费用
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%病理诊断费%') BLZDF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  病理诊断费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%实验室诊断费%') SYSZDF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  实验室诊断费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%影像学诊断费%') YXXZDF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  影像学诊断费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%临床诊断项目费%') LCZDXMF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  临床诊断项目费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND (y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%非手术治疗项目费%' or y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%临床物理治疗费%')) FSSZLXMF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  非手术治疗项目费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%临床物理治疗费%') QZLCWLZLF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  其中：临床物理治疗费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND (y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%手术治疗费%' or  y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%麻醉费%' or y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%手术费%')) SSZLF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  手术治疗费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%麻醉费%') QZMZF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  其中：麻醉费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%手术费%') QZSSF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  其中：手术费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%康复费%') KFF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  康复费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%中医治疗费%') ZYZLF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  中医治疗费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND (y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%西药费%' or y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%抗菌药物费%')) XYF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  西药费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%抗菌药物费%') QZKJYWF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  其中：抗菌药物费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%中成药费%') ZCYF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  中成药费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%中草药费%') ZCAOYF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  中草药费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%血费%') XF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  血费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%白蛋白类制品费%') BDBLZPF, ---  NUMBER  16,3  Y  白蛋白类制品费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%球蛋白类制品费%') QDBLZPF, ---  NUMBER  16,3  Y  球蛋白类制品费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%凝血因子类制品费%') NXYZLZPF, ---  NUMBER  16,3  Y  凝血因子类制品费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%细胞因子类制品费%') XBYZLZPF, ---  NUMBER  16,3  Y  细胞因子类制品费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%检查用一次性医用材料费%') JCYYCXYYCLF, ---  NUMBER  16,3  Y  检查用一次性医用材料费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%治疗用一次性医用材料费%') ZLYYCXYYCLF, ---  NUMBER  16,3  Y  治疗用一次性医用材料费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%手术用一次性医用材料费%') SSYYCXYYCLF, ---  NUMBER  16,3  Y  手术用一次性医用材料费
        (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class ='其他费') + (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name = '其他费') QTF

           FROM HIS.PAT_VISIT B , HIS.SETTLE_ZY_REC C
           where C.PATIENT_ID(+) = b.PATIENT_ID
   AND C.VISIT_ID(+) = b.VISIT_ID

           --and B.Discharge_Date_Time >sysdate-7
/*(jzlsh, zylsh, rysj, rylx, ylfffs, zycs, mzh, zyh, bah, patientid, xm, xb, csrq, nl, gj, xsecstz, xserytz, hyzk, mz, jg, csd, sfz, lxdh, cysj, cyksbm, sjzyts, cyfs, ryqk, ryqwyzz, qzrq, mzcyzd, ywgm, qjcs, cgcs, sfcxwjn, sfcxyc, xx, xsejbsc, chcyl, xse_xb, zrysgh, zrysxm, zzysgh, zzysxm, zyysgh, zyysxm, hszgh, hszxm, zrhsgh, zrhsxm, zkysgh, zkysxm, zkhsgh, zkhsxm, zkrq, swgbyy, swsj, lyfs, njsyymc, zzyjh_31, zyzfy, zyzfyqzzfje, ybylfwf, ybzlczf, hlf, zhylfwlqtfy, blzdf, syszdf, yxxzdf, lczdxmf, fsszlxmf, qzlcwlzlf, sszlf, qzmzf, qzssf, kff, zyzlf, xyf, qzkjywf, zcyf, zcaoyf, xf, bdblzpf, qdblzpf, nxyzlzpf, xbyzlzpf, jcyycxyyclf, zlyycxyyclf, ssyycxyyclf, qtf, sslclj, cyksmc, ssbm2, ssmc2)
AS
SELECT nvl(substr( c.ZYLSH,0,instr(c.zylsh,'-')-1 ),A.INP_NO) ||'-' || substr('000' || to_char(B.visit_id),
                                     length('000' || to_char(B.visit_id)) - 2,
                                     3)  as ZYLSH,
nvl(substr( c.ZYLSH,0,instr(c.zylsh,'-')-1 ),A.INP_NO) ||'-'|| substr('000' || to_char(B.visit_id),
                                     length('000' || to_char(B.visit_id)) - 2,
                                     3) as  JZLSH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  就诊流水号：医院his的唯一编号
       b.admission_date_time RYSJ, ---  DATETIME    Y  入院时间（yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss）
       DECODE(b.patient_class, 2, '1', 1, '2', 3, '3', 9, '9', '9') RYLX, ---  VARCHAR  2  Y  入院类型（途径）：编码（1：门诊入院；2：急诊入院；3：其他医疗机构转入；9：其他）
       NVL((SELECT '0' || x.stat_code
             FROM HIS.STAT_VS_CHARGE_TYPE x
            WHERE x.charge_name = b.charge_type),
           '07') YLFFFS, ---  VARCHAR  4  Y  医疗付费方式：（01：城镇职工基本医疗保险；02：城乡居民基本医疗保险；03：新型农村合作医疗；04：贫困救助；05：商业医疗保险；06：全公费；07：全自费；08：其他社会保险（指生育保险、工伤保险、农民工保险等）；99：其他）
       b.visit_id ZYCS, ---  INT  4  Y  住院次数：对应病案首页上的第_次住院
       a.patient_id MZH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  门诊号
       nvl(substr( c.ZYLSH,0,instr(c.zylsh,'-')-1 ),A.INP_NO) ZYH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  住院号
       nvl(substr( c.ZYLSH,0,instr(c.zylsh,'-')-1 ),A.INP_NO) BAH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  病案号：指本医疗机构为患者住院病案设置的唯一性编码。原则上，统一患者在同一医疗机构多次住院应当使用同一病案号。
       a.patient_id PatientId, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  患者id
       a.name XM, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  姓名：新生儿姓名填写为XX之女或XX之子
       DECODE(a.sex, '男', '1', '女', '2', '9') XB, ---  VARCHAR  6  Y  性别：（1：男；2：女；9：未说明的性别；）
       a.date_of_birth CSRQ, ---  DateTime    Y  出生日期
       (CASE
         WHEN FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(B.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME, A.DATE_OF_BIRTH) / 12) >= 1 THEN
          FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(B.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME, A.DATE_OF_BIRTH) / 12)
         ELSE
          0
       END) NL, ---  NUMERIC    Y  年龄
       a.citizenship GJ, ---  VARCHAR2  50  Y  国籍：国家名称
       NVL(B.WEIGHT_BIRTH, 0) XSECSTZ, ---  INT  6  N  新生儿出生体重：单位（克），精确到10克，新生儿必填
       B.BODY_WEIGHT XSERYTZ, ---  INT  6  N  新生儿入院体重：单位（克），精确到10克，新生儿必填
       DECODE(a.marital_status,
              '未婚',
              '1',
              '已婚',
              '2',
              '丧偶',
              '3',
              '离婚',
              '4',
              '其他',
              '9',
              a.marital_status) HYZK, ---  VARCHAR  2  Y  婚姻状况：（1：未婚；2：已婚；3：丧偶；4：离婚；9：其他）
       NVL((SELECT y.nation_name
             FROM HIS.nation_dict y
            WHERE y.nation_code = a.nation
               OR y.nation_name = a.nation),
           a.nation || '族') MZ, ---  VARCHAR  20  Y  民族：直接上传名称
       (SELECT m.name
          FROM HIS.pub_dictionary m
         WHERE m.DICTIONARYTYPEID = '371377748353093'
           AND m.code = (SUBSTR(a.birth_place, 0, 2) || '0000')) ||
       (SELECT m.name
          FROM HIS.pub_dictionary m
         WHERE m.DICTIONARYTYPEID = '371377748353093'
           AND m.code = SUBSTR(B.PATIENT_AREA, 0, 4) || '00') JG, ---  VARCHAR  32  Y  籍贯：格式：”XX省（区、市）XX市“
       (SELECT o.area_name
          FROM HIS.area_dict o
         WHERE o.area_code = a.birth_place) CSD, ---  VARCHAR  200  Y  出生地
       a.id_no SFZ, ---  VARCHAR  18  Y  身份证号
       a.next_of_kin_phone LXDH, ---  VARCHAR  20  Y  联系电话
       b.discharge_date_time CYSJ, ---  DATETIME    Y  出院时间
       b.dept_discharge_from CYKSBM, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  出院科室编码
       CASE
         WHEN ROUND(TO_NUMBER(B.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME - B.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME),
                    0) = 0 THEN
          1
         ELSE
          ROUND(TO_NUMBER(B.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME - B.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME), 0)
       END SJZYTS, ---  NUMERIC  4  Y  实际住院天数
       CASE
         WHEN B.DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION IN ('1', '3', '4', '6', '7') THEN
          '1'
         WHEN B.DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION IN ('2') THEN
          '3'
         WHEN B.DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION IN ('5') THEN
          '2'
       END CYFS, ---  VARCHAR  1  Y  出院方式：（1：常规；2：自动；3：转院；）
       (SELECT DECODE(c.patient_status_name,
                      '一般',
                      '3',
                      '重',
                      '1',
                      '危',
                      '1',
                      '9')
          FROM HIS.patient_status_dict c
         WHERE b.pat_adm_condition = c.patient_status_code) RYQK, ---  VARCHAR  4  Y  入院情况：（1：危重；2：急诊；3：一般；9：其他；）
       CASE
         WHEN b.entrance_hospital IS NULL THEN
          '2'
         ELSE
          '1'
       END RYQWYZZ, ---  VARCHAR  1  N  入院前经外院诊治：（1：有；2：无）
       cast( NULL as date) as QZRQ, ---  DATETIME    N  确诊日期
       NULL MZCYZD, ---
       b.ALERGY_DRUGS YWGM, ---  VARCHAR  500  Y  药物过敏：填写具体药物的名称，多种以”;“间隔，没有必填”无“
       b.EMER_TREAT_TIMES QJCS, ---  INT    N  抢救次数
       b.ESC_EMER_TIMES CGCS, ---  INT    N  成功次数
       b.SERIOUS_INDICATOR SFCXWJN, ---  VARCHAR  3  Y  住院是否出现危重、急症、疑难：0：否；1：是；
       NULL SFCXYC, ---  VARCHAR  3  Y  住院是否出现压疮：0：否；1：是；
       b.BLOOD_TYPE XX, ---  VARCHAR  2  N  血型：（1：A；2：B；3：O；4：AB；5：不详；6：未查；）
       NULL XSEJBSC, ---  VARCHAR  3  Y  新生儿疾病筛查：1：是；2：否；
       cast(null as number(4,2))as CHCYL, ---  NUMERIC  8,1  Y  产后出血量：单位为ml
       NULL XSE_XB, ---  VARCHAR      新生儿性别
       b.DIRECTOR ZRYSGH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  主任医师工号
       (SELECT name FROM HIS.staff_dict st WHERE st.emp_no = b.director) ZRYSXM, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  主任医师姓名
       b.attending_doctor ZZYSGH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  主治医师工号
       (SELECT name FROM HIS.staff_dict st WHERE st.emp_no = b.attending_doctor) ZZYSXM, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  主治医师姓名
       b.doctor_in_charge ZYYSGH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  住院医师工号
       (SELECT name FROM HIS.staff_dict st WHERE st.emp_no = b.doctor_in_charge) ZYYSXM, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  住院医师姓名
       NULL HSZGH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  护士长工号
       NULL HSZXM, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  护士长姓名
       b.duty_nurse ZRHSGH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  责任护士工号
       (SELECT name FROM HIS.staff_dict st WHERE st.emp_no = b.duty_nurse) ZRHSXM, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  责任护士姓名
       b.doctor_of_control_quality ZKYSGH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  质控医师工号
       (SELECT name
          FROM HIS.staff_dict st
         WHERE st.emp_no = b.doctor_of_control_quality) ZKYSXM, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  质控医师姓名
       b.nurse_of_control_quality ZKHSGH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  质控护士工号
       (SELECT name
          FROM HIS.staff_dict st
         WHERE st.emp_no = b.nurse_of_control_quality) ZKHSXM, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  质控护士姓名
       b.date_of_control_quality ZKRQ, ---  DATETIME    Y  质控控日期
       NULL SWGBYY, ---  VARCHAR  500  N  死亡根本原因：离远方式为死亡时必填
       cast(null as date) as SWSJ, ---  DATETIME    N  死亡时间：离远方式为死亡时必填
       (SELECT mr_code
          FROM HIS.MR_COMM_VS_HIS_COMM t
         WHERE t.CLASS_CODE = 'DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_DICT'
           AND t.HIS_CODE = b.discharge_disposition) LYFS, ---  VARCHAR  1  Y  离院方式：1：医嘱离院；2：医嘱转院，拟接收医疗机构名称；3：医嘱转社区卫生服务机构/乡镇卫生院，拟接收医疗机构名称；4：非医嘱离院；5：死亡；9：其他
       CASE
         WHEN (SELECT mr_code
                 FROM HIS.MR_COMM_VS_HIS_COMM t
                WHERE t.CLASS_CODE = 'DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_DICT'
                  AND t.HIS_CODE = b.discharge_disposition) = 2 THEN
          b.trans_hospital
         WHEN (SELECT mr_code
                 FROM HIS.MR_COMM_VS_HIS_COMM t
                WHERE t.CLASS_CODE = 'DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_DICT'
                  AND t.HIS_CODE = b.discharge_disposition) = 3 THEN
          b.trans_community
       END NJSYYMC, ---  VARCHAR  200  N  离院后拟接收医疗机构名称：离院方式为2和3时，必填
       CASE
         WHEN NVL(b.PLAN_31_ADMISSION, '0') = '2' THEN
          b.REASON_31_ADMISSION
         ELSE
          '无'
       END ZZYJH_31, ---  VARCHAR  200  Y  是否有出院31天内再住院计划：如有，请填写再入院目的，否则填写”无“。
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id) ZYZFY, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  住院总费用
       c.brfdje ZYZFYQZZFJE, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  住院总费用其中自付金额
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%一般医疗服务费%') YBYLFWF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  一般医疗服务费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%一般治疗操作费%') YBZLCZF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  一般治疗操作费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%护理费%') HLF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  护理费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%其他费用%') ZHYLFWLQTFY, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  综合医疗服务类其他费用
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%病理诊断费%') BLZDF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  病理诊断费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%实验室诊断费%') SYSZDF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  实验室诊断费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%影像学诊断费%') YXXZDF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  影像学诊断费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%临床诊断项目费%') LCZDXMF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  临床诊断项目费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND (y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%非手术治疗项目费%' or y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%临床物理治疗费%')) XMF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  非手术治疗项目费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%临床物理治疗费%') QZLCWLZLF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  其中：临床物理治疗费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND (y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%手术治疗费%' or  y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%麻醉费%' or y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%手术费%')) SSZLF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  手术治疗费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%麻醉费%') QZMZF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  其中：麻醉费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%手术费%') QZSSF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  其中：手术费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%康复费%') KFF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  康复费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%中医治疗费%') ZYZLF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  中医治疗费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND (y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%西药费%' or y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%抗菌药物费%')) XYF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  西药费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%抗菌药物费%') QZKJYWF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  其中：抗菌药物费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%中成药费%') ZCYF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  中成药费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%中草药费%') ZCAOYF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  中草药费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%血费%') XF, ---  NUMBER  12，3  Y  血费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%白蛋白类制品费%') BDBLZPF, ---  NUMBER  16,3  Y  白蛋白类制品费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%球蛋白类制品费%') QDBLZPF, ---  NUMBER  16,3  Y  球蛋白类制品费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%凝血因子类制品费%') NXYZLZPF, ---  NUMBER  16,3  Y  凝血因子类制品费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%细胞因子类制品费%') XBYZLZPF, ---  NUMBER  16,3  Y  细胞因子类制品费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%检查用一次性医用材料费%') JCYYCXYYCLF, ---  NUMBER  16,3  Y  检查用一次性医用材料费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%治疗用一次性医用材料费%') ZLYYCXYYCLF, ---  NUMBER  16,3  Y  治疗用一次性医用材料费
       (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name LIKE '%手术用一次性医用材料费%') SSYYCXYYCLF, ---  NUMBER  16,3  Y  手术用一次性医用材料费
        (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class ='其他费') + (SELECT NVL(SUM(x.costs), 0)
          FROM HIS.MR_BILL_COSTS x, HIS.mr_bill_class_dict y
         WHERE x.patient_id = b.patient_id
           AND x.visit_id = b.visit_id
           AND x.mr_bill_class = y.mr_bill_class_code
           AND y.mr_bill_class_name = '其他费') QTF, ---  NUMBER  16,3  Y  其他费
       CASE
         WHEN b.CLINICAL_PATHWAY = '1' THEN
          '2'
         ELSE
          '3'
       END SSLCLJ, ---  VARCHAR  1  Y  实施临床路径：（1：中医；2：西医；3：否；）
       (SELECT dd.dept_name
          FROM HIS.dept_dict dd
         WHERE dd.dept_code = b.dept_discharge_from) CYKSMC, ---出院科室名称
       d.operation_code SSBM2, ---病案首页 第二手术编码
       d.operation_desc SSMC2 ---病案首页 第二手术名称
  FROM HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX A, HIS.PAT_VISIT B, HIS.SETTLE_ZY_REC C, HIS.OPERATION D
 WHERE A.PATIENT_ID = B.PATIENT_ID
   AND C.PATIENT_ID(+) = b.PATIENT_ID
   AND C.VISIT_ID(+) = b.VISIT_ID
   AND D.PATIENT_ID(+) = b.patient_id
   AND D.VISIT_ID(+) = b.visit_id
   AND d.operation_no(+) = '2'
   AND b.discharge_date_time >= TO_DATE('20200101', 'yyyymmdd');*/

EMR_SHOUYE_JH.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "DBZ"."EMR_SHOUYE_JH" ("JZLSH1", "JZLSH", "RYSJ", "RYLX", "ZRY30TN", "YLFFFS", "ZYCS", "MZH", "ZYH", "BAH", "PATIENTID", "XM", "XB", "CSRQ", "NL", "GJ", "XSECSTZ", "XSERYTZ", "HYZK", "SFZ", "LXDH", "CYSJ", "CYKSBM", "CYKSMC", "SJZYTS", "RYQWYZZ", "QZRQ", "MZCYZD", "YWGM", "QJCS", "CGCS", "SFCXWJN", "SFCXYC", "XX", "XSEJBSC", "CHCYL", "XSE_XB", "ZRYSGH", "ZZYSGH", "ZYYSGH", "HSZGH", "HSZXM", "ZRHSGH", "ZKYSGH", "ZKHSGH", "ZKRQ", "SWGBYY", "SWSJ", "LYFS", "ZZYJH_31", "SSLCLJ") AS 
  select
to_char( A.INP_NO)||''||to_char( B.visit_id) as jzlsh1,
nvl(substr( b.ZYLSH,0,instr(b.zylsh,'-')-1 ),A.INP_NO) ||'-' || substr('000' || to_char(B.visit_id),
                                     length('000' || to_char(B.visit_id)) - 2,
                                     3) as
                                     JZLSH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  就诊流水号：医院his的唯一编号
       b.admission_date_time RYSJ, ---  DATETIME    Y  入院时间（yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss）
       decode(b.patient_class, 2, '1', 1, '2', 3, '3', 9, '9', '9') RYLX, ---  VARCHAR  2  Y  入院类型（途径）：编码（1：门诊入院；2：急诊入院；3：其他医疗机构转入；9：其他）
       --case when b.visit_id=1 then 0 when exists(select 1 from HIS.PAT_VISIT t1 where t1.patient_id=a.patient_id and t1.visit_id=(b.visit_id-1) and t1.discharge_date_time < (b.admission_date_time-30)) then 1 else 0 end
       0 as ZRY30TN,
       nvl((SELECT '0' || x.stat_code
             FROM HIS.STAT_VS_CHARGE_TYPE x
            where x.charge_name = b.charge_type),
           '07') YLFFFS, ---  VARCHAR  4  Y  医疗付费方式：（01：城镇职工基本医疗保险；02：城乡居民基本医疗保险；03：新型农村合作医疗；04：贫困救助；05：商业医疗保险；06：全公费；07：全自费；08：其他社会保险（指生育保险、工伤保险、农民工保险等）；99：其他）
       b.visit_id ZYCS, ---  INT  4  Y  住院次数：对应病案首页上的第_次住院
       a.patient_id MZH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  门诊号
       nvl(substr( b.ZYLSH,0,instr(b.zylsh,'-')-1 ),A.INP_NO) ZYH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  住院号
       nvl(substr( b.ZYLSH,0,instr(b.zylsh,'-')-1 ),A.INP_NO) BAH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  病案号：指本医疗机构为患者住院病案设置的唯一性编码。原则上，统一患者在同一医疗机构多次住院应当使用同一病案号。
       a.patient_id PatientId, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  患者id
       a.name XM, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  姓名：新生儿姓名填写为XX之女或XX之子
       decode(a.sex, '男', '1', '女', '2', '9') XB, ---  VARCHAR  6  Y  性别：（1：男；2：女；9：未说明的性别；）
       a.date_of_birth CSRQ, ---  DateTime    Y  出生日期
       (CASE
         WHEN floor(months_between(B.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME, A.DATE_OF_BIRTH) / 12) >= 1 THEN
          floor(months_between(B.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME, A.DATE_OF_BIRTH) / 12)
         ELSE
          0
       END) NL, ---  NUMERIC    Y  年龄
       a.citizenship GJ, ---  VARCHAR2  50  Y  国籍：国家名称
       nvl(B.WEIGHT_BIRTH, 0) XSECSTZ, ---  INT  6  N  新生儿出生体重：单位（克），精确到10克，新生儿必填
       B.BODY_WEIGHT XSERYTZ, ---  INT  6  N  新生儿入院体重：单位（克），精确到10克，新生儿必填
       decode(a.marital_status,
              '未婚',
              '1',
              '已婚',
              '2',
              '丧偶',
              '3',
              '离婚',
              '4',
              '其他',
              '9',
              a.marital_status) HYZK, ---  VARCHAR  2  Y  婚姻状况：（1：未婚；2：已婚；3：丧偶；4：离婚；9：其他）

       a.id_no SFZ, ---  VARCHAR  18  Y  身份证号
       a.next_of_kin_phone LXDH, ---  VARCHAR  20  Y  联系电话
       b.discharge_date_time CYSJ, ---  DATETIME    Y  出院时间
       b.dept_discharge_from CYKSBM, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  出院科室编码
       d.dept_name as CYKSMC,--出院
       CASE
         WHEN round(TO_NUMBER(B.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME - B.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME),
                    0) = 0 THEN
          1
         ELSE
          round(TO_NUMBER(B.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME - B.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME), 0)
       END SJZYTS, ---  NUMERIC  4  Y  实际住院天数

       case
         when b.entrance_hospital is null then
          '2'
         else
          '1'
       end RYQWYZZ, ---  VARCHAR  1  N  入院前经外院诊治：（1：有；2：无）
       cast(null as date) QZRQ, ---  DATETIME    N  确诊日期
       cast( null as varchar(50)) MZCYZD, ---
       b.ALERGY_DRUGS YWGM, ---  VARCHAR  500  Y  药物过敏：填写具体药物的名称，多种以”;“间隔，没有必填”无“
       b.EMER_TREAT_TIMES QJCS, ---  INT    N  抢救次数
       b.ESC_EMER_TIMES CGCS, ---  INT    N  成功次数
       b.SERIOUS_INDICATOR SFCXWJN, ---  VARCHAR  3  Y  住院是否出现危重、急症、疑难：0：否；1：是；
       cast( null as varchar(50)) SFCXYC, ---  VARCHAR  3  Y  住院是否出现压疮：0：否；1：是；
       b.BLOOD_TYPE XX, ---  VARCHAR  2  N  血型：（1：A；2：B；3：O；4：AB；5：不详；6：未查；）
       cast( null as varchar(50)) XSEJBSC, ---  VARCHAR  3  Y  新生儿疾病筛查：1：是；2：否；
       cast( null as number) CHCYL, ---  NUMERIC  8,1  Y  产后出血量：单位为ml
       cast( null as varchar(50)) XSE_XB, ---  VARCHAR      新生儿性别
       b.DIRECTOR ZRYSGH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  主任医师工号
       --(select name from HIS.staff_dict st where st.emp_no = b.director) ZRYSXM, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  主任医师姓名
       b.attending_doctor ZZYSGH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  主治医师工号
       --(select name from HIS.staff_dict st where st.emp_no = b.attending_doctor) ZZYSXM, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  主治医师姓名
       b.doctor_in_charge ZYYSGH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  住院医师工号
       --(select name from HIS.staff_dict st where st.emp_no = b.doctor_in_charge) ZYYSXM, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  住院医师姓名
       cast( null as varchar(50)) HSZGH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  护士长工号
       cast( null as varchar(50)) HSZXM, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  护士长姓名
       b.duty_nurse ZRHSGH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  责任护士工号
       --(select name from HIS.staff_dict st where st.emp_no = b.duty_nurse) ZRHSXM, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  责任护士姓名
       b.doctor_of_control_quality ZKYSGH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  质控医师工号
       --(select name from HIS.staff_dict st where st.emp_no = b.doctor_of_control_quality) ZKYSXM, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  质控医师姓名
       b.nurse_of_control_quality ZKHSGH, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  质控护士工号
       --(select name from HIS.staff_dict st where st.emp_no = b.nurse_of_control_quality) ZKHSXM, ---  VARCHAR  50  Y  质控护士姓名
       b.date_of_control_quality ZKRQ, ---  DATETIME    Y  质控控日期
       cast( null as varchar(50)) SWGBYY, ---  VARCHAR  500  N  死亡根本原因：离远方式为死亡时必填
       cast( null as date) SWSJ, ---  DATETIME    N  死亡时间：离远方式为死亡时必填
       (select mr_code
          FROM HIS.MR_COMM_VS_HIS_COMM t
         WHERE t.CLASS_CODE = 'DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_DICT'
           and t.HIS_CODE = b.discharge_disposition) LYFS, ---  VARCHAR  1  Y  离院方式：1：医嘱离院；2：医嘱转院，拟接收医疗机构名称；3：医嘱转社区卫生服务机构/乡镇卫生院，拟接收医疗机构名称；4：非医嘱离院；5：死亡；9：其他

       case
         when nvl(b.PLAN_31_ADMISSION, 0) = 2 then
          b.REASON_31_ADMISSION
         else
          '无'
       end ZZYJH_31, ---  VARCHAR  200  Y  是否有出院31天内再住院计划：如有，请填写再入院目的，否则填写”无“。
       case
         when b.CLINICAL_PATHWAY = 1 then
          2
         else
          3
       end SSLCLJ ---  VARCHAR  1  Y  实施临床路径：（1：中医；2：西医；3：否；）
       from HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX A
  left join HIS.PAT_VISIT B on A.PATIENT_ID = B.PATIENT_ID
  --left join HIS.SETTLE_ZY_REC C on C.PATIENT_ID= b.PATIENT_ID and C.VISIT_ID=b.VISIT_ID
  left join HIS.DEPT_DICT d on  d.dept_code=b.dept_discharge_from
 where  length(a.inp_no)!=0-- is not null

   and b.discharge_date_time >= to_date('20200101','yyyymmdd')

EMR_YYJL.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "DBZ"."EMR_YYJL" ("PATIENTID", "ZYJZLSH", "SZKSDM", "SZKSMC", "SZBQDM", "SZBQMC", "YZZH", "YZXH", "YZLBDM", "SFCQSY", "YZXMLXDM", "ITEMCODE", "ITEMNAME", "YZCJSJ", "STARTTIME", "ENDTIME", "YYTJ", "KYZKSDM", "KYZKSMC", "ZXSJ", "YPSYCJL", "YPSYCJLDW", "ORDERCLASSNAME", "PC", "FREQ_COUNTER", "FREQ_INTERVAL", "FREQ_INTERVAL_UNIT", "ORDER_STATUS") AS 
  select
t.patient_id as PatientId,
nvl(substr( t4.ZYLSH,0,instr(t4.zylsh,'-') ),t1.inp_no) || substr('000' || to_char(t.visit_id),
                                     length('000' || to_char(t.visit_id)) - 2,
                                     3) ZYJZLSH,
t.Ordering_Dept as SZKSDM,
t2.dept_name as SZKSMC,
'' as SZBQDM,
'' as SZBQMC,
t.order_no as YZZH,
t.order_SUB_no as YZXH,
case when t.repeat_indicator='0' then '2' else '1' end as YZLBDM,--
case when t.repeat_indicator='0' then '临时' else '长期' end  as SFCQSY,
t.Order_Class as YZXMLXDM,
t.order_code as ITEMCODE,
t.order_text as ItemName,
t.start_date_time as YZCJSJ,
t.start_date_time as STARTTIME,
t.stop_date_time as ENDTIME,
t.administration as YYTJ,
t.ordering_dept as KYZKSDM,
t2.dept_name as KYZKSMC,
t.enter_date_time as ZXSJ,
t.dosage as YPSYCJL,
t.dosage_units as YPSYCJLDW,
t3.order_class_name as OrderClassName,
t.frequency as pc,
t.freq_counter,
t.freq_interval,
t.freq_interval_unit,
t.order_status


from HIS.ORDERs t
left join HIS.ORDER_CLASS_DICT t3 on t.order_class=t3.order_class_code
left join HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX t1 on t.patient_id=t1.patient_id
left join his.dept_dict t2 on t2.dept_code=t.ordering_dept
left join his.pat_visit t4 on t4.patient_id=t.patient_id and t4.visit_id=t.visit_id
where t.order_class='A' or t.order_class='AA' and t.order_status!=4 and t.order_status!=8
and t.start_date_time>=to_date('2024','yyyy')

LAB_REPORT.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "DBZ"."LAB_REPORT" ("LAIYUAN", "PATIENTID", "JZLSH", "JYLSH", "ITEMCODE", "ITEMNAME", "JCJG", "SUBITEMCODE", "SUBITEMNAME", "RESULTTYPE", "UNIT", "APPLYTIME", "REPORTTIME", "APPLYDEPTCODE", "APPLYDEPTNAME", "CKZ") AS 
  SELECT
case when lab.inp_id is null then '门诊' else '住院' end laiyuan,
       lab.pat_id as patientId,
       case when lab.inp_id is null then lab.custom1 else
           lab.pat_no || '-' || substr('000' || to_char(lab.inp_id),
                                     length('000' || to_char(lab.inp_id)) - 2,
                                    3)
                                    end
                                     as jzlsh,
       lab.barcode as jylsh,
       '' as itemCode,
       lab.req_reason as itemName,
       lar.result_str as jcjg,
       lar.rpt_itemcode as SubItemCode,
       lar.rpt_itemname as SubItemName,
       (case lar.result_flag when 'L' then '偏低'
       when 'LL' then '偏低'
         when 'M' then '正常'
         when 'N' then '阴性'
         when 'P' then '阳性'
         when 'Q' then '弱阳性'
         when 'H' then '偏高'
           when 'HH' then '偏高'
           else '正常' end) as ResultType,
             lar.result_unit as Unit,
             lab.req_dt as ApplyTime,
             nvl( nvl(lab.report_dt,lab.input_dt),lar.last_dt) as reportTime,
             lab.req_deptno as ApplyDeptCode,
             his.dept_name as ApplyDeptname,
             lar.result_ref as CKZ
FROM LIS.LAB_REPORT lab
left join LIS.LAB_RESULT lar on lab.reportid = lar.reportid
left join HIS.DEPT_DICT his on lab.req_deptno = his.dept_code
--left join HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX A on lab.pat_id=a.patient_id
--left join HIS.lab_test_master t on t.patient_id=lab.pat_id and t.test_no=lab.barcode
where lab.req_dt>=to_date('2020-01-01','yyyy-MM-dd') and lar.result_str!='已上机'-- and lab.req_dt<=to_date('2020-08-01','yyyy-MM-dd')

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "KZL"."BASYFY" ("PATIENT_ID", "VISIT_ID", "ZFY", "AA", "BB", "CC", "DD", "EE", "FF", "GG", "HH", "II", "JJ", "KK", "LL", "MM", "NN", "OO", "PP", "QQ", "RR", "SS", "TT", "UU", "VV", "WW", "XX", "YY", "ZZ", "AAA", "BBB") AS 
  select tt.patient_id,tt.visit_id,tt.tt zfy,
sum(D11) AA,sum(D12) BB,sum(D13) CC,sum(D14) DD,sum(D15) EE,sum(D16)FF,sum(D17) GG,sum(D18) HH
,sum(D19) II,sum(D19x01) JJ,sum(D20) KK,sum(D20x01) LL,sum(D20x02) MM ,sum(D21) NN,sum(D22) OO,sum(D23) PP,
sum(D23x01) QQ,sum(D24)RR,sum(D25)SS,sum(D26)TT,sum(D27)UU,sum(D28)VV,sum(D29)ww,sum(D30)xx,sum(D31)yy,sum(D32)zz
,sum(D33)aaa,sum(D34)bbb from (
select
a.patient_id,
a.visit_id,
(select sum(r.costs) from his.mr_bill_costs r where  a.patient_id=r.patient_id
   and a.visit_id=r.visit_id) tt,
decode(r.mr_bill_class,'01',sum(r.costs))  D11  ,-- 综合医疗服务费-一般医疗服务费
decode(r.mr_bill_class,'02',sum(r.costs))  D12  ,-- 综合医疗服务费-一般治疗操作费
decode(r.mr_bill_class,'03',sum(r.costs))  D13 ,-- 综合医疗服务费-护理费
decode(r.mr_bill_class,'04',sum(r.costs))  D14 ,-- 综合医疗服务费-其他费用
decode(r.mr_bill_class,'05',sum(r.costs))  D15  ,-- 诊断-病理诊断费
decode(r.mr_bill_class,'06',sum(r.costs))  D16  ,-- 诊断-实验室诊断费
decode(r.mr_bill_class,'07',sum(r.costs))  D17  ,-- 诊断-影像学诊断费
decode(r.mr_bill_class,'08',sum(r.costs))  D18  ,-- 诊断-临床诊断项目费
decode(r.mr_bill_class,'09',sum(r.costs))  D19  ,-- 治疗-非手术治疗项目费
decode(r.mr_bill_class,'0904',sum(r.costs))  D19x01 ,-- 治疗-非手术治疗项目费-临床物理治疗费
decode(r.mr_bill_class,'10',sum(r.costs))   D20 ,-- 治疗-手术治疗费
decode(r.mr_bill_class,'1001',sum(r.costs))   D20x01 ,-- 治疗-手术治疗费-麻醉费
decode(r.mr_bill_class,'1002',sum(r.costs))   D20x02 ,-- 治疗-手术治疗费-手术费
decode(r.mr_bill_class,'11',sum(r.costs))   D21  ,-- 康复费
decode(r.mr_bill_class,'12',sum(r.costs))   D22 ,-- 中医治疗费
decode(r.mr_bill_class,'13',sum(r.costs))   D23 ,-- 西药费
decode(r.mr_bill_class,'1301',sum(r.costs))   D23x01  ,-- 西药费-抗菌药物费用
decode(r.mr_bill_class,'14',sum(r.costs))   D24 ,-- 中药费-中成药费
decode(r.mr_bill_class,'15',sum(r.costs))   D25 ,-- 中药费-中草药费
decode(r.mr_bill_class,'16',sum(r.costs))   D26 ,-- 血费
decode(r.mr_bill_class,'17',sum(r.costs))  D27  ,-- 白蛋白类制品费
decode(r.mr_bill_class,'18',sum(r.costs))   D28  ,-- 球蛋白类制品费
decode(r.mr_bill_class,'19',sum(r.costs))   D29 ,-- 凝血因子类制品费
decode(r.mr_bill_class,'20',sum(r.costs))   D30  ,-- 细胞因子类制品费
decode(r.mr_bill_class,'21',sum(r.costs))   D31  ,-- 一次性医用材料费-检查用
decode(r.mr_bill_class,'22',sum(r.costs))   D32  ,-- 一次性医用材料费-治疗用
decode(r.mr_bill_class,'23',sum(r.costs))   D33 ,-- 一次性医用材料费-手术用
decode(r.mr_bill_class,'24',sum(r.costs))   D34 -- 其他费
  from his.pat_visit a,his.pat_master_index t,kzl.patient_id b,his.mr_bill_costs r
 where a.patient_id=b.paid
   and a.visit_id=b.vi
   and a.patient_id=t.patient_id
   and a.patient_id=r.patient_id
   and a.visit_id=r.visit_id
   group by a.patient_id,
a.visit_id,r.mr_bill_class,t.patient_id) tt  group by tt.patient_id,visit_id,tt
