EXAM_INFO.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "KZL"."EXAM_INFO" ("PATIENT_ID", "VISIT_SN", "VISIT_TYPE", "VISIT_CARD_NO", "OUTPATIENT_NO", "VISIT_TIMES", "MEDICAL_RECORD_NO", "INPATIENT_NO", "HOSPITALIZATION_TIMES", "NAME", "APPLY_NO", "ORDER_SN", "APPLY_DATETIME", "APPLY_DEPT_CODE", "APPLY_DEPT_NAME", "EXAM_SN", "EXAM_DATETIME", "EXAM_TYPE", "EXAM_ITEM_TYPE", "EXAM_ITEM_CODE", "EXAM_ITEM_NAME", "EXAM_SITES", "REPORT_NO", "REPORT_DATETIME", "REPORT_DEPT_CODE", "REPORT_DEPT_NAME", "EXAM_DIAG_DESCRIPTION", "EXAM_DIAG_CONCLUSION", "EXTEND_DATA1", "EXTEND_DATA2", "RECORD_STATUS") AS 
  SELECT
                        ER.PATIENT_ID,  --  患者在本院的唯一标识
                        ER.PATIENT_ID || '|' || --  标识一次就诊行为的唯一编号，如果原系统中需多个字段标识，则通过"|"进行拼接。例如，患者ID|住院号|住院次数|就诊类型、患者ID|门诊号|就诊次数|就诊类型
                        (CASE  WHEN ER.VISIT_TYPE = '住院' THEN TO_CHAR(EM.VISIT_ID)
                               WHEN ER.VISIT_TYPE = '病房' THEN TO_CHAR(EM.VISIT_ID)
                               WHEN ER.VISIT_TYPE = '门诊' AND (SELECT COUNT(HC.VISIT_NO) FROM HIS.CLINIC_MASTER HC WHERE HC.PATIENT_ID = ER.PATIENT_ID
              AND TO_CHAR(HC.VISIT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = TO_CHAR(EM.REQ_DATE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND HC.VISIT_DEPT = EM.REQ_DEPT
              AND HC.DOCTOR = EM.REQ_PHYSICIAN AND HC.REGISTRATION_STATUS = 2 ) = 1 THEN (SELECT TO_CHAR(HC.VISIT_NO) FROM HIS.CLINIC_MASTER HC WHERE HC.PATIENT_ID = ER.PATIENT_ID
              AND TO_CHAR(HC.VISIT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = TO_CHAR(EM.REQ_DATE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND HC.VISIT_DEPT = EM.REQ_DEPT
              AND HC.DOCTOR = EM.REQ_PHYSICIAN AND HC.REGISTRATION_STATUS = 2 ) ELSE '' END )
                         || '|' || (CASE WHEN ER.VISIT_TYPE = '病房' THEN '住院' ELSE ER.VISIT_TYPE END) VISIT_SN,  --  标识一次就诊行为的唯一编号，如果原系统中需多个字段标识，则通过"|"进行拼接。例如，患者ID|住院号|住院次数|就诊类型、患者ID|门诊号|就诊次数|就诊类型
                        (CASE WHEN ER.VISIT_TYPE = '病房' THEN '住院' ELSE ER.VISIT_TYPE END) VISIT_TYPE, --  就诊类型：住院、门诊
                        ER.PATIENT_ID VISIT_CARD_NO,  --  患者在本医院就诊时使用的就诊卡号
                        (CASE ER.VISIT_TYPE WHEN '门诊' THEN NULL
                                            ELSE ER.PATIENT_ID
                        END ) OUTPATIENT_NO,  --  患者门诊就诊时对应的门诊号或者病历号
                        (CASE ER.VISIT_TYPE WHEN '门诊' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HIS.CLINIC_MASTER C WHERE C.PATIENT_ID = ER.PATIENT_ID AND ER.PATIENT_ID IS NOT NULL)
                                            ELSE (select max(t.visit_id) from  his.pat_visit  t where T.patient_id= ER.patient_id)
                        END ) VISIT_TIMES,  --  本院门诊次数
                        (CASE WHEN ER.MEDICAL_RECORD_NO IS NULL THEN ER.PATIENT_ID  --  患者在本院就诊时使用的病案号
                            ELSE ER.MEDICAL_RECORD_NO END) MEDICAL_RECORD_NO,
                        ER.INPATIENT_NO,  --  患者住院号
                        (CASE  WHEN ER.VISIT_TYPE = '住院' THEN TO_CHAR(EM.VISIT_ID)
                               WHEN ER.VISIT_TYPE = '病房' THEN TO_CHAR(EM.VISIT_ID)
                               WHEN ER.VISIT_TYPE = '门诊' AND (SELECT COUNT(HC.VISIT_NO) FROM HIS.CLINIC_MASTER HC WHERE HC.PATIENT_ID = ER.PATIENT_ID
              AND TO_CHAR(HC.VISIT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = TO_CHAR(EM.REQ_DATE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND HC.VISIT_DEPT = EM.REQ_DEPT
              AND HC.DOCTOR = EM.REQ_PHYSICIAN AND HC.REGISTRATION_STATUS = 2 ) = 1 THEN (SELECT TO_CHAR(HC.VISIT_NO) FROM HIS.CLINIC_MASTER HC WHERE HC.PATIENT_ID = ER.PATIENT_ID
              AND TO_CHAR(HC.VISIT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = TO_CHAR(EM.REQ_DATE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND HC.VISIT_DEPT = EM.REQ_DEPT
              AND HC.DOCTOR = EM.REQ_PHYSICIAN AND HC.REGISTRATION_STATUS = 2 ) ELSE '' END )  HOSPITALIZATION_TIMES, --  住院次数
                        ER.NAME,  --  患者姓名
                        ER.APPLY_NO,  --  该字段能够与表14门诊医嘱及处方或表10住院医嘱(request_no)进行关联
                        ER.APPLY_NO ORDER_SN, --  该字段能够与表14门诊医嘱及处方或表10住院医嘱(order_sn)进行关联
                        (CASE WHEN ER.APPLY_DATETIME < ER.EXAM_DATETIME THEN ER.APPLY_DATETIME
                            WHEN ER.APPLY_DATETIME >= ER.EXAM_DATETIME THEN ER.EXAM_DATETIME END )APPLY_DATETIME, --  申请单开单时间
                        ER.APPLY_DEPT_CODE, --  科室名称对应的编码
                        ER.APPLY_DEPT_NAME, --  申请科室名称
                        ER.EXAM_SN, --  通过|拼接保证表内唯一
                        (CASE WHEN ER.APPLY_DATETIME >= ER.EXAM_DATETIME THEN ER.APPLY_DATETIME
                            WHEN ER.APPLY_DATETIME < ER.EXAM_DATETIME THEN ER.EXAM_DATETIME END ) EXAM_DATETIME,  --  即到检时间
                        ER.EXAM_TYPE, --  心电\超声\放射
                        case when ER.EXAM_TYPE like '%胃%' then '胃'
                             when ER.EXAM_TYPE like '%肠%' then '肠' else ER.EXAM_ITEM_TYPE end EXAM_ITEM_TYPE, --  CT、腹部彩超、肠镜、胃镜、动态心电、12导联心电
                        ER.EXAM_ITEM_CODE,  --  填写医院原始代码
                        ER.EXAM_ITEM_NAME,  --  填写检查项目名称
                         Nvl((case when ER.EXAM_ITEM_TYPE like '%胃%' then '胃'
                             when ER.EXAM_ITEM_TYPE like '%肠%' then '肠'
                            when ER.EXAM_ITEM_TYPE like '%心%' then '心脏'
                           else ER.EXAM_SITES End),ER.EXAM_ITEM_NAME) exam_sites,
                        ER.REPORT_NO,
                        ER.REPORT_DATETIME, --  符合【yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss】的格式
                        ER.REPORT_DEPT_CODE,  --  报告科室对应的编码
                        ER.REPORT_DEPT_NAME,  --  发布检查报告的科室
                        ER.EXAM_DIAG_DESCRIPTION, --  可上传json结构数据或者字符串拼接
                        ER.EXAM_DIAG_CONCLUSION,  --  可上传json结构数据或者字符串拼接
                        ER.EXTEND_DATA1,  --  用于填写补充信息
                        ER.EXTEND_DATA2,  --  用于填写补充信息
                        ER.RECORD_STATUS  --  1正常 0作废

          FROM KZL.EXAM_REPORT ER
               LEFT JOIN HIS.EXAM_MASTER EM ON EM.EXAM_NO = ER.APPLY_NO
          WHERE ER.VISIT_TYPE IN ('住院', '病房', '门诊')-- TO_CHAR(ER.EXAM_DATETIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') >= '2022-01-01 00:00:00' -- ORDER BY ER.EXAM_DATETIME ASC
                AND ER.PATIENT_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT PI.PAID FROM  KZL.PATIENT_ID PI )

INPATIENT_INFO.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "KZL"."INPATIENT_INFO" ("PATIENT_ID", "VISIT_SN", "VISIT_CARD_NO", "MEDICAL_RECORD_NO", "INPATIENT_NO", "HOSPITALIZATION_TIMES", "NAME", "ADMISSION_DATETIME", "CURRENT_DEPT_CODE", "CURRENT_DEPT_NAME", "CURRENT_WARD_NAME", "CURRENT_BED_NAME", "VISIT_DOCTOR_NO", "DISCHARGE_DATETIME", "DISCHARGE_DEPT_CODE", "DISCHARGE_DEPT_NAME", "FEE_TYPE", "ADMISSION_TYPE_CODE", "ADMISSION_TYPE_NAME", "SPECIAL_FLAG", "EXTEND_DATA1", "EXTEND_DATA2", "RECORD_STATUS") AS 
  select

(

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "KZL"."PATHOLOGICAL_EXAM_RECORD" ("PATIENT_ID", "VISIT_SN", "VISIT_TYPE", "VISIT_CARD_NO", "OUTPATIENT_NO", "VISIT_TIMES", "MEDICAL_RECORD_NO", "INPATIENT_NO", "HOSPITALIZATION_TIMES", "NAME", "GENDER", "AGE", "DATE_OF_BIRTH", "APPLY_NO", "ORDER_SN", "APPLY_DATETIME", "PATHOLOGY_NO", "PATHOLOGY_SN", "EXAM_DATETIME", "PATHOLOGY_TEST_TYPE_CODE", "PATHOLOGY_TEST_TYPE", "SPECIMEN_SITE", "SPECIMEN_OBTAIN_METHOD", "SPECIMEN_TYPE", "SPECIMEN_CODE", "COLLECTED_DATETIME", "RECEIVED_DATETIME", "REPORT_NO", "REPORT_DATETIME", "STAGING_VERSION", "CLINICAL_STAGE", "PATHO_T_STAGING", "PATHO_N_STAGING", "PATHO_M_STAGING", "GROSS_DESCRIPTION", "MICRO_DESCRIPTION", "PATHO_DIAG_CONCLUSION", "IHC_RESULTS", "MOL_TEST_MARK", "MOL_TEST_GENE_AND_METHOD", "MOL_TEST_RESULT", "DIFFERENTIATION_DEGREE", "BLOOD_VESSEL_INFIL", "LYMPH_INFILT", "LYMPH_MET", "VASC_TUMOUR_THROMBUS", "NERVE_INVASION", "EXTEND_DATA1", "EXTEND_DATA2", "RECORD_STATUS", "INTRAOPERATIVE_FREEZING_RESULT", "RECORDER1", "RECORDER2") AS 
  SELECT
BP.PATIENT_ID,  --  患者在本院的唯一标识
   BP.PATIENT_ID || '|' ||
  (CASE  WHEN BP.VISIT_TYPE = '住院' THEN (SELECT TO_CHAR(HL.VISIT_ID) FROM HIS.lab_test_master HL WHERE HL.TEST_NO = BP.APPLY_NO)
         WHEN BP.VISIT_TYPE = '门诊' AND (SELECT COUNT(HC.VISIT_NO) FROM HIS.CLINIC_MASTER HC WHERE HC.PATIENT_ID = BP.PATIENT_ID
              AND TO_CHAR(HC.VISIT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = TO_CHAR(HL.REQUESTED_DATE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND HC.VISIT_DEPT = HL.ORDERING_DEPT
              AND HC.DOCTOR = HL.ORDERING_PROVIDER AND HC.REGISTRATION_STATUS = 2 ) = 1 THEN (SELECT TO_CHAR(HC.VISIT_NO) FROM HIS.CLINIC_MASTER HC WHERE HC.PATIENT_ID = BP.PATIENT_ID
              AND TO_CHAR(HC.VISIT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = TO_CHAR(HL.REQUESTED_DATE_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND HC.VISIT_DEPT = HL.ORDERING_DEPT
              AND HC.DOCTOR = HL.ORDERING_PROVIDER AND HC.REGISTRATION_STATUS = 2 ) ELSE '' END )
                             || '|' || BP.VISIT_TYPE visit_sn,  --  标识一次就诊行为的唯一编号，如果原系统中需多个字段标识，则通过"|"进行拼接。例如，患者ID|住院号|住院次数|就诊类型、患者ID|门诊号|就诊次数|就诊类型
  BP.VISIT_TYPE,  --  就诊类型：住院、门诊
  BP.PATIENT_ID VISIT_CARD_NO,  --  患者在本医院就诊时使用的就诊卡号
  (CASE BP.VISIT_TYPE WHEN '门诊' THEN NULL
          WHEN '病房' THEN BP.PATIENT_ID ELSE NULL END ) OUTPATIENT_NO, --  患者门诊就诊时对应的门诊号或者病历号
  (CASE BP.VISIT_TYPE WHEN '住院' THEN (select max(t.visit_id) from  his.pat_visit  t where T.patient_id= BP.patient_id)
          WHEN '门诊' THEN NULL END ) VISIT_TIMES,  --  本院门诊次数
  BP.PATIENT_ID MEDICAL_RECORD_NO,  --  患者在本院就诊时使用的病案号
  BP.INPATIENT_NO,  --  患者住院号
  BP.HOSPITALIZATION_TIMES,
  BP.NAME,
  BP.GENDER,  --  性别：男、女、未知
  BP.AGE, --  年龄（岁）
  BP.DATE_OF_BIRTH, --  出生日期：yyyy-MM-dd
  BP.APPLY_NO,  --  该字段能够与表14门诊医嘱及处方或表10住院医嘱(request_no)进行关联
  BP.ORDER_SN,  --  该字段能够与表14门诊医嘱及处方或表10住院医嘱(order_sn)进行关联
  BP.APPLY_DATETIME,  --  符合【yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss】的格式
  BP.PATHOLOGY_NO,
  BP.PATHOLOGY_SN,  --  通过|拼接保证表内唯一
  BP.EXAM_DATETIME,
  BP.PATHOLOGY_TEST_TYPE_CODE,  --  填写医院原始代码
  BP.PATHOLOGY_TEST_TYPE, --  常规病理、组织细胞学、免疫组化等
  BP.SPECIMEN_SITE,
  BP.SPECIMEN_OBTAIN_METHOD,
  BP.SPECIMEN_TYPE, --  形态学、组织学、细胞学、术中冰冻等
  BP.SPECIMEN_CODE, --  标本的唯一编号
  BP.COLLECTED_DATETIME,  --  符合【yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss】的格式
  BP.RECEIVED_DATETIME, --  符合【yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss】的格式
  BP.REPORT_NO,
  BP.REPORT_DATETIME, --  符合【yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss】的格式
  BP.STAGING_VERSION, --  分期结果标准对应的版本号
  BP.CLINICAL_STAGE,  --  肿瘤对应的总分期
  BP.PATHO_T_STAGING, --  肿瘤对应的病理T分期
  BP.PATHO_N_STAGING, --  肿瘤对应的病理N分期
  BP.PATHO_M_STAGING, --  肿瘤对应的病理M分期
  BP.GROSS_DESCRIPTION,
  BP.MICRO_DESCRIPTION, --  病理诊断描述，大体描述
  BP.PATHO_DIAG_CONCLUSION,
  BP.IHC_RESULTS,
  BP.MOL_TEST_MARK, --  是否进行分子检测
  BP.MOL_TEST_GENE_AND_METHOD,
  BP.MOL_TEST_RESULT,
  BP.DIFFERENTIATION_DEGREE,  --  高分化，中分化，低分化，无法评估
  BP.BLOOD_VESSEL_INFIL,  --  有，无，不确定
  BP.LYMPH_INFILT,  --  百分比（或有无）
  BP.LYMPH_MET, --  有，无，不确定
  BP.VASC_TUMOUR_THROMBUS,  --  有，无，不确定
  BP.NERVE_INVASION,  --  有，无，不确定
  BP.EXTEND_DATA1,  --  用于填写补充信息
  BP.EXTEND_DATA2,  --  用于填写补充信息
  BP.RECORD_STATUS, --  1正常 0作废
  BP.INTRAOPERATIVE_FREEZING_RESULT,
  BP.RECORDER1,
  BP.RECORDER2

 FROM bl.pathological_exam_record BP
      LEFT JOIN HIS.LAB_TEST_MASTER HL ON BP.APPLY_NO = HL.TEST_NO
 WHERE BP.PATIENT_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT PI.PAID FROM  KZL.PATIENT_ID PI )

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "KZL"."RAD_INFO" ("PATIENT_ID", "VISIT_SN", "VISIT_TYPE", "VISIT_CARD_NO", "OUTPATIENT_NO", "VISIT_TIMES", "MEDICAL_RECORD_NO", "INPATIENT_NO", "HOSPITALIZATION_TIMES", "NAME", "GENDER", "AGE", "DATE_OF_BIRTH", "RADIO_SN", "COURSE_SN", "RADIO_START_TIME", "RADIO_END_TIME", "RADIO_TECH", "RADIO_SITE", "TARGET_VOLUME", "PRES_DAYS", "PRES_TOTAL_DOSE", "PRES_RADIO_COUNT", "RADIO_SINGLE_DOSE", "SYN_CHEMO_MARK", "SYN_CHEMO_SCHEME", "SYN_OTHER_SCHEME_MARK", "SYN_OTHER_SCHEME", "EFFECT_EVAL_TIME", "EFFECT_EVAL", "ADVERSE_DRUG_REACTION", "EXTEND_DATA1", "EXTEND_DATA2", "RECORD_STATUS", "THERAPEUTIC_PURPOSES") AS 
  select b.patient_id as patient_id,

       case when b.inp_no is not null then b.patient_id||'|'||c.visit_id||'|'||'住院'
         else '' end as visit_sn,
       case when b.inp_no is null then '门诊'
         else '住院' end as visit_type,
       b.id_no as visit_card_no,
       b.patient_id as outpatient_no,
       case when b.inp_no is null then ''
         else '1' end as visit_times,
       '' as medical_record_no,
       b.inp_no as inpatient_no,
       case when b.inp_no is null then ''
         else '1' end as hospitalization_times,
       a.HZXM as name,
       a.xb as gender,
       a.nl as age,
       nvl(a.csrq,b.date_of_birth) as date_of_birth,
       a.fllsh as radio_sn,
       a.lch as course_sn,
       a.flksrq as radio_start_time,
       a.fljsrq as radio_end_time,
       a.fljs as radio_tech,
       a.flbw as radio_site,
       a.bqbw as target_volume,
       a.cfts as pres_days,
       a.cfzjl as pres_total_dose,
       a.cfflcs as pres_radio_count,
       a.cffcjl as radio_single_dose,
       a.sftbhl as syn_chemo_mark,
       a.tbhlfa as syn_chemo_scheme,
       a.sftbqtywzl as syn_other_scheme_mark,
       a.qttbzlfa as syn_other_scheme,
       a.lxpjrq as effect_eval_time,
       a.lxpj as effect_eval,
       a.blfy as adverse_drug_reaction,
       a.kzzd1 as extend_data1,
       a.kzzd2 as extend_data2,
       a.jlzt as record_status,
       a.zlmd as therapeutic_purposes

from HIS.FLJL a
left join his.pat_master_index b on a.hzid=b.patient_id or
( to_char(a.csrq,'yyyy-MM-dd')=to_char(b.date_of_birth,'yyyy-MM-dd')
and a.hzxm=b.name
and a.xb=b.sex)
left join his.pat_visit c on b.patient_id=c.patient_id
and to_char(a.flksrq,'yyyy-mm-dd')>to_char(c.admission_date_time,'yyyy-mm-dd') and to_char(a.fljsrq,'yyyy-mm-dd')<=to_char(c.discharge_date_time,'yyyy-mm-dd')

                     WHEN '门诊' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HIS.CLINIC_MASTER C WHERE C.PATIENT_ID = M.PATIENT_ID AND M.PATIENT_ID IS NOT NULL)

    test_method,
    test_content,
    test_result,
    report_no,
    report_datetime,

    test_gene,
    transcript,

    amino_acid_alt,
    mut_abundance,
    variation_type,
    mut_interpretation,
    geno_type,

a.dept_admission_to as ryksbm	,--入院科室编码
(select ks.dept_name from his.dept_dict ks
where ks.dept_code=a.dept_admission_to) as ryks	,--入院科室
a.DISCHARGE_WARD_CODE as rybqbm	,--入院病区编码
(select ks.dept_name from his.dept_dict ks
where ks.dept_code=a.DISCHARGE_WARD_CODE) as rybq	,--入院病区
a.ATTENDING_DOCTOR as zzysid	,--主治医师id
(select yg.name from his.staff_dict yg
where yg.emp_no=a.attending_doctor) as zzys	,--主治医师
a.dept_discharge_from as cyksbm	,--出院科室编码
(select ks.dept_name from his.dept_dict ks
where ks.dept_code=a.dept_discharge_from) as Cyksmc	,--出院科室名称
a.DISCHARGE_WARD_CODE as cybqbm	,--出院病区编码
(select ks.dept_name from his.dept_dict ks
where ks.dept_code=a.DISCHARGE_WARD_CODE) as Cybqmc	,--出院病区名称
trunc(a.discharge_date_time-a.admission_date_time) as zyts	,--住院天数
(select zd.diagnosis_code from his.diagnosis zd
where zd.patient_id=a.patient_id
and zd.visit_id=a.visit_id
and zd.diagnosis_type='3'
and rownum='1') as cyzdicd	,--出院诊断ICD码
(select zd.diagnosis_desc from his.diagnosis zd
where zd.patient_id=a.patient_id
and zd.visit_id=a.visit_id
and zd.diagnosis_type='3'
and rownum='1') as cyzd	,--出院诊断
(select ss.operation_code from his.operation ss
where ss.patient_id=a.patient_id
and ss.visit_id=a.visit_id
and rownum='1') as ssbm1	,--主手术编码
(select ss.operation_desc from his.operation ss
where ss.patient_id=a.patient_id
and ss.visit_id=a.visit_id
and rownum='1') as ssmc1	,--主手术名称
(select ss.OPERATION_SCALE from his.operation ss
where ss.patient_id=a.patient_id
and ss.visit_id=a.visit_id
and rownum='1') as ssjb1	,--手术级别
a.DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION as lyfs	,--离院方式
a.TOTAL_COSTS as zfy	,--总费用
case when fy.mr_bill_class in('13','1301','14','15')
then fy.costs else null end as yf	,--药费
case when fy.mr_bill_class in('21','22','23')
then fy.costs else null end as clf	,--材料费
fy1.brfdje as zifeije	,--自费金额
fy1.grzhzf as zifuje	--自付金额

from his.pat_visit a, his.pat_master_index b, his.INP_SETTLE_MASTER_YB fy1,his.mr_bill_costs fy
 where a.patient_id = b.patient_id
 and a.patient_id=fy1.patient_id
 and a.visit_id=fy1.visit_id
 and a.patient_id=fy.patient_id
and a.visit_id=fy.visit_id
 and a.discharge_date_time is not null
 ) a
 group by bah,
lsh,
zycs,
xm,
nl,
ryzd1,
ryzdbm1,
ryrq,
cyrq,
ryksbm,
ryks,
rybqbm,
rybq,
zzysid,
zzys,
cyksbm,
Cyksmc,
cybqbm,
Cybqmc,
zyts,
cyzdicd,
cyzd,
ssbm1,
ssmc1,
ssjb1,
lyfs

PL_JCSQ.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "JXXT"."PL_JCSQ" ("JCSQID", "LSH", "MZBZ", "JCBW", "JCSJ", "LCZDBM", "LCZDMC", "XMBM", "XMMC", "SBMC", "SQSJ", "KDKSMB", "KDKSMC", "KDYGBM", "KDYGMC", "JCSJ_TIME", "ZXKSBM", "ZXKSMC", "CZYGBM", "CZYGMC", "BGSJ", "BGYGBM", "BGYGMC", "SHSJ", "SHYGBM", "SHYGMC", "SFYX", "JL", "SFYY", "ZT") AS 
  select
        a.exam_no as jcsqid,--  检查申请id
        '' lsh,-- 病人就诊流水号(门诊号/住院)
        decode(a.visit_id,'0','0','1') as mzbz,--  门诊、住院标识
        a.exam_sub_class as jcbw,--  检查部位
        to_char(pr.reportdiagnose) as jcsj,--  检查所见
        a.clin_diag as lczdbm,--  临床诊断编码
        a.clin_diag as lczdmc,--  临床诊断名称
        cc.clinic_item_class||'_'||cc.clinic_item_code||'_'||cc.charge_item_no as xmbm,--  项目编码
        /*a.exam_class*/b.exam_item as xmmc,--  项目名称
        '' as sbmc,--  设备名称
        a.req_date_time as sqsj,--  申请时间
        a.req_dept as kdksmb,--  开单科室编码
        (select ks.dept_name from his.dept_dict ks where ks.dept_code=a.req_dept) as kdksmc,--  开单科室名称
        a.req_physician as kdygbm,--  开单员工编码
        a.req_physician as kdygmc,--  开单员工名称
        a.exam_date_time as jcsj_time,-- 检查时间
        a.performed_by as zxksbm,--  执行科室编码
        (select ks.dept_name from his.dept_dict ks where ks.dept_code=a.performed_by) as zxksmc，--  执行科室名称
        a.technician as czygbm,--  操作员工编码
        (select d.name from HIS.STAFF_DICT d where a.technician=d.emp_no) as czygmc,--  操作员工名称
        a.report_date_time as bgsj,--  报告时间
        a.reporter as bgygbm,--  报告员工编码
        (select d.name from HIS.STAFF_DICT d where a.reporter=d.emp_no) as bgygmc,--  报告员工名称
        a.exam_date_time as shsj,--  审核时间
        a.technician as shygbm,--  审核员工编码
        (select d.name from HIS.STAFF_DICT d where a.technician=d.emp_no) as shygmc,--  审核员工名称
        decode(pr.ispositive,'阳性','1','阴性','0',pr.ispositive) as sfyx,--  是否阳性
        pr.ispositive as jl,--  结论
        '1' as sfyy,--  是否预约
        '1' as zt --  状态
from his.exam_master a
left join pacs.examinfo pe on a.exam_no = pe.examitemhisid
left join pacs.report pr on pr.reportid = pe.examid
left join his.exam_items b on a.exam_no=b.exam_no
left join his.clinic_vs_charge cc on cc.clinic_item_code = b.exam_item_code
where a.req_date_time >= to_date('2024-07-01 00:00:00','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
and a.Charge_Indicator='1'

PL_JYJG.ddl:

       '' as syff2,-- 使用方法2

       '' as xynd2,-- 血药浓度2

       '' as kssdljg,-- 抗生素定量结果

PL_JYSQ.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "JXXT"."PL_JYSQ" ("BARCODE", "SJDW", "JYSQID", "LSH", "MZBZ", "KDKSMB", "KDKSMC", "KDYGBM", "KDYGMC", "ZXKSBM", "ZXKSMC", "ZXYGBM", "ZXYGMC", "SHYGBM", "SHYGMC", "JYLBBM", "JYLBMC", "YBZL", "YBH", "BLZDBM", "BLZD", "XMBM", "XMMC", "SQSJ", "CYSJ", "YBSDSJ", "ZXSJ", "BGSJ") AS 
  select distinct
       a.barcode as barcode,--条码
       case when cd.out_spection is null then '本院'
         else '外院' end as sjdw,--	送检单位
       a.reportid as jysqid,--	检验申请id
       '' as lsh,--	病人就诊流水号(门诊号/住院)
       decode(a.PAT_TYPECODE,'1','0','2','0','1') as mzbz,--	门诊、住院标识
       /*a.REQ_DEPTNO*/c.Ordering_Dept as kdksmb,--	开单科室编码
       (select ks.dept_name from his.dept_dict ks where ks.dept_code=c.Ordering_Dept) as kdksmc,--	开单科室名称
       /*a.REQ_DOCNO*/c.Ordering_Provider as kdygbm,--	开单员工编码
       (select yg.name from his.staff_dict yg where yg.emp_no=c.Ordering_Provider) as kdygmc,--	开单员工名称
       '0502' as zxksbm,--	执行科室编码
       '检验科' as zxksmc,--	执行科室名称
       b.Report_User as zxygbm,--	执行员工编码
       b.Report_UserName as zxygmc,--	执行员工名称
       a.Rechk_User as shygbm,--	审核员工编码
       (select yg.name from his.staff_dict yg where yg.emp_no=a.Rechk_User) shygmc,--	审核员工名称
       '' as jylbbm,--检验类别编码
       a.req_reason as jylbmc,--	检验类别名称
       nvl(a.specimen_code,'-') as ybzl,--样本种类
       '' as ybh,--	样本号
       '' as blzdbm,--病理诊断编码
       '' as blzd,--	病理诊断
      CC.CLINIC_ITEM_CLASS||'_'||CC.CLINIC_ITEM_CODE||'_'||CC.CHARGE_ITEM_NO AS XMBM,--项目编码
       /*A.REQ_REASON*/D.ITEM_NAME AS XMMC,--项目名称
/*       case when c.source = 1 then cc.clinic_item_class||'_'||ld.clinic_item_code||'_'||ld.charge_item_no
         else cc.clinic_item_class||'_'||cc.clinic_item_code||'_'||cc.charge_item_no
           end AS xmbm,--项目编码
       case when c.source = 1 then ld.charge_item_name
         else d.item_name end xmmc,--项目名称 */
       /*a.REQ_DT*/ c.requested_date_time as sqsj,--申请时间
       a.SAMPLED_DT as cysj,--采样时间
       a.Recieve_dt as ybsdsj,--样本收到时间
       a.Test_DT as zxsj,--	执行时间
       a.Report_DT as bgsj --	报告时间
from lis.lab_report a
left join lis.req_master b on a.barcode = b.barcode
left join lis.req_detail e on a.barcode = e.barcode
left join his.lab_test_master c on e.His_Refcol2 = c.test_no
left join his.lab_test_items d on c.test_no = d.test_no
left join HIS.Clinic_Vs_Charge cc on cc.clinic_item_code = d.item_code
left join his.clinic_item_dict cd on cd.item_code = d.item_code
where a.Pat_Typecode <>'4'
and a.barcode is not null
/*left join his.lab_test_items_detail ld on c.test_no = ld.test_no and ld.item_no = d.item_no*/
--where a.REQ_DT>= to_date('2024-07-01 00:00:00','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') and a.REQ_DT < to_date('2024-08-01 00:00:00','yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')

PL_MZJLB.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "JXXT"."PL_MZJLB" ("LSH", "BRID", "BRXM", "ZJHM", "JZYSID", "JZYSXM", "JZKSBM", "JZKSMC", "YSYLZBM", "YSYKZMC", "YSKSBM", "YSKSMC", "JZRQ", "GHLBBM", "GHLBMC", "ZB", "PRICE", "AMOUNT", "FEE") AS 
  select a.clinic_no as lsh,-- 就诊流水号
       a.patient_id as brid,--  病人ID
       a.name as brxm,--  病人姓名
       b.id_no as zjhm,--  证件号码
       a.doctor as jzysid,--  主诊医师id
       (select yg.name from his.staff_dict yg where yg.emp_no=a.doctor) as jzysxm,--  主诊医师姓名
       a.visit_dept as jzksbm,--  his科室编码
       (select ks.dept_name from his.dept_dict ks where ks.dept_code=a.visit_dept) as jzksmc,--  his科室名称
       '' as ysylzbm,-- 医生所属医疗组编码
       '' as ysykzmc,-- 医生所属医疗组名称
       (select yg.dept_code from his.staff_dict yg where yg.emp_no=a.doctor) as ysksbm,--  医生所属科室编码
       (select ks.dept_name from his.dept_dict ks where ks.dept_code=(select yg.dept_code from his.staff_dict yg where yg.emp_no=a.doctor)) as ysksmc,--  医生所属科室名称
       a.registering_date as jzrq,--  就诊时间(至少精确到年月日时)
       '' as ghlbbm,--  挂号类别编码
       a.clinic_type as ghlbmc,--  挂号类别名称
       case when a.charge_type like '%急诊%' then '1'
         else '0' end as zb,--  诊别
       '' as price,--单价
       case when RETURNED_DATE is not null then '-1'
         else '1' end as amount,--数量
       a.clinic_charge as fee --金额
from his.clinic_master a
left join his.pat_master_index b on a.patient_id=b.patient_id
where  a.RETURNED_DATE is null

a.PATIENT_CLASS as rytj	,--入院途径

a.ATTENDING_DOCTOR as zzysid	,--主诊医师id
(select yg.name from his.staff_dict yg

(select ks.dept_name from his.dept_dict ks

'' as ysssylzbm	,--医生所属医疗组编码
'' as ysssylzmc	,--医生所属医疗组名称
(select yg.dept_code from his.staff_dict yg
where yg.emp_no=a.attending_doctor) as ysksbm	,--医生所属科室编码

'' as sbjzlsh	,--社保就诊流水号
'' as yllb	,--医疗类别
'' as tcqbm	,--（医保）统筹区编码
'' as tcqmc	,--（医保）统筹区名称

PL_SFXMMX.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "JXXT"."PL_SFXMMX" ("STAT_TIME", "KDKSBM", "KDKSMC", "KDYGBM", "KDYGMC", "ZXKSBM", "ZXKSMC", "ZXYGBM", "ZXYGMC", "KDYLZBM", "KDYLZMC", "ZXYLZBM", "ZXYLZMC", "ZXHSZBM", "ZXHSZMC", "ZXBQZBM", "ZXBQZMC", "XMBM", "XMMC", "FYLBBM", "FYLBMC", "PRICE", "AMOUNT", "FEE", "GG", "DW", "BRSZKSBM", "BRSZKSMC", "BRSZYLZBM", "BRSZYLZMC", "BRID", "LSH", "MZBZ", "BED_NO", "RCPT_NO", "NAME", "NJZXYGBM", "NJZXYGMC", "NJZXKSBM", "NJZXKSMC") AS 
  SELECT a.billing_date_time stat_time, ----时间  Datetime  时间，如 2013/3/5 13:30:22  标准绩效
       a.ordered_by kdksbm, ----  开单科室编码  nvarchar  his开单科室编码  标准绩效
       (SELECT dept_name FROM his.dept_dict WHERE dept_code = a.ordered_by) kdksmc, ----  开单科室名称  nvarchar  his开单科室名称  标准绩效
       a.doctor_user kdygbm, ----  开单员工编码  nvarchar  his开单员工的编码  标准绩效
       (select name from his.staff_dict sd where a.doctor_user = sd.emp_no) kdygmc, ----  开单员工名称  nvarchar  his开单员工的姓名  标准绩效
       a.performed_by zxksbm, ----  执行科室编码  nvarchar  his执行科室编码  标准绩效
       (SELECT dept_name FROM his.dept_dict WHERE dept_code = a.performed_by) zxksmc, ----  执行科室名称  nvarchar  his执行科室名称  标准绩效
       (SELECT t.emp_no
          FROM his.staff_dict t
         WHERE t.name = a.perform_doctor
           AND ROWNUM = 1)  zxygbm, ----  执行员工编码  nvarchar  his执行员工的编码  标准绩效
       a.perform_doctor zxygmc, ----  执行员工名称  nvarchar  his执行员工的名称  标准绩效
       (SELECT DDD.ORDER_GROUP
                 FROM his.DOCTOR_GROUP DDD
                WHERE DDD.DOCTOR_USER = a.doctor_user) kdylzbm, ----  开单医疗组编码  nvarchar  his开单医疗组编码  标准绩效
       (SELECT dd.dept_name
                 FROM his.DOCTOR_GROUP DDD,his.dept_dict dd
                WHERE DDD.DOCTOR_USER = a.doctor_user
                and DDD.ORDER_GROUP=dd.dept_code) kdylzmc, ----  开单医疗组名称  nvarchar  his开单医疗组名称  标准绩效
       CASE
         WHEN LENGTH(NVL(A.perform_group, '0')) > 1 THEN
          TO_CHAR(a.perform_group)
         WHEN LENGTH(NVL(A.perform_group, '0')) <= 1 THEN
          CASE
            WHEN LENGTH(NVL(A.PERFORMED_BY, '0')) > 1 THEN
             TO_CHAR(A.PERFORMED_BY)
            WHEN LENGTH(NVL(A.PERFORMED_BY, '0')) <= 1 THEN
             TO_CHAR(A.ORDER_GROUP)
          END
       END zxylzbm,
       ----  执行医疗组编码  nvarchar  his执行医疗组编码  标准绩效
       CASE
         WHEN LENGTH(NVL(A.perform_group, '0')) > 1 THEN
          (SELECT s.group_name
             FROM his.staff_group_dict s
            WHERE s.group_code = a.perform_group and rownum=1)
         WHEN LENGTH(NVL(A.perform_group, '0')) <= 1 THEN
          CASE
            WHEN LENGTH(NVL(A.PERFORMED_BY, '0')) > 1 THEN
             (SELECT s.group_name
                FROM his.staff_group_dict s
               WHERE s.group_code = a.PERFORMED_BY and rownum=1)
            WHEN LENGTH(NVL(A.PERFORMED_BY, '0')) <= 1 THEN
             (SELECT s.group_name
                FROM his.staff_group_dict s
               WHERE s.group_code = a.ORDER_GROUP and rownum=1)
          END
       END zxylzmc,
       ----  执行医疗组名称  nvarchar  his执行医疗组名称  标准绩效
       case
         when a.performed_by like '%H%' then
          a.performed_by
         else
          a.wardcode
       end zxhszbm, ----  执行护士站编码  nvarchar  his执行护士站编码  标准绩效
       case
         when a.performed_by like '%H%' then
          (SELECT dept_name FROM his.dept_dict WHERE dept_code = a.performed_by)
         else
          (SELECT dept_name FROM his.dept_dict WHERE dept_code = a.wardcode)

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "JXXT"."PL_TJSFXMMX" ("LSH", "CHARGE_ORDER_DATE", "ORDER_DEPT_CODE", "ORDER_DEPT_NAME", "ORDER_EMP_CODE", "ORDER_EMP_NAME", "CHARGE_EXEC_DATE", "EXEC_DEPT_CODE", "EXEC_DEPT_NAME", "EXEC_EMP_CODE", "EXEC_EMP_NAME", "CHARGE_TYPE_CODE", "CHARGE_TYPE_NAME", "CHARGE_ITEM_CODE", "CHARGE_ITEM_NAME", "JCSQH", "NUM", "PRICE", "UNIT", "AMOUNT") AS 
  select distinct
     a.id  lsh, --患者流水号
     nvl(b.JDRQ,a.DJDATE) charge_order_date, --费用开单时间
     dd1.DEPT_CODE order_dept_code, --开单科室编码
     dd1.DEPT_NAME order_dept_name, --开单科室名称
     nvl((select sd.EMP_NO from his.staff_dict sd where sd.name=a.DJYS and rownum =1),'-') order_emp_code,  --开单员工编码
     a.DJYS order_emp_name,  --开单员工姓名
     a.JCRQ charge_exec_date,  --费用执行时间
     c.KSBM exec_dept_code,  --执行科室编码
     d.KSLABEL exec_dept_name,  --执行科室名称
     sd.emp_no exec_emp_code, --执行员工编码
     a.JCYS exec_emp_name, --执行员工姓名
     a.SFLBDM charge_type_code,  --收费类别编码
     '' charge_type_name,  --收费类别名称
     a.SFXMDM charge_item_code,  --收费项目编码
     c.SFXMMC charge_item_name,  --收费项目名称
     a.id jcsqh, --检查申请号
     --b.DJCOUNT num, --数量
     '1' as num, --数量
     a.JE price, --收费项目单价
     ''unit,  --收费项目单位
     a.je amount  --收入总额
     --nvl(b.NOWJE,a1.zje) amount  --收入总额

from tj.JCSFXM A
left join TJ.JCXX b
on a.id =b.id
left join tj.sfxm c
on a.SFXMDM=c.SFXMDM
left join tj.ksbm d
on c.KSBM=d.KSBM
left join (select a.*,row_number() over(partition by name order by CREATE_DATE desc)r from his.staff_dict a) sd
on sd.name =a.JCYS and sd.r=1
left join (select a.*,row_number() over(partition by name order by CREATE_DATE desc)r from his.staff_dict a) sd1
on sd1.name =a.SFYS and sd1.r=1
left join his.dept_dict dd1
on sd1.DEPT_CODE =dd1.DEPT_CODE

EMR_ADMISSION_INFO.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "CRBSB"."EMR_ADMISSION_INFO" ("ID", "PATIENT_ID", "SERIAL_NUMBER", "WARD_NAME", "WARD_NO", "BED_NO", "PATIENT_NAME", "ID_CARD_TYPE_CODE", "ID_CARD_TYPE_NAME", "ID_CARD", "ADMISSION_DATE", "CHIEF_COMPLAINT", "PRESENT_ILLNESS_HIS", "HEALTH_STATUS_CODE", "PAST_ILLNESS_HIS", "INFECTION_CODE", "INFECTION_HIS", "VACCINATION_HIS", "OPERATION_HIS", "BLOOD_TRANSFUSION", "ALLERGY_HIS", "PERSONAL_HIS", "MARITAL_HIS", "MENSTRUAL_HIS", "AMILY_HIS", "PHYSICAL_EXAMINATION", "SPECIALIZED_EXAMINATION", "STUDIES_SUMMARY_RESULT", "OBSERVATION_RESULT", "TREATMENT", "WM_INITAL_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "WM_INITAL_DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "TCM_INITAL_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "TCM_INITAL_DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "TCM_INITAL_SYNDROME_CODE", "TCM_INITAL_SYNDROME_NAME", "INITAL_DIAGNOSIS_DATE", "WM_REVISED_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "WM_REVISED_DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "TCM_REVISED_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "TCM_REVISED_DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "TCM_REVISED_SYNDROME_CODE", "TCM_REVISED_SYNDROME_NAME", "REVISED_DIAGNOSIS_DATE", "WM_CONFIRMED_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "WM_CONFIRMED_DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "TCM_CONFIRMED_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "TCM_CONFIRMED_DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "TCM_CONFIRMED_SYNDROME_CODE", "TCM_CONFIRMED_SYNDROME_NAME", "CONFIRMED_DIAGNOSIS_DATE", "COMPLEMENTARY_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "COMPLEMENTARY_DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "COMPLEMENTARY_DIAGNOSIS_DATE", "ADMISSION_DIAGNOSIS_ORDER", "VISITING_PHYSICIAN_ID", "RESIDENT_PHYSICIAN_ID", "CHIEF_PHYSICIAN_ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DEPT_CODE", "DEPT_NAME", "OPERATOR_ID", "OPERATION_TIME") AS 
  select pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO||'_'||to_char(pi.INHOS_NUM) as id,
       pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO as patient_id,--患者基本信息ID
       pi.VISIT_ID||pi.INHOS_NUM as serial_number,--住院号
       pi.WARD_NAME as ward_name,--病区名称
       pi.WARD_CODE as ward_no,--病房号
       pi.BED_NAME as bed_no,--病床号
       pi.PAT_NAME as patient_name,--患者姓名
       '01' as id_card_type_code,--身份证件类别代码
       '居民身份证' as id_card_type_name,--身份证件类别名称
       pi.PAT_ID_NUMBER as id_card,--身份证件号码
       to_date(pi.ADMIT_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') as admission_date, --入院日期时间
       b.chief_complaint as chief_complaint,  --主诉
       b.present_illness_his as present_illness_his,  --现病史
       null as health_status_code,--一般健康状况标志
       null as past_illness_his,--疾病史(含外伤）
       null as infection_code,--患者传染性标志
       null as infection_his,  --传染病史
       null as vaccination_his,--预防接种史
       null as operation_his,  --手术史
       null as blood_transfusion,--输血史
       null as allergy_his,--过敏史
       b.personal_his as personal_his,--个人史
       b.marital_his as marital_his,--婚育史
       null as menstrual_his,--月经史
       null as amily_his,--家族史
       b.physical_examination as physical_examination,--体格检查
       null as specialized_examination,--专科情况
       b.studies_summary_result as studies_summary_result,--辅助检查
       null as observation_result,   --中医“四诊”观察结果
       null as treatment,--治则治法
       nvl(dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE,'Z00.000') as wm_inital_diagnosis_code,--初步诊断-西医诊断编码
       nvl(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'一般性医学检查') as wm_inital_diagnosis_name,--初步诊断-西医诊断名称
       null as tcm_inital_diagnosis_code,--初步诊断-中医病名代码
       null as tcm_inital_diagnosis_name,--初步诊断-中医病名名称
       null as tcm_inital_syndrome_code,--初步诊断-中医证候代码
       null as tcm_inital_syndrome_name,--初步诊断-中医证候名称
       dd.DIAGNOSIS_DATE as inital_diagnosis_date,--初步诊断日期
       null as wm_revised_diagnosis_code,--修正诊断-西医诊断代码
       null as wm_revised_diagnosis_name,--修正诊断-西医诊断名称
       null AS tcm_revised_diagnosis_code,--修正诊断-中医病名代码
       null as tcm_revised_diagnosis_name,--修正诊断-中医病名名称
       null as tcm_revised_syndrome_code,--修正诊断-中医证候代码
       null as tcm_revised_syndrome_name,--修正诊断-中医证候名称
       null as revised_diagnosis_date,-- 修正诊断日期
       nvl(dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE,'Z00.000') as wm_confirmed_diagnosis_code,--确定诊断-西医诊断代码
       nvl(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'一般性医学检查') as wm_confirmed_diagnosis_name,--确定诊断-西医诊断名称
       null as tcm_confirmed_diagnosis_code,--确定诊断-中医病名代码
       null as tcm_confirmed_diagnosis_name,--确定诊断-中医病名名称
       null as tcm_confirmed_syndrome_code,--确定诊断-中医证候代码
       null as tcm_confirmed_syndrome_name,--确定诊断-中医证候名称
       dd.DIAGNOSIS_DATE as confirmed_diagnosis_date,--确定诊断日期
       null as complementary_diagnosis_code,--补充诊断编码
       null as complementary_diagnosis_name,--补充诊断名称
       null as complementary_diagnosis_date,--补充诊断日期
       null as admission_diagnosis_order,--入院诊断顺位
       pi.INHOSP_DR_SIGN_CODE as visiting_physician_id,--接诊医师
       pi.INHOSP_DR_SIGN_CODE as resident_physician_id,--住院医师
       pi.ATTEND_DR_SIGN_CODE as chief_physician_id,--主治医师
       '370104000' as org_code, --医疗机构代码
       '山东省第二人民医院' as org_name, --医疗机构名称
       pi.DEPT_CODE DEPT_CODE ,-- 科室代码
       pi.DEPT_NAME  DEPT_NAME ,-- 科室名称
       a.CREATOR_ID as operator_id,--操作人 ID
       a.LAST_MODIFY_DATE_TIME as operation_time --操作时间
from cda.patient_info pi
join jhemr.jhmr_file_index a
on TOPIC like '%入院记录%' and pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO=a.patient_id and pi.INHOS_NUM=a.visit_id
left join
(
SELECT
    FILE_UNIQUE_ID,
    MAX(CASE WHEN DG_CODE = 'S.01' THEN DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(DG_PLAIN_CONTENT_BLOB,2000) END) AS chief_complaint,--主诉
    MAX(CASE WHEN DG_CODE = 'S.03' THEN DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(DG_PLAIN_CONTENT_BLOB,2000) END) AS present_illness_his,   --现病史
    MAX(CASE WHEN DG_CODE = 'S.04.009' THEN DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(DG_PLAIN_CONTENT_BLOB,2000) END) AS personal_his,   --个人史
    MAX(CASE WHEN DG_CODE = 'S.04.010' THEN DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(DG_PLAIN_CONTENT_BLOB,2000) END) AS marital_his,   --婚育史
    MAX(CASE WHEN DG_CODE = 'S.04.013' THEN DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(DG_PLAIN_CONTENT_BLOB,2000) END) AS amily_his,   --家族史
    MAX(CASE WHEN DG_CODE = 'S.02' THEN DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(DG_PLAIN_CONTENT_BLOB,2000) END) AS physical_examination,   --体格检查
    MAX(CASE WHEN DG_CODE = 'S.05' THEN DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(DG_PLAIN_CONTENT_BLOB,2000) END) AS studies_summary_result --辅助检查
FROM jhemr.jhmr_file_content_dg
GROUP BY FILE_UNIQUE_ID
) b on a.FILE_UNIQUE_ID=b.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
left join
(
select a.*,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PATIENT_ID,VISIT_ID ORDER BY DIAGNOSIS_DATE) rw
from his.diagnosis a where DIAGNOSIS_TYPE ='2'
) dd  on pi.INHOSP_INDEX_NO=dd.patient_id and pi.INHOS_NUM=dd.visit_id and dd.rw=1

EMR_ADMISSION_RECORD.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "CRBSB"."EMR_ADMISSION_RECORD" ("ID", "PATIENT_ID", "SERIAL_NUMBER", "PATIENT_NAME", "ID_CARD_TYPE_CODE", "ID_CARD_TYPE_NAME", "ID_CARD", "HEALTH_CARD_NO", "PAY_METHOD_CODE", "PAY_METHOD_NAME", "ADMISSION_NUM", "REG_NO", "ADMISSION_DATE", "ADMISSION_DEPT_CODE", "ADMISSION_DEPT_NAME", "WARD_NO", "DISCHARGE_DATE", "DISCHARGE_DEPT_CODE", "DISCHARGE_DEPT_NAME", "DISCHARGE_WARD", "ADMISSION_DAYS", "WM_OUTPATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "WM_OUTPATIENT_DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "DISCHARGE_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "DISCHARGE_DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "WM_OTHER_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "WM_OTHER_DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "EXTERNAL_CAUSES_CODE", "EXTERNAL_CAUSES_NAME", "EXTERNAL_CAUSES_SYSTEM_NAME", "PATHOLOGICAL_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "PATHOLOGICAL_DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "PATHOLOGICAL_NO", "ALLERGY_CODE", "ALLERGY_DRUG", "AUTOPSY_CODE", "CHIEF_PHYSICIAN_ID", "RESIDENT_PHYSICIAN_ID", "ACCEPT_ORG_CODE", "ACCEPT_ORG_NAME", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DEPT_CODE", "DEPT_NAME", "OPERATOR_ID", "OPERATION_TIME") AS 
  select a.patient_id||'_'||a.visit_id AS id,
       A.PATIENT_ID AS patient_id, --患者基本信息ID
       B.INP_NO||a.visit_id AS serial_number, --住院号
       b.name as patient_name, --患者姓名
       '01' as id_card_type_code, --身份证件类别代码
       '居民身份证' as id_card_type_name, --身份证件类别名称
       nvl(b.id_no,'-') as id_card, --身份证件号码
       '' as health_card_no, --居民健康卡号
       (select cd.STAT_CODE
          from crbsb.STAT_VS_CHARGE_TYPE cd
         where cd.CHARGE_NAME = a.charge_type) as pay_method_code, -- 医疗付费方式代码
       (select cd.STAT_NAME
          from crbsb.STAT_VS_CHARGE_TYPE cd
         where cd.CHARGE_NAME = a.charge_type) as pay_method_name, -- 医疗付费方式名称
       a.visit_id as admission_num, --住院次数
       b.inp_no as reg_no, --病案号
       a.admission_date_time as admission_date, --入院日期时间
       a.dept_admission_to as admission_dept_code, --入院科别代码
       (select ks.dept_name
          from his.dept_dict ks
         where ks.dept_code = a.dept_admission_to) as admission_dept_name, --入院科别名称
       '' as ward_no, --入院病房编号
       a.discharge_date_time as discharge_date, --出院日期时间
       a.dept_discharge_from as discharge_dept_code, --出院科别代码
       (select ks.dept_name
          from his.dept_dict ks
         where ks.dept_code = a.dept_discharge_from) as discharge_dept_name, --出院科别名称
       '' as discharge_ward, --出院病房
       decode(trunc(a.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME - a.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME, 0),
              '0',
              '1') as admission_days, --实际住院天数
       nvl(nvl((select cd.国标编码
                 from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                  and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                  and cd.院标名称 = (select e.诊断名称
                                   from CDA.EMR_ZD e
                                  where e.患者ID = a.patient_id
                                    and a.visit_id = e.住院次数
                                    and e.诊断类别名称 = '门诊诊断'
                                    and rownum = '1')
                  and rownum = '1'),
               (select ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_CODE
                  from cda.入院西 zd
                 where zd.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = a.patient_id
                   and zd.INHOS_NUM = a.visit_id
                   and rownum = '1')),
           'Z00.000') as wm_outpatient_diagnosis_code, --门（急)诊诊断代码
       nvl(nvl((select cd.国标名称
                 from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                  and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                  and cd.院标名称 = (select e.诊断名称
                                   from CDA.EMR_ZD e
                                  where e.患者ID = a.patient_id
                                    and a.visit_id = e.住院次数
                                    and e.诊断类别名称 = '门诊诊断'
                                    and rownum = '1')
                  and rownum = '1'),
               (select ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_NAME
                  from cda.入院西 zd
                 where zd.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = a.patient_id
                   and zd.INHOS_NUM = a.visit_id
                   and rownum = '1')),
           '一般性医学检查') as wm_outpatient_diagnosis_name, --门（急)诊诊断名称
       nvl((select (select cd.国标编码
                     from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                    where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                      and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                      and cd.院标名称 = d.diagnosis_desc
                      and rownum = 1)
             from his.diagnosis d
            where d.diagnosis_type = '3'
              and d.diagnosis_no = '1'
              and d.patient_id = a.patient_id
              and d.visit_id = a.visit_id
              and rownum = '1'),
           '-') discharge_diagnosis_code, -- 出院诊断主要诊断代码
       nvl((select (select cd.国标名称
                     from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                    where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                      and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                      and cd.院标名称 = d.diagnosis_desc
                      and rownum = 1)
             from his.diagnosis d
            where d.diagnosis_type = '3'
              and d.diagnosis_no = '1'
              and d.patient_id = a.patient_id
              and d.visit_id = a.visit_id
              and rownum = '1'),
           '-') discharge_diagnosis_name, -- 出院诊断-主要西医诊断代码
       (select ddd.diag_code
          from (SELECT patient_id,
                       visit_id,
                       (select cd.国标编码
                          from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                         where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                           and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                           and cd.院标名称 = a.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
                           and rownum = '1') diag_code
                  FROM (SELECT patient_id,
                               visit_id,
                               diagnosis_code,
                               DIAGNOSIS_DESC,
                               ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY patient_id, visit_id ORDER BY DIAGNOSIS_DATE desc) AS row_num
                          FROM his.diagnosis
                         WHERE diagnosis_type = '3') a
                 WHERE row_num = 1) ddd
         where ddd.patient_id = a.patient_id
           and ddd.visit_id = a.visit_id) wm_other_diagnosis_code, -- 出院诊断-其他诊断代码
       (select ddd.diag_name
          from (SELECT patient_id,
                       visit_id,
                       (select cd.国标名称
                          from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                         where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                           and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                           and cd.院标名称 = a.DIAGNOSIS_DESC
                           and rownum = '1') diag_name
                  FROM (SELECT patient_id,
                               visit_id,
                               diagnosis_code,
                               DIAGNOSIS_DESC,
                               ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY patient_id, visit_id ORDER BY DIAGNOSIS_DATE desc) AS row_num
                          FROM his.diagnosis
                         WHERE diagnosis_type = '3') a
                 WHERE row_num = 1) ddd
         where ddd.patient_id = a.patient_id
           and ddd.visit_id = a.visit_id) wm_other_diagnosis_name, -- 出院诊断-其他诊断名称
       nvl(nvl((select cd.国标编码
                 from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                  and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                  and cd.院标名称 = (select e.diagnosis_desc
                                   from his.diagnosis e
                                  where e.patient_id = a.patient_id
                                    and a.visit_id = e.visit_id
                                    and e.diagnosis_no = '1'
                                    and e.diagnosis_type = '7')
                  and rownum = '1'),
               (select ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_CODE
                  from cda.入院西 zd
                 where zd.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = a.patient_id
                   and zd.INHOS_NUM = a.visit_id
                   and rownum = '1')),
           'Y98.x00') external_causes_code, -- 损伤中毒的外部原因疾病编码

       nvl(nvl((select cd.国标名称
                 from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                  and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                  and cd.院标名称 = (select e.diagnosis_desc
                                   from his.diagnosis e
                                  where e.patient_id = a.patient_id
                                    and a.visit_id = e.visit_id
                                    and e.diagnosis_no = '1'
                                    and e.diagnosis_type = '7')
                  and rownum = '1'),
               (select ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_NAME
                  from cda.入院西 zd
                 where zd.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = a.patient_id
                   and zd.INHOS_NUM = a.visit_id
                   and rownum = '1')),
           '与生活方式有关的情况') external_causes_name, -- 损伤中毒的外部原因疾病编码
       '-' as external_causes_system_name, --损伤中毒的外部原因
       nvl(nvl((select cd.国标编码
                 from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                  and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                  and cd.院标名称 = (select e.diagnosis_desc
                                   from his.diagnosis e
                                  where e.patient_id = a.patient_id
                                    and a.visit_id = e.visit_id
                                    and e.diagnosis_no = '1'
                                    and e.diagnosis_type = '8')
                  and rownum = '1'),
               (select ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_CODE
                  from cda.入院西 zd
                 where zd.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = a.patient_id
                   and zd.INHOS_NUM = a.visit_id
                   and rownum = '1')),
           'Z00.000') pathological_diagnosis_code, -- 病理诊断代码

       nvl(nvl((select cd.国标名称
                 from cda.cda_dictionary cd
                where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
                  and cd.系统标识 = 'HIS'
                  and cd.院标名称 = (select e.diagnosis_desc
                                   from his.diagnosis e
                                  where e.patient_id = a.patient_id
                                    and a.visit_id = e.visit_id
                                    and e.diagnosis_no = '1'
                                    and e.diagnosis_type = '8')
                  and rownum = '1'),
               (select ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_NAME
                  from cda.入院西 zd
                 where zd.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = a.patient_id
                   and zd.INHOS_NUM = a.visit_id
                   and rownum = '1')),
           '一般性医学检查') pathological_diagnosis_name, -- 病理诊断名称
       '' as pathological_no, --病理号
       case
         when a.ALERGY_DRUGS is not null then
          '1'
         else
          '0'
       end as allergy_code, --药物过敏标志
       a.ALERGY_DRUGS as allergy_drug, --过敏药物
       '0' as autopsy_code, --死亡患者尸检标志
       nvl(a.attending_doctor, '-') as chief_physician_id, --主治医师
       nvl(a.attending_doctor, '-') as resident_physician_id, --住院医师
       '' as accept_org_code, --拟接收医疗机构代码
       a.ENTRANCE_HOSPITAL as accept_org_name, --拟接收医疗机构名称
       '370104000' as org_code, --医疗机构代码
       '山东省第二人民医院' as org_name, --医疗机构名称
       a.dept_discharge_from as dept_code, --科室代码
       (select ks.dept_name
          from his.dept_dict ks
         where ks.dept_code = a.dept_discharge_from) as dept_name, --科室名称
       a.CATALOGER as operator_id, --操作人ID
       a.discharge_date_time as operation_time --操作时间
  from HIS.PAT_VISIT A
  JOIN HIS.PAT_MASTER_INDEX B
    ON A.PATIENT_ID = B.PATIENT_ID

EMR_DAILY_COURSE.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "CRBSB"."EMR_DAILY_COURSE" ("ID", "PATIENT_ID", "SERIAL_NUMBER", "PATIENT_NAME", "ID_CARD_TYPE_CODE", "ID_CARD_TYPE_NAME", "ID_CARD", "WARD_NAME", "WARD_NO", "BED_CODE", "CREATE_TIME", "COURSE", "ORDER_CONTENT", "OBSERVATION_RESULT", "TREATMENT", "DISEASE_PROGRESSION_CODE", "DISEASE_PROGRESSION_NAME", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DEPT_CODE", "DEPT_NAME", "OPERATOR_ID", "OPERATION_TIME") AS 
  select pv.patient_id||'_'||pv.visit_id as id,
       pv.patient_id as patient_id, --患者基本信息ID
       pmi.inp_no||pv.visit_id as serial_number,  --住院号
       pmi.name as patient_name,  --患者姓名
       '01' as id_card_type_code,--身份证件类别患者代码
       '居民身份证' as id_card_type_name,--身份证件类别名称
       nvl(pmi.id_no,pv.INSURANCE_NO) as id_card,--身份证件号码
       (select dd.dept_name from his.dept_dict dd where dd.dept_code=pv.discharge_ward_code) WARD_NAME,--病区名称
       '' as ward_no,--病房号
       to_char(pv.discharge_bed_no) BED_CODE, --病床号
       to_char(t1.DOC_CREATE_DATE,'yyyymmddhh24miss') as create_time, --记录日期时间
       Nvl(t3.zybc,DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t4.段落内容,2000)) as course, --住院病程
       Nvl(t3.yznr,'-') as order_content, --医嘱内容
       Nvl(t3.zyszgcjg,'-') as observation_result, --中医“四诊”观察结果
       Nvl(t3.Bzlzxxms,'-') as treatment,--辨证论治
       '9' as disease_progression_code, -- 病情转归代码
       '其他' as disease_progression_name, -- 病情转归名称
       '370104000' as org_code, --医疗机构代码
       '山东省第二人民医院' as org_name, --医疗机构名称
       pv.dept_admission_to as dept_code,  --科室代码
       (select dd.dept_name from his.dept_dict dd where dd.dept_code=pv.dept_admission_to) as dept_name, --科室名称\
       t1.CREATEUSERID as operator_id, --操作人ID
       to_char(t1.CREATEON,'yyyymmddhh24miss') as operation_time --操作时间
from mtl.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX t
inner JOIN mtl.EPR_INPATIENT t1
on t.UHID=t1.UHID /*and t1.DOC_STATS = '1'*/ and t1.DOC_TITLE ='日常病程记录'
inner join mtl.EMRSD38 T3 ON T3.段落编号=T1.ID
left join his.pat_master_index pmi on pmi.patient_id = t.p_clinic_id
inner join his.pat_visit pv on pv.patient_id = t.p_clinic_id and pv.visit_id = t.p_inpatient_times
Left Join MTL.EMRSD_CONTENT t4 On t4.UHID=t.UHID and t4.段落编号=t3.段落编号

EMR_DEATH_INFO.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "CRBSB"."EMR_DEATH_INFO" ("ID", "PATIENT_ID", "ACTIVITY_TYPE_CODE", "ACTIVITY_TYPE_NAME", "SERIAL_NUMBER", "PATIENT_NAME", "ID_CARD_TYPE_CODE", "ID_CARD_TYPE_NAME", "ID_CARD", "TREATMENT_DESC", "DEAD_DATE", "DIRECT_CAUSE_CODE", "DIRECT_CAUSE_NAME", "DEATH_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "DEATH_DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "CHIEF_PHYSICIAN_ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DEPT_CODE", "DEPT_NAME", "OPERATOR_ID", "OPERATION_TIME") AS 
  select  pv.patient_id||'_'||pv.visit_id as id,
        pv.patient_id as patient_id, --患者基本信息ID
        '6' as activity_type_code,  --就诊记录类型代码
        '住院' as activity_type_name,  --就诊记录类型名称
        pmi.inp_no||pv.visit_id as serial_number, --就诊流水号
        pmi.name as patient_name,  --患者姓名
        '01' as id_card_type_code,--身份证件类别患者代码
        '居民身份证' as id_card_type_name,--身份证件类别名称
        nvl(pmi.id_no,pv.INSURANCE_NO) as id_card,--身份证件号码
        nvl(nvl(t3.Zlgcms,t2.Zlgcms),DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t4.段落内容,2000)) as treatment_desc, --诊疗过程描述
        to_char(nvl(pv.death_date_time,pv.discharge_date_time),'yyyymmddhh24miss') as dead_date,--死亡日期时间
        nvl(a.ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_CODE,(select cd.国标编码 from cda.cda_dictionary cd
        where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码' and cd.系统标识='HIS'and cd.院标名称=d.diagnosis_desc and rownum = 1))as direct_cause_code,--直接死亡原因编码
        nvl(a.ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_NAME,(select cd.国标名称 from cda.cda_dictionary cd
        where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码' and cd.系统标识='HIS'and cd.院标名称=d.diagnosis_desc and rownum = 1))as direct_cause_name,--直接死亡原因名称
        nvl(a.ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_CODE,(select cd.国标编码 from cda.cda_dictionary cd
        where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码' and cd.系统标识='HIS'and cd.院标名称=d.diagnosis_desc and rownum = 1))as death_diagnosis_code, --死亡诊断代码
        nvl(a.ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_NAME,(select cd.国标名称 from cda.cda_dictionary cd
        where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码' and cd.系统标识='HIS'and cd.院标名称=d.diagnosis_desc and rownum = 1))as death_diagnosis_name, --死亡诊断名称
        pv.Attending_Doctor as chief_physician_id, --主治医师
        '370104000' as org_code, --医疗机构代码
        '山东省第二人民医院' as org_name, --医疗机构名称
        pv.dept_admission_to as dept_code,  --科室代码
        (select dd.dept_name from his.dept_dict dd where dd.dept_code=pv.dept_admission_to) as dept_name, --科室名称
        t1.CREATEUSERID as operator_id, --操作人ID
        to_char(t1.CREATEON,'yyyymmddhh24miss') as operation_time --操作时间
from mtl.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX t
inner JOIN mtl.EPR_INPATIENT t1
on t.UHID=t1.UHID /*and t1.DOC_STATS = '1' */and t1.doc_type_name in ('24小时内入院死亡记录','死亡记录')
left join mtl.EMRSD36 T2 ON T2.段落编号=T1.ID
left join mtl.EMRSD50 T3 ON T3.段落编号=T1.ID
left join mtl.emrsd_content t4 on t4.段落编号=t1.id
inner join his.pat_visit pv on pv.patient_id = t.p_clinic_id and pv.visit_id = t.p_inpatient_times
left join his.pat_master_index pmi on pmi.patient_id = pv.patient_id
left join
(
    SELECT INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM,ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_CODE,ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_NAME,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY PRNA_WEST_CIS_POSITION) as rn
    FROM cda.入院西
) a
on a.rn = 1 and a.INHOSP_INDEX_NO = pv.patient_id and a.INHOS_NUM = pv.visit_id
Left Join
(
    select patient_id,visit_id,diagnosis_desc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id,visit_id ORDER BY DIAGNOSIS_DATE desc,DIAGNOSIS_NO) as rn
    from his.diagnosis where DIAGNOSIS_DATE is not null
) d
On d.rn=1 and pv.patient_id=d.patient_id And pv.visit_id=d.visit_id

EMR_DISCHARGE_INFO.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "CRBSB"."EMR_DISCHARGE_INFO" ("ID", "PATIENT_ID", "SERIAL_NUMBER", "PATIENT_NAME", "ID_CARD_TYPE_CODE", "ID_CARD_TYPE_NAME", "ID_CARD", "WARD_NAME", "WARD_NO", "BED_NO", "ADMISSION_DATE", "ADMISSION_DESC", "ADMISSION_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "ADMISSION_DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "STUDIES_SUMMARY_RESULT", "OBSERVATION_RESULT", "REATMENT", "TREATMENT_DESC", "TCM_DECOCTION_METHOD", "TCM_USE_METHOD", "DISCHARGE_DESC", "DISCHARGE_DATE", "DISCHARGE_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "DISCHARGE_DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "TCM_DISCHARGE_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "TCM_DISCHARGE_DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "TCM_DISCHARGE_SYNDROME_CODE", "TCM_DISCHARGE_SYNDROME_NAME", "DISCHARGE_SYMPTOMS_SIGNS", "DISCHARGE_ORDER", "DISEASE_PROGRESSION_CODE", "DISEASE_PROGRESSION_NAME", "RESIDENT_PHYSICIAN_ID", "CHIEF_PHYSICIAN_ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DEPT_CODE", "DEPT_NAME", "OPERATOR_ID", "OPERATION_TIME") AS 
  select a.patient_id||'_'||a.visit_id as id,
       a.patient_id as patient_id,--患者基本信息ID
       (select b.inp_no from his.pat_master_index b where b.patient_id=a.patient_id)||a.visit_id as serial_number,--住院号
       (select b.name from his.pat_master_index b where b.patient_id=a.patient_id) as patient_name,--患者姓名
       '01' as id_card_type_code,--身份证件类别患者代码
       '居民身份证' as id_card_type_name,--身份证件类别名称
       nvl((select b.id_no from his.pat_master_index b where b.patient_id=a.patient_id),'-') as id_card,--身份证件号码
       (select ks.dept_name from his.dept_dict ks where ks.dept_code=a.Discharge_Ward_Code) as ward_name,--病区名称
       a.Discharge_Ward_Code as ward_no,--病房号
       a.discharge_bed_no as bed_no,--病床号
       a.admission_date_time as admission_date,--入院日期时间
       c.admission_desc as admission_desc,--入院情况
       nvl(dd.DIAGNOSIS_CODE,'Z00.000') as admission_diagnosis_code,--入院诊断编码
       nvl(dd.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'一般性医学检查') as admission_diagnosis_name,--入院诊断名称
       null as studies_summary_result,--阳性辅助检查结果
       null as observation_result,--中医“四诊”观察结果
       null as reatment,--治则治法
       c.treatment_desc as treatment_desc,--诊疗过程描述
       null as tcm_decoction_method,--中药煎煮方法
       null as tcm_use_method,--中药用药方法,
       c.discharge_desc as discharge_desc,--出院情况
       a.discharge_date_time as discharge_date,--出院日期时间
       nvl(dd1.DIAGNOSIS_CODE,'Z00.000') as discharge_diagnosis_code ,-- 出院诊断- 西医诊断代码
       nvl(dd1.DIAGNOSIS_DESC,'一般性医学检查') as discharge_diagnosis_name ,-- 出院诊断- 西医诊断代码
       null as tcm_discharge_diagnosis_code,--出院诊断 - 中医病名代码
       null as tcm_discharge_diagnosis_name,--出院诊断 - 中医病名名称
       null as tcm_discharge_syndrome_code,--出院诊断 - 中医证候代码
       null as tcm_discharge_syndrome_name,--出院诊断 - 中医证候名称
       null as discharge_symptoms_signs,--出院时症状与体征
       c.discharge_order as discharge_order,--出院医嘱
       a.DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION as disease_progression_code,--病情转归代码
       (select d.DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_NAME from his.DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_dict d where a.DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION=d.DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_CODE) as disease_progression_name,--病情转归名称
       a.Doctor_In_Charge as resident_physician_id,  --住院医师
       a.ATTENDING_DOCTOR as chief_physician_id,  --主治医师
       '370104000' as org_code, --医疗机构代码
       '山东省第二人民医院' as org_name, --医疗机构名称
       a.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM DEPT_CODE ,-- 科室代码
       (select d.dept_name from his.dept_dict d where d.dept_code =a.DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM) as DEPT_NAME ,-- 科室名称
       b.CREATOR_ID as operator_id,--操作人 ID
       b.LAST_MODIFY_DATE_TIME as operation_time --操作时间
from his.pat_visit a
join jhemr.jhmr_file_index b
on TOPIC like '%出院记录%' and b.patient_id=a.patient_id and b.visit_id=a.visit_id
left join
(
SELECT
    FILE_UNIQUE_ID,
    MAX(CASE WHEN DG_CODE = 'S.21' THEN DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(DG_PLAIN_CONTENT_BLOB,2000) END) AS admission_desc,--入院情况
    MAX(CASE WHEN DG_CODE = 'S.12' THEN DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(DG_PLAIN_CONTENT_BLOB,2000) END) AS treatment_desc,--诊疗过程描述
    MAX(CASE WHEN DG_CODE = 'S.12.003' THEN DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(DG_PLAIN_CONTENT_BLOB,2000) END) AS discharge_desc,--出院情况
    MAX(CASE WHEN DG_CODE = 'S.12.002' THEN DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(DG_PLAIN_CONTENT_BLOB,2000) END) AS discharge_order--出院医嘱
FROM jhemr.jhmr_file_content_dg
GROUP BY FILE_UNIQUE_ID
) c on c.FILE_UNIQUE_ID=b.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
left join
(
select a.*,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PATIENT_ID,VISIT_ID ORDER BY DIAGNOSIS_DATE) rw
from his.diagnosis a where DIAGNOSIS_TYPE ='2'
) dd  on a.patient_id=dd.patient_id and a.visit_id=dd.visit_id and dd.rw=1
left join
(
select a.*,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PATIENT_ID,VISIT_ID ORDER BY DIAGNOSIS_DATE) rw
from his.diagnosis a where DIAGNOSIS_TYPE ='3'
) dd1  on a.patient_id=dd1.patient_id and a.visit_id=dd1.visit_id and dd1.rw=1

EMR_EX_CLINICAL.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "CRBSB"."EMR_EX_CLINICAL" ("ID", "PATIENT_ID", "ACTIVITY_TYPE_CODE", "ACTIVITY_TYPE_NAME", "SERIAL_NUMBER", "PATIENT_NAME", "ID_CARD_TYPE_CODE", "ID_CARD_TYPE_NAME", "ID_CARD", "WARD_NAME", "WARD_NO", "BED_NO", "APPLICATION_FORM_NO", "APPLY_ORG_CODE", "APPLY_ORG_NAME", "APPLY_DEPT_CODE", "APPLY_DEPT_NAME", "SYMPTOM_START_DATE", "SYMPTOM_END_DATE", "SYMPTOM_DESC", "TREATMENT_DESC", "SPECIAL_EXAMINATION_CODE", "EXAMINATION_TYPE_CODE", "EXAMINATION_TYPE_NAME", "EXAMINATION_OBJECTIVE_DESC", "EXAMINATION_SUBJECTIVE_DESC", "EXAMINATION_NOTES", "EXAMINATION_REPORT_NO", "EXAMINATION_REPORT_DATE", "EXAMINATION_REPORT_ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DEPT_CODE", "DEPT_NAME", "OPERATOR_ID", "OPERATION_TIME") AS 
  select   a.EXAM_NO as id,
         a.PATIENT_ID as patient_id, -- 患者基本信息ID
         case when a.VISIT_ID ='0' then '1' else '6' end as activity_type_code,--就诊记录类型代码 01 门诊  02 住院
         case when a.VISIT_ID ='0' then '门诊' else '住院' end as activity_type_name,--就诊记录类型名称 01 门诊  02 住院
         case when a.VISIT_ID ='0' then cm.CLINIC_NO else pmi.INP_NO||a.visit_id end as serial_number,  --就诊流水号
         NVL(pmi.name,cm.NAME) as patient_name,--患者姓名
         '01' as id_card_type_code,--身份证件类别患者代码
         '居民身份证' as id_card_type_name,--身份证件类别名称
         NVL(pmi.id_no,'-') as id_card,--身份证件号码
         (select dd.dept_name from his.dept_dict dd where dd.dept_code=a.REQ_DEPT) as ward_name,--病区名称
         '' as ward_no, --病房号
         '' as bed_no,--病床号
         nvl(a.exam_no,'-') as application_form_no, --电子申请单编号
         '370104000' as apply_org_code,--检查申请机构代码
         '山东省第二人民医院' as apply_org_name,--检查申请机构名称
         a.REQ_DEPT as apply_dept_code, --检查申请科室代码
         (select q.dept_name from HIS.DEPT_DICT q where a.req_dept=q.dept_code and rownum='1') as apply_dept_name, --检查申请科室名称
         '' as symptom_start_date,  --症状开始时间
         '' as symptom_end_date,  --症状停止时间
         nvl(a.clin_symp,pe."PreClinicalSymptom") as symptom_desc, --症状描述
         nvl(a.phys_sign,'-') as treatment_desc, --诊疗过程描述
         '' as special_examination_code, --特殊检查标志
         (select q.EXAM_CLASS_CODE from HIS.EXAM_CLASS_dict q where a.EXAM_CLASS=q.EXAM_CLASS_NAME) as examination_type_code, --检查类别代码
         a.EXAM_CLASS as examination_type_name, --检查类别名称
         nvl(to_char(pr."ReportDiagnose"),'-') as examination_objective_desc, --检查报告结果-客观所见
         nvl(to_char(pr."ReportResult"),'-') as examination_subjective_desc, --检查报告结果-主观提示
         '-' as examination_notes, --检查报告备注
         to_char(pr."ReportID") as examination_report_no, --检查报告单编号
         to_date(pe."PostExamReportDate"||''||pe."PostExamReportTime",'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as examination_report_date, --检查报告日期
         case when REGEXP_LIKE(pe."PostExamReporterName", '[0-9]') then to_char(pe."PostExamReporterName") else
         (select y.emp_no from his.STAFF_DICT y where y.name=pe."PostExamReporterName" and rownum='1') end as examination_report_id, --报告医师
         '370104000' as org_code, --检查报告机构代码
         '山东省第二人民医院' as org_name, --检查报告机构名称
         '0503' as dept_code, --检查报告科室代码
         '影像科' as dept_name, --检查报告科室名称
         a.TECHNICIAN as operator_id, --操作人ID
         to_char(a.exam_date_time,'yyyymmddhh24miss') as operation_time --操作时间
from his.EXAM_MASTER a
inner join pacs.examinfo pe on a.exam_no = pe."ExamItemHISID" and pe."ExamSatus"='6'
left join pacs.report pr on pr."ReportID" = pe."ExamID"
left join his.pat_master_index pmi on a.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
left join his.clinic_master cm on a.patient_id = cm.patient_id

union all


select   a.EXAM_NO as id,
         a.PATIENT_ID as patient_id, -- 患者基本信息ID
         case when a.VISIT_ID ='0' then '1' else '6' end as activity_type_code,--就诊记录类型代码 01 门诊  02 住院
         case when a.VISIT_ID ='0' then '门诊' else '住院' end as activity_type_name,--就诊记录类型名称 01 门诊  02 住院
         case when a.VISIT_ID ='0' then cm.CLINIC_NO else pmi.INP_NO||a.visit_id end as serial_number,  --就诊流水号
         NVL(pmi.name,cm.NAME) as patient_name,--患者姓名
         '01' as id_card_type_code,--身份证件类别患者代码
         '居民身份证' as id_card_type_name,--身份证件类别名称
         NVL(pmi.id_no,'-') as id_card,--身份证件号码
         (select dd.dept_name from his.dept_dict dd where dd.dept_code=a.REQ_DEPT) as ward_name,--病区名称
         '' as ward_no, --病房号
         '' as bed_no,--病床号
         nvl(a.exam_no,'-') as application_form_no, --电子申请单编号

EMR_EX_CLINICAL_ITEM.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "CRBSB"."EMR_EX_CLINICAL_ITEM" ("ID", "EX_CLINICAL_ID", "ITEM_CODE", "ITEM_NAME", "EXAMINATION_RESULT_CODE", "EXAMINATION_RESULT_NAME", "EXAMINATION_QUANTIFICATION", "EXAMINATION_QUANTIFICAT_UNIT", "OPERATOR_ID", "OPERATION_TIME") AS 
  SELECT  a.EXAM_NO as id,
        a.EXAM_NO as ex_clinical_id,  --检查报告ID
        (select erp.DESCRIPTION_CODE from crbsb.exam_rpt_pattern erp where pe."PreExamNotes"=erp.DESCRIPTION and rownum =1) as item_code,  --检查项目代码
        to_char(pe."PreExamNotes") as item_name,  --检查项目名称
        case when pr."IsPositive" ='阳性'then '02'
             when pr."IsPositive" ='阴性'then '01' else '03' end as examination_result_code, --检查结果代码
        case when pr."IsPositive" ='阳性'then '异常'
             when pr."IsPositive" ='阴性'then '未见异常' else '不确定' end as examination_result_name, --检查结果名称
        '' as examination_quantification, --检查定量结果
        '' as examination_quantificat_unit, --检查定量结果计量单位
        case when REGEXP_LIKE(a.reporter, '[0-9]') then to_char(pe."PostExamReporterName") else
         (select y.emp_no from his.STAFF_DICT y where y.name=to_char(pe."PostExamReporterName") and rownum='1') end as operator_id, --操作人ID
        to_date(pe."PostExamReportDate"||''||pe."PostExamReportTime",'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as operation_time --操作人时间
from his.EXAM_MASTER a
inner join pacs.examinfo pe on a.exam_no = pe."ExamItemHISID" and pe."ExamSatus"='6'
left join pacs.report pr on pr."ReportID" = pe."ExamID"
left join his.pat_master_index pmi on a.patient_id = pmi.patient_id

union all

        a.EXAM_NO  as ex_clinical_id,  --检查报告ID

        bho."ExamItems" as item_name,  --检查项目名称
        case when bho."Positive" in ('是','阳') then '02'
             when bho."Positive"='否'  then '01' else '03' end as examination_result_code, --检查结果代码
        case when bho."Positive" in ('是','阳') then '异常'
             when bho."Positive"='否'  then '未见异常' else '不确定' end as examination_result_name, --检查结果名称

        case when bho."Positive" in ('是','阳') then '02'

  select   a.TEST_NO as id,

         case when a.VISIT_ID ='0' then '门诊' else '住院' end as activity_type_name,--就诊记录类型名称 01 门诊  02 住院

         NVL(pmi.name,cm.NAME) as patient_name,--患者姓名

         '' as ward_no, --病房号

         b.ITEM_CODE as specimen_category_code,  --标本类别代码
         b.ITEM_NAME as specimen_category_name,  --标本类别名称
         nvl(a.TEST_NO,'-') as specimen_no, --检验标本号
         a.SPCM_SAMPLE_DATE_TIME as specimen_sampling_date,  --标本采样日期时间
         a.SPCM_RECEIVED_DATE_TIME as specimen_receiving_date,  --接收标本日期时间
         case when REGEXP_LIKE(a.transcriptionist, '[0-9]') then a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST else
           (select y.emp_no from his.STAFF_DICT y where y.name=a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST and rownum='1') end as examination_physician_id, --检验医师
         to_char(a.execute_date,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') as examination_date, --检验日期
         a.RCPT_NO as examination_report_no, --检验报告单编号
         ''as examination_objective_desc, --检验报告结果-客观所见
         ''as eexamination_subjective_desc, --检验报告结果-主观提示
         ''as examination_notes,  --检验报告备注
         to_char(a.RESULTS_RPT_DATE_TIME,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') as examination_report_date,  --检验报告日期
         case when REGEXP_LIKE(a.transcriptionist, '[0-9]') then a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST else
           (select y.emp_no from his.STAFF_DICT y where y.name=a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST and rownum='1') end as examination_report_id,  --报告医师
         '370104000' as org_code, --检验报告机构代码
         '山东省第二人民医院' as org_name, --检验报告机构名称
         a.PERFORMED_BY as dept_code, --检验报告科室代码
         (select q.dept_name from HIS.DEPT_DICT q where a.PERFORMED_BY=q.dept_code and rownum='1') as dept_name, --检验报告科室名称
         case when REGEXP_LIKE(a.transcriptionist, '[0-9]') then a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST else
           (select y.emp_no from his.STAFF_DICT y where y.name=a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST and rownum='1') end as operator_id, --操作人ID
         to_char(nvl(A.EXECUTE_DATE,a.REQUESTED_DATE_TIME),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') as operation_time --操作时间
from (select * from HIS.LAB_TEST_MASTER Where results_rpt_date_time is not null and RESULT_STATUS='4') a
left join HIS.lab_test_items b on a.TEST_NO=b.TEST_NO
left join his.pat_master_index pmi on a.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
left join his.pat_visit pv on a.patient_id = pv.patient_id and a.VISIT_ID = pv.VISIT_ID
left join his.clinic_master cm on a.patient_id = cm.patient_id and to_char(cm.VISIT_DATE,'yyyymmdd')=to_char(a.REQUESTED_DATE_TIME,'yyyymmdd')

EMR_EX_LAB_ITEM.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "CRBSB"."EMR_EX_LAB_ITEM" ("ID", "EX_LAB_ID", "ITEM_CODE", "ITEM_NAME", "SOURCE_EXAMINATION_RESULT_CODE", "SOURCE_EXAMINATION_RESULT_NAME", "EXAMINATION_RESULT_CODE", "EXAMINATION_RESULT_NAME", "EXAMINATION_QUANTIFICATION", "EXAMINATION_QUANTIFICA_UNIT", "EXAMINATION_QUANTIFICA_LOWER", "EXAMINATION_QUANTIFICA_UPPER", "EXAMINATION_QUANTIFICATION_RI", "OPERATION_TIME", "OPERATOR_ID") AS 
  select   a.TEST_NO||c.PRINT_ORDER as id,
         a.TEST_NO as ex_lab_id, -- 检验报告ID
         c.REPORT_ITEM_CODE as item_code, --院内检验项目代码
         c.REPORT_ITEM_NAME as item_name, --院内检验项目名称
         case when c.result like '阳性%' then 'P'
              when c.result like '阴性%' then 'N'
           else c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR END as source_examination_result_code, --院内检验定性结果代码
         case when c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'H' then '偏高'
              when c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'L' then '偏低'
              when (c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'P' or c.result like '阳性%') then '阳性'
              when c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'Q' then '弱阳性'
              when c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'E' then '错误'
              when (c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'N' or c.result like '阴性%') then '阴性'
              when c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'M' then '正常'
              when c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'S' then '敏感'
              when c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'R' then '耐药' end as source_examination_result_name, --院内检验定性结果名称
         case when c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'H' then '12'
              when c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'L' then '10'
              when (c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'P' or c.result like '阳性%') then '01'
              when c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'Q' then '05'
              when (c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'N' or c.result like '阴性%') then '02'
              when c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'S' then '15'
              when c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'R' then '16' end as examination_result_code, --标化检验定性结果代码
         case when c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'H' then 'H 高度耐药'
              when c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'L' then 'L 低度耐药'
              when (c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'P' or c.result like '阳性%') then '阳性'
              when c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'Q' then '弱阳性'
              when c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'E' then '未检出'
              when (c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'N' or c.result like '阴性%') then '阴性'
              when c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'M' then '检出'
              when c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'S' then '敏感'
              when c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'R' then '耐药' end as examination_result_name, --标化检验定性结果名称
         c.RESULT as examination_quantification,  --检验定量结果
         c.UNITS as examination_quantifica_unit, --检验定量结果计量单位
         REGEXP_SUBSTR(c.PRINT_CONTEXT, '^[^--]+') as examination_quantifica_lower,  --检验定量结果参考区间-下限
         REGEXP_SUBSTR(c.PRINT_CONTEXT, '[^--]+$', 1, 1) as examination_quantifica_upper,  --检验定量结果参考区间-上限
         /*REGEXP_SUBSTR(c.PRINT_CONTEXT, '^[^--]+')*/
         case when c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'H' then '2'
              when c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'L' then '1'
              when (c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'P' or c.result like '阳性%') then '0'
              when c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'Q' then '0'
              when c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'E' then '0'
              when (c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'N' or c.result like '阴性%') then '0'
              when c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'M' then '0'
              when c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'S' then '2'
              when c.ABNORMAL_INDICATOR = 'R' then '0' end as examination_quantification_ri,  --检验定量结果超出或低于参考值
         to_char(nvl(A.EXECUTE_DATE,a.REQUESTED_DATE_TIME),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') as operation_time, --操作时间
         case when REGEXP_LIKE(a.transcriptionist, '[0-9]') then a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST else
           (select y.emp_no from his.STAFF_DICT y where y.name=a.TRANSCRIPTIONIST and rownum='1') end as operator_id --操作人ID
from (select * from HIS.LAB_TEST_MASTER Where results_rpt_date_time is not null and RESULT_STATUS='4') a
left join HIS.lab_test_items b on a.TEST_NO=b.TEST_NO
left join HIS.Lab_Result c on a.test_no=c.test_no and b.ITEM_NO=c.ITEM_NO
where c.REPORT_ID is not null

EMR_FIRST_COURSE.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "CRBSB"."EMR_FIRST_COURSE" ("ID", "PATIENT_ID", "SERIAL_NUMBER", "PATIENT_NAME", "ID_CARD_TYPE_CODE", "ID_CARD_TYPE_NAME", "ID_CARD", "WARD_NAME", "WARD_NO", "BED_CODE", "CREATE_TIME", "CHIEF_COMPLAINT", "PRESENT_ILLNESS_HIS", "OBSERVATION_RESULT", "DIAGNOSIS_BASIS", "WM_INITAL_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "WM_INITAL_DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "TCM_INITAL_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "TCM_INITAL_DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "TCM_INITAL_SYNDROME_CODE", "TCM_INITAL_SYNDROME_NAME", "WM_DIFF_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "WM_DIFF_DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "TCM_PRIMARY_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "TCM_PRIMARY_DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "TCM_PRIMARY_SYNDROME_CODE", "TCM_PRIMARY_SYNDROME_NAME", "REATMENT", "TREATMENT_PLAN", "DISEASE_PROGRESSION_CODE", "DISEASE_PROGRESSION_NAME", "RESIDENT_PHYSICIAN_ID", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DEPT_CODE", "DEPT_NAME", "OPERATOR_ID", "OPERATION_TIME") AS 
  select pv.patient_id||'_'||pv.visit_id as id,
       pv.patient_id as patient_id, --患者基本信息ID
       pmi.inp_no||pv.visit_id as serial_number,  --住院号
       pmi.name as patient_name,  --患者姓名
       '01' as id_card_type_code,--身份证件类别患者代码
       '居民身份证' as id_card_type_name,--身份证件类别名称
       nvl(pmi.id_no,pv.INSURANCE_NO) as id_card,--身份证件号码
       (select dd.dept_name from his.dept_dict dd where dd.dept_code=pv.discharge_ward_code) WARD_NAME,--病区名称
       '' as ward_no,--病房号
       to_char(pv.discharge_bed_no) BED_CODE, --病床代码
       to_char(t1.DOC_CREATE_DATE,'yyyymmddhh24miss') as create_time, --记录日期时间
       DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t3.zs,2000) as chief_complaint,  --主诉
       DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(t3.BLTD,2000) as present_illness_his,  --病理特点
       '' as observation_result,--中医“四诊”观察结果
       t3.ZDYJ as diagnosis_basis,  --诊断依据
       nvl(zd.ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_CODE,
       (select cd.国标编码 from cda.cda_dictionary cd where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码' and cd.系统标识='HIS'and cd.院标名称=dd.diagnosis_desc and rownum = 1)
       ) as wm_inital_diagnosis_code,  --初步诊断-西医诊断编码
       nvl(zd.ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_NAME,
       (select cd.国标名称 from cda.cda_dictionary cd where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码' and cd.系统标识='HIS'and cd.院标名称=dd.diagnosis_desc and rownum = 1)
       ) as wm_inital_diagnosis_name,  --初步诊断-西医诊断名称
--        zd4.ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_NONAG_CODE as tcm_inital_diagnosis_code,  --初步诊断-中医病名代码
--        zd4.ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_NONAG_NAME as tcm_inital_diagnosis_name,  --初步诊断-中医病名名称
--        zd5.ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_SYMPTOM_CODE as tcm_inital_syndrome_code,--初步诊断-中医证候代码
--        zd5.ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_SYMPTOM_NAME as tcm_inital_syndrome_name,--初步诊断-中医证候名称
       '' as tcm_inital_diagnosis_code,  --初步诊断-中医病名代码
       '' as tcm_inital_diagnosis_name,  --初步诊断-中医病名名称
       '' as tcm_inital_syndrome_code,--初步诊断-中医证候代码
       '' as tcm_inital_syndrome_name,--初步诊断-中医证候名称
       nvl(nvl(zd6.REVISED_DIAG_WEST_CODE,zd.ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_CODE),
       (select cd.国标编码 from cda.cda_dictionary cd where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码' and cd.系统标识='HIS'and cd.院标名称=dd.diagnosis_desc and rownum = 1)
       )as wm_diff_diagnosis_code,--鉴别诊断-西医诊断代码
       nvl(nvl(zd6.REVISED_DIAG_WEST_NAME,zd.ADMIT_WEST_DIAG_NAME),
       (select cd.国标名称 from cda.cda_dictionary cd where cd.字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码' and cd.系统标识='HIS'and cd.院标名称=dd.diagnosis_desc and rownum = 1)
       )as wm_diff_diagnosis_name,--鉴别诊断-西医诊断名称
--        nvl(zd7.REVISED_DIAG_TCM_NONAG_CODE,zd4.ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_NONAG_CODE) as tcm_primary_diagnosis_code,--鉴别诊断-中医病名代码
--        nvl(zd7.REVISED_DIAG_TCM_NONAG_NAME,zd4.ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_NONAG_NAME) as tcm_primary_diagnosis_name,--鉴别诊断-中医病名名称
--        nvl(zd8.REVISED_DIAG_TCM_SYNDROME_CODE,zd5.ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_SYMPTOM_CODE) as tcm_primary_syndrome_code,--鉴别诊断-中医证候代码
--        nvl(zd8.REVISED_DIAG_TCM_SYMPTOM_NAME,zd5.ADMIT_TCM_DIAG_SYMPTOM_NAME) as tcm_primary_syndrome_name,--鉴别诊断-中医证候名称
       '' as tcm_primary_diagnosis_code,--鉴别诊断-中医病名代码
       '' as tcm_primary_diagnosis_name,--鉴别诊断-中医病名名称
       '' as tcm_primary_syndrome_code,--鉴别诊断-中医证候代码
       '' as tcm_primary_syndrome_name,--鉴别诊断-中医证候名称
       '' as reatment,--治则治法
       t3.ZLJH as treatment_plan, --诊疗计划
       '9' as disease_progression_code, -- 病情转归代码
       '其他' as disease_progression_name, -- 病情转归名称
       nvl(pv.Doctor_In_Charge,'-') as resident_physician_id, --住院医师
       '370104000' as org_code, --医疗机构代码
       '山东省第二人民医院' as org_name, --医疗机构名称
       pv.dept_admission_to as dept_code,  --科室代码
       (select dd.dept_name from his.dept_dict dd where dd.dept_code=pv.dept_admission_to) as dept_name, --科室名称\
       t1.CREATEUSERID as operator_id, --操作人ID
       to_char(t1.CREATEON,'yyyymmddhh24miss') as operation_time --操作时间
from mtl.EPR_INPATIENT_DOCINDEX t
inner JOIN mtl.EPR_INPATIENT t1
on t.UHID=t1.UHID /*and t1.DOC_STATS = '1'*/ and t1.doc_type_name ='首次病程记录'
inner join mtl.EMRSD37 T3 ON T3.段落编号=T1.ID
inner join his.pat_visit pv on pv.patient_id = t.p_clinic_id and pv.visit_id = t.p_inpatient_times

    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY INHOSP_INDEX_NO,INHOS_NUM ORDER BY REVISED_WEST_CIS_POSITION) as rn
    FROM cda.修正西
