EMR_ORDER.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "CRBSB"."EMR_ORDER" ("ID", "PATIENT_ID", "ACTIVITY_TYPE_CODE", "ACTIVITY_TYPE_NAME", "SERIAL_NUMBER", "PATIENT_NAME", "ID_CARD_TYPE_CODE", "ID_CARD_TYPE_NAME", "ID_CARD", "PRESCRIPTION_NO", "PRESCRIPTION_TYPE_CODE", "PRESCRIPTION_ISSUANCE_DATE", "PRESCRIPTION_VALIDITY_DAYS", "EXCUTE_DATE", "PRESCRIPTION_ISSUANCE_ID", "PRESCRIPTION_DISPENSING_ID", "PRESCRIPTION_NOTES", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DEPT_CODE", "DEPT_NAME", "OPERATOR_ID", "OPERATION_TIME") AS 
  select  a.PATIENT_ID||'_'||a.VISIT_ID||'_'||a.ORDER_NO||'_'||a.ORDER_SUB_NO as id,
        a.patient_id as patient_id, -- 患者基本信息ID
        '6' as activity_type_code,--就诊记录类型代码 01 门诊  02 住院
        '住院' as activity_type_name,--就诊记录类型名称 01 门诊  02 住院
        pmi.INP_NO||b.visit_id as serial_number, --就诊流水号
        pmi.name as patient_name,-- 患者姓名
        '01' as id_card_type_code,--身份证件类别患者代码
        '居民身份证' as id_card_type_name,--身份证件类别名称
        nvl(pmi.id_no,'-') id_card,--身份证件号码
        a.ORDER_NO||'_'||a.ORDER_SUB_NO as prescription_no, --处方编号
        (select m.DRUG_INDICATOR from his.drug_dict m where a.ORDER_CODE=m.DRUG_CODE) as prescription_type_code, --处方类别代码:1.西药2.中成药3.中药饮方4.中草药
        a.start_date_time as prescription_issuance_date, --处方开立日期
        TRUNC(a.STOP_DATE_TIME-a.start_date_time) as prescription_validity_days, --处方有效天数
        a.start_date_time as excute_date, --医嘱处方执行日期
        a.doctor_user as prescription_issuance_id, --处方开立医师
        '' as prescription_dispensing_id, --处方发药药剂师
        '' as prescription_notes, --处方备注信息
        '370104000' as org_code, --医疗机构代码
        '山东省第二人民医院' as org_name, --医疗机构名称
        a.ORDERING_DEPT as dept_code,  --科室代码
        (select dd.DEPT_NAME from his.dept_dict dd where dd.dept_code=a.ORDERING_DEPT) as dept_name, --科室名称
        a.doctor as operator_id, --操作人ID
        to_char(a.START_DATE_TIME,'yyyymmddhh24miss') as operation_time --操作时间
from his.orders a
inner join his.pat_visit b
on a.patient_id = b.patient_id and a.visit_id = b.visit_id
left join his.pat_master_index pmi on pmi.patient_id=a.patient_id
where a.ORDER_CLASS in ('A','B')

EMR_ORDER_ITEM.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "CRBSB"."EMR_ORDER_ITEM" ("ID", "ORDER_ID", "DRUG_CODE", "DRUG_NAME", "DRUG_SPECIFICATIONS", "DRUG_DOSAGE_CODE", "DRUG_DOSAGE_UNIT_CODE", "DRUG_DOSAGE_UNIT_NAME", "DRUG_DOSAGE_TOTAL", "TCM_PRESCRIPTION", "TCM_NUMBER", "TCM_DECOCTION_METHOD", "TCM_USE_METHOD", "OPERATOR_ID", "OPERATION_TIME") AS 
  select  a.PATIENT_ID||'_'||a.VISIT_ID||'_'||a.ORDER_NO||'_'||a.ORDER_SUB_NO as id,
        a.PATIENT_ID||'_'||a.VISIT_ID||'_'||a.ORDER_NO||'_'||a.ORDER_SUB_NO as order_id, --医嘱处方ID
        nvl(nvl(c.药品编码,a.ORDER_CODE),'-') as drug_code,--药物代码
        nvl(c.药品名称,a.ORDER_TEXT) as drug_name, --药物名称
        nvl((select m.DRUG_SPEC from his.drug_dict m where a.ORDER_CODE=m.DRUG_CODE),'-') as drug_specifications, --药物规格
        nvl(a.DOSAGE,'-') as drug_dosage_code, --单次用药剂量
        case when a.DOSAGE_UNITS in ('g','克') then '01'
             when a.DOSAGE_UNITS in ('mg','毫克') then '02'
             when a.DOSAGE_UNITS in ('ug') then '03'
             when a.DOSAGE_UNITS in ('升') then '05'
             when a.DOSAGE_UNITS in ('ml') then '06'
             when a.DOSAGE_UNITS in ('IU','iu','万IU','万iu') then '07'
             when a.DOSAGE_UNITS in ('u','万u') then '08' else '99' end as drug_dosage_unit_code, --药物使用剂量单位代码
        case when a.DOSAGE_UNITS in ('g','克') then '克（g）'
             when a.DOSAGE_UNITS in ('mg','毫克') then '毫克（mg）'
             when a.DOSAGE_UNITS in ('ug') then '微克（μg）'
             when a.DOSAGE_UNITS in ('升') then '升（L）'
             when a.DOSAGE_UNITS in ('ml') then '毫升（ml）'
             when a.DOSAGE_UNITS in ('IU','iu','万IU','万iu') then '国际单位（IU）'
             when a.DOSAGE_UNITS in ('u','万u') then '单位（U）' else '其他' end as drug_dosage_unit_name, --药物使用剂量单位名称
        '' as drug_dosage_total, --药物使用总剂量
        case when a.ORDER_CLASS ='B' THEN a.ORDER_TEXT else '' end as tcm_prescription, --中药饮片处方
        '' as tcm_number, --中药饮片剂数(剂）
        '-' as tcm_decoction_method, --中药饮片煎煮法
        case when a.ORDER_CLASS ='B' THEN a.FREQ_DETAIL else '' end as tcm_use_method, --中药用药方法
        a.doctor as operator_id, --操作人ID
        to_char(a.START_DATE_TIME,'yyyymmddhh24miss') as operation_time --操作时间
from his.orders a
inner join his.pat_visit b
on a.patient_id = b.patient_id and a.visit_id = b.visit_id
left join ods.pub_lyyp c on a.ORDER_CODE =c.HIS药品编码
where a.ORDER_CLASS in ('A','B')

EMR_OUTPATIENT_OBS.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "CRBSB"."EMR_OUTPATIENT_OBS" ("ID", "PATIENT_ID", "SERIAL_NUMBER", "PATIENT_NAME", "ID_CARD_TYPE_CODE", "ID_CARD_TYPE_NAME", "ID_CARD", "ALLERGY_HIS_FLAG", "ALLERGY_HIS", "OUTPATIENT_DATE", "INITAL_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "CHIEF_COMPLAINT", "PRESENT_ILLNESS_HIS", "PAST_ILLNESS_HIS", "PHYSICAL_EXAMINATION", "OBSERVATION_RESULT", "STUDIES_SUMMARY_RESULT", "WM_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "WM_DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "TCM_INITAL_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "TCM_INITAL_DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "TCM_INITAL_SYNDROME_CODE", "TCM_INITAL_SYNDROME_NAME", "DIFFERENTIATION_BASIS", "TREATMENT", "COURSE", "OBSERVATION_DATE", "NOTES", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DEPT_CODE", "DEPT_NAME", "OPERATOR_ID", "OPERATION_TIME") AS 
  select  a.SERIAL_NO as ID,--  文档流水号，标识一份文档的唯一值
        t.patient_id as patient_id,-- 患者基本信息ID
        t.CLINIC_NO as serial_number, --门（急）诊号
        (select m.name from his.pat_master_index m where m.patient_id=t.patient_id) patient_name  ,-- 患者姓名
        '01' as id_card_type_code,--身份证件类别患者代码
        '居民身份证' as id_card_type_name,--身份证件类别名称
        (select m.id_no from his.pat_master_index m where m.patient_id=t.patient_id) id_card,--身份证件号码
        '' as allergy_his_flag, --过敏史标志,0.无1.有
        '' as allergy_his,  --过敏史
        to_char(t.REGISTERING_DATE,'yyyymmddhh24miss') as outpatient_date,  --就诊日期时间
        t.FIRST_VISIT_INDICATOR as inital_diagnosis_code,--初诊标志代码,1.初诊2.复诊
        nvl(nvl(r.main_suit,r1.main_suit),'-') as chief_complaint,-- 主诉
        nvl(nvl(r.medical_history,r1.medical_history),'-') as present_illness_his,  --现病史
        nvl(nvl(r.previous_history,r1.previous_history),'-') as past_illness_his,  --既往史
        nvl(nvl(r.physical_check,r1.physical_check),'-') as physical_examination,  --体格检查
        '-' as observation_result, --中医“四诊”观察结果
        nvl(nvl(r.AUXILIARY_EXAMINATION,r1.AUXILIARY_EXAMINATION),'-') as studies_summary_result, --辅助检查
        (select a.国标编码 from cda.cda_dictionary a where  a.字典名称='ICD-10诊断编码' and a.系统标识='HIS' and a.院标名称=mr.diag_desc and rownum='1') as wm_diagnosis_code, --初步诊断-西医诊断代码
        (select a.国标名称 from cda.cda_dictionary a where  a.字典名称='ICD-10诊断编码' and a.系统标识='HIS' and a.院标名称=mr.diag_desc and rownum='1') as wm_diagnosis_name, --初步诊断-西医诊断名称
        '' as tcm_inital_diagnosis_code,  --初步诊断-中医病名代码
        '' as tcm_inital_diagnosis_name,  --初步诊断-中医病名名称
        '' as tcm_inital_syndrome_code,  --初步诊断-中医证候代码
        '' as tcm_inital_syndrome_name,  --初步诊断-中医证候名称
        nvl(nvl(r.physical_check,r1.physical_check),'-') as differentiation_basis,  --辩证依据
        '' as treatment,  --治则治法
        nvl(jz.view_advice,'-') as course, --急诊留观病程记录
        to_char(to_date(jz.in_view_time,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss'),'yyyymmddhh24miss') as observation_date,  --收入观察室日期时间
        '无' as notes, --注意事项
        '370104000' as org_code, --医疗机构代码
        '山东省第二人民医院' as org_name, --医疗机构名称
        (select dd.DEPT_CODE from his.dept_dict dd where dd.dept_code=a.SUBJECT_NAME) as dept_code,  --科室代码
        a.SUBJECT_NAME as dept_name, --科室名称
        t.doctor as operator_id, --操作人ID
        to_char(t.REGISTERING_DATE,'yyyymmddhh24miss') as operation_time --操作时间

from YBEMR.medical_api_medicalrecords a
inner join his.clinic_master t on to_char(t.patient_id)=substr(a.serial_no,0,8)
and to_char(t.visit_no)=substr(a.serial_no,10,10)
inner join ybemr.clinic_api_outviewrecord jz on a.id=jz.medical_records_id
left join YBEMR.clinic_api_fiafirstoutrecord r on a.id = r.MEDICAL_RECORDS_ID
left join YBEMR.clinic_api_fiasecoutrecord r1 on a.id = r1.MEDICAL_RECORDS_ID
left join his.outp_mr_diag_desc mr on to_char(t.visit_no)=mr.visit_no And t.patient_id=mr.patient_id
where a.subject_name in ('急诊门诊','留观门诊')

EMR_OUTPATIENT_RECORD.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "CRBSB"."EMR_OUTPATIENT_RECORD" ("ID", "PATIENT_ID", "SERIAL_NUMBER", "PATIENT_NAME", "ID_CARD_TYPE_CODE", "ID_CARD_TYPE_NAME", "ID_CARD", "ALLERGY_HIS_FLAG", "ALLERGY_HIS", "OUTPATIENT_DATE", "INITAL_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "CHIEF_COMPLAINT", "PRESENT_ILLNESS_HIS", "PAST_ILLNESS_HIS", "INFECTION_HIS", "VACCINATION_HIS", "OPERATION_HIS", "BLOOD_TRANSFUSION", "PERSONAL_HIS", "MARITAL_HIS", "MENSTRUAL_HIS", "FAMILY_HIS", "PHYSICAL_EXAMINATION", "OBSERVATION_RESULT", "STUDIES_SUMMARY_RESULT", "WM_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "WM_DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "TCM_INITAL_DIAGNOSIS_CODE", "TCM_INITAL_DIAGNOSIS_NAME", "TCM_INITAL_SYNDROME_CODE", "TCM_INITAL_SYNDROME_NAME", "DIFFERENTIATION_BASIS", "TREATMENT", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DEPT_CODE", "DEPT_NAME", "OPERATOR_ID", "OPERATION_TIME") AS 
  select  t.PATIENT_ID||'_'||t.VISIT_NO as id,
        t.patient_id as patient_id, --患者基本信息ID
        t.CLINIC_NO as serial_number, --门（急）诊号
        nvl((select m.name from his.pat_master_index m where m.patient_id=t.patient_id AND rownum =1),
        (select cm.name from his.clinic_master cm where cm.patient_id=t.patient_id AND rownum =1)) as patient_name  ,-- 患者姓名
        '01' as id_card_type_code,--身份证件类别患者代码
        '居民身份证' as id_card_type_name,--身份证件类别名称
        nvl((select m.id_no from his.pat_master_index m where m.patient_id=t.patient_id),'-') id_card,--身份证件号码
        Decode(r.allergy,Null,'0','1') as allergy_his_flag, --过敏史标志,0.无1.有
        nvl(r.allergy,'-') as allergy_his,  --过敏史
        to_char(t.REGISTERING_DATE,'yyyymmddhh24miss') as outpatient_date,  --就诊日期时间
        t.FIRST_VISIT_INDICATOR as inital_diagnosis_code,--初诊标志代码,1.初诊2.复诊
        nvl(nvl(nvl(nvl(r.main_suit,r1.main_suit),r2.main_suit),r3.main_suit),'-') as chief_complaint,  --主诉
        nvl(nvl(nvl(nvl(r.medical_history,r1.medical_history),r2.medical_history),r3.medical_history),'-') as present_illness_his,  --现病史
        '-' as past_illness_his,  --既往史
        '' as infection_his,   --传染病史
        '' as vaccination_his,  --预防接种史
        '' as operation_his, --手术史
        '' as blood_transfusion, --输血史
        nvl(nvl(nvl(nvl(r.MAIN_SUIT,r1.MAIN_SUIT),r2.MAIN_SUIT),r3.MAIN_SUIT),'-') as personal_his,  --个人史
        substr(substr(r.PREVIOUS_HISTORY,instr(r.PREVIOUS_HISTORY,'婚姻史')+4),1,
        instr(substr(r.PREVIOUS_HISTORY,instr(r.PREVIOUS_HISTORY,'婚姻史')+4),'，')-1)as marital_his, --婚育史
        case when instr(r.PREVIOUS_HISTORY,'月经史') =0 then '无' else
        substr(substr(r.PREVIOUS_HISTORY,instr(r.PREVIOUS_HISTORY,'月经史')+4),1,
        instr(substr(r.PREVIOUS_HISTORY,instr(r.PREVIOUS_HISTORY,'月经史')+4),'，')-1) end as menstrual_his,  --月经史
        substr(r.PREVIOUS_HISTORY,instr(r.PREVIOUS_HISTORY,'家族史')+4) as family_his,  --家族史
        nvl(nvl(nvl(nvl(r.physical_check,r1.physical_check),r2.physical_check),r3.physical_check),'-') as physical_examination,  --体格检查
        '' as observation_result,  --中医“四诊”观察结果
        nvl(nvl(nvl(nvl(r.auxiliary_examination,r1.auxiliary_examination),r2.auxiliary_examination),r3.auxiliary_examination),'-') as studies_summary_result,  --辅助检查
        nvl((select a.国标编码 from cda.cda_dictionary a where  a.字典名称='ICD-10诊断编码' and a.系统标识='HIS' and a.院标名称=mr.diag_desc and rownum='1'),'Z00.000')as wm_diagnosis_code,  --初步诊断-西医诊断代码
        nvl((select a.国标名称 from cda.cda_dictionary a where  a.字典名称='ICD-10诊断编码' and a.系统标识='HIS' and a.院标名称=mr.diag_desc and rownum='1'),'一般性医学检查')as wm_diagnosis_name,  --初步诊断-西医诊断名称
        '' as tcm_inital_diagnosis_code,  --初步诊断-中医病名代码
        '' as tcm_inital_diagnosis_name,  --初步诊断-中医病名名称
        '' as tcm_inital_syndrome_code,  --初步诊断-中医证候代码
        '' as tcm_inital_syndrome_name,  --初步诊断-中医证候名称
        nvl(r.physical_check,'-') as differentiation_basis,  --辨证依据
        '' as treatment,  --治则治法
        '370104000' as org_code, --医疗机构代码
        '山东省第二人民医院' as org_name, --医疗机构名称
        t.VISIT_DEPT as dept_code,  --科室代码
        (select dd.DEPT_name from his.dept_dict dd where dd.dept_code=t.VISIT_DEPT and rownum=1) as dept_name, --科室名称
        t.doctor as operator_id, --操作人ID
        to_char(t.REGISTERING_DATE,'yyyymmddhh24miss') as operation_time --操作时间
from his.clinic_master t
left join his.outp_mr_diag_desc mr on to_char(t.visit_no)=mr.visit_no And t.patient_id=mr.patient_id and ITEM_NO=1
left join YBEMR.medical_api_medicalrecords a on to_char(t.patient_id)=substr(a.serial_no,0,8) and to_char(t.visit_no)=substr(a.serial_no,10,10)
left Join YBEMR.clinic_api_firstoutrecord r on a.id = r.MEDICAL_RECORDS_ID
left join YBEMR.clinic_api_repeatedoutrecord r1 on a.id = r1.MEDICAL_RECORDS_ID
left join YBEMR.clinic_api_chinafirstoutrecord r2 on a.id = r2.MEDICAL_RECORDS_ID
left join YBEMR.clinic_api_chinasecoutrecord r3 on a.id = r3.MEDICAL_RECORDS_ID

EMR_VITAL_SIGNS_RECORD.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "CRBSB"."EMR_VITAL_SIGNS_RECORD" ("ID", "PATIENT_ID", "ACTIVITY_TYPE_CODE", "ACTIVITY_TYPE_NAME", "SERIAL_NUMBER", "PATIENT_NAME", "ID_CARD_TYPE_CODE", "ID_CARD_TYPE_NAME", "ID_CARD", "CREATE_DATE", "VENTILATORUSED_CODE", "VENTILATORUSED_NAME", "CRITICAL_CARE_CODE", "CRITICAL_CARE_NAME", "ORG_CODE", "ORG_NAME", "DEPT_CODE", "DEPT_NAME", "OPERATOR_ID", "OPERATION_TIME") AS 
  select  pv.patient_id||'_'||pv.visit_id as id,
        pv.patient_id as patient_id, --患者基本信息ID
        '6' as activity_type_code,  --就诊记录类型代码
        '入院' as activity_type_name,  --就诊记录类型名称
        pmi.inp_no||pv.visit_id as serial_number, --就诊流水号
        pmi.name as patient_name,  --患者姓名
        '01' as id_card_type_code,--身份证件类别患者代码
        '居民身份证' as id_card_type_name,--身份证件类别名称
        nvl(pmi.id_no,pv.INSURANCE_NO) as id_card,--身份证件号码
        to_char(f.CREATED_DATE,'yyyymmddhh24miss') as create_date,  --记录日期时间
        case when pv.BREATH_MACH_TIMES is not null then '1' else '0' end as ventilatorused_code, --是否使用呼吸机代码
        case when pv.BREATH_MACH_TIMES is not null then '是' else '否' end as ventilatorused_name, --是否使用呼吸机名称
        case when pv.ICU_DAYS is not null then '1' else '0' end as critical_care_code,  --是否重症监护代码
        case when pv.ICU_DAYS is not null then '是' else '否' end as critical_care_name,  --是否重症监护名称
        '370104000' as org_code, --医疗机构代码
        '山东省第二人民医院' as org_name, --医疗机构名称
        pv.dept_admission_to as dept_code,  --科室代码
        (select dd.dept_name from his.dept_dict dd where dd.dept_code=pv.dept_admission_to) as dept_name, --科室名称
        f.CREATED_BY as operator_id, --操作人ID
        to_char(f.CREATED_DATE,'yyyymmddhh24miss') as operation_time --操作时间
from ydhl.mcs_doc_form f inner Join ydhl.inpatients p
On f.PATIENT_UID=p.pat_index_no and f.is_valid='1' and f.created_by<>'dba'
inner join his.pat_visit pv On  to_char(pv.patient_id)=to_char(substr(p.patient_id,'1','8'))
and to_char(pv.visit_id)=to_char(substr(p.patient_id,'10','10'))
left join his.pat_master_index pmi
on pv.patient_id = pmi.patient_id

       -- he.titlerank ZCJBDM ,hg.enddate LZRQ , ht.begindate HTKSRQ , ht.enddate HTJSRQ , ht.contractnum HTH ,ht.termmonth HTJX ,ht.continuetime HTQDCS  ,bc.modifiedtime XGRQ,
       (case
         when (he.titlerank = '~' or he.titlerank is null) then
          '-'
         else
          he.titlerank
       end) as ZCJBDM,
       (case
         when he.titlerank = '1' then
          '高级职称'
         when he.titlerank = '2' then
          '中级职称'
         when he.titlerank = '3' then
          '初级职称'
         else
          '-'
       end) as ZCJBMC,
       nvl(ht.contractnum, '-') HTH,

       (case
         when (bc.modifiedtime = '~' or bc.modifiedtime is null) then
          bc.creationtime
         else
          bc.modifiedtime
       end) as XGRQ,
       --to_date(bc.modifiedtime, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:mm:ss') TBRQ,
       bc.modifiedtime TBRQ,
       bc.creationtime JDRQ,
       om_job.jobname mainjobname , --主要职务  2024年3月7日
       hb.jobglbdef19  jobname--职务 2024年3月7日
  from bd_psndoc bc
 inner join  (
 select j1.* from hi_psnjob j1 left join ( select job.pk_psndoc,max(job.begindate) begindate
 from hi_psnjob job where nvl(job.dr,0)=0 and job.lastflag='Y'
 group by job.pk_psndoc) j2 on j1.pk_psndoc = j2.pk_psndoc
 and j1.begindate = j2.begindate
 where j1.pk_psndoc = j2.pk_psndoc and j1.begindate = j2.begindate

 ) hb
    on bc.pk_psndoc = hb.pk_psndoc --最新开始日期，取最新任职记录，保留唯一。
 inner join org_dept ot
    on ot.pk_dept = hb.pk_dept --部门
 inner join org_adminorg ogg
    on ogg.pk_adminorg = bc.pk_org --行政组织
  left join bd_address bs
    on bs.pk_address = bc.addr --地址簿
  left join hi_psndoc_edu hu
    on hu.pk_psndoc = bc.pk_psndoc --教育经历
  left join hi_psndoc_langability hy
    on hy.pk_psndoc = bc.pk_psndoc --语言能力
  left join hi_psndoc_psnchg hg
    on hg.pk_psndoc = bc.pk_psndoc --流动情况
  left join hi_psndoc_title he
    on he.pk_psndoc = bc.pk_psndoc --职称信息
  left join hi_psndoc_ctrt ht
    on ht.pk_psndoc = bc.pk_psndoc --合同信息
  left join bd_countryzone bce
    on bce.pk_country = bc.country --国籍信息
  left join bd_defdoc bdec
    on bc.nationality = bdec.pk_defdoc --自定义档案
  left join bd_defdoc bdec2
    on hu.education = bdec2.pk_defdoc --自定义档案（找学历信息）
  left join bd_defdoc bdec3
    on bdec3.pk_defdoc = hu.pk_degree -- 自定义档案（找学位信息）
    left join bd_defdoc bdec4
    on bdec4.pk_defdoc =   bc.polity     --自定义档案（找政治面貌）
  left join bd_psncl bdl
    on bdl.pk_psncl = hb.pk_psncl --人员类别
    left join om_job  om_job
    on om_job.pk_job = hb.pk_job --职务  2024年3月7日增加
 where hu.glbdef6 = 'Y'
   and ot.name <> '入职人员科室'
   and hb.lastflag = 'Y'  --只保留最新记录，不保留历史调动。-2023.09.12
   and ismainjob = 'Y'  --兼职记录和工作记录同一个表，用该字段去掉兼职记录数据-2023.09.15

PL_CBHS_MZ.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "HRP"."PL_CBHS_MZ" ("时间", "核算科目", "科室代码", "科室名称", "科室费用", "成本核算编码", "成本核算单元名称", "核算费用") AS 
  WITH base_data AS (
    select a1.时间 as 时间,
           a1.SUBJ_NAME as 核算科目,
           A.科室代码,
           A.科室名称,
           A.成本核算编码,
           A.成本核算单元名称,
           SUM(a1.COSTS) OVER (PARTITION BY a1.时间,a1.SUBJ_NAME,A.科室代码) as 科室费用,
           SUM(a1.COSTS) OVER (PARTITION BY a1.时间,a1.SUBJ_NAME,A.成本核算编码) as 核算费用
    from
    (
        SELECT E.时间,
               E.ORDERED_BY_DEPT,
               F.CLASS_NAME SUBJ_NAME,
               NVL(E.COSTS, 0) COSTS
        FROM
        (
           SELECT to_char(B.VISIT_DATE,'yyyy-mm') as 时间,
                  C.ORDERED_BY_DEPT,
                  A.CLASS_NAME AS SUBJ_NAME,
                  SUM(B.charges) AS COSTS
           FROM his.RECK_ITEM_CLASS_DICT A,
                his.OUTP_BILL_ITEMS      B,
                his.OUTP_ORDER_DESC      C
           WHERE B.RCPT_NO = C.RCPT_NO
             AND A.CLASS_CODE = B.CLASS_ON_RECKONING
             AND B.VISIT_NO = C.VISIT_NO
             AND B.VISIT_DATE = C.VISIT_DATE
           GROUP BY C.ORDERED_BY_DEPT,A.CLASS_NAME,to_char(B.VISIT_DATE,'yyyy-mm')
         ) E,
            his.RECK_ITEM_CLASS_DICT F
         WHERE F.CLASS_NAME = E.SUBJ_NAME(+)
           AND F.CLASS_CODE <> '024'

         UNION ALL

         SELECT to_char(A.VISIT_DATE,'yyyy-mm'),
                A.VISIT_DEPT,
                '挂号费' AS SUBJ_NAME,
                SUM(A.CLINIC_CHARGE)
         FROM his.CLINIC_MASTER A
         GROUP BY A.VISIT_DEPT,to_char(A.VISIT_DATE,'yyyy-mm')

         UNION ALL


         SELECT to_char(B.RETURNED_DATE,'yyyy-mm'),
                a.VISIT_DEPT,
                '挂号费' AS SUBJ_NAME,
                -SUM(B.CLINIC_CHARGE)
         FROM his.CLINIC_MASTER A,his.CLINIC_RETURNED_ACCT B
         WHERE A.VISIT_DATE = B.VISIT_DATE
           AND A.VISIT_NO = B.VISIT_NO
           AND A.CLINIC_LABEL = B.CLINIC_LABEL
           AND A.VISIT_TIME_DESC = B.TIME_DESC
         GROUP BY a.VISIT_DEPT,to_char(B.RETURNED_DATE,'yyyy-mm')
    ) a1
    left join ods.HIS_VS_COSTACCOUNTING A
    on a1.ordered_by_dept=A.科室代码
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    时间,
    核算科目,
    科室代码,
    科室名称,
    科室费用,
    成本核算编码,
    成本核算单元名称,
    核算费用
FROM base_data

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "TJ"."TJ_GNJCZB" ("YLJGDM", "BGLSH", "FKBGLSH", "TJLSH", "KSBM", "KSMC", "JCZHDM", "JCZHMC", "XJ", "JCYSGH", "JCYSXM", "BGRQ", "BGYSGH", "BGYSXM", "MJ", "TBRQ", "XGRQ", "XGBZ") AS 
  SELECT 
    'YLV21051' AS YLJGDM,
    a.StudyID AS BGLSH,
    -- 在 Oracle 中字符串拼接使用 ||
    TO_CHAR(JCSFXMTOSFXM.ID) || JCSFXMTOSFXM.SFXMDM AS FKBGLSH,
    a.StudyID AS TJLSH,
    a.KSBM AS KSBM,
    KSBM.KSMC AS KSMC,
    JCSFXMTOSFXM.SFXMDM AS JCZHDM,
    JCSFXMTOSFXM.SFXMMC AS JCZHMC,
    a.JG AS XJ,
    YHXX.YHDM AS JCYSGH,
    a.Doctor AS JCYSXM,
    -- 在 Oracle 中使用 TO_CHAR 进行日期格式化
    TO_CHAR(a.StudyDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS BGRQ,
    YHXX.YHDM AS BGYSGH,
    a.Doctor AS BGYSXM,
    '0' AS MJ,
    TO_CHAR(a.StudyDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS TBRQ,
    TO_CHAR(a.StudyDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS XGRQ,
    '1' AS XGBZ
FROM 
    V_KSJL a
-- 左连接 KSBM 表
LEFT JOIN KSBM 
    ON a.KSBM = KSBM.KSBM
-- 左连接 JCSFXMTOSFXM 视图
LEFT JOIN JCSFXMTOSFXM 
    ON a.KSBM = JCSFXMTOSFXM.KSBM 
    AND a.StudyID = JCSFXMTOSFXM.ID 
    AND a.XXDM = JCSFXMTOSFXM.XXDM
-- 左连接 YHXX 表
LEFT JOIN YHXX 
    ON a.Doctor = YHXX.YHMC
WHERE 
    a.XXDM IN ('000001', '000003') 
    AND JCSFXMTOSFXM.SFXMDM IS NOT NULL 
    AND a.JG IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
-- 第二个 SELECT 语句部分
SELECT 
    'YLV21051' AS YLJGDM,
    JCSFXM.ID AS BGLSH,
    -- 在 Oracle 中字符串拼接使用 ||
    TO_CHAR(JCSFXM.ID) || JCSFXM.SFXMDM AS FKBGLSH,
    JCSFXM.ID AS TJLSH,
    'HY' AS KSBM,
    '化验室' AS KSMC,
    JCSFXM.SFXMDM AS JCZHDM,
    SFXM.SFXMMC AS JCZHMC,
    '详见报告' AS XJ,
    '-' AS JCYSGH,
    JCSFXM.JCYS AS JCYSXM,
    '-' AS BGRQ,
    '-' AS BGYSGH,
    JCSFXM.JCYS AS BGYSXM,
    '0' AS MJ,
    -- 在 Oracle 中使用 TO_CHAR 进行日期格式化
    TO_CHAR(JCSFXM.JCRQ, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS TBRQ,
    TO_CHAR(JCSFXM.JCRQ, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS XGRQ,
    '1' AS XGBZ
FROM 
    JCSFXM
-- 左连接 SFXM 表
LEFT JOIN SFXM 
    ON JCSFXM.SFXMDM = SFXM.SFXMDM 
WHERE 
    JCSFXM.SFBJ = '1' 
    AND JCSFXM.TFBJ = '0' 
    AND JCSFXM.JCYS IS NOT NULL 
    AND JCSFXM.JCRQ IS NOT NULL 
    AND SFXM.KSBM = 'HY'

V_ZYBR.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "MTL"."V_ZYBR" ("患者ID", "次数", "住院号", "患者姓名", "出生日期", "性别", "入院日期", "BED_NO", "入院诊断", "入院病情", "管床医生", "门诊医师", "护理级别", "所在科室编码", "所在科室名称") AS 
  select a.patient_id 患者ID,a.visit_id 次数,c.INP_NO 住院号,c.name 患者姓名,c.date_of_birth 出生日期,c.sex 性别,a.admission_date_time 入院日期,a.bed_no,a.diagnosis 入院诊断,
case PATIENT_CONDITION when '1' then '病危' when '2' then '病重' when '3' then '普通' else null end 入院病情 ,d.DOCTOR_IN_CHARGE 管床医生,d.CONSULTING_DOCTOR 门诊医师，
  case  NURSING_CLASS    when '0' then '特级护理'  when '1' then '一级护理' when '2' then '二级护理'  when '3' then '三级护理' else null end 护理级别 ,  b.DEPT_CODE 所在科室编码, b.DEPT_NAME 所在科室名称
        from his.pats_in_hospital a left join his.dept_dict b on a.dept_code=b.dept_code
inner join his.pat_master_index c on c.patient_id=a.patient_id
inner join his.pat_visit d on d.patient_id=a.patient_id and d.visit_id=a.visit_id

FANCY_STAFF_SCHEDUL_1.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "PORTAL"."FANCY_STAFF_SCHEDUL_1" ("LEADER_NAME", "DEPT_CODE", "COMPARE_DEPT_CODE", "STAFF_CODE", "SCHED_DATE", "SCHED_NAME") AS 
  select a1.LEADER_NAME as LEADER_NAME,
       a1.his_dept_code as dept_code,
       dw.dept_code as COMPARE_DEPT_CODE,
       a1.STAFF_CODE as STAFF_CODE,
       substr(a1.SCHED_DATE,1,10) as SCHED_DATE,
       a1.SCHED_NAME as SCHED_NAME
from
(
select a.*,
      case when dd.dept_code is null then
        (select d.dept_code from his.staff_dict s,his.dept_dict d where s.dept_code =d.dept_code and a.STAFF_CODE=s.emp_no)
        else dd.dept_code end as his_dept_code,
       case when dd.dept_name is null then
        (select d.dept_name from his.staff_dict s,his.dept_dict d where s.dept_code =d.dept_code and a.STAFF_CODE=s.emp_no)
        else dd.dept_name end as his_dept_name
from PORTAL.fancy_staff_schedul a
left join his.dept_dict dd
on a.UNITNAME =dd.dept_name
) a1
left join his.dept_vs_ward dw
on a1.his_dept_code =dw.WARD_CODE

union all

select aa.leader_name,
       aa.dept_code,
       '' as COMPARE_DEPT_CODE,
       aa.staff_code,
       aa.sched_date,
       decode(aa.admini_value,'Y','考勤','N','休息') as sched_name

  from PORTAL.fancy_staff_schedul_2 aa

CDR_OUTPATIENT_VISIT.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "FXJCPT"."CDR_OUTPATIENT_VISIT" ("ID", "PATIENT_ID", "OUT_PATIENT_ID", "HEALTH_CARD_NO", "OUTP_NO", "VISIT_ID", "VISIT_TYPE_CODE", "VISIT_TYPE_NAME", "EMERGENCY_VISIT_IND", "PERSON_NAME", "CHARGE_TYPE_CODE", "CHARGE_TYPE_NAME", "DATE_OF_BIRTH", "ID_CARD_NO", "SEX_CODE", "SEX_NAME", "MARITAL_STATUS_CODE", "MARITAL_STATUS_NAME", "OCCUPATION_CODE", "OCCUPATION_NAME", "PHONE_NUMBER", "MAILING_ADDRESS", "VISIT_DEPT_CODE", "VISIT_DEPT_NAME", "VISIT_DOCTOR_CODE", "VISIT_DOCTOR_NAME", "REG_CATEGORY_CODE", "REG_CATEGORY_NAME", "REG_TYPE_CODE", "REG_TYPE_NAME", "REG_VISIT_SECTION_CODE", "REG_VISIT_SECTION_NAME", "REGISTER_BY_CODE", "REGISTER_BY_NAME", "REGISTING_TIME", "REGISTER_CANCEL_BY_CODE", "REGISTER_CANCEL_BYNAME", "REGISTER_CANCEL_TIME", "SEPARATE_TIME", "SEPARATE_OPER_CODE", "SEPARATE_OPER_NAME", "SEPARATE_NO", "FIRSTV_INDICATOR", "VISIT_TIME", "VISIT_CONSALT_ROOM") AS 
  select distinct
       a.patient_id||'|'||a.clinic_no as id ,
       a.patient_id as patient_id,
       a.patient_id as OUT_PATIENT_ID,--门诊患者标识
       '' as HEALTH_CARD_NO,--健康卡号
       '' as OUTP_NO,--门诊号
       a.clinic_no as  visit_id,--就诊流水号
       '01' as VISIT_TYPE_CODE,--就诊类型编码
       '门诊' as VISIT_TYPE_NAME,--就诊类型名称
       case when a.CLINIC_TYPE like'%急诊%' then 'true'
         else 'false' end as EMERGENCY_VISIT_IND,--急诊就诊标识
       a.name as PERSON_NAME,--姓名
       a.Charge_Type as CHARGE_TYPE_CODE,--费别编码
       a.Charge_Type as CHARGE_TYPE_NAME,--费别名称
       to_char(b.date_of_birth,'YYYY-MM-DD') as DATE_OF_BIRTH,--出生日期
       b.id_no as ID_CARD_NO,--证件号
       b.sex as SEX_CODE,--性别编码
       b.sex as SEX_NAME,--性别名称
       case when b.MARITAL_STATUS='未婚' then '1'
  when b.MARITAL_STATUS='已婚' then '2'
    when b.MARITAL_STATUS='丧偶' then '3'
      when b.MARITAL_STATUS='离婚' then '4'
        when b.MARITAL_STATUS='其他' then '5'
          else b.MARITAL_STATUS end as MARITAL_STATUS_CODE,--婚姻状态编码
       b.MARITAL_STATUS as MARITAL_STATUS_NAME,--婚姻状态名称
       b.Occupation as  OCCUPATION_CODE,--职业编码
       '' as OCCUPATION_NAME,--职业名称
       --(select od.occupation_name from his.occupation_dict od where od.occupation_code = replace(b.Occupation,' ','')) as OCCUPATION_NAME,--职业名称
       b.Next_Of_Kin_Phone as PHONE_NUMBER,--电话
       b.Patient_Area_Address as MAILING_ADDRESS,--联系详细地址
       a.Visit_Dept as VISIT_DEPT_CODE，--就诊科室编码
       (select t.dept_name from his.dept_dict t where a.Visit_Dept=t.dept_code) as VISIT_DEPT_NAME，--就诊科室名称
       a.Doctor as VISIT_DOCTOR_CODE,--就诊医生工号
       (select t1.name from his.staff_dict t1 where a.doctor=t1.user_name) as VISIT_DOCTOR_NAME,--就诊医生名称
       a.Clinic_Label as REG_CATEGORY_CODE,--号别编码
       a.Clinic_Label as REG_CATEGORY_NAME,--号别名称
       a.Clinic_Type as REG_TYPE_CODE,--号类编码
       a.Clinic_Type as REG_TYPE_NAME,--号类名称
       a.Visit_Time_Desc as REG_VISIT_SECTION_CODE,--出诊时段编码
       a.Visit_Time_Desc as REG_VISIT_SECTION_NAME,--出诊时段名称
       a.operator as REGISTER_BY_CODE,--挂号员工号
       (select t1.name from his.staff_dict t1 where a.operator=t1.id) as REGISTER_BY_NAME,--挂号员名称
       a.registering_date as REGISTING_TIME,--挂号时间
       a.returned_operator  REGISTER_CANCEL_BY_CODE,  --退号操作职工工号
       (select name from his.staff_dict where id = a.returned_operator) as REGISTER_CANCEL_BYNAME,  --退号操作职工姓名
       a.returned_date as REGISTER_CANCEL_TIME,--退号时间
       '' AS SEPARATE_TIME,--分诊时间
       '' as SEPARATE_OPER_CODE,--分诊操作员工号
       '' as SEPARATE_OPER_NAME,--分诊操作员名称
       '' as SEPARATE_NO,--分诊序号
       case when a.First_Visit_Indicator='1' then 'true'
         else 'false' end as firstv_indicator,--初诊标志
       a.REGISTERING_DATE as VISIT_TIME,--就诊时间
      (select t.dept_name from his.dept_dict t where a.visit_dept=t.dept_code) as VISIT_CONSALT_ROOM --就诊诊室
from his.clinic_master a,his.pat_master_index b
where a.patient_id=b.patient_id

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "BL"."PATHOLOGICAL_EXAM_RECORD" ("PATIENT_ID", "VISIT_SN", "VISIT_TYPE", "VISIT_CARD_NO", "OUTPATIENT_NO", "VISIT_TIMES", "MEDICAL_RECORD_NO", "INPATIENT_NO", "HOSPITALIZATION_TIMES", "NAME", "GENDER", "AGE", "DATE_OF_BIRTH", "APPLY_NO", "ORDER_SN", "APPLY_DATETIME", "PATHOLOGY_NO", "PATHOLOGY_SN", "EXAM_DATETIME", "PATHOLOGY_TEST_TYPE_CODE", "PATHOLOGY_TEST_TYPE", "SPECIMEN_SITE", "SPECIMEN_OBTAIN_METHOD", "SPECIMEN_TYPE", "SPECIMEN_CODE", "COLLECTED_DATETIME", "RECEIVED_DATETIME", "REPORT_NO", "REPORT_DATETIME", "STAGING_VERSION", "CLINICAL_STAGE", "PATHO_T_STAGING", "PATHO_N_STAGING", "PATHO_M_STAGING", "GROSS_DESCRIPTION", "MICRO_DESCRIPTION", "PATHO_DIAG_CONCLUSION", "IHC_RESULTS", "MOL_TEST_MARK", "MOL_TEST_GENE_AND_METHOD", "MOL_TEST_RESULT", "DIFFERENTIATION_DEGREE", "BLOOD_VESSEL_INFIL", "LYMPH_INFILT", "LYMPH_MET", "VASC_TUMOUR_THROMBUS", "NERVE_INVASION", "EXTEND_DATA1", "EXTEND_DATA2", "RECORD_STATUS", "INTRAOPERATIVE_FREEZING_RESULT", "RECORDER1", "RECORDER2") AS 
  SELECT DISTINCT
  a.PatientID AS patient_id,
  CAST( a.PathologyID AS VARCHAR2 ( 20 ) ) || '|' || CAST( a.PatientID AS VARCHAR2 ( 20 ) ) AS visit_sn,
CASE
    WHEN A.InPatientID IS NULL THEN
    '门诊'
    WHEN A.InPatientID IS NOT NULL THEN
    '住院' ELSE '其他'
  END visit_type,
  '' AS visit_card_no,
  a.outPatientID AS outpatient_no,
  '' AS visit_times,
  '' AS medical_record_no,
  InPatientID AS inpatient_no,
  a.HospitalizationTime AS hospitalization_times,
  a.PatientName AS NAME,
  a.PatientSex AS gender,
  a.PatientAge AS age,
  TO_CHAR ( a.Birthday, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) AS date_of_birth,
  a.ReqNoteID AS apply_no,
  a.hisid AS order_sn,
  TO_CHAR ( a.SubmitCheckTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) AS apply_datetime,
  a.PathologyID AS pathology_no,
  a.PathologyID AS pathology_sn,
  TO_CHAR ( a.ReportTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) AS exam_datetime,
  a.MedicalRecordDB AS pathology_test_type_code,
CASE
    WHEN a.MedicalRecordDB = '1' THEN
    '常规'
    WHEN a.MedicalRecordDB IN ( '19', '20' ) THEN
    '细胞'
    WHEN a.MedicalRecordDB = '22' THEN
    'HPV' ELSE '其他'
  END AS pathology_test_type,
  a.bbmc AS specimen_site,
  '' AS specimen_obtain_method,
  a.bblx AS specimen_type,
  '' AS specimen_code,
  '' AS collected_datetime,
  TO_CHAR ( A.SpecRecvTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) AS received_datetime,
  a.PathologyID AS report_no,
  TO_CHAR ( a.VerifyReportTime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) AS report_datetime,
  '' AS staging_version,
  '' AS clinical_stage,
  '' AS patho_t_staging,
  '' AS patho_n_staging,
  '' AS patho_m_staging,
  a.rysj AS gross_description,
  a.gjsj AS micro_description,
  a.zdyj AS patho_diag_conclusion,
  '' AS IHC_results,
CASE
    WHEN a.MedicalRecordDB IN ( '22', '9998', '9999' ) THEN
    '有' ELSE '无'
  END AS mol_test_mark,
CASE
    WHEN a.MedicalRecordDB = '22' THEN
    'HPV检测'
    WHEN a.MedicalRecordDB = '9998' THEN
    '药物基因检测'
    WHEN a.MedicalRecordDB = '9999' THEN
    'RNA检测' ELSE '无'
  END AS mol_test_gene_and_method,
  a.zdyj AS mol_test_result,
  '' AS differentiation_degree,
  '' AS blood_vessel_infil,
  '' AS lymph_infilt,
  '' AS lymph_met,
  '' AS vasc_tumour_thrombus,
  '' AS nerve_invasion,
  '' AS extend_data1,
  '' AS extend_data2,
CASE
    WHEN a.STATUS = '128' THEN
    '1'
    WHEN a.STATUS = '256' THEN
    '1'
    WHEN a.STATUS = '512' THEN
    '1'
  END AS record_status,
  ( SELECT ExamineResult FROM Pitaya_FrozenReport WHERE PathologyID = a.PathologyID AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS intraoperative_freezing_result,
  a.shys AS recorder1,
  a.shys AS recorder2
FROM
  Pitaya a
  LEFT JOIN Pitaya_DBType b ON a.MedicalRecordDB = b.MedicalRecordDB
  LEFT JOIN Pitaya_Advice c ON c.PathologyID = a.PathologyID
WHERE
  a.STATUS >= 128

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "YDHL"."V_HLJL" ("患者ID", "患者UID", "床号", "FORM_ID", "护理记录时间", "记录人", "护理记录表单单创建时间", "TEMPLATE_CODE", "护理单类型", "姓名", "性别", "年龄", "科室", "床号_填写", "住院号", "诊断", "入院日期", "体温", "心率脉搏", "呼吸", "血压", "血氧饱和度", "血糖", "意识神志", "氧疗_鼻导管", "氧疗_面罩", "氧疗_其他名称", "氧疗_其他量", "入量_名称", "入量_途径", "入量_量", "入量_量2", "出量_名称", "出量_量", "出量_颜色", "出量_性状", "尿量", "呕吐", "刀口情况", "管道护理", "皮肤情况", "皮肤护理", "高危风险", "病情观察及护理措施", "护士签名", "审核者签名") AS 
  WITH
-- ① 先筛选在院患者（小结果集），避免 INPATIENTS 全表扫描
active_pat AS (
    SELECT /*+ INDEX(d) */
        d.pat_index_no,
        d.patient_id
    FROM ydhl.inpatients d
    WHERE --d.status    = 'in'
  --  and
     d.dept_code not  in ('030210','030224','030603','030611','0306','040711','040712','040705')

),

-- ② 先筛选有效表单（走 FORM_TIME 索引），减少后续 JOIN 行数
valid_form AS (
    SELECT /*+ INDEX(a IX_DOC_FORM_UID_TIME) */
        a.id          AS form_id,
        a.patient_uid,
        a.bed_no,
        a.form_time,
        a.created_name,
        a.created_date
    FROM ydhl.mcs_doc_form a
    WHERE a.form_time >= TO_DATE('2026-03-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd') and
       a.is_valid   = '1'
),

-- ③ 把递归层次查询预先物化，避免在 JOIN 内部反复执行 CONNECT BY
node_tree AS (
    SELECT
        t.template_code,
        t.code,
        t.parent_code,
        t.seq,
        NVL(t.display_name, t.name)  AS display_name,
        LEVEL                        AS node_level,
        CONNECT_BY_ISLEAF            AS is_leaf
    FROM ydhl.mcs_doc_nodes t
    WHERE t.template_code IN ('572','709')
    START WITH
        t.parent_code IS NULL
        AND t.template_code IN ('572','709')
    CONNECT BY
        PRIOR t.code  = t.parent_code
        AND t.template_code IN ('572','709')
),

-- 709 S RY-病重（病危）患者护理记录

-- ④ 核心明细：先 JOIN 小表再关联记录表
base AS (
    SELECT
        p.patient_id                AS 患者ID,
        f.patient_uid               AS 患者UID,
        f.bed_no                    AS 床号,
        f.form_time                 AS 护理记录表单单创建时间,
        f.created_name              AS 记录人,
        f.created_date              AS 护理记录时间,
        f.form_id                   AS FORM_ID,
        n.template_code,
        n.code,
        n.parent_code,
        n.seq,
        n.node_level,
        n.is_leaf,
        n.display_name,
        c.number_value,
        CASE
            WHEN c.string_value IS NOT NULL
                THEN c.string_value
            WHEN c.number_value = 1 AND n.is_leaf = 1
                THEN n.display_name
            WHEN c.number_value IS NOT NULL
                THEN TRIM(TO_CHAR(c.number_value, 'FM99999999990.099'))
        END                         AS value,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY f.form_id, n.code
            ORDER BY n.node_level
        )                           AS rn
    FROM active_pat p
    INNER JOIN valid_form f
        ON p.pat_index_no = f.patient_uid
    INNER JOIN ydhl.mcs_doc_form_records c
        ON  c.form_id = f.form_id
        AND (c.string_value IS NOT NULL OR c.number_value IS NOT NULL)
    INNER JOIN node_tree n
        ON  n.template_code = c.template_code
        AND n.code          = c.node_code
)
SELECT
    base.患者ID,
    base.患者UID,
    base.床号,
    base.FORM_ID,
    base.护理记录时间,
    base.记录人,
    base.护理记录表单单创建时间,
    base.template_code                                          AS TEMPLATE_CODE,
    CASE base.template_code
        WHEN '572' THEN '一般患者护理记录单'
        WHEN '709' THEN '病重（病危）患者护理记录'
        ELSE '其他'
    END                                                         AS 护理单类型,

    -- ① 基本信息
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.code='00021' THEN base.value END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00002' THEN base.value END)
    ) AS 姓名,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.code='00022' THEN base.value END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00003' THEN base.value END)
    ) AS 性别,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.code='00023' THEN base.value END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00004' THEN base.value END)
    ) AS 年龄,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.code='00018' THEN base.value END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00005' THEN base.value END)
    ) AS 科室,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.code='00019' THEN base.value END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00006' THEN base.value END)
    ) AS 床号_填写,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.code='00020' THEN base.value END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00007' THEN base.value END)
    ) AS 住院号,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.code='00024' THEN base.value END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00009' THEN base.value END)
    ) AS 诊断,
    MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00140' THEN base.value END)
      AS 入院日期,

    -- ② 生命体征
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.code='00172' THEN base.value END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00022' THEN base.value END)
    ) AS 体温,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.code='00174' THEN base.value END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00023' THEN base.value END)
    ) AS 心率脉搏,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.code='00122' THEN base.value END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00024' THEN base.value END)
    ) AS 呼吸,
    COALESCE(
        CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' THEN
            MAX(CASE WHEN base.code='00117' THEN base.value END)
            || CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN base.code='00117' THEN base.value END) IS NOT NULL
                    AND  MAX(CASE WHEN base.code='00119' THEN base.value END) IS NOT NULL
                    THEN ' / ' END
            || MAX(CASE WHEN base.code='00119' THEN base.value END)
        END,
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00028' THEN base.value END)
    ) AS 血压,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.code='00120' THEN base.value END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00029' THEN base.value END)
    ) AS 血氧饱和度,
    MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00172' THEN base.value END)
      AS 血糖,

    -- ③ 意识/神志
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.parent_code='00038' AND base.number_value=1
                 THEN base.display_name END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00142' THEN base.value END)
    ) AS 意识神志,

    -- ④ 氧疗
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.code='00133' THEN base.value END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00143' THEN base.value END)
    ) AS 氧疗_鼻导管,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.code='00134' THEN base.value END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00144' THEN base.value END)
    ) AS 氧疗_面罩,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.code='00132' THEN base.value END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00145' THEN base.value END)
    ) AS 氧疗_其他名称,
    MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00161' THEN base.value END)
      AS 氧疗_其他量,

    -- ⑤ 入量
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.code='00084' THEN base.value END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00148' THEN base.value END)
    ) AS 入量_名称,
    MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00171' THEN base.value END)
      AS 入量_途径,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.code='00085' THEN base.value END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00149' THEN base.value END)
    ) AS 入量_量,
    MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.code='00086' THEN base.value END)
      AS 入量_量2,

    -- ⑥ 出量
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.code='00088' THEN base.value END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00150' THEN base.value END)
    ) AS 出量_名称,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.code='00089' THEN base.value END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00151' THEN base.value END)
    ) AS 出量_量,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.code='00090' THEN base.value END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00152' THEN base.value END)
    ) AS 出量_颜色,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.code='00091' THEN base.value END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00166' THEN base.value END)
    ) AS 出量_性状,
    MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.code='00162' THEN base.value END)
      AS 尿量,
    MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.code='00164' THEN base.value END)
      AS 呕吐,

    -- ⑦ 刀口情况
    LISTAGG(
        CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.parent_code='00143'
             AND base.number_value=1 AND base.rn=1
             THEN base.display_name END
    , '，') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY base.seq) AS 刀口情况,

    -- ⑧ 管道护理
    MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.code='00148' THEN base.value END)
      AS 管道护理,

    -- ⑨ 皮肤情况
    LISTAGG(
        CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.parent_code='00149'
             AND base.number_value=1 AND base.rn=1
             THEN base.display_name END
    , '，') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY base.seq) AS 皮肤情况,

    -- ⑩ 皮肤护理
    LISTAGG(
        CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.parent_code='00155'
             AND base.number_value=1 AND base.rn=1
             THEN base.display_name END
    , '，') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY base.seq) AS 皮肤护理,

    -- ? 高危风险
    LISTAGG(
        CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.parent_code='00073'
             AND base.number_value=1 AND base.rn=1
             THEN base.display_name END
    , '，') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY base.seq) AS 高危风险,

    -- ? 病情观察及护理措施
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.code='00093' THEN base.value END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00153' THEN base.value END)
    ) AS 病情观察及护理措施,

    -- ? 护士签名
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.code='00094' THEN base.value END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00062' THEN base.value END)
    ) AS 护士签名,

    -- ? 审核者签名
    MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00169' THEN base.value END)
      AS 审核者签名

FROM base
WHERE base.rn = 1
GROUP BY
    base.患者ID, base.患者UID, base.床号, base.FORM_ID,
    base.护理记录表单单创建时间, base.记录人, base.护理记录时间 , base.template_code
    HAVING COALESCE(
           MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='572' AND base.code='00093' THEN base.value END),
           MAX(CASE WHEN base.template_code='709' AND base.code='00153' THEN base.value END)
       ) IS NOT NULL

FXJCPT_BASY.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ZNT"."FXJCPT_BASY" ("PATIENT_ID", "VISIT_ID", "INP_NO", "NAME", "SEX", "BIRTHDAY", "AGE", "ADMISSION_DATE", "DISCHARGE_DATE", "MAIN_DIAG", "OTHER_DIAG") AS 
  select pv.patient_id as patient_id, --住院号
       pv.visit_id as visit_id , --住院次
       pmi.inp_no as inp_no,
       pmi.name as name,--姓名
       pmi.sex as sex, --性别
       pmi.date_of_birth as birthday, --出生日期
       TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, pmi.date_of_birth) / 12) as age, --年龄
       pv.admission_date_time as admission_date, --入院日期
       pv.discharge_date_time as discharge_date, --出院日期
       (select hd.diagnosis_desc from his.diagnosis hd where hd.patient_id = pv.patient_id and hd.visit_id = pv.visit_id and hd.diagnosis_type = 1)as main_diag, --主要诊断
       (select hd.diagnosis_desc from his.diagnosis hd where hd.patient_id = pv.patient_id and hd.visit_id = pv.visit_id and hd.diagnosis_type =3 and hd.diagnosis_no =1) as other_diag --其他诊断
  from his.pat_visit pv
  left join his.pat_master_index pmi
    on pv.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
  where pv.dept_admission_to in ('030327','030326','030325','030315','030316','030317','021738','021729','021740','021741','021743','021746',
                                 '030122','030124','030125','030112','030113','040506','040507','040509','040510','040519','030225','030227','030228','030219','030222','030425','030210')

CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ZNT"."FXJCPT_CSJCBG" ("PATIENT_ID", "VISIT_ID", "INP_NO", "INSPECTION_SITE", "EXAM_DATE", "EXAM_REPORT_RESULT", "EXAM_RESULT_PROMPT") AS 
  select pv.patient_id as patient_id, --住院号
       pv.visit_id   as visit_id, --住院次
       pmi.inp_no as inp_no,
       a.exam_sub_class as Inspection_site,--检查部位
       a.exam_date_time as exam_date , --检查日期
       nvl(to_char(pr."ReportDiagnose"), '-') EXAM_REPORT_RESULT, -- 检查报告结果-客观所见
       nvl(to_char(pr."ReportResult"), '-') EXAM_RESULT_PROMPT -- 检查报告结果-主观提示
  from his.exam_master a
  left join pacs.examinfo pe
    on a.exam_no = pe."ExamItemHISID"
   and pe."ExamSatus" = '6'
  left join pacs.report pr
    on pr."ReportID" = pe."ExamID"
  left join his.pat_visit pv
    on a.patient_id = pv.patient_id and a.VISIT_ID = pv.VISIT_ID
  left join his.pat_master_index pmi
    on a.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
 WHERE A.EXAM_CLASS IN ('B超', '妇产超声')
 and a.req_dept in ('030327','030326','030325','030315','030316','030317','021738','021729','021740','021741','021743','021746',
                                 '030122','030124','030125','030112','030113','040506','040507','040509','040510','040519','030225','030227','030228','030219','030222','030425','030210')
 and a.visit_id >0

FXJCPT_CYJL.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ZNT"."FXJCPT_CYJL" ("PATIENT_ID", "VISIT_ID", "INP_NO", "ADMISSION_STA", "DISCHARGE_STA", "DISCHARGE_DIAG", "DISCHARGE_ORDER", "DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME") AS 
  select a.patient_id as patient_id ,--住院号
       a.visit_id as visit_id , --住院次
       pmi.inp_no as inp_no,
       --(select d.dg_plain_content_blob from JHEMR.Jhmr_File_Content_Dg d where d.dg_code = 'S.21' and d.patient_id = a.patient_id and d.visit_id = a.visit_id) as admission_sta, --入院情况
       --(select d.dg_plain_content_blob from JHEMR.Jhmr_File_Content_Dg d where d.dg_code = 'S.12.003' and d.patient_id = a.patient_id and d.visit_id = a.visit_id) as Discharge_sta, --出院情况
       --(select d.dg_plain_content_blob from JHEMR.Jhmr_File_Content_Dg d where d.dg_code = 'S.112' and d.patient_id = a.patient_id and d.visit_id = a.visit_id) as Discharge_diag,--出院诊断
       --(select d.dg_plain_content_blob from JHEMR.Jhmr_File_Content_Dg d where d.dg_code = 'S.12.002' and d.patient_id = a.patient_id and d.visit_id = a.visit_id)as discharge_order --出院医嘱
        d21.dg_plain_content_blob as admission_sta, --入院情况
        d12003.dg_plain_content_blob as Discharge_sta, --出院情况
        d112.dg_plain_content_blob as Discharge_diag, --出院诊断
        d12002.dg_plain_content_blob as discharge_order, --出院诊断
        b.discharge_date_time as discharge_date_time   --出院时间
        from JHEMR.Jhmr_File_Index a
        join his.pat_visit b on a.patient_id=b.patient_id and a.visit_id =b.visit_id
        left join his.pat_master_index pmi on a.patient_id=pmi.patient_id
        left join jhemr.jhmr_file_content_dg d21 on d21.patient_id = a.patient_id and d21.visit_id = a.visit_id and d21.dg_code = 'S.21'
        left join jhemr.jhmr_file_content_dg d12003 on d12003.patient_id = a.patient_id and d12003.visit_id = a.visit_id and d12003.dg_code = 'S.12.003'
        left join jhemr.jhmr_file_content_dg d112 on d112.patient_id = a.patient_id and d112.visit_id = a.visit_id and d112.dg_code = 'S.112'
        left join jhemr.jhmr_file_content_dg d12002 on d12002.patient_id = a.patient_id and d12002.visit_id = a.visit_id and d12002.dg_code = 'S.12.002'

        where  a.topic like '%出院记录%'
        and a.patient_cur_dept_code in ('030327','030326','030325','030315','030316','030317','021738','021729','021740','021741','021743','021746',
                                 '030122','030124','030125','030112','030113','040506','040507','040509','040510','040519','030225','030227','030228','030219','030222','030425','030210')

FXJCPT_JCBG.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ZNT"."FXJCPT_JCBG" ("PATIENT_ID", "VISIT_ID", "INP_NO", "EXAMITEM", "EXAMDATE", "DIAG", "EXAM_REPORT_RESULT", "EXAM_RESULT_PROMPT") AS 
  select pv.patient_id as patient_id, --住院号
       pv.visit_id as visit_id, --住院次
       pmi.inp_no as inp_no,
       a.exam_class as examItem, --检查项目
       a.exam_date_time as examDate, --检查日期
       nvl(a.phys_sign, '-') as diag, --诊断意见
       nvl(to_char(pr."ReportDiagnose"), '-') EXAM_REPORT_RESULT, -- 检查报告结果-客观所见
       nvl(to_char(pr."ReportResult"), '-') EXAM_RESULT_PROMPT -- 检查报告结果-主观提示
  from his.EXAM_MASTER a
  join pacs.examinfo pe
    on a.exam_no = pe."ExamItemHISID" and pe."ExamSatus" = '6'
  join pacs.report pr on pr."ReportID" = pe."ExamID"
  join his.pat_visit pv on a.patient_id = pv.patient_id and a.visit_id = pv.visit_id
  left join his.pat_master_index pmi on a.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
  where a.req_dept in ('030327','030326','030325','030315','030316','030317','021738','021729','021740','021741','021743','021746',
                      '030122','030124','030125','030112','030113','040506','040507','040509','040510','040519','030225','030227','030228','030219','030222','030425','030210')
  and a.visit_id>0

  union all

 select pv.patient_id as patient_id, --住院号
       pv.visit_id   as visit_id, --住院次
       pmi.inp_no as inp_no,
       a.exam_sub_class as Inspection_site,--检查部位
       a.exam_date_time as exam_date , --检查日期
       nvl(a.phys_sign, '-') as diag, --诊断意见
       nvl(to_char(BHO."OPSDesc"), '-') EXAM_REPORT_RESULT, -- 检查报告结果-客观所见
       nvl(to_char(BHO."OPSDiagnose"), '-') EXAM_RESULT_PROMPT -- 检查报告结果-主观提示
  from his.exam_master a
  join cs.BHosCheckUS BHO on a.exam_no = BHO.HISID1
  join his.pat_visit pv on a.patient_id = pv.patient_id and a.VISIT_ID = pv.VISIT_ID
  join his.pat_master_index pmi on a.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
 WHERE a.req_dept in ('030327','030326','030325','030315','030316','030317','021738','021729','021740','021741','021743','021746',
                                 '030122','030124','030125','030112','030113','040506','040507','040509','040510','040519','030225','030227','030228','030219','030222','030425','030210')
 and a.visit_id >0

 union all

select pv.patient_id as patient_id, --住院号
       pv.visit_id   as visit_id, --住院次
       pmi.inp_no as inp_no,
       a.exam_sub_class as Inspection_site,--检查部位
       a.exam_date_time as exam_date , --检查日期
       nvl(a.phys_sign, '-') as diag, --诊断意见
       nvl(to_char(BHO."OPSDesc"), '-') EXAM_REPORT_RESULT, -- 检查报告结果-客观所见
       nvl(to_char(BHO."OPSDiagnose"), '-') EXAM_RESULT_PROMPT -- 检查报告结果-主观提示
  from his.exam_master a
  join nj.BHosCheckES BHO on a.exam_no = BHO.HISID1
  join his.pat_visit pv on a.patient_id = pv.patient_id and a.VISIT_ID = pv.VISIT_ID
  join his.pat_master_index pmi on a.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
 WHERE a.req_dept in ('030327','030326','030325','030315','030316','030317','021738','021729','021740','021741','021743','021746',
                                 '030122','030124','030125','030112','030113','040506','040507','040509','040510','040519','030225','030227','030228','030219','030222','030425','030210')
 and a.visit_id >0

FXJCPT_JYBG.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ZNT"."FXJCPT_JYBG" ("PATIENT_ID", "VISIT_ID", "INP_NO", "TESTNO", "SPECIMEN_TYPE", "TESTTIME", "RESULTTIME", "ITEMCODE", "ITEMNAME", "ITEMRESULT", "ITEMUNITS", "REFER") AS 
  select pv.patient_id as patient_Id, --住院号
       pv.visit_id as visit_id, --住院次
       pmi.inp_no as inp_no,
       ltm.test_no as testNo, --检验单号
       ltm.specimen as specimen_type, --标本类型
       ltm.execute_date as TestTime, --检验日期
       ltm.results_rpt_date_time as resultTime, --报告日期
       lR.REPORT_ITEM_CODE as itemCode, --检验项目代码
       lR.REPORT_ITEM_NAME as itemName, --检验项目名称
       lr.result as itemResult, --结果
       lr.units as itemUnits, --单位
       lr.print_context as refer --参考范围
  from his.lab_test_master ltm
  left join his.pat_visit pv
    on ltm.patient_id = pv.patient_id and ltm.visit_id = pv.visit_id
  left join his.pat_master_index pmi
    on ltm.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
  --left join his.lab_test_items_detail ltid
    --on ltm.test_no = ltid.test_no
  left join his.lab_result lr
    on lr.test_no = ltm.test_no
  left join his.lab_test_items lti
    on lti.test_no = ltm.test_no
 where ltm.ordering_dept in ('030327','030326','030325','030315','030316','030317','021738','021729','021740','021741','021743','021746',
                                 '030122','030124','030125','030112','030113','040506','040507','040509','040510','040519','030225','030227','030228','030219','030222','030425','030210')
  and ltm.visit_id >0

FXJCPT_RYJL.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ZNT"."FXJCPT_RYJL" ("PATIENT_ID", "VISIT_ID", "INP_NO", "CHIEF_COMPLAINT", "PHYSICAL_EXAMINATION", "PRESENT_ILLNESS", "PAST_HISTORY", "PERSONAL_HISTORY", "MARRIAGE_PREGNANCY_HISTORY", "AUXILIARY_CHECKLIST", "ADMISSION_DIAG", "DEPT_CODE") AS 
  select jfi.patient_id,
       jfi.visit_id,
       pmi.inp_no,
       d1.dg_plain_content_blob as chief_complaint, --主诉
       d2.dg_plain_content_blob as physical_examination,-- 体检
       d3.dg_plain_content_blob as Present_illness, --现病史
       d4.dg_plain_content_blob as past_history, --既往史
       d4009.dg_plain_content_blob  as Personal_history,-- 个人史
       d4101.dg_plain_content_blob as Marriage_pregnancy_history, --婚孕史
       d5.dg_plain_content_blob as Auxiliary_checklist, --辅助检查表
       d111.dg_plain_content_blob as admission_diag,
       b.dept_admission_to as dept_code  --就诊科室
        from JHEMR.Jhmr_File_Index jfi
        join his.pat_visit b on jfi.patient_id=b.patient_id and jfi.visit_id =b.visit_id
       left join his.pat_master_index pmi on jfi.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
       left join JHEMR.Jhmr_File_Content_Dg d1 on d1.patient_id = jfi.patient_id and d1.visit_id = jfi.visit_id and d1.dg_code ='S.01'
       left join JHEMR.Jhmr_File_Content_Dg d2 on d2.patient_id = jfi.patient_id and d2.visit_id = jfi.visit_id  and d2.dg_code ='S.02'
       left join JHEMR.Jhmr_File_Content_Dg d3 on d3.patient_id = jfi.patient_id and d3.visit_id = jfi.visit_id  and d3.dg_code ='S.03'
       left join JHEMR.Jhmr_File_Content_Dg d4 on d4.patient_id = jfi.patient_id and d4.visit_id = jfi.visit_id  and d4.dg_code ='S.04'
       left join JHEMR.Jhmr_File_Content_Dg d4009 on d4009.patient_id = jfi.patient_id and d4009.visit_id = jfi.visit_id  and d4009.dg_code ='S.04.009'
       left join JHEMR.Jhmr_File_Content_Dg d4101 on d4101.patient_id = jfi.patient_id and d4101.visit_id = jfi.visit_id  and d4101.dg_code ='S.04.010'
       left join
       (select * from (
           (select rownum xh,a1.* from JHEMR.Jhmr_File_Content_Dg a1
            where a1.dg_code ='S.05' order by a1.CONTENT_DATE_TIME desc
            ))
       where rownum='1') d5
        on d5.patient_id = jfi.patient_id and d5.visit_id = jfi.visit_id  and d5.dg_code ='S.05'
       left join JHEMR.Jhmr_File_Content_Dg d111 on d111.patient_id = jfi.patient_id and d111.visit_id = jfi.visit_id  and d111.dg_code ='S.111'
       where  jfi.topic like '%入院记录%'
       and jfi.patient_cur_dept_code in ('030327','030326','030325','030315','030316','030317','021738','021729','021740','021741','021743','021746',
                                 '030122','030124','030125','030112','030113','040506','040507','040509','040510','040519','030225','030227','030228','030219','030222','030425','030210')

FXJCPT_SCBC.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ZNT"."FXJCPT_SCBC" ("PATIENT_ID", "VISIT_ID", "INP_NO", "COURSE_DISEASE_DATE", "COURSE_DISEASE_LOG") AS 
  select d.patient_id as patient_id, --住院号
       d.visit_id as visit_id, --住院次
       pmi.inp_no as inp_no,
       d.CAPTION_DATE_TIME as course_disease_date, --病程日期
       t.MR_CONTENT as course_disease_log --病程记录
from JHEMR.jhmr_file_index d
left join jhemr.JHMR_FILE_CONTENT_TEXT t on d.FILE_UNIQUE_ID=t.FILE_UNIQUE_ID
left join his.pat_master_index pmi on d.patient_id=pmi.patient_id

FXJCPT_YXJCBG.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ZNT"."FXJCPT_YXJCBG" ("PATIENT_ID", "VISIT_ID", "INP_NO", "EXAMITEM", "EXAMDATE", "DIAG", "EXAM_REPORT_RESULT", "EXAM_RESULT_PROMPT") AS 
  select pv.patient_id as patient_id, --住院号
       pv.visit_id as visit_id, --住院次
       pmi.inp_no as inp_no,
       a.exam_class as examItem, --检查项目
       a.exam_date_time as examDate, --检查日期
       nvl(a.phys_sign, '-') as diag, --诊断意见
       nvl(to_char(pr."ReportDiagnose"), '-') EXAM_REPORT_RESULT, -- 检查报告结果-客观所见
       nvl(to_char(pr."ReportResult"), '-') EXAM_RESULT_PROMPT -- 检查报告结果-主观提示
  from his.EXAM_MASTER a
  left join pacs.examinfo pe
    on a.exam_no = pe."ExamItemHISID"
   and pe."ExamSatus" = '6'
  left join pacs.report pr
    on pr."ReportID" = pe."ExamID"
  left join his.pat_visit pv
    on a.patient_id = pv.patient_id and a.visit_id = pv.visit_id
  left join his.pat_master_index pmi
    on a.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
  where a.req_dept in ('030327','030326','030325','030315','030316','030317','021738','021729','021740','021741','021743','021746',
                                 '030122','030124','030125','030112','030113','040506','040507','040509','040510','040519','030225','030227','030228','030219','030222','030425','030210')
  and a.visit_id>0

FXJCPT_YZYP.ddl:
CREATE OR REPLACE FORCE VIEW "ZNT"."FXJCPT_YZYP" ("PATIENT_ID", "VISIT_ID", "INP_NO", "DRUG", "DOSE", "FREQ", "ADMINISTRATION", "START_DATE", "STOP_DATE", "DOCTOR", "REPEAT_INDICATOR") AS 
  select  o.patient_id as patient_id , --患者号
        pv.visit_id as visit_id, --住院次
        pmi.inp_no as inp_no,
        o.order_text as drug, --药品名称
        o.dosage as dose, --剂量
         o.frequency as freq,         --频次
        o.administration as administration, --给药方式
        o.start_date_time as start_date, --医嘱开始时间
        o.stop_date_time as stop_date, --医嘱结束时间
        o.doctor as doctor, --开医嘱医生
        o.REPEAT_INDICATOR as REPEAT_INDICATOR --长期临时
from his.orders o
left join his.pat_visit pv on o.patient_id = pv.patient_id and o.visit_id = pv.visit_id
left join his.pat_master_index pmi on o.patient_id = pmi.patient_id
where o.order_class = 'A' and o.ordering_dept in ('030327','030326','030325','030315','030316','030317','021738','021729','021740','021741','021743','021746',
                                 '030122','030124','030125','030112','030113','040506','040507','040509','040510','040519','030225','030227','030228','030219','030222','030425','030210')
